items.title: 12 Days of Giving
items.description: A man uses his small fortune to spread joy and kindness by anonymously giving Christmas gifts to strangers.

items.title: 17 Miracles
items.description: The Willie / Martin Handcart Company faced seemingly insurmountable hardships on their way to Zion in the Salt Lake Valley so late in the year. Through all they endured with faith and hope, God granted miracles before, during, and after the journey.

items.title: 1984: 40 Years Strong and True
items.description: The 1984 National Champion BYU Football team gathers for a special, roundtable event commemorating that special season. Members of the team share never before heard stories game-by-game, reliving the championship year under head coach LaVell Edwards.

items.title: 23 Blast
items.description: Travis Freeman, a Kentucky teen football hero, loses his sight overnight in 1997 after an infection. With support from family, friends, and his coach, he bravely returns to the field, inspiring his team and leading them to the state finals.

items.title: 48 Christmas Wishes
items.description: Two junior elves lose the Christmas wishes of a small town and go undercover to save Christmas. Along the way, they discover that some wishes can't be granted in a shop as they befriend a broken family.

items.title: Feast or Famine
items.description: On the second day of their journey to the planet Neptune, the misfit crew of the BZ-3 must work together to fix a food shortage and to stop a French killer robot.

items.title: The Sandwich Thief
items.description: When RJ’s sandwich mysteriously disappears, the entire crew must undergo lie detector tests to prove their innocence. Kashmere unplugs from social media and discovers the world around her.

items.title: Easiest Test in the World
items.description: A simple test among the crew leads Natalie and Stuart to a potentially life-threatening discovery. Quincy and Quentin's lemonade stand faces still competition from the robot chef.

items.title: The Harold Herald
items.description: Time is running out for the crew of the BZ-3 when an oxygen leak threatens to end their lives. Harold publishes a tabloid newspaper.

items.title: Final Meal
items.description: Stuart has found the ship's oxygen leak, but has trouble stopping it. The rest of the crew use their weaknesses as their strengths and overcome their differences.

items.title: Talent Show
items.description: Stuart tries fixing M.A.R.T.H.A. after she glitches. Suzy organize a talent show to bring everyone together. They learn that celebrating each other's talents is the true mark of a winner.

items.title: Truth Serum
items.description: Suzy finds an anonymous love letter. Natalie learns an important lesson: You don't win anything when you win a meaningless argument.

items.title: Rawhide
items.description: Phillipe 5000 goes on strike. Suzy and Sasha compete on a cooking show. RJ takes Quentin and Quincy camping and learns that sometimes the biggest thing you can give somebody is a bit of your time.

items.title: Yogurt Party
items.description: Quentin and Quincy learn the importance of keeping promises. Natalie regrets lying to her co-worker.

items.title: The Countdown
items.description: Sasha must return to Earth for medical attention. Stuart learns to finally act on his feelings for Natalie, despite his doubts and fears.

items.description: Space travel meets workplace comedy. Eleven misfit astronauts must get along as they travel to Neptune. Mixing humor with lessons on kindness and problem solving, 9 Years to Neptune is the perfect show for both kids and parents.

items.title: A Bocelli Family Christmas
items.description: A Bocelli Family Christmas captures the wonder and music of the holidays with a mix of classic carols and original songs from the Bocelli family's brand new multi-generational album.

items.title: A Cape Cod Christmas
items.description: A woman returns to her family home in Cape Cod for one last holiday before it’s sold, reuniting with her siblings and her childhood sweetheart.

items.title: A Celtic Family Christmas
items.description: Celtic music stars Natalie MacMaster, Donnell Leahy, and their children present a Christmas performance.

items.title: A Christmas Movie Christmas
items.description: Eve is a die-hard Christmas movie fanatic who dreams of a movie-perfect Christmas with a movie-perfect boyfriend. But when real life refuses to follow the script, she must decide whether the holiday magic she’s chasing is closer than she thinks.

items.title: A Christmas Recipe for Romance
items.description: As the last ditch effort to save her family’s historic inn, a woman enters a holiday cooking contest, forcing her to work with a talented but difficult chef.

items.title: A Christmas Star
items.description: When she learns that her small town will be bulldozed, a young girl with a special gift must use her powers to unite the community and save their home. Featuring Pierce Brosnan and Liam Neeson.

items.title: A Christmas Village
items.description: Piper is promoting her new book on a local show when she meets Tim, owner of a Christmas theme park that is failing. Piper volunteers to help Tim save his park despite her disdain for the season and finds herself the receiver of countless miracles.

items.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson
items.description: Overworked and underappreciated, Lori quits her job and visits a small town in hopes to meet Patrick, a handsome widower featured on a local show. She struggles to tell Patrick the truth of why she came to Hudson after she starts to fall for him.

items.title: A Country Music Christmas
items.description: Songwriter Brooke has the decision of a lifetime to make when a charming executive makes promises of fortune and glory that require leaving her best friend and writing partner behind.

items.title: A Furry Little Christmas
items.description: A big-city veterinarian sets out to recreate a New York City Christmas in a small Vermont town, only to fall for a local doctor along the way. As the holiday season unfolds, he discovers that home and happiness may be waiting where he least expects.

items.title: A Humble Force of Nature - One Musician's Journey to Let God Lead
items.description: When an autoimmune disease threatens gifted pianist Jackie Biggs’ ability to play, she turns to faith, therapy, and determination adapting through chronic pain to pursue her musical dreams and trust God with the path ahead.

items.title: A Kind of Spark: Trailer
items.description: Watch the trailer for BYUtv's newest series.

items.title: Insider: A Kind of Spark
items.description: Go behind the scenes with BYUtv's new series, "A Kind of Spark".

items.title: The Spark
items.description: A field trip ignites Addie's (Lola Blue) desire to solve a centuries-old mystery: what happened to Lady Margaret Fraser? With the help of her older sisters Keedie (Georgia De Gidlow) and Nina (Caitlyn Hamilton), Addie begins her search for answers.

items.title: Juniper
items.description: Addie's older sister Nina gives her a makeover. Later, when Addie gives a speech in front of the town council, she is heartbroken to find that her new best friend Audrey (Eve Midgley), who promised to support her, doesn't show up to hear her speech.

items.title: The Witch List
items.description: Addie and Audrey's solidify their friendship when they go door to door to spread the word about the women who were wrongfully accused as witches. To heal the rift between her twin sisters, Addie plans a party for their upcoming birthday.

items.title: Sisters
items.description: The Darrow sisters and Nina's boyfriend, Frank, go to the city in Addie's search for answers about Maggie's disappearance. While at the University library, Addie discovers some devastating information about Maggie's sister, Elinor.

items.title: Party
items.description: Despite Mr. MacIntosh's strict rules about using the town hall and Miss Murphy's attempts to shut it down, Addie’s birthday party for Nina and Keedie is a success. But when Addie's bully Emily crashes the party, things take a downward turn.

items.title: Nicest Village
items.description: Keedie avoids her new friends out of fear they'll treat her differently if they know she has autism. Addie's fundraising campaign disrupts a beloved town event, which turns into the opportunity Miss Murphy needs to take control of the town council.

items.title: Sleepover
items.description: Addie's mom accidentally invites Jenna to Addie and Audrey's slumber party. Addie reads from Lady Margaret's diary about her attempt to rescue her servant, Beth. Jenna questions Keedie on the rift between her and Miss Murphy.

items.title: Something Wicked
items.description: Backstage drama threatens the school's production of Macbeth. Emily's jealousy reaches a breaking point and lashes out at Addie. Nina and Keedie must then rescue their little sister from the wrath of Miss Murphy.

items.title: Burnout
items.description: Both at low points following their confrontations with Miss Murphy, Addie and Keedie turn to each other for healing. Frank creates a much-needed diversion for Nina when he recruits her to help him find a lost turtle.

items.title: The Way I Am
items.description: Addie's fate at her school is decided. Audrey and Frank discover the amazing story of Lady Margaret's escape, inspiring Addie to make one final plea to the town for a memorial for young women wrongfully accused as witches.

items.title: What’s Next
items.description: Addie’s memorial brings her more attention than she anticipated. A new adventure awaits Addie when she discovers an abandoned bookstore. Keedie makes the connection between an old friend and an online troll.

items.title: Bonnie
items.description: Addie, Audrey, and Jenna work to reopen the village bookstore to keep Pamela Parks from selling it. Keedie joins Nina and Frank at the University Fair but leaves to visit Bonnie, who still has bad feelings about Juniper. Audrey has a choice to make.

items.title: Le Tour De Frank
items.description: Keedie comes to the rescue when costumes are needed for the history tour. Audrey accepts a job helping Miriam. Bonnie visits, hoping to see some change, but insists that Juniper is the same as ever. Addie receives unexpected recognition.

items.title: Shark Day
items.description: Audrey schedules a day off for Addie, hoping to find time to tell her about New York. Keedie and Nina watch the shop in Addie's absence and find evidence that someone has been breaking in. Jenna attempts to catch Jude's eye. Emily rights a wrong.

items.title: Choices
items.description: With the Founders’ Day dance approaching, Addie must find a story from Juniper’s past that the town can all be proud of. Bonnie lets Addie know that she has a story that fits the bill. Nina struggles with her options for college.

items.title: Codebreakers
items.description: The Darrow sisters' sleepover turns chaotic when Bonnie seeks to disrupt their perfect image. Addie uncovers a WWII code-breaking story linked to Verity Loveday, raising questions of truth and loyalty.

items.title: Miriam
items.description: Addie seeks confirmation of the Codebreakers story for the Founders’ Day event. Miriam's reluctance gives way to a touching revelation.

items.title: Juniper at War
items.description: The Founders’ Day dance takes Juniper back to 1944. Addie feels on top of the world but a well-meaning mistake threatens to undo all her good work.

items.title: Runaway
items.description: Panic ensues in Juniper as everyone searches for Addie and Bonnie. With the bookstore vandalized, Emily’s mom seeks an advantage. Tensions rise between Bonnie's parents.

items.title: Safe
items.description: Do Good Books is up for sale and Bonnie is banned from Juniper. But when Addie and her friends find a final clue for the mysterious safe there might be a way to save the shop... and Bonnie too.

items.title: A Little Game
items.description: Max, a 10-year-old girl, is ostracized at her new school and grief-stricken over her grandma’s death. She learns from Norman, a chessmaster, how to persevere through hardship and change.

items.title: A Marriage Made in Heaven
items.description: TV show personality Demetri Chicopoulos meets his guardian angel Johnny and is given the chance to go back in time for one week to mend his broken relationship with his wife and kids, discovering what truly matters in life before it’s too late.

items.title: A Merry Single Christmas
items.description: A woman attempts to rekindle her Christmas spirit, but things get complicated when her ex shows up.

items.title: A More Perfect Union
items.description: From director Peter N. Johnson comes the true story of the Constitutional Convention. In 1797, the Founding Fathers convene, striving to forge “A More Perfect Union” and shape the future of America.

items.title: A Poor Wayfaring Man of Grief by BYU Men’s Chorus
items.description: Listen to the BYU Men's Chorus perform A Poor Wayfaring Man of Grief, a moving Christian hymn about compassion, service, and recognizing Jesus Christ in those around us. This sacred choral performance shares a timeless message of faith.

items.title: A Sacrifice of All Things: The Story of St. George and its Temple
items.description: How a small group of faithful, determined settlers carved the city of St. George out of an arid desert wilderness, and then tackled the additional challenge of building the first LDS temple in the western United States.

items.title: A Swede and A Seed: The Ivar Sandberg Story
items.description: In 1920, after a terrible accident, Swedish teenager Ivar Sandberg started a new life in South Dakota. What began in tragedy for became a miraculous journey of renewal and consecration. An inspiring documentary about faith and redemption.

items.title: A Very Corgi Christmas
items.description: A woman reluctantly returns home during the holidays to care for a mischievous corgi while balancing her career and reconnecting with the townspeople.

items.title: A Very Country Christmas Homecoming
items.description: Complications arise for a country music superstar and his new wife when her former father-in-law throws a wrench into their holiday planning.

items.title: Cougs Go Wild

items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler break down BYU’s 41-23 win over Colorado State in Fort Collins, revisiting the biggest plays, key moments, and takeaways from the Cougar victory.

items.title: A Battle in Forth Worth
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler break down BYU’s gritty 17-10 road win over TCU. The AFR crew revisits the biggest plays, key moments, and defensive stops from a hard-fought battle in Fort Worth.

items.title: Cyclones Sent Packing
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler break down BYU’s 24-10 win over Iowa State, highlighting key defensive stops, offensive plays, and touchdowns before looking ahead to the Cougars’ matchup against Notre Dame.

items.title: Irish Luck Runs Dry
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler break down BYU’s massive 28-24 upset over Notre Dame. From Bear Bachmeier’s stellar performance to the defense’s game-winning stop, the crew relives a night that may rank among the biggest in Provo history.

items.title: Overtime Heartbreak in Orlando
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler recap BYU’s 39-31 double-overtime loss to UCF. The AFR crew revisits the biggest plays, key turning points, and the moments that ultimately decided a hard-fought battle in Orlando.

items.title: Cougars Bring the Heat
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler recap BYU’s spooky 27-20 Halloween win over Arizona State, highlighting key defensive stops, sacks, passing plays, and the biggest moments from a hard-fought battle.

items.title: A Rivalry Rumble
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler recap BYU’s 28-20 loss to Utah. The AFR crew looks at the turnover battle, key moments, and a hard-fought matchup that came down to the final minute.

items.title: Cougars in Control
items.description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler break down BYU’s 28-7 home win over Baylor. They revisit the biggest plays, touchdowns, and key moments while discussing the keys to the game that led the Cougars to victory.

items.title: After the Storm
items.description: A school teacher's world comes crashing down around her after a massive storm destroys her home. Determined to rebuild, she is forced to rely on an old flame to help her.

items.title: After Woodside: A Look Back at Dwight in Shining Armor
items.description: A round table with the cast, hosted by Scout Smith.

items.title: All Glory, Laud and Honor by BYU Men’s Chorus & Alumni Featuring BYU Drumline
items.description: BYU Men's Chorus and alumni perform All Glory, Laud and Honor with the BYU Drumline. This Palm Sunday hymn celebrates Jesus Christ's entry into Jerusalem through vibrant choral harmonies and rhythmic percussion, sharing a message of faith and praise.

items.title: Diving
items.description: Ten teen athletes compete for the title of All-Round Champion. Michael coaches the athletes in diving with the help of Laura Wilkinson, an Olympic gold medalist. They overcome their fears of heights with each new jump.

items.title: Gymnastics
items.description: Sydney coaches the young athletes in gymnastics with the help of Olympic medalist and four-time World Champion Alicia Sacramone Quinn. The athletes have both their stamina and anxieties tested as they strive to learn the essentials of gymnastics.

items.title: Equestrian
items.description: Fenella coaches the other young athletes in equestrian riding as they conquer nerves and fears of horses. Olympic equestrian Jessica Phoenix helps coach and inspire the athletes as they learn to connect to their horses in order to perform better.

items.title: Golf
items.description: Haven mentors the other teen athletes in the art of golf alongside US Women’s Open Champion Brittany Lang. Michael pushes through an injury while Fenella struggles to pick up the golfing technique.

items.title: Skateboarding
items.description: Cayde coaches the other young athletes on skateboarding. After practicing balance with flyboarding, the athletes learn tricks and confidence from Cayde and Professional skateboarder CB Burnside. The athletes struggle with falling and hesitation.

items.title: Swimming
items.description: Jasmine teaches the athletes the fundamentals of swimming alongside 12-time Olympic Medalist Natalie Coughlin. The competition begins to test the athletes like never before as they learn how swimming is more physically demanding than it appears.

items.title: BMX Racing
items.description: Olympian Donny Robinson and Marshall prepare the teen athletes for victory on the BMX track, gaining them more points towards ultimate success and the title of All-Round Champion. To do so, they must conquer their fears and race to the finish line.

items.title: Wakeboarding
items.description: Daniel coaches the other young athletes in wakeboarding. The athletes learn balance and how to perform tricks. Twelve-time world champion Darin Shapiro trains and inspires the athletes as their skills and confidence improve.

items.title: Kart Racing
items.description: NASCAR Winston Cup champion Rusty Wallace helps Faith coach the athletes in the high-speed art of go-kart racing. Adrenaline and stakes run high as the athletes learn the importance of staying focused while competing in this extreme sport.

items.title: Kayaking
items.description: It’s a sentimental last week as Brodie and World Champion Nick Troutman train the teen athletes in kayaking. While bracing the fast-paced current of the river, the athletes also cherish their last moments with their new friends and mentors.

items.title: Arcathlon
items.description: It’s anyone’s game as the athletes compete in their final competition, the first-ever Arcathlon. Through a series of track and field events, the competitors give it their all for a last chance to be titled this season’s All-Round Champion.

items.title: Freestyle Skiing
items.description: Ten elite athletes representing different sports have gathered to compete in the ultimate sports competition. Gage and Olympic champion Jennifer Heil teach freestyle skiing.

items.title: Figure Skating
items.description: Caiyla and Olympic gold medalist Jaime Salé show the athletes the basics of figure skating. They start with rollerblading to practice balance.

items.title: Dog Mushing
items.description: Ellyn and 3-time Iditarod champion Mitch Seavey show the athletes the ropes of dog mushing. Each athlete is given time to bond with their lead dogs promoting unity, focus, and communication.

items.title: Cross Country Skiing
items.description: The athletes learn the grace, balance, and patience required for cross-country skiing from their coaches Evan and Olympic gold medalist Beckie Scott.

items.title: Luge
items.description: Caitlyn and world champion Erin Hamlin teach Luge. The athletes struggle with steering but learn to practice their patience and persistence.

items.title: Snowboarding
items.description: The athletes learn about the creativity required for snowboarding and decorate their own helmets. They learn tips and tricks from the best of the best, Tristan and X-Games Champion Max Parrot.

items.title: Ice Climbing
items.description: The athletes overcome their fear of heights and work on connecting with nature as they master ice climbing. Sloane and North American Champion Gordan McArthur help the team feel brave enough to make the climb.

items.title: Speed Skating
items.description: Speed skating is particularly challenging for the team but they get help from Adam and Olympic champion Derek Parra. They warm up with roller skating and learn to work on posture, speed, and committing to every turn.

items.title: Curling
items.description: Rajan and Olympic champion Kaitlyn Lawes coach the athletes in curling. They sharpen their balance, form, and concentration.

items.title: Arcathlon (Winter) Part 1
items.description: The young athletes compete for the title of All-Round Champion. They compete in snow volleyball, shoe ski slalom, and they get a lesson in skeleton by world champion Noelle Pikus-Pace.

items.title: Arcathlon (Winter) Part 2
items.description: The athletes compete their hardest in the ARCathlon for the title of All-Round Champion. They compete in fat bike racing, a hockey shootout, and snowshoe archery.

items.title: Pole Vault
items.description: Ten elite athletes representing different sports have gathered to compete in the ultimate sports competition. Pole Vault is revealed as the first sport and Lacee must train her fellow athletes for the first competition in only three days.

items.title: Sport Climbing
items.description: The young athletes learn how to sport climb. Sienna and three-time world champion Sean McColl teach the athletes how to boulder, fall, and climb safely.

items.title: Inline Racing
items.description: Chandra and Olympian Jordan Belchos help the young athletes stay on their feet as they learn inline racing. The athletes compete in the longest race in ARC history.

items.title: Soccer
items.description: The young athletes train in soccer, and Emanuel must get them competition ready in three days. Four-time MLS Cup Champion and League MVP Dwane De Rosario helps the athletes with ball control, footwork, passing, touches, and scoring.

items.title: Tennis
items.description: Gabi teaches the athletes tennis. Olympian and twelve-time Grand Slam Champion Daniel Nestor helps them understand the mental toughness and technique needed to win.

items.title: Track Cycling
items.description: Aaron coaches track cycling alongside Curt Harnett, Olympic medalist and Pan Am games champion. Controversy ensues when a competitor doesn’t play fair.

items.title: Boxing
items.description: Sierra and two-time Pan Am Games champion Mandy Bujold train the athletes in boxing. With two gold medals on the line, the athletes fight to make it to the podium.

items.title: Dance
items.description: Phoebe teaches the athletes that dancing takes just as much agility, technique, and skill as any other sport. With the help of choreographer Amanda Cleghorn, she gets the athletes competition-ready in just three days.

items.title: Trampoline
items.description: Jai and Olympic medalist Rosie MacLennan teach the athletes tricks and flips to help them succeed in trampolining. The prank war heats up again.

items.title: Gymnastics
items.description: Carter and Olympian Kyle Shewfelt coach the young athletes in gymnastics and focus on proper technique to succeed. An advantage helps Sierra achieve her goal.

items.title: Arcathlon
items.description: It's time for the Arcathalon and its anyone's game. Each of the athletes compete in four events that will help them earn more points to contribute to their current score. The All-Round Champion is crowned.

items.title: Alpine Skiing
items.description: Ten elite athletes representing both summer and winter sports are competing in the ultimate sports competition. Alpine Skiing is revealed as the first sport and Rebecca must train her fellow athletes for the first competition in only three days.

items.title: Fencing
items.description: It’s Fencing and Jabreel is the Sport Leader. With Épée in hand, it gets intense and grueling; especially for Chace who walks out mid-training. The Sport Star has fun with Noah. Jabreel disses Perdita. A history making podium.

items.title: Powerlifting
items.description: It's Damiyah's sport - Powerlifting. When it comes to training, the athletes are put to various tests that could prove rewarding. The bus breaks down and the athletes are up for a true test of strength. Can Claire three-peat for another medal?

items.title: Boarder Cross
items.description: Chace’s confidence in winter sports returns while Rebecca has a tough time with her prosthetic and seeks the advice of a Boardercross Paralympian. Damiyah is determined to stay upright. The Competition is wild leading to another historic Podium.

items.title: Snowkiting
items.description: It’s Snowkiting and Claire is riding a hot streak. Elle is getting frustrated while Rebecca gets the sense that something is wrong and both are determined to fix it. The Competition proves tough and Nathanaël has an epic meltdown.

items.title: Karate
items.description: It's Karate and while Noah has fun remembering the names of the moves, Claire bleeds and Nathanaël goes down hard. The athletes are in for a few surprises before the Competition. The gold medal is decided with one second remaining in the match.

items.title: Artistic Swimming
items.description: It's Artistic Swimming... Jabreel struggles, Rebecca faces another decision with regards to her prosthetic and Sabrina excels as coach. A shocking announcement is made just before Competition. Another, even bigger shocker comes at Podium.

items.title: Hockey
items.description: It's Hockey... Elle receives stunning news and an early injury while Nathanaël seems to finally be making progress in a winter sport. Claire shares a cause close to her heart. A close competition leads to heartbreak at the Podium.

items.title: Ninja
items.description: The athletes quickly realize that Ninja looks easy but is physically and emotionally draining. Chace struggles, Claire is desperate for the podium and Damiyah makes a phone call that could affect the competition, which takes place in the dark.

items.title: Hurdles
items.description: It’s Hurdles and Liesel has yet to podium and knows its now or never for a medal. Rebecca debates which prosthetic to use during the final week. Chace’s diminutive statue affects his performance and confidence. Surprises abound at the podium.

items.title: Arcathlon
items.description: The Arcathlon is back, this time – Highland Games style! The contest continues with the most physically and mentally demanding events ever in the history of ARC with significant points up for grabs. The Greatest All-Round Champion ever is crowned.

items.title: Track
items.description: As the athletes are about to leave behind family and friends for nine weeks, they are surprised by an epic skydiving opportunity. One of the athletes experiences regret. Track is revealed as the first sport and Samantha must train her fellow athletes

items.title: Rowing
items.description: This week's sport is Rowing and Dominic is the Sport Leader. Tempers flare during training as Maggie and Brayden can’t find a rhythm. Momo has a meltdown trying to adapt while Lily demonstrates empathy even though it could affect her results.

items.title: Wheelchair Boxing
items.description: Lily, former All-Round Champion Sierra, and former WBC amateur national lightweight champion Leo Sammarelli coach the para-athletes in adaptive boxing. They focus on angles, combinations, and the importance of adapting.

items.title: Swimming
items.description: It's Swimming. Things do not start out well for Maggie. Jackson causes a minor emergency which some athletes view as an opportunity. Brad instantly gloats, Dominic can’t seem to float and the competition is going to need a bigger boat!

items.title: Sledge Hockey
items.description: It’s Sledge Hockey and Jackson is riding a hot streak. Training proves hard on Gurnoor, leading to mental stress. Momo needs points and a little extra effort to succeed. Dominic’s frustration continues. History is made at the Podium

items.title: Climbing
items.description: It's Climbing. Jackson aims for a sixth straight podium appearance; Momo is inspired by the Sport Star and Lily adapts to an unusual technique. Brayden takes a moment to inspire his fellow athletes. A pinky promise impacts the podium ceremony.

items.title: Wheelchair Basketball
items.description: It's Wheelchair Basketball... An advantage is on the line and tensions run high between the athletes. Sam is still seething from last week’s results. Lily is hoping to three-peat for a medal and a surprise at the podium proves to be a game-changer.

items.title: Sailing
items.description: Sailing is revealed as the featured sport and a homesick Bradley is the Sport Leader. Momo is super focused but is forced into a dangerous situation. Maggie’s adaptation proves beneficial. Jackson aims for a return to podium from a two-week hiatus.

items.title: Goalball
items.description: It’s Goalball and Dominic is noticeably absent as he deals with a family issue. The athletes are immediately put to the test as they are forced to train without seeing. The Competition makes the athletes happy, but surprises abound at the podium.

items.title: Arcathlon
items.description: With a tie atop the Leaderboard, The Arcathlon is back! The contest continues with the most physically and mentally demanding events ever in the history of ARC with significant points up for grabs. The first-ever Para All-Round Champion is crowned.

items.title: Arcathlon
items.description: Eleven elite athletes meet for the first time, face fears, master new skills and pounce for points in season six's thrilling premiere. With an Arcathlon kickoff to a “game changing” season, it's a heart-pounding battle for supremacy.

items.title: Canoe Sprint
items.description: The canoe sprint is the first sport and Mischa takes charge as Sport Leader. Perdita announces that, for the first time ever, the athletes will compete in pairs throughout the season. The difficult water sport results in a historic podium.

items.title: Beach Volleyball
items.description: The sport is Beach Volleyball and Ariana is Sport Leader. Wil and Deliya are teammates again and must work on communicating. Michael comes back from a rough week in the canoe to dominate on the sand. Elli fights some homesickness, losing focus.

items.title: Pickleball
items.description: It's pickleball and Sport Leader Wil teaches the athletes how to have fun. Mischa misses a day of practice due to sickness. Michael wins the advantage and has the choice to change his teammate which could impact the whole leaderboard.

items.title: Cricket
items.description: Rohan takes on the role of Sport Leader to teach cricket. Mischa battles a shoulder injury and Emily feels some frustration about her spot on the leaderboard. Lexie overcomes a big fear and receives a shoutout. Michael sets a new record.

items.title: Cheer
items.description: It's Cheer and Elli is Sport Leader, joined by Guinness World Record holder Angel Rice. The tension is higher than ever at the halfway point of the season. Lexie works through a concussion. In the end, the gold medal is decided by a single point.

items.title: MMA
items.description: It's MMA, making Braden the Sport Leader. Lexie cannot train or compete due to her concussion, leaving Emily to choose a new opponent. Perdita gives an extra shoutout to a special corner partner. Braden gets injured while teaching the athletes.

items.title: Sync Diving
items.description: This week it's Synchronized Diving and Lexie is the Sport Leader! All of the athletes struggle to jump off the high diving platforms. Perdita faces a fear of her own. Wil and Rohan make a last-minute decision that impacts the podium results.

items.title: Breaking
items.description: It's Breaking and Emily is the Sport Leader. Braden's past experience in the sport helps his team excel. Ariana and Lexie are disappointed by the standings. Tensions rise when one athlete refuses to vote for a shoutout, but receives one themself.

items.title: Teqball
items.description: It's Teqball and Michael is Sport Leader. The athletes struggle with learning such a unique sport. Wil loses positivity. Lexie and Braden redeem themselves from Beach Volleyball. The leaderboard stays close nearing the end of the competition.

items.title: Roller Derby
items.description: This week's sport is Roller Derby and Deliya takes charge as Sport Leader. Lexie faces more injuries playing the contact sport. Emily faces a disadvantage during the final competition. The underdog team tilts the leaderboard significantly.

items.title: Ice Dancing
items.description: Ice Dance is the last sport and Woolf is the Sport Leader. It's an emotional week as everyone prepares to compete for the belt and say goodbye. The athletes are shocked to learn they will have one more chance to earn points in another Arcathlon.

items.title: Finale
items.description: To end a season of game changers, the athletes compete in an Arcathlon for the second time--and they compete in pairs! With a close leaderboard, it's anyone's game and tensions are high. The winner is crowned, taking the belt by just 3 points!

items.title: Mum's the Word
items.description: Amelia is worried about finding the right look for her dance recital. Thankfully, she has Cleo in her corner.

items.title: Field Trippin'
items.description: Amelia decides to forge a permission slip so she can go on a field trip with her classmates but has to face the consequences when she feels sick.

items.title: She Lives in Us
items.description: Amelia tries to continue the birthday traditions that her late mother started with Nathan. Victoria offers to tutor Vikram.

items.title: Learning by Heart
items.description: Amelia struggles to communicate with her first crush, as Tony fights to stop Amelia being streamlined.

items.title: Just the Two of Us?
items.description: Amelia has her first American sleepover at Declynn’s. Their friendship progresses when they go on an adventure back to Amelia’s to retrieve her forgotten head wrap.

items.title: Out of Bounds
items.description: Amelia must stand up for herself when she’s pressured to join the soccer team. Cleo realizes her youngest, Charlie, is not so little anymore.

items.title: Best Friends Forever?
items.description: Amelia’s best friend and her godmother come to visit from England, but they don’t get along like they thought they would. Cleo tries to bridge the divide between their family and their English friends.

items.title: Four’s Company
items.description: Amelia learns to set boundaries when Nathan takes over the movie she’s making with her friends. Nick overstays his welcome at Roger’s house.

items.title: Sole to Soul
items.description: Amelia wins a songwriting competition, but is terrified to perform the song in front of people. When Nick switches sponsors for more money, Nathan worries his cousin is a sell-out.

items.title: Joy
items.description: Amelia decides to push herself to speak, but learns her trauma runs deeper than she thought. Through his driving lessons, Nathan must deal with his unresolved feelings around his mother’s death.

items.title: America's Sacred Ground: Kirtland
items.description: Kirtland, Ohio from 1831 to 1838 was host to many miracles. Using eyewitness accounts, this documentary examines the faith of the people who lived here and the remarkable spiritual events they experienced as they learned the teachings of Jesus Christ

items.title: The New World
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth traces the historical origins of freedom and independence back to the Renaissance and examines how these concepts inspired the creation of the New World colonies.

items.title: Seeds of Independence
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Mount Vernon and introduces a key player in the founding of the United States, George Washington.

items.title: Trigger of the Revolution
items.description: Stan Ellsworth tells the story of the daring pilgrims of the Plymouth colony and details how their experiences created the idea behind a government “for the people, by the people.”

items.title: The Die Has Now Been Cast
items.description: A trip to Lexington, Massachusetts has host Stan Ellsworth breaking down Paul Revere’s famous ride and examining the first hours of the Revolutionary War.

items.title: Miracle of Ticonderoga
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares how the events at Lexington and Concord inspire Ethan Allen and the Green Mountain Boys to unite with Benedict Arnold to take over Fort Ticonderoga.

items.title: We Hold These Truths to Be Self-Evident
items.description: The Continental Congress meets in Philadelphia to discuss the destiny of the new nation. Host Stan Ellsworth examines the critical moments leading up to the creation of the Declaration of Independence.

items.title: Miracle at New York
items.description: A tour of New York City has host Stan Ellsworth describe the critical role that New York plays in the Revolution. General William Howe challenges George Washington and prepares to launch an attack against the colonies.

items.title: The Crisis
items.description: Following Washington’s surrender in New York, Thomas Payne writes The Crisis and encourages the Continental Army to strike back. Host Stan Ellsworth shares the details behind Washington’s crossing of the Delaware river.

items.title: The Battle of Saratoga
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth analyzes the Battle of Saratoga, New York. Alexander Bryan is sent as a spy for General Horatio Gates as the Saratoga campaign looms on the horizon.

items.title: Refiner's Fire
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits Valley Forge and explains its importance in determining the course of the revolution. Stan emphasizes the importance of faith in George Washington’s success as a military leader.

items.title: The War Goes South
items.description: In Charleston, South Carolina, host Stan Ellsworth travels to Fort Moultrie to investigate the events that brought the Revolutionary War to the South.

items.title: Victory of the Common Man
items.description: At the Battle of Cowpens in South Carolina, General Daniel Morgan leads the patriots to victory by trapping the British troops in a complex double envelopment. Host Stan Ellsworth shares what makes this campaign his favorite in the Revolutionary War.

items.title: Patriots' Finest Hour
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the origins of the United States Navy and shares how an alliance with France guides the Patriots to victory.

items.title: We The People--A Miracle
items.description: Facing unrest after the revolution, the nation’s delegates meet at Independence Hall to draft the United States Constitution. Host Stan Ellsworth explores the ideas that made the Constitution possible.

items.title: Now What? Doubling Our Size
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the many challenges faced by George Washington during his tenure as the first president of the United States.

items.title: Into the Great Unknown
items.description: After making a deal with Napoleon Bonaparte, Thomas Jefferson expands the nation with the Louisiana Purchase and sends Lewis and Clark on their famous expedition.

items.title: Hanging On to What We've Got
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth breaks down the causes of the War of 1812. President James Madison is forced to act swiftly as the British troops invade Washington, D.C., while Andrew Jackson defends New Orleans.

items.title: Discovery Continues
items.description: Westward expansion creates icons like Daniel Boone and Johnny Appleseed as settlers venture into the American frontier.

items.title: The Mountain Men
items.description: The fur trade brings adventure, exploration, and greed to the American frontier. Mountain men like Jim Bridger connect the Eastern and Western United States through trade.

items.title: Rivers and Railroads
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth explains why the creation of canals and railroads made the American economy vastly successful in the early 19th century and tells the story of a momentous race that redefined transportation in America.

items.title: The Growing Stain of Slavery
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits the National Underground Railroad Freedom Center in Cincinnati, Ohio, to share the heroic stories of the Underground Railroad. Museum curator Dina Bailey explains the impact of the abolition movement in US history.

items.title: From Sea to Shining Sea
items.description: As American settlers move into the Texas territory, war breaks out with the historic Battle of the Alamo. Host Stan Ellsworth visits New Mexico to break down the causes of the Mexican American War.

items.title: Go West, Young Man
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth tracks each of the important pioneer movements from the Oregon Trail to the Mormon exodus. Through the stories of the pioneers, Stan emphasizes the significance of Manifest Destiny in American history.

items.title: Moving Forward
items.description: The Pony Express connects the country like never before with its short lived, yet revolutionary mail service. Stan Ellsworth shares the stories of the riders who braved the ten day trek across the country to deliver the mail.

items.title: Different Visions, Different Dreams
items.description: Different ideas about the nature of America’s government and economy separate the Northern and Southern states as the Industrial Revolution changes the character of the United States.

items.title: A House Divided
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth examines how a series of failed compromises between the Northern and Southern states, the Dred-Scott case, and the election of Abraham Lincoln ignite the Civil War.

items.title: Mr. Lincoln's War
items.description: After a tense election, President Abraham Lincoln becomes a pivotal figure in the Civil War. Host Stan Ellsworth shares the stories that shape Lincoln’s character and political career.

items.title: The Fires of Secession
items.description: Visits to Fort Sumter and Manassas National Battlefield Park has host Stan Ellsworth recount the first major battles of the Civil War. The First Battle of Bull Run illustrates how long and deadly the Civil War will be.

items.title: From the Jaws of Victory (They Snatched Defeat)
items.description: New technology like armored battleships alter how the Civil War is fought. Host Stan Ellsworth describes the importance of naval blockades in the Union’s strategy.

items.title: The Cost of Freedom
items.description: The Civil War proves to be more costly than expected as new artillery hits the scene. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the site of Second Manassas where the Union army faces defeat.

items.title: Changing of the Guard: Lee and Grant
items.description: Learn about the genius of General Robert E. Lee, the last great warrior of the Napoleonic age, and discover what made General Grant the first warrior of a new era.

items.title: Gettysburg
items.description: The Battle of Gettysburg changes the course of the war as the Union Army prevails and the Confederates face considerable defeat. Stan examines the strategies of both sides during this pivotal battle at Gettysburg.

items.title: Price of Honor
items.description: Campaigns during the summer of 1863 give the Union Army the upper hand. Stan shares the story of the 54th Massachusetts, the all-black infantry regiment who led the assault on Fort Wagner in South Carolina.

items.title: March to the Sea
items.description: General William Sherman advances the Union Army for Savannah, destroying the Confederate economy along the way. Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Georgia to follow the course of Sherman’s crusade.

items.title: On to Richmond
items.description: Generals Ulysses S. Grant and Robert E. Lee face-off in a series of battles during the Overland Campaign of 1864. Host Stan Ellsworth shares how the strategy of a young Union soldier wins the entire war for General Grant.

items.title: Lost Cause
items.description: After a devastating failure at the Battle of the Crater, General Ulysses S. Grant leads the Union Army to victory in the Siege of Petersburg.

items.title: Brothers Again
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Appomattox where General Lee surrenders to General Grant. After years of conflict and destruction, the Civil War comes to an end.

items.title: The Rest of the Story
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares what happened to Civil War icons like Robert E. Lee and George McClellan after the South’s surrender.

items.title: Legacy of Lincoln
items.description: Days after the Civil War ends, President Abraham Lincoln is assassinated by John Wilkes Booth. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the site of the assassination to explore the events that led to that fateful night.

items.title: Dust in the Wind
items.description: Following Lincoln’s death, tensions between the North and South run high as plans for Reconstruction are underway. Stan shares stories of the Bushwhackers and the Jayhawkers of the Wild West.

items.title: Rails, Trails, and Boomtowns
items.description: The transcontinental railroad connects the country like never before, as rumors of gold bring thousands out West.

items.title: Wanderers, Vagabonds, Drifters, and Saddletramps
items.description: Stan travels to Texas to share the true story of the American cowboy and the important role the beef industry has in the post-war economy.

items.title: Bad Company
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares the stories of American icons like Clay Allison, John Wesley Hardin, and Calamity Jane who put the “wild” in the Wild West.

items.title: Order from Chaos
items.description: As crime runs rampant in the Wild West, lawmen like Bat Masterson and Wild Bill Hickok bring order to the chaos.

items.title: Lookin' Fer Trouble
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth shares stories of some of the Wild West’s most iconic and infamous outlaws, gunfights and crime sprees.

items.title: The Earps
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Dodge City, Kansas, to visit the site where Western legend Wyatt Earp’s story began.

items.title: How the West Was Lost--Part 1
items.description: While the prospect of great success brings settlers to the American frontier, the Lakota Nation fights to keep their land and their culture alive. Host Stan Ellsworth details the challenges the Lakota leaders face during this era.

items.title: How the West Was Lost--Part 2
items.description: Stan follows the trail of the Nez Perce, recounting the heroic tale of their leader Chief Joseph in his fight to protect their land from invading settlers.

items.title: Range Wars
items.description: Disputes over land between cattle barons and incoming settlers ignite a series of range wars across the Western states. Stan visits the sites of these conflicts to discover how the beef industry became bloody.

items.title: The Barbary Coast: End of An Era
items.description: Stan shares the stories of entrepreneurs like Leland Stanford and George Hearst who found great success in California and developed it into the great state it is today.

items.title: The Last Round-Up
items.description: The age of the Wild West comes to an end as new technology outsmarts famous crime gangs. Host Stan Ellsworth recounts the final days of America’s legendary outlaws.

items.title: The Romance and Mystique of the American West
items.description: Tall tales, dime novels, stage shows, and early motion pictures immortalize the days of the Wild West. Host Stan Ellsworth tracks the history of these stories as they become forever associated with the American identity.

items.title: Time for a Change
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth ushers in the Gilded Age by introducing the key political players of the late 19th century of Chester A. Arthur and Grover Cleveland.

items.title: Immigrant Song
items.description: During the Gilded Age, immigrants from China, Ireland, Italy, and Mexico pour into America seeking a fresh start, opportunity and success.

items.title: Age of Genius
items.description: Inventors like Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla use their inventions to reinvent modern life during the Gilded Age. Stan shares the stories of these pioneers and how their contributions to technology changed the world.

items.title: Captains of Industry
items.description: Titans of the Industrial Revolution like Andrew Carnegie, John D. Rockefeller, and Cornelius Vanderbilt find massive economic success in the early 20th century. Stan shares how these men transformed the nature of American industry.

items.title: Civil Rights, Civil Wrongs
items.description: As industry and commerce boom during the Gilded Age, civil rights movements emerge to protect the rights of workers, women, and African Americans. Stan explores the events that inspire these social awakenings across the country.

items.title: Remember The Maine!
items.description: The Spanish-American War begins as control over the Philippines and Cuba is contested. Host Stan Ellsworth examines how the influence of yellow journalism fans the flames of the war.

items.title: Bull Moose and His Big Stick
items.description: Stan recounts the life and legacy of Theodore Roosevelt and describes how his achievements as president made America a global superpower.

items.title: The Gathering Darkness
items.description: President Woodrow Wilson ushers in a new age of American politics with multiple pioneering policies. Host Stan Ellsworth describes President Wilson’s struggle to remain neutral as war ignites in Europe.

items.title: Over There
items.description: Stan travels to France to examine the events that brought the United States into World War I where trench warfare and new technologies prove to be costly to the Allied forces.

items.title: The War to End All Wars
items.description: Stan travels to France to share the story of the Meuse–Argonne offensive led by Sergeant Alvin York. The results of the offensive push the Central powers to an armistice and lead to the creation of the Treaty of Versailles.

items.title: The Roaring '20s
items.description: An industrial boom after the Great War ushers in an era of excess as Broadway, Hollywood, and baseball provide the average American with new forms of entertainment.

items.title: End of a Dream
items.description: The Roaring ‘20s come to a screeching halt as the stock market crash of 1929 devastates the American economy. Professor of Economics Larry T. Wimmer breaks down how certain economic practices led to this infamous era.

items.title: To Notre Dame
items.description: In this special edition of American Ride, host Stan Ellsworth travels to South Bend, Indiana, to share the history of the University of Notre Dame.

items.title: FDR
items.description: After years of economic turmoil, President Franklin D. Roosevelt offers America a new hope. Stan breaks down Roosevelt’s innovative strategies that helped heal the nation.

items.title: Day of Infamy
items.description: The United States is thrust into World War II following the attack on Pearl Harbor. Stan travels to Pearl Harbor to honor the fallen and introduce the factors that led to the “Day of Infamy.”

items.title: The Giant Arises
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth details the boom of American industry as World War II creates new demands overseas. At home, patriotism runs high as women join the workforce to support the war effort.

items.title: Bloodied but Unbowed
items.description: Stan highlights the impact of the Battle of Midway as it changes the tides of the war while innovative naval strategies give the United States an advantage in their defense against Japan.

items.title: Wolf Pack/Shadow War
items.description: U-boats, espionage, and propaganda campaigns create new challenges for the United States as World War II rages on.

items.title: Sacred Honor
items.description: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor, American suspicion and prejudice increases, leading President Franklin D. Roosevelt to authorize the creation of internment camps for Japanese American citizens.

items.title: Terrible Swift Sword
items.description: Stan introduces the important military leaders of the United States’ war efforts–Generals George C. Marshall, Dwight D. Eisenhower, and George S. Patton–and shares their stories of success on behalf of the Allied forces.

items.title: Overlord
items.description: Stan travels to the beaches of Normandy to visit the site of the famous WWII offensive Operation Neptune and shares the Allies’ strategy to liberate France.

items.title: Across the Pacific
items.description: Operation Cartwheel unfolds in the Pacific Theater with a series of costly battles. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the Pacific to detail the United States’ operations during its arduous campaign against the Japanese Empire.

items.title: On to Victory
items.description: The outcome of the Battle of the Bulge paves the way for an Allied victory against Nazi Germany. Stan details the roles of General Patton and President Roosevelt in bringing the war to an end.

items.title: Uncommon Valor
items.description: As V-Day is celebrated across the globe, the conflict in the Pacific Theater rages on. The United States gains new ground in a series of campaigns against the Japanese Empire.

items.title: Cost of Victory
items.description: The dropping of atomic bombs in Japan and the horrors of the Holocaust take a massive toll on human life across the globe. Host Stan Ellsworth traces the origins of both events and honors the legacies of the lives lost.

items.title: Sand, Surf, and Celebration: Miami
items.description: Stan travels to Miami to discover the history of a colorful city full of adventure and rich Latin American heritage.

items.title: Southern Belles: Charleston and Savannah
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth explores two of the biggest cities in the South–Savannah, Georgia and Charleston, South Carolina–and highlights their beautiful scenery and haunted pasts.

items.title: Smoky Mountains
items.description: A trip through the Appalachian Mountains finds host Stan Ellsworth learning the history of bluegrass music and discovering the beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

items.title: Land of the Conquistadores: La Florida
items.description: Stan travels to Florida, a land of mystery and adventure with a rich history that dates back to the early 16th century. As he adventures down the A1A, Stan explores the wildlife, tourism, and industry that populates the Florida coast today.

items.title: Legends and Legacy--Part 1: American Pirates
items.description: Stan’s visit to North Carolina has him track down the story of one of the most popular icons in American history, the pirate Blackbeard.

items.title: Liberty: The Hope of Every Human Heart
items.description: Stan tours Washington D.C. and explores numerous memorials, monuments, and museums that honor the Founding Fathers and our nation’s history.

items.title: Baltimore: The Star-Spangled City
items.description: Stan travels to Baltimore, Maryland to discover the history, icons, and cuisine that make up the “Charm City.”

items.title: Pennsylvania: Home of Religious Tolerance
items.description: Philadelphia enters the spotlight as Host Stan Ellsworth explores the important movements that made it a haven for political and religious freedom.

items.title: Legends and Legacy: The Salem Witch Trials
items.description: The Salem Witch Trials leave a dark stain on Massachusetts' history. Stan Ellsworth meets with Stacy Tilney, director of communications at the Salem Witch Museum to trace the events that led to a fateful era full of hysteria and injustice.

items.title: Nantucket: Children of the Sea
items.description: Nantucket, Massachusetts becomes the whaling capital of the world in the 19th century. Host Stan Ellsworth explores the island and learns more about the whaling industry at the Nantucket Whalers Museum.

items.title: Atlanta: City of Dreams
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Atlanta, Georgia to visit the important sites that inspired Civil Rights leader Martin Luther King Jr.

items.title: Kentucky Thunder
items.description: Stan travels to the famous Kentucky Horse Park to learn about Kentucky’s history as the horse capital of the world.

items.title: Music City
items.description: Stan swings through Nashville, Tennessee to learn about the icons and events that earned it the title of “Music City.”

items.title: Ol' Man River
items.description: Memphis, Tennessee is a hub of commerce, culture, and cuisine along the Mississippi River. Host Stan Ellsworth learns about the impact of the Mississippi River, the cotton industry, and blues music on Memphis’ history.

items.title: California Dreamin'
items.description: Along the Pacific Coast, Stan visits multiple California towns that were the homes of some of the greatest artists of the 20th century.

items.title: City by the Bay
items.description: Stan makes his way to San Francisco and reflects on its rich history as a hub of 19th century immigration, shares stories of its famous landmarks and sports icons, and tells of its resilience after the tragic earthquake of 1906.

items.title: Redwoods
items.description: Further up the Pacific Coast, Host Stan Ellsworth marvels at the majesty and history of the Redwood Forest.

items.title: The Emerald City
items.description: Once a capital of the lumber industry, Seattle has become a center of innovation. Stan traces the history of the city and finds how the aviation and technology industries brought success to the Pacific Coast.

items.title: The North West Passage
items.description: Stan explores the San Juan Islands, home to some of the richest biodiversity in the country and the site of the Pig War of 1859.

items.title: Legacy of Liberty
items.description: Stan tours the many historical sites of Boston, Massachusetts and details how the city’s history has created a lasting impact on its citizens.

items.title: Sons of the South
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth travels to Williamsburg, Virginia to study how the contributions of overlooked patriots Patrick Henry and Richard Henry Lee paved the way to American Independence.

items.title: Storm Bringers
items.description: In Boston, Massachusetts four members of the Sons of Liberty fan the flames of the Revolution. Stan shares the stories of Founding Fathers Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Paul Revere, and Joseph Warren as he tours the great city.

items.title: Sage of the Age: Dr. Benjamin Franklin
items.description: A journey to Philadelphia has host Stan Ellsworth recounting the life of Founding Father Benjamin Franklin.

items.title: The Indispensable Man: George Washington
items.description: Stan discovers the true history of George Washington and details his humble beginnings in West Virginia and his tenure as the first President of the United States.

items.title: The Eagle & Dove: Adams & Jefferson--Part 1
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth spotlights two of the most prominent Founding Fathers, John Adams and Thomas Jefferson, and recounts what inspired them to lead the fight for American Independence.

items.title: Friends, Foes & Friends Again: Adams & Jefferson—Part 2
items.description: Thomas Jefferson and John Adams face off in the contentious election of 1800. Stan visits the Massachusetts Historical Society to learn of the events that drew these Founding Fathers apart.

items.title: The Federalist: Alexander Hamilton
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth recounts the life of Alexander Hamilton, an unsung Founding Father, pioneering patriot, and George Washington’s right-hand man.

items.title: The Architect of American Government: James Madison
items.description: Stan travels across Virginia and Pennsylvania to discover the contributions of James Madison as a framer, founder, and president of the United States.

items.title: The Last Cocked Hat: James Monroe
items.description: One of the least known Founding Fathers James Monroe rises through the ranks and becomes the fifth President of the United States. Host Stan Ellsworth travels through Virginia to trace the pivotal events in Monroe’s life.

items.title: Ladies of Liberty
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth highlights the contributions of Martha Washington and Abigail Adams during their years as First Lady of the United States.

items.title: JQA
items.description: John Quincy Adams wins the election of 1824, causing a rift between the two political parties of the time. Host Stan Ellsworth visits historical sites from Adams’ life to study the events that shaped the sixth President of the United States.

items.title: Old Hickory and Jacksonian Democracy (1829-1837)
items.description: A trip to Tennessee has host Stan Ellsworth recounting the life and legacy of the seventh President of the United States, Andrew Jackson.

items.title: Times of Turmoil: Van Buren, Harrison and Tyler
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth visits the homelands of presidents Martin Van Buren, William Henry Harrison, and John Tyler to share stories of their time in office.

items.title: The Alamo
items.description: Across Texas, host Stan Ellsworth explores the rich history of the Lone Star State, from the Battle of the Alamo to the Texas Revolution.

items.title: James K. Polk: A Man On A Mission
items.description: President James K. Polk expands the country further west, bringing economic success and tense political conflicts to the nation. Host Stan Ellsworth visits the important sites in Polk’s life to recount the major events of his presidency.

items.title: A Time of Compromise: Zachary Taylor and Millard Fillmore
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth examines the impact of westward expansion and the question of slavery on the presidencies of Zachary Taylor and Millard Fillmore.

items.title: Times Of Trouble: Franklin Pierce & James Buchanan
items.description: Franklin Pierce and James Buchanan enter the spotlight as host Stan Ellsworth studies how divisive actions of their presidencies drove the Union apart.

items.title: A Time of Crisis: Abraham Lincoln and the Case for Union
items.description: Host Stan Ellsworth commemorates the presidency of Abraham Lincoln and visits the Gettysburg National Cemetery to honor the site of his famous Gettysburg Address.

items.title: Triumph and Tragedy: Andrew Johnson and Reconstruction
items.description: Stan travels to Tennessee to uncover the true story of one of the nation’s most misunderstood presidents, Andrew Johnson.

items.title: The Enforcer of Federalism: Ulysses S. Grant
items.description: President Ulysses S. Grant attempts to piece the Union back together during Reconstruction. Host Stan Ellsworth tracks Grant’s career from his days in the Mexican-American War to his tenure as the 18th President of the United States.

items.title: An Evening with Marie Osmond
items.description: Award-winning entertainer Marie Osmond performs some of her biggest hits. Highlighting key moments from her career, she shares personal stories and also sings a variety of music. Featuring guest performers David Osmond and Daniel Emmet.

items.title: Getting Started
items.description: After facing racism from a young age, Victor Villasenor shares how through genealogy he learned that anybody’s story can be wonderful. Author Desmond Walls Allen explains the standard format for anyone getting started with family history.

items.title: Looking at Home
items.description: Shannon Applegate discovered the importance of searching for family belongings. Antonia Conttrell Martin describes the process of looking for history in our homes and completing group records.

items.title: Gathering Family Stories
items.description: Fabiana Chiu shares how learning about her Chinese and Peruvian heritage gave her a clear identity. Author Bill Zimmerman explains how to prepare and organize an interview to record oral histories.

items.title: The Paper Trail
items.description: Rafael Guber learned that remembering his ancestors gave life to names on paper. Sharon DeBartolo Carmak explains how to bridge genealogy gaps using compiled records.

items.title: Libraries and Archives
items.description: Tom Madrid learns about his hispanic heritage. Jim and Terry Willard take a field trip to the family history library in Salt Lake City and learn that specific objectives can help them branch out on their family trees.

items.title: Census and Military Records
items.description: Garry Bryant describes his change of heart to serve in the military after learning about his genealogy. Curt Witcher shares how to use census records and military records to expand our family research.

items.title: African American Research
items.description: Collete DeVerge and Tony Burroughs share how they have been able to discover their African American heritage through specific documents and processes.

items.title: Your Medical Heritage
items.description: Discovering her family’s medical history saved Carol Krause’s life. Dr. Raymond White and Vickie I. Venne describe the process of creating a medical pedigree and analyzing the health impact of genetics.

items.title: High-Tech Help
items.description: Prison inmates share how technology has revolutionized their ability to research family history and helped them become accepted again. Richard Eastman explains the process and tools of online genealogy databases.

items.title: Leaving a Legacy
items.description: Eric, Neeci, and Hannibal share how family history research has reunited them with their ancestors and living family members. They can then carry on their ancestors' legacies and create their own.

items.title: Records at Risk
items.description: Genealogy experts explain the dangers of natural disasters and carelessness that cause genealogical destruction. They share how family history records can be preserved and restored.

items.title: Family Records
items.description: Suzanne Ballard shares how a scrap of paper connected her to her Irish ancestors. Genealogical experts discuss the importance of family records from diaries to family bibles, from letters to photographs.

items.title: Compiled Records
items.description: Sheila Hsia honors her Chinese ancestors by keeping record of her family history. Genealogy experts share how compiled records can be an invaluable resource in finding what research has already been done on a family line.

items.title: Genealogy and Technology
items.description: Megan Smolenyak used technology to take her family history all the way to Estonia. Genealogy experts share how family history and technology can be used as an invaluable tool.

items.title: Vital Records
items.description: Jeff Gallup uses vital records, death, marriage, and birth certificates, to rebuild his Italian culture. Genealogy experts discuss what vital records contain and how to find them.

items.title: Religious Records
items.description: Greg Spacher discovers that his German heritage also includes French blood. He and genealogy experts use religious records, baptisms, marriage, and burial information, to fill missing gaps in family histories.

items.title: Cemetery Records
items.description: Cemetery records are made up of death, burial, and gravesite information. Beth Uyehare and genealogy experts use those records to find their ancestors.

items.title: Census Records
items.description: Darius Gray and genealogy experts use census records to find the occupation, ages, and relationships of their ancestors.

items.title: Military Records
items.description: Susan Hadler uses service records to learn about her father killed in war. Genealogy experts describe the types of military records, including pension and service records.

items.title: Newspapers as Records
items.description: From newspaper records, Lori Davis learns about her ancestor who was a con-artist. Genealogy experts describe how news about ancestors can be found and how it helps with family history.

items.title: Probate Records
items.description: Bruce Stewart and genealogy experts learn about their ancestors from probate records, or the wills and other documents ancestors leave after their death.

items.title: Immigration Records
items.description: Cathy Horn unveils family history secrets through immigration records. Genealogy experts discuss ship passenger lists and naturalization records.

items.title: Writing a Family History
items.description: Taylor MacDonald preserves his family history in a manuscript. Genealogy experts discuss the organization and publication of a written family history.

items.title: Dream Giver
items.description: Where do dreams come from? A magical creature unlocks the subconscious imaginings of children as they sleep.

items.title: Estefan
items.description: Estefan is the world's greatest hairdresser; however, his latest client proves to be a challenge.

items.title: Metro
items.description: A ticket purchase to ride the metro train leads a young woman to a fantastical discovery.

items.title: Owned
items.description: An unwitting slacker faces off against a baby in the ultimate video game challenge.

items.title: Papa
items.description: An overprotective angel does everything in his power to sabotage his daughter’s first date.

items.title: Grendel
items.description: A dragon’s peaceful and solitary existence is disrupted when pesky Vikings settle on his island.

items.title: Ram's Horn
items.description: An adventurer faces off against a mountain goat in a quest to scale a difficult mountain peak.

items.title: Salt
items.description: A Senegalese mother helps her daughter find joy in the sounds and rhythms of their everyday life.

items.title: Stowaway
items.description: A young sea monster is accidentally brought aboard a pirate ship.

items.title: Taijitu
items.description: A young boy must confront his fears when he is chosen to live in a remote monastery.

items.title: Cenote
items.description: When Axel, a young axolotl, gets separated from his family by ancient magic it’s up to him and Memo, an unlikely human ally, to get him out of the Cenote he’s trapped in and back to his home.

items.title: Xing
items.description: The ghost of an armadillo is frustrated by her still-living boyfriend’s wishy-washiness.

items.title: Turtles
items.description: An inconsiderate turtle gets his comeuppance while attempting to grab a bite to eat.

items.title: Pajama Gladiator
items.description: A boy recounts to his mother his fantastical abduction by aliens.

items.title: Lion and the Mouse
items.description: A timid mouse comes to the rescue of the lion who spared his life.

items.title: Lemmings
items.description: A reluctant lemming has second thoughts about jumping off a cliff.

items.title: Kites
items.description: A boy takes a magical journey on a kite as he mourns the loss of his grandfather.

items.title: Las Pinatas
items.description: In sunny Mexico, two pinatas must survive a birthday party.

items.title: Chasm
items.description: A brilliant scientist travels through time and space to find her husband who disappeared years earlier.

items.title: The Witch's Cat
items.description: Jealousy strikes a witch’s cat when the witch’s boyfriend proposes, prompting the cat to take drastic action in this heartwarming tale of love, acceptance, and forgiveness.

items.title: Animation & Imagination - Teaching Children the Language of Art
items.description: BYU students step beyond the classroom to teach children the language of art, discovering how creativity can build confidence, connect diverse voices, strengthen faith, and transform both the students and the children they mentor.

items.title: Annabelle Hooper and the Ghosts of Nantucket
items.description: A teenaged mystery writer travels to Nantucket, Massachusetts, where she uncovers a legendary ghost story and must outwit two thieves to solve a centuries-old riddle.

items.title: Art of Falling in Love
items.description: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

items.title: Brian Kershisnik / Paige Anderson
items.description: Painter and sculptor Brian Kershisnik reveals his sources of inspiration for his artwork. Paige Anderson describes how she balances creating art and being present with her family.

items.title: Zachary Proctor / Beth Krensky
items.description: Experience the works of Zachary Proctor and Beth Krensky. These two unique artists share their thoughts on what it takes to create art and identify their true source of inspiration.

items.title: Fidalis Buehler / Christine Armbruster
items.description: Fidalis Buehler's life has been a blending of cultures that he pulls on to paint works full of meaning. He uses his art to ask difficult questions. Christine Armbruster is a true people person and uses her strengths to photograph individuals.

items.title: Colby Sanford / Joe & Melinda Ostraff
items.description: Colby Sanford realized early on that Heavenly Father wanted him to do something that added positive value to his life. Joe and Melinda Ostraff are a married couple who share a studio and collaborate to create beautiful works of art together.

items.title: Emily McPhie / Cassandra Barney
items.description: Emily Mcphie is a painter who believes that her works are a way to express her spiritual identity. Cassandra Barney is a painter and costumer who considers her relationships with others to be the sustaining and creative voice behind her passion.

items.title: Fatima Ronquillo / Justin Wheatley
items.description: Fatima Ronquillo is a self-taught artist who is constantly working to explore her own identity through painting. Justin Wheatley is a painter who likes to find the “divine moments” in ordinary places and paints structures set in natural spaces.

items.title: Tony Abeyta / Del Curfman
items.description: Tony Abeyta believes that being a mentor is an important way to show gratitude to the people who gave him opportunities throughout his life. Del Curfman has been the recipient of Tony’s mentorship and hopes to bring art education to his tribe.

items.title: Ben Behunin / Wren Ross
items.description: Ben Behunin is a potter and writer. He created a beautiful home full of his art because he believes home should be a sanctuary. Wren Ross is a painter who also makes sketchbooks. It is clear to her that God works through art to connect with people.

items.title: Emilia Wing / David Habben
items.description: Emilia Wing paints aerial views of cities and wants her art to help people connect with place and with Christ in a deeper way that they haven’t before. David Habben is a graphic designer who believes that if you will ask, God will guide you in your w

items.title: Justin Taylor / Christian Bolt
items.description: Justin Taylor knows that God cares about visual things. He believes that people are divine, and he uses his art to explore humanity. Christian Bolt is a sculptor who strongly believes in inspiration.

items.title: Brittany Scott / Steve & Tonya Vistaunet
items.description: Brittany Scott is a figure painter who found that doubt and failure are a natural part of progression as she co-created with God. Steve and Tonya Vistaunet make art from the heart with a use of color that invokes the joy they felt called to foster.

items.title: Rebecca Klundt / J Kirk Richards
items.description: Rebecca Klundt's use of recycled materials reminds her of God's sometimes mysterious ability to create something beautiful from what we already have. J. Kirk Richards uses his artwork to ask God for help finding opportunities to serve others.

items.title: Nick Stephens / Linda Etherington
items.description: Nick Stephens experiments with color, geometry, texture, and pattern to explore how God’s work throughout the ages fits together. Linda Etherington depicts the holy moments that happen in the small and simple daily tasks that tie a family together.

items.title: Rob Chipman / Kathleen Peterson
items.description: Rob Chipman creates reduction woodblock prints that remind him that life is a layer upon layer process where mistakes make good mentors. Kathleen Peterson uses figure paintings to discover the light of Christ in individual souls.

items.title: Caitlin Connolly / Jorge Cocco Santángelo
items.description: Caitlin Connolly is a painter whose art explores the significance of womanhood as she uses painting as a medium to converse with God. Jorge Cocco Santángelo portrays sacred events through shapes and colors that visually capture spiritual feelings.

items.title: Emma Taylor / Nnamdi Okonkwo
items.description: Emma Taylor understands that no matter how many times she must paint over her mistakes, God sees every layer and accepts them all. Nnamdi Okonkwo seeks to touch as many lives in a positive way as possible through his sculptures.

items.title: David Troncoso / Shari Lyon
items.description: David Troncoso paints in the Renaissance style to explore what lies beyond our reality, asking questions about the spiritual. Shari Lyon works with hot wax and flame to create works of encaustic art that connect her with her divine femininity.

items.title: Eva Koleva Timothy / Liz Harris
items.description: Eva Koleva Timothy is a celebrated photographer who feels guided by the Savior as she creates a body of work about Him. Liz Harris communicates the divinity and humanity of her subjects through her portraits, capturing how they see the Lord.

items.title: Lyn Hovey / Melissa Kamba Boggs
items.description: Lyn Hovey is a master of stained glass whose expressive windows illustrate the threads God weaves through our lives. Melissa Kamba Boggs's gold leaf paintings symbolize divinity and self-worth, inviting viewers to see themselves as God does.

items.title: Bobby Martin / Joe Bennion
items.description: Bobby Martin's prints and drawings use old family photographs that remind him how God brought people into his life to nurture his faith. Joe Bennion crafts each of his pots to enhance the sacred experience of families sitting down together to eat.

items.title: Brooke Bowen / Walter Rane
