items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | God among Us
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "God is among us—and is personally involved in our lives and actively guiding His children."

items.title: Joy D. Jones | Essential Conversations
items.description: Joy D. Jones, recently released Primary General President. "We cannot wait for conversion to simply happen to our children. Accidental conversion is not a principle of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Hearts Knit Together
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you extend yourself with kindness, care, and compassion, I promise that you will lift up arms that hang down and will heal hearts."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Room in the Inn
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In this Easter season, Jesus Christ invites us to become, like Him, a good Samaritan, to make His Inn (His Church) a refuge for all."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | I Love to See the Temple
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "It is in the temple that we can receive the assurance of loving family connections that will continue after death and last for eternity."

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Not as the World Giveth
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The instruments we need to create a brighter day and grow an economy of genuine goodness are abundantly provided for in the gospel of Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Infuriating Unfairness
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Jesus Christ both understands unfairness and has the power to provide a remedy."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Personal Journey of a Child of God
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As covenant children of God, we love, honor, nurture, safeguard, and welcome those spirits who are coming from the premortal world."

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Hope in Christ
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We long to help all who feel alone or feel they don’t belong. Let me mention, in particular, those who are currently single."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Bishops—Shepherds over the Lord's Flock
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The bishop has a paramount role in serving as a shepherd to guide the rising generation to Jesus Christ."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Bless in His Name
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "The purpose for our receiving the priesthood is to allow us to bless people for the Lord, doing so in His name."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | What Has Our Savior Done for Us?
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Jesus Christ has done everything that is essential for our journey through mortality toward the destiny outlined in the plan of our Heavenly Father."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | What We Are Learning and Will Never Forget
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "If you look at your life prayerfully, I believe you will see many ways in which the Lord has been guiding you through this time of hardship."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Jesus Christ: The Caregiver of Our Soul
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we genuinely repent of our sins, we allow the atoning sacrifice of Christ to become wholly effective in our life."

items.title: Sister Reyna I. Aburto | The Grace Has No Victory
items.description: Sister Reyna I. Aburto, Second Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Through the redeeming Atonement and glorious Resurrection of Jesus Christ, broken hearts can be healed, anguish can become peace, and distress can become hope."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Christ Is Risen; Faith in Him Will Move Mountains
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Faith in Jesus Christ is the greatest power available to us in this life. All things are possible to them that believe."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Defending Our Divinely Inspired Constitution
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Our belief in divine inspiration gives Latter-day Saints a unique responsibility to uphold and defend the United States Constitution and principles of constitutionalism."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | "Behold! I Am a God of Miracles"
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Miracles, signs, and wonders abound among followers of Jesus Christ today, in your lives and in mine."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Why the Covenant Path
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The difference of the covenant path is uniquely and eternally significant."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "The Principles of My Gospel"
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "A gospel principle is a doctrinally based guideline for the righteous exercise of moral agency."

items.title: Elder Alfred Kyungu | To be a Follower of Christ
items.description: Elder Alfred Kyungu of the Seventy. "To be a follower of Christ is to strive to conform our actions, conduct, and lives to those of the Savior."

items.title: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema | A House of Sequential Order
items.description: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema of the Seventy. "'Sequential order' is a simple, natural, and effective way for the Lord to teach us, as His children, important principles."

items.title: Elder Michael A. Dunn | One Percent Better
items.description: Elder Michael A. Dunn of the Seventy. "Every effort to change we make—no matter how tiny it seems to us—just might make the biggest difference in our lives."

items.title: President Camille N. Johnson | Invite Christ to Author Your Story
items.description: President Camille N. Johnson of the Primary General Presidency. "Let your narrative be one of faith, following your Exemplar, the Savior Jesus Christ."

items.title: President Bonnie H. Cordon | Come unto Christ and Don't Come Alone
items.description: President Bonnie H. Cordon of the Young Women General Presidency. "The best way for you to improve the world is to prepare the world for Christ by inviting all to follow Him."

items.title: Sister Susan H. Porter | God's Love: The Most Joyous to the Soul
items.description: Sister Susan H. Porter, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "God’s love is not found in the circumstances of our lives but in His presence in our lives."

items.title: Sister Sharon Eubank | I Pray He'll Use Us
items.description: Sister Sharon Eubank of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Small efforts collectively make a big impact, magnifying the many individual things we do as disciples of Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | The Greateset Possession
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Each of us is to come to Christ with uncompromised commitment to His gospel."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | The Peace of Christ Abolishes Enmity
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When love of Christ envelops our lives, we approach disagreements with meekness, patience, and kindness."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | The Things of My Soul
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "What things do you ponder? What things really matter to you? What are the things of your soul?"

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | "Lovest Thou Me More Than These?"
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostle. "What things can you do within your own life to show that you love the Lord first?"

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Simply Beautiful—Beautifully Simple
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we keep the gospel simple as we take upon us our divinely appointed responsibilities."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Trust Again
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Trust in God and each other brings heaven’s blessings."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Love of God
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our Father and our Redeemer have blessed us with commandments, and in obeying Their commandments, we feel Their perfect love more fully and more profoundly."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | The Savior's Abiding Compassion
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The expression of compassion for others is the essence of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | With the Power of God in Great Glory
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Honoring covenants arms us with righteousness and with the power of God in great glory."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Name of the Church Is Not Negotiable
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When we willingly follow the counsel of the Lord as revealed through His living prophet... the Lord blesses us with additional spiritual power."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Daily Restoration
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We need an ongoing, daily infusion of heavenly light. We need 'times of refreshing.' Times of personal restoration."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Personal Peace in Challenging Times
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "It has never been more important to seek personal peace."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | The Faith to Ask and Then to Act
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "Faith in Jesus Christ is the key to receiving revelations of truth."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | The Need for a Church
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The scriptures clearly teach the origin and need for a church directed by and with the authority of our Lord, Jesus Christ."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Temple and Your Spiritual Foundation
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Whenever any kind of upheaval occurs in your life, the safest place to be spiritually is living inside your temple covenants!"

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Missionary Service Blessed My Life Forever
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I pray that you young men and young women and your parents will see and know how missionary service will forever bless your life."

items.title: Sister Reyna I. Aburto | We Are The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
items.description: Sister Reyna I. Aburto, Second Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "The Church is more than the buildings and the ecclesiastical structure; the Church is us, the members, with Christ at the head and the prophet as His mouthpiece."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | But We Heeded Them Not
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Covenants and ordinances point us to and help us always remember our connection with the Lord Jesus Christ as we progress along the covenant path."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Following Jesus: Being a Peacemaker
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Peacemakers are not passive; they are persuasive in the Savior’s way."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Steady in the Storms
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "When the storms in life come, you can be steady because you are standing on the rock of your faith in Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Fear Not: Believe Only!
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Begin your search for happiness by embracing the bounty we have already received from the giver of every good gift."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | We Each Have a Story
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Please come find your family, all your generations, and bring them home."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Conversion to the Will of God
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our personal conversion includes the responsibility to share the gospel of Jesus Christ with the world."

items.title: Sister Susan H. Porter | Lessons at the Well
items.description: Sister Susan H. Porter, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "We can turn to the Savior for the strength and healing that will enable us to do all that we were sent here to do."

items.title: Sister Rebecca L. Craven | Do What Mattereth Most
items.description: Sister Rebecca L. Craven, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "As we center our lives on Jesus Christ, we will be blessed with spiritual strength, contentment, and joy."

items.title: President Jean B. Bingham | Covenant with God Strengthen, Protect, and Prepare Us for Eternal Glory
items.description: President Jean B. Bingham, Relief Society General Presidency. "As we choose to make covenants and keep them, we will be blessed with more happiness in this life and a glorious eternal life to come."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Your Divine Nature and Eternal Destiny
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to center your life on Jesus Christ and remember the foundational truths in the Young Women theme."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Our Relationship with God
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "No matter what our mortal experience may entail, we can trust God and find joy in Him."

items.title: Sister Amy A. Wright | Christ Heals That Which Is Broken
items.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "He can heal broken relationships with God, broken relationships with others, and broken parts of ourselves."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Love, Share, Invite
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we love, share, and invite, we take part in that great and glorious work that prepares the earth for the return of its Messiah."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | To Heal the World
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Wounds and differences can be resolved and even healed when we honor God, the Father of us all, and Jesus Christ, His Son."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Power of Spiritual Momentum
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I would like to suggest five specific actions we can take to help us maintain positive spiritual momentum."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Divine Love in the Father's Plan
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The purpose of the doctrine and policies of this restored Church is to prepare God’s children for salvation in the celestial kingdom and for exaltation in its highest degree."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | In Awe of Christ and His Gospel
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May the remembrance of what our eyes have seen and our hearts have felt increase our amazement at the Savior’s atoning sacrifice."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Our Heartfelt All
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If we want the Savior to lift us heavenward, then our commitment to Him and His gospel can’t be casual or occasional."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Overcome the World and Find Rest
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Find rest from the intensity, uncertainty, and anguish of this world by overcoming the world through your covenants with God."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Helping the Poor and Distressed
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The Church of Jesus Christ is committed to serving those in need, and it is also committed to cooperating with others in that effort."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Legacy of Encouragement
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I encourage you to continue striving to qualify to return to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Youth
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Put your trust in Jesus Christ. He will lead you the right way. He is your strength."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | A Framework for Personal Revelation
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We need to understand the framework within which the Holy Ghost functions. When we operate within the framework, the Holy Ghost can unleash astonishing insight."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | This Day
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our living prophet is doing his part to flood the earth with the Book of Mormon. We must follow his lead."

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Follow Jesus Christ with Footsteps of Faith
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ can carry us today through difficult times. He did it for the early pioneers, and He will do it now for each one of us."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | In Partnership with the Lord
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The restored gospel of Jesus Christ proclaims the principle of full partnership between woman and man, both in mortal life and in the eternities."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Doctrine of Belonging
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The doctrine of belonging comes down to this for each of us: I am one with Christ in the gospel covenant."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Drawing Closer to the Savior
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Seeking to know and love the Savior, we separate ourselves from the world through covenants with God... without isolating ourselves from others who believe differently."

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | Lifted Up upon the Cross
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "To be a follower of Jesus Christ, one must sometimes carry a burden and go where sacrifice is required and suffering is inevitable."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Happy and Forever
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "True, enduring joy and eternity with those we love are the very essence of God’s plan of happiness."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | Put On Thy Strength, O Zion
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Each of us should evaluate our temporal and spiritual priorities sincerely and prayerfully."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Nourishing and Bearing Your Testimony
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to seek opportunities to bear your testimony in word and in deed."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be True to God and His Work
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We all need to seek our own testimony of Jesus Christ, bridle our passions, repent of our sins, and be true to God and His work."

items.title: Sister Tracy Y. Browning | Seeing More of Jesus Christ in Our Lives
items.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "The Savior invites us to see our lives through Him in order to see more of Him in our lives."

items.title: Sister Kristin M. Yee | Beauty for Ashes: The Healing Path of Forgiveness
items.description: Sister Kristin M. Yee, Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "To live in such a way that you give beauty for the ashes of your life is an act of faith that follows the Savior."

items.title: Sister Michelle D. Craig | Wholehearted
items.description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, First Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "We should be followers of Jesus who are joyful and wholehearted in our own personal journey of discipleship."

items.title: Sister J. Anette Dennis | His Yoke Is Easy and His Burden Is Light
items.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "Let us remember that each person on this earth is a child of God and He loves each one."

items.title: Elder Joseph W. Sitati | Patterns of Discipleship
items.description: Elder Joseph W. Sitati, Emeritus Member of the Seventy. "Learning about Christ and His ways leads us to know and to love Him."

items.title: Elder Isaac K. Morrison | We Can Do Hard Things through Him
items.description: Elder Isaac K. Morrison of the Seventy. "We grow in our discipleship when we exercise faith in the Lord during difficult times."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | The Greatest Easter Story Ever Told
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Look at the Book of Mormon in a new light and consider the profound witness it bears of the reality of the risen Christ."

items.title: President Bonnie H. Cordon | Never Give Up an Opportunity to Testify of Christ
items.description: President Bonnie H. Cordon of the Young Women General Presidency. "True joy rests on our willingness to come closer to Christ and witness for ourselves."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Ministering
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Let us reach out and care as our Savior would, especially to those whom we are privileged by love and assignment to minister."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Safely Gathered Home
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are in a unique position to gather Israel on both sides of the veil as never before under the Father’s plan."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Finding Personal Peace
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I pray that you may find peace, help many others to find it, and pass it along."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Parents
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Help your children build faith in Jesus Christ, love His gospel and His Church, and prepare for a lifetime of righteous choices."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Accessing God's Power through Covenants
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you walk the covenant path, from baptism to the temple and throughout life, I promise you power to go against the natural worldly flow."

items.title: Elder Juan A. Uceda | The Lord Jesus Christ Teaches Us to Minister
items.description: Elder Juan A. Uceda of the Seventy. "With our Savior’s help, we can love His precious sheep and minister to them as He would."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | One in Christ
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "It is only in and through our individual loyalty to and love of Jesus Christ that we can hope to be one."

items.title: President Camille N. Johnson | Jesus Christ Is Relief
items.description: President Camille N. Johnson of the Primary General Presidency. "We can partner with the Savior to help provide temporal and spiritual relief for those in need—and in the process find our own relief."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Followers of the Prince of Peace
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we strive to develop attributes like the Savior’s, we can become instruments of His peace in the world."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | My Mind Caught Hold upon This Thought of Jesus Christ
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you continue to attentively catch hold of the thought of Jesus Christ, I promise you not only heavenly guidance but heavenly power."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Peacemakers Needed
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "You have your agency to choose contention or reconciliation. I urge you to choose to be a peacemaker, now and always."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | The Teachings of Jesus Christ
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "We are given the scriptures to direct our lives. My message today consists of a selection of the words of our Savior—what He said."

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Remember What Matters Most
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "What matters most is our relationships with Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son, our families, and our neighbors, and allowing the Spirit to guide us."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | Hosanna to the Most High God
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Jesus Christ’s triumphant entry into Jerusalem and the events of the week that followed exemplify doctrine we can apply in our lives today."

items.title: Elder Ahmad S. Corbitt | Do You Know Why I as a Christian Believe in Christ?
items.description: Elder Ahmad S. Corbitt of the Seventy. "Jesus Christ had to suffer, die, and rise again to redeem all humanity from physical death and to give eternal life with God."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "Abide in Me, and I in You; Therefore Walk with Me"
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The Savior’s promise to abide in us is true and available to every covenant-keeping member of His restored Church."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | In the Path of Their Duty
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "You who today are pressing forward in the path of your duty are the strength of the Savior’s restored Church."

items.title: Sister Amy A. Wright | Abide the Day in Christ
items.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "Jesus Christ makes it possible for us to 'abide the day.'”

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Sealing Power
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The sealing power makes individual salvation and family exaltation universally available to the children of God."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Kingdoms of Glory
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "We have a loving Heavenly Father who will see that we receive every blessing and every advantage that our own desires and choices allow."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Tithing: Opening the Windows of Heaven
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The windows of heaven open in many ways. Trust in the Lord’s timing; the blessings always come."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Promptings of the Spirit
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The constant companionship of the Holy Ghost is one of the greatest spiritual gifts Latter-day Saints enjoy."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | How Great Will Be Your Joy
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I now invite you to take your know-how, coupled with your time-honored testimonies, and go on a mission."

items.title: Elder Joni L. Koch | Humble to Accept and Follow
items.description: Elder Joni L. Koch of the Seventy. "Humility is a mandatory requirement for us to be ready to return to the presence of God."

items.title: Sister Tamara W. Runia | Seeing God's Family through the Overview Lens
items.description: Sister Tamara W. Runia, First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "I believe we can, through the eye of faith, zoom out and view ourselves and our families with hope and joy."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Brothers and Sisters in Christ
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we enjoy more the spiritual kinship that exists between us and value the different attributes and varied gifts we all have."

items.title: President M. Russell Ballard | Praise to the Man
items.description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "How abundantly blessed we are to know all that we know because we have Joseph Smith, the prophet of this last dispensation of time."

items.title: President Emily Belle Freeman | Walking in Covenant Relationship with Christ
items.description: President Emily Belle Freeman of the Young Women General Presidency. "The One who was bruised and broken for us will allow mortality to do its work in us, but He doesn’t ask us to face those challenges alone."

items.title: Elder Adilson de Paula Parrella | Bearing Witness of Jesus Christ in Word and Actions
items.description: Elder Adilson de Paula Parrella of the Seventy. "As we strive to live our lives in harmony with the gospel of Jesus Christ, our conduct will be a living testimony of our Redeemer."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be Peaceable Followers of Christ
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I testify that 'peaceable followers of Christ' will find personal peace in this life and a glorious heavenly reunion."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | The Prodigal and the Road That Leads Home
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Though choices may have taken you far from the Savior and His Church, the Master Healer stands at the road that leads home, welcoming you."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Our Constant Companion
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "You and I have the opportunity to have the Holy Ghost as our constant companion."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Jesus Christ Is the Treasure
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Focus on Jesus Christ. He is our Savior and Redeemer, the 'mark' to whom we should look, and our greatest treasure."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Love Is Spoken Here
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we each learn to speak and hear His love here, in our hearts and homes, and in our gospel callings, activities, ministering, and service."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Think Celestial!
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Your choices will determine where you will live throughout eternity, the kind of body with which you will be resurrected, and those with whom you will live forever."

items.title: President Jeffrey R. Holland | Motions of a Hidden Fire
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "God hears every prayer we offer and responds to each of them according to the path He has outlined for our perfection."

items.title: Sister J. Anette Dennis | Put Ye On the Lord Jesus Christ
items.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor of the Relief Society General Presidency. "Through honoring our covenants, we enable God to pour out the multitude of promised blessings associated with those covenants."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Covenant Confidence through Jesus Christ
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "When we enter the Lord’s house, we embark on a sacred journey of learning to become higher and holier disciples of Christ."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | All Will Be Well Because of Temple Covenants
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "There is nothing more important than honoring the covenants you have made or may make in the temple."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | "Be Still, and Know That I Am God"
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We can be still and know that God is our Heavenly Father, we are His children, and Jesus Christ is our Savior."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | All Things for Our Good
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In time and eternity, the purpose of Creation and the nature of God Himself are to bring all things together for our good."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Be One with Christ
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are united by our love of and faith in Jesus Christ and His Atonement. The essence of truly belonging is to be one with Christ."

items.title: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus | Faithful to the End
items.description: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus, Second Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "By His hand, you will be able to bring down every Goliath that appears in your life."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | A Higher Joy
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we all seek and find the higher joy that comes from devoting our lives to our Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | Words Matter
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Words set a tone. They voice our thoughts, feelings, and experiences, for good or bad."

items.title: President Susan H. Porter | Pray, He Is There
items.description: President Susan H. Porter of the Primary General Presidency. "I invite you to pray to know Heavenly Father is there, pray to grow to become like Him, and pray to show His love to others."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | The Powerful, Virtuous Cycle of the Doctrine of Christ
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "I invite you to live the doctrine of Christ repeatedly, iteratively, and intentionally and help others on their way."

items.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | God's Intent Is to Bring You Home
items.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Everything about the Father’s plan for His beloved children is designed to bring everyone home."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Covenants and Responsibilities
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "The Church of Jesus Christ is known as a church that emphasizes making covenants with God."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | The Testimony of Jesus
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "My invitation is to act now to secure your place as one who is valiant in the testimony of Jesus."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Bridging the Two Great Commandments
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our ability to follow Jesus Christ depends upon our strength and power to live the first and second commandments with balance and equal devotion."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | Temples, Houses of the Lord Dotting the Earth
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As you come worthily and prayerfully to His holy house, you will be armed with His power."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | Rejoice in the Gift of Priesthood Keys
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Priesthood keys govern how the priesthood of God may be used to bring about the Lord’s purposes and bless all who accept the restored gospel."

items.title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | The Triumph of Hope
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Hope is a living gift, a gift that grows as we increase our faith in Jesus Christ."

items.title: President Emily Belle Freeman | Live Up to Your Privileges
items.description: President Emily Belle Freeman of the Young Women General Presidency. "Learn how priesthood ordinances and covenant promises will allow God’s power to flow into your life."

items.title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | "This Is My Gospel"—"This Is My Church"
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "This is the Savior’s gospel, and this is His Church (see 3 Nephi 27:21; Mosiah 26:22; 27:13). The combination of the two is powerful and transformative."

items.title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Following Christ
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "As followers of Christ, we teach and testify of Jesus Christ, our Perfect Role Model. So let us follow Him by forgoing contention."

items.title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Burying Our Weapons of Rebellion
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we bury—very, very deep—any element of rebellion against God in our lives and replace it with a willing heart and a willing mind."

items.title: Elder Juan Pablo Villar | His Hand Ready to Help Us
items.description: Elder Juan Pablo Villar of the Seventy. "As we reach out to Jesus Christ in faith, He will always be there."

items.title: Elder Patrick Kearon | Welcome to the Church of Joy
items.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Because of the redeeming life and mission of our Saviour, Jesus Christ, we can—and should—be the most joyful people on earth!"

items.title: Elder D. Martin Goury | Be Thou Clean
items.description: Elder D. Martin Goury of the Seventy. "Daily repentance allows us to discern the guidance of the Lord through the Holy Ghost."

items.title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Aligning Our Will with His
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Following the Lord’s will in our life will enable us to find the most precious pearl in the world—the kingdom of heaven."

items.title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | Holiness to the Lord in Everyday Life
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Holiness to the Lord makes daily living sacred. It draws us closer and happier to the Lord and each other."

items.title: Sister Kristin M. Yee | The Joy of Our Redemption
items.description: Sister Kristin M. Yee, Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "Jesus Christ’s love and power can save each of us from our mistakes, weaknesses, and sins and help us to become something more."

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar | In the Space of Not Many Years
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If we are not faithful and obedient, we can transform the God-given blessing of prosperity into a prideful curse that diverts and distracts us."

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | "I Am He"
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ’s charity—evident in complete loyalty to divine will—persisted and continues to persist."

items.title: Sister Tracy Y. Browning | Seeking Answers to Spiritual Questions
items.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "Our sincere gospel questions can provide Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ with opportunities to help us grow."

items.title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Days Never to Be Forgotten
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Upcoming moments will provide members of the Church everywhere with increased opportunities to share the glad tidings of the gospel of Jesus Christ."

items.title: President Henry B. Eyring | Simple Is the Doctrine of Jesus Christ
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "I bear witness of the sacred work of teaching Heavenly Father’s children the simple doctrine of Jesus Christ."

items.title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Nourish the Roots, and the Branches Will Grow
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The branches of your testimony will draw strength from your deepening faith in Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son."

items.title: Elder Takashi Wada | The Words of Christ and the Holy Ghost Will Lead Us to the Truth
items.description: Elder Takashi Wada of the Seventy. "Knowing this incredible plan will help us know we are children of God and we can become like Him."

items.title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | "Behold I Am the Light Which Ye Shall Hold Up"
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We hold up the Lord’s light when we hold fast to our covenants and when we support our living prophet."

items.title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Sacred Scriptures—the Foundations of Faith
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We cannot underestimate the significance of sacred scriptures both in conversions and in remaining faithful in the gospel."

items.title: Elder I. Raymond Egbo | Focus on Jesus Christ and His Gospel
items.description: Elder I. Raymond Egbo of the Seventy. "When we ignore the distractions of the world and focus on Christ and His gospel, we are guaranteed success."

items.title: President Russell M. Nelson | The Lord Jesus Christ Will Come Again
items.description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Now is the time for you and for me to prepare for the Second Coming of our Lord and Savior, Jesus the Christ."

items.title: Jeffrey R. Holland | As A Little Child
items.description: Elder Jeffery R Holland from the quorum of the 12 apostles. "Children really do love Him, and that love can carry over into their other relationships in the playground of life."

items.title: Camille N. Johnson | Spiritually Whole in Him
items.description: President Camille N. Johnson, Relief Society general president. "‘We can choose to be made whole by exercising our faith in Him."

items.title: Ronald A. Rasband | Right Before Our Eyes
items.description: Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Right before my eyes were missionaries who had set aside the things of this world to serve the Lord and help hasten His coming.”

items.title: Quentin L. Cook | The Atonement of Jesus Christ Provides the Ultimate Rescue
items.description: Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As we turn to Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world, He rescues us from the storms of life through His Atonement."

items.title: Henry B. Eyring | Draw Near Unto Me
items.description: President Henry B. Eyring, second counselor in the First Presidency. "Jesus Christ loves each of us. He offers the opportunity to draw closer to Him."

items.title: Neil L. Andersen | Cherishing Life
items.description: Neil L. Anderson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Nurturing and protecting life that is yet unborn … is a moral law confirmed by the Lord through His prophets"

items.title: Dale G. Renlund | Personal Preparation to Meet the Savior
items.description: Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We are wise when we accept the gospel, seek to have the Holy Ghost with us and avoid deception."

items.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | By This All Will Know That You Are My Disciples
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Our love for God and His children is a powerful testimony to the world that this is truly the Savior’s Church."

items.title: Gary E. Stevenson | And We Talk of Christ
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Christ is at the center of His Church and should be at the center of our lives."

items.title: Amy A. Wright | Thou Art the Christ
items.description: Sister Amy A. Wright, first counselor in the Primary general presidency. "Lifelong discipleship of Jesus Christ begins in our homes — and in Primary."

items.title: D. Todd Christofferson | Worship
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “True worship means loving God and yielding our will to Him — the most precious gift we can offer.”

items.title: David A. Bednar | The Times of Restitution of All Things
items.description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Joseph did not pray merely to know what was right. Rather, he prayed to know what was right so he could do what was right.”

items.title: Tamara W. Runia | Your Repentance Doesn’t Burden Jesus Christ; It Brightens His Joy
items.description: Sister Tamara W. Runia, first counselor in the Young Women general presidency. “The Savior is forever brighter than the darkness of shame. He would never attack your worth.”

items.title: Gerrit W. Gong | Eternity’s Great Gifts: Jesus Christ’s Atonement, Resurrection, Restoration
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong from the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "May we each find in Jesus Christ atonement, resurrection and restoration -- peace, becoming and belonging -- that which is enduringly real and joyful, happy and forever"

items.title: Dallin H. Oaks | Divine Helps for Mortality
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, first counselor in the First Presidency. “By far God’s strongest mortal help was His provision of a Savior, Jesus Christ, who would suffer to pay the price and provide forgiveness for repented sins,”

items.title: Ulisses Soares | Reverence for Sacred Things
items.description: Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Reverence for the sacred fosters genuine gratitude, expands true happiness, leads our minds to revelation and brings greater joy to our lives."

items.title: Patrick Kearon | Receive His Gift
items.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "You are a child of God. This is not just a nice song we sing."

items.title: Russell M. Nelson | Confidence in the Presence of God
items.description: President Russel M. Nelson, president of the Church of Jesus Christ. “In the Lord’s own words, charity and virtue open the way to having confidence before God!”

items.title: Gary E. Stevenson | Blessed Are the Peacemakers
items.description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “To be peacemakers, we forgive others and deliberately build others up instead of tearing them down.”

items.title: Tracy Y. Browning | Tune Your Heart to Jesus Christ: The Sacred Gift of Primary Music
items.description: Sister Tracy Y. Browning, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. “Primary songs have carried a holy influence in my life and have lifted my soul, taught me eternal truths and drawn me nearer to the Savior and to His gospel.”

items.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Do Your Part With All Your Heart
items.description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Simply put, discipleship takes self-discipline. It is not a casual endeavor, and it doesn’t happen by accident.”

items.title: Ronald A. Rasband | The Family Proclamation — Words From God
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “The proclamation has a divine origin, so we must treat it with the reverence deserving words from God.”

items.title: Kevin G. Brown | The Eternal Gift of Testimony
items.description: Elder Kevin G. Brown, General Authority Seventy. “The gift and witness of the Holy Ghost are available to everyone.”

items.title: Gerrit W. Gong | No One Sits Alone
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “In His Church and through His ordinances and covenants, we come to each other and to Jesus Christ.”

items.title: Quentin L. Cook | The Lord Is Hastening His Work
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Let me once again assure all new converts and those returning to the Lord’s Church: We love you; we need you; the Lord needs you.”

items.title: Patrick Kearon | Jesus Christ and Your New Beginning
items.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Little by little, the more we invite His goodness into our hearts and cast out the self-defeating voices in our heads, we become His people because we truly make Him our God.”

items.title: J. Anette Dennis | Cheering Each Other On
items.description: Sister J. Anette Dennis, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. “Christlike love and care are higher and holier. The pure love of Christ is charity.”

items.title: Neil L. Andersen | The Atoning Love of Jesus Christ
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Your Heavenly Father rejoices in your resolve to come unto Him with a broken heart and contrite spirit.”

items.title: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland | And Now I See
items.description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “When we participate in any of the ordinances of the gospel and honor the corresponding covenants, we come to know the Savior much more personally.”

items.title: Ulisses Soares | Adorned With the Virtue of Temperance
items.description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “The gospel of Jesus Christ invites us to exercise this virtue especially in times of challenge, for it is precisely on these occasions that the true character of individuals is revealed.”

items.title: D. Todd Christofferson | Look to God and Live
items.description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Looking to God means that He is not just one of our priorities; it means rather that He is our one highest priority.”

items.title: Andrea Muñoz Spannaus | Prophets of God
items.description: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. “Each member of the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles is a prophet, seer and revelator.”

items.title: Henry B. Eyring | Proved and Strengthened in Christ
items.description: Elder Henry B. Eyring of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “When we continue to have faith in Jesus Christ — even when things might feel impossible to us at the moment — we become spiritually stronger.”

items.title: David A. Bednar | They Are Their Own Judges
items.description: David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "In the Lord’s presence, we will acknowledge what we have chosen to become in mortality and know for ourselves where we should be in eternity.”

items.title: Dale G. Renlund | Taking on the Name of Jesus Christ
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “As His disciples, we … strive to become like Him and seek to be blessed with His attributes.”

items.title: Dallin H. Oaks | The Family-Centered Gospel of Jesus Christ
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks, President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. “Parents — single or married and others like grandparents who fill that role for children — are the master teachers.”

items.title: Patrick Kearon | About His Business
items.description: A call to center our lives on Jesus Christ by actively engaging in His work through serving, loving, and choosing discipleship daily with intent and purpose.

items.title: Kristin M. Yee | Ministering—“That Ye Love One Another; as I Have Loved You”
items.description: An invitation to follow Christ's example of pure love by showing compassion, patience, and kindness to all, especially in difficult moments, reflecting His love in how we treat others every day.

items.title: Clark G. Gilbert | Come Home
items.description: A loving invitation to come home to Christ, reminding us that no matter how far we feel we have strayed, He is always ready to receive us as we turn back with faith, humility, and a willing heart.

items.title: David A. Bednar | All Who Have Endured Valiantly
items.description: A hopeful reminder that those who have endured valiantly in faith, despite struggle or doubt, are known and loved by God, and their quiet perseverance is honored in His eyes.

items.title: Henry B. Eyring | Prayers for Peace
items.description: An invitation to seek peace through sincere prayer, trusting that God hears and answers, bringing comfort, guidance, and calmness even in life's most uncertain and difficult moments.

items.title: Gary E. Stevenson | Lost Luggage, Redeemed Souls
items.description: As disciples of Jesus Christ, we rise with renewed determination to succor and care for those with whom we come in contact.

items.title: Gérald Caussé | Love All; Love Each
items.description: May we follow the Lord's perfect example and learn to love all and to love each, just as He does.

items.title: Clement M. Matswagothata | He Knows You by Name
items.description: The most eternity-shaping name we can receive is the sacred name of Jesus Christ.

items.title: Ulisses Soares | Jesus Christ—the True Vine
items.description: In a world of many voices, remaining connected to the True Vine is not merely desirable; it is essential to our spiritual survival.

items.title: Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Encounter at the Empty Tomb
items.description: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf reflects on the women who discovered Christ's empty tomb, teaching that we must encounter the reality of His Resurrection, come to know that He lives, and then share that witness with others, as those first witnesses did.

items.title: Emily Belle Freeman | Best Days and Worst Days
items.description: President Emily Belle Freeman teaches that because of Jesus Christ, our best days are ahead no matter how bad things are now. Drawing on Peter's story and her family's trial with cancer, she shows testimony is built over time, on best days and worst.

items.title: Ronald A. Rasband | He Is Risen
items.description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband testifies that Christ's Resurrection secured salvation from physical death for all God's children. Drawing on scriptural witnesses and the loss of his grandson Paxton, he affirms the hope of reunion, resurrected whole, through

items.title: Dale G. Renlund | Because of Jesus Christ
items.description: Elder Dale G. Renlund teaches that amid life's many competing concerns, focusing on Jesus Christ and His Atonement brings joy and clarity. Using the story of his dog chasing two balls at once, he shows why keeping our eye on the Savior matters most.

items.title: Thierry K. Mutombo | The Joy of a Covenant Relationship with God
items.description: Elder Thierry K. Mutombo teaches that whatever we face, we can feel God's infinite love through Christ. Sharing how he and his wife lost four children and faced pressure to separate, he testifies that keeping covenants brings peace, for Sunday will c

items.title: Dallin H. Oaks | Alive in Christ
items.description: President Dallin H. Oaks teaches that the literal, universal Resurrection changes our whole view of mortality. He calls followers of Christ to love even their adversaries, forgo contention, and become peacemakers, without surrendering their values.

items.title: D. Todd Christofferson | The Character of Christ
items.description: President D. Todd Christofferson teaches that preparing for Christ's Second Coming means acquiring His character, which grows from a Christlike heart: pure love, a desire to lift and minister to others, and devotion to doing the will of God.

items.title: Chi Hong (Sam) Wong | Remember, Remember
items.description: Elder Chi Hong (Sam) Wong draws on five 'remember, remember' verses from the Book of Mormon, teaching that we are blessed for keeping God's commandments, saved through Christ's Atonement, secure when built on Him, and free to use our agency wisely.

items.title: Susan H. Porter | Here Am I, Send Me
items.description: President Susan H. Porter teaches children that, like the boy with loaves and fishes, they can offer what they have, however small, and let Heavenly Father make it great. She invites them to pray, as Jesus did, 'Here am I, send me.'

items.title: Neil L. Andersen | Eternal Marriage Is an Eternal Journey
items.description: Elder Neil L. Andersen teaches that eternal marriage, sealed by priesthood power, is not a short-term experiment but a lifelong journey of becoming like Christ, requiring patience, repentance, and forgiveness, sustained through the Holy Ghost.

items.title: Quentin L. Cook | Keys, Covenants, and Easter
items.description: Elder Quentin L. Cook connects Easter to the Savior's Atonement and Resurrection and to priesthood keys restored by Elijah in the Kirtland Temple. These sealing keys, he testifies, make eternal families possible for God's covenant people.

items.title: Taniela B. Wakolo | Come unto Christ—Together
items.description: Elder Taniela B. Wakolo shares stories of part-member families who waited years in patient faith, teaching that the gospel is a bridge, not a wedge, to unite families, and that the Lord honors patience and fulfills His promises in His timing.

items.title: Gerrit W. Gong | Tis Eastertide: No One Walks Alone
items.description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong draws on the road to Emmaus, teaching that the risen Christ walks with us even when unrecognized, and that through scripture, covenants, and the Holy Ghost we come to know He abides with us, so no one should walk alone.

items.title: BYU Camp Review & Utah Tech Preview
items.description: BYU wraps up fall camp and previews Utah Tech. Defensive Coordinator Kelly Poppinga, new Special Teams Coordinator Justin Ena, and Offensive Coordinator Aaron Roderick break down who stood out in camp and what to expect on the field.

items.title: BYU Win Over Utah Tech: Kelly Poppinga & Aaron Roderick | Arizona Next
items.description: BYU beats Utah Tech and looks ahead to Arizona. Kelly Poppinga talks injuries, depth, CJ Tiller, and Tre Alexander’s play-one pick. Aaron Roderick breaks down the game plan, Legend Glasker’s success, and the early offensive start.

items.title: BYU’s Win Over Arizona: Aaron Roderick on the Offense & Justin Ena on Special Teams | CSU Next
items.description: BYU beats Arizona and looks ahead to Colorado State. Aaron Roderick breaks down the offense, turnovers, and the O-line, while Justin Ena talks special teams success, Devries’ big returns, and Fuller Shurtz’s punting game.

items.title: BYU’s Dominant Win at CSU: Justin Ena on the Special Teams Surge, Kelly Poppinga on the Defense | Bye Week Plans Before TCU
items.description: No. 9 BYU dominates at Colorado State. Justin Ena covers the fast start, karaoke during the delay, and special teams surge. Kelly Poppinga talks Clegg’s first pick, the defense setting the tone, depth, and bye week plans before TCU.

items.title: BYU’s Win Over TCU: Kelly Poppinga on the Defense & Depth, Aaron Roderick on the Rain & Bachmeier’s Impact | Iowa State Next
items.description: BYU beats TCU and looks ahead to Iowa State. Kelly Poppinga talks bye week prep, Satuala’s interception, depth, and Matthias Dunn’s career-long kick. Aaron Roderick covers the rain, the revamped O-line, and Bachmeier’s impact.

items.title: BYU vs. Iowa State Recap: Aaron Roderick on offense & Justin Ena on Special Teams | Notre Dame Preview
items.description: BYU beats Iowa State and looks ahead to Notre Dame. Aaron Roderick on LJ Martin and the offense, Justin Ena on special teams, Brody Laga’s injury, Dunn’s expanded role, and the Notre Dame. Plus, College GameDay coming to BYU.

items.title: BYU’s Win Over Notre Dame: Justin Ena & Kelly Poppinga | UCF Next
items.description: BYU beats Notre Dame and looks ahead to UCF. Justin Ena covers the LES energy and Cannon Devries’ injury update. Kelly Poppinga breaks down breaking CJ Carr’s streak and keeping the Irish out of the end zone.

items.title: BYU’s Double OT Loss to UCF: Kelly Poppinga on the Defense, Aaron Roderick on Resetting for Arizona State
items.description: BYU’s double overtime loss to UCF, from both sides of the ball. Kelly Poppinga explains the defense, the blocked kick, and Justin Kirkland’s big night. Aaron Roderick covers the turnovers, Bachmeier’s milestone, and how BYU resets for Arizona State.

items.title: BYU’s Win Over ASU: Aaron Roderick on Offense, Justin Ena on Special Teams | First-Ever Top 10 Rivalry Game vs. Utah
items.description: BYU beats ASU and turns to Utah in the first-ever top 10 rivalry game. Aaron Roderick covers fast starts, turnovers, and LJ Martin’s status. Justin Ena breaks down the onside kick recovery, Matthias Dunn, and the players of the week.

items.title: BYU’s Loss to Utah: Justin Ena on Special Teams, Kelly Poppinga on the Defense | Baylor Next
items.description: BYU falls to Utah and looks ahead to Baylor. Justin Ena covers Matthias Dunn’s rivalry debut, Brody Laga’s return, and the penalties. Kelly Poppinga breaks down the turnover margin, the 20-14 lead, and Bodie Schoonover’s big game.

items.title: BYU’s Win Over Baylor: Kelly Poppinga on the Defense, Aaron Roderick on the Offense | Kansas Next
items.description: BYU beats Baylor and looks ahead to Kansas. Kelly Poppinga covers Tommy Prassas’ interception, the pressure, and the players of the week. Aaron Roderick discusses LJ Martin, the season’s longest drive, and Bear Bachmeier’s big game.

items.title: Cupid's Proxy
items.description: Olive, a love advice columnist, enlists her 12-year-old neighbor, Justin, to secretly help with her writing. Justin decides to use his alter ego “Cupid’s Proxy” to set up his mother, Rebecca, and music teacher, Stewart.

items.title: All Nations Will Flow Unto It
items.description: Seven young adults from around the world come to Salt Lake City to experience the historic Salt Lake Temple. As they meet for the first time, they begin exploring its renovation, history, and purpose, and what it means to draw closer to Jesus Christ.

items.title: Strengthening Foundations: The Salt Lake Temple Renewal
items.description: The six young adults go beneath the Salt Lake Temple to discover the massive seismic engineering effort designed to protect it from earthquakes and preserve this sacred place for generations as an ensign to the nations.

items.title: Covenant Connections
items.description: At a remarkable Jerusalem film set, the seven young adults explore the ancient history of temples and their purpose today. They discover why temples are called the House of the Lord and how these sacred spaces can bring us closer to Jesus.

items.title: Heavenly Design: The Gift of the Salt Lake Temple
items.description: The seven young adults visit the historic Kirtland Temple to discover why early Saints sacrificed to build it and learn how sacred promises made with God in temples can provide strength, direction, and a deeper connection to Jesus Christ.

items.title: Sealed by Love: Eternal Families
items.description: The seven young adults discover how temples bind us to Jesus Christ and can unite families for eternity. Through the temple's stained glass and sacred imagery, they also explore how the light of Christ can bring hope and direction to our lives.

items.title: Heather Olmstead
items.description: The winningest coach in volleyball history almost never was.

items.title: Isaiah and Jackson Kaufusi
items.description: Two brothers, once Utah Utes fans, play for each other at BYU.

items.title: Tristen Hoge
items.description: Follow an offensive lineman's journey from Pocatello to South Bend to Provo.

items.title: Dayan Ghanwoloku

items.title: Ashley Hatch
items.description: Ashley Hatch had to make the difficult decision when she was young to abstain from playing club soccer on Sundays. She credits this for her growth in the game to a US Women's National Team player and one of the top players in the NWSL.

items.description: While Lindsey Hunter was on death’s doorstep after a misdiagnosis of appendicitis, she vowed that if she survived, she would try to savor every moment of life from that time forward. Now, this BYU gymnast is painting a new picture on life.

items.title: Josue Dominguez
items.description: BYU swimmer Josue Dominguez reached a pinnacle of his sport that few athletes have at BYU; he represented his home country of the Dominican Republic in the 2020 Olympics, but his road to get there was anything but easy.

items.title: Sara Musselman
items.description: After her mother committed suicide, Sara Musselman found escape and solace in running. Achieving success with her teammates and seeing an All-American goal accomplished through their support.

items.title: Kody Epps

items.description: Dallin Hall has a list of goals he looks at each night. One goal was to serve a mission, another is to play in the NBA. Despite being told making the NBA is unrealistic and going on a mission would be detrimental to his NBA goal, he hasn't stopped.

items.description: As BYU Men’s Basketball head coach from 2005 to 2019, Dave Rose created a culture of character. And for the last 15 years, Rose’s courageous battle with cancer continues to inspire others to live each day to its fullest.

items.title: Sione Moa
items.description: Faced with choosing between walking on at BYU or accepting a scholarship elsewhere, Sione Moa turned to God for guidance. Once he received his answer, his faith, hard work, and determination paved the way for success on and off the field.

items.title: Larry Echo Hawk

items.title: Will Voight

items.description: For Cougars’ center Xavion Staton, family is everything. Hear his inspiring story of the challenges he’s faced growing up and the accomplishments he’s earned, all with his family supporting him every step of the way.

items.description: He’s analyzed for the Kings, Jazz, and Suns. Now BYU’s Director of Analytics & Strategy, Akash Sebastian and his family share his journey from an NBA dream to finding a home with the Cougs.

items.description: The eyes of the world may be on the #1 NBA prospect, but at the end of the day, AJ Dybantsa is—and will always be—Ace and Chelsea’s son.

items.title: Jordan Brady
items.description: A Deep Blue profile of Jordan Brady, tracing his journey from determined basketball player to coach, overcoming setbacks, career disappointments, and adversity through hard work, faith, and resilience.

items.title: Keba Keita
items.description: A Deep Blue profile of Keba Keita, who left West Africa to pursue basketball, overcame homesickness and adversity, and used faith, hard work, and family motivation to achieve success at BYU.

items.title: Arielle Mackey Williams
items.description: Ari Mackey-Williams’ path to BYU hasn’t been easy. Moving from Ngati Porou, New Zealand at 18, she faced homesickness and two ACL tears. Through faith, family, and connection to her people, Ari has found strength to rise above every challenge.

items.title: Carmen Alder
items.description: Discover the real-life stories of BYU athletes, coaches, and fans in this powerful documentary series.

items.title: Shawn Olmstead
items.description: BYU Men’s Volleyball Coach Shawn Olmstead faces his toughest battles in brutal 100‑mile races, where a major health setback tested him; with his wife Farrah’s unwavering support and his faith in God, he pushes forward step by step to the finish.

items.title: Shari Skabelund
items.description: Teen tragedy didn’t define Shari Skabeland—it deepened her love for others. For nearly 40 years, the BYU Swimming head coach has built a legacy of faith, family, and world-class swimmers.

items.title: Kate Zimmerman
items.description: Kate Zimmerman shares her journey to becoming a BYU Cougarette. Hear about the sacrifices, hard work, and faith it took to earn a spot on the elite dance team and the determination required to stay there.

items.title: Krystie Solomon-Jensen
items.description: Krystie Solomon-Jensen is a runner at Brigham Young University. She shares her story of running at a young age, dealing with eating disorders, recovering from pregnancy, and ultimately pushing through trials to do what she loves.

items.title: Bruce Mitchell
items.description: Bruce Mitchell’s journey to LaVell Edwards Stadium is one of hard work, perseverance, faith, and trust in God’s timing. Hear from Bruce, Miller, and the family members who supported him through the highs and lows along the way.

items.title: Wes Johnson
items.description: A devastating diagnosis ended Wes Johnson’s dream of playing college football, but he found new purpose through coaching. Now, Wes helps lead BYU’s cornerbacks—including his brother, Evan—while inspiring others through his journey.

items.title: Cade Uluave
items.description: Growing up a BYU fan, Cade Uluave never imagined playing for the Cougars. After an accident threatened his football career, his faith brought hope and healing—and an unexpected chance to play for his favorite team.

items.title: LJ Martin
items.description: Big 12 Offensive Player of the Year LJ Martin, along with his family and coaches, share his story of overcoming self-doubt through perseverance, humility, and hard work.

items.title: Pops & Kalani
items.description: Coach Kalani Sitake and family journey to Tonga, where his support for the We Are One Foundation helps provide education, employment and infrastructure to create a brighter future for Tongans.

items.title: Skyler Mayne
items.description: He's a familiar face (literally) on the sidelines at football games. Get to know the man behind the mustache, Dr. Skyler Mayne, BYU football's Director of High Performance.

items.title: Andrew Gentry
items.description: Andrew Gentry always knew he wanted to serve a mission. That choice led him down an unexpected path, ultimately to BYU's O-line. Now, he sees how God guided him to the right place, the right team, at the right time.

items.title: 1976 Team
items.description: The Cougars' 1976 football team reunite to share the remarkable lessons taught by coach LaVell Edwards and replay the incredible season that put BYU in front of a national audience.

items.title: Denver Latter-day Saints and Their Neighbors
items.description: This documentary explores what matters most to members of the Church in and around Denver, Colorado, for over 150 years. From the late 1800s to the present day, a heartwarming story of cooperation, community, service and faith in Christ emerges.

items.title: Designing a Safer World - BYU UX Design
items.description: Students take design beyond the classroom to address real safety and sanitation challenges in India, discovering how empathy, collaboration, and creative problem-solving can lead to solutions with the potential to improve lives worldwide.

items.title: LoRusso Family vs. Castleberry Family
items.description: In a combined game show and cooking competition to win $10,000, the LoRussos make an Italian salmon pasta and bruschetta while the Castleberrys prepare BBQ ribs and tri-tip steak. The teams face setbacks as they play games to rack up points.

items.title: Horlacher Family vs. Mills Family
items.description: The Horlacher family cooks Hawaiian food and the Mills family makes comfort food in this combined cooking competition and game show. Tensions rise while they work to complete meals and play games to earn points to win $10,000.

items.title: Smith Family vs. Ortega Family
items.description: In this mixed game show and food competition, the Smith family prepares tortilla soup and the Ortega family makes marsala chicken. The time sensitive cooking is disrupted to play games that earn the teams points in hopes of winning $10,000.

items.title: Peterson Family vs. Patmides Family
items.description: The Peterson family makes Mahalo burgers and the Patmides family prepares fasolakia in hopes of winning $10,000 in this blended cooking competition and game show. They play games that disrupt their cooking processes as they work against the clock.

items.title: Lee Family vs. Yen Family
items.description: In this merged game show and cooking competition, the Lee family creates a Thai inspired meal and the Yen family prepares mushroom chicken as they compete to win $10,000. They rush to finish the meal and play games to earn points.

items.title: Vasquez Family vs. Lighten Family
items.description: The Vasquez family prepares traditional Puerto Rican food and the Lighten family makes tomato basil bisque with homegrown ingredients in a cooking competition. The teams also compete in games to earn points in hopes of winning $10,000.

items.title: Wanlass Family vs. Best Family
items.description: In this fused game show and cooking competition, the Wanless family makes surf and turf tacos and the Best Family prepares flank steak. The teams’ progress is disrupted with games that give them a chance to rack up points in hopes of winning $10,000.

items.title: McLean Family vs. Marshall Family
items.description: The McLean family makes their award-winning turkey chili and the Marshall family creates sweet and sour meatballs in this melded cooking competition and game show. The families play games to rack up points as they rush to finish in hopes of $10,000.

items.title: Cardwell Family vs. Worthen Family
items.description: Hoping to win $10,000 in this combined game show and cooking show, the Caldwell family creates spaghetti pizza and the Worthen family prepares cinnamon chili pork. The teams keep spirits up as they cook their meals and play games to earn points.

items.title: Junca Family vs. Uberty Family
items.description: The Junca and Uberty families compete by creating meals and play games in hopes of winning $10,000. The Junca family prepares traditional Uruguayan churrasco while the Uberty family makes a three-cheese lobster mac and cheese.

items.title: Carter Family vs. Jashinsky Family
items.description: The Carter family creates Cajun-inspired dishes and the Jashinsky family makes Italian-influenced food in this fused cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. The teams race to finish every recipe and are interrupted by games to earn points.

items.title: Luu Family vs. Tresner Family
items.description: The Luu family creates Vietnamese orange duck and the Tresner family prepares Italian chicken parmesan pasta in hopes to win $10,000 in this blended game show and cooking competition. The teams’ hurried cooking progress is interrupted to play games.

items.title: Garcia Family vs. Frost Family
items.description: In this blended game show and cooking competition, the Garcia family creates Chinese-Mexican dishes and the Frost family prepares European inspired cuisine in hopes of winning $10,000. Stress starts boiling as they battle in games to earn points.

items.title: Sisa-At Family vs. Daniel Family
items.description: The Sisa-At family creates traditional Thai cuisine and the Daniel family prepares Mexican inspired dishes in this mixed cooking contest and game show to win $10,000. The teams rush against time in cooking and playing games to earn the most points.

items.title: Peterson Family vs. Fonotisatele Family
items.description: In this blended cooking and game show, the Peterson family makes pot roast beef and the Fonotisatele family prepares roasted chicken in hopes of winning $10,000. The cooking progress is disrupted as teams go head-to-head in games to earn points.

items.title: Ofahengaue Family vs. Trout Family
items.description: The Ofahengaue family prepares Hawaiian style fare and the Trout family makes Mexican inspired cuisine in this combined cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. Meal progress is disrupted to play games to earn points along the way.

items.title: Leonidas Family vs. Hubsmith Family
items.description: The Leonida family prepares traditional Tanzania cuisine and the Hubsmith family creates Italian inspired dishes in a game show cooking competition to win $10,000. Cooking is disrupted for games to earn points as they race against the clock.

items.title: Kimsey Family vs. Gressman Family
items.description: In a mixed cooking competition and game show, the Kimsey family prepares ginger glazed king salmon and the Gressman family makes quiche Lorraine. As they rush to complete the meals, they are interrupted to play games in hopes of winning $10,000.

items.title: Lewis Family vs. Santos Family
items.description: The Lewis family creates herb and spice tri-tip steak and the Santos family prepares Ecuadorian shrimp ceviche in this combined cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. The hurried progress is disrupted by games to earn points.

items.title: Jensen Family vs. Brox Family
items.description: The Jensen family creates Cajun-spiced bacon burgers and the Brox family prepares specialty fried chicken in this blended cooking competition and game show to win $10,000. Kitchen mistakes are made and games are played so the teams can earn points.

items.title: Hanamaika'i Family vs. Lloyd Family
items.description: In this mixed cooking competition and game show, the Hanamaika’i family prepares traditional southwestern cuisine and the Lloyd family creates Italian inspired dishes for $10,000. The teams participate in games as they rush to finish each plate.

items.title: Hunt Family vs. Wilkins Family
items.description: The Hunt family creates Mexican-inspired dishes and the Wilkins family prepares traditional Swiss cuisine in this blended cooking competition and game show for $10,000. While hurrying to complete the meals, the teams battle in games to earn points.

items.title: Reese Family vs. Campos Family
items.description: In this combined cooking competition and game show, the Reese family makes a seafood risotto and the Campos family prepares bistec encebollado in hopes of $10,000. Cooking progress is slowed as teammates go head-to-head to play games for points.

items.title: Hansen Family vs. Sorensen Family
items.description: The Hanson family makes chicken piccata and the Sorensen family prepares chili casserole in this combined game show and cooking competition in hopes of winning $10,000. While racing against the clock to finish the food, they play games for points.

items.title: Joseph Smith-History
