items.description: Religious scholars discuss the events leading to the coming forth of the Book of Mormon including celestial visitations and the calling of Joseph Smith as prophet, seer, and revelator. With Andrew H. Hedges, Kent Jackson, Keith Wilson, Steven Harper.

items.title: Testimony of the Witnesses and General Church History
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the efforts of Joseph Smith to translate, print, and bind the Book of Mormon as well as the testimony of the witnesses to the plates. With Andrew H. Hedges, Kent P. Jackson, Keith J. Wilson, and Steven C. Harper.

items.title: The Structure of the Book of Mormon
items.description: Religious scholars discuss and explain the structure, chronology, and writing styles of the Book of Mormon. With Andrew H. Hedges, Keith J. Wilson, Todd B. Parker, and Steven C. Harper.

items.title: The Divine Purposes of the Book of Mormon--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the title page, written by Moroni, as well as the many authors that contributed to the Book of Mormon. With Daniel K. Judd, Clyde J. Williams, Frank F. Judd, and Stan A. Johnson.

items.title: The Divine Purposes of the Book of Mormon--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the divine purposes of the Book of Mormon to testify of Jesus Christ and the claim that it is the most correct book on the Earth. With Daniel K. Judd, Clyde J. Williams, Frank F. Judd, and Stan A. Johnson.

items.title: 1 Nephi 1-2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Prophet Lehi and his family’s obedience to flee Jerusalem to the promised as written by Nephi, Lehi’s son, in 1 Nephi chapters 1-2. With Terry B. Ball, Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, and Paul Y. Hoskisson.

items.title: 1 Nephi 3-7
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Lehi’s sons’ errands to Jerusalem to retrieve the brass plates and the family of Ishmael as ordered by the Lord in 1 Nephi chapters 3-7. With Terry B. Ball, Paul Y. Hoskisson, Clyde J. Williams, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: 1 Nephi 8-10
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Lehi’s vision of the tree of life in 1 Nephi chapters 8-10. With Terri B. Ball, Gaye Strathearn, Paul Y. Hoskisson, and Clyde J. Williams.

items.title: 1 Nephi 11-12
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Nephi’s vision of the tree of life in 1 Nephi chapters 11 and 12.

items.title: 1 Nephi 13-15
items.description: Religious scholars continue discussing Nephi’s vision in 1 Nephi chapters 13-15 and applying the symbolism in the latter days. With Daniel K. Judd, Kith J. Wilson, Camille Fronk Olson, and Dana M. Pike.

items.title: 1 Nephi 16-18
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Nephi chapters 16-18 which detail the preparations Lehi’s family took for their journey to the promised land. With Daniel K. Judd, Kith J. Wilson, Camille Fronk Olson, and Dana M. Pike.

items.title: 1 Nephi 19-22
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Nephi’s work of recording in the small plates and the scattering of Israel as found in 1 Nephi chapters 19-22. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: 2 Nephi 1, 3
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 1 and 3 which detail the scattering of Israel, Nephi’s contentions with his brothers, and Lehi’s teaching his son Joseph. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: 2 Nephi 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss how redemption is provided by the Holy Messiah as taught to Jacob, Lehi’s firstborn in the wilderness, in 2 Nephi chapter 2. With Robert L. Millet, Thomas A. Wayment, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: 2 Nephi 4-5
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 4 and 5 which describe the blessings Lehi gives to his posterity before his death and Nephi’s psalm. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Eric D. Huntsman, Victor L. Ludlow, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: 2 Nephi 6-8, 10
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob teaching the words of Isaiah and the history of the Jews in 2 Nephi chapters 6, 7, 8, and 10. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, and Eric D. Huntsman.

items.title: 2 Nephi 9
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapter 9 which provides Jacob’s teaching of Isaiah’s words concerning the Atonement and the gathering of Israel. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Stanley A. Johnson, Eric D. Huntsman, and Victor L. Ludlow.

items.title: 2 Nephi 11-16
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Isaiah chapters found in 2 Nephi chapters 11 through 16 and the principles of covenants associated with the Atonement. With Victor L. Ludlow, Dana M. Pike, Terry B. Ball, and Kerry Muhlestein.

items.title: 2 Nephi 17-24
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Isaiah chapters found in 2 Nephi chapters 17 through 24 which detail the prophecies of the coming and purposes of Jesus Christ. With Victor L. Ludlow, Dana M. Pike, Terry B. Ball, and Kerry Muhlestein.

items.title: 2 Nephi 25-27
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 25 through 27 and Nephi’s expounding on the words of Isaiah and how we can apply them to our lives in the latter days. With Victor L. Ludlow, Kerry Muhlestein, Dana M. Pike, and Terry B. Ball.

items.title: 2 Nephi 28-30
items.description: Religious scholars discuss false churches and the denial of miracles and modern revelation in the last days as found in 2 Nephi chapters 28 through 30. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: 2 Nephi 31-33
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Nephi chapters 31 through 33 which provide Nephi’s testimony on baptism, prayer, the Holy Ghost, and Jesus Christ. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: Jacob 1-3, 7
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob’s taking the mantle from Nephi of keeping a record and his teaching to reject pride and immorality in Jacob chapters 1, 2, 3, and 7. With Gaye Strathearn, Keith J. Wilson, Michael Rhodes, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: Jacob 4-6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the allegory of the olive tree and how it applies to the ancient Israelites and to us today as found in Jacob chapters 4 through 6. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Frank Judd, and Jared Ludlow.

items.title: Enos; Jarom; Omni
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the books of Enos, Jarom and Omni which demonstrate the importance of record keeping, repentance, and obedience. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Frank Judd, and Jared Ludlow.

items.title: Words of Mormon; Mosiah 1-2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon’s work of abridgment and the reign and teaching of King Benjamin as described in the Words of Mormon and the Book of Mosiah chapters 1 and 2. With Victor L. Ludlow, Charles Swift, Jared Ludlow, and Frank Judd.

items.title: Mosiah 3-6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Atonement of Jesus Christ as taught by King Benjamin and his work to organize and record the names of his people in Mosiah chapters 4-6. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Mosiah 7-13
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the contention between the Nephites and Lamanites and the lives of Ammon, Zeniff, Laman, Noah and Abinadi in Mosiah chapters 7-13. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Mosiah 18-24
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s authority as a prophet and the conflict between the people of King Noah and King Limhi as described in Mosiah chapters 18 through 24. With Clyde Williams, Andrew C. Skinner, Eric D. Huntsman, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Mosiah 14-17
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Mosiah chapters 14 through 17 which provide Abinadi’s sermon to King Noah which taught of Jesus Christ being the Messiah as taught by Isaiah. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Mosiah 25-28
items.description: Religious scholars discuss organizing the Church of God and the importance of belief in order to understand as taught in Mosiah chapters 25 through 28. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Mosiah 29
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma the Younger’s change of heart and purpose and Mosiah changing the government from kings to judges as described in Mosiah chapter 29. With Robert L. Millet, D. Kelly Ogden, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Alma 1-4
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapter 1 through 4 which detail Nehor’s false teaching and the conflicts spread throughout the land politically and spiritually. With Terry B. Ball, Thomas Wayment, David M. Whitchurch, and Dana M. Pike.

items.title: Alma 5-7
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma the Younger’s preaching the gospel and organizing the Church in the lands of Zarahemla and Gideon as detailed in Alma chapters 5 through 7. With Terry B. Ball, Dana M. Pike, David M. Whitchurch, and Thomas Wayment.

items.title: Alma 8-12
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the continued preaching of Alma the Younger in Alma chapters 8 through 12 where he sees varied results from Melek, Ammonihah, Zeezrom, and others. With Terry B. Ball, David M. Whitchurch, and Thomas Wayment, Dana M. Pike.

items.title: Alma 13-16
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 13 through 16 which detail Alma and Amulek being sent to prison but after a miraculous act of God were able to walk out. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Camille Fronk Olson, Eric D. Huntsman, Clyde J. Williams.

items.title: Alma 17-21
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the sons of Mosiah preaching to the Lamanites in the land of Nephi as found in Alma chapters 17 through 21. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Eric D. Huntsman, Clyde J. Williams, and Camille Fronk Olson.

items.title: Alma 20-24
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 20 through 24 which detail Ammon delivering his brothers from prison to continue missionary work to King Lamoni’s people. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Clyde J. Williams, Camille Fronk Olson, and Eric D. Huntsman.

items.title: Alma 25-29
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the ongoing preaching of the sons of Mosiah despite Lamanite aggressions and their return to the land of Nephi in Alma chapters 25 through 29. With Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, Charles Swift, and Keith J. Wilson.

items.title: Alma 30
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the lies of Korihor, the anti-Christ, compared against the truth that Alma preaches as found in Alma chapter 30. With Clyde J. Williams, Gaye Strathearn, Charles Swift, and Keith J. Wilson.

items.title: Alma 31-32
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 31 and 32 which detail Alma’s efforts to humble the apostate Zoramites who were prideful and prayed on a Rameumptom. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Gaye Strathearn, and Charles Swift.

items.title: Alma 33-35
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s continued preaching to the Zoramites about mercy and salvation provided by Christ as found in Alma chapters 33 through 35. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Alma 36-37
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 36 and 37 which detail Alma’s teaching to his son Helaman who, as Alma, went through a conversion process and will be a prophet. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Alma 38-39
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapters 38 and 39 which provide Alma’s commandments, blessings, and callings to his sons Shiblon and Corianton. With Victor L. Ludlow, Stanley A. Johnson, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Alma 40-41
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma’s continued teaching to his son Corianton concerning the resurrection and judgment of all men in Alma chapters 40 and 41. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Alma 42
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Alma chapter 42 which details how Alma teaches God’s plan of redemption to his son Corianton who has struggled with overcoming the natural man. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Alma 43-50
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the war chapters found in Alma chapters 43 through 50 and the spiritual lessons available to us in these chapters and the example of Captain Moroni. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, and Brian M. Hauglid.

items.title: Alma 51-63
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the wars described in Alma chapters 51-63 including Captain Moroni and the stripling warriors and epistles between Pahoran and Moroni. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Helaman 1-6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the contention and conflicts that existed among the Nephites as found in Helaman chapters 1 through 6. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Helaman 7-12
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Nephi, the son of Helaman, and the discouragement he encounters as many reject his words as found in Helaman chapters 7 through 12. With Clyde J. Williams, Keith J. Wilson, Jared W. Ludlow, and D. Kelly Ogd

items.title: Helaman 13-16
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Samuel the Lamanite and the persecution and rejection he experienced as described in Helaman chapters 13 through 16. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Michael Rhodes, Thomas A. Wayment, and Todd B. Parker.

items.title: 3 Nephi 1-4
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Lamanite and Nephite people after Samuel the Lamanite’s prophecies in 3 Nephi chapters 1-4 including them fighting the Gadianton robbers. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Thomas A. Wayment, Todd B. Parker, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: 3 Nephi 5-9
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 5-9 which detail the Nephite repentance cycle and the destruction attesting Christ’s crucifixion and precedes His coming. With Paul Y. Hoskisson, Todd B. Parker, Michael Rhodes, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: 3 Nephi 10-11
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the voice of Christ heard after many hours of silence and His appearance among the Nephites as described in 3 Nephi chapters 10 and 11. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: 3 Nephi 12
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapter 12 which details Christ’s sermon to the Nephites on the Beatitudes, similar to the Sermon on the Mount in the New Testament. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: 3 Nephi 13-14
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus teaching the Nephites on prayer and striving for perfection as described in 3 Nephi chapter 13 and 14. With D. Kelly Ogden, David M. Whitchurch, Thomas A. Wayment, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: 3 Nephi 15, 17
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 15 and 17 which details Jesus’s fulfillment of the law of Moses, teaching things that cannot be written, and blessing the sick. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: 3 Nephi 18-19
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus introducing the sacrament to the Nephites and provide an example and instruction on prayer as described in 3 Nephi chapters 18 and 19. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: 3 Nephi 16, 20-22
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 3 Nephi chapters 16 and 20 through 22 which detail Jesus teaching the Nephites about gathering His lost sheep and establishing Zion. With Gaye Strathearn, Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk Olsen, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: 3 Nephi 23-26
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus quoting and expounding on the words of Isaiah and Malachi as he teaches the Nephites about the last days in 3 Nephi chapters 23 through 26. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: 3 Nephi 27-30
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Christ naming and organizing His church and gospel with the Nephites and the righteous desires of the 12 disciples in 3 Nephi chapters 27 through 30. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: 4 Nephi
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 4 Nephi which details the 200 years of peace and prosperity between the Nephites and Lamanites as all were converted after Christ’s appearance. With Robert L. Millet, Todd B. Parker, Kerry Muhlestein, and Dan Belnap.

items.title: Mormon 1-6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon the prophet and his accomplishments and challenges as a military leader and prophet as described in Mormon chapters 1 through 6. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: Mormon 7-9
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Mormon chapters 7 through 9 which provide Mormon’s invitation to the remnant of the Lamanites in the latter days to believe in Christ. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: Ether 1-6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Jaredites journey to the promised land including the brother of Jared seeing the finger of the Lord in Ether chapters 1 through 6. With Keith J. Wilson, Andrew C. Skinner, David M. Whitchurch, and Stanley A. Johnson.

items.title: Ether 7-11
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Ether chapters 7 through 11 which detail the journey of the Jaredites to the promised land and the dissension that arose among them. With Andrew C. Skinner, Terry B. Ball, Jared Ludlow, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Ether 12-15
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the dissension of the Jaredite people that led to loss of faith, war, and their utter destruction as described in Ether chapters 12 through 15. With Andrew C. Skinner, Terry B. Ball, Jared Ludlow, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Moroni 1-6
items.description: Religious scholars continue discussing the end of the Jaredites and the instructions Moroni provides in church administration as found in Moroni chapters 1 through 6. With Andrew C. Skinner, Jared Ludlow, Terry B. Ball, and Terrence L. Szink.

items.title: Moroni 7
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Moroni chapter 7 which provides Moroni’s invitation to live the gospel with pure intent and his teaching on the Spirit of Christ. With Stanley A. Johnson, Thomas A Wayment, Camille Fronk Olson, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Moroni 8-10
items.description: Religious scholars discuss principles of baptism, the importance of laboring diligently, and Moroni’s promise of truth as found in Moroni chapters 8 through 10. With Stanley A. Johnson, Thomas A Wayment, Camille Fronk Olson, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Introduction and Historic Overview
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the title page and revelations found in the Doctrine and Covenants, as well as the people involved in creating, preserving, and arranging it. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Susan Easton Black, and Andrew Skinner.

items.title: D&C 1: A Voice of Warning
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the preface of the Doctrine and Covenants. Section 1 invites members of the Church of Jesus Christ to listen to and obey the voice of the Lord. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, and Susan Easton Black.

items.title: D&C 2: Promises Made to the Fathers
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Spirit of Elijah, the importance of families, and the power of the priesthood found in Doctrine and Covenants section 2. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Susan Easton Black, and Andrew Skinner.

items.title: D&C 3 & 10: The Lost Manuscript
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 3 and 10 which details how the translation of the Book of Mormon is disrupted when Martin Harris loses the first 116 pages. With Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, Craig Ostler, Brent Top.

items.title: D&C 5 & 17: Witnesses of the Book of Mormon
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 5 and 17 and the witnesses to the gold plates. They provide context to the Book of Mormon but the Spirit brings conversion. With Brent Top, Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 6 & 8-9: The Spirit of Revelation
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 6, 8, and 9 where Oliver Cowdery desires a witness and confirmation of his personal revelation and is given gifts of spirit. With Brent Top, Guy Dorius, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 7 & 13: John the Revelator & John the Baptist
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 7 and 13. Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery ask about John’s power over death and receive the Aaronic Priesthood. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 4, 11-12 & 14-16: Qualifications for Service
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 4, 11, 12, 14, and 16 where Joseph Smith received revelations relevant to full-time missionaries and members today. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 18-19: The Worth of Souls
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 18 and 19 and the revelation regarding calling twelve apostles in the latter days and the responsibility therein. With Matthew Richardson, John Livingston, Steven Harper, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 20-22: The Organization of the Church
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the organizational instruction for the roles and responsibilities of priesthood offices found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 20 through 22. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 23-24 & 26: The Cause of Zion
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the revelations found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 23, 24, and 26 that provide instruction and support for the Saints through persecution. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 25: An Elect Lady
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 25. The only section written to a woman, Emma Smith, is applicable to all members of the Church. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Mary Jane Woodger, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 27-28: Take Upon You My Whole Armor
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 27 and 28 where the Saints receive direction on the sacrament and discernment between revelation and deceit. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

items.title: D&C 29: Prepare for the Days to Come
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 29 which teaches that Jesus Christ will gather his people, forgive them, and serve as advocate at the judgment day. Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

items.title: D&C 30-35: Calls to Preach the Gospel
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 30 through 35 where several individuals receive direct callings and instructions to preach the gospel. With Andrew Skinner, Matthew Richardson, Randy Bott, and Alexander Baugh.

items.title: D&C 36-40: Heeding the Lord's Call
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 36 through 40 where the Saints of the early restored Church are commanded to urgently move to Ohio. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, Steven and Harper.

items.title: D&C 41-42: The Law of the Church
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of the Church found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 41 and 42 and the importance of calling, sustaining, and preaching the gospel. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, Steven and Harper.

items.title: D&C 43-45: The Great Day of the Lord
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 43, 44, and 45. The Saints learn the importance of being endowed with power to prepare for the second coming of Christ. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, Randy Bott, and Steven Harper.

items.title: D&C 46-49: To Every Man Is Given a Gift
items.description: Religious scholars discuss spiritual gifts as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 46 through 49 as well as the importance of stewardship and recording history. With Brent Top, Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 50-56: Called to Forsake the World
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 50 through 56 which teach discernment between good and evil spirits and the law of consecration. With Brent Top, Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 57-59: Laying the Foundation of Zion
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 57 through 59 where the Saints of the early restored Church travel to Missouri to establish Zion. Brent Top, H. Dean Garrett, Alexander Baugh, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 60-62: A Commission to Testify
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 60 through 62 where missionaries experience rejection and trials and are instructed on how to proceed with good cheer. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Steven Harper.

items.title: D&C 63-65: The Lord Requireth the Heart
items.description: Religious scholars discuss found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 63 through 65. The Lord’s anger is kindled by sign seekers and the Saints are commanded to forgive each other. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Steven Harper, and Randy Bott.

items.title: D&C 66-68: The Everlasting Covenant
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 66 through 68 and the specific guidance given to several individuals regarding callings, blessings, and promises. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Manscill, Steven Harper, and Randy Bott.

items.title: D&C 69-75: An Account of Their Stewardship
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 69 through 75 where the Lord provides instruction on stewardship and progression in His Church. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 76: The Vision--Part 1
items.description: Part one of two of religious scholars discussing Doctrine and Covenants section 76. Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon receive a revolutionary vision of the spirit world. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingston, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 76: The Vision--Part 2
items.description: Part two of religious scholars discussing Doctrine and Covenants section 76. Outlines of those who will reside in the three glories of the kingdom of God are presented. With Matthew Richardson, Richard Cowan, John Livingston, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 77-79: A Covenant That Cannot Be Broken
items.description: Religious scholars discuss preparing for the second coming of Jesus Christ and the United Order as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 77 through 79. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

items.title: D&C 80-83: Keys of the Kingdom
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the responsibilities of the First Presidency and the law of consecration as described in Doctrine and Covenants sections 80 through 83. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

items.title: D&C 84-87: Oath and Covenant of the Priesthood
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 84 through 87 where the lineage and authority of the priesthood is outlined and responsibilities are expounded. With Matthew Richardson, Craig Manscill, Randy Bott, and Richard Cowan.

items.title: D&C 88-89: Prepare and Sanctify Yourselves
items.description: Religious scholars discuss how to sanctify ourselves, progress, comprehend the laws of God, and the Word of Wisdom in Doctrine and Covenants sections 88 and 89. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 90-93: Light and Truth
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 90 through 93 which teaches how to progress grace for grace as Jesus Christ did in mortality. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 94-97: A House of God
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the sacrifices and blessings that came from obeying the Lord’s command to build temples as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 94 through 97. With Guy Dorius, Jerry Perkins, Steve Harper, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 98-100: I Will Prove You in All Things
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 98 through 100 which provides guidance and comfort to the Saints who experience persecution and trials. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

items.title: D&C 101, 103 & 105: Chastened and Tried
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the continued persecution and chastisement the Saints endure and Zion’s Camp in Doctrine and Covenants sections 101, 103, and 105. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

items.title: D&C 102, 104 & 106: Inasmuch as They Are Faithful
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 102, 104, and 106 which provide instruction on the organization of the high council and the law of consecration. With Matthew Richardson, Dean Garrett, John Livingston, and Craig Manscill.

items.title: D&C 107: Quorums and the Priesthood
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the responsibilities of the offices of the Melchizedek and Aaronic Priesthoods outlined in the first half of Doctrine and Covenants section 107. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 107-109: Let Every Man Learn His Duty
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the clarification on priesthood offices found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 107-109. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 109-110: A Place of Holiness
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the dedicatory prayer of the Kirtland temple and the appearance of Jehovah and ancient prophets in Doctrine and Covenants sections 109 and 110. With Andrew Skinner, Susan Easton Black, Richard Cowan, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 111-113: More Treasures Than One
items.description: Religious scholars discuss treasure, the Apostles’ faith, questions from reading Isaiah, and the Lord’s guidance presented in Doctrine and Covenants sections 111 through 113. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 114-116: The Stakes of Zion
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 114 through 116 where the Lord gives instruction on the continued organization and growth of the Church in Missouri. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 117-120: I Will Provide
items.description: Religious Scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 117 through 120 and the direction on callings for the quorum of the Twelve Apostles and clarification on tithes. With Matthew Richardson, Alexander Baugh, Jerry Perkins, and Craig Ostler.

items.title: D&C 121: Peace Be Unto Thy Soul
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Joseph Smith’s prayer for mercy while in Liberty Jail and the Lord’s comfort and encouragement found in Doctrine and Covenants section 121. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 122-123: Art Thou Greater Than He?
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Liberty Jail epistles in Doctrine and Covenants sections 122-123 which show the Lord’s understanding of and compassion for our suffering. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 124: The City of Nauvoo
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 124 which details instructions for continued progress as the Church headquarters is now in Nauvoo, Illinois. With Susan Easton Black, Craig Ostler, John Livingstone, and Lawrence Flake.

items.title: D&C 125-128: Baptisms for the Dead
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the will of the Lord pertaining to stakes of Zion, Brigham Young, and baptisms of the dead as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 125 through 128. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 129-131: The Order of Heaven
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants sections 129 through 131 which outline how to discern between angels and spirits and the importance of obedience to God’s laws. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 132-133: A New and Everlasting Covenant
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of celestial marriage and preparing for Christ’s Second Coming as explained in Doctrine and Covenants sections 132 and 133. With Susan Easton Black, Dean Garrett, Randy Bott, and Guy Dorius.

items.title: D&C 134: Governments Were Instituted of God
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Doctrine and Covenants section 134 which outlines the importance and support of government as an encouragement of the agency of man. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 135-136: The Martyrdom
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the martyrdoms of Joseph and Hyrum Smith in Doctrine and Covenants section 135 and the will of the Lord given to Brigham Young in section 136. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: D&C 137-138: Heirs of the Kingdom
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the redemption of the dead and progression in the spirit world as found in Doctrine and Covenants sections 137 and 138. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: Section 138 & Official Declarations: Continuing Revelation
items.description: Religious scholars finish discussing the spirit world in Doctrine and Covenants section 138 and examine revelations on polygamy and priesthood in the Official Declarations. With Andrew Skinner, Lawrence Flake, Steven Harper, and Mary Jane Woodger.

items.title: The Old Testament: An Introduction and Overview
items.description: Religious scholars provide an introduction and overview of the Old Testament. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Gen. 1: The Creation
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapter 1 which details God’s process of creating the Earth culminating with the creation of mankind in God’s image. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Gen. 2-3: Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden and their actions and decision that led to them leaving the garden as described in Genesis chapters 2 and 3. With Andrew C. Skinner, Ray Huntington, Terry B. Ball, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Gen. 4-6: The Fall; The Patriarchs
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapters 4 through 6 which detail the conflict between Cain and Abel as well as the line of righteous patriarchs from Adam to Noah. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Gen. 9-16: Noah; Abraham and the Covenant
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the covenants God made with Enoch, Noah, and Abraham as described in Genesis chapters 9 through 16. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Abraham: A Man of Faith and Righteousness
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapter 17 through 22 which detail the differences between Abraham’s sons Ishmael and Isaac and their parts in the Abrahamic covenant. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Gen. 23-30: The Birthright
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the birthright conflict between Isaac and Rebekah’s twins Esau and Jacob as described in Genesis chapters 23 through 30. With Andrew C. Skinner, D. Kelly Ogden, Clyde J. Williams, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Gen. 29-37: Jacob and His Family
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jacob’s life in Genesis chapters 29 through 37 from marrying Leah and Rachel, reuniting with Esau, his name changing to Israel, to his children. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Gen. 37-50: Joseph
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Genesis chapters 37 through 50 which detail Joseph’s journey from his brothers selling him into slavery to rising to second in command of Egypt. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Gen. 49 - Ex. 10: The Death of Jacob; Moses
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the death of Jacob, the trials of the Israelites, and the life of Moses at the end of Genesis and Exodus chapters 1 through 10. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Ex. 11-18: The Passover and the Exodus
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Exodus chapters 11 through 18 which detail Moses’ leading the Israelites out of Egypt, through the Red Sea, and in the wilderness. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Clyde J. Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Ex. 20: The Ten Commandments
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Ten Commandments that were received by Moses for the Israelites in the wilderness as described in Exodus chapter 20. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Ex. 21-24 & 31-35: The Law of Moses
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the law of Moses as found in Exodus chapters 21 through 24 and 31 through 35 which provide guidance in spiritual and temporal matters. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

items.title: The House of the Lord in the Wilderness
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the details of the tabernacle that is carried as the Israelites journey in the wilderness in Exodus chapters 25 through 30 and 35 through 40. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Lev. 1-27: The Book of Leviticus
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Book of Leviticus which provides instructions for the Levites, the priesthood holders, on how to administer sacrifices and ordinances. With Victor L. Ludlow, Paul Y. Hoskisson, S. Kent Brown, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Num. 1-7: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the census, callings, and preparation of the Israelites that are accomplished in Numbers chapters 1 through 7. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

items.title: Num. 8-21: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Numbers chapters 8 through 21 which detail the trials and murmurings of the Israelites as they journey in the wilderness. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

items.title: Num. 21-36: Lessons in the Wilderness--Part 3
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Israelite journey in the wilderness as they reach the land of Moab and the acts of the prophet Balaam as found in Numbers chapters 21 through 36. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

items.title: Deut. 1-10: Final Sermons of Moses--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the final sermons and warnings of Moses to the children of Israel as found in Deuteronomy chapters 1 through 10. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

items.title: Deut. 11-34: Final Sermons of Moses--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Moses’ final sermons to the children of Israel that emphasize covenants and worship of the one God as found in Deuteronomy chapters 11 through 34. With Andrew C. Skinner, Victor L. Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Dana Pike.

items.title: Josh. 1-24: Entry into the Promised Land
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Book of Joshua which details the change of leadership from Moses to Joshua and the Israelites arrival to the promised land. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Judg. 1-12: Judges--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Lord appointing judges to rule over the children of Israel after they worship false gods as described in Judges chapters 1 through 12. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Judg. 13-Ruth 4: Judges--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the different acts of Gideon, Jephthah, Samson, and Ruth and Naomi as described in Judges chapters 13 through 21 and Ruth chapters 1 through 4. With Dana Pike, Paul Hoskisson, Todd Parker, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: 1 Sam. 1-15: Samuel and Saul
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Samuel chapters 1 through 15 which detail Hannah’s prayer for a son and promise to give him to the Lord, resulting in Samuel the prophet. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 1 Sam. 16-31: Saul and David
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Israelite demand for a king leading to the promising beginnings and downfalls of kings Saul and David as described in 1 Samuel chapters 16 through 31. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 1 Sam. 18-2 Sam. 5: The Fall of King David
items.description: Religious scholars discuss David’s popularity with the people and his relationships with King Saul and Saul’s son Jonathan as found 1 Samuel chapters 18-31 and 2 Samuel chapters 1-5. With Andrew Skinner, Terry Ball, Keith Wilson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 2 Sam. 6-12: David's Kingship and Decline
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Samuel chapters 6 through 12 which detail David’s rise, fall, and return to humility and repentance as king in Israel. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: The Price of Sin—Tragedy in the House of David
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the difficulties in the house of King David including his sons’ sins of incest, infidelity, and murder as found in 2 Samuel chapters 13 through 24. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: 1 Kgs. 1-11: Solomon
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Kings chapters 1 through 11 which details the throne passing from David to Solomon and the conflicts that arise after that transition. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: The Psalms--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the different authors of the book of Psalms and the examples of poetry displayed and special purposes provided in them. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: The Psalms--Part 2: Messianic Psalms
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Messianic Psalms scattered throughout the book of Psalms and how interpretations have varied between different faiths. With Paul Hoskisson, D. Kelly Ogden, Eric Huntsman, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Prov. 1-Eccl. 12: Proverbs and Ecclesiastes
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the wisdom literature found in the books of Proverbs and Ecclesiastes which were not written by prophets. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Job 1-42: The Book of Job
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Job and the lessons and parallels to our lives that are available to us. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 1 Kgs. 12-16: A Kingdom Divided Against Itself
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the division of the Israelites into the Kingdom of Judah and the Kingdom of Israel as found in 1 Kings chapters 12 through 16. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 1 Kgs. 17-22: The Ministry of Elijah
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Kings chapters 17 through 22 which detail the ministry of Elijah and the miracles and wonders and sealing powers he facilitated among the Israelites. With Terry Ball, Richard Draper, Eric Huntsman, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: 2 Kgs. 1-4: The Ministry of Elisha
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Kings chapters 1 through 4 which tell of the prophetic mantle being passed from Elijah to Elisha. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: 2 Kgs. 4-9: The Ministry of Elisha
items.description: Religious scholars discuss miracles the prophet Elisha performed in 2 Kings chapters 4 through 9 including promising a child to a barren woman, raising the dead, and healing leprosy. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Amos 1-9: The Book of Amos
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Amos which details Amos' calling from God to prophesy and preach in the Kingdom of Judah. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Jonah 1-4: The Book of Jonah
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jonah’s prophetic calling and his attempts to run from it in order to save himself from the hands of the Assyrians as described in the book of Jonah. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Thomas Wayment, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Hosea 1-14: The Book of Hosea
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Hosea which details the marriage of Hosea and the scattering and gathering of his family and how it parallels God and the Israelites. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Micah 1-7 & Joel 1-3: The Books of Micah and Joel
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the prophecies about and for the Israelites that are still applicable in the latter days as found in the books of Micah and Joel. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Fall of N. Kingdom and Preservation of S. Kingdom
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 2 Kings chapters 14 through 20 which detail the political strife that leads to the fall of the Northern Kingdom of Israel and the lost ten tribes of Israel. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Isa. 1-6: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the life and prophetic calling of Isaiah and his master of symbolic poetry in teaching gospel principles and prophecies in Isaiah chapters 1 through 6. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Keith Wilson.

items.title: Isa. 7-12: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 7 through 12 which provide Isaiah’s Messianic prophecies amidst politic conflict and destruction that abound in the land. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

items.title: Isa. 13-23: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 3
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 13 through 23 which prophecy the destruction of Babylon, Moab, Damascus, Egypt, and Jerusalem and the gathering of Israel in the last days. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

items.title: Isa. 24-35: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 4
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the prophecies regarding the Second Coming and Christ’s reign during the Millennium as described in Isaiah chapters 24 through 35. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

items.title: Isa. 36-44: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 5
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 36 through 44 which detail Isaiah’s counsel to Hezekiah, the Lord protecting Judah, and Hezekiah’s life extending 15 more years. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, D. Kelly Ogden, and Terrence Szink.

items.title: Isa. 45-52: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 6
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the role of Jehovah as the Savior, the destruction of Babylon, and Zion in the last days as described in Isaiah chapters 45 through 52. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Isa. 52-62: Great Are the Words of Isaiah--Part 7
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the covenants to be established in the latter days and the lessons available in temples to prepare for the Second Coming in Isaiah chapters 52 through 62. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Judah's Return to Wickedness
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Isaiah chapters 63 through 66 which tell of Christ’s Millennial reign and 2 Kings chapters 21 through 25 which detail the wicked acts of King Manasseh. With Terry Ball, Victor Ludlow, Clyde Williams, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: The Books of Nahum, Zephaniah, and Habakkuk
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the books of Nahum, Zephaniah, and Habakkuk which detail the destruction of many lands and prophecy of the Second Coming of Christ. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Jer. 1-17: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the hesitancy Jeremiah expressed after his prophetic calling and his preaching as described in Jeremiah chapters 1 through 17. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Jer. 18-29: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jeremiah chapters 18 through 29 which detail the struggles and rejection Jeremiah experiences as he preaches repentance to the children of Israel. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Jer. 29-42: The Prophet Jeremiah--Part 3
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the oncoming captivity of the Jews and the scattering and gathering of Israel as described in Jeremiah chapters 29 through 42. With Ray Huntington, Dana Pike, David Whitchurch, and D. Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Ezek. 1-11: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 1
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel chapters 1 through 11 which detail Ezekiel’s vision and prophetic calling and his preaching to the Israelites in captivity. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Ezek. 12-33: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 2
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel’s use of prophetic reenactments to preach to the Israelites in captivity and call them to repentance as described in Ezekiel chapters 12 through 33. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Ezek. 33-48: The Prophet Ezekiel--Part 3
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezekiel chapters 33 through 48 which detail the fulfilling of Ezekiel’s prophecies regarding the destruction of Jerusalem and the doctrine of repentance. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Dan. 1-12: The Book of Daniel
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the example of wisdom and understanding of Daniel as he lives in Babylon under the reign of Nebuchadnezzar as found in the book of Daniel. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Dana Pike, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Ezra 1-6: The Return of Exiles
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Ezra chapters 1 through 6 which detail the Israelite return to Jerusalem after King Cyrus of Persia overtakes Babylon. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Hag. 1-2: The Book of Haggai
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the command to rebuild the temple and the delayed obedience of the Jews after their return to Jerusalem in the book of Haggai. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Zech. 1-8: The Visions of Zechariah
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the interpretations and applications of the eight visions of Zechariah as found Zechariah chapters 1 through 8. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Zech. 9-14: The Prophet Zechariah
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Zechariah chapters 9 through 14 which detail Zechariah’s Messianic and latter-day revelations he delivered to Jerusalem. With Dana Pike, Eric Huntsman, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Esth. 1-10: The Book of Esther
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Esther’s faith, courage, and example as described in the book of Esther where she risks her life to plead for the lives of the Jews in the Persian kingdom. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Mal. 1-4: The Book of Malachi
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the preaching of Malachi to Jerusalem on the responsibilities they hold as God’s chosen people as found in Malachi chapters 1 through 4. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Mal. 4 & Ezra 7-10: Renewing the Covenant
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Elijah’s role in preparing for Christ’s second coming in Malachi chapter 4 and Ezra’s work among the Israelites in Jerusalem in Ezra chapters 7 through 10. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Neh. 1-13: The Book of Nehemiah
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the book of Nehemiah which details King Artaxerxes trust in Nehemiah as a cupbearer and to rebuild the walls surrounding the city of Jerusalem. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Between the Testaments
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the historical events and religious writings that document the times and people between the Old and New Testaments. With Dana Pike, D. Kelly Ogden, Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Divine Restoration
items.description: After the devastating Lahaina fires, Maui faith communities face loss and an uncertain future. Through prayer, service, and community, they find hope in what remains and discover that restoration is about more than rebuilding what was lost.

items.title: Southmead
items.description: The team renovate an adventure playground in Southmead for future generations.

items.title: Longframlington
items.description: Nick Knowles and the team issue a call to arms and recruit friends, family, and local trades to help transform the homes of families across Britain.

items.title: Stoke
items.description: Nick Knowles and the team issue a call to arms and recruit friends, family, and local trades to help transform the homes of families across Britain.

items.title: Charlton Kings
items.description: Nick Knowles and the team issue a call to arms and recruit friends, family, and local trades to help transform the homes of families across Britain.

items.title: Drop Off
items.description: Thirteen-year-old Tim Parker and his friends make a shocking discovery while riding their bikes along a wooded trail: a duffel bag stuffed with a million dollars. What begins as an innocent adventure quickly becomes a test of loyalty, courage, and co

items.title: Trailer: Dwight in Shining Armor
items.description: Watch the trailer for Dwight in Shining Armor.

items.title: Pilot
items.description: While exploring the woods outside his suburban town, Dwight (a 21st century teen) accidentally awakens a Gothic princess, Gretta, along with her court magician Baldric, and scores of medieval villains.

items.title: Flip
items.description: Jacopo the Troubadour demands that Gretta relinquish her throne; using his magical lute he entrances the citizens of Woodside to do his bidding in his quest.

items.title: Peanut
items.description: Dwight’s community service project follows him home in the shape of the adorable puppy, Peanut; Gretta and Baldric swear that the harmless puppy is something much more menacing.

items.title: Lotions and Potions
items.description: A mysterious elderly woman has arrived in Woodside and kidnapped Gretta; Dwight, Baldric, and Chlodwig must discover the identity of the woman, and what plan she has in store for Gretta.

items.title: Shackled
items.description: While trying to coordinate the annual Woodside Carnival, Dwight and Gretta are kidnapped by a group of bandits and shackled together. Literally inseparable, the two must navigate their way through the carnival.

items.title: Lessons One Through Four
items.description: Baldric becomes possessed by an evil fairy with an aim to open a portal to the fairy realm; Dwight and Gretta hunt for Fairy Baldric as he sets out on a quest for four very specific items.

items.title: Winnie the Wyvern
items.description: Winnie, a nuisance from Gretta’s past, reemerges; Dwight is immediately taken with the beautiful, but uncommunicative woman, and vows to help right the wrong from Winnie’s past.

items.title: Dragon
items.description: In an effort to fix Baldric’s staff, Gretta and Dwight come face to face with the dragon guarding Gretta’s castle; they uncover a family secret in the process.

items.title: Todd
items.description: An unfortunate love spell makes the 7th grade paperboy, Todd, the object of Gretta’s affection; Dwight and Baldric do what they can to help Gretta avoid embarrassment...and a restraining order.

items.title: Champion Do-Over Pt. 1
items.description: A dashing and charismatic knight, Sir Aldred, enters the life of Gretta and Dwight; he possesses a plan to release Dwight from the bonds of the Champion Spell, and take his place as Gretta’s champion.

items.title: Champion Do-Over Pt. II
items.description: Sir Aldred, Baldric, and Gretta set off in the woods to uncover something lost in Gretta’s castle; Dwight, Chlodwig, and Hexela discover information that the group in Gretta’s castle may be in mortal peril.

items.title: Unlucky in Love
items.description: Dwight unknowingly moves a Kofewalt, unleashing a string of bad luck on himself; Gretta and Baldric try to help Dwight avoid his bad luck induced disasters so that he can reconnect with a former crush.

items.title: All Hail the Woodchuck
items.description: The Woodside basketball team inadvertently summons an ancient Highlander warrior; Gretta and Baldric must come to Dwight’s aid as he has fallen ill and cannot perform his duties as Woody the Woodchuck, Woodside’s mascot.

items.title: Alban Elfed Day
items.description: Dwight agrees to help Gretta host an ancient version of Thanksgiving; an infinity spell causes them to live the same day over and over until they accomplish everything correctly.

items.title: Switcheroo
items.description: Due to a magical birthday tradition, Chlodwig and Dwight switch bodies for the day; Gretta and Baldric try to aide the body swapped heroes venture through their days as one another.

items.title: Truthberry Cobbler
items.description: While on a camping trip together, Dwight, Gretta, Baldric, Hexela, and Chlodwig eat magical berries that compel them to tell the truth; Two handsome woodcutters are introduced to the candid group.

items.title: The Queen Tree
items.description: Gretta and Dwight join royal woodcutters, Emelian and Yoska to protect the Queen Tree and search for who is killing trees in the royal forest. Chlodwig “helps” Emelian win Gretta’s attention in the most Chlodwig way possible.

items.title: Invincible
items.description: A thief with an invincibility cloak comes back to finish a job he started 1000 years ago; Gretta, Baldric, and Dwight set out to find the Quiet Friars to discover the identity of the thief and his target.

items.title: Agnet
items.description: Chlodwig’s stalker arrives in Woodside with the intention of winning his undying love; Gretta and Dwight get roped into helping Chlodwig avoid his persistent follower.

items.title: Wishy Washy Pt. I
items.description: A member of Hexela’s coven, Ragana, surprises her in Woodside; Baldric, Gretta, and Dwight are roped into the escalating rivalry between the two witches.

items.title: Wishy Washy Part 2
items.description: Dwight is captured by the evil witch Ragana; Hexela, Baldric, Gretta and Chlodwig follow Ragana to the Witches Inn and hatch a plan to finish the witches' brawl with Ragana to release Dwight.

items.title: Glimpse
items.description: Gretta steals a ring that gives her a brief glimpse of her future. Gretta, Dwight, and Chlodwig do their best to prevent that future from happening. Hexela and Baldric try to catch a tricky Speed Demon.

items.title: Fancy Pants
items.description: While helping Gretta and Baldric do some spring cleaning, Dwight finds a magical pair of pants with a sinister motive. These possessed pants lead the wearer back to the lair of an ancient evil court Jester.

items.title: Mirabel
items.description: Gretta’s Coming of Age Ball has been foiled time and time again by a vengeful ghost, but Dwight and Baldric are determined to make it happen. The Woodside High Sweetheart’s Ball is where they take their final stand.

items.title: Just Desserts
items.description: Dwight and Gretta must attend a trial where the defendant is a misbehaving cow. Baldric is captured by a love-sick witch, Madgie, who won’t take no for an answer. She brews a potion that would ensnare him forever.

items.title: Lake Monster
items.description: The people of Woodside are swept up in a cryptid craze, and everyone is trying to get a peak at the mysterious lake monster. Dwight, Gretta, Baldric, and Hexela know the secret behind this monster, and they need to find out what it wants.

items.title: A Bone to Pick
items.description: Dwight and Gretta investigate the dozens of holes appearing all around Woodside, but the source is far more sinister than the duo originally thought; Hexela and Baldric must track the dreaded Tovenar.

items.title: Sporg
items.description: Sir Aldred will stop at nothing to claim the final Tovenar bone and Baldric and Hexela are the only ones standing in his way. Dwight and Gretta are captured and watch Sir Aldred’s evil plans unfurl.

items.title: Uncle Arnolf
items.description: Sir Aldred and Sporg are closer than ever to resurrecting all of the Tovenars. Gretta summons her magical Uncle Arnolf who offers some key information, including how to contact Fate herself.

items.title: Dead Dead
items.description: The Tovenars seem to be undefeatable because of the inextinguishable eternal flame that keeps them alive, but Hexela still has a few tricks up her sleeve that could save the party as well as the whole world.

items.title: Another Slice of Pilot
items.description: While waiting in line at a food truck, Prince Chlodwig the Unstable tells his story of what happened to him on the day the Champion Spell was broken.

items.title: Guy Club
items.description: The members of Guy Club finally return from their journey through the cosmos, but they’ve brought back some unexpected intergalactic friends. Dwight and Chlodwig work to return the old version of Chlodwig back to his home universe.

items.title: The Severians
items.description: Gretta is confronted by Militsa, the princess of the Severians, who has set out to free her tribe from the rule of the Rogemorians. Gretta and Baldric learn to set aside their generational biases to see the Severians as they truly are.

items.title: Kirk the Beserker
items.description: Dwight coaches the Woodside Senior Center dodgeball team but chaos breaks loose when he blows a magic whistle that summons Kirk, the Berserker. The Viking bear warrior, who is only visible to Dwight, must learn to help the team.

items.title: Smooch
items.description: Dwight helps Hexela promote her salon through social media, but a magical lip balm accidentally turns her, Nana, and Gretta into goats. To reverse the curse, Kirk, Dwight, and Baldric must follow the specific instructions given by the Contrarian.

items.title: The Draugar
items.description: On Halloween night, Dwight and Gretta volunteer for the school’s haunted house. Little do they know that a restless vampire and a zombie army have risen to seek revenge on the one night they can roam the Earth.

items.title: Hansel & Gretta
items.description: Hexela needs Baldric’s assistance at Lotions and Potions, but Gretta feels neglected. She resorts to emotional eating, but a baker named Hansel has ulterior motives for her new habit.

items.title: The Grim Reaper
items.description: Baldric faces his successful brother after many years of living in his shadow. Dwight finds a book that accidentally summons the Grim Reaper. The Grim Reaper cannot return to the spirit world without claiming a soul.

items.title: Biffels
items.description: Gretta makes Rogemorian cream puffs called Biffels for a family history presentation at school. Macklyn the Fox returns with news of the Memory Thief who has stolen from Macklyn, Baldric, and Gretta.

items.title: Four Weddings and a Health Code Violation
items.description: Agnet rushes a wedding with Jacopo, but suffers the consequences. Dwight learns the hard way about the odd wedding traditions of the kingdom and finds himself at the center of it all.

items.title: Forks Up
items.description: Dwight must keep local food critic, Nick Reeves, happy and blissfully ignorant as he samples the entertainment and cuisine at the Swine & Slosh Tavern.

items.title: The Clapper
items.description: When Gretta gives sanctuary to elven princess Pridwyn, Pridwyn decides she wants Dwight as her Champion. With the help of her butler, Pridwyn places Dwight under a spell to turn him into an elf Champion.

items.title: What’s Amiss?
items.description: Deep in the forest of Woodside, Baldric and Hexela discover a stone soldier that leads them to a witch's lair. When they find the witch’s remains, Hexela contacts the witch’s spirit and uncovers a murder mystery.

items.title: Brodogg
items.description: Brodogg drops by Gretta’s house unexpectedly and convinces Baldric to train him in magic. At the same time, Dwight and Gretta are at the mercy of their RealBaby parental-training dolls for a school project.

items.title: The Memory Thief Part 1
items.description: Dwight’s teacher appreciation brunch turns disastrous when a mysterious creature tears up the venue. But when Dwight and Gretta search for answers, they find all the witnesses are missing memories of that day.

items.title: The Memory Thief Part 2
items.description: Dwight and Gretta are struggling to piece together the appearance of a mysterious creature. But time is running out for them to solve the mystery.

items.title: Flashback
items.description: Macklyn helps Dwight, Gretta, and Baldric find ingredients for a counter spell to stop the memory thief and pledges to bring reinforcements to aid in the fight. Dwight and Gretta are forced to confront their past together.

items.title: The Scrying Pool
items.description: Hammond and Ragana plot their next move to complete the Scrying Pool and kill Gretta and Baldric. Dwight and Gretta prepare for battle, restored memories from their pasts weighing heavily on their minds.

items.title: Finale Part 1
items.description: Dwight in left reeling in the absence of the Rogemorians while danger looms over Woodside. Ragana is determined to raise an army of stone soldiers and build a new Rogemore in the 21st century. It’s up to Dwight to stop her.

items.title: Finale Part 2
items.description: Baldric faces Ragana in an effort to save Hexela from her trap. Hammond hunts after Dwight and Gretta at Woodside High, and Dwight and Gretta are forced to make their final stand. Chlodwig gathers reinforcements, but will they make in in time?

items.title: Escape From Germany
items.description: A gripping true story following a daring missionary-led effort to rescue American teenagers from Nazi Germany in 1939. As war closes in, the group must outsmart rising danger, trust their faith, and make a tense race across borders to reach safety.

items.title: Every Boy Needs a Hero
items.description: Hoping to reconnect with his son, a man forms a baseball team that also unites their town.

items.title: Everyday Discipleship Across England
items.description: Across England, encounters with Christians from diverse traditions become a personal journey of faith, revealing the many ways people follow Jesus Christ and what it means to find belonging within a larger Christian community.

items.title: Exploring Turkey: Modern Believers in an Ancient Land
items.description: Host Steven Kapp Perry speaks with people of faith across Turkey, including a Jewish community leader; a retired imam; the leader of the whirling dervishes; and a recent Latter-day Saint convert. Steve witnesses the land’s beauty and rich history.

items.title: Extinct Trailer
items.description: Watch the Trailer for Extinct

items.title: Pilot
items.description: Four hundred years after the extinction of the human race, a seemingly benevolent alien species regenerates three humans. The humans discover new dangers on Earth that threaten to annihilate the human race all over again.

items.title: Brother's Keeper
items.description: The Reborns explore the abandoned settlement, and Ezra comes face-to-face with his past.

items.title: The Contract
items.description: Abram discovers a strange alien structure, and Feena's troubled past is revealed.

items.title: Reunion
items.description: The obelisk agrees to bring back more humans, so Feena travels to the lake to find them.

items.title: Broken
items.description: Silas tries to persuade Lynn to join the Skin Riders, and Abram discovers details about his past.

items.title: True or False
items.description: The Reborns discover information about the first settlers that will forever change them.

items.title: Of Two Minds
items.description: The Skin Riders attempt to penetrate the settlement, and Jax returns from the ancestor.

items.title: Death Did Us Part
items.description: Ezra and Lynn are captured by the previous settlers, and Silas attempts to strengthen his parasite.

items.title: Wounds
items.description: Ezra and Lynn try to escape the Skin Riders, and Abram attempts to find the Ancestor.

items.title: The Ancestor
items.description: The final battle between the Skin Riders and the Reborns begins.

items.title: Elder Andersen, Sister Bingham, and Sister Eubank (6-13-21)
items.description: In this global Face to Face devotional, Elder Neil L. Andersen, Sister Jean B. Bingham, and Sister Sharon Eubank share inspiring stories about faith, service, revelation, and overcoming challenges through Jesus Christ.

items.title: Elder David A. Bednar and Sister Susan Bednar (9-12-21)
items.description: In this global Face to Face event, Elder David A. Bednar and Sister Susan Bednar teach young adults about personal revelation, testimony, faith, the Holy Ghost, and finding answers through Jesus Christ.

items.title: Fatherhood and Hard Work
items.description: Suit up with the a father/daughter duo that bonds over beekeeping. Then mosey on down to the Heartland with a cow-milking couple that teach their four children the value of hard work.

items.title: Health and Teamwork
items.description: Meet the Anderson-Kossens, who strengthen their family through healthy living and daily fitness. Then meet the Burns family to explore how they turn their nine-member family into a true team.

items.title: Individuality and Accountability
items.description: The Forsyths love to hike and have learned about individuality along the way. The Rosales family is working through the tough topic of substance abuse with positivity and good choices.

items.title: Positivity and Service
items.description: Learn how grilled cheese and resilience strengthened the Samuel family. The Von Niederhausern family found a big way to come together by looking outside of themselves and doing service for others.

items.title: Confidence & Setting Goals
items.description: The Chipman family young women have learned the value of self-worth. The Bills family has captured the importance of goal-setting as a father and his two sons train for competitive Spartan racing.

items.title: Music & Play
items.description: All four children in the Spencer family play the violin. The Keslers have a yearly gathering with their huge extended family, where they are all so busy playing, they forget to even look at their phones.

items.title: Anti-entitlement & Mindfulness
items.description: The Andrus parents teach their six children anti-entitlement by expanding their bubble and helping them serve in the community. The Kepas family practices yoga as a form of mindfulness and meditation to improve the spirit in their home.

items.title: Wholesome Recreation & Personal Relationships
items.description: The surfing Baltzer family knows participating in wholesome recreation as a family brings them closer together. Mark and Kelly Jensen explain why putting marriage first helps them be better parents and a stronger family.

items.title: Finance & Grandparents
items.description: The Anderson parents teach their children the value of a dollar by putting them to work in their businesses. The Orton grandma spends time with her grandchildren every day after school and even conducts a choir made up of her granddaughters.

items.title: Peace & Preparation
items.description: The Meredith family shares an emergency preparedness approach. Relationship coach Dr. Matt Townsend teaches emotional resilience. Parenting expert Ralphie Jacobs advises a more peaceful home. The Cutler family sees calm in the chaos of lively kids.

items.title: Fun & Finance
items.description: The Paige family raises money-savvy kids. Financial counselor Amanda Christensen makes finances approachable. Family therapist David Koszlowski shares a business model for family. The Gundersons make purposeful decisions toward a fun family journey.

items.title: The Value of Grandparents & Keeping Family Culture Alive
items.description: Elaine and Stephen Dalton discuss grandparents' roles. The Havells share the impact of grandparents keeping family close. Plus, the Cooks honor Hawaiian and Filipino heritage, and co-hosts Yahosh and Natalie connect with their own family cultures.

items.title: Building a Tech-Positive Home & Raising Kids with Healthy Habits
items.description: Technology editor Amy Iverson advises on technology navigation. The Jones family shows how tech-positivity helps balance kids' use. Plus, the Kanos' focus on family fitness leads to healthy habits, and dietitian Miki Eberhardt gives nutrition advice.

items.title: How to Raise Curious Kids & The Power of Positivity
items.description: Author Gretchen Rubin puts positive mindsets to work. The Huntingtons learn positivity as they travel across the globe. Musician Peter Breinholt shares how wonder shaped his career. The Wrights invite curiosity by encouraging personal discovery.

items.title: Helping Kids Find Their Passion & The Nature Connection
items.description: Brad Wilcox shares ways to help kids find their purpose. The Beaches encourage their children to discover their passions. Matt Galland makes the outdoors part of family life. The Ockeys take time in nature to grow closer free from distractions.

items.title: The Family Narrative & Living with Loss
items.description: Nate and Vanessa Quigley keep family memories alive. The Websters get their children excited about ancestry. Counselor Emilio Parga explains how to talk to those who are grieving. The Poulsens find ways to remember family members who have passed.

items.title: The Food Connection & Raising an Introverted Child
items.description: The Six Sisters share insights for making food a family connector. The Richardsons use cooking to grow more connected. Author Brenda Knowles discusses raising a quiet child. The Funks blend personalities and set a pace to stay close.

items.title: The Sound of Service & The Strong Single Parent
items.description: Elaine Bradley discusses the power music has to bless lives. The Mellecios serve others through music. Cindy Cloninger and Julie Burraston share ways to support single-parent families. The Davenports rise to the challenge of single parenthood.

items.title: Raising Selfless Kids & The Power of Rituals
items.description: Hank Smith and Kristen Duke discuss raising big-hearted teens. The Parkinsons weave giving into living by expanding their talents. Heather Johnson discusses the impact of intentional family routines. The Packers keep their lives simple by design.

items.title: Unstructured Play & Raising Independent Kids
items.description: The Kings experiment with the art of unstructured play. The Sammis family sets a goal to raise kids who can stand on their own. Shaun Johnson encourages more fun in family life. Tim Thayne provides insights on launching older teens into adulthood.

items.title: Minimalistic Family Life & The Teenage Phase
items.description: The Anderson family chooses a minimalist lifestyle and finds more peace; organizer Tracy McCubbin resolves common "clutter blocks". The Coggins family enjoys relationships with their teenagers; David Butler points out the unique traits of teens.

items.title: Balanced Busyness & Meaningful Gatherings
items.description: The Hughes family gets together better, even for made-up holidays; a BYU professor tells the formula for designing experiences people will remember. The super-busy Blackmer family stays on time and in sync. Susie Salinas advances household systems.

items.title: Strengthening Talents & An Attitude of Adventure
items.description: A spirit of adventure starts at home. The Family Rules hosts go outside their comfort zone with in-studio adventures; the Thomas family gets out-and-about. The Fredericks spot their kids' talents; Stephen Jones identifies gifts versus talents.

items.title: Hard Work at Home & In-Laws in Action
