items.description: Operation Awesome goes to Brunswick, Ohio to meet 10-year-old Brady Snakovsky, owner of Brady's K-9 Fund. They build obstacle courses for K-9s, bake dog treats, and partner with the local animal shelter to host a doggie Adopt-a-thon.

items.title: Kindness Counts
items.description: Operation Awesome ventures to Fort Wayne, Indiana where they meet 11-year-old Sammie Vance, creator of Sammie's Buddy Bench. They recycle bottle caps to create benches for the community.

items.title: Find Your Superpower
items.description: Operation Awesome heads off to Ypsilanti, Michigan to meet Jermaine Dickerson, owner of Hero Nation. They create a Superhero Scavenger Hunt for kids to find their own Superhero Identity.

items.title: Back to School Cool
items.description: Operation Awesome drives to Mason, Ohio to meet Rishika Jeyaprakash, founder of Little Helpers. They hold a School Supplies Drive to help students start the new school year right.

items.title: Big Bold Birthday Bash
items.description: Operation Awesome meets Sarah from Meals on Wheels in Cincinnati, Ohio. They pull off two surprise Big Bold Birthday Bashes for two seniors, Dorothy and Rhoda.

items.title: Party Hub
items.description: Operation Awesome travels to West Liberty, Ohio to meet Rocky Grimes, founder of The HUB. Operation Awesome and Rocky host an open house. The HUB provides recreational programs for individuals with disabilities and critical illnesses.

items.title: Changemakers
items.description: Operation Awesome finishes their road trip in Gaithersburg, Maryland and meets Cavanaugh Bell, founder of Cool & Dope to prevent bullying. Operation Awesome creates a new mobile food pantry and a Little Big Library for Cavanaugh and Jaden.

items.title: Orphan Horse
items.description: A young runaway hides out in the barn of a retired horse trainer and is offered shelter in exchange for her help with a troubled horse.

items.title: The Gospels and Their Significance
items.description: Religious scholars introduce the four Gospels in the New Testament and the focus their ongoing discussion will have on the Savior and the everlasting covenant. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

items.title: The Foreordained Redeemer
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the premortal world and the first-born obligation that Christ fulfilled in His mission on Earth as well as the ancient prophets foretelling His coming. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

items.title: The Jewish Messianic Expectation
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the events of the ancient world before the coming of Christ and the expectations the Jews had of the Messiah. With Andrew Skinner, Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, and Paul Hoskisson.

items.title: The Birth of Jesus
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the circumstances and faith of Mary and Joseph when they received the news that Mary would birth the promised Messiah, Jesus Christ. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: The Childhood of Jesus
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the few events that are described of Jesus Christ’s childhood including his fleeing to Egypt with Joseph and Mary and his visits to the temple. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: The Baptism of Jesus
items.description: Religious scholars discuss John the Baptist’s role as prophet and forerunner of Christ as well as the significance of Christ’s baptism as an example and following doctrinal law. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Christ's Early Ministry
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the miracles and actions of Jesus in his early ministry including making wine from water and cleansing the temple. With Brent L. Top, David Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Woman at the Well
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ journey to Galilee through Samaria where He meets and speaks with the woman at the well despite that Jews avoid the area and people. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Rejection at Nazareth
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus proclaiming that He fulfilled Isaiah’s prophecy about the Messiah when He is reading from the Torah in a synagogue in Nazareth. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: The Calling of the Twelve
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the criticism Jesus received for dining with sinners and details of the men Jesus calls to be His apostles. With Andrew Skinner, Paul Hoskisson, Brent L. Top, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: The Beatitudes
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the beatitudes outlined in Jesus Christ’s Sermon on the Mount. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Sermon on the Mount
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Sermon on the Mount and the direction to be perfect even as Christ is perfect as well as instructions on judging righteously. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: Why Parables?
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ use of parables to teach eternal truths in His ministry as a way to have timely and expansive reaches to His disciples. With Brent L. Top, Camille Fronk, Ray Huntington, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: "Thy Faith Hath Made Thee Whole"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ ministry in Capernaum where He heals a woman with an issue of blood when she touches His clothes and raises a young girl from the dead. With Brent Top, Ray Huntington, David Whitchurch, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Feeding The Multitude
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the imprisonment and beheading of John the Baptist, the miracle of feeding the five thousand, and Jesus walking on water. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Bread of Life
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ teachings on committing to the new gospel, that He is the bread of life, and how He has fulfilled the law of Moses. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Rock of Our Salvation
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus calling Peter to be the rock of His church and teaching about priesthood authority and ordinances. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Mount of Transfiguration
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the events and lessons that occurred when Jesus brough Peter, James, and John to the Mount of Transfiguration and its importance in our day. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Feast of the Tabernacles
items.description: Religious scholars discuss when Jesus attends the Feast of the Tabernacles, as required by law, and the persecution He begins to experience that lasts until His crucifixion. With Brent Top, S. Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Light of the World
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the lessons we can learn from Jesus’ treatment of the woman caught in adultery and how He deals with her accusers. With Brent Top, S. Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: The Good Shepherd
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the miracle where Jesus healed the blind man with clay and washing, how we can apply this miracle, and how He will always take care of His flock. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: The Cost of Discipleship
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the doctrinal principles Jesus taught using many parables including the good Samaritan, the foolish rich man, and the unjust steward. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Brent Top.

items.title: Lazarus, Come Forth
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the relationship Jesus had with Mary, Martha, and Lazarus and when He raised Lazarus from the dead after mourning with his sisters. With Brent Top, Jeffrey Marsh, Kent Brown, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: The Triumphal Entry
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Christ’s triumphant entry to Jerusalem that began the last week of His life and mortal ministry. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: The Long Day of Debate
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the debate between Jesus and the Jewish leaders who questioned His authority. This provided us with many parables to learn from. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: The Olivet Discourse
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the discourse Jesus provides on the Mount of Olives that answers questions of His apostles such as clarifying that He will come again and other lessons. With Camille Fronk, Keith Wilson, Paul Hoskisson, and Ray Huntington.

items.title: Preparations for the Last Supper
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jesus’ preparation for the Last Supper during the Passover feast as well as Judas's actions of betrayal. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Last Supper
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the conversation, events, and lessons that occurred between Jesus and the twelve apostles in the upper room during the Last Supper. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: That They All May Be One
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Judas’ betrayal and the final lessons Jesus teaches to His apostles in preparation for His crucifixion and resurrection. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: Gethsemane
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the group journey to the garden of Gethsemane and the solitary prayer and suffering Jesus endured within the garden. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, Ray Huntington, and Kelly Ogden.

items.title: The Arrest and Trial
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Judas betraying Jesus with a kiss, Jesus healing one of His persecutors, and Peter’s motivations for defending and denying Christ. With Andrew Skinner, Kelly Ogden, David Whitchurch, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: The Crucifixion
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the trials Jesus endured and His journey to Golgotha, the place of His crucifixion. With Andrew Skinner, Kelly Ogden, David Whitchurch, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: The Resurrection
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the types and symbols from the Old Testament to Christ’s sacrifice as well as the details of the crucifixion and resurrection. With Andrew Skinner, Gaye Strathearn, Kelly Ogden, and David Whitchurch.

items.title: "What Think Ye of Christ?"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the overall principles and lessons of Jesus Christ presented in the four gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John found in the New Testament. With Andrew Skinner, Kent Brown, David Whitchurch, and Brent Top.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Deeply affected by his war trauma and driven by his unique love of animals, George attempts to build his dream - a zoo without bars.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: George attempts to rescue two Himalayan black bears from a cave in Matlock, while Reverend Webb is intent on uncovering what the Mottersheads are up to.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: The family confront a barrage of hostility from the residents of Upton.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: When Adam the bear escapes, George is badly injured in the process of retrieving him. Dr Ford treats his injuries, but June is disturbed to learn how close her father was to death.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: After the devastating news that planning permission for the zoo has been denied, George ventures to London with Lady Katherine for one last throw of the dice.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Everything hangs in the balance as the Mottersheads prepare for the appeal that will decide the fate of the zoo; but with tensions running high after the aviary is slashed, a hot-headed George proves more of a liability than an asset.

items.title: Overstaying Your Welcome
items.description: Overlord overhears the Underwoods' plan to get rid of him and runs away. Flower tries to gather escaped animals from her Pet Rescue Party and Jim tries to salvage what Overlord has trashed.

items.title: Overthrowing the Underscores
items.description: Overlord takes on a school bully at Weaver's school but finds he's out of his element. Flower and Jim decide to run a three-legged race for charity, but Flower's competitive side takes over.

items.title: Undersized
items.description: Overlord creates a shrinking device that Jim accidentally sets off, shrinking both Weaver and Overlord. Flower accuses Willow of taking her makeup and makes her pay for it by working at the animal shelter.

items.title: Slime and Understanding
items.description: Overlord brings home an space slug to test Flower's claim that she loves all creatures. Weaver becomes a demanding director when he shoots Willow and Dayna's basketball video.

items.title: Into the Underbrush
items.description: Overlord crashes the Underwood's annual camping trip. R0-FL gets a nice day off and decides to lets loose in the Underwoods' home.

items.title: Game Over!
items.description: Overlord zaps the Underwoods to a void outside of time and space so he can watch a movie alone at home. The family must work together to escape or else be trapped forever!

items.title: 3 Easy Overpayments
items.description: Overlord goes to crazy lengths to buy a blender. Jim and Flower visit a new day spa.

items.title: Not Under My Roof!
items.description: Willow starts dating a boy and Overlord does not approve. Weaver is worried that Bebe has a crush on him and does everything he can to convince her not to fall in love with him.

items.title: 13 Going on Overlord
items.description: Weaver receives a DNA test kit for his birthday, only to have Overlord use it on himself. With the threat of Overlord's DNA being discovered, the family works together to keep his existence under wraps.

items.title: Undercover LARP
items.description: Overlord finds his place with a group of Live Action Role Players and rises to become their leader. Meanwhile, Flower and Jim won't allow Willow to use the car until she passes their own bizarre tests.

items.title: Overshooters
items.description: When Willow's girls' soccer team is overlooked, Overlord decides to coach...the boy's team. Flower takes it upon herself to help R0-FL follow her own interests independent of Overlord.

items.title: Overdue Update
items.description: After Jim accepts a system update on R0-FL, she becomes his assistant and stops at nothing to make sure he's relaxed at all times. Overlord, meanwhile, hires his nemesis Petey to be his assistant.

items.title: Overexposed
items.description: Overlord goes to extreme lengths to try and get in the Underwoods' family picture. Willow tries to impress the cool girls at school.

items.title: Family Over Frabjleplarm
items.description: Overlord is battling homesickness, so the Underwoods agree to celebrate his favorite holiday. However, the day ends with a cruel twist of fate.

items.title: Overpiece Theatre
items.description: Overlord helps Weaver with morning announcements and uses the opportunity to hypnotize the adults at school. Jim drags an unwilling Willow to "Bring Your Daughter to Work Day." Flower has trouble letting an adorable hedgehog go.

items.title: Overlock Holmes and the Undercooked Pie
items.description: Jim and Flower throw a dinner party to impress Jim's boss. When the dessert goes missing, Overlord becomes the prime suspect.

items.title: Do-over and Over and Over
items.description: The Underwoods all have terrible days, so Overlord offers them a shot at re-doing the day with a device he owns. They use it over and over hoping to perfect the day. What they don’t realize is that they are pawns in Overlord’s game.

items.title: Under the Sea Land
items.description: Weaver is assigned to do a school project about a person he admires. When he chooses Flower, Overlord becomes jealous and tries to diminish her reputation. Willow feels left out when River gets along great with Jim.

items.title: One Year Over-versary
items.description: When Overlord enlists the family to look for an object he misplaced one year ago, he leads the Underwoods to recount the first day he arrived at their home.

items.title: Over The Moon
items.description: Overlord's carelessness puts the family in danger, leading to the ultimate test of his moral compass. Meanwhile, Willow tries to post the perfect verified social media post and Weaver attempts to finally put his stories on film.

items.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Winston-Salem, North Carolina culture. He tries frog leg hushpuppies and visits Andy Griffith’s hometown.

items.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Bermuda to inspire his painting. From the Bermuda Triangle to cathedral ruins, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

items.description: To get a taste of Prince Edward Island, Canada, artist Eric Dowdle visits the Anne of Green Gables house and Canada’s Smallest Library.

items.description: Artist Eric Dowdle explores Niagara Falls to inspire his painting. From the spiciest chicken wings to daredevil experiences, Eric engages with the locals to learn what makes the city tick.

items.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Mackinac Island, Michigan culture. He learns about the American Fur Trade and more about why the city chose to put a ban on motor vehicles.

items.title: Sydney
items.description: In Sydney, Australia, artist Eric Dowdle visits the Opera House, learns about astronomy, and meets kangaroos and koalas.

items.title: Marthas Vineyard
items.description: To inspire his painting, artist Eric Dowdle discovers what makes up Martha’s Vineyard culture. He visits the bridge from the movie Jaws and explores the rows of uniquely crafted and colored houses.

items.title: Kenya
items.description: In Kenya, Africa, artist Eric Dowdle attends his adopted son, Bensons, wedding, goes on an African safari, and spends time with the Maasai people.

items.title: The Boy Crisis
items.description: Young men are struggling around the world. The Jolleys show how they practice self-love while the Watsons work on goal setting. Warren Ferrell, author of The Boy Crisis and American political scientist, shares the importance of male role models.

items.title: The Loneliness Epidemic
items.description: Kinsey Larsen shares about battling loneliness and how she finds comfort in teaching. David Kozlowski, a licensed marriage and family therapist, discusses the link between loneliness and social media, as well as investing in authentic connections.

items.title: The Entitlement Intervention
items.description: The Losees share how they dealt with an entitled child and Nate Mitchell, co-director of the Anasazi Foundation, talks about keeping a strong relationship with your child. The Lonos are grateful for the kindness shown to their special needs son.

items.title: Pushing Back Against Instant Gratification
items.description: Moms discuss why their kids work in their homes. Nicholeen Peck, President of the Worldwide Organization for Women, talks about the importance of work being a positive thing. The Bennetts show how they’re rewarded for their work.

items.title: When Your Family is Different
items.description: Feeling different when dealing with special needs is challenging. The Ricks-Meles share how they show patience. Zion Clark, a professional wrestler and wheelchair racer, speaks on the importance of kids following their passions.

items.title: The Over-Scheduled Child
items.description: Moms talk about finding balance in their kids' schedules. Eli Harwood, best selling author of Securely Attached, discusses being in tune with your child. The Savages listen to their kids' feelings about their busy schedules.

items.title: Overcoming the Chaos of the World
items.description: Seeking refuge at home varies for every family. Brooke Romney, author of 52 Modern Manners for Today’s Teens, promotes intentional parenting. The blended Buehner-Walter family prioritizes connection while the Jones family values trust.

items.title: A Parent's Guide to Social Media
items.description: Moms discuss how they have taught their kids to use social media as a tool. Amie Anger, a licensed child and family therapist, talks about the decision to be on social media. The Geigles talk about the pressures of the internet.

items.title: Pathway to Hope with Jane Clayson Johnson
items.description: In Pathway to Hope, Jane Clayson Johnson explores how BYU-Pathway Worldwide is reshaping higher education in Africa and across the globe, opening doors of opportunity and faith for students who are changing their lives, families, and communities.

items.title: Linda
items.description: Emma Nissen shares Linda’s story, and how “Gotta Have Faith” helped her through the loss of her son, performing a tender rendition inspired by her.

items.title: Heather
items.description: Emma Nissen catches up with her long-time friend Heather who shares her journey with hearing loss. Together, they perform Emma’s heartfelt song "Angel."

items.title: Amazing Grace
items.description: Emma shares how faith shapes her relationship with Christ and her music as she Jazz scats her rendition of ‘Amazing Grace.’

items.title: Breathe
items.description: Emma Nissen brings her soulful jazz vibes with "Breathe" and shares the story behind the song.

items.title: New Song
items.description: Emma Nissen takes the stage with her band to perform her uplifting new song, a heartfelt anthem about loving yourself and spreading that love to others.

items.title: Duet
items.description: Annika Wickihalder joins Emma Nissen to perform “Hold On,” sharing a powerful message: if you keep holding on, things will get better.

items.title: Comedian Visits Recovery Center
items.description: Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. brings laughter and hope to an addiction recovery center, reminding everyone that no one is too far gone for grace.

items.title: Stand-up Comedian Visits Jail
items.description: Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. reminds inmates that their past doesn’t define their future. Change is always possible.

items.title: Comedian Visits Sober Living Home
items.description: Healing starts with hope. Stand-up comedian Michael Jr. brings laughter to a sober-living home. Sharing a message that leaves a lasting impact.

items.title: Peaches from the Super Mario Bros. Movie by BYU Men’s Chorus
items.description: Hear the BYU Men's Chorus perform Peaches from The Super Mario Bros. Movie. This playful choral rendition brings a fan-favorite movie song to the concert stage, blending the humor of Bowser's ballad with the sound of a men's choir.

items.title: Introduction/Adam and Eve

items.title: The Facsimiles/The Picnic
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the facsimiles in the Pearl of Great Price and the insight they provide into Abraham and the ancient Egyptians. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Michael Rhodes, Richard Draper, and Andrew Skinner.

items.title: The Premortal Life/Canning/Boarding House
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the premortal existence and the phases of the spiritual and temporal creation of man as taught in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Andrew C. Skinner, Richard D. Draper, Joseph F. McConkie, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Atonement and Rebirth
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Adam and Eve in the Pearl of Great Price and the consequences and opportunities of the Fall for mankind. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Andrew C. Skinner, Michael Rhodes, Richard D. Draper, and Joseph F. McConkie.

items.title: Obedience and Sacrifice/The Bicycle
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the examples and teaching of Adam and Eve in obedience and sacrifice in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Andrew C. Skinner, Michael Rhodes, Richard D. Draper, and Joseph F. McConkie.

items.title: The Ministry of Enoch
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the life and ministry of Enoch in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Michael Rhodes, Andrew C. Skinner, Robert D. Draper, and Joseph F. McConkie.

items.title: The Abrahamic Covenant
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Abrahamic Covenant and the spirit of Elijah in the Pearl of Great Price and their importance in the restored gospel. With Robert L. Millet, Michael Rhodes, Camille Fronk, and Joseph F. McConkie.

items.title: The First Vision
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the First Vision and the circumstances that led to Joseph Smith receiving it and its inclusion in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Joseph F. McConkie, Richard D. Draper, and Michael Rhodes.

items.title: Calling of Prophets/Establishing Zion
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the calling of prophets and establishing Zion as taught in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Joseph F. McConkie, Michael Rhodes, Richard D. Draper, and Andrew C. Skinner.

items.title: Signs of the Times
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Joseph Smith–Matthew in the Pearl of Great Price which contain warnings concerning the Second Coming. With Robert L. Millet, Camille Fronk, Michael Rhodes, Andrew C. Skinner, Richard D. Draper, and Joseph F. McConkie.

items.title: The Articles of Faith
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the Articles of Faith found in the Pearl of Great Price. With Robert L. Millet, Michael Rhodes, Andrew C. Skinner, Joseph F. McConkie, and Richard D. Draper.

items.title: Persuasion
items.description: Captain Frederick has everything he once dreamed of—fortune, status, and a new future—until an unexpected reunion with Anne, the woman who once refused him, changes everything. A heartfelt period romance about lost love and finding your way back.

items.title: Praise to the Lord by BYU Singers
items.description: BYU Singers performs Praise to the Lord, a beloved Christian hymn celebrating faith, gratitude, and God's goodness. Expressive choral harmonies bring warmth and reverence to this timeless song of worship, inviting reflection on life's many blessings.

items.title: Dream Driveway
items.description: Watch Random Acts ease one of the burdens of a young mother dealing with chronic pain.

items.title: Missed Christmas

items.title: Magic Movers
items.description: Random Acts plans a bit of home moving magic for a new mom whose husband is deployed overseas.

items.title: Studio C-prise
items.description: The Studio C cast surprises a family dealing with cancer, and BYU Vocal Point singers pose as maintenance workers.

items.title: Music and the Random Act
items.description: Watch Random Acts make Shelby's dream of playing with the Orchestra at Temple Square come true.

items.title: Ninja Makeover
items.description: Random Acts makes a dream bedroom makeover happen for Theo... all while he is asleep in the room!

items.title: Here We Vow Again
items.description: Determined to make memories while he still can, John surprises his wife, Jane, with a vow renewal.

items.title: Quilting Life Back Together

items.title: Illusion Reunion
items.description: The Random Acts team reunites Janis with family during a magic show illusion.

items.title: Wheelin' Forward
items.description: Random Acts surprises Rebecca and Mo with proper wheelchair transportation.

items.title: Copter Kindness
items.description: Random Acts gives Steffan the aerial experience of a lifetime before he loses his eyesight.

items.description: Emmalene, who has cerebral palsy, brings her dreams to the ballet stage with help from Random Acts.

items.title: Goalden Ticket
items.description: Gary Staples has dedicated his life to service, so Random Acts and Real Salt Lake surprise him.

items.title: Sleep Her Agent
items.description: Janet cares full-time for her sons with special needs. so Random Acts gives her a dream bedroom.

items.title: Ball Dressed Up
items.description: Random Acts creates a Regency ball to honor Ciera, a young woman with a devastating illness.

items.title: Ivory-One Loves You

items.title: ConGRADulations

items.description: Random Acts surprises Ryan, a paraplegic, with a gift that gets him and his family outside!

items.title: Grand Cameo
items.description: See how Random Acts surprises Kiarra after she loses her hand in a shop class accident.

items.title: Let's Make A Smile
items.description: See how Random Acts makes Brinley, a survivor of serious health issues, the star of her own show!

items.title: Wyatt's World
items.description: See how Random Acts gives Wyatt, who has a brain disability, his own world right in his bedroom!

items.title: Make Yourself A Home
items.description: This single mom has no idea what's in store for her when she helps a friend move into an apartment.

items.title: Saved By Service
items.description: A young accident survivor meets her rescuer for the first time while attending a Utah Jazz game.

items.title: Yard In The Cards
items.description: Random Acts transforms a backyard into a safe haven.

items.title: May The Horse Be With You
items.description: Random Acts teams up with Hoofbeats to Healing to give this animal-loving girl a big surprise!

items.title: Love Is in the Air
items.description: Will, Emilie, and Jenna team up with a local balloonist to make a bucket list dream of riding in a hot air balloon come true for Julie, a women who recently lost her husband to cancer; Will solicits the help of strangers to propose to Emilie.

items.title: Serving Service
items.description: Will, Emilie, Mason, and Melanie spend the day as street performers to raise money as a mega tip to give Laura, a waitress in Seattle who is constantly doing random acts of kindness for those around her; Will and Melanie pop balloons to inspire good.

items.title: The Commander
items.description: Will and Emilie team up with a recording studio to surprise Carl, a service-oriented man with Down syndrome, with an opportunity to meet one of his favorite musicians: Alex Boyé; The hosts do random acts at the movie theater and grocery store.

items.title: Racing to Restore
items.description: Will, Emilie, and Mason work together to restore an old Camaro and prepare a race track experience for Clint, a man who has recently lost his father and brother to accident and illness. Emilie and Will find good Samaritans at the state fair.

items.title: Make or Bake
items.description: Brooklyn is 14 years old and can only eat 20 foods, so Emilie, Jenna, Will, and returning host Lisa Valentine Clark work to create a baking competition surprise. Emilie, Will and Mason give people a fishy opportunity at Waterfront park in Seattle.

items.title: Random Tracks of Kindness
items.description: David is a double amputee confined to his electric wheelchair and the routes of public transportation, so Will and Emilie plan a road trip for him with a surprise at each stop. Mason partakes in cosplay as a Viking at Fan X.

items.title: Best Friends Fur-ever
items.description: Eight-year-old Ali has been battling cancer for several years. Will and Emilie surprise Ali and her best-friend Bentlie at school with the news that they are getting on a plane and going on an adventure. Will and Jenna give fortunes in San Diego.

items.title: The Great Indoors
items.description: Jeff and Debbie Strong have adopted 15 children, many with disabilities or terminal conditions. They’ve given a home to so many, so Will and Melanie give the kids who can’t easily go outside a place to play inside. Jenna and Emilie ride a trolley.

items.title: Snow Far Snow Good
items.description: Katie has a syndrome causing her to be born without ears and cheekbones. Jenna and Emilie surprise her at work with a day off and a trip into the mountains to go dog sledding. Will and Melanie reward kind people at a Seattle bookstore.

items.title: From Random With Love
items.description: Will, Melanie, and Jenna surprise William, a 12-year-old boy with Spina Bifida, with a superhero experience at a “secret facility” where he films a fake movie trailer. Will and Emilie team up with author Camron Wright to celebrate kindness.

items.title: The Thrift Gift
items.description: Will and Emilie surprise Mary, a thrift-store owner whose goal is to provide for and serve the nearby homeless population. Mary is surprised with a scuba diving adventure. Mason and Emilie help strangers virtually shop for their groceries.

items.title: Cooking Up Kindness
items.description: Cindy is a baker who spreads her love via thousands of desserts to those in need of a pick-me-up. Will and Jenna surprise her with a dream-come-true kitchen remodel. Will and Emilie chauffeur unsuspecting airport travelers.

items.title: Sky Thriving
items.description: Savannah is a happy and charitable teenager who was recently diagnosed with a rare life-shortening disease. Emilie and Will step in to help her check skydiving off her bucket list. Lisa and Will enlist the help of kids at a mini golf course.

items.title: Soaring Surprise
items.description: Chris Miller is a high school social worker and wrestling coach whose sole mission is to help students in need. Emilie and Jenna surprise Chris with a stunt plane experience of a lifetime. The hosts descend on unsuspecting cars at a gas station.

items.title: We've Got Your Back(yard)
items.description: Mindi Holmgren lost her husband in a tragic accident, putting their plans to finish the backyard on hold. Will and Melanie call in some old friends to make the backyard dream a reality. Will and Emilie go biking in San Diego.

items.title: National Treasures
items.description: Edie Swan has a rare and painful condition called Chiari malformation. Emilie, Will, and Mason work together to make a special trip to Arches National Park possible. The hosts take over a toll booth.

items.title: Passion for Fashion
items.description: Lilly is dealing with the recent death of her father, but despite this tragedy she still dreams of becoming a fashion designer. Emilie, Mason, and Lisa work together to put on a fashion show. Emilie and Jenna surprise kids at the zoo.

items.title: Sail-ebration
items.description: Dani Bates and her two daughters lost their husband and father to suicide. Will distracts Dani with a surprise sailing trip while Jenna works on a quilting miracle. Emilie and Will start water fights in a park.

items.title: A Lotta Piñata
items.description: Aleisha McDaniel constantly does random acts of kindness in her daily life, including secretly giving away piñatas. Will and Jenna help Aleisha with a giant piñata surprise. Will, Emilie, and Mason add an unconventional experience to a haunted house.

items.title: Space for Love
items.description: Lisa Love is an elementary school teacher who has changed the lives of her students through her love of space. Will and Jenna fulfill Lisa’s dream of going to Space Camp. Will, Emilie, and Mason give random people the chance to play Apple Blasters.

items.title: Jars of Joy
items.description: Emily is a passionate elementary school teacher. In the spirit of Jason F. Wright’s book “Christmas Jars,” her entire school comes together to give her a mega Christmas surprise. The hosts surprise people with a giant talking Christmas Jar.

items.title: Random Kayacts
items.description: Will and Emilie surprise the Serna family with a camping and kayaking adventure on the Colorado River. Will and Emilie have fun with tents at Scheels.

items.title: Free Run Fun
items.description: Trey Montgomery is figuring out his new normal after the tragic loss of his father. Trey loves the training discipline of parkour, so Will and Jenna give Trey the parkour surprise of a lifetime. Will, Jenna, and Mason throw a dozen birthday parties.

items.title: Underwater Sea-Prise
items.description: After losing her husband, Brad, to cancer, Robin Smith is staying strong for her children. Will and Emilie send Robin to Catalina Island where several more surprises await her. Will and Jenna search for buried treasure at the aquarium.

items.title: Woodn’t Believe Your Eyes
items.description: Jesse Wright has endured a life of struggle and pain, starting with a debilitating accident when he was 17 years old. Will and Emilie help give Jesse and his kids their very own rooms. Will, Jenna, and Mason help with annoying little odd jobs.

items.title: Snow Day Like Today
items.description: Year after year Zoie never gets to play in the snow, so Will and Emilie bring “winter” to Zoie’s backyard a bit early to accommodate her medical condition. Will and Emilie convince grocery shoppers to help them ring a bell for donations.

items.title: Acrobatic Affection
items.description: Annalise is the victim of severe bullying. To help her know she is loved, Emilie and Jenna arrange a dream-come-true performance where Annalise becomes the star. Mason and Emilie transform from caterpillar to butterfly in response to kindness.

items.title: Blue Sky Memory
items.description: Maddi and Sammi are two sisters who were in a terrible car accident that took the life of their best friend. Will and Emilie surprise them with a healing adventure. Will, Emilie, and Mason have fun with balloons and kind strangers in a mall.

items.title: Hush-Hush Hawaii
items.description: Kimberly always puts others first, which is why Will and Jenna decide to give her a day off that includes pampering and a party that she’ll never forget. Will and Emilie take to the road to show gratitude to frontline professionals.

items.title: Around the World in Addie Days
items.description: Addison is an amazing young woman who suffers from a rare disease that will eventually take her vision. Will and Emilie take Addison on a virtual world tour with surprises along the way. Will and Mason have photographic fun with kind strangers.

items.title: Dolphinitely Seaprising
items.description: Annalisa was born with a string of health challenges, and yet she’s happy, positive, and constantly serving others. Will and Emilie setup a day of surprises including a trip to Florida and working as a dolphin trainer; Emilie helps dunk Will.

items.title: Welcome Holmes
items.description: Aimee Holmes is a kind, selfless, and empathetic wife and mother. Will and Emilie surprise Aimee with a baking class so she can unknowingly make dinner for her family, and a surprise guest; Will and Mason surprise kids at their lemonade stands.

items.title: That's So School
items.description: Anna Jeffrey is visually impaired. She’s also a wife, mother, teacher, and community leader. Will and Jenna install some helpful updates in Anna’s home including a big red surprise in the backyard; Emilie seeks help to load a lot into her little car.

items.title: A Knight To Remember
items.description: Damien has Muscular Dystrophy and has lost his ability to walk. Will and Emilie surprise Damien with his first time on an airplane so he can have an ice-cold experience in Las Vegas; Will and Mason shave ice and share it.

items.title: Searching For Surprises
items.description: Denise Watts was killed in a terrible car accident. Will and Emilie surprise her husband and kids with a scavenger hunt. Everything culminates into big birthday celebration for Denise; Emilie and Mason reward kind people who help them solve clues.

items.title: The Cinderella Project
items.description: Angela Miller helps young women get access to prom dresses with The Cinderella Project. Will and Emilie enlist Angela’s help to design a ball for a very deserving person; Emilie and Mason convince random mall shoppers to help Emilie pick a dress.

items.title: Zoo-mongous Surprise
items.description: Esther loves to dance, but she has a rare disease that is slowly taking away her ability to use one of her legs. So, Will and Mason setup a dancing surprise with her favorite TikTok Celebrity; Will and Jenna ask for help in choosing animal costumes.

items.title: Ready, Set, Snow!
items.description: The Rasmussen family were evacuated from their home early Christmas morning, minutes before a bomb exploded, so Will and Jenna give this wonderful family a Christmas redo; Will and Mason decorate front yards to celebrate Secret Santas of the world.

items.title: Hawaiian Hijinks
items.description: Christie Rasmussen does random acts of kindness every single day of her life. Because of her constant service she’s never been a vacation with just her husband Brian. Will, Jenna, and Mason surprise Christie and Brian with a tropical vacation.

items.title: Love and Lederhosen
items.description: Ricky and Lexi met and fell in love while both receiving cancer treatment. Because Ricky was born in Germany, Emilie and Mason surprise them both with a Bavarian dinner full of family and friends, with dessert becoming another surprise entirely.

items.title: Diving and Thriving
items.description: When Nate Ogden became a quadriplegic, he refused to give up on his huge underwater dream. Will, Emilie, and Mason work with a specialized organization to make Nate's dream a reality. Emilie and Mason set up a spa surprise right outside an elevator.

items.title: One Stop Holiday Shop
items.description: Cheryl Smith, founding member of the Autism Council of Utah, gets a holiday surprise. Having missed almost all family activities because of the care her autistic son Carson requires, she gets to catch up on much-needed grandkid time.

items.title: Duvet is the Day
items.description: Lucy Blaylock has been making blankets for children all over the world to help them through hard times. Overwhelmed with orders, Will and Emilie put together a team to help Lucy fulfill her orders and to give her a surprise trip she’s always wanted.

items.title: Bag Pipe-Dream
items.description: Kari Craig is known for her dependable good mood and willingness to help anyone in need, especially in her work as a medical professional. The hosts surprise Kari with a trip to a local Scottish festival and more to celebrate her heritage.

items.title: A Room of His Own
items.description: The Kendall family works hard through many sleepless nights to care for their son with special needs and still manage to be active and beloved members of their community. The hosts facilitate a major surprise for them to make their lives easier.

items.title: Snappy Memories
items.description: The Spindle family is known for being selfless and giving, even after they lost everything--including their family photos--in a wildfire. The Random Acts team sets up a photo shoot to help the Spindles recapture their favorite memories.

items.title: Peak-ing Amazing
items.description: After losing her dad in a tragic rock climbing accident, Winter has turned her grief into helping and lifting others and continuing climbing. The hosts surprise Winter with a trip that will honor her father and continue his legacy.

items.title: Lemon-Aid Stand
items.description: Ever since she lost a teacher to cancer, Savannah has been organizing an annual lemonade stand that has grown to involve her whole community and has raised thousands of dollars. The hosts surprise her with a country music trip of her dreams.

items.title: Italian Sopresa
items.description: Katie is constantly serving others despite the challenges she faces with Spina Bifida and after losing her adopted mom. Her friends come together with the Random Acts team to give her the birthday celebration she deserves.

items.title: Turtally Amazing
items.description: Despite being born with brittle bone disease, Hadley is a constant source of joy for all those around her. Since she loves swimming and sea turtles, the Random Acts team surprise Hadley with an up close and personal turtle experience.

items.title: Lighting Their World
items.description: Jessica Rigsby is seven years into a five-year cancer diagnosis and is trying to have lots of happy family memories while she still can. The hosts plan a Christmas surprise that involves a very bright surprise; Emilie and Mason vend kindness.

items.title: Arizona to Denmark
items.description: Will arrives at Camp Grace in Arizona to surprise camp director Jennifer Brimhall with a life-changing trip to Denmark, where Jennifer's ancestors lived before emigrating to America.

items.title: Kindness Begins With Kim
items.description: Kim Fields is a campus supervisor at Taft Union High School where he’s impacted thousands of students. The hosts plan a huge pep rally in his honor, with a final NFL related surprise.

items.title: Life's a Circus
items.description: Carilee Card is an exceptional woman who suffers from serious health issues due to the long-term effects of having anorexia. She loves doing acrobatics, so Will and JiWon head to Vegas to plan a circus surprise.

items.title: Giving Back to Brenda
items.description: Brenda Hughes feeds her community through her organization, the Giving Back Foundation. The Random Acts team surprises Brenda with a trip to Paris, the place she feels an emotional connection to.

items.title: In For A Penny
items.description: Penny and Lee Larson have fostered over 65 children despite Penny's ongoing medical struggles. Will, Jenna, and Charan join Heart 2 Home to surprise the family with a much-needed home renovation that allows Penny to better care for the kids.

items.title: Emily in NYC
items.description: Emily Traveller became paralyzed from the shoulders down in 2022, stalling her dreams of being a fashion designer. The hosts team up with Runway of Dreams to give Emily a NYC Fashion Week experience to remind her that her goals are still possible.

items.title: Double the Fun
items.description: Joy and Diana nominated each other for a Random Act, so Jenna and Charan decide that two surprises are better than one. The women decorate each other's houses. Joy and Diana also love The Chosen TV show, so the hosts get them a special VIP tour.

items.title: Missy on the Move
items.description: Missy, a 17-year-old with spina bifida loves the theater and performing. The hosts plan a surprise that allows Missy to be a reporter for a day. She also receives a much-needed gift from Compassion Mobility.

items.title: The Helpers
items.description: Despite spending much of her time in hospitals due to a life-threatening heart condition, 12-year-old Abigail helped to start a service-minded club called The Helpers. Will and Jenna help the club to set up a carnival to raise money for Make-A-Wish.

items.title: Angels of Kindness
items.description: Will and Jenna team up with Kristiny to select Angels to surprise in her hometown of Havre, Montana. In the end the final Christmas-themed surprise is for Kristiny, the biggest angel of them all; Emilie, and Charan set up a kindness vending machine.

items.title: Easter Special 2026
items.description: Random Acts helps Kim recognize local heroes who are making a difference in her Tennessee community. Meanwhile, the community secretly prepares to share their appreciation for Kim with a surprise Easter festival and a surprise guest.

items.title: Random Acts Light the World Special 2025
items.description: This Christmas, the Random Acts team travels to Texas to surprise Ralphie, a generous soul who dedicates her time to celebrating local heroes, with a Santa’s workshop of her own, so she can continue spreading Christmas kindness.

items.title: Strengthening Families--Part 1
items.description: Focusing on love, time, and commitment, family specialists William J. Doherty, Stephen F. Duncan, and Shirley Klein discuss strengthening families. The Bennet, Cousin, and Wiginton families share what they have done to cultivate a strong family unit.

items.title: Strengthening Families--Part 2
items.description: Focusing on the attributes of a successful family, specialists William J. Doherty, Stephen F. Duncan, and Shirley Klein discuss strengthening families. The Bennet, Cousin, and Wiginton families share how they have cultivated a strong family unit.

items.title: Protecting Family Time
items.description: Specialists William J. Doherty, E. Jeffrey Hill, and Patti Freeman discuss protecting family time. The Cahan and Chapman families share how they set aside time to strengthen their family unit.

items.title: Managing Our Emotions
items.description: Family specialists Eva Feindler, Stephen F. Duncan, and Laura Padilla-Walker discuss managing emotions. The Candland and Wood families share how they build emotional intelligence and manage anger.

items.title: Keeping a Marriage Strong--Part 1
items.description: Family specialists Scott M. Stanley, Jason S. Carroll, and James M. Harper discuss keeping a marriage strong. The Jackson and Skolaski families share how they continue to build love, intimacy, and romance.

items.title: Keeping a Marriage Strong--Part 2
items.description: Family specialists Scott M. Stanley, Jason S. Carroll, and James M. Harper discuss keeping a marriage strong. Karyl Chase and the Frandsen family share how they love their spouses through challenges.

items.title: Effective Parenting
items.description: Family specialists Amanda Harrist, Craig Hart, and David A. Nelson discusses effective parenting. The Howard and Rowe families share how love, limits, and latitude cultivate a successful parenting environment.

items.title: Parenting Teens
items.description: Family specialists Laurence Steinberg, Chris and Lili Anderson, and Bruce Chadwick discuss parenting teens. Janice Brooks-Nichter and the Willis family share how they build relationships with their teenagers.

items.title: Family Finances
items.description: Specialists Craig Israelsen, Bernard Poduska, and Deanna Sharpe discuss family finances. The Huges and Beverly families share how money affects their family unit.

items.title: Strengthening Blended Families
items.description: Specialists Janet S. Scharman, Kay Pasley, and S. Brent Scharman, discuss strengthening blended families. The Webb and Hill families share how divorce and loss can be an opportunity for new family relationships.

items.title: Successful Single Parenting
items.description: Family specialists Francesca Adler-Baeder and Elaine Walton discuss successful single parenting. Allison Newell and Brent Dicou share how growth after divorce or death in family relationships is possible.

items.title: Family Crucibles
items.description: Specialists Pauline Boss, Elaine Marshall, and Jason S. Carroll discuss family crucibles. The Bussey and Johnson families share how they begin healing after tragedy and build relationships with their special needs children.

items.title: Avoiding/Overcoming Pornography
items.description: Pornography addiction therapists discuss overcoming and avoiding the dangers of pornographic materials at all ages. Individuals share the effects of pornography in their families, both the hope in recovery and the devastation of addiction.

items.title: Adoptee Meets Her Birth Mom
items.description: Jenna meets her biological mother, Melissa, who gave her up for adoption when Jenna was an infant. As mother and daughter reunite, both reveal how they've held the other in their hearts throughout the years. Jenna gets more family surprises.

items.title: Adoptee Meets His Sister
items.description: Michael was adopted at birth and never knew his biological family. Brandi found out about Michael as a teenager but wasn't able to find him. Decades later, a miraculous DNA match brings the two siblings together for the first time.

items.title: Brother and Sister are Reunited
items.description: Chris was put in foster care as an infant. Decades later, he finally meets his sister LaToyia, who remembers him as a baby. She answers his questions and they discuss familial loss and their need for each other.

items.title: Father Meets His Daughter
items.description: After years of searching, Lindsay finally connects with her father, David, who shares his side of their story. Lindsay learns about how her parents got together and more about her biological mother.

items.title: He Never Knew He Had A Sister
items.description: Lisa always knew she was adopted, but didn't start looking for her biological family until adulthood. Now, she's found her brother, Jim. As the siblings connect, Lisa learns more about her family and herself.

items.title: I Have A Sister?!
items.description: As a baby, Kimberly was taken away from her family, and has been looking for her dad ever since. Decades later, she meets her sister. Her father has passed, but their meeting fulfills his dream of uniting her with her family.

items.title: I Know Who Our Mom Is!
items.description: Stacey and Jennifer were both given up for adoption by their mother and placed into separate families. Neither knew about each other, until Stacey regained contact with their mother. Now, they meet for the first time and share their stories.

items.title: I Never Gave Up Hope: Father and Daughter Meet
items.description: Terri has spent two decades trying to find her family. When she finally meets her father William and her sister Frances, she realizes they have been searching for her, too.

items.title: She Has A Lot Of Siblings
items.description: Demetria shares a tender embrace with Marco, the brother she never knew she had. Then, Marco tells her that she has several other siblings, who all want to meet her. She learns some vital information about her father.

items.title: Sisters Meet After 40 Years
items.description: After more than forty years of searching, Zuri finally meets her biological sister, Kim. After a warm embrace, Kim tells Zuri that their father is alive and wants to meet her.

items.title: The Son He Didn't Know He Had
items.description: Ever since Clinton found out he was adopted, he's had questions about his birth family. More than 30 years after he was given up, Clinton meets his brother Seth, and his father Barry. They share a heart to heart and connect through music.

items.title: Woman Meets Her Birth Parents
items.description: 40 years after being adopted at birth, Miracle comes face to face with her biological parents, Teresa and Tony. Finally, Miracle is able to get some answers to her deep questions, and learn about why they had to give her up.

items.title: Brooke and Anthony - Season 1
items.description: Brooke and Anthony Brown share how Relative Race gave them the chance to start their own family.

items.title: Doug and Margo - Season 1
items.description: Margo and Doug Engberg share some of their favorite moments from Relative Race.

items.title: Jenn & JD - Season 6
items.description: J.D. and Jenn Barnes share what being on Relative Race has meant to them and their new family.

items.title: Jerica and Joe - Season 4
items.description: Jerica and Joe from Team Black share how discovering new family has changed their lives.

items.title: Keith & Marcus - Season 5
items.description: Catch up with your favorite Relative Race teams from past seasons.

items.title: Maria & Elizabeth Clifton - Season 5
items.description: Catch up with your favorite Relative Race teams from past seasons.

items.title: Michael & Dylan - Season 3
items.description: Michael and Dylan Anderson talk about how they have completely changed their focus toward family.

items.title: Mike & Austen - Season 4
items.description: Austen and Mike share what they did with their prize money and their bond with their new family.

items.title: Paris & Preshious - Season 4
items.description: Paris and Preshious Anderson share what it is like to meet family for the first time.

items.title: Paul & Anitra - Season 6
items.description: Paul and Anitra Louis share what life has been like since meeting Anitra's father.

items.title: Ray & Nicole - Season 6
items.description: Ray and Nicole Campbell share how their lives have changed since meeting Ray's brother.

items.title: Rebecca Hoyt - Season 3
items.description: Rebecca Hoyt talks about her divorce from John and how her life has completely changed.

items.title: The Harper Sisters - Jamie and Morgan - Season 3
items.description: Jamie and Morgan Harper share how being on relative Race was an experience they will never forget.

items.title: Troy and Nicole - Season 3
items.description: Troy and Nicole Hitt share the changes and lifelong bonds that they've formed since Relative Race.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four teams begin a life-changing competition to meet new family members and win the grand prize of $50,000. The race begins in Miami, Florida, where the teams take on challenges involving cooking, books, soccer, and dancing the cha-cha.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Team Green gathers eggs, Team Blue goes on a book hunt, Team Red navigates a maze together, and Team Black tries their hand at accounting. Joe receives a mysterious photo and makes a beautiful discovery.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: The teams try their hand at drone flying during their third challenge. Kyla reconciles with her father’s side of the family. Team Green gets surprised with a pirate adventure.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: The teams struggle with a Pictionary challenge. Rolexis and Leo play polo for the first time while Team Green goes ziplining with their relative. Duley plays checkers with a professional checker player.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: The teams all meet up in North Carolina and get messy with a pie competition. Team Green and Team Blue attend big family reunions and barbeques. Team Black gets all dressed up to compete with competitive arm wrestlers.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: The teams receive the addresses of their relatives with the help of a remote control truck. Team Green helps their newfound family with some demolition. Joe has an emotional reunion with his father.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Between testing survival skills and taking selfies, the teams are pushed to their limits on day seven with challenges. Joe and Madison help their relative run a charity event. Brittany learns about her German heritage.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Justin and Brittany twist pretzels with relatives in Philadelphia. Joe makes special connections. Leo cleans gravestones with his relatives.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Brittany is surprised with a huge family reunion. Rolexis has a lightsaber battle with her relative. Duley tours the U.S.S. Constitution with his new family member.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: The remaining teams meet up in Boston and compete in a historical scavenger hunt for the $50,000 prize.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Season three kicks off from Washington D.C. as four teams embark on the journey of a lifetime to find family and win $50,000. A new twist in travel plans allows teams to make new family connections.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: A memory challenge proves to be difficult for the teams. Michael goes fishing with a relative he never knew existed. Rebecca reunites with a family member who knew her as a child.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: The teams complete slide puzzles that reveal their next relative's address. Jamie and Morgan meet a cousin who shares their love for music, while Troy encounters a relative who bears a striking resemblance to him.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: A darts challenge takes hand-eye coordination to a new level. Rebecca meets a key relative who has crucial answers. Troy meets a relative who shares pictures of Troy's father he's never seen.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Pumpkin carving, joke-telling, and foreign foods send the competitors into a frenzy. Troy meets a relative nicknamed Wonder Woman while Michael finds a like-minded relative. One team has a target on their backs approaching the finale.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: A sudden rule change makes navigation even harder. Michael meets his first maternal relative and sees a picture of his mother for the first time. Troy finally finds an emotional answer to his biggest family mystery.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Teams Black and Red head to California while Teams Green and Blue head to South Carolina to face off in an obstacle course challenge. Rebecca finds a family member she has been waiting for since she was five years old.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: The competition intensifies as Team Black receives immunity and the remaining teams compete for first place. Nicole meets her first relative in the race. Michael meets a life-changing family member.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: With only three teams remaining, the pressure to navigate well is on. John finds out that he is the missing link to a line his relatives have been searching for. Relative Race history is made when two teams experience an unexpected twist.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: After nine tough days of travel, challenges, and new family members, the three remaining teams return to Washington D.C. to compete in a final challenge to determine who takes home the grand prize of $50,000.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four new teams begin a new race with an athletic challenge. Team Black trains like ninjas, Paris does some farm work, and Tiffany and Josh get some army experience. Michael gets some emotional answers he never expected.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: The teams compete in a water balloon challenge. Team Black learns about their grandfather from an unexpected source, Josh learns his family name, and Preshious connects with a new family member who answers her questions.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: One team discusses going home after all the teams struggle with a difficult challenge. Preshious gets a birthday surprise from her new family. Jerica and Joe try glass blowing with their relatives.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Emotions run high as one team is eliminated and another team gets sick and may not be able to continue. The challenge requires them to work on their impressions. Preshious learns more about her father’s side of the family.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Team Black narrowly avoids disaster and another team meets a brother for the very first time. Michael tours a submarine with his newfound relative. Paris helps his relatives find family members of their own.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: The teams are tested on their lip-reading skills. Team Red discovers a military connection while Team Black goes water tubing and Team Green sees a cherished family photo for the very first time.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: All of the teams test their trivia and archery skills in order to find more relatives and earn immunity. Team Black goes camping with their relatives. Preshious is surprised with a huge family reunion. Michael gets some closure.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Even with immunity, Team Black faces pressure as they race to earn a coveted prize. Austen connects with a relative who’s closer than expected. Team Green goes to the batting cages with their new relative.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Preshious gets the answers she’s been searching for from her most important relative yet and two teams face elimination. Joe and Jerica go mountain biking with their new family. Michael and Austen go ax throwing.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: The final two teams face off in Philadelphia in an epic scavenger hunt, racing to solve riddles, earn the $50,000 prize, and be crowned the champion of Relative Race.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four new teams take off from St. Louis with a startling twist at the starting line. Chonta discovers her Southern roots. Marcus learns Arkansas is a state and takes part in a family dance-off.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Teams Red and Blue battle heavy rain and compete head-to-head in a building block challenge. Kaley and Kristin go back to driving school with their relative. Demetrius has an emotional meeting with his first paternal relative.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: All the teams must “smell” their way to victory competing in a blindfolded challenge. Maria’s life is changed forever. Kaley and Kristin connect with their family at a recording studio. Marcus meets his mom’s brother for the first time.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Team Green gets a geography lesson. All teams carefully balance their way through a challenge. Demetrius discovers another relative on his dad’s side and Maria attends a special surprise birthday party.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: The teams show off their singing abilities. Marcus meets the person who linked him to his father. Elizabeth discovers her Dad’s side of the family. Team Black finds out twins run in their family.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: With immunity on the line, a “hamster-like” challenge has the teams rolling in all directions. Chonta is surprised by an emotional cousin. Team Red plays hockey, Team Green camps and learns to wakeboard, and Team Black learns about baseball.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: The teams display their art skills in a challenge. Elizabeth's emotions are tested with a close relative. The twins continue their journey and meet a key relative in the search for their father. Marcus connects with his father's side of the family.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: The teams are faced with a marble challenge and their teamwork is tested. Keith and Marcus visit Las Vegas for the first time. Elizabeth meets a close relative on her mother's side. Maria gets overwhelmed by the pressure of the competition.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: An audible memory challenge stumps the teams. Demetrius meets a key paternal relative in Chicago. Marcus and his Dad share a heartwarming discovery. A trip to Day 10 is on the line for two teams with two strikes!

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: After nine days on the road, the remaining teams face off in the desert of Tucson, Arizona for the $50,000 prize. They are challenged in cowboy-themed skills, like quick-draw gun duels, rock climbing, corn shucking, and a cattle roundup.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: The teams begin the race by meeting at the Virginia International Raceway and must work together as a pit crew. Raymond and DeShae meet their first biological relative, and Anitra gets closer to finding her parents. JD receives difficult news.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: A costly penalty puts three teams at a complete standstill on the road. A medieval challenge launches the teams into a fierce battle. Anitra finally discovers her family name. Raymond gets some important answers he’s been seeking about his mother.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: The challenge requires them to decipher baby talk. Jenn learns more about her grandfather. Raymond gets more answers, DeShae learns her family name, and Anitra learns about her adoption story.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: A physical challenge pushes all the teams to their limits, and one team over the edge! Ray meets an important relative with connections to his mother. JD discovers his closest relative yet. Deshaye takes a huge step in finding her parents.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: After a slacklining challenge, Team Green gets a riverboat tour with their new family. Anitra gets answers about her parents. Ray learns all about his mother’s extraordinary legacy.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: A surprise envelope changes the game for all four teams! A movie theater, popcorn, and emojis mix for a hilarious and competitive challenge. JD meets a campsite full of relatives! Deshaye meets a name she's wondered about her whole life.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: With immunity in hand, Team Blue plays a new game. The teams test out their acting skills in a charades challenge. Anitra meets a close connection to her father. DeShae and Raymond both finally get the tearful reunions they've been waiting for.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: The teams are challenged to see how much they think alike. Despite being out of the race, JD meets one final relative who changes his life. DeShae catches up with a long-awaited relative. Anitra learns about the paratroopers in her family.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: A unique challenge puts the three remaining teams' smarts and stomachs to the ultimate test. Raymond meets close family and gets the answer to who his father is. Anitra's journey comes to a close with an emotional reunion.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: After nine days on the road filled with meeting new family, two teams suit back up in their racing gear. Going head-to-head in a series of racing challenges at the world's largest indoor speedway, one team will win the $50,000 grand prize.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four new teams compete to find relatives and a chance to win $50,000. For the first time, contestants can use a GPS unit, but there's a catch. Kacey meets her first biological relatives. The twins get key information about their mother.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: A life-size puzzle has the teams scrambling to work together. Monika learns more about her mom and what happened when she was adopted. Elizabeth makes a discovery that launches a quest to find three siblings.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Team Green chooses one team to take a lofty penalty. Teams chip and putt their way through a tedious golf challenge. Monika finds out just how big her family is. The twins find a relative who has been searching for them for 20 years.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: A basketball-inspired challenge leaves one team shooting long-distance air balls. Kacey's musical roots hit a high note with a close family member. Devin comes closer to narrowing down who his father may be.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: The feud between Teams Green and Black has Kacey breaking out the war paint. The teams struggle to find balance in a difficult tandem challenge. Monika learns she was missed by her biological family. The twins learn about their mom.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Immunity is on the line as the teams race for first place. Monika meets an important relative from her mother's side. Kacey reads a letter her sibling wrote for her 20 years ago. Liz's life is transformed forever with the surprise of her life.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Team Red's immunity prize causes friction among the teams. Monika helps bridge a gap on her mother's side of the family. Liz visits her grandmother’s grave, and Devin meets a special relative with answers about his biological father.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Joe and Anthony meet a relative with important answers about who their mother is and why they were put up for adoption. Sean finds a connection with his biological father, who served in the military. Liz completes her family tree.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Sean discovers a relative with connections to his dad who died in the military. The twins finally meet the one person they've been desperately searching for their entire lives. But with strikes on the line, one team will say goodbye to the race.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: The season culminates in the Rocky Mountains with a bevy of challenges that push the teams to fight to the end for the championship title and the grand prize of $50,000. And a surprise ending shows just how much the teams care about each other.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four teams set out from Nashville, Tennessee in search of family connections. JT discovers his occupation might run in his family while Stephen meets an uncle with heavy answers to his past and a mysterious name that he must find.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: A first-place victory allows Team Green to dish out a costly penalty to another team. The twins find someone who’s been searching for them for 25 years and learn devastating news. Stephen sees an old photo with five men, one of which is his father.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Team Black battles snow and altitude sickness on the road. An oversized bowling challenge has the teams crushing pins and the competition. Jarrell learns his mother's identity and where she came from.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Team Green’s string of 1st place victories becomes a concerning pattern for the other teams. JT adds to his total of biological brothers and learns about his father. Stephen learns he was never forgotten and is given a photo he lost as a child.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: A difficult challenge has the teams scooping and hooping their way against the clock. Jarrell meets the person who fostered his mother when he was an infant. JT learns devastating news about his family’s past.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: A sudoku-type challenge has the teams counting and second-guessing their math skills. After getting lost, Stephen and Susan have a multi-layered family surprise. The twins learn more about their father through a close connection.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Team Black makes a critical navigation mistake that could cost them. Stephen meets another family member with information about a second sister. And Jarrell makes a surprise entrance for a Mother's Day celebration.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: The lineup for a Day 10 showdown begins to take shape. Team Red uses their golden ticket to meet one more relative. Kaleigh finds surprising information about her Italian roots. The twins and Stephen discover long-lost sisters.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Stephen receives a warm welcome into a new family. The twins use their golden ticket to finish the quest to find their biological father. JT completes his journey with a surprise-filled visit with another brother. The showdown for Day 10 is set.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: Two teams raced through a 9-day road trip, meeting their biological family along the way. Now, in Prescott, Arizona, they compete in food-themed challenges for the grand prize of $50,000 and the title of Relative Race Champions.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: The teams kick off the season by giving service to a local family. Tiffani finally learns her last name, Layton learns more details about her father, and Angie learns the truth about her mother.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Angie learns about her roots in Pennsylvania, while Tiffani connects with her family through pictures. Rachelle learns more about her father and discovers that dancing is in her DNA.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Kyle gets surprised with a relative he never expected. Rachelle solves another mystery in the search for her father and Angie learns a heartbreaking story.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Layton meets her first relative from her mother's side. Tiffani finds a name on her family tree that leaves her speechless.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Team Red keeps the kindness going. Tiffani receives a family heirloom and hears about her father’s life from someone very special. Karim makes an unexpected acquaintance.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Food starts flying during a messy challenge. Angie meets someone who has been waiting for her. Layton makes a surprise entrance to a birthday party that will change her life forever.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: The three remaining teams compete in a baseball challenge that puts their throwing skills to the test. Rachelle adds another sibling to her growing family tree and Jose learns about his deep cultural roots.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Tiffani meets a relative with connections on both sides of her family. Kyle boards a train car to find a family member he never knew existed.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Team Red gives a penalty. Kyle and Layton take a risky shortcut. Tiffani discovers family is closer than she thought. Rachelle receives a letter with life-changing answers.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: The final two teams face off in an amusement park in Alabama for a chance to win the $50,000 prize and the title of Relative Race Champions.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four teams' journey of a lifetime starts in North Carolina. But before the race begins, one team receives some shocking news.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: The photo subject for the day spurs intense competition and strikes a personal chord for Scott and Hannah (Team Green). Jamie and Jansen (Team Black) discover that their long-lost family are closer than they imagined.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Shawn and Curtis (Team Blue) are shocked to learn Shawn's father is still alive. Jamie (Team Black) finds someone he’s been searching his entire life for. A photo saves a team from a strike.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Day 4 starts with big surprises for Teams Red, Blue and Black. Team Red picks up a unique passenger while Team Green reflects on how blessed they are. Alex meets his closest relative yet and the Photo Challenge proves to be the difference.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Alex celebrates his sister’s birthday with a heartfelt song. Teams Red, Green and Blue all find close connections waiting for them. Jamie from Team Black has a life-changing discovery.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: The morning starts with a surprise relative for Alex. Team Photos are filled with patriotic pride while all the teams get excited for their challenge.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Immunity is on the line and the teams push themselves to the limit. Jaime from Team Red has perhaps his most important family member waiting for him back at home in Brooklyn.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Team Red navigates New York City traffic. Jansen introduces his dad to an entirely new meaning for "the smell of victory." Team Green gets an unexpected and emotional phone call.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Team Red gets caught up in NYC freeway traffic so they resort to surface streets to save them from a fatal strike. Team Black gets surprised with a family reunion.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: The three remaining teams face extreme weather in upstate New York as they face the waters of Lake George. A surprising twist adds an additional member to each team for the final showdown.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Four teams kick off Season 11 with a heavy equipment challenge. Team Red's Thaddeus gets a huge surprise a the first door he knocks on. Nolin from Team Green learns key information about his adoption.

items.title: Episode 2
