items.description: A remote control challenge has the teams flying high for points. Thadeuss discovers that his love for art runs throughout his biological family. Carolen meets a cousin with heartbreaking news. Nolin meets two brothers with amazing stories.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Thaddeus sees a picture of his birth mother for the first time. Tia meets a sister. Jon experiences a flood of emotions after meeting a brother.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Tia and Carolen (Team Black) have a major setback. Nolin meets his birth father. Kentrelle opens his heart as two new family members welcome him with open arms.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Emotions run high as the race reaches the halfway point. Carolen meets a sister with knowledge about their family. Nolin learns the truth about the circumstances surrounding his adoption.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Tia (Team Black) sees pictures of her mother for the first time. Kentrelle (Team Blue) struggles with new information about his birth mother. Thaddeus (Team Red) is surprised when he meets a special relative.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Jon (Team Blue) meets a relative he's been waiting to meet his whole life. Nolin (Team Green) discovers more siblings. Tia (Team Black) finds out about her long-lost brother.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Thaddeus (Team Red) returns to his hometown to find a deep connection. Nolin (Team Green) seems to meet his twin. Carolen (Team Black) meets her father while Kantrelle (Team Blue) finds out how much he has in common with his birth mom.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Tia (Team Black) meets a long lost sister while Jon (Team Blue) adds a third brother to his list of family. Nolin (Team Green) has an emotional moment when he finally meets his mother and Thaddeus (Team Red) meets his mother at a hospital.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: In the season finale, three teams suit up for the ultimate challenge at a fire fighter training facility. Things get hot as teams compete to put out a blaze as the teams compete to conduct a rescue in a three story building to win the grand prize.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: A new season kicks off with four new teams embarking on the journey of a lifetime. Tears flow for Team Blue as they get answers to questions they’ve had their whole lives. Team Red discovers that one of their talents is a family trait.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: On day two, the teams complete a challenge that leaves them hanging. Teams Green and Red both receive devastating news.Teams Black and Blue discover family secrets and stories.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: On day three, the teams struggle to complete their most difficult challenge so far. Teams Blue and Red each meet an unexpected family member, while Team Black recognizes immediately who’s waiting at the door.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: On day four, the teams continue their quest to solve family mysteries. Teams Black and Red receive bittersweet news, while Teams Green and Blue are amazed to see striking resemblances in their newfound families.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: The teams complete a big picture for day five’s challenge. Teams Red and Green feel more part of their families’ background, while Teams Blue and Black feel their family circle expand around them.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Day six brings new challenges and new family meetings. Team Black celebrates a big birthday with an incredible surprise, Team Red gets challenging news, and Teams Green and Blue connect with new cousins.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Things keep popping for the teams on day seven. Despite winning the benefit the day before, Team Blue is delayed due to an injury. Teams Green and Red learn more about their parents from cousins. Team Black instantly recognizes their new family.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: The teams are plunging forward as they head into day eight. Teams Blue and Black have emotional connections with people they knew before while Teams Green and Red get surprised by more than they ever dreamed.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: On day nine, the teams stick together in hopes of reaching day 10. Teams Green, Black and Blue all receive the final piece of their family puzzles, while Team Red learns more about their impressive family legacy.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: On the final day of Relative Race, all four teams get a special surprise that bring them even closer. At the Forge Adventure Park outside Chicago, three teams will have to compete in three challenges to see who will take home the grand prize.

items.title: Family
items.description: Host Dan Debenham, Season 3 alum Rebecca, and Season 6 alumni JD and Jenn light the world through a special visit at a care facility.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Season 13 kicks off medieval-style in Nashville, Tennessee with new faces, new cars, and new rules. Abe (Team Blue) and Ashlee (Team Black) both meet their brothers, but Abe gets devastating news.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Fueled by yesterday’s defeat, Team Green fights to get back in the competition. Team Red and Team Blue go head-to-head in Deerfield, Illinois. Ashlee (Team Black) discovers an uncanny resemblance to her grandmother.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Team Green gives the other teams a penalty as Team Red struggles to stay in the race. Team Black meets an extra special relative. Jo (Team Green) meets her grandfather and Justin (Team Red) meets his sister who gives him disappointing news.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Teams Green and Red work to communicate better. All teams play chicken with a new set of challenges. Ashlee (Team Black) and Jo (Team Green) meet family members that have been waiting for them their whole lives.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: The halfway point finds Team Blue with a crucial advantage over the other teams. Justin finds a close relative, Ashlee finds more information about her mother, and both Jo and Eric find siblings.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Teams Green and Black get freaked out at the challenge. Justin finds a first cousin and Ashlee discovers a niece. Eric has multiple life-changing moments, including learning his father's name.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Jo has a surprise birthday party! Day 7's challenge is out of this world. Abe meets his first relative from his mother's side of the family. Jo and Justin both find new siblings. Ashlee and Brennan meet cousins who share home videos.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: James receives a letter he never expected while Team Blue is excited to head into Manhattan. Today's challenge is the toughest one yet. Jo, Justin, and Ashlee all meet new sisters. Abe and Eric race to a Manhattan rooftop to meet Eric's cousin.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: All the Teams are anxious to find out who will be heading to Day 10. Ashlee reads the final passages of her mom’s journal. The day ends with a big surprise!

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: On the final day of Relative Race, each team is looking to secure the grand prize. Team Red has renewed strength after finding out they made it to Day 10. After a series of medieval-themed challenges, Dan reveals the winner of Season 13.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Dan welcomes the new teams to a new season of Relative Race at Pangaea Studios in Atlanta, Georgia. After a game of "Guess That Movie Line" the teams get on the road, ready to start their journeys of meeting new family members.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Team Black is blocked by a bridge, and three teams have to collect 'city selfies.' Teams then must complete feats of smarts and strength before meeting long lost relatives.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Our teams start this episode with a tough challenge that leaves them in a pickle. If they succeed, they will be rewarded with a special surprise. One competitor finally fulfills their dream of meeting their long lost father.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: One contestant bids bittersweet farewell to a their relative. Then, the teams must play golf, but with a twist that is anything but par for the course.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Team Blue gets a flying lesson. Today's challenge has teams smashing down doors. Johnny meets his first relative, and another contestant meets two relatives.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Families share tearful goodbyes before teams continue their journey. Contestants must '"work the red carpet" before they can meet more family members. A new team takes the lead.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: As the teams prepare to embark on Day 7, Laura Jean has a surprise for her relatives that will change their lives. Due to health concerns, Team Black has to make a difficult decision. Team Red gets devastating news.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: As the race nears its end, each team is hungry for the number one position. Despite winning an advantage, Team Blue gets lost finding their relative. Team Red turns the tables and answers questions for their relative.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: The teams prepare for their last day of traveling and reflect on the relatives they've met. Teams blue and green meet maternal relatives. Team Red meets the last relative they were looking for.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: In a thrilling conclusion to this cinematic season, Teams Blue, Green, and Red compete in movie-set challenges to determine the ultimate winner. Filled with movie magic, explosive endings, and a surprise reunion, this finale is a showstopper.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Season 15 begins with a bang as the new teams complete their first challenge on the USS New Jersey. The rules of the race have changed once again, keeping the contestants on their toes as they meet new family members for the first time.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Jen and Leland (Team Green) make a special stop with Jen's father before hitting the road. Team Red seeks to keep their lead intact but struggles with the challenge. David and Dan both meet very special relatives.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Fresh off their Day 2 victory, Gabby from Team Black has a full-circle moment with her relatives. Dan from Team Red meets someone he's been searching decades for.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Team Red’s Kayli meets a crucial member of her family. Team Black’s David meets a nephew who notices a family resemblance, while Teams Green and Blue meet relatives they didn’t know existed.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: A health scare jeopardizes a team’s ability to continue in the race. Joanie and Dan learn more about their family origins from their relatives. David receives the answers he's been searching for.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: In a Relative Race first, a new contestant joins a team mid-race. Each team feels the pressure to complete the challenge despite tricky penalties. Dan finds a special relative who reveals important information about his father.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Teams Black and Red set out with two strikes and a burning determination to avoid a third. Team Green dusts off their history knowledge while Team Blue learns more about their family's military service. Team Red has its most emotional meeting yet.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Nearing the end of the race, Teams Blue and Green are fighting for first place. Team Red receives a precious gift from Kayli's father. Team Green meets the last piece of her paternal family tree, while Team Black meets more of David's family.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Following a whirlwind day of challenges and travels, Team Red finishes their journey with a full-circle moment. Teams Green and Blue meet long awaited relatives and David from Team Black receives a special gift.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: Team Black receives a heartwarming surprise. After driving tanks through an obstacle course, the race comes down to two teams vying for the $50,000 grand prize.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Season 16 launches with success as all four teams start the race off in Alabama with the challenge "Launch it Like it's Hot!" Team Black receives some shocking news that leaves them with more questions than answers.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: After a penalty from the winners, Team Black gets stuck in traffic. Jerry uncovers mysteries about his siblings. Team Red makes a TikTok with their new relative.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Team Green connects with a niece and learns some devastating news. Team Black connects with relatives at the skating rink. The winners are faced with a decision of which team to give their award to.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: A hairstyling competition goes awry for Team Green who enjoy a joyful reunion with their new relative. Meanwhile, Jerry from Team Blue is proud to learn he shares a military legacy with his grandfather.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Andrae’a from Team Red is counting on her husband’s experience as a locomotive engineer to give her team an edge in the challenge. Team Black shares an emotional reunion with a relative who had long prayed for the chance to see Sadie again.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: When just one second separates first from second place, the tension is high, but emotions run even higher when Jerry reveals which relative he met. Candis, from Team Red, is moved to tears upon learning of the passing of her biological grandmother.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Team Blue swaps roles with their family member, sharing all they’ve learned about their loved ones. Meanwhile, Team Green’s Hillary forms a deep connection as she learns about her mother through the stories of a long-lost relative.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Team Red’s Candis finally sees a photo of her birth mother. Jerry from Team Blue meets his first paternal relative, and Hilary gets a heartfelt surprise gift from her newly found family.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: It’s the final chance for the Relative Race teams to meet family members, and emotions are at an all-time high. Sadie and Candis both find themselves deeply moved as their journeys lead to powerful moments of connection and compassion.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: On Day 10, teams compete for $50,000 through space-themed challenges, facing moon-walking simulators, tackling space trivia, and navigating demanding spaceship courses.

items.title: He Was the First to Hold Me
items.description: Sadie meets Devin and Robin, her biological grandparents, and finds more about the day she was born.

items.title: I Finally Met My Father
items.description: After meeting multiple relatives, Candis meets the one she’s waited her whole life for: her father.

items.title: I Met My Mother for the First Time
items.description: Sadie and her adoptive brother Jake finally meet Aunya, Sadie’s birth mother, in an emotional reunion.

items.title: My Father Would Have Kept Me
items.description: After decades without knowing the identity of his father, Jerry meets Bruce, his biological dad, who had no idea Jerry was his son until recently.

items.title: Why Did You Let Me Go?
items.description: Hillary meets her birth father in an emotional reunion and learns why she was put up for adoption.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Season 17 launches with a treasure hunt deep in the caverns of Luray, Virginia. As the contestants start their road trips across the country in search of family and $50,000, they reflect on what a newfound family would mean to them.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Team Red makes their first misstep, while Team Green dodges a mystery penalty. Jeremy finds a relative that looks familiar.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Reeling from the previous day, Jeremy finds hope in his newest relative. Matt meets a relative he never thought existed. Team Green manages to stay on top of the latest challenge, giving the other teams something to buzz about.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: Team Black falters in the latest challenge, but regains momentum when teammate Nikia realizes the competition is far more personal than just supporting Meyet.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: Information about his father brings Matt to a relative that holds the key to his own past. The latest challenge tests all four teams’ bonds and forces Sean to reevaluate his goals.

items.title: Episode 6
items.description: Meyet discovers a unique connection to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Sean learns why he was unable to find his father. After decades, Jeremy finally finds the person he’s been searching for.

items.title: Episode 7
items.description: Matt makes a connection that will change his life forever. Meyet’s accuracy in the throwing challenge and Nikia’s precision in the blade-swinging challenge may not be enough to lift them to victory.

items.title: Episode 8
items.description: Matt attends a family event for the first time. Meyet and Sean find relatives they’ve spent decades searching for. Team Green attempts to secure the prize money in today’s challenge.

items.title: Episode 9
items.description: Sean finds a relative who has traveled thousands of miles just to meet him. Meyet experiences her most special meeting on the race. The Red Team pushes themselves in their most difficult challenge yet.

items.title: Episode 10
items.description: As the competition wraps up, the teams gather at Natural Bridge Caverns in San Antonio, Texas to reflect on their journeys. Then, the race for $50,000 culminates in a series of challenges that will decide everything.

items.title: Hoyt and Williams
items.description: Rebecca Hoyt from Season 3 shares her story of life after the show. She’s now an employee of Relative Race and works to help others discover family. Mike Brown and Austen Williams of Season 4 share how the family they met changed their lives.

items.title: Brown and Barnes
items.description: Brooke and Anthony Brown from Season 1 reveal the heartwarming way they’ve spent their winnings. J.D. and Jenn Barnes of Season 6 share how their family has grown by over 100 members since finishing Relative Race.

items.title: Harper and Williams
items.description: Kayla and Duly Williams from Season 2 share what finding family has meant to their kids. Jamie and Morgan Harper of Season 3 reveal exciting updates about their lives and careers.

items.title: Louis and Anderson
items.description: Paul and Anitra Louis from Season 6 introduce Anitra’s biological family to her adopted family in an emotional meeting. Paris and Preshious Anderson from Season 4 say that the family they've met plays an important role in their lives today.

items.title: Henline and Anderson
items.description: Relative Race Season 4 sibling team Joe and Jerica Henline reveal their new family connections. The father-and-son team of Season 3, Michael and Dylan Anderson, share how meeting family has changed their lives for the better.

items.title: Pardon and Engberg
items.description: Chris and DeShae Pardon of Relative Race Season 6 share how DeShae’s family is impacting her life today. Plus, learn how Doug and Margo Engberg of Season 1 keep family relationships stronger than ever while building their booming cupcake business.

items.title: Breedlove and Campbell
items.description: Marcus and Keith Breedlove from Relative Race Season 5 have new family members providing ongoing love and support to them. Ray and Nicole Campbell of Season 6 and their connection with Ray’s brother has flourished.

items.title: Clifton and Hitt
items.description: Maria and Elizabeth Clifton from Season 5 have kept in contact with their newfound parents and siblings. Troy and Nicole Hitt from Season 3 share how they’ve adopted a completely new way of life since Relative Race.

items.title: Paris
items.description: Growing up in Tuskegee, Alabama, Paris faced limited opportunities, until a knock on the door changed his life. A caring missionary believed in him, guiding Paris toward confidence, purpose, and a law degree from BYU.

items.title: Kareisha
items.description: Kareisha, an Afghanistan veteran and mother, overcame obstacles to graduate from Colorado Christian University. With faith and support, she proves that when life’s odds are against you, God’s support helps transform dreams into reality.

items.title: Nikki Maxon
items.description: Returning to the Arizona town she once struggled to leave, Nikki brings her daughter along for the ride. In facing her past, she sees how faith and education became the foundation of her future.

items.title: Arien Benadie
items.description: After losing her father and brother in South Africa and facing health challenges during COVID, Arien found support in Zimbabwe, which led her to BYU-Idaho, where she’s breaking family cycles and finding deep meaning in education.

items.title: Hinatea Ah Chookoon
items.description: Born on the small island of Huahine in Tahiti, Hinatea traveled by boat each day just to attend high school. With few expectations set before her, she dreamed of BYU–Hawaii. Through BYU–Pathway, that distant dream became reality.

items.title: Wilford Wu
items.description: Wilford grew up in China where his education had no elements of faith. Because he served a Church mission his university ambitions were dashed in China, but the iWORK program at BYU-Hawaii restored his ability to still seek higher education.

items.title: Jay Cannon
items.description: From failing first grade to failing out of college, Jay’s path was rocky. Though he loved learning, classrooms never fit, and faith felt unrelated. Marriage and spiritual renewal changed that. Now his faith fuels growth he once thought impossible.

items.title: Kyla Ford
items.description: Kyla loved going to school and had big college plans. But soon after high school found herself in a faith crisis. As a young mom with three little kids, she’d found the education she’d always dreamed of through BYU Pathway.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: Rocket and Alli welcome their newest foster siblings, Casey and Lena, to The Knot. As Rocket and Alli prepare to compete in the annual village show, they discover that Casey and Lena might not be who they say they are, uncovering a world of magic.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: Rocket's search for the truth will uncover a web of secrets that reaches further than he had ever imagined.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: With just hours left in the doomsday prophecy, Alli and Rocket come closer to learning the truth about Casey and Lena.

items.title: An Answer for Everything
items.description: There's a new foster kid coming to stay.

items.title: Brandon and the Beast
items.description: When a mythical creature is sighted in the woods, Rocket is determined to save it from extinction.

items.title: The Fairy Queen
items.description: When an old lady, Mary Mac, comes to stay, Jade discovers that she is the queen of the fairies.

items.title: The Golden Egg
items.description: When Alli breaks a rare bird's egg at school, she embarks on a quest to find a new one.

items.title: Alli and the Wish Friend
items.description: After Alli makes a wish for a best friend, she is shocked to find it comes true.

items.title: Fallout
items.description: Alli and Shada are trapped in a haunted fallout shelter.

items.title: The Mermaid's Song
items.description: Rocket and friends find themselves trapped in a cove with the tide coming in.

items.title: The Wolf Tree
items.description: Rocket learns about the ancient Wolf Tree, which is said to make the old young again.

items.title: The Lost Boy
items.description: When a mysterious new foster kid arrives at the Knot, the others think that he is hiding something.

items.title: Rocket's Return
items.description: When a time machine crash-lands, Archie explains that the stranger is actually a time traveler.

items.title: The Goblin Curse
items.description: Brandon triggers an ancient goblin's curse.

items.title: The Ballabungie Detective Agency
items.description: Rocket and Dibber re-activate the Ballabungie Detective Agency to find who set fire to the school.

items.title: The Tearpot
items.description: Rocket tries to show his mother how much the village loves them at the Ballabungie parade.

items.title: Here Be Dragons
items.description: After Rocket discovers a giant fossil, new foster kid Benjamin thinks he sees a real dragon.

items.title: The Tell Stones
items.description: After Dibber cheats on a school presentation, he appears to become the target of ancient powers.

items.title: The Broken Soldier
items.description: After Archie finds an old toy soldier under his bed, Jade worries that he might have brought it to life.

items.title: Madison the Vampire
items.description: Madison's sudden strange behavior leads the Knot kids to believe that she might be a vampire.

items.title: Jade the Magnificent
items.description: After being struck by lightning, Jade appears to have developed potentially dangerous magical powers.

items.title: The Mirror of Morglaw
items.description: A skeleton washes up on the Dirgelmor shore, uncovering the journal of Lord Loomis and his quest to find a mirror that reflects a person's true self.

items.title: Telling Porkies
items.description: A new foster kid, the energetic Izzy Wizzy, makes a noisy arrival at the Knot.

items.title: The Selkie Boy
items.description: After a handsome, mythical Selkie arrives, Alli hopes for an end to her loneliness; Izzy gets herself into more trouble when she loses one of Sarah's treasured rings.

items.title: Mountain Post
items.description: A lone mailbox atop Dirgelmor's only mountain is rumored to be able to send letters to historical figures. But when Brandon uses it to contact his mother, it leads to a big surprise.

items.title: The Knights of Dirgelmor
items.description: Upset over Brandon's departure, Jade searches for a ruined castle in the hope that she can be happy forever, but she becomes trapped by ancient knights who defend it.

items.title: Izzy Wizzy and the Weeping Oak
items.description: Rocket believes Izzy Wizzy has been acting strangely because she is possessed by tree sprites.

items.title: Goodbye Island
items.description: Peter tells the family that there will be no new foster kids at the Knot. Meanwhile, Jade, Archie and Izzy Wizzy go in search of the legendary Dirgeldoor, which is rumored to transport you to your true home.

items.title: The Dirgeldoor
items.description: Jane, Archie and Izzy find themselves trapped in the mines while searching for the Dirgeldoor to take them to their true home.

items.title: I Wish He Was Still Here
items.description: Upon moving to a new town with her dad, Ruby discovers a magic well that shows her the wish of a woman in town. Ruby, with the help of her new friends Sam and Mina, work to help reunite the woman's family.

items.title: I Wish I Knew Where to Start
items.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina fulfill the wish of the town librarian, leading them on a treasure hunt to uncover a centuries-old mystery and Emerald’s best kept secret. Meanwhile, Daniel attempts to fix his old home with help from a new friend.

items.title: I Wish I Could Walk With Her
items.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina try to fulfill the wish of a local family to save a wedding, and in the process, they learn not to judge a book by its cover. Daniel discovers more revelations about Old Tom's property.

items.title: I Wish She Would Trust Me
items.description: Trust is brought into question when Ruby wonders if she can tell her dad about the magical well. Daniel meets a military friend of his father's who sheds some light on the past.

items.title: I Wish I Got The Credit I Deserve
items.description: Ruby, Sam, and Mina help a science camp teacher get the credit she deserves. Daniel investigates Ruby’s good deeds around town.

items.title: I Wish I Could Stop Pretending
items.description: Ruby, Sam and Mina learn the importance of telling the truth when they bring a long-kept secret to light. Meanwhile, Daniel and Paula try to win over a developer interested in Emerald who could potentially put the town back in business.

items.title: I Wish I Could Have Another Chance
items.description: The Emerald Apple Festival is back and reveals a new, unusual wish for Ruby to fulfill. Daniel and Paula revive the festival’s apple cart race, and a longstanding tradition of competition between the Prices and the O’Reillys.

items.title: I Wish I Could Meet My Family
items.description: Ruby wrestles with how to solve a wish that hits close to home, involving Sam's desire to meet his biological family. Ruby’s maternal grandparents come to town for a visit.

items.title: I Wish I Could Get Back at Her
items.description: Development endangers Ruby's wishing well, while Daniel makes a wish of his own. Ruby and Sam learn about the consequences of seeking revenge when they discover a wish regarding two feuding actors.

items.title: I Wish We'd Stayed Friends
items.description: Ruby discovers a wish from beyond the grave that needs to be fulfilled. Daniel fights for the preservation of the wishing well, but the development company has other ideas.

items.title: I Wish Things Could've Turned Out Differently
items.description: After a wishless winter, Ruby struggles to save the well while granting the wish of an enemy of the town. Are these two tricky missions somehow intertwined? Meanwhile, Daniel and Paula plan to delay a construction crew poised to demolish the well.

items.title: I Wish I Could Find Her
items.description: Ruby’s latest wisher hopes to find someone, but figuring out who turns out to be the hardest part of the wish. Meanwhile, Daniel is bombarded by calls from his father who wants Daniel and Ruby to give up the orchard and leave Emerald for good.

items.title: I Wish I Could Get Away
items.description: As Ruby and friends tackle a new wish, they run into a strange new problem: the wish appears to be granting itself. Meanwhile, Ruby worries her dad is lonely in Emerald and embarks on a mission to find him some new friends.

items.title: I Wish We Could Get Back Together
items.description: Ruby receives a musical wish that involves a local celebrity and a broken friendship,while Daniel and Paula organize a benefit concert.

items.title: I Wish I Could Spend Time With Her
items.description: As Ruby embarks on her newest wish, she rekindles the search for a long-missing Emerald resident. Meanwhile, Daniel’s efforts to bring back the O’Reilly apple tree uncovers a brand new mystery.

items.title: I Wish They Would Just Listen
items.description: After the well gives Ruby clues but no wish, Ruby must figure out what that means. Only then can she help a wisher enjoy their wish to travel. Meanwhile, Daniel’s efforts to solve a mystery sets off a misunderstanding among Emerald’s residents.

items.title: I Wish I Had Some Space
items.description: Ruby and her friends struggle to grant the wish of a very intimidating and mysterious wisher. Meanwhile, Ruby and Daniel are both unsure how to handle an important date on the calendar: what would’ve been Summer’s birthday.

items.title: I Wish I Could Get It Back
items.description: Ruby and her friends embark on a thrilling and unexpected adventure close to home as they try to recover something precious lost by a wisher. Meanwhile, Ava and Daniel bond over raising teenage daughters.

items.title: I Wish I Could Stop Hurting
items.description: A confusing wish challenges Ruby with brokering peace after a longstanding family feud. Meanwhile, Daniel and Sam take a journey through the orchard and discover more about Ruby’s well-keeping ancestors.

items.title: I Wish the Well Would Let Us Be
items.description: Ruby receives her toughest wish yet from someone who knows all about the well’s magic. If the wisher is who she thinks it is, granting this wish could mean the end of the wishing well itself.

items.title: I Wish I Knew Where It Was
items.description: A famous bank robbery in Emerald’s past becomes the focus of Ruby’s latest wish, but the wisher is the last person she would’ve suspected. After a lifetime of keeping a crushing secret, the wisher worries the past is about to catch up with them.

items.title: I Wish I Could Stop This Monster
items.description: A wish expressed in barks instead of words leads Ruby to help a rural veterinarian struggling with a lot more than panicky pets. But she soon realizes the monster he’s facing is scarier than she thought.

items.title: I Wish I Could Rest In Peace
items.description: The well gives Ruby a wish from beyond the grave from Viole O’Reilly, the Victorian well keeper from her previous visions. This wish is part of All Souls Day, the Irish day of the dead, which means Ruby only has until midnight tomorrow to grant it.

items.title: I Wish He Knew the Whole Story
items.description: Sam and his mom find themselves on opposite sides of a hot-button community issue. Meanwhile, Ruby receives a wish so vague that it’s going to take all her and Mina’s legwork even to make a dent in it.

items.title: I Wish He was Dead
items.description: After missing an important family event, Ruby is racked with guilt. Worse, she receives a wish too awful to grant! Mina and Sam are ready to take over for her and manage to supply Ruby and her dad with a much-needed bonding opportunity.

items.title: I Wish I Could Feel Love Again
items.description: Ruby and Sam join forces to help someone who wants to “feel love again”. But after the wisher is discovered, a misunderstanding leads to a possibly disastrous revelation. Now, they must figure out what the wish really means before it’s too late.

items.title: I Wish She Was Out of the Way
items.description: Ruby believes that a wisher wants to get rid of rivals for Daniel's affections– including her mom's memory. Given the growing importance of family in Ruby’s life, that is a step too far! That is, unless Ruby is wrong about the intent of the wish.

items.title: I Wish I Was the Next Well Keeper
items.description: After struggling to balance wish granting with regular teen life, Ruby’s now ready to rock her next challenge. But when she gets the worst-possible wish, will she find a way out? Meanwhile, Seb is onto Mina and the secret she’s keeping from him.

items.title: I Wish... I Wish... I Wish...
items.description: Ruby returns to Emerald from Ireland with fresh concerns about keeping the well alive. She receives three different visions of wishes to fulfill with the help of Mina and Sam. Meanwhile, Dan and Leah have an awkward reunion--and a new secret.

items.title: I Wish I Could Land a Sweet Deal
items.description: Ruby has her hands full with a particularly ambitious wish from powerhouse realtor Amanda "The Wolf" Wilczek, which includes working with the most haunted house in Emerald. Meanwhile, Dan helps out the local firehouse, sparking a dream of his own.

items.title: I Wish I Was A Kid Again
items.description: Ruby and her friends search for a wisher who wants to be a kid again. When they find that it's another kid, they dig deep to find an extra special answer. Dan starts his journey as a probationary volunteer fireman with an unlucky Emerald resident.

items.title: I Wish I Knew What She Was Hiding
items.description: Ruby's fear of losing the well intensifies when she sees a vision of video footage at the well. She, Mina, and Sam launch an investigation into vintage items to find the videographer. Meanwhile, Dan helps Mrs. Martin look for a newer, safer home.

items.title: Ecnahc Rehtona Dah I Hsiw I
items.description: Ruby receives a garbled clue from the well that forces her, Mina, and Sam to think in a different direction. Dan runs interference between Amanda and her sudden interest in the magical well.

items.title: I Wish Tom Didn't Ruin Everything
items.description: With more scrutiny than ever before, Ruby uses her wish to keep the well healthy and secret. Meanwhile, Emerald's Thanksgiving dinner could be ruined if the wish isn't fulfilled in time. Dan and Brea work together to get Wally to join the fun.

items.title: I Wish I Wouldn’t Lose
items.description: The well's clues are the most garbled and blurry yet. Ruby worries that she will lose the well forever. She, Mina, and Sam still work to fulfill the wish and get involved in the world of football. Dan continues to cope with the idea of Ruby leaving.

items.title: I Wish...
items.description: Ruby hopes that her wish is the next to come out of the well--but is shocked when it's Dan's that comes next. Time is running out for the well as Mrs. Rivers-Snyder asks more questions. A surprise visitor provides answers about the failing well.

items.title: Running the Bases
items.description: Brooks never played baseball to win—he played for something bigger. But when his faith is tested in a town that won’t play along, he must choose: stay true to his beliefs or play it safe and risk losing what matters most.

items.title: Runt
items.description: When her family's farm is in danger, a determined young girl and her trusty dog train for a prestigious dog agility championship with hopes of saving the place they call home.

items.title: Salutation: Eriks Esenvalds by BYU Singers
items.description: BYU Singers performs Salutation by Eriks Esenvalds, a contemporary choral work filled with expressive harmonies and musical artistry. Discover the beauty of blended voices in a reflective concert performance that celebrates the power of choral music.

items.title: Super Mega Sophie Kapow!
items.description: Old Bennett goes back in time to persuade his younger self to be kinder to his sister, Sophie. But Young and Old Bennett's attempt to make things right turns Sophie into a fearless crime fighter...and puts her in danger!

items.title: Moose Ninja Vanish!
items.description: After consulting the Unicorn Commandos, Old and Young Bennett build a life-size animatronic moose ninja for Liam's gaming videos. But chaos ensues when the robot moose ninja goes on a terror spree through Star City!

items.title: Man's Best Friend's Enemy
items.description: Bennett invents a device that gives his new pet dog super intelligence. Things go haywire when the dog becomes a talking criminal mastermind!

items.title: Snowmageddon
items.description: Young Bennett risks losing his friends when he upstages them during a TV quiz show. Young and Old Bennett construct a snow cone-making robot to help win his friends back, but the robot malfunctions and causes the blizzard of the century!

items.title: The Shampoo Sham
items.description: Young Bennett accidentally unleashes an army of sasquatches when he visits his father's shampoo factory.

items.title: Engineer Club
items.description: Robber Boss uses Young Bennett's Engineer Club to devise a break Momma Robber out of jail. Old Bennett builds a headband that turns people's criticisms into compliments.

items.title: The Shoes Make the Man
items.description: Old Bennett convinces his younger self to take up Boot Ball, his mom's favorite sport. Things quickly get out of hand when Young Bennett tricks out his Boot Ball boots with artificial intelligence.

items.title: Mind Trip
items.description: Sophie and Liam try to top each other's Mother Day gifts. Old and Young Bennett take a trip down Memory Lane.

items.title: Genius at Work
items.description: Snodgrass eyes Young Bennett's robot Edee for military purposes, while Young Bennett and Penelope must work together to fend off an alien crystal.

items.title: Rebel With a Cause
items.description: Snodgrass creates a giant vampire-dentist-robot to capture the Guardian. Young Bennett, Sophie and Liam try to find the Guardian, but get wrangled into a showdown with Robber Boss.

items.title: Grounded
items.description: To bypass being grounded, Young Bennett builds a body-swapping device and trades places with Nira. Meanwhile, the DGS stages a fake commercial to convince Star City that the Mystery Soldier was just a publicity stunt.

items.title: Anger Mismanagement
items.description: With Old Bennett's help, Young Bennett makes a unique music instrument for Sophie that catches the attention of an evil pop star named Trill.

items.title: The Candidate
items.description: When a mayoral candidate proposes to make the school day longer, Bennett uses AI to create an opponent named Abraham Trutherman to run against her.

items.title: Fishzilla
items.description: The annual Bramble fishing trip goes haywire when Bennett's newest invention turns aquatic animals into giants.

items.title: Clash of the Horns
items.description: Bennett's ego gets the better of him when he takes over his sister Sophie's Unicorn Commandos fan film. Meanwhile, Inspector Gorgana of the Galactic Alliance meets with the DGS.

items.title: The Emplifier
items.description: Young and Old Bennett build a device called the Emplifier to get Jessica, Liam's latest crush, to notice him. But the Emplifier works too well and turns everyone it encounters into obsessed Liam fans.

items.title: Disabler Enabler
items.description: The Bramble kids spend too much time on their digital devices. Robber Mama returns and kidnaps Young Bennett.

items.title: The Not-So Fun Fundraiser
items.description: Bennett devises a get-rich-quick scheme to earn money for a Unicorn Commandos remote controlled monster truck toy. But Young Bennett's actions affects Old Bennett's timeline.

items.title: Bennett the Grouch
items.description: Bennett creates a "sleeping cap" to curtail his grumpiness. But when Bennett's dad Mark uses the cap, the fragile agreement between Earth and the Intergalactic Alliance is jeopardized.

items.title: The Vault
items.description: Old Bennett must intervene when both Young Bennett and Snodgrass discover the entrance to the secret elevator.

items.title: A Date With Some Rocks
items.description: While visiting his dad in Wellington, New Zealand, 11-year-old Jake obtains the skin of a selkie, a mythical sea creature who transforms from a seal to a woman when on land.

items.title: It Wasn't A Dream
items.description: Jake follows in his dad's footsteps by gathering clues to support his hypothesis. Jessie teaches Jake a valuable lesson when he gets in trouble with some of the local kids.

items.title: Its Power Is Strong
items.description: Jake’s friend Jessie reveals that Cara cannot return to the sea without her seal skin. Jake agrees to return the skin to where he found it but fears the alluring pelt has too great a hold on him.

items.title: Where's Ted?
items.description: When Ted goes missing, Jake and Jessie must use their smarts to get him back to safety. Robert falls under Cara’s allure as she confronts Jake regarding the whereabouts of her seal skin.

items.title: Do The Right Thing
items.description: Ted desperately searches for Cara to stop her dangerous plan. Jake finally locates Cara's skin but must outrun the local kids in order to keep it. An unlikely ally saves the day.

items.title: Open Your Mind A Little
items.description: Jake embarks on a daring mission to find a special kelp that can heal Jessie's injuries. Ted reveals the truth to Robert about Cara by telling the story of his own Selkie experience. But the danger has already set in.

items.title: People We Care About
items.description: Jake enlists the help of Ted and Jessie when Robert refuses to give Cara's skin back. Ted reveals to Robert more of his tragic story but not before Robert's betrayal turns Cara into a different creature.

items.title: The Only Way This Can End
items.description: With Robert injured by Cara's animal rage, Jake embarks on a perilous mission to retrieve the seal skin from its underwater hiding place.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: When Mr. Dashwood passes away, Mrs. Dashwood and her daughters are forced to move into a tiny Devonshire cottage and start their lives again.

items.title: Episode 2
items.description: While Colonel Brandon is away on business in London, Marianne and Willoughby find themselves falling in love.

items.title: Episode 3
items.description: Heartbroken at the hands of Willoughby and Edward, Marianne and Elinor travel to Cleveland; when they return to Devon, there's some good news.

items.title: Sharing Aloha
items.description: A backstage exploration of what it means for young Islanders to preserve and pass on the culture of their ancestors, diving behind the scenes for a rare look into one of Hawaii's most popular (and least understood) tourist stops.

items.title: Shifting Gears
items.description: Tom, an overworked husband and father, abandons his job to own a business. He invests everything in a failing mechanic shop, and must enter a dirt track race to save the business.

items.title: Shoelaces For Christmas
items.description: Jennifer starts helping more around the house and volunteering at a homeless shelter when her dad won’t pay for a trip to Paris until she proves she can be selfless. Her outlook on life changes as her new friends show how little it takes to be happy.

items.title: Lipstick Time
items.description: The Show Offs team up with guests Lucas Grabeel and Tom Quinn to create a hilarious golden-age musical right on the spot.

items.title: Where Art Thou?
items.description: The Show Offs team up with James “Murr” Murray (Impractical Jokers) and Shaun Johnson (The Johnson Files) to create an outstanding Shakespearean comedy. Watch as Murr becomes host Casey Jost's puppet and must do and say whatever he tells him to.

items.title: Never Happy Again
items.description: The Show Offs create a contemporary musical on the spot with Shaun Johnson and Kelly Lohman. When Carl (Jake Van Wagoner) falls in love with a stranger in the park (Lisa Valentine Clark), he'll go to any lengths to find her again.

items.title: The Handbiters
items.description: The Show Offs join forces with Kirby Heyborne (BYUtv's Making Good). Watch as they create a classic film-noir plot while host Casey Jost makes the cast speak in different accents, sing songs, and even perform a dance number.

items.title: The First Pizza Delivery Boy
items.description: Special guest Alex Boyé joins the Show Offs in a modern-day musical. The cast creates an exciting adventure chronicling a pizza-delivery boy’s journey from Italy to America. Tom Quinn also guest stars.

items.title: Doctor Space
items.description: Along with special guests Corbin Bleu (High School Musical) and Jake Suazo, the Show Offs create a science fiction musical where Bleu and Hailey Smith ace off against the dark leader of the galaxy (Suazo) and his bumbling son (Jake Van Wagoner).

items.title: The Grass is Always Greener
items.description: The Show Offs go contemporary with this version of a Broadway musical. Joined by guests Adam Johnson and Sarah Cornell, the cast launches into a long history between two best friends turned enemies.

items.title: Forgotten Boots
items.description: The Show Offs and guests Kelly Lohman and Will Rubio (Random Acts) improvise a very British comedy. As the lord and lady of Thunderbird Manor challenge each other to an opposite day where they each have to take over the other's household duties.

items.title: No Veggies in Sight
items.description: The Show Offs perform a Golden Age musical with guests Adam Johnson and Jake Suazo. A movie star and his manager ask a hot dog vendor to point them in the direction of available women they can meet.

items.title: No Service in Knownstown
items.description: The Show Offs and guests Tom Quinn and Sarah Cornell improvise a Spaghetti Western. An evil cattle baron vows to take over the town, but two people stand in his way. Saddle up with the Show Offs as they showdown at sundown in this episode.

items.title: Shenanigans in the Castle
items.description: The Show Offs take on the fantasy genre with special guests Kelly Stables (Superstore, The Exes) and Will Rubio (Random Acts). Jake is an evil wizard that has released a terrible dragon to terrorize the land.

items.title: Midnight Sunrise
items.description: Ice-dancing rock stars, a kidney transplant, and the chance of a lifetime: NSYNC's Joey Fatone joins the Show Offs for a wildly original rock opera adventure. Jack Suazo also guest stars.

items.title: Cheery Days
items.description: The Show Offs and guests Shaun Johnson and Will Rubio improvise a Golden Age musical in which two swindlers have a change of heart after trying to replace authentic cheer with artificial joy. Turns out you can't buy happiness!

items.title: I Love Sandwiches
items.description: Join the sandwich revolution! In this completely improvised rock opera, Lazy Sue has her mind blown when she tries a new type of sandwich. PB and J, this is your day! Jake Suazo and Shaun Johnson guest star with the Show Offs.

items.title: Galaxy Next Door
items.description: Darius's space wife threatens to banish him to a faraway galaxy unless he can travel to earth and retrieve an ottoman. It's the sci-fi musical of the century, starring the Show Offs and special guests Carrie McCrossen and Sarah Cornell.

items.title: Toucheth Me Not
items.description: A beautiful queen fleeth to Italy to escape her suitors. Shakespearean plights and poisonous snake bites reveal true intentions and secret loves. With guest stars Tom Quinn and Sarah Cornell.

items.title: High School Planes
items.description: In this modern Broadway musical, Persephone makes new friends in Mrs. Willis' art class after sharing her incredible model airplanes. Get ready for High School Musical, the improv way! Lauren Pritchard and Sarah Cornell guest star.

items.title: Starvation Planet
items.description: In a galaxy far from Earth, an admiral and his trusty robot seek the help of a daring chef to save their starving planet. Shaun Johnson and John Rhys-Davies (The Lord of the Rings trilogy, Raiders of the Lost Ark) guest star.

items.title: All in a Row
items.description: Get your spurs, 'cuz this improv Western is rarin' to go. Peter steals a prize duck in hopes of impressing Eliza, but Wolfmeister Malone strikes first. Kelly Lohman and Jake Suazo join the Show Offs as special guests.

items.title: It's Raining Fur
items.description: To stop a small-town realtor from selling to a new couple, Trevor and Penelope hatch a plan involving flying cats and lonely llamas. This hilarious Broadway-style improv will have you laughing till you cry. Kelly Lohman and Jordan Coleman guest star.

items.title: Hungry for Something
items.description: Guitars, drums, and bass feed the soul in this improv rock opera. Kaylee must choose between Ricky the jock or Kyle, the mysterious new kid. What is she to do? Shaun Johnson and Will Rubio (Random Acts) guest star with the Show Offs.

items.title: Mistletoe Miracle
items.description: Will Forte (SNL, The Last Man on Earth) guest stars. In this never-before-seen musical, Barnaby is worried about providing for his large family, especially after an impulsive Christmas shopping spree. Matt Cook also guests stars.

items.title: Desserts in the Wind
items.description: Will Rubio (Random Acts) and Carrie McCrossen guest star. When a pudding bar at a wedding turns up some cynical characters, even the bride and groom wonder if love can save the day. It's improv comedy at its most delicious!

items.title: The Rose and the Buffoon
items.description: As this fairy tale goes, an elf in love with a human is desperate to save his forest and win his true love. Tom Quinn and Abel Arias guest star in this hilarious improv romance.

items.title: Pride and Reptiles
items.description: In this improv Regency masterpiece, warring nobles seek to control the newly imported alligator population. Prepare for delightful intrigue perfect for fans of Pride and Prejudice or Downton Abbey. Lea Thompson (Back to the Future) guest stars.

items.title: Dumpster Diving for Love
items.description: In cold New York City, Brandeen is a lonely pet shop owner who considers selling her shop after she unexpectedly falls in love. Tom Quinn and Lauren Pritchard guest star in this never-before-seen rom-com.

items.title: Don't Laugh at My Pain
items.description: Barnum hesitates to take over his father's business, but when he discovers that he has a sister he never knew about, he heads out to find her so they can run the business together. Don Lake and Tom Quinn guest star in this hilarious Broadway musical.

items.title: Evergreen Manor
items.description: Nancy's true love has finally come home from the circus, but Nancy's father is opposed to the match. Jake Suazo and Kelly Lohman guest star in this improv Regency romance.

items.title: The Third Eclipse
items.description: Join the Show Offs and guest stars Aliza Pearl and Jake Suazo on a boisterous improv musical. A centaur must prevent an eclipse from happening.

items.title: Flight of the Trucks
items.description: Matt Cook and Lauren Pritchard guest star in a fantastical, musical improv comedy. Bethany is an aspiring witch who must defeat a swarm of magical trucks that wield wheels of fire.

items.title: Beyond Chairs
items.description: Two accountants, tired of their pencil-pushing lives, steal sailor uniforms and make their getaway. The Show Offs are joined by guest stars Jake Suazo and Lauren Pritchard to produce this on-the-spot Golden Age musical.

items.title: Edge of the World
items.description: Weary space travelers must search for fuel to escape their current planet. Together, they must outsmart Crazy John, a man with an odd dual personality, to make their getaway plans a reality. With guest stars Aliza Pearl and Kelly Lohman.

items.title: Silent Night
items.description: A BYUtv Original Movie about the true story behind the most popular Christmas carol of all time. As a priest in Austria, Joseph Mohr was inspired by those he met in his ministry. Together with Franz Gruber, he spread God's word in song.

items.title: Silver Wolf
items.description: After a family tragedy forces him to move to the mountains, a teen rescues an injured wolf and together, they embark on a journey of friendship, courage, and second chances.

items.title: Dragonfly
items.description: Four teens--Louis, Kaz, Meg, and Glen--begin their mysterious journey when they stumble upon a strange artifact in the woods near the Silverpoint summer camp.

items.title: Fermi's Paradox
items.description: An abandoned cabin isn’t quite what it seems for Bea and Louis, while the mysterious rock reveals a new power to Meg and Glen.

items.title: 43 Seconds
items.description: After testing the rock's teleportation powers, Louis agrees to let Glen jump through the portal. But when Glen fails to appear back at camp, Team Dragonfly must find out where he went.

items.title: The Man in the Basement
items.description: Louis confesses his real reason for being at the camp to the rest of the group, leading the four a step closer towards unlocking the alien rock’s secrets.

items.title: Today We Vanish
items.description: After discovering what he thinks is a portal, Louis must convince the rest of Team Dragonfly to cross over with him to see what’s on the other side. Meg, however, has other plans.

items.title: Here There Be Monsters: Part 1
items.description: Feeling the pressure to find their missing friend, Kaz tasks Louis with getting Meg back. Meanwhile, something monstrous is lurking in the woods.

items.title: Here There Be Monsters: Part 2
items.description: With things becoming increasingly stranger and the camp under attack by a monster, Team Dragonfly must face some personal demons to save themselves and their friends.

items.title: Whatever Happened to Meg?
items.description: While Bea and Team Dragonfly try to make sense of their predicament, Kaz tries to run away, only to encounter an invisible barrier surrounding the camp.

items.title: This is the Way Our World Ends
items.description: As Bea and Team Dragonfly find some fun distractions in the alternate world, Bea realizes she was never meant to be there.

items.title: Detour
items.description: Sent into the past, Louis, Kaz, Glen, Bea and Louis discover that Meg is the only one who can bring them back to the present. Louis finally gets an answer to the mystery that brought him to Silverpoint.

items.title: The Silent, Strong Type
items.description: Fisher takes control of the alien rock. With no time to lose, Meg needs Finn, Alice and Elliot to join her on a mission to save her friends.

items.title: Someone Worth Saving
items.description: Kaz is still missing and the rest of Team Dragonfly feel uneasy about leaving the camp without her. Fisher has a proposal for Louis -- but can he be trusted?

items.title: Us Four Together Again
items.description: Having made it to the facility and discovered even more about the mysterious alien rock, a reunited Team Dragonfly seeks out the truth of what lies behind the red door.

items.title: Focus
items.description: Louis, Meg, Glen and Kaz discover they’re one of four groups, each with their own alien Artefact and part of a game to save the world.

items.title: Little Sister
items.description: Dragonfly discover a way into their rival’s alternative environment and learn more about how the alien game works. Emma begins to suspect that Greenfront can’t be trusted.

items.title: Don't You Forget Me
items.description: Feeling they’re in danger, Emma shares her night-time discovery with Maeve. Dragonfly know their friendship is at stake as they ally with Landslide and take on the first challenge.

items.title: One Door Closes, Another One Opens
items.description: As Glen joins Monika and Isabel to rig a TV and scan for news, Jay, Kaz and Louis get a nasty shock when they explore the spaceship. But Louis finds a clue to the aliens’ identity.

items.title: The Amnesia Girls
items.description: Back in the city, Bea McConnell makes contact with one of the losers of the first challenge. And, with Alice and Finn’s help, the four go in search of her missing friends.

items.title: Day 1
items.description: With the second challenge seemingly impossible, it’s left to Louis to find a solution. While frustration grows for Meg, as Jay and Kaz find an unlikely distraction in each other.

items.title: Lights Out
items.description: Certain Greenfront are hiding something, Louis, Glen, Monika, and Isabel stay up to see what happens after 1AM. And, with everyone else asleep, the truth finally reveals itself.

items.title: Special
items.description: With the news from the previous night still on everyone’s minds, an unexpected visitor shows up at the facility. While in the camp, Meg and Kaz find they’re stronger together.

items.title: Don't Touch
items.description: Allegiances are tested for Dragonfly when a new player joins the game. While the third challenge reveals the last of the Artefacts’ locations and something lurking in the shadows.

items.title: Headaches
items.description: With Louis in a bad way and his condition worsening, Meg blames herself. However, Kaz manages to buy them a little time and looks to Dragonfly’s past for a way to save him.

items.title: The Things We Did
items.description: Following Isabel’s advice, Bea gets a little closer than expected to the Artefacts. While a call for help from some old acquaintances sees Meg and the rest of Dragonfly reunited.

items.title: Time to Save the World
items.description: The shape-shifting alien has escaped and those left at the facility must face the fact that one of them is not who they say they are. Bea must decide who she can trust.

items.title: How I Wonder What You Are
items.description: Trapped on the spaceship, Dragonfly must decide to stay or fight, as the prospect of a life off-world looms closer. Back on earth, some important people have questions.

items.title: St. Louis: Oasis of Tolerance and Love

items.title: Season 10 Episode 1
items.description: After Dalton and Tori recruit Studio C’s new cast, Dalton plays every character in Dalton Abbey, Lin Manual Miranda has a new project on William Henry Harrison, soap opera actors take over a union meeting, and a prince climbs up Rapunzel’s hair.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 2
items.description: A bystander ruins a news broadcast, a V.O. artist can’t articulate a company slogan, a dying man tries to leave his dimwitted sons with a poignant message, Guy Fieri hunts for food in the south, and an animatronic Lincoln comes to life at Disneyland.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 3
items.description: A Say Yes to the Dress spoof features Lincoln, Bigfoot crashes a group of Bigfoot hunters, a mobster mistakes his bosses orders, a girl sings about love while having a heart attack, and a family band has trouble getting the audience to sing along.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 5
items.description: Sarah’s boyfriend meets her creepy sister. One girl escapes from a masked stranger. After being brought to life, Frankenstein is slammed with bills. The sense of smell can be very dangerous. A man plans to release the wolves he’s kept locked up.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 6
items.description: Dora the Explorer discovers dating apps. Sports drinks have unexpected results. The Today Show hosts both fail a personality test. Then, a volleyball team puts in their final player -- Sailor Moon. Finally, newsies discover the power of clickbait.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 7
items.description: A scientist laments his results. Two men realize dating is for the birds. A mom from takes over a YouTube channel. The press conference is worse than the disaster. Titanic survivors tell their tales of woe. A Home School Musical unites a family.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 8
items.description: Grandpa Joe reacts to Charlie’s golden ticket. Mary Poppins works in an office. Being one’s self proves dangerous. Chopin is performed via stylophone. Slick Rick raps about getting the girl. Summer love ends in the friendzone.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 9
items.description: Clark Kent struggles to meet his deadline, a group secretly dances to disco music, Clint Dilly blames legs for a woman’s missing husband, Roman senators plot to kill Caesar, a man watches a video before surgery and puberty shocks middle schoolers.

items.title: Season 10 Episode 10
items.description: A highly educational song about the mighty dung beetle. A not so motivational speaker. Thomas Edison’s greatest inventions. Strange meanings for common acronyms. Hansel and Gretel help the witch. A driving test doesn’t go as expected.

items.title: Season 10 Christmas Special
items.description: The Bachelor with Santa. The Grinch’s heart grows. Martha ruins a contest. Rudolph gets sued. Dancers wrap gifts. Santa gives gifts. A family fends off Kevin. A family is cramped. A family gives gifts. A man gets the moon. A school has a competition.

items.title: A Finnish Family Singalong
items.description: A family band from Finland perform their “fun song,” asking the audience to try and sing along. The father becomes increasingly irate with the audience’s as they have trouble trying to sing along to a song that is entirely in Finnish.

items.title: Acronym Mix Up
items.description: Roommates Mitchel, Joe, and Dale speak in Acronyms for everyday life. Only problem is their roommate, Garry, doesn’t understand the real life meaning behind each one. He confuses the definitions of simple Acronyms to the chagrin of his Room Mates.

items.title: Alec's Mom's Video Game Review
items.description: Sick in bed, Alec (Tanner Gillman) has no choice but to let his mom (Jetta Juriansz) make his online video game review for the day. This is a tour de force for Jetta, who becomes very animated when discussing a world she knows nothing about.

items.title: An Educational Song About the Dung Beetle
items.description: This is a highly educational song about the strongest animal on the planet - the dung beetle. Dressed in dung beetle costumes, the cast sings, dances and playfully interacts while teaching the audience interesting facts about the quirky dung beetle.

items.title: An Unscented Place
items.description: Shot in the style of A Quiet Place, An Unscented Place features a world in which the sense of smell is very dangerous. This world is plagued by vagueness, as the main characters struggle to tell whether they shouldn’t make a smell or be smelled.

items.title: Another Great Performance: Chopin’s Nocturne Opus 9 No. 2
items.description: Taking place in a formal concert hall, Garet Allen and Jessica Drolet perform Chopin’s Prelude in E minor. As Jessica is stationed before a grand piano, Garet is clad in a tuxedo and confidently pulls out his stylophone to captivate the audience.

items.title: Athlete Drink Sweat Commercial
items.description: This is a parody of the famous black and white Gatorade commercials that feature athletes working out and sweating different colors. In this commercial, Dalton Johnson recognizes that colored sweat isn’t normal and he begins to spiral out of control

items.title: Be Yourself
items.description: When Trent thinks it’s time for his girlfriend, Sara, to meet his parents, he encourages her to not be nervous and to just be herself. Taking this quite literally, Sara begins to unleash a multitude of secrets and peculiar quirks at the dinner table.

items.title: Beethoven's "Moonlight Sonata"
items.description: Wearing a tuxedo, Garet uses a melodica to play Beethoven’s “Moonlight Sonata”. He is accompanied by Jessica Drolet, who wears a formal gown and takes a seat behind the piano. The set is staged as if the two are performing at a high-brow concert.

items.title: Beware The Ides Of March
items.description: In an office setting, Roman Senators Cato, Brutus, and Cassius devise a plot to kill their boss, Caesar. Each time they commit to their plan, however, Caesar cheerily appears and gives the Senators a reason to question their decision to kill him.

items.title: Bigfoot
items.description: At the Bigfoot Field Research Organization, researchers explore leads on Bigfoot’s whereabouts. Although they appear to be looking high and low, one employee named Stanley (played by Garet Allen) is clearly Bigfoot yet somehow gets away with it.

items.title: Clickbait Newsies

items.title: Dad Driving Test
items.description: A soon to be father, finds out that there’s a strange new driving test for new parents. When the instructor, Darvin enters the car he gets in the back seat he puts Walton through tests like asking if, “we are there yet and throwing a tantrum.

items.title: Dalton Abbey
items.description: A parody of Downton Abbey in which all the iconic characters are played by Dalton Johnson in period costume. Taking place around the dinner table, this scene tests the main characters’ refined tastebuds when they’re served breakfast for dinner.

items.title: Diners, Drive-ins, and Dives!
items.description: A parody of the show Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives, this sketch follows Guy Fieri and his crew into the deep south along Guy’s quest for tasty food. After his go-to spots are closed or shut down, Guy Fieri has no choice but to follow locals to Momma’s.

items.title: Disco Addict
items.description: After storming out of his family’s home, Garet assembles his friends in an alley. What starts out as a sketchy situation turns into all four boys innocently dancing to Abba. When Garet’s parents find him, they join in and come together as a family.

items.title: Dora the Middle-Age Explorer
items.description: This parody of Dora the Explorer features Dora as a middle-aged, washed up woman who is still tethered to her identity as seen on Nickelodeon over thirty years ago. In this sketch, Dora asks her viewers to help her find a new boyfriend via a dating a

items.description: A man is on the verge of death when his three sons visit his hospital room for the last time. Realizing he doesn’t have much time left, the dying man struggles to relay his final words of profound wisdom to his dimwitted sons who just don’t get it.

items.title: Elevator Romance (Music Video)
items.description: Shot in the style of a music video, this sketch follows a girl who thinks she’s falling in love with a boy she locks eyes with in an elevator. In reality, she is actually experiencing the symptoms of a heart attack, causing their romance to take a tu

items.description: As lighting and bolts of electricity light up the background, Frankenstein’s monster is brought to life. Once awake, the monster is met by an unexpected visitor: the hospital orderly, who is equipped with a clipboard and a never ending list of bills.

items.title: Ghost Sister
items.description: When Sarah invites her boyfriend, Zach, over to meet her family, Sarah’s sister, Cornea, takes a special liking to him. Accompanied by creepy music and dancing, Cornea desperately attempts to steal Zach, who is falsely led to believe she’s a ghost.

items.description: A school hosts a Gingerbread House building competition for the Christmas. The judge for this event is New Jersey contractor, Tom Devlin. Tom takes his job seriously and judges the kid’s Gingerbread houses using OSHA regulations and by the book.

items.description: In a twist, on the classic fairy tale of Hansel and Gretel, the two children have been placed by the witch into a large cauldron. Everything goes off the rails when the two children start to question the Witch’s cooking abilities and home life.

items.description: A large family comes together to stay in a house for the Christmas holiday, only to find that the sleeping arrangements are few and far between. The Mother of the house tries to accommodate all of the family’s sleeping needs with little success.
