items.description: Miles and Marla, both competitive contenders in the sport of Ribbon Dancing and now gift wrappers at a local mall, ruin a customer’s day. The customer asks for them to wrap a simple sweater and add some ribbon and instead they give her a dance.

items.title: Peacocking
items.description: While at a club, Garet Allen and Arvin Mitchell watch the ladies swoon as Tanner walks by. As they discuss Tanner’s magnetic charm, the waiter uses the term ‘peacocking’. Misinterpreting this concept, they leave only to return as actual peacocks.

items.title: President Lincoln Gets Heckled
items.description: At the Great Moments with Mr. Lincoln attraction at Disneyland, the animatronic Lincoln is reprogramed to tell jokes and pick up on the audience’s disinterest. This prompts the robotic Lincoln to put one heckler in particular back in his place.

items.title: Press Conference
items.description: Timothy (Dalton Johnson), a man with limited social skills, is thrust into the spotlight as head of a press conference concerning an earthquake in the city. With limited experience and knowledge Timothy tries to dodge the reporter’s questions

items.title: Puberty
items.description: When Emily, Sarah and Becky return to school for their first day of seventh grade, they are excited to share the ways in which they’ve matured over the summer. Meanwhile, their male counterparts appear one by one and showcase the wonders of puberty.

items.title: Rapunzel's Prince Arrives
items.description: Trapped in a tower, Rapunzel tosses her hair out the window so that her Prince can climb up to her. From joyously swinging on her locks to bringing along his bowling balls and horse, the Prince unknowingly causes Rapunzel to be thrashed all around.

items.title: Release the Wolves
items.description: In a town that doesn’t embrace singing and dancing, Roustabout encourages the others to be themselves through music. However, when Ike Flitcraft’s character listens to Roustabout’s advice, he sings about releasing his pack of bloodthirsty wolves.

items.title: Rudolph Goes to Court
items.description: A holiday legal battle is underway with a twist on the classic Christmas song, Rudolph The Red Nosed Reindeer. Rudolph is being sued for defamation by the other reindeers for their negative portrayal in Rudolph’s song. They use a mediator to help.

items.title: Sailor Moon Volleyball
items.description: In this Sailor Moon parody, Tori Pence plays a volleyball player named Serena. While on the court, Serena “levels up” and behaves much like the main character in Sailor Moon. This sketch juxtaposes a normal sports game with the world of anime.

items.title: Santa Claus Breaks Curfew
items.description: On a quiet Christmas Eve night, at the Jefferson home, Santa repels down the chimney to deliver Christmas gifts to a family. While Santa is placing the presents under the tree, he is startled by an eight-year-old girl, full of questions, named Katie.

items.title: Smack That Child's Fat
items.description: During a recording session for popular slogans, the voice over artist has a hard time pronouncing the majority of the words and mumbles her way through the session. The man in charge grows frustrated as he gives her many chances to get it right.

items.title: Superman's Deadline
items.description: While stressing over his article for The Daily Planet, Clark Kent is paid a visit by Wonder Woman, who vocalizes that Brainiac is attacking and Metropolis is in danger. Needing his help, all the superheroes work together to meet Superman’s deadline.

items.title: Surgery Prep Goes Wrong
items.description: Prior to getting his appendix removed, Frank is told he must watch a short educational video that will walk him through his procedure. The video, which features an unconscious patient and Dr. Celburn, depicts a very graphic and cringe-worthy surgery.

items.title: The DM Slide!
items.description: When Billy and David seek help talking to girls, Slick Rick pays them a visit. Clad in a fedora and track suit, Slick Rick insists that sending DMs is the best move. In the context of a rap, Slick Rick outlines how to properly do the DM slide.

items.title: The Friendzone Song
items.description: A la the song “Summer Nights” from Grease, Mandy and Donnie sing about their love story. Unfortunately, they are not on the same page at all. Mandy believes Donnie is one of her best friends whereas Donnie is hopeful they share something romantic.

items.title: The Grinch's Heart Grows Too Big
items.description: In a Holiday parody of, “Dr. Seuss’ The Grinch Who Stole Christmas,” The Grinch (Tanner Gillman) finds himself in a boat load of trouble, on the top of Mount Crumpit, after his heart grows three sizes in an instant and triggers a major heart attack.

items.title: The Today Show
items.description: In this Today Show parody, Kathie Lee and Hoda welcome Professor Jackson onto the show to talk about psychology. After an interview filled with inside jokes, tambourines, and random dancing, he concludes they possess some psychopathic tendencies.

items.title: The Union Meeting of Plumbers, Pipe Fitters, and Soap Opera Actors
items.description: At a standard union meeting for plumbers, pipe fitters and soap opera actors, the union leader loses control when the soap opera actors usher in their drama. From dramatic music cues to smashed glasses, this union meeting quickly goes off the rails.

items.title: The World’s Fair with Thomas Edison
items.description: At the 1893 world’s fair in Chicago, “The Wizard or Menlo park,” Thomas Edison, shows a crowd of onlookers several of his greatest inventions. He the phonograph the lightbulb, and film projector to a range of insane reactions from the crowd.

items.title: Titanic Lifeboat Leaves Husbands Behind
items.description: After the Titanic sinks, a group of women on a lifeboat pontificate over what they lost on the ship, including their husbands. As they go on about missing their stranded husbands, it becomes clear that they don’t actually want their husbands to retur

items.title: VHS: Allenn
items.description: Allenn is single right now, but lots of women are interested.

items.title: VHS: Bill Bucks
items.description: Bill is a lonely guy looking for a girl to take to the bank.

items.title: VHS: Chelly F.
items.description: Chelley is looking for Bob. And basketball tickets.

items.title: VHS: Dane
items.description: Dane is not hiding that he’s a romantic guy who shines bright.

items.title: VHS: Ezekiel Browngoat
items.description: Ezekiel is a successful businessman in need of a wife.

items.title: VHS: Linda Willis
items.description: Linda Willis is looking to exercise her heart and fall in love.

items.title: VHS: Marguy Hairs
items.description: Marguy Hairs is a confident woman who loves horses.

items.title: VHS: Marvin
items.description: Marvin is looking for a dog lover with most of her teeth.

items.title: VHS: Sherry Tillberry
items.description: Sherry Tillberry is hunting for the one. And a shoulder to cry on.

items.title: VHS: Steven Oligarch
items.description: Steven’s hair may not be real, but his love is.

items.title: White Elephant Gift Exchange
items.description: A tense family finds itself in hot water when they come together for the holiday tradition of giving white elephant gifts to each other. They all argue about everything from the rules of the game to whether or not a re-gift count as an actual gift.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 1
items.description: An appendix fights with other organs of the body. Two inflatable tube men argue. Mr. Science blows up a volcano experiment. A music video goes all wrong. A carjacker learns how to drive a stick shift. Peter Jackson loses control of his unruly cast.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 2
items.description: A courtroom puts kissing on trial. A college student fights Hungar. A customer drives a grocery clerk nuts. A hedge fund manager performs slam poetry. A sandwich shop employee has high expectations for her customers.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 3
items.description: A ghost hunter finds a Revolutionary War ghost. A middle schooler appears on a cooking show. Belle is startled by the enchanted objects in Beast’s castle. Apple announces a high-performance battery. JoJo Siwa crashes a slumber party.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 4
items.description: Come on out to an old-fashioned hoedown. Brace yourself for a dramatic look at life on the prairie. Get caught up in a magic show with the finest magician and assistant. Join a family on a road trip. And test your mothering knowledge.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 5
items.description: The stakes are high, leading one ballroom dancer to lose control. Then, The Wright Brothers take control of the sky, and the patrons of the sky in a historical documentary.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 6
items.description: Sometimes everything just goes wrong. A restaurant can’t get an order right. Sherlock can’t talk to women. Teens attempt to rewrite Shakespeare. Millennials can’t escape a room. And two couples question their communication skills.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 7
items.description: A breakroom is home to cryogenically frozen heads. A man tries to liven up a funeral with a game of Twister. An alarm clock keeps users from snoozing. A bride meets a wedding guest. An office is run by puppet leaders. A crime scene is ruined.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 8
items.description: A sitcom is filmed in front of an audience of dogs. Lassie debates conspiracy theories. The great and powerful Oz is Dr. Oz. Scooby Doo is the real monster. Red Riding Hood’s words are her defense. Cruella Deville’s henchmen are not up to the job.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 9
items.description: A rocket malfunction strands two astronauts. A medieval tournament is won by a unique knight. A wedding bouquet toss gets awkward for one woman. The cast addresses fan theories regarding cast relationships. A tribute to the show’s crew.

items.title: Season 11 Episode 10
items.description: A murder trial is derailed by the lawyer. A pirate doesn’t speak pirate. An automatic bathroom malfunctions. Every romantic movie cliché interrupts a proposal. Out of money, Garet and Matthew perform their sketch.

items.title: Belle & the Enchanted Objects
items.description: Belle stumbles upon an enchanted castle, where she meets… a comfort pillow? All the other enchanted objects are tired of Comfort Pillow, believing she has no real worth in the castle. But when Beauty gets mad at Beast, he only wants Comfort Pillow.

items.title: Boss Puppet
items.description: In a typical office conference room Terri, Kim, and Glenn file in and take their seats. Their boss, Jean, enters and explains to them that they will have a new supervisor. Jean reaches into her briefcase and removes a puppet wearing a power suit.

items.title: Car Jacking
items.description: A carjacker approaches a driver and steals his keys. The carjacker’s plans are soon thwarted, however, as he realizes he can’t drive a stick shift. But no worries; the owner of the car teaches him everything he needs to know on how to drive the car.

items.title: Celebrate Restaurant
items.description: Two women go over the details of a merger at an American restaurant. Things goes awry when the wait staff sings and celebrates every time the two start to get into their work. They celebrate everything from birthdays, Promotions at work, and more.

items.title: Checkout
items.description: A swindling customer puts the patience of a checkout clerk, of a small grocery store, to the test by trying to get free lollipops every time he goes through the checkout line. He comes at her with every character in his wheelhouse.

items.title: Cooking Show
items.description: A bickering, elderly, brother & sister cooking duo (named Mary Mae and Willy) host a home cooking show called “Kicking It in The Taste Buds” from a television studio. They constantly argue and fight with each one ending in, “I’m through with you!”

items.title: Crew Song
items.description: Things go off the rails when Studio C cast members, Ike Flitcraft and Jetta Juriansz, write and perform a song to celebrate the people who work behind the scenes on the show. The song starts off well until they have to say the crew member name.

items.title: Crime Scene
items.description: Two policemen and a crime scene investigator examine the scene of a murder. Against the investigator’s demands, the policeman absentmindedly move furniture, sweep up glass, wipe off countertops, and play hopscotch on the chalk outline of the body.

items.title: Dog Henchmen
items.description: Two tough as nails and dastardly henchmen for the evil, animal loathing, Cruella Deville, meet with their boss on a cold, London shipping marina. Cruella instructs them to dispose of some crates into the ocean, an “easy” until they look in the crate.

items.title: Dr. Oz
items.description: Two shows from different eras collide in this parody of Dr. Oz and The Wizard of OZ. Dorthey from Kansas, Scarecrow, The Cowardly Lion, and Toto, find themselves guests on Dr. Oz’s live television show. They try to get help but the Dr. won’t help.

items.title: Fighting Hungar
items.description: A college student is asked to donate a dollar towards what he believes is fighting hunger. But he quickly finds out that by doing so, he unknowingly agrees to fight Hungar (a burly man in a red leotard with a giant mustache) in a hidden fight club.

items.title: Future Pain
items.description: A Tech Engineer at Apple Inc. holds a conference to unveil their new high-performance battery. The battery works by using the human bodies’ own electro-magnetic field to charge all of the Apple devices (Watch, Phone, Laptops, ETC.).

items.title: Gatorade Coach
items.description: At the last fifteen seconds of a High-School Basketball championship game, a coach constantly interrupts, as well as annoys, his players, with his obsession of being drenched in Gatorade by his team when they win the final game.

items.title: Heads
items.description: At the Taylor Springs Cryogenics Lab, frozen heads (named CHUCK and BAXTER) live in a break room refrigerator. Chuck and Baxter both chose to be frozen Cryogenically but couldn’t afford the higher-priced packages so they chose the Economy Package.

items.title: High Tech Bathroom
items.description: Three women get trapped in an automated, Bathroom, where they have to deal with erratic automated equipment malfunctioning, such as, lights turning off and on randomly, automatic sinks not working, and even being shot at by mint dispensers.

items.title: Hitchhiker
items.description: A fun and fancy-free suburban family, on a road trip, picks up a suspicious hitchhiker who has escaped from the local penitentiary. When a Mom, Dad, their young son Ethan, and Grandma help where they can until an escaped convict tests that system.

items.title: Hoedown
items.description: Buckle up your rodeo belts, put on your best boots, and come on out to a good-old-fashioned, Studio C Hoedown! Starring the Jensen Family band! When a couple, out on a date at a Hoedown, the dance takes a turn for the worse when they can’t keep up.

items.title: Inflatable Tube Men
items.description: There is tension between wacky inflatable tube men because one of them, Red, dated Blue’s sister, Tubealina. As they argue a gust of wind blows them around, a wild bird tries to attack and kill them, and Janitors try to deflate them. Will they live?

items.title: Inspirational Subway
items.description: When a Man falls off of the subway platform and into the path of an oncoming subway train, he is held hostage by his good Samaritan, a woman with only positive affirmations to help. The Woman tries to help, to no avail, by opening a book of quotes.

items.title: JoJo Siwa
items.description: Three friends, (Janessa, Kimmy, and Jill) at a sleep over party, get more than they bargained for when they play Jo-Jo-Siwa. If you say Jo-Jo Siwa into a mirror three times the teen internet star shows up and brands you with her merch and bad music.

items.title: King Henry VII
items.description: Shot in the style of The Newlywed Show, this sketch features King Henry VIII and his many wives. Known for his cut throat demeanor and constant rotation of wives, King Henry VIII does not tolerate any wrong answers from his wives on this gameshow.

items.title: Lassie
items.description: Timmy falls into a deep well and instructs Lassie to run home and get Pa to help him out of the well. Lassie finds Pa, but Pa believes Lassie is debating with him about various conspiracy theories in lieu of taking him to rescue Timmy.

items.title: Let's Get All The Kissing Out of the Way
items.description: Buckle up, strap in, and get ready for the Studio C sketch of your life. We’ve read the date and studied the algorithms and we know what the audience wants from Studio C, and that, is Kissing. Whenever a cast member kisses the audience responds.

items.title: Live Alarm Clock
items.description: Live Alarm Clock is the perfect replacement for your regular alarm clock. This service will send a live person to wake you up in the morning, whether that be a burly man in tattoos, a loving mother, bonding father, or even a twerpy baby brother.

items.title: Lord of the Rings Table Read
items.description: At a first table read for The Lord of The Rings series, several actors make interesting character choices. New Zealand native director, Peter Jackson introduces all of the different actors including Sir Ian McKellen and Elijah Wood.

items.title: Magic is a Sham
items.description: When Josh is rejected from “The Jeffers’ institute of Illusion” he takes revenge on the owner by exposing him as a fraud on YouTube using software he calls, “Alaka-Sham.” Josh posts online showing several of Martin Jeffers’ trademarked Illusions.

items.title: Magician's Assistant
items.description: Everything goes wrong when a Magician’s Assistant goes off the path and messes up the entire act. The Magician tries and fails to do the disappearing dove trick, the appearing pole trick, and fails to make his assistant disappear.

items.title: Meet Cute
items.description: Harry plans to propose to his long-time girlfriend Mary, every romantic movie cliché tries to stop him. In a city Park, Harry tries to ask Mary to be his wife. Only to find a classically handsome man named Brad runs into her instead.

items.title: Millennial Escape Room
items.description: Escape rooms are all the rage now a days for dates and group hang outs. There are several different themed rooms and games to play with each escape room. But, have you ever heard of a millennial escape room? These Millennials find out the hard way.

items.title: Mom Game Show
items.description: Welcome to the gameshow “Causes and Cures!” Where they take three contestants from different parts of the world and ask them questions. The contestants are Rosamaria from Oaxaca, Mexico, Olga rom Bratsk, Russia, and Mare from Minneapolis, Minnesota.

items.title: No Mo' Money
items.description: Studio C is out of money. But that doesn’t stop cast members, Garet Allen and Matthew Galvan, from putting on the sketch they wrote. Using only the two actors they act out every character, action, and scene about a family torn apart by two lovers.

items.title: Numb Dance
items.description: Two ballroom dancers join a tango competition to find one of the dancers has a medical condition that causes him to faint like a goat when he is stressed. The competition starts out fine until it’s revealed random body parts on one dancer freeze up.

items.title: One Shot Music Video
items.description: A band attempts to make a music video in just one take. Disaster after disaster occurs as no redos or cuts results in comedic mess-ups. They run into wardrobe mishaps, paint spills, treadmill accidents, broken couches, and even drums setting on fire.

items.title: Organ Song
items.description: Like the “Dung Beetle Song” the show singers take on the human body in The Organ Song. The Brain, the lungs, the heart, the liver, the kidneys, and the Appendix all march out to talk about their individual roles. The Appendix wants to be the star.

items.title: People Person
items.description: At the Sandwich Palace, the servers are required to ask customers, “How are you today?” But when none of the customers respond back to Sandwich Palace employee, Patti, she “Loses her buttons.” She’s upset that no one cares about her or feelings.

items.title: Peter Pan
items.description: Reprising her role as Peter Pan for the first time in 38 years it's Broadway legend, Georgia Clifford. This time she’s performing at the Benton, Idaho Community Theatre. Georgia’s old-style performance throws off the whole production.

items.title: Pictionary
items.description: When two couples Harper, Ben, Angelica, and Kent settle down to play Pictionary against one another one couple gets jealous of the other’s chemistry with each other. It seems like Angelica and Kent are always in synchronization with each other.

items.title: Pirate Talk
items.description: In the Captain’s Quarters of a Pirate ship, a dying Captain speaks with his first mate, Bart. The Captain calls for Bart to tell him he is sick and dying. He then gives Bart a map to his greatest treasure, only to find that it’s not a very clear map.

items.title: Planet Workout World
items.description: A technical mishap causes two astronauts to explore a Planet unlike anything they’ve ever seen called, “Planet Workout World.” The astronauts go about taking land samples, atmosphere readings, and in doing so they show a parody of gym culture.

items.title: Real Housewives of the Prairie
items.description: Parodying a reality TV show, this program gives a special glimpse into the community and lives of five women on the prairie. Tensions rise during a breakfast meetup as a result of butter, eating earwax, and dead husbands.

items.title: Red Riding Hood
items.description: In a parody of the fairy tale Red Riding Hood, The Big Bad Wolf gets his feelings hurt. When Little Red Riding Hood enters her Grandmother’s house, she finds The Big Bad Wolf in her place instead. She asks him personal questions and offends The Wolf.

items.title: Relationship Tango
items.description: An extravagant song and dance number featuring the entire Season 11 Cast of Studio C dramatically dancing and singing to the Habanera from Carmen. The song speculates about which Studio C cast members are in relationships with other cast members.

items.title: Revolutionary Ghost
items.description: A ghost has been haunting and the Homeowner hires a Ghost Hunter. He uses a device to draw out the spirit of a Revolutionary General named, Reginald York III. He is disappointed to find out the British lost the war and that his death was suspicious.

items.title: Rich Guy Slam Poetry
items.description: In a hip beatnik lounge, a slam poetry competition is underway. The contestants, Matthew, a seasoned bohemian slam poet, and Bradley Wilson the Fifth, an amateur slam poet and one per-center, compete to see who has the best skills in the club.

items.title: Scooby Doo
items.description: Crook scared straight by supernatural Scooby-Doo. Oblivious Mystery Gang misses the clues about their pet. Is Scooby secretly a cryptid canine? Stranger things keep happening with Scooby-Doo, and finally the bad guy begs to be taken into custody.

items.title: Shakespeare
items.description: The Casper High School presentation of Shakespeare’s greatest hits like the world has never seen before. The programs have “Fire emojis” and Shakespeare has gold chains. The students have decided to put on a contemporary version of the play.

items.title: Sherlock Flirt
items.description: Sherlock Holmes meanders around a cafe, hoping to talk to any one of the lovely women there. Using his brilliant powers of deduction, he analyzes each girl before approaching. Though he tries out different opening lines, each girl turns him down.

items.title: Shoe In My Meal
items.description: Jeff and friends go out to eat. Jeff’s water has ice in it after he asked for it without. He is too timid to say something and receives backlash from his friends. After Jeff’s spaghetti comes out with a boot in it, things have finally gone too far.

items.title: Sir Humphrey
items.description: Sir Humphrey competes at a tournament where he tries out a new form of chivalry which he calls “being emotionally present.” He talks to his opponents about their true feelings. He teaches everyone in the kingdom how to be emotionally vulnerable.

items.title: Sitcom for Dogs
items.description: The Randolph Family, which is filmed in front of a live studio Audience of dogs. The show’s topics have to do with chasing away the mailman, howling when someone plays the piano, and all howling in delight when they hear that a cat got ran over.

items.title: Time Travel
items.description: The Military has a new way to travel through time. An old woman named Aunt Bibbs, who can slap anyone into the middle of next week. When Frank Jordan mouths off to his Aunt Bibbs it’s revealed that she has the power to slap people back in time.

items.title: Too Many Southern Lawyers
items.description: Jackie waits for her lawyer. When he arrives, it turns out that he is an “old southern lawyer.” When the judge tries to intervene, another Southern Lawyer shows up to complain about the heat. More lawyers show up sending the courtroom into disarray.

items.title: Twister
items.description: A man, at a funeral, interrupts the mourners when he tries to get a game of Twister going between everyone there. The man is desperate to put, as he says, “the fun in funeral,” by ordering pizza, launching confetti canons, and hiring a gorilla.

items.title: Wright Brothers
items.description: In a parody of educational photo-documentary films, Studio C presents: The Wright Brothers. This documentary follows Orville, Wilbur, and the lesser known Everette Wright, who fell through the ice as a child. He invents the TSA.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 1
items.description: Dalton is kidnapped. The Style Gurlz try to kick Julian out of the band. A cooking show's secret ingredient is explosive. And DMV patrons try to register their "trucks."

items.title: Season 12 Episode 2
items.description: A teen's is transformed by braces. Actors learn to expect geese on set. One boy band member is not crushable. Bryson Brunson, Wayne Brady's Comedy IQ winner, guest stars.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 3
items.description: A mascot clumsily fires a t-shirt gun at himself before a cheering crowd and concerned announcers. When an angel arrives to take him to heaven, Ron realizes his pants are unzipped and he is mortified.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 4
items.description: At Halloween, nothing is as it seems on Studio C. A bed and breakfast loses its charm. One man believes his mattress is evil; another battles a leaf blower. A woman celebrates her birthday. A man walks into a murder mystery.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 5
items.description: A paperboy and a milk delivery girl team up. A messenger is easily distracted from delivering news. An actor doesn't understand green screens. A wedding party gets carried away decorating the car. A psychology instructor gets dramatic.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 6
items.description: The president test the limits of his power. The Shmandrew Sisters are exhausted from their tour. A kid on a bike shows off for some unfortunate passersby. Love overcomes all, including airport security. An actor refuses to ride horses.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 7
items.description: Tourists meet performers on the subway. An emotional father officiates at his daughter's wedding. A detective refuses to let a witness give him information. Three family men are ready for a night out. A man dramatically quits his job.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 8
items.description: A weatherman gets rattled. An overly confident server trains a new employee. An appraiser destroys the value of everything. Army recruits don't understand their drill sergeant’s insults. An adult visiting his parents gets tucked into bed.

items.title: Season 12 Episode 9
items.description: An average guy's podcast changes the world. Blood donation becomes a competition. Copying a key is magical. Andrew Lloyd Webber writes an oddly specific show about eggs. Women at a business conference share their successes.

items.title: Season 12 Christmas Special
items.description: Complete with musical numbers, special guests, corporate sponsors, and a visit (or three) from the big man himself, Studio C presents a Christmas variety show replete with nostalgia and laughs.

items.title: 3ternity: Live in Concert
items.description: A fan is chosen to join her favorite band onstage. The boys sing romantic lyrics to her, but one band member gets in her face with a high pitched voice, ruining the moment. The fan finds out she also gets to have dinner with him after the show.

items.title: A Christmas Village
items.description: Pamela comes home from Christmas shopping to a demanding family. She looks longingly at her perfect ceramic Christmas village, and wishes she lived there. Suddenly, she is there singing and dancing about her perfect life.

items.title: ASPCA Commercial
items.description: In this parody of Sarah MacLachlan's ASPCA Christmas ads, Sarah once again tugs at viewers' heartstrings with a moving plea for homeless animals, but she quickly loses her cool as her canine costars prove more rambunctious than she'd anticipated.

items.title: Antiques Roadshow
items.description: On an episode of the PBS classic Antiques Roadshow, Terry, an appraiser, starts accidentally dropping and breaking the priceless antiques she's examining. The show's guests are horrified as she destroys their newly-valued and expensive possessions.

items.title: Back to You
items.description: As the weatherman finishes up his report, he sends the viewers’ back to anchor Nancy by saying, “Back to you.” This continues through the various newscasters, each one reporting there is nothing to report and saying, “Back to you.”

items.title: Bed and Breakfast with Igor / The Innkeeper
items.description: Igor is a caretaker at a bed and breakfast. Yet, his misshapen appearance and morbid topics of conversation are a bit disturbing to the guests. Ironically, he finds some of the guests’ behavior equally disturbing, but for vastly different reasons.

items.title: Ben Franklin Supercut
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Boyz Night
items.description: It is “Boyz Night” when three friends get together, watch the game, and hang out. But, we soon see that the Boyz are actually dedicated family men, and each of them take turns responding to the various family needs that arise.

items.title: Braces
items.description: In a high school lunchroom, a nerdy girl breaks into song celebrating that she has more game now that she has braces. As the nerdy girl sings her song through the hallways of the school, the boys appreciate different things about her tinsel teeth.

items.title: Bridal Party Entrance
items.description: A bridal party plans an elaborate dance for their wedding entrance. But every time they begin parading down the aisle of the church, someone makes a minor mistake and they have to restart. The guests and Grandma, meanwhile, are getting impatient.

items.title: Captain Hook
items.description: Captain Hook captures Peter Pan and Wendy, but he's horrified to learn that they've named him after the accident where he lost his hand and gained a hook. Instead of making them walk the plank, he gives them a lecture on being considerate of others.

items.title: Chopped: Hand Grenade
items.description: In this parody of the hit series Chopped, three chefs are given a basket with an unexpected secret ingredient, a live hand grenade! Just as the meal on the chopping block is revealed, they realize a pin has been pulled and used as a garnish.

items.title: Clue Dun-It
items.description: An unsuspecting man brings a two liter of soda to a friend’s party, but he is at the wrong house, and every time the lights turn off, someone else is killed. The wacky residents refuse to call the police just like in the famous game and movie, Clue.

items.title: Cold Heart
items.description: On a very cold night, Ellie and Bennet are walking on a romantic bridge. Bennet tells Ellie that the bridge is the spot where they met, and he has an important question to ask her. Unfortunately, by the time Bennet proposes, Ellie is frozen stiff.

items.title: Cowboy Dutch
items.description: In 1937, after being repeatedly trampled by his horse, a star cowboy actor refuses to work with horses, forcing the studio to find a creative solution for creating westerns without actual horses.

items.title: Creepy Old Janitor
items.description: Two kids solving an old mystery are interrupted by a creepy old janitor with a maniacal laugh. He hints that he knows about the case, but each time they ask he gives them irrelevant information. The exasperated kids give up and leave the library.

items.title: Dad Officiates
items.description: Dad is excited to perform his daughter's wedding ceremony, but he's so emotional about his little girl getting married that he starts delaying the ceremony and repurposing the groom's wedding vows to declare his own paternal love for the bride.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: A milk delivery girl gently delivers her milk bottles. Then, a paperboy appears with a bicycle built for two and invites her to continue her deliveries with him. Together they toss their products to complete their deliveries, with disastrous results.

items.title: Detective Doesn't Want Specifics
items.description: A detective investigating an arson sits down to interview the sole eyewitness, but his confidence is so high that he refuses to let her give him any descriptive details or relevant information. Instead, he insists that he can sniff out the perp.

items.title: Dissection
items.description: A science lab is derailed as the students accidentally dissect frogs instead of building baking soda volcanos. Frustrated, the teacher goes to the front of the class to do an example experiment, but his volcano somehow ends up spouting small frogs.

items.title: Diva Dalton / Style Gurlz
items.description: The Style Gurlz confront their diva lead dancer, Julian, about his attitude problem and try to kick him out of the group. But Julian's magnetic dance moves keep making them rethink their decision as he shows off his stuff in choreographed routines.

items.title: Don't Get on That Plane
items.description: In a classic rom-com climax, a man runs after a woman to the airport to confess his love. But the moment is interrupted by airport employees who threaten to arrest the man for breach of security, only to have their hearts softened by true love.

items.title: Drill Sergeant
items.description: A drill sergeant tries to shape up a batch of new recruits by yelling insults at them. However, the optimistic recruits take every insult as a compliment, thanking him profusely for calling them ladies, babies, dirt, scum, and other intended insults.

items.title: Eggs! The Musical
items.description: In this commercial, we get a peek at Andrew Lloyd Webber's latest show: Eggs! The Musical. Set on a post-apocalyptic farm, the show features dramatic dance numbers and songs inspired by Webber's greatest hits, all performed by a cast of giant eggs.

items.title: Extras Workshop
items.description: Four aspiring actors attend a workshop meant to train them on how to be a film extra. Rather than blending into the background, the instructor aims to help them steal scenes by always expecting and over reacting to the presence of a goose on set.

items.title: First Time Green Screen
items.description: Sir Malcolm, a classically trained British stage actor, is thrilled to star in his first big Hollywood blockbuster. But, to the director's dismay, he has never worked with a green screen and gets carried away inventing new, invisible characters.

items.title: Flash Mob
items.description: An overenthusiastic high school drama teacher plans a flash mob with her students at a local mall. When the school bus breaks down and only three students show up, she tries to get the other mall patrons invested in their quiet, awkward flash mob.

items.title: Goodnight from Mom and Dad
items.description: Twenty-eight-year-old William's parents have a hard time adjusting when he comes back to stay overnight in his childhood home. Despite his increasing protests, they insist on following the same bedtime rituals they did when he was a little kid.

items.title: Handphone
items.description: During a Studio C writing session, the cast jokingly speaks to each other over handphones. The situation turns dire as Tanner receives a handphone call that Dalton has been kidnapped. The Cast works together to trace the call and rescue their friend.

items.title: Honest Lexus Commercial
items.description: In a Christmas car commercial, a man decides to give his wife the gift of a shiny new Lexus. But when his wife gets outside to see her Christmas surprise, she is furious that he sold their old car for an expensive new one without even talking to her.

items.title: I Quit
items.description: When his boss asks him to work on Saturdays, Rob dramatically quits and walks out. But the effect of this exit is undercut when he needs to come back into the room to grab his jacket, have someone call his phone, and even discuss a severance package.

items.title: Iconic Subway Performers
items.description: A group of subway performers hype up their audience for an act. They are interrupted by each stop and are joined by more performers, starting over. The confused crowd gets fed up and chases the performers off the train at the last stop.

items.title: Is It Up to Me?
items.description: The president consults with a general and advisor about whether or not he should sign an important treaty. But when he realizes that the ultimate decision is his, he decides to test his newfound power and see what other decisions are also up to him.

items.title: Issa Mistletoe
items.description: MC MJ Crush and J Frenzy drop a music video for their hip hop Christmas album. With a cozy fireplace backdrop, the duo raps We Three Kings, Jingle Bells, and Ball Out This Christmas. Santa and his elves dance as Crush and Frenzy sing Issa Mistletoe.

items.title: It's A Truck
items.description: A DMV clerk gets increasingly annoyed as a parade of back-country vehicle owners comes in to register what they describe as trucks, but actually ranges from modified motorcyles, to trucks sawn in half, to tipis with wheels, to George Foreman grills.

items.title: Kid on a Bike
items.description: A kid on a bike zooms past a couple, begging for their attention by showing off his no handed bike skills and bragging about his ten hour record. The couple wonders if their children will be as wild as this kid on a bike and admit they would be glad.

items.title: Leaf Blower vs. Clean Car / Leaf Me Alone
items.description: A man hears the the discordant sound of a leaf blower running in his neighborhood. It sounds nearby, and when he looks outside, he sees that his beautiful car is covered in debris. He takes the car to the car wash, and then the scene repeats itself.

items.title: Lessons in Psychology
items.description: A college psychology instructor walks into the first day of class ready to wow her students. But as she uses audience plants in one psychological bait and switch after another, the only two real students in the class just get increasingly confused.

items.title: Milk is a Fine Wine
items.description: When a couple gets engaged at a fancy restaurant, they decide to celebrate the occasion by splurging on the house's finest bottle...of milk. A sommelier, a neighboring couple, and a waitress get involved in finding the perfect vintage of aged 2%.

items.title: No More Nightmares
items.description: Percy, a posh Englishman, returns his mattress because he believes it was purposefully giving him bad dreams. As he tries to choose a replacement, he finds that all of the mattresses in the store are just as malicious and troublesome as the first.

items.title: Red Cross
items.description: While donating blood, Chester is competitive with another patient because he has a better blood type. Chester tries to race the other patient, pumping his fist to donate faster. Chester gets more angry, passes out, and the other patient helps him up.

items.title: Shmandrew Sisters, The
items.description: The Shmandrew Sisters, a World War II-era singing group similar to the Andrews Sisters, arrive in wartorn Italy for the latest stop on a grueling concert tour. But their act quickly degenerates into nonsense as they fall apart from lack of sleep.

items.title: Shy Kids at Holiday Show
items.description: An uptight theatre director presents her elementary school holiday show to an audience of adoring parents. But whenever the parents awwww, take photos, or wave at their kids, the theatre director shuts down the show to scream about theatre manners.

items.title: Starting a Podcast
items.description: When Mikey, an average twenty-something, tells his friends that he's starting a podcast about movies or something, the world reacts with overwhelming awe and amazement. Only Jakey questions why everyone is so impressed by Mikey's painfully dull plan.

items.title: The Keymaker
items.description: When Jeff goes to get a copy of a key, he’s surprised by an eccentric shop owner. Jeff gets tired of the Keymaker’s antics and dramatic flair, and the Keymaker makes the copy dejectedly. Feeling guilty, Jeff encourages the Keymaker and plays along.

items.title: The Messenger and the Prince
items.description: A messenger returns from the battlefield with news, but gets distracted. Each time he loses track, he gives long-winded apologies, frustrating the Prince. Finally, the Prince asks a yes or no question, and the messenger jumps out the window.

items.title: Timid Confident Server
items.description: While an overly confident server trains her new coworker, it becomes clear that he isn’t good at his job. He gets flustered taking orders, fumbles over his words, and knocks over tables, cups, and food. A customer pays him to leave them alone.

items.title: Too Many Party Santas
items.description: At a Christmas party, the kids are thrilled to see someone's dad arrive dressed up as Santa. But the parents forgot to coordinate among themselves, and when more and more dads dressed as Santa show up, the kids start to have a mental breakdown.

items.title: Unfinished Business
items.description: After Ron chokes on a grape and an angel arrives to take him to heaven, Ron realizes his pants are unzipped. He begs the angel to let him go back in his body to zip his pants so he won’t be embarrassed. The angel consents after much pleading.

items.title: Wedding Car
items.description: A wedding party gets carried away while decorating the bride and groom's car. They start by decorating the car with markers to show their love for the new couple, but it quickly escalates to breaking windows and crushing the car with a bowling ball.

items.title: Women Supporting Women
items.description: At a “Women in Business” conference, every speaker tells how she had a hard childhood, worked her way to the top, and bought herself a white Mercedes. The details become unbelievable. As the stories go on, the crowd and the speakers get out of hand.

items.title: Zombie Birthday / Employee of the Munch
items.description: Genetic scientist Tina frantically prepares to escape from the zombie apocalypse her company accidentally started in their lab. She's interrupted by Ronda, a clueless Karen type who thinks Tina's setting up for her own surprise birthday party.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 1
items.description: When jokes fail, a rescue begins. An executioner uses unconventional methods. Ezekiel Browngoat's success has brought regret. Two speed walkers demonstrate their athleticism. A baseball team uses hand signals. A ship captain tries to flee.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 2
items.description: Cupid gets his heart broken while hosting this special Valentine's episode of Studio C where strangers and friends interfere in relationships, romance fizzles, and sorrows are swallowed in pizza before laughter returns.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 3
items.description: A boy explains why he lives in a bird's nest. Uber offers lower fares with student drivers. The Tooth Fairy's daughter loses her first tooth. A spy jumps to conclusions at a robbery. A new boss becomes insecure.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 4
items.description: The Westminster Cat Show is a cat-astophe. A grandma likes being kidnapped. Maria teaches the Von Trapps. Fast food staff intervene. A screenwriter gets notes on her script. Cursed kids attend a party.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 5
items.description: Death comes for Ethel. A man's fridge stinks. Three kids compete in track. Rare footage of the first car accident. A coach wants a victory celebration. An artist puts himself into his work. A woman is excited by a change machine.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 6
items.description: An astronaut steps onto the Martian surface as the world awaits her first words. A city council meeting in Florida becomes extra chaotic when an unexpected visitor shares its concerns. A Jack-in-the-box terrorizes three cursed kids.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 7
items.description: Matthew and Tanner battle it out for the title of best hair on Studio C. Arvin pranks Dalton. An embattled spaceship crew tries every theoretical way to evade their enemies. New parents visit the hospital nursery for the first time.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 8
items.description: Guy Fieri rolls into town and faces off against an imposter claiming to be him. King Arthur and his squire seek an audience with the Lady of the Lake and get an unladylike surprise. Bob Ross has prunes on his mind and on his canvas.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 9
items.description: Cast members show where they find sketch ideas. A dad brings snakes to career day. A cop experiences an existential crisis. A dairy farmer becomes suspicious that his cows are trying to steal his identity. A kid is cyberbullied.

items.title: Season 13 Episode 10
items.description: A wild west folk ballad reveals the truth about the rugged frontier settlers in a town. Co-workers face off for the title of office funny guy. A producer and director are awestruck by an actor's audition.

items.title: Abandon Ship
items.description: Passengers on a ship wonder if the ship is sinking while the captain denies there is a problem. The captain devises ways to exit the ship wearing various disguises. Finally, the captain jumps off the side of the boat while they exit to the lifeboats.

items.title: Acting with the Wind
items.description: A producer and director search for the perfect actor for their show. An actor with amazing abilities entertains the two, and turns the audition into a believable romantic comedy although he is the one and only participant.

items.title: America the Beautiful
items.description: An American Pioneer poet begins to write an ode to the beautiful scenery that surrounds him. He is overcome with illness but continues to feverishly write rather outlandish and silly words to the tune of America the Beautiful.

items.title: Artist Puts Himself in Everything
items.description: Mr. and Mrs. Hilton eagerly await the expensive art they’ve commissioned, only to find that the artist has included himself in every painting. Bjarkn’s face appears on a pear in a still life and covers their daughter’s face in the family portrait.

items.title: Baseball Talk
items.description: Using only hand signals, a professional baseball team manages to discuss not only the next kind of pitch to be thrown, but also the details of the catcher's weekend plans and the previous episodes of a popular TV show.

items.title: Beach Cube
items.description: A toy manufacturer is brainstorming new ideas for a summer toy. Once the team is convinced of the merits of the beach cube, they decide that the boss should be ousted and the inventor of the beach cube should lead them.

items.title: Best Friend Rescue
items.description: Every girl needs a best friend to back her up and protect her against the bad behavior of a boyfriend. his best friend will not stand for any nonsense, and claims her girl is bigger and better than anything a mere boyfriend could imagine.

items.title: Better Boss
items.description: As the human resources department plans the annual company retreat. The new manager, Ardmond, plans to outperform the old manager, Dale, on every level. The competition is real and it is intense, and danger is not a deterrent.

items.title: Bird Boy
items.description: A man living in a bird's nest tells a story about how he got there. He flashes back to when he asked a genie to be able to live with birds, but forgot to ask for wings. As a result, he is now forever stuck in a bird's nest with no way to fly.

items.title: Calling For Daughter
items.description: Timmy arrives at the Fester family home to take their daughter on a date. The Fester family calls out to Ricola, but to no avail. Finally, when Timmy calls up using the American pronunciation of the name Ricola, she comes bouncing down the stairs.

items.title: Calm Yourself
items.description: Mary runs into her Regency era home, rejoicing that her wealthy heartthrob has returned. In turn, several daughters announce that men are coming to court them. Mama gets more and more unsettled, while urging her daughters to calm themselves.

items.title: Career Day
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.
