items.title: CastEval - Tori
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Confused Cop
items.description: Matthew is pulled over by a cop. He assumes that he was speeding, but the cop's questions soon spiral from normal cop questions into increasingly bizarre existential questions as the cop asks Matthew questions about his own dreams, fears, and goals.

items.title: Cry No More
items.description: A waitress thinks Arvin made his girlfriend cry, and spills everything on him as payback. Arvin admits he was planning to propose, pulling out a ring. His girlfriend cries harder, prompting the waitress to bring out a flambé, and the couple runs out.

items.title: Cyber Bullies
items.description: Jeffrey doesn't want to go to school because he's being cyber bullied by the cool kids, who happen to be robots. The cyber bullies tease Jeffrey by poking fun at his mom's weight, his glasses, and other perceived flaws, all in monotonous robot-speak.

items.title: Dad Gets Charmed
items.description: Dad tries to intimidate his daughter's boyfriend, Jeremy, when Jeremy arrives at his house to pick his daughter up for a date that night. But his tough and menacing pose is undercut when he can't stop laughing hysterically at everything Jeremy does.

items.title: Disheveled Airport Woman
items.description: A woman who doesn’t understand TSA rules frustrates the agents by walking through with her bags. She complains about removing her electronics, liquids, and pet iguana. Her bag still sets off the machine, however because her iguana always has a knife.

items.title: Dodo Fairy
items.description: Elanor, the Toothfairy’s daughter, waits for the mystical Dodo Bird Fairy to come take her tooth. The fairy is clumsy and scary rather than graceful and beautiful. She chokes on Elanor’s tooth and falls to the ground when she tries to fly away.

items.title: Don't Need Nothing But You
items.description: In a 1930s-style musical number, Molly tells Jimmy that she doesn't need their mansion or their fancy possessions, only their love. Jimmy, relieved, confesses to a horrified Molly that he just lost his job and they're about to lose everything.

items.title: Drive Thru
items.description: Kevin goes to his local Burger Jester and orders a huge meal. However, the drive-thru staff refuse to serve him this order, saying that they can't be responsible for killing him. Instead, they counsel Kevin over the speaker about healthy choices.

items.title: Dungulah
items.description: Two orphan girls living in a Victorian-era orphanage discuss their dreams for their future lives when they are adopted. They are interrupted by Dungulah, a third orphan girl, who shares that her dream is to have a little man who lives in her pocket.

items.title: Essential Witches
items.description: Three witches gather in the woods to brew potions together, but it quickly transpires that the potion party was only a pretext for one of the witches, a member of a multilevel marketing scheme, to try and convince her guests to buy essential oils.

items.title: Ethel Fights Off Death
items.description: Ethel, a sassy and determined grandma, is horrified when Death arrives with his scythe to collect her soul. Instead of accepting her fate, she fends off Death by eating superfoods, doing puzzles to keep her mind active, and finally just running away.

items.title: Ezekiel Browngoat
items.description: Ezekiel Browngoat, owner of a small-town mattress store, narrates a low-budget commercial about a blowout sale at his store. As it goes on, he slowly breaks down and reveals that he has lost his entire family inside the gigantic mattress warehouse.

items.title: First Fender Bender
items.description: Two early car owners get in a fender bender when one of them looks down to write a quick letter. With the help of a confused local policeman, they need to figure out a whole new car accident protocol, including exchanging their contact information.

items.title: First Words on Mars
items.description: An astronaut overthinks the first words on Mars, and tries to be funny. When her attempts flop, she gets back in the spacecraft and tries again. Mission control cuts her off, and she half-heartedly says a scripted line as she plants the flag.

items.title: Florida City Council
items.description: A Florida city council meeting is derailed when the citizens realize that one of the meeting participants is, in fact, an alligator. They protest to the chairman that an alligator shouldn't be allowed to participate in local Florida government.

items.title: Folk Ballad
items.description: In the wild west, a guitarist sings a song about a villain, before realizing his subject is actually a nice guy. The singer wanders through the town in search of a bad guy, but each time he is misdirected by actions that turn out to be really nice.

items.title: Grandma Likes Being Kidnapped
items.description: A family gathers in their living room with a hostage negotiator to try and rescue Grandma, who was kidnapped while on vacation. However, it becomes clear that Grandma has no intention of leaving her idyllic life in Colombia for a retirement home.

items.title: Grandpa the Dairy Farmer
items.description: Two kids visit their dairy farmer grandpa on his farm and learn to taste different flavors in milk. But when Grandpa starts tasting his cologne and heart medication in the cows' milk, he gets paranoid that the cows are secretly trying to become him.

items.title: Hair Height
items.description: A chance remark about Tanner's hair drives Tanner and Matthew into an elaborate hair duel. They begin by hairspraying their hair to its most impressive height, then start magically transforming into various movie characters and historical figures.

items.title: Hollywood Executive
items.description: In a Christmas car commercial, a man decides to give his wife the gift of a shiny new Lexus. But when his wife gets outside to see her Christmas surprise, she is furious that he sold their old car for an expensive new one without even talking to her.

items.title: House Always Wins
items.description: Rick just wants to get some change from the hotel change machine, but he is continually interrupted by Tara, a fellow guest who thinks that he's gambling at a slot machine and enthusiastically cheers him on for his impressive winning streak.

items.title: How Did That Get There
items.description: Charlie’s friends don’t seem to understand what their baby is or where he came from. They think it’s bringing them presents, or putting money under their pillows, or if it’s superman. They decide to have another one, but they don’t know what.

items.title: Imposter Fieri
items.description: Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives host Guy Fieri shows up to a local restaurant for another episode of his famous food show. To his shock, he must prove his identity when he finds a imposter Guy already there, trying to scam his way into some free food.

items.title: It Could Work Theoretically
items.description: A scrappy spaceship crew is about to be captured or killed by enemy troops, but the ship's captain won't go down without a fight. With the help of her crew, she tests out the unlikeliest plans for how they could theoretically escape their enemies.

items.title: Judge Judy
items.description: The beloved show, “Judge Judy” is adapted into “Judge Judge Judy Judge Judy” where the plaintiff, defendant, witnesses, and judge are all played by Judge Judith Sheindlin. The Judy’s argue about who is more experienced and recite isms from the show.

items.title: Lady of the Lake
items.description: King Arthur and his squire journey to receive the sword Excalibur from the Lady of the Lake. But when they arrive, the lake looks more like a swamp, and the Lady of the Lake is a colorful rural character who tries to sell them homemade stink bait.

items.title: Mission Control
items.description: Actors freeze and Mission Control steps in to save a sketch with an unamused audience. The team uses statistics, graphs, and imitating the set to try and make the sketch funny, to no avail. Finally, they send in an alpaca and the crowd goes wild.

items.title: Morning Show
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Office Funny Guy
items.description: A painfully boring office has a competition for the role of official office funny guy. The two contenders, both very awkward, must reenact common office scenarios such as dropping off files and running into people at the water cooler.

items.title: Phil's Deals
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Pizza Breakup
items.description: At a sleepover, a group of girls are consoling Stacy after her breakup by eating delicious pizza. One-by-one, the other girls are dumped, leading them to buy increasingly large pizzas. Eventually, the pizza is so huge it’s delivered by a helicopter.

items.title: Promposal
items.description: Shane asks Janelle to prom with a pun about bananas. She excitedly accepts with a pun about nuts. But when Shane's mischievous little sister sends Janelle a rude message, ostensibly from Shane, the puns and pranks start to spiral out of control.

items.title: Rock Concert Questions
items.description: A rock star warms up the audience before a concert by asking the usual rhetorical questions about how they're feeling and if they're ready to rock. But he's thrown off his game when audience members answer him, saying that they aren't ready to rock.

items.title: Snake Dad at Career Day
items.description: At an elementary school’s career day, a dad comes in and explains his work as an amateur immunologist. The kids and teacher are shocked as Jackal allows a snake to bite him, explaining that overtime his blood will become a universal anti-venom.

items.title: Sound of Music
items.description: Maria tries to teach the Von Trapp kids about music and singing, but every time she says a word they're not familiar with, they have a full-blown existential crisis and start marching, blowing whistles, and yelling in heavy Austrian accents.

items.title: Speed Walkers
items.description: Two speed walkers take a fast walk through their neighborhood park. They criticize passing runners, cyclists, and skateboarders for being arrogant showoffs and reassure themselves that speedwalking is really much more difficult and dangerous.

items.title: Stinky Fridge
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Teenage Uber
items.description: In this commercial, customers balk at the price of a regular Uber ride and decide to opt for a cheaper alternative: the new Teenage Uber app. But the student drivers who pick them up are a little less than qualified for tricky things like left turns.

items.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 1: Birthday Party
items.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, and all three goat boys fall over when the birthday crowd calls out their surprise.

items.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 2: Track Meet
items.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, passing out at a when a gunshot goes off at the start of a track meet.

items.title: The Fainting Goat Boys 3: Jack in the Box
items.description: A farmer curses boys for messing with his goats. The boys become part fainting goat, falling over whenever they are startled. This interrupts their everyday lives, and all three goat boys fall over when the jack in the box springs out at them.

items.title: Tickle Fight
items.description: An executioner approaches the chopping block to kill a prisoner. However, he doesn't know what he's doing and decides to slap the prisoner in the face instead, to the shock and confusion of the official in charge of the execution.

items.title: Well, Well, Well
items.description: Two spies accidentally rob the same bank. One spy tries to guess the other’s plan incorrectly, but clams that as a spy, confidence is all that matters. While she is distracted with weird theories of his motives, the other spy leaves with the money.

items.title: Westminster
items.description: The final round of the Westminster Cat Show goes off the rails as the cats refuse to run the track. One cat clings to a judge’s face and his owner drags them both through the course. The judges crown a dog owner from the audience as the real winner.

items.title: The Disappearance of Jason Gray
items.description: Excited to welcome back Jason Gray, the cast unfortunately mistakes him for an imposter and zaps him into a dimension governed by a mystical cat who does not want to help Jason return to season 14, where he belongs.

items.title: Surveilled It
items.description: Arvin's stand up comedy set is interrupted by the audience. Rock climbing rescuers surveil the scene. An innovative vacuum will change housework forever. A family takes part in their grandma's funeral. A man has an emotional breakthrough.

items.title: Recommended by 5/5 Dentists
items.description: Jetta gets locked out of the studio. Cockney shopkeepers hawk their goods. Five dentists recommend a new product. A professional football team owner goes undercover as a player. And a father wears his most expensive shoes to a wedding,

items.title: Flippa The Pancake
items.description: Embedded in an episode about sports journalists, epic chess games, construction workers, and a trendy restaurant, Dalton discovers the Earth shattering truth that his entire life has been a lie, created for the entertainment of others.

items.title: Edgar Allan Crow
items.description: Edgar Allan Poe's Halloween Studio C special goes awry when he and his pet crow Butterbean touch a cursed amulet at the same time, switching bodies. Stuck in the body of his crow, Poe is helpless as his tales of terror elicit laughter.

items.title: Rat Tail
items.description: Studio C confronts a major issue -- Garet's hair. A poker game requires skilled shuffling. A new medication declares war on indigestion. Two New Yorkers enjoy a staycation. Another New Yorker teaches a unique form of self defense.

items.title: My Real Dad You Are Not
items.description: A teacher tries to motivate his class. An art critic evaluates a painting. Children learn life lessons from microwaved meals. Teens teach about alien attacks. A family attends an action movie. A grown Baby Yoda deals with teen stress.

items.title: At Peace With The Mess
items.description: Studio C's janitor needs to head home to his family, but a series of messy sketches -- involving leaking pens, food fights, excessive water, and whipped cream pies -- test his patience and lead him on a journey of self discovery.

items.title: Boom Shaka Laka
items.description: Two boys are playing video games in the year 1995. When one of them says Boom Shaka Laka, a Terminator-type bounty hunter bursts in and zaps him with a laser gun. The bounty hunter explains to the second boy that Boom Shaka Laka is alien code.

items.title: The Christmas Special
items.description: Tucked in and snuggly in their bed, the cast of Studio C listens to their favorite Christmas tales about Scrooge, wrapping paper hacks, Giuseppe the Italian Elf, office Christmas parties, The Grinch, and Nicolas Cage.

items.title: '80s Teen Ghost
items.description: A girl getting bullied in a school bathroom meets three 80s teen ghosts, who need to help her gain confidence before they can cross over. However, the ghosts' ideas, like challenging the bullies to a ski race, are too outdated to be much help.

items.title: A Good Cry
items.description: At a couples' retreat, Talya-Ann leads her workshop participants in expressing their deepest feelings and needs to their partners. One of the participants, Garth, starts crying, but his cry is so loud and jarring it interrupts the entire workshop.

items.title: A Special Gift
items.description: At a Christmas party, Brian announces that everyone bought a special gift for Eric, who had a hard year after his car broke down. Brian fills his introduction speech with car puns, but when Eric opens the gift, he sees that it is an electric toothbru

items.title: Bad Shuffler
items.description: James Bond and Le Chiffre cross paths again, this time over a game of poker. However, their witty banter is interrupted by the game's shuffler, who can't seem to shuffle cards without them flying in the players' faces or accidentally flipping over.

items.title: Bog Dentist
items.description: A toothpaste brand representative presents her products in the hope of receiving the elusive five out of five dentist approval. However, one of the five dentists reviewing her products is a bog dentist, who prefers chewing on twigs to using toothpast

items.title: Boom Shaka Laka
items.description: Two boys are playing video games in the year 1995. When one of them says Boom Shaka Laka, a Terminator-type bounty hunter bursts in and zaps him with a laser gun. The bounty hunter explains to the second boy that Boom Shaka Laka is alien code.

items.title: Boomer Horror
items.description: Casey is horrified when she receives a phone call from a man with a hoarse, creepy voice who asks her what her favorite scary movie is. But the man on the other end is Casey's dad, who has a million questions for her about how to log into Hulu.

items.title: Caveman Art Critic
items.description: Cave artist Grota presents her painting to an audience of cave people. She is interrupted by Jub, a famous cave art critic. Jub proceeds to verbally tear down Grota's painting, using modern art theories presented in simplistic cave person terminology

items.title: Chess
items.description: Two chess commentators narrate a professional chess championship. When one player's king abdicates the throne in favor of her queen, the chess game spins out of control into a political morass of alliances, betrayals, coups, and puppet leaders.

items.title: Christmas Carol
items.description: After his night with the ghosts, Scrooge opens his window and calls to a young boy on the street to buy the biggest turkey in the shop for the Cratchit family. His order gets more and more complicated as the shop keeps running out of what he wants.

items.title: Clown Pies
items.description: A bakery owner is suspicious that his customers, who keep buying whipped cream pies, are secretly clowns who are planning to slam the pies in their faces. However, he keeps accepting their alternative explanations for clearly clownish behavior.

items.title: Cockney Market
items.description: American tourists try to buy food at a Cockney market, but the vendors there will only describe their products indirectly, using Cockney rhyming slang. The tourists get increasingly frustrated as every rhyming slang term turns out to mean strawberrie

items.title: Construction Workers
items.description: Construction workers building a house keep stopping their work to take soda breaks for the flimsiest possible reasons. Every time they slip up at their tongue-twister-style dialogue or fail to catch a soda, they have to restart the scene from the top

items.title: Dad Justifies Ski Boots at a Wedding
items.description: A dad arrives at his daughter's wedding wearing the most expensive pair of shoes he owns: his ski boots. However, when he tries to walk his daughter down the aisle, he finds that the physical aspect of walking in ski boots is difficult to manage.

items.title: Edgy Teacher Breaks Chair
items.description: A high school teacher gives an inspirational speech to his classroom of at-risk youth. But when he tries to sit down backwards on his chair in classic movie fashion, he can't seem to figure out how to do it and keeps falling off and spinning around.

items.title: Emergency Exit Leader
items.description: April and Jason welcome everyone to Studio C, but when they mention the emergency exits, they are interrupted by an audience member who designates herself the official emergency exit leader. She starts educating the audience about emergency protocols

items.title: Everyone's in on the Prank
items.description: Dalton is surprised when April interrupts a sketch to play a prank on him. However, his surprise changes to concern when April and the rest of the cast reveal that the rest of Dalton's life, including his job and his wife, was just part of the prank.

items.title: Explosive Pen
items.description: A news reporter's pen breaks live on air, splattering her shirt with ink. As she and her colleague attempt to continue the show, the pen spurts ink all over them. The stakes heighten when an art curator arrives on the show with a Van Gogh painting.

items.title: Extraterrestrials and You
items.description: In the year 2076, students at Lower Dome High School perform a skit about dealing with everyday alien encounters, including common warning signs that someone is an alien (dead eyes, gills, tentacles, and slime) and how to respond to alien threats.

items.title: Food Fight
items.description: Avery, an elementary school student, tries to start a food fight in the cafeteria, but all the other students are confused and start punching their slices of pizza and strangling their burritos, instead of using their food to fight each other.

items.title: Football Pre Game Journalist
items.description: On an football pregame show, three ex-football players and a journalist run through a potential play for the upcoming game. When the journalist drops the football instead of making a catch, he insists that they run the play back until he gets it righ

items.title: Funeral Talent Show
items.description: At Grandma's funeral, Trish plays a song on the piano that Grandma used to enjoy hearing her play. Sibling rivalry immediately kicks in as her brother and sister show off their own talents instead of making speeches about their deceased Grandma.

items.title: GI Joe
items.description: A commercial promotes Gastrointestinal Joe, also called G.I. Joe, a man-shaped indigestion pill that parachutes into your stomach. The product is aimed at men who want to feel macho about their medication and think Pepto Bismol is excessively pink.

items.title: Genie Doesn't get Social Cues
items.description: After granting Kevin's three wishes, a genie awkwardly sticks around, wanting to hang out. No matter how many social cues Kevin gives him that it's time to leave, he insists on staying to watch TV, drink Kevin's beverages, and try to be friends.

items.title: Good Jason Impression
items.description: Jason and Jetta demonstrate their impressions for the audience. When they ask if any audience members can do an impression, Megan does one of Jason. The impression is awful, but the cast can't tell the difference between Megan and the real Jason.

items.title: Goosebusters
items.description: After losing the ghostbusters.com website domain name, the Ghostbusters rebrand as the Goosebusters and start a new career busting geese. If you have a problem with geese in your local creek, brook, river, or fjord, they'll be there to help you out.

items.title: Grinch Cage
items.description: When the Grinch sneaks into a family's house to steal Christmas, he is interrupted by Nicolas Cage, who is trying to steal the Declaration of Independence. The two would-be thieves get into an argument over whose mission should take precedence.

items.title: Gymnast Parents
items.description: Two parents watch their daughter's routine in a gymnastics competition. As they get more invested in her performance, they start performing their own routine, with choreographed dancing, jumping out of their seats, and throwing each other in the air.

items.title: Heist Naming
items.description: Cameron introduces the members of her heist crew to each other. Along with traditional roles like the hacker, the muscle, and the pickpocket, she has also hired a mailbox with eyelashes, a man with feet for hands, and the Moon, among many others.

items.title: Introducing Friends
items.description: A woman is excited to introduce her friends Sam and Alex for the first time, but when it turns out that they're old friends from the same hometown, she gets insecure about being the third wheel in the friendship and begins inventing inside jokes.

items.title: Italian Elf
items.description: The elves in Santa's workshop are trying to get all of their toys finished before Santa leaves in his sleigh, but Giuseppe, an Italian elf, keeps accidentally making his mother's Italian meatball sandwiches and chicken parmesan instead of toys.

items.title: Kid Cuisine part 1
items.description: A commercial advertises Kid Cuisine, a kids' microwaveable meal that teaches important life lessons. For example, hot apple sauce teaches kids to survive disappointment, and confusing gravy with chocolate sauce shows them how tragedy begets growth.

items.title: Kid Cuisine part 2
items.description: A commercial advertises Kid Cuisine, a kids' microwaveable meal that teaches important life lessons. For example, hot apple sauce teaches kids to survive disappointment, and confusing gravy with chocolate sauce shows them how tragedy begets growth.

items.title: Long Island Ladies
items.description: Two women from Long Island, Bernice and Chanice, tan on lawn chairs outside their apartments. They discuss everything from fighting subway pigeons to their relationships with their many ex-husbands, but keep coming back to the joys of a staycation.

items.title: MASH Court
items.description: In a courtroom, the prosecutor examines Frank N. Stein, a witness for a wrongful death suit. Stein describes his experiences on the night of October 31st, when his lab work was interrupted by a party of vampires and ghouls that poisoned his monster.

items.title: Mandela Effect
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Mechanic Musical
items.description: When a woman goes to the mechanic to get her car fixed, she is confused about the difference between a camshaft and a crankshaft. The mechanic is delighted to explain it to her and brings out a chorus of mechanics who perform a song about cars.

items.title: Milk Freak
items.description: When they hear there's been a break-in targeting the dairy fridges, grocery store employees worry that a milk freak is on the loose. Their supervisor insists that there is no such thing as a milk freak, but the scared employees refuse to believe her.

items.title: Mouse Karate
items.description: New Yorker Vinnie Pecorino teaches a self-defense class in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Every time a student tries to attack him, he demonstrates the only move in his self-defense arsenal, which is carrying a mouse and throwing it in your attacker's face.

items.title: Pancake Flippers
items.description: Business partners and a couple on a first date are excited to go to Benihana, a breakfast restaurant that makes your food right in front of you. But the pancake flippers at the restaurant insist on flipping everything directly at the patrons' faces.

items.title: Positive Heckler
items.description: Arvin is excited to perform his standup routine for the Studio C audience, but he keeps getting interrupted by hecklers. However, the Studio C hecklers just want to praise Arvin's performance and share random facts with him about their own lives.

items.title: Rat Tail Intervention
items.description: The cast stages an intervention to convince Garet to get rid of his long, braided rat tail. As they tearfully describe how the rat tail is ruining their friendship with Garet, the rat tail itself interrupts, revealing that it's sentient and can talk.

items.title: Roomba Commercial
items.description: The new Roomba Max Pro Series 12, made with groundbreaking new technology developed by scientists at NASA, includes a vacuum-style handle to control exactly when and where your Roomba cleans and a charging cable that plugs directly into the wall.

items.title: Sad Kids at The Rock
items.description: A dad and his three children go to a movie theatre to watch The Rock, starring Nicholas Cage and directed by Michael Bay. The kids don't want to watch a movie, because they're sad that their grandfather died that morning. Dad doesn't know what to do.

items.title: Schrodinger's Kitty
items.description: Dr. Erwin Schrodinger presents his scientific theory of Schrodinger's cat at the Copenhagen Physicists' Conference, but the other scientists in the room keep getting distracted by the idea that there is a real kitty in the box for them to play with.

items.title: Shark Tank
items.description: Tim arrives on Shark Tank to present his new product, Christmas Supr-eyes, a pair of glasses with wrapping paper over the eyes so parents don't have to individually wrap kids' presents. He describes the trauma that led him to create this product.

items.title: Storage Wars: Texas
items.description: A couple on Storage Wars finds the state of Texas inside a jar in an abandoned storage unit. To find out if this Texas in a jar is the real deal, the couple has to call someone living in Texas to see if they're currently inside a glass jar or not.

items.title: Studio C Janitor
items.description: April welcomes everyone to Studio C, but is interrupted by the janitor, Jerry, who is getting a jump start on the cleaning because he has to make it to his daughter's birthday party that night. Jerry protests the messy sketches the cast has planned.

items.title: Surveilled It
items.description: A hiker stranded on the side of a cliff is delighted when rescuers Jody and Jony arrive. However, Jody and Jony's philosophy of rescue is that, before you do anything else, you must fully surveil the area and make note of any potential dangers.

items.title: Teen Yoda
items.description: A sitcom-style show gives us a glimpse into the life of Baby Yoda, now all grown up into a gangly and acne-ridden teenager called Teen Yoda, who struggles with typical teenage problems like arguing with his dad and asking his crush to the dance.

items.title: Undercover Football Boss
items.description: This week on Undercover Boss, John Livingston, the owner of the Blue Bay Smackers football team, goes undercover as a football player. He's confident in his disguise, but his employees are suspicious of the old man who suddenly joined the team.

items.title: Water Bottle Lady
items.description: A CEO's speech about the company's poor performance, which will necessitate some layoffs, is interrupted by a thirsty employee named Williams. Williams drinks all of the water in the room, including the vase on the table, before she is finally fired.

items.title: With Special Guest Will Forte
items.description: Will Forte (Saturday Night Live, The Last Man on Earth) guest stars. A super villain's cat has a secret. A worker is stuck in a vat of cereal. Behind the scenes of the recording session for the Seinfeld theme song.

items.title: Dedicated to the Children
items.description: Jason Gray struggles in an unnecessarily complex warmup game. Cast members impersonate Tom Cruise, Billie Eilish, Chris Rock, Taylor Swift, Cher, Ariana Grande, Owen Wilson, Adam Driver and James Corden.

items.title: The Spy Who Hugged Me
items.description: FBI Agents canvas an apartment complex. A waitress compromises a spy mission. A defense program seeks funding. Journalists react to Apollo 13. Loki interviews Nick Fury. A hero's eating habits are revealed.

items.title: Live Action Studio C
items.description: Bob Iger reveals Disney’s newest live-action remake of Ratatouille. Loki interviews Doctor Strange. A driver claims his car turned invisible. Jason Gray finds a video he made in junior high school.

items.title: Tanner & The Deathly Hollers
items.description: A Hogwarts sorting ceremony leads to some unexpected pronouncements, including Tourette Syndrome and OCD. Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely learn about the wonders of crayons. Jetta Juriansz snaps as her roommate says goodnight to everything in the room

items.title: Studio C+
items.description: Jason Gray announces Studio C's all new streaming platform, Studio C+. “Shows” on the new app include Loki’s interview with Spider-Man, Garet Allen deciding what to wear, and a snappy West Side Story parody.

items.title: Daltline
items.description: Dalton Johnson hosts a “True Crime” edition of Studio C. Agent Brinlee (Jetta Juriansz) gets a suspect to reveal information. A clueless juror (Naomi Winders) can’t make up her mind. An Alexa smart speaker is a witness in a criminal case.

items.title: History That Surely Happened
items.description: John Hancock signs the Declaration so well that the founding fathers name signatures after him. Romeo and Juliet suffer through several rounds of spicy wings as they lie on their deathbed.

items.title: GOOOOOOAAAAAAALLLLLLLLL!!!!!
items.description: BYU Men's Basketball coach Mark Pope guest stars in this sports-themed episode. Pope subs in as director of the show. A soccer commentator can't wait to announce a goal. Tanner Gillman gives a rousing speech to puppies.

items.title: A Studio C Wedding
items.description: Jetta struggles to find a date to a wedding. A Christopher Nolan movie about a budding romance gets intense. The bride and groom have some confusion over names.

items.title: Alexa Witness
items.description: In a courtroom trial for a robbery, the prosecution calls the victims' Amazon Alexa to the stand to testify. However, she realizes that cross-examining an Alexa device is more difficult than she anticipated when Alexa continuously misunderstands her.

items.title: Ambulance Chasing Lawyer
items.description: Lawyer Joe Phlegm advertises his services to ambulance-chasing lawyers who got in car accidents while chasing ambulances. He offers testimonials from the many ambulance-chasing lawyers he has represented in accidents that were clearly their fault.

items.title: Apollo 13
items.description: In the middle of the Apollo 13 mission disaster, a NASA scientist holds a news conference with journalists. When she uses a car metaphor to describe the problem the journalists begin to suggest solutions inspired by their knowledge of car mechanics.

items.title: Bank Drive Thru
items.description: A bank drive thru gets held up by a robber, who sends a gun and a rope through the money tube to taunt the crowd inside. The teller sends a pair of handcuffs through the money tube and its enough for the robber to admit defeat.

items.title: Big Booty Opener
items.description: Naomi leads the rest of the Studio C cast in a game of Big Booty, but Jason struggles to keep up with the others. As the game gets more and more complicated, involving arcane rules and lengthy synchronised chanting, Jason just can't stop messing up.

items.title: Biker Twins
items.description: Two tough biker sisters obsessed with being twins terrorize a biker bar full of much bigger men, who are intimidated by their relentless barrage of twin jokes. Their aggressive type of sibling affection results in a lot of glass bottles being broken.

items.title: Bride Forgets
items.description: During the reading of a couple's wedding vows, the bride tries to hide that she never actually learned the groom's name. As the ceremony proceeds, the officiant and, finally, the groom himself admit that they also don't know the groom's name.

items.title: Cerealously
items.description: A man eating breakfast calls the Marshmallow Pirates cereal help line to complain about his stale cereal, but the employee he reaches on the other end has been trapped in a vat of cereal for six months after a quality check went horribly wrong.

items.title: Choir
items.description: Choir director leads choir members in a complex warm-up that starts with vocal exercises, then progresses to reciting famous movie quotes, acting out a conversation between a husband and wife, and fighting each other in a Star Wars-style laser war.

items.title: Christopher Nolan Rom Com
items.description: A trailer for the romantic comedy Infatuation. Samantha, a wannabe journalist, finds her boyfriend held hostage by her boss. She goes to space to save him and reunites with him behind a bookshelf, much like Christopher Nolan's Interstellar.

items.title: Coach Pope
items.description: Studio C is sketch comedy for the whole family. With Garet Allen, Carl Foreman, Dalton Johnson, Tori Pence, Kiri Case, Aleta Myles, and Jericho Lopez.

items.title: Coach Pope Pirate Office
items.description: When the director of Studio C gets food poisoning, Coach Pope of the BYU Basketball team steps in as a sub. Austin is benched after abandoning the script, and Jess must convince Coach Pope that she has enough heart to take over Austin's leading role.

items.title: Commercial After the Sale
items.description: Theo makes a commercial after his cushion bazaar's storewide Sunday sale is over, scolding blowing their chance to save money and not showing up to the sale. Theo resents the sun for stealing his customers on and builds a rocket ship.

items.title: Cool Guy Can't Eat Fruit
items.description: The world is about to when and a cool guy enters the briefing room at the Pentagon. He is capable and confident and tells the committee he is ready to save the day. But the committee is unsure when they see him peel fruit, but eat the skins and the r

items.title: Coronation
items.description: At Napoleon's coronation, the crown bearer struggles to get a normal-sized crown to stay on Napoleon's famously tiny head. He tries all sorts of strategies to get it to stay on, as Napoleon gets increasingly apoplectic with anger and embarrassment.

items.title: Dad Runs Hot
items.description: Daughter Sarah and her boyfriend Direk are visiting Sarah's parents when Dad decides to show Direk his new air conditioning system. As Dad turns the AC further down, hoping to make the unflappable Direk feel cold, he himself gets increasingly chilly.

items.title: Dane's Flowers
items.description: Dane picks the best bouquets for customers at a flower shop. A biker gang confronts Dane for giving their gang buddy flowers that got him hitched. Dane hands them a flower arrangement so fine that they calm down and leave Dane in peace.

items.title: FBI
items.description: Two agents announce their FBI status with literally every sentence as they taunt a resident to open their apartment door. An innocent man finally answers and declares he hasn't seen the suspect. The agents move on to taunt the next door.

items.title: Family History
items.description: Jason interrupts a sketch to announce that people must pay for Studio C+MAX in order to finish it.

items.title: Gender Reveal
items.description: Jason and Jetta host a convoluted party for their baby's gender reveal. The party guests must pop a balloon, hit the bullseye on Jason's back with a paintball, open a letter, and stop Grandpa's death before they know the baby's gender.

items.title: Goodnight Moon
items.description: As Naomi and Jetta settle in for sleep, Naomi wishes goodnight to everything in the room until Jetta snaps. Jetta apologizes and the two wish each other goodnight. Naomi squeezes in a last goodnight to a secret someone in the room.

items.title: Goooooooooalllllll!!!!!!!!!!
items.description: Dalton and Joe commentate a soccer in Spanish. Joe keeps announcing false goals and Dalton keeps correcting him. A real goal is finally scored. Dalton announces it, but Joe notices too late and misses his chance to announce a true goal.

items.title: Goths conform
items.description: Two goth kids loiter outside a school building, mocking the other kids for conforming to society. They make a point of their mockery by reciting plays in unison and playing football together. Goth kid Megan promptly straightens up as a theatre kid co

items.title: Hancock
items.description: Thomas Jefferson scolds John Hancock for signing the Declaration of Independence too big. Benjamin Franklin and George Washington join the party to sign the document and love Hancock's work. Washington deems all signatures John Hancocks.

items.title: Invisible Car
items.description: Garet claims his car turned invisible when Arvin from roadside services arrives. Arvin isn't convinced but hits his foot on the invisible care when he tries to leave. Garet leaves Arvin in awe, realizing this invisible car isn't his.

items.title: Jason Gray vs Jason Gray
items.description: Jason encounters a past version of himself in an old video camera. Jason tries to financially advise his past self, ends up insulting him instead. His past self takes revenge by committing to a tattoo that suddenly appears on Jason arm.

items.title: Juror didn't Listen
items.description: A jury is passionately divided on a trial verdict. As they deliberate, they discover that Juror Marcia paid no attention in the trial. They try to catch Marcia up, but bickering ensues. Marcia leaves them with her verdict on a lunch order.

items.title: Little women
items.description: The March sisters realize Laurie proposed to both Jo and Amy. Meg and Beth are offended Laurie didn't propose to them, too. Beth coughs in Laurie's face before collapsing. As Beth dies, Laurie mourns that he'll never get to ask her to marry him.

items.title: Live Action Ratatouille
items.description: Bob Iger shares exclusive clips of the Ratatouille live-action remake. In the clips, Linguini lifts a massive rat onto his shoulders, tries to tell Colette about this rat, and reveals this rat to the food critic who loved its cooking.

items.title: Marty the Sketchbot
items.description: Marty, the robot that writes most of Studio C's sketches, sings of his want to be a real boy and part of Studio C's human cast. The audience claps for Marty until his entertainment meter is full, transforming him into real boy Will Forte.

items.title: Mr. Rogers' Crayon
items.description: Mr. Rogers puts Mr. Mcfeely's VHS into the player and a video of crayon production plays. The video cuts to a shot of Mr. Rogers eating an entire green crayon at a painstaking pace. Mr. Rogers and Mr. Mcfeely sit in uncomfortable silence.

items.title: Obvious Spies
items.description: Two undercover spies track down a villain when a waitress blows their cover. The spies try to ward the waitress off when the villain reveals himself. The waitress posts a pic of the villain on social media and lead the FBI straight to him.

items.title: Pen Funeral
items.description: Jason's whiteboard marker runs out of ink during a Studio C writing session. While mourning its death, the cast takes equal responsibility for the whiteboard marker's early demise. They hold a funeral before chucking it into the trash.

items.title: Price Match
items.description: Jason requests a price match for a TV he found at Buy Best and reveals that he stole the TV itself. The store clerk, the store manager, and a Best Buy employee try to take the TV back, but the confusion ends in him towing the TV away.

items.title: Puppy Bowl
items.description: Coach Tanner lays into his team of puppies after their weak performance on the puppy bowl playing field. He praises only the, who scored the team their only goal. Tanner recalls his youth and rallies the puppies to give the game their all.

items.title: Revenge Movie Trailer
items.description: Jack Wolfe vows to take revenge on the ocean that murdered his wife. He goes about punching bodies of water, slamming hooligan’s against walls, and answering phone calls through conch shells all for the sake of avenging his wife.

items.title: Richard Wants a Perfect Body
items.description: When Cleo wakes up to her husband Richard sporting a new muscle suit, she slips as she tries angrily to get it off his body. She gets stuck under fallen armoire and she-hulks it off her body when her faux-muscled husband is no help.

items.title: Seinfeld Bass Player
items.description: A studio preps to record the Seinfeld opening song. Bass player Shawn Cardigan spoils every take with his improvisation until the music producer dismisses him. On the last take, Shawn busts through the door and smashes everything in sight.

items.title: Shower Thoughts
items.description: Federal agents Arvin and Tanner bring in Brinlee, an obnoxiously cutesy girl, to torture suspect Jason with shower thoughts. Brinlee gives Jason too much to think about, and he cracks, revealing the location of a hidden bomb.

items.title: Sorting Hat
items.description: The Sorting Hat assigns Tanner the Hogwarts House of Tourettes. Tanner argues that Tourettes is his disorder, not his house. He can't channel Tourettes on Snape's demand. Voldemort appears. Tanner's Tourettes turns Voldemort into knickers.

items.title: Spicy Chicken
items.description: Romeo and Juliet perform their final lines with a twist - they eat a spicy chicken wings every time a bell rings. Juliet shares a hot sauce-covered kiss with Romeo's corpse. Juliet weeps over the spice as she drives a dagger into her chest.

items.title: Spider Free Movers
items.description: Mario and Rey Duggins premiere their Movers business commercial. They get down to business, claiming their vans are spider free, their movers won't mess with client property, and the dark month of May 2019 will never happen again.

items.title: Talk to Text
items.description: A woman with two broken arms captivates the bus passengers with voice texts about her long-lost father and puppy. The passengers demand closure before she gets off the bus, and find it when her father steps forward, puppy in tow.

items.title: Tanner is Mom
items.description: The cast of Studio C interrupts Tanner's warm welcome with a Happy Mother's Day wish. Tanner refutes their claim that he is the mom of the cast. A stranger tells him he's a phenomenal mother. He gives up and brings the cast in for a hug.

items.title: Time Traveler
items.description: Trevor of 2035 pays a visit to Trevor of 2022 and forgets the message he needed to deliver. He tells Trevor of 2022 about the horrors of the future until he remembers the message; he must not to take advice from his future self.

items.title: Togbort
items.description: The audience pleads for The Human Chainsaw to let Togbort win their wrestling match so he can complete his hobbit quest. Togbort defeats Chainsaw when a witch appears. Chainsaw defeats the witch and Togbort deems Chainsaw his quest buddy.

items.title: Villain's Pet
items.description: Daniel Danger confronts the evil Tanya Dynamite, who pets a man in a cat costume that sits in her lap. Dynamite tries to take Danger out with her cat, but Danger reveals to Dynamite that her cat is his partner agent. She loses again.

items.title: We Are the World
items.description: An ensemble of celebrities gathers to sing about the children of the world. Taylor Swift sells her 20th studio album, Adam Driver talks about his height, and the ensemble sings in chorus all for the sake of the world's children.

items.title: We Robbed a Zoo
items.description: In an exercise to get to know each other, a class of 3rd graders each share their name and the type of exotic pet they own. The class confesses to robbing a zoo. One student says her father's zoo was robbed and the class feels guilty.

items.title: Wedding Play
items.description: Jack tells the bride of a wedding that he loves her but learns he too late. At first, Jack writes off his confession as part of a play but eventually admits he does love her. The guests think he is performing a monologue from his play.

items.title: West Side Snapping
items.description: The Jets learn one of their gang members can't snap and refuse his suggestions for alternate forms of intimidation. The Jets fail to scare their rival gang away by snapping, so Joe starts tap dancing. His skill scares the Sharks off.

items.title: Wolverine Budget Proposal
items.description: Two officials propose the budget for a new project. They ask for $100 billion dollars, detailing their need to create a supersolider that can heal all wounds and how to build a cyborg that doesn't feel pain. The senator greenlights their budget.

items.title: Write Me
items.description: The teacher separates Megan and Naomi after they disrupt the class. Megan and Naomi write letters to each other, telling of the cold and the cute boy that asked Naomi to Spring Formal. The teacher catches them and sends them to detention.

items.title: Zamboni Time
items.description: Jess welcomes Joe the pretzel guy onboard as they ride the Zamboni across the ice. Jess scoots skaters off the ice and drives over Nancy Kerrigan, who didn't listen. She drives the Zamboni into the pretzel stand to chase customers away.

items.title: Special Guest Jon Heder
items.description: Jon Heder (Napoleon Dynamite) guest stars. Survey game contestants meet painful ends to wrong answers. Heder and Jason Gray try to get people to recognize them. Heder uses virtual reality to inadvertently ruin a party.

items.title: A Two of Diamonds
items.description: Jason and Naomi write "anonymous" complaints about each other. Hal and Andrew meet at summer camp and think they're long lost twins. Magician employees use magic to save a card factory. A basketball Coach is disappointed in his team.

items.title: One Measly Spider

items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Jones and Renterias on a wild adventure as they make daunting assents, daring rappels, and exhausting rafting journeys. Which family will be the first to raise their flag, in this fight to the finish and claim the $10,000?

items.title: Climb to Survive
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Moore and McFann families as they scale new heights through the windswept high desert. In a treacherous land where one misstep step could be their last, which family will climb to the top and claim the $10,000 prize?

items.title: Overcoming Obstacles
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Harkrider and Pace families in a trek full of climbs, rappels, and rallying jeeps across the dusty landscape. Who will overcome pain and personal injury to claim the $10,000 prize?

items.title: Pushed to the Brink!
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Armes and Hills in a tough trek across land, water, and over terrifying cliffs. Which family will handle the unexpected personal challenges and natural elements on the journey to claim the $10.000 prize?

items.title: It’s Snow Time in the Wild!
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Kraus and the Reochs on a three-day outing as they brave frozen lakes, dense forests and snow-covered mountains. Who will withstand the heat of battle to claim the cold $10,000 prize?

items.title: Florida Fighters
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Adams and the Carach families as they trek through towering monoliths in the cold desert. These Florida families are way out of their element but will hope they can learn their lessons and claim the $10,000.

items.title: The Ups and Downs
items.description: The Burrell family from South Carolina and the deVries family from Texas set out on a three-day, 16-mile race across some of the most rugged terrain in America. Hosted by Colin O'Brady, this is a thrilling race against time for $10,000!

items.title: Sinking Sands
items.description: The Bowling and Tran families compete in a four-day adventure race. The Bowling family wants to develop closer bonds and the Tran family hopes to reconnect after the oldest son moved out for college.

items.title: Leap of Faith
items.description: The Albert and Cook families participate in a four-day competition in Baja, Mexico. The Alberts work on their leadership and trust skills while the Cooks strive to prove their positive attitudes and endurance.

items.title: Towering Dunes
items.description: The Yoffee family strives to improve communication while the Phillips family works on rebuilding trust in each other in this adventure competition. The families race through water and rough terrain to be the first to the finish line.

items.title: Sharks in the Water!
items.description: The Raymond family hopes to deepen their connection while the Trop family works to overcome personal challenges.

items.title: Making Up For Lost Time
items.description: The Scott and Robbins families compete in an adventure race and challenges. The Scott family wants to reconnect after struggles with addiction while the Robbins family strives to get back to their adventurous roots.

items.title: A Daughter in Distress
items.description: The Newbold family works toward building deeper bonds with each other while the Muse family endeavors to improve their communication.

items.title: Changing Dynamics
items.description: In this four-day adventure competition, the Pettit family rebuilds connections after a brother moved out, while the White family establishes stronger relationships before a sister leaves for college.

items.title: The Long Road
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Horne and Leung families as they set off into the Baja wilderness for a four-day race. As the Leungs strive to strengthen their relationship, the Hornes try to control their competitive spirit.

items.title: A Sea Of Sharks!
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Prendergast and the Wakens on a four-day backcountry adventure, where the individual families must learn to trust each other.

items.title: Paddles Away!
items.description: Colin O’Brady hosts the Desuasido and Pears families on a four-day journey through the diverse untamable wilds of Mexico. These families need to learn how to come together, but in a sea of doubts, who can set the right course and claim the prize?

items.title: Water Buffalo
items.description: Klara and Pim arrive in their new home, daunted by the upheaval. Klara meets two strange girls—edgy, street-smart Cat and mysterious, reclusive Esme. Meanwhile, Pim runs away and discovers a huge, enigmatic Water Buffalo.

items.title: Broken Toys
items.description: When Pim’s favourite toy is broken by their grumpy neighbor and Mum is too busy to help, Klara takes him to the park to cheer him up. There, they encounter a strange man in what looks like a space suit, who needs their help.

items.title: Distant Rain
items.description: Budding artist Klara considers braving an art competition, while Pim and Lucy bond by writing stories together. As they all struggle to express themselves, a peculiar storm is brewing in the skies above.

items.title: Making A Friend
items.description: With Klara enthralled by an intriguing neighbour and Lucy starting a new job, Pim needs someone to play with. He builds a dinosaur friend out of junk, stunned when it comes to life. But their fun quickly gets out of hand.

items.title: Eric
items.description: Klara, Pim and Lucy are feeling disconnected and out of place, but they’re all forced to find a new way of looking at the world, when a mysterious, tiny houseguest comes to stay.

items.title: Inner Courtyard
items.description: Pim and Klara stumble into a strange and beautiful garden within their own house—and have a wondrous encounter that will forever change the way they see their mum. But can they make it out before it’s too late?

items.title: Moonfish
items.description: Pim grapples with big feelings about his absent dad, so Grandpa takes him sky-fishing to lift his spirits. Meanwhile Grandma helps Klara realise she can no longer deny her own overwhelming emotions.

items.title: The Badlands
items.description: Klara and Pim go with Grandma and Grandpa on a thrilling treasure hunt, beyond the borders of suburbia. Faced with perplexing challenges, they must decide if they can stick together to find their way home.

items.title: Dugong
items.description: Klara’s self-doubt threatens to swallow her whole, while Pim’s birthday takes a strange turn when a dugong inexplicably appears on the front lawn, far from the ocean and in desperate need of help.

items.title: Turning
items.description: Klara nervously heads to the city for her art competition, with supportive Pim in tow. But when the journey doesn’t go as planned, Klara’s despair leads to a confrontation that will change her—and her neighborhood—forever.

items.title: That Promised Day
items.description: Deepen your appreciation for the massive effort made to create the Topical Guide, Bible Dictionary, Joseph Smith Translation, footnotes, and more.

items.title: Luke 24 & Acts 1: "Behold My Hands and My Feet"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the apostles continuing Christ’s church after His ascension as described in Luke chapter 24 and Acts chapter 1. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Acts 1-2: "Ordained to Be a Witness"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 1 and 2 which detail Jesus Christ’s 40-day ministry after His resurrection, the leadership in the apostles, and the day of Pentecost. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Acts 3-5: "There Is None Other Name"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Peter and John healing and preaching outside the temple and their arrest by and testimonies to the Pharisees as described in Acts chapters 3 through 5. With Andrew Skinner, Jeffrey Marsh, Robert Millet, and Camille Fronk.

items.title: Acts 6-8: "I See The Heavens Opened"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 6 through 8 which detail the further organizing of the Church, rejection of Stephen’s testimony, and Saul persecuting the Church. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Acts 9-10: "Why Persecutest Thou Me?"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the conversions and callings of Saul and Cornelius which opens the door for more to be converted to Christ’s Church in Acts chapters 9 and 10. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Acts 10-13: "God Is No Respecter of Persons"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 10 through 13 which detail the teaching of the Gospel to the Gentiles, the martyrdom of James, and Saul’s name change to Paul. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Acts 14-16 & Gal. 2: "Continue in the Faith"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 14 through 16 which detail Paul and Barnabas’ mission to preach unto the Gentiles and organize Christ’s Church among them. With Robert Millet, Ray Huntington, Robert J. Matthews, and Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Acts 16-18 & 1 Thes. 1: "Him Declare I unto You"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 16 through 18 which detail Paul and Silas’ preaching in Macedonia, Thessalonica, Berea, and Athens including the baptism of Lydia. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: Acts 18-20 & 1 Cor. 1-2, 12: "In the Power of God"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 18 through 20 which teach importance of proper authority and 1 Corinthians chapters 1,2, and 12 which provide Paul’s corrective words. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: 1 Cor. 15 & 2 Cor. 11-12: "O Death, Where Is Thy Sting?"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistolary sermons about resurrection and the gospel of Christ as found in 1 Corinthians chapter 15 and 2 Corinthians chapters 11 and 12. With Robert J. Matthews, Ray Huntington, Rex Reeve, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: Gal. 1-2: "But by the Revelation of Jesus Christ"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Galatians chapters 1 and 2 which detail Paul’s teaching among the Gentiles about the true gospel and his condemnation of false gospels. With Daniel Judd, David M. Whitchurch, S. Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Gal. 3-6: "Ye Are All One in Christ Jesus"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s teachings about Christ’s law and covenants superseding the law of Moses as described in Galatians chapters 3 through 6. With Daniel Judd, David M. Whitchurch, S. Kent Brown, and Gaye Strathearn.

items.title: Only by His Grace: Gal. 3 & Rom. 1-3
items.description: Religious scholars review Paul’s preaching Christ’s law in Galatians chapter 3 and discuss Paul’s teaching Christ’s gospel of salvation in Romans chapters 1 through 3. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Rom. 4-7: "Justified of Faith and Works"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Romans chapters 4 through 7 which detail Paul using the example of Abraham to teach how we are justified and sanctified through Christ’s Atonement. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Rom. 8-12: "Joint-heirs with Christ"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s teaching of how we become joint heirs with Christ in the kingdom of God as well as the law of election as found in Romans chapters 8 through 12. With Andrew Skinner, Camille Fronk, Robert Millet, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Acts 21-28: "A Minister and a Witness"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Acts chapters 21 through 28 which detail Paul’s journey to Jerusalem, the persecution and difficulties he faces, and his journey to Rome. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

items.title: Philemon, Colossians & Philippians: "Ye Are Risen with Him"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistles to Philemon, the Colossians, and the Philippians which tell of changed lives because of the gospel of Jesus Christ. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

items.title: Ephesians: "The Whole Armor of God"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s epistles to the Ephesians which prophecy of the restoration of the gospel in the latter days and the importance of baptism and families. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

items.title: 1 & 2 Timothy & Titus: "An Example of the Believers"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 and 2 Timothy and Titus which detail Paul’s counsel to teach only true doctrine and the responsibilities of priesthood offices. With Robert L. Millett, D. Kelly Ogden, Ray L. Huntington, and Robert Matthews.

items.title: 1 Tim. 2 & 1 Cor. 7 & 11: Render Due Benevolence
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Paul’s guidance on behavior and learning to new converts as found in 1 Timothy chapter 2 and 1 Corinthians chapters 7 and 11. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: Heb. 1-3: "Crowned with Glory and Honor"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Hebrews chapters 1 through 3 which detail Paul’s testimony of Jesus Christ and His role as the Only Begotten Son and Redeemer. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: Heb. 3-5 & 7: The Order of Melchizedek
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Hebrews chapters 3, 4, 5, and 7 which detail Christ’s example of priesthood authority after the order of Melchizedek. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Richard D. Draper, and Thomas A. Wayment.

items.title: Heb. 8-10, 12-13: "A More Excellent Ministry"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the new law and covenant brought by Jesus Christ as described in Hebrews chapters 8, 9, 10, 12, and 13. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

items.title: James 1; 3-5: "Be Ye Doers of the Word"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss James chapters 1 and 3 through 5 which detail the importance of gospel wisdom while in the world and how to obtain it. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

items.title: Heb. 11; James 2: "Faith without Works"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the power of faith and the importance of partnering faith with action as discussed in Hebrews chapter 11 and James chapter 2. With Robert Matthews, David M. Whitchurch, D. Kelly Ogden, and Keith J. Wilson.

items.title: 1 Pet. 1-2: "The Trial of Your Faith"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss 1 Peter chapters 1 and 2 which detail Peter’s teachings regarding faith, salvation, and Christ as the chief cornerstone. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: 2 Peter: "Partakers of the Divine Nature"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Peter’s teaching on preparing for the Second Coming and making our calling and election sure as described in the Second Epistle General of Peter. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: 1 John: "What Manner of Love"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the general epistles of John which teach of the crucial reality of Christ in the flesh and as our Savior. With Robert Matthews, Camille Fronk, Victor L. Ludlow, and W. Jeffrey Marsh.

items.title: Jude: "Remember Ye the Words"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Jude’s teachings of the Godhead, principles of the first estate, and the Second Coming as described in the General Epistle of Jude. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

items.title: Rev. 1-3: The Words of This Prophecy
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the revelation of Jesus Christ and the visions of John of the last days that begin in Revelation chapters 1 through 3. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

items.title: Rev. 1-3: "Alpha and Omega"
items.description: Religious scholars continue to discuss Revelation chapters 1 through 3 which detail John’s vision of the Risen Lord in the last days and details of eternal life. With Andrew Skinner, Victor Ludlow, Richard Draper, and Kent Brown.

items.title: Rev. 4-6: "A Sea of Glass"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the meaning of symbolic images described in Revelation chapters 4 through 6 and how these images are meant to arouse curiosity in readers. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Rev. 6-13: "Before the Throne of God"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss the symbolism of the many seals and the meaning for the last days that are described in Revelation chapters 6 through 13. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

items.title: Rev. 19-22: "King of Kings, and Lord of Lords"
items.description: Religious scholars discuss Revelation chapters 19 through 22 which detail the events that will lead to the Second Coming of Jesus Christ and details of the Millennium. With Joseph McConkie, Victor Ludlow, Jeffrey Marsh, and Richard Draper.

items.title: The Bishop's Wife
items.description: A high-strung bishop, consumed with building a new cathedral at the expense of his family, reconsiders his priorities when an angel arrives. Starring Cary Grant, David Niven, and Loretta Young.

items.title: Spring
items.description: The Otis family moves into an abandoned mansion that comes with its own mysteries. As they get to know their new neighbors, they also meet the angry ghost of Sir Simon de Canterville (Anthony Head).

items.title: Summer
items.description: Sir Simon steps up his efforts to terrorize the Americans, but the Otis family refuses to be frightened. And when the Otises are challenged by Lady Deborah to host a local cricket match, everyone braces for a royal embarrassment.

items.title: Autumn
items.description: The haunter becomes the hunted as the Otis kids attempt to capture Sir Simon. And after Hiram receives devastating news, Lucy is determined not to wallow in the loss and resolves to host a Christmas ball.

items.title: Winter
items.description: Virginia must summon all her courage to defend Sir Simon in the court of the dead. Meanwhile the twins search for buried treasure, but things go terribly wrong. Past and present collide in this stirring conclusion to the miniseries.

items.title: The Christ Child
items.description: The Nativity story of Jesus Christ is depicted, recounting the sacred events from 2,0000 years ago as described in the Gospels of Matthew and Luke in the Bible.

items.title: The Christmas Calendar
items.description: Emily, a struggling small-town baker, receives a handmade Christmas calendar from a secret admirer. As she juggles finances, romance, and a big chain store threatening to put her out of business, the calendar proves a Christmas miracle for everyone.

items.title: The Christmas Candle
items.description: A new minister arrives in town and finds the locals believing in a magic Christmas candle that grants wishes, forcing him to reconcile his faith with their tradition.

items.title: The Curse of Kirrin Island
items.description: George Barnard's life on the Dorset coast is turned upside down when she learns that her cousins are on their way from London to stay.

items.title: Peril on the Night Train
items.description: When Uncle Quentin's life's work is stolen from Kirrin Cottage, the Famous Five take the night train to Scotland and are drawn into a deadly game of espionage, theft, and deceit.

items.title: The Eye of the Sunrise
items.description: As the summer draws to a close, George sets in motion a new adventure, protecting a circus magician from an unscrupulous doctor who wishes to make use of his powers in the clinic.

items.title: Mystery at the Prospect Hotel
items.description: An old friend invites the Five to solve a murder. The twist? It hasn't happened yet.

items.title: Big Trouble on Billycock Hill
items.description: After a Spitfire plane crashes near Kirrin Cottage, the Five rescue an injured pilot with no memory. As danger closes in, they race to uncover his identity and the truth—before those hunting him strike first.

items.title: The Farmer and the Belle: Saving Santaland
items.description: When Belle, a famous model, returns to her hometown for the holidays, she reconnects with Josh, her former pen pal. As sparks fly and they fight to save Santaland, she rediscovers the true meaning of beauty, love, and Christmas magic.

items.title: The Fighting Preacher
items.description: In 1905 champion boxer Willard Bean travels to upstate New York to serve as a preacher for five years.

items.title: The Final Season
items.description: In Norway, Iowa, the community rallies around its beloved baseball team. But when the school board moves to merge with a neighboring town, the team faces one final season with new coach Kent Stock to prove their worth before everything changes.

items.title: Mt. of Olives, Mexico
items.description: The Fixers travel to Uruapan, Mexico to the Mount of Olive orphanage to build a vocational school for orphans—adding their own artistic touches along the way. Giving the kids a chance to build their future and join the job market ready to work.

items.title: Waves of Hope, Nicaragua
items.description: The Fixers travel to Northern Nicaragua to help Waves of Hope—a local charity determined to provide fresh water for the community. They’ll dig a well while simultaneously refurbishing an entire elementary school.

items.title: Shelter to Soldier, Oceanside
items.description: The Fixers travel to California to help Shelter to Soldier—an organization dedicated to adopting dogs and pairing them with post 9/11 veterans suffering from PTSD. They’ll build new kennels and training areas, hoping to save lives…two at a time.

items.title: New Roots Haiti
items.description: The Fixers help New Roots Haiti, a farm that raises livestock to create jobs for the Haitian community. They work together to build a grain mill that will allow the Haitian people to sell their corn.

items.title: Sustainable Bolivia
items.description: Working with Sustainable Bolivia, the Fixers travel to a remote village in the Bolivian Amazon. Using traditional construction methods, they help the local people build a community-run restaurant and tourism center.

items.title: Global Village Connect, Thailand
items.description: The Fixers travel to Chiang Mai, Thailand to help Global Village Connect. They will build a chicken-fish farm for the local school’s students to have an abundant source of protein.

items.title: Association of the Beatitudes, Peru
items.description: The Fixers travel to Lima, Peru to help Asociación de las Bienaventuranzas, an organization that gives abandoned special needs people a home. They build a recycling facility to help the organization generate money and promote recycling in Lima.

items.title: Orchard: Africa, South Africa
items.description: The Fixers go to Khayelitsha, South Africa to assist Orchard: Africa to build a training facility for vertical gardening.

items.title: One Heart Bulgaria
items.description: The Fixers travel to Plovdiv, Bulgaria to help One Heart Bulgaria, an organization that helps Bulgarian orphans. They will build a horse arena and sensory obstacle course to give orphans, both young and old a new type of therapy.

items.title: The People's Farm, AZ
items.description: The Fixers travel to Arizona to help the White Mountain Apache Tribe. Working with Ndee Bikiyaa (People’s Farm), they’ll repurpose an old building into a fresh market where locals can sell produce and restore confidence in local heritage.

items.title: Alaska's Healing Hearts
items.description: The Fixers travel to Alaska to help Alaska’s Healing Hearts, an organization helping veterans reintegrate into society through outdoor recreational activities. The Fixers transform the island with an outdoor kitchen, painted cabins, and a dock.

items.title: CAEMBA, Ecuador
items.description: The Fixers are off to Ecuador to work with CAEMBA, an organization that builds bamboo homes for underprivileged women. The Fixers are building a trade school with a sewing room, woodshop, kitchen, and nursery for the children.

items.title: The Lake Clinic, Cambodia
items.description: The Fixers head to Cambodia to help The Lake Clinic restore one of their floating medical clinics. They’ll update the clinic with a new floating dock, roof, kitchen, and floor.

items.title: Arecibo Capitanes, Puerto Rico
items.description: The Fixers venture to the small coastal town of Arecibo, Puerto Rico, to help rebuild a basketball court that has fallen into disrepair. The Fixers will rehabilitate the court and create murals that will draw in crowds and add beauty to the area.

items.title: Hope & Humanity United, Honduras
items.description: The Fixers travel to the rural community of La Coroza, Honduras, to help Hope and Humanity United build a bakery for a team of local women. The Fixers will build the bakery from the ground up, adding industrial kitchen appliances and a cozy cafe.

items.title: TOPPS, Arkansas
items.description: The Fixers journey to Pine Bluff, Arkansas, to work with TOPPS, a program dedicated to providing meals and a safe space for children. A facility remodel inside and a playground build outside will give the children a safe space to play and learn.

items.title: Concerned Black Men, Los Angeles
items.description: The Fixers team up with Concerned Black Men of Los Angeles and rehab an old building as CBMLA's new home.

items.title: Blue's Gym, Grand Rapids
items.description: The Fixers travel to Grand Rapids, Michigan, to help world champion kickboxer Dino Newville and Blue’s Gym in their mission to empower and educate the city's at risk youth.

items.title: COMEA, Cheyenne
items.description: The Fixers are heading to Cheyenne to work with COMEA, the largest homeless shelter in Wyoming, to build a homeless shelter designed specifically for families. And winter is coming. But the Fixers will do whatever it takes to get the job done.

items.title: CRIT, Mexico
items.description: The Fixers fly to Tampico, Mexico to work at a rehabilitation center for children with neuromuscular issues. The center is missing one crucial item – a repair shop for the equipment. The Fixers will pull out all the stops to make this build happen.

items.title: Daisy Centre Kenya
items.description: The Fixers go to the Daisy Centre School in Kenya. They educate over 500 children a year and need more resources to provide enough protein. The Fixers are here to help improve their livestock area, providing more space for cows and chickens.

items.title: ROMP Guatemala
items.description: The Fixers travel to Zacapa, Guatemala, to build a mobility lab so newly-amputated patients can test out their prosthesis on a variety of terrain.

items.title: Hunters Greave England
items.description: In Leeds, England, the Fixers refurbish an old scout camp that has fallen on hard times. This camp gives the local children a safe, fun way to experience the outdoors, but could be shut down without improvements from the Fixers.

items.title: Nizhoni Garden Navajo Nation
items.description: The Fixers go to the Navajo Nation to create a garden project at the Red Valley/Cove High School and provide fresh produce for more kids and their families.

items.title: Down Home Ranch, Texas
items.description: The Fixers head to Texas to build a gym for the Down Home Ranch, a nonprofit that gives vocational, social, and residential opportunities to adults with disabilities.

items.title: CEPIA Costa Rica
items.description: In Costa Rica, the Fixers create a space for the women in San Jose de la Pinilla to sell their baked delicacies and handmade artisanal goods.

items.title: Asajaka Weno Suriname
items.description: The Fixers travel to the remote, indigenous village of Pierre Kondre, Suriname to work with Asajaka Weno cooperative, whose mission is to inspire women from rural communities by creating entrepreneurship opportunities with pineapple products.

items.title: Crescer Portugal
items.description: In Portugal, the Fixers help Barrio Padre Cruz to build É Um Restaurante, a large restaurant that provides jobs for the unhoused community.

items.title: Trails of Purpose Virginia
items.description: The Fixers work with Trails of Purpose, a small equine therapy center that provides services free of charge to veterans struggling with PTSD.

items.title: Siksha Foundation Zambia
items.description: The Fixers head to Kitwe, Zambia to visit the Kapoto Primary school. With 3,400 students, the school is in desperate need of more classrooms. The Fixers goal is to build six new classrooms and a pre-school, giving them the space they need.

items.title: Socks
items.description: Hosts Andi Sweeney Blanco and Courtney Dober create a unique way to give socks to those in need.

items.title: Mi Casa Esperanza, Mexico
items.description: In Mexico, the Fixers help build a new playground for a women’s shelter, Mi Casa Esperanza. A new Fixer, Nick Bishop, finds an unexpected connection with the people of Mi Casa Esperanza.

items.title: Unsilenced Voices, Sierra Leone
items.description: The Fixers travel to Sierra Leone to build a cassava processing plant for an impoverished village. As they work, they learn how Muslims and Christians coexist in the area.

items.title: Humanity & Hope, Honduras
