items.description: The Fixers reunite with familiar faces as they return to a location from a previous build in Honduras to repair hurricane damage and reinforce homes in preparation for future storms.

items.title: The Lemong'o Project, Kenya
items.description: The Fixers help the Maasai in Kenya build a bead processing plant that will provide revenue for their village. Short on time and manpower, the Fixers work to provide a safe place for the women of the tribe to practice their traditional craft.

items.title: Engineering Without Borders, Argentina
items.description: In Argentina, the Fixers help a town construct an education center for students learning agriculture. The school specializes in beekeeping, and the Fixers must figure out how to extract honey from the hives.

items.title: Green VI, British Virgin Islands
items.description: The Fixers revitalize a recycling center in the British Virgin Isles to help alleviate the growing problem of trash buildup on Tortola. Original Fixer Nick Apostolides returns as a guest star to help the group with their work.

items.title: It's Humanity Foundation, Bangladesh
items.description: The Fixers face their most unique challenge yet in Bangladesh where they must turn a bus into a mobile classroom to help get pre-school education to the disadvantaged areas of Dhaka.

items.title: Battle Scarred Motorsports, Louisiana
items.description: In Louisiana, the Fixers build a racing garage for a track that serves Veterans through adrenaline therapy. A potential new Fixer is put to the test to see if he has what it takes to become a member of the team.

items.title: Ya'axché Conservation Trust, Belize
items.description: The Fixer’s work with their newest teammate, Rob, to build a new ranger station in the jungles of Belize. Their efforts help provide protection from wildfires, illegal logging, and poachers.

items.title: Caribbean Christian Center for the Deaf, Jamaica
items.description: The Fixers travel to Kingston, Jamaica to build a culinary institute for the Caribbean Christian Center for the Deaf. There they find a welcoming and generous community ready to work hard to give access to those who cannot hear.

items.title: The Fixers Season 4 Trailer
items.description: Watch the trailer for season 4 of The Fixers.

items.title: Uruguay
items.description: In Montevideo, Uruguay, the Fixers join forces with Cireneos and Father Gordo, a Catholic priest dedicated to serving his community. Together, they construct a much-needed kitchen workspace that will provide support for local residents.

items.title: Chicago
items.description: In the Pullman neighborhood of Chicago, the Fixers start off with a tour from teammate Rob North who grew up there. After the tour, they join Pullman Tech students in transforming a workshop, helping to create a lasting impact for future students.

items.title: Philippines
items.description: The Fixers partner with Smile Train, an organization that provides free care for children and young adults with cleft lips and palates. With one less day than usual and a team member falling ill, they must push through to finish the project.

items.title: Togo
items.description: n Togo, the Fixers work on a special project that promises to give more help and support teens and youth struggling with mental health.

items.title: Ghana
items.description: After receiving a call from LA Galaxy soccer star Joseph Paintsil, The Fixers travel to Ghana to team up with Project Maji, an organization dedicated to bringing safe and clean drinking water to villages all over Africa.

items.title: Greece
items.description: Working with the group We Need Books, the Fixers renovate and improve a library space for youth in Athens. During the build, they hear inspiring stories of resilience from both the founders and the young people who attend the library regularly.

items.title: Nepal
items.description: With a goal to help the organization Paint the Globe Foundation transform a classroom in Nepal, the Fixers create an inspiring space to facilitate academic opportunities for women.

items.title: Mongolia
items.description: In Mongolia, the Fixers tackle a project in a remote area. Faced with harsh weather and limited materials, their build slows and the project is put at risk.

items.title: Double Trouble
items.description: The Food Nanny Liz Edmunds is on a mission to rescue dinnertime, helping families fit the cooking and planning of meals into their lives. The Dickie family has a pair of rambunctious twins that need some help on their manners.

items.title: Chicken, Chicken
items.description: The Bates family struggles to make dinnertime a priority when schedules don’t line up for everyone to be there for dinner. The Food Nanny is to the rescue helping mom face her chicken fears and finding more consistency for the family meal times.

items.title: Hamburger Rut
items.description: The Willies family has found themselves in the habit of cooking hamburger for every meal: Tacos, Burgers, Spaghetti, and even dad’s famous Tater Tot Casserole. So The Food Nanny comes to help bring variety to their meals and save family dinner.

items.title: Money, Money, Money
items.description: The Parkin family cooks dinner on a budget and it's difficult for them to enjoy family dinnertime. The Food Nanny is to the rescue helping find a solution for them to still enjoy their old favorites and save money.

items.title: Fight the Good Fight
items.description: The Yorgusin family struggles to come together for dinner, but The Food Nanny has come to help.

items.title: Fed Up
items.description: A family of picky eaters has turned one mother into a short-order cook, making different meals for all of her family members. The Food Nanny has some ideas to help kids try new foods at dinner.

items.title: Home Sweet Bachelor Pad
items.description: Single dad takes on the challenge of taking his eating out habits and changing to make home-cooked meals for himself and his kids. The Food Nanny brings out her recipe book to help show dad how easy it can be.

items.title: Baby Steps to Dinner
items.description: After a terrible car accident, the household roles switch in the Levitt family. Dad becomes Mr. Mom and mom becomes the breadwinner. The Food Nanny helps him take baby steps to learn how easy cooking can be with her one-pot-wonder recipes.

items.title: Girls' Day Out
items.description: The Tanoka family has a habit of snacking all day. They have a hard time finding healthy options when time is so limited in the day. They call The Food Nanny, who is on a mission to help them find nutritious and easy alternatives.

items.title: Please Pass the Salt
items.description: Jenny runs a ballet studio at night and Blake works during the day, so their family dinners have fallen short. The Food Nanny helps them find a new balance between their careers and a chance to have dinner with their young family.

items.title: No-Tech Zone
items.description: When everyone is on electronics and in different places in the house, it makes it hard for dinner time to become a time for the Quiroz family to bond with each other. The Food Nanny helps them make dinner time a family activity.

items.title: No Regrets
items.description: The Peterson family are used to eating corn dogs at the ballpark three to four nights a week. The Food Nanny is to the rescue to help bring some variety and budget-friendly food to their meals.

items.title: Parker's Picky Palate
items.description: Corn, bread, and fries are some of the only things Parker eats. It makes it hard for mom and dad to cook a meal that they all like. The Food Nanny has come to conquer Parker’s food fears and help create a better meal plan for the Christensen family.

items.title: Spicing It Up
items.description: In the Roper house, dad likes a lot of spice in his food, but mom likes things bland. The Food Nanny is going to help them come to a middle ground on their food tastes and help spice up the conversations at dinnertime.

items.title: Dinner and a Song
items.description: With very different lifestyles and a job that doesn’t have set hours, it makes dinnertime a challenge at the Abernathy house. The Food Nanny has come to bring some home-cooked meals into this young family’s kitchen.

items.title: Downsize Me
items.description: The Nales don’t own a dining table because of the economic downturn and want to start changing their meals to a healthy alternative. The Food Nanny steps in to help them find meals and space to eat healthy on a budget.

items.title: La Vita Vera
items.description: The Food Nanny visits a generations-old New York grocery store where they make mozzarella cheese using a traditional family recipe. Liz gets to go behind the scenes to make their famous eggplant parmigiano.

items.title: Give Mom a Break
items.description: When mom and dad grew up in Germany and the kids grew up in the U.S., dinnertime comes with some cultural differences. The Food Nanny helps the Kell family find meals that everyone will love.

items.title: Running from Ramen
items.description: Scott Manning and his five college roommates call on The Food Nanny to help them find meals that are delicious, budget-friendly, and will help them find time to spend together during their busy schedules.

items.title: Making Memories
items.description: Spring lost her husband a couple years ago and has found it hard to make meal time a priority for her and her toddler. The Food Nanny helps support and bring some hope to this window through cooking and dinnertime.

items.title: Holy Cannoli
items.description: The Food Nanny visits Ferarra, a traditional Italian restaurant in New York City. She bakes cannoli and gnocchi and talks with the owner, Ernest, about the importance of La Vita Vera, or "the true life" through dinnertime with family.

items.title: Rockin' with the Nanny
items.description: The Food Nanny helps America’s Got Talent semi-finalists and starving college students John and Cruise Russo make time for dinner. Performing with their band, Reverse Order, and going to college limits both their time and money for dinnertime.

items.title: Four Jobs and a Baby
items.description: When the New York fast-paced lifestyle crashes on family dinnertime, The Food Nanny helps the Chappells make mealtime more of priority.

items.title: G'pop's Surprise
items.description: In search of both a signature family dish to bring to Thanksgiving dinner and a way to stop their take-out and TV binge, The Food Nanny helps the Moores make dinner a family event.

items.title: Oh Dinner, Where Art Thou?
items.description: Utah’s mother of the year can seem to keep up with everything but family dinner time. The Food Nanny brings a love of cooking back into the Dunn family kitchen.

items.title: Slice of Life
items.description: The Beckstrands go through loaves and loaves of bread every week, but mom can’t quite figure out how to successfully make homemade bread. The Food Nanny shares her grandmother's bread-making traditions and helps the Beckstrands make flawless bread.

items.title: Dog Gone Dinner
items.description: When diet restrictions make limit dinner options, the Beacom family struggles to find something everyone likes and mom enjoys cooking. The Food Nanny helps rescue dinnertime.

items.title: Joie de Vivre
items.description: French cook Jean Louis and restaurant owner in Park City, Utah, shows The Food Nanny how to cook coq au vin and shares his experience with La Vita Vera.

items.title: Fire's Burning but Dinner's Cold
items.description: With a captain with special dietary needs and when a call might come in at any minute, it is hard for these firefighters to have an actual dinnertime. The Food Nanny comes to help.

items.title: 10-Minute Meal
items.description: When an old friend needs help putting more veggies on the table and putting dinner on the table in ten minutes, the Food Nanny comes to the rescue.

items.title: Danish Delights
items.description: The Food Nanny takes a trip to a Danish town in Solvang, California. She learns how to make aebleskiver, frikadeller, chocolate, and learns the importance of hyggelig.

items.title: The Blind Shall Lead
items.description: The Food Nanny travels to Las Vegas to help patrons of the Blind Center of Nevada conquer cooking without their eyesight and share the love of La Vita Vera once again.

items.title: Taming the Grill
items.description: At The Dream Center in Los Angeles, California, The Food Nanny learns about the program they have to help homeless people and helps others fulfill their dreams of cooking.

items.title: Flipping over Filippi's
items.description: The Food Nanny cooks some easy Italian meals with Danny Mocceri at Fillippi’s Pizza Grotto in San Diego’s Little Italy and learns more about La Vita Vera.

items.title: In Search of La Vita Vera
items.description: The Food Nanny visits the Parolini family in Lucca, Italy. She relives the experience that first taught her the importance of la vita vera.

items.title: Florence Fried Chicken
items.description: The Food Nanny helps Rafaela cook fried chicken, while also learning how to make some Italian classics herself, like gelato and pepper mushroom pasta.

items.title: Greek Goodness
items.description: The Food Nanny visits Athens, Greece to learn how to make coriatiki and yemista from a local chef.

items.title: Home on the Range
items.description: On the Rockin’ R Ranch in Antimony Utah, The Food Nanny learns how to make rolls, shredded pork, apple pie, and more in a dutch oven.

items.title: Dinner Is Served
items.description: The Food Nanny helps Olympians Kerri Walsh and Casey Jennings find a way to bring a piece of home with them on the road.

items.title: Turkish Delight
items.description: The Food Nanny travels to Turkey to make Turkish slow-cooked casserole, güveç, and homemade ekmek, with her friend Kiya.

items.title: Tour of Italy
items.description: The Food Nanny takes a tour of Italy, visiting Pisa, Florence, Tuscany, and Venice to taste black ink squid pasta, Italian chocolate, and more.

items.title: Mediterranean Cruise
items.description: The Food Nanny joins master chef David Reihona aboard a Royal Caribbean cruise ship, sailing the Mediterranean coast, to learn all about la vita vera far from home.

items.title: Rock 'n' Mojo
items.description: Brandon Campbell, bassist for Neon Trees, finds his family struggling to make dinner a priority and asks The Food Nanny for help.

items.title: London Calling
items.description: The Food Nanny visits London to help the Harper family, and to taste London's delicacies, like fish and chips.

items.title: Kitchen Idol
items.description: American Idol top five finalist, Brooke White, and her husband, Dave, struggle to find time for family dinner when they are working so hard to make her music career a success.

items.title: The Spirit of Aloha
items.description: The Food Nanny visits The North Shore in Oahu, Hawaii to experience the food and lifestyle. She makes stops at Matsumoto’s Shaved Ice, Tita’s Grill, The Dole Plantation, and Giovanni’s Shrimp Truck.

items.title: Catch a Wave
items.description: The Food Nanny helps the Walkers prepare a Hawaiian Luau, experiences the taro fields, tries surfing, and learns more about Hawaiian culture.

items.title: The Gift of Christmas
items.description: When Christmas arrives, Pastor George grows concerned for his flock. Hoping to help reunite a daughter with her estranged father, he enlists his brother Allen—but his well-meaning interference sparks unexpected tension.

items.title: The Case of the Curious New Girl / The Case of the Disappearing Deliveries
items.description: When Maudie solves a playground robbery on her first day at school, she and new friends Ezra, Ava and Kyle create The Inbestigators Detective Agency. Also, when Sophie's online parcels are delivered but never received, she hires the Inbestigators.

items.title: The Case of the Missing Solar System / The Case of the Distressed Dancer
items.description: Pixie is horrified when her space diorama goes missing and Miss Tan falsely accuses her of not doing her homework. Also, when his dance troupe's concert routine is sabotaged, Zac hires the Inbestigators to find out who at the academy is responsible.

items.title: The Case of the Sleepover Secret / The Case of the Big Mouth Challenge
items.description: Pixie is furious when something she privately told Ava is made public, so Maudie resolves to find out how Pixie's secret got out. Also, when Ben mounts a competition to see who can fit a large biscuit in their mouth like he can, Maudie is suspicious.

items.title: The Case of the Pestering Prank Caller / The Case of the Spoiled Sports Day
items.description: When a prank caller targets Ezra and his neighbors, Maudie believes the Inbestigators can track down who is making the mystery calls. Also, four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging their adventures and becoming fast friends.

items.title: The Case of the Exciting Excursion / The Case of the Very Lost Notebook
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Suspect Sprinkler / The Case of the Peculiar Pop Quiz
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Science Sabotage / The Case of the Wrecked Rehearsal
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Perplexing Painting / The Case of the Turtle Thief
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Misplaced Mug / The Case of the Sad Little Sister
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Disoriented Drone / The Case of the Baffling Birthday
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Concert Catastrophe / The Case of the Soccer Saga
items.description: Maudie stashes a stack of tickets in a drawer for safekeeping, but somebody takes them; a so-so soccer player is suddenly a lot better than he used to be.

items.title: The Case of the Puzzling Pet Day; The Case of the Copy Cat
items.description: The animal shelter comes to school to film a commercial; at an event for future leaders, Ava is accused of stealing someone else's speech.

items.title: The Case of the Rosemary Riddle; The Case of the Robot Robbery
items.description: Ezra's nana cooks up a mystery at the market; a student's robot costume goes missing on Science and Technology Day.

items.title: The Case of the Vanishing Koalas; The Case of the Extremely Empty Freezer
items.description: The latest snack craze sparks a theft at school; the kids throw Mr. Barker a 1980s-themed birthday party, but they can't find the cake.

items.title: The Case of the Miraculous Mini Golfer/The Case of the Problematic Party
items.description: A miniature golfer's winning streak sounds too good to be true; the whole class is invited to a laser tag and pizza party for birthday boy Toby who winds up needing the Inbestigators' help.

items.title: The Case of the Lousy Lunch Orders; The Case of the Interrupting Intern
items.description: Ezra orders pizza but gets a salad roll instead, prompting the Inbestigators to find out who swapped the students' Treat Day lunches for healthier foods; the Inbestigators take on an intern.

items.title: The Case of the Freaky Frequency; The Case of the Tricky Trimathlon
items.description: Mrs. Maniaci's doorbell is broken, and nobody's car keys are working; Kyle and Ezra team up for an online math competition.

items.title: The Case of the Burgled Bags; The Case of the Distracted Detective
items.description: Four clever students start their own detective agency, vlogging about their adventures and becoming fast friends in the process.

items.title: The Case of the Fishy Fundraiser / The Case of the Incredible Fortune Teller
items.description: Someone sabotages a lemonade stand; at a school fundraiser, the fortune teller's predictions are eerily accurate.

items.title: The Case of the Unhappy Camper / The Case of the Triple Inbestigation
items.description: Someone slips Mr. McGillick's phone into a tub of rice; the Inbestigators shoot a commercial, but, first, they have to find Ezra's fish.

items.title: The Kid Who Only Hit Homers
items.description: For Syl Coddmeyer, baseball is in his blood; however, he can't seem to hit the ball. After a mysterious man coaches him out of his slump, Syl becomes an overnight sensation....but what happens when his luck runs out?

items.title: The Gift of Faith
items.description: Leon Logothetis starts a new journey from Alaska to Argentina depending entirely on the generosity of strangers for fuel, food, and lodging. He meets a man who, despite battling cancer, helps men struggling with addiction to get back on their feet.

items.title: The Gift of Community
items.description: Leon continues his journey through freezing Canada. He encounters people who help him dig his car out of the snow, let him stay in a lodge, and teach him curling. He also meets with a coordinator of an immigrant and refugee organization.

items.title: The Gift of Purpose
items.description: After getting help fixing his windshield wipers, Leon travels through Montana. He stays with people who have exotic pets before traveling through the woods and avoiding wild animals. He meets someone who followed her dream to help others.

items.title: The Gift of Home
items.description: Leon gets a fresh shave in Beaver, Utah, before visiting a cattle ranch in Cedar City. He drives through Las Vegas and stops in Tijuana, Mexico, and meets a man who helps those trying to immigrate to the United States.

items.title: The Gift of Food
items.description: When his travel plans are upended, Leon goes back to San Diego to make new plans for his trip to Argentina. He finally secures passage to Costa Rica with a layover in Houston, Texas, where he works with veterans who help hurricane victims.

items.title: The Gift of Shelter
items.description: Leon tries to avoid crocodiles and faces his fear of heights while ziplining in the jungles of Costa Rica. He then meets missionaries who refuse his gift of generosity so that a family in need can better their lives.

items.title: The Gift of Hope
items.description: Leon leaves his car behind as he travels to a village in Panama where there is no electricity and feels real connection with the people. He then goes to Panama City to board a container ship which will take him through the Panama Canal to Colombia.

items.title: The Gift of Winnie Love
items.description: Leon takes the risk of driving through dangerous territory in Colombia on his way to Quito, Ecuador. He speaks with a leader of Hari Krishna that helps lift his spirits after a difficult day on his trip. He then meets a woman who takes in stray dogs.

items.title: The Gift of Connection
items.description: Leon takes the risk of filming undercover at the border of Venezuela to share the story of a woman who has gone through a lot of hardships. He runs out of gas on his way to Lima, Peru where he meets a man who hosts many world travelers.

items.title: The Gift of Knowledge
items.description: While traveling through Peru, Leon sees the terrible conditions enslaved people endured on plantations. He also revisits the woman who built an orphanage where he worked 20 years ago which inspired his trips around the world.

items.title: The Gift of Travel
items.description: Leon leaves Peru and continues on to Bolivia where he encounters another world traveler. He visits the Uyuni Salt Flats and meets a young musician who moves him to tears.

items.title: The Gift of Friendship
items.description: Leon visits the Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid museum before leaving Bolivia to finally arrive in Argentina. He struggles to find someone who speaks English until he connects with a foreign student from Haiti.

items.title: The Gift of Kindness
items.description: As Leon reaches his final destination in southern Argentina, he reflects on his trip, the places and things he experienced, and the people who inspired him along the way.

items.title: The Legend of 5 Mile Cave
items.description: In 1929, a stranger rents a room on a widow's farm and tells tales of the Old West to her son. As they bond, the boy suspects he knows too much about a gold robbery—and discovers the secret that could save their farm.

items.title: The Letter Writer
items.description: Maggy is struggling with school, friends, and at home when she receives a letter from someone she doesn’t know. After tracking down and befriending the writer, Sam, Maggy is inspired to turn her life around and use her gifts to help others.

items.title: The Mighty Macs
items.description: Based on a true story, Cathy Rush volunteers to coach Immaculata’s struggling women’s basketball team in 1971. With no gym, no uniforms, and barely enough players, Cathy’s determination and grit are all she has as she prepares her team for nationals.

items.title: The Nativity Song by BYU Concert Choir
items.description: Celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ with The Nativity Song, performed by the BYU Concert Choir. Rich choral harmonies and a reverent spirit bring the Christmas story to life, offering a peaceful reminder of the hope and joy of the season. Hear it now

items.title: Jake Parker
items.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen sit down with cartoonist Jake Parker to learn what inspires him to create and how he’s using artistic collaboration to connect with his community.

items.title: Shaun "Shonduras" McBride
items.description: Austin and Jordan meet social media star Shonduras and discover what motivates him as a creator. The hosts challenge Shonduras to step out of his comfort zone and create an inspirational mural.

items.title: Eric Mesplé
items.description: Eric Mesplé combines computer science and sculpture as he creates innovative and interactive works of art. Austin and Jordan peek behind the curtain to see how Eric Mesplé brings his creations to life.

items.title: Michelle Osorio
items.description: Austin and Jordan meet virtual storyteller Michelle Osorio and learn how virtual reality and 360-degree video are changing the way artists create.

items.title: Aisha Fukushima
items.description: Musician Aisha Fukushima combines her activism and talent as a rapper into raptivism, inspiring people around the world to give back to their communities and engage in pressing social issues.

items.title: Kirby Ferguson
items.description: Independent filmmaker Kirby Ferguson teaches Austin and Jordan how to explore new ways of thinking as they create a video essay.

items.title: Benjamin Von Wong
items.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen meet Benjamin von Wong, an emerging visual engineer who uses his photography to bring awareness to important social issues.

items.title: Patrick Rochon
items.description: Artist Patrick Rochon introduces Austin and Jordan to light painting, a type of photography that uses long exposure cameras and multicolored lights to create innovative works of art.

items.title: Mindy Gledhill & Trisha Zemp: Part 1
items.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Petersen unite singer-songwriter Mindy Gledhill and stop-motion animator Trisha Zemp to create a one-of-a-kind music video.

items.title: Mindy Gledhill & Trisha Zemp: Part 2
items.description: Hosts Austin Craig and Jordan Peterson, singer-songwriter Mindy Gledhill and animator Trisha Zemp work to finish Mindy’s stop-motion music video before their deadline.

items.title: The Other Side of Heaven
items.description: Based on a true story. After leaving Idaho to serve in the remote islands of Tonga, a young missionary faces opposition and experiences miracles while learning to love the people he came to serve. Also starring Anne Hathaway.

items.title: The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith
items.description: John H. Groberg returns to Tonga with his young family when he is called as mission president. They sail dangerous seas and serve the people of the Pacific Islands. When their newborn gets very ill, the island people of all faiths pray together.

items.title: Better Half
items.description: Tony and Cleo plan to celebrate their six-month anniversary, but Tony gets distracted at work. Victoria and Nathan try to outdo each other when buying gifts for their parents.

items.title: Calling Dr. Anderson
items.description: Cleo is eager to return to work after a six-month absence. Tony has to work with his nephew, balancing the roles of agent and uncle.

items.title: Bittersweet Sixteen
items.description: Tony and Cleo learn the importance of parenting while preparing a party for Nathan’s 16th birthday. Roger is excited that Charlie is named his school’s hall monitor and takes him to work to show him the ropes.

items.title: Yes, And…?
items.description: To bond with her father and brother, Victoria joins their improv class. Meanwhile, Cleo helps Nick restore his reputation with the city of Chicago.

items.title: This Wasn’t the Plan
items.description: Tony accompanies Cleo to a dental conference. Victoria and Nathan go to the movies together, but Victoria is bullied for her cosplay.

items.title: Parker Anderson Can’t Lose
items.description: Victoria enlists Nathan’s help with her student body presidential campaign. Tony asks for a day alone to honor his his late wife, Joy, but keeps getting interrupted.

items.title: Father & Sons
items.description: The family takes a trip to the mall, where Tony and Nathan are racially profiled in a store. Victoria realizes her own racial prejudices.

items.title: Everyone and the Kitchen Sink
items.description: Tony and Cleo DIY their kitchen sink. Victoria struggles to work with her team on a group project

items.title: A Home for Harvey
items.description: Cleo’s father, Harvey, comes to stay with the family after Tony delays his plans to move to a retirement home. With Nick’s guidance, a fragile Roger attempts to rejoin the dating pool.

items.title: Great Expectations
items.description: When Cleo botches a big presentation, she discovers shocking news that will change the family’s life forever. Tony faces his biggest test as Nick’s agent as he renegotiates a new contract for him.

items.title: The Potential Inside
items.description: A retired veteran cyclist, Chris Carmik, trains a cycling prodigy, using cutting-edge techniques and technology.

items.title: The Primrose Railway Children
items.description: When their father disappears, the Robinson kids are whisked away by their mother to a summer cottage in the old railway town of Primrose. There, Phoebe uses her vivid imagination to search for clues and uncover what really happened to her father.

items.title: The Real Mo Farah
items.description: Sir Mo Farah, UK-bound as a child, toiled as an illegal domestic servant, adopting a false name. Revealing a hidden past, he shares the truth about his journey from Djibouti, challenging the narrative of his refugee origin.

items.title: The Game Has Changed
items.description: King McClure launches The Rotation with Jaden Owens, Cat Osterman, Olivia Petnicki, Alex Glover-Jemison and Diljeet Taylor for a candid conversation about college athletics, culture and life beyond sports.

items.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
items.description: With a deadline looming, editor Isabell retreats to her family's cabin for inspiration, where a local helps her revive the Christmas Festival and discover the ending to her own story.

items.title: The Trek Begins
items.description: The spin of a pen sends Todd Hansen knocking on strangers' doors, where he finds amazing stories from everyday people like the Bear family, Elaine and Doug Alder, and Floyd Hunt.

items.title: Excited about Nothing
items.description: Todd braves single-digit temperatures in Colorado to find amazing stories from Cecil Gardner and the Hogan family and even his own private rap concert with the Cunninghams.

items.title: Yesterday I Was In Jail
items.description: Todd ends up at the home of Troy Riley, who was in jail just a few hours earlier. Todd hears the inspiring story of Jamie Pluta. He is invited into the Salway home where Brandi runs a cookie business.

items.title: It's My Country
items.description: Todd meets Ed Pacha, a WWII veteran who tells his amazing story, and the Killen family opens up about their life. Todd meets a Floridian glass harp player.

items.title: A Tragic Twist
items.description: Todd Hansen heads to Tooele, Utah, where he meets a rapper named Michael Espinoza. Todd also meets Clar Hansen, a prayerful mechanic. A Vietnam War veteran named Jay Jeppesen shows off his miniature train set.

items.title: Every Day Is for Them
items.description: Todd goes to Searcy, Arkansas and meets Bindi Barnett, an immigrant mother from India who has overcome incredible odds to keep her children safe. Todd heads to Beebe and interviews Jerry Greer, a trucker who experienced a health scare.

items.title: Losing a Loved One
items.description: Todd meets Vicki Darais, who’s personal tragedy inspired her to be a physical therapist to help others. He also talks to Aiken, Minnesota native Michele Piispanen and her health struggles.

items.title: The Big Apple
items.description: Todd travels to Ohio and meets widower Chuck LaPrad, who tells the love story of he and his wife, Jean, and their 54 years of marriage. Bob Placier of Chillicothe, Ohio talks about his model airplane hobby.

items.title: Olympic Dreams
items.description: Todd Hansen trudges through the Utah snow to find stories, like aviator Dave Mueller. He discusses how he handles the trauma of a plane crash through therapeutic painting. Todd also meets Tanisha Jackson and Jeremy Hansen, survivors of gang violence.

items.title: A Rude Awakening
items.description: Todd Hansen goes to Auburn, California and interviews Allen Cassidy, a friendly do-gooder for the less fortunate in the neighborhood. Claudia Castro of Roseville shares how she stays positive when times get tough.

items.title: Extra Special Day
items.description: Todd interviews returned missionaries and their experience with coming home. Cherice and Rick Foster share about their son Ryan, Paulina and Eric Smith talk about their love story, and Kyle Norton talks about his unique family.

items.title: Light Where There Was No Light
items.description: Todd Hansen goes to Ogden and meets Josh Hurst on the street. Josh had a near-death experience that left him disabled, but recovered miraculously with the help of his mother. Ashlee Egbert tells about her recovery after abuse and drug addiction.

items.title: I Miss Him Every Day
items.description: Todd meets an artist named Jonathan Kort in Neotsu, Oregon, who speaks about his mental health. In Lincoln City, Todd interviews Loretta Glaze about keeping faith in times of struggle.

items.title: Culture Shock
items.description: Host Todd Hansen visits Herriman, Utah to hear the story of Dave Johnston, an Air Force veteran with a passion for genealogy. In Draper, Jennie Bethers tells of her years as a former gymnast and TV commercial star.

items.title: Be Good. Be Smart. Be Careful.
items.description: In the small town of Carlisle, Pennsylvania, Todd meets Sharon Carey, a single mother who provides hope to her family despite ongoing health issues. Over in Gettysburg, Carolyn Mintmier speaks about her troubled past and the power of gratitude.

items.title: Quest for a Story
items.description: In the quiet town of Lebanon, Connecticut, host Todd Hansen meets local resident Cheryl Wilhelm and learns about her journey to find joy in life despite troubled relationships.

items.title: The "Perfect" Family
items.description: In Payson, Utah, host Todd Hansen hears from Ryan Deems, a recovering addict who discovered how puppetry helped him with his recovery.

items.title: Protecting Strangers
items.description: Through quiet towns in rural Washington, host Todd Hansen meets Tom Barkholz and learns of his rocky journey to fatherhood.

items.title: A Better Life
items.description: In Saratoga Springs, Utah, Todd hears stories from Connie Server about her days traveling through Ellis Island in the early 20th century.

items.title: A Marvelous Experience
items.description: Todd’s cross-country trek takes him to Pollock, Idaho where he meets Virginia James and her daughter Katherine Coonts and learns about their troubled relationship. In New Meadows, Todd meets Archie Breedlove, a veteran who lives life to the fullest.

items.title: The Random Virtuoso
items.description: In the neighborhoods of Salt Lake City, host Todd Hansen hears stories from Nick Beddoes about his experience with addiction and from Erich Graf about his time as a flutist in the Utah Symphony.

items.title: Tough Love
items.description: On the Great Plains of South Dakota, Todd interviews Slim McNaught and learns of his experiences as a leatherworker and his passion for cowboy poetry.

items.title: The Glass Is Always Full
items.description: In Wellington, Utah, Sisters Lil Duncan and Betty Flom tell stories of their difficult childhoods and how the power of service gave them a new purpose in life.

items.title: Serving the Country
items.description: Host Todd Hansen travels to West Virginia where he hears the inspiring life stories of three veterans: Les Beaton, Royal Gilkey, and Jackson Radabaugh.

items.title: Season Finale
items.description: In this special episode, creator and host Todd Hansen gives a behind-the-scenes look at how some of the best interviews of the season came to be and updates viewers on the lives of his guests after their appearances on the show.

items.title: A Different Road
items.description: Along the Treasure Coast in Florida, host Todd Hansen meets Yvonne Gargiulo who shares how her family helped her stay positive following her husband’s death.

items.title: Stay Linked
items.description: In the heart of Texas, host Todd Hansen learns how important high school football is to the residents of Refugio City. Football coach Jason Herring shares what helped him bring his team to the state championship.

items.title: The Accident That Changed My Life
items.description: A tour of Orem, Utah has host Todd Hansen hear Charis Wagenman’s inspiring story of how a tragic car accident saved her life.

items.title: Work Now and Play Later
items.description: A visit to Henryetta, Oklahoma, has host Todd Hansen sit down with high schooler Logan Dewitt to hear his perspective of teenage life in his small town.

items.title: The Unlikely Hero
items.description: A trip to Sulphur, Louisiana has host Todd Hansen meet Teresa Moss and hears what makes her a hero as she cares for her younger sister following their mother’s passing.

items.title: My Miracle
items.description: Tiffany Dalley of Salt Lake City shares her story of how she turned her life around following a series of strange accidents and through learning the importance of self love.

items.title: An Amazing Mind
items.description: In Honeyville, Utah, host Todd Hansen meets Harold Wise, a 70-year-old rodeo star who is determined to live life to the fullest.

items.title: How to Change the World
items.description: In the small town of Midway, Utah, Todd interviews David and Jennifer Curtis and learns about their mission to give back to underserved communities across the globe with their nonprofit Interweave.

items.title: Biker Gangs and Basketball
items.description: Todd ventures to Unionville, Nevada, where he meets Joanna Davis and hears about her journey of escaping abuse in the Bay Area to finding her haven in the middle of nowhere.

items.title: Piano Prodigies
items.description: In Alpine, Utah, Race Davies shares the sacrifices his parents made to purchase a baby grand piano and how this decision has impacted his family for generations.

items.title: Defining Moments
items.description: Host Todd Hansen visits the small town of Woodbury, Tennessee, where Wanda and Robert Todd share how their teenage romance helped them escape years of domestic violence.

items.title: The Bullied Beauty Queen
items.description: In Park City, Utah, host Todd Hansen meets local movie critic Marilyn Phillips and learns how her daughter Allison uses her platform as a pageant queen to share her experiences of bullying.

items.title: Route 66
items.description: In Flagstaff, Arizona, Todd meets Everett Walter, a former math professor searching for an answer after his son’s unexpected death. In Winslow, David Smith shares his goal to get a master’s degree to someday help at-risk youth.

items.title: The Mamma Bird Man
items.description: In Nephi, Utah, resident Brian Hansen shares how an act of kindness led him to create an unexpected bond with an abandoned baby starling.

items.title: The Child Entrepreneur
items.description: Host Todd Hansen travels to the small town of Mackinaw, Illinois and meets Lauryn Eitenmiller, a young entrepreneur with a passion for duct tape crafts, pogo sticks, and tackle football.

items.title: Art Postponed
items.description: Roger Reaves shares how his time in the Vietnam War impacted his life and led him to follow his true passion in becoming an artist.

items.title: Hamming It Up
items.description: In the city of Adamsboro, Indiana, host Todd Hansen meets Tom Hartoin, a Vietnam veteran who is using his disability to discover new hobbies like operating a ham radio.

items.title: The Family Name
items.description: In Logan, Utah, college student Logan Beckstrand shares how his grandpa’s service in World War II has inspired him to strive for success.

items.title: The Message
items.description: Host Todd Hansen randomly winds up in Bay City, Michigan, where he meets Claire Gregory, an artisan committed to restoring the historical homes of her city.

items.title: God Has Something Better
items.description: In North Carolina, Todd interviews Rosa Fryar and Terri McDuffie–two women who inspire their small towns with their acts of service and examples of faith.

items.title: The Gregs
items.description: Best friends, landlords, and handymen Greg Campbell and Greg Gibson sit down with host Todd Hansen to share what makes their friendship so special.

items.title: A Family in Crisis
items.description: In Columbia, Missouri, Todd meets local citizen Dick Parker and learns about his colorful life as a university professor, a member of a hippie commune, a truck driver, and a father of four.

items.title: A Deadly Plane Crash
items.description: Resident of St. George, Utah, Cindy Hafen shares how a tragic plane accident helped her gain a new perspective on life and understand the importance of spending time with your loved ones.

items.title: A Look Back
items.description: In this special episode, host Todd Hansen sits with members of his crew Eric and Shirstie Gaylord, Troy Slade, and Aaron Southerland to give a behind the scenes look at how The Story Trek is made.

items.title: Outlaws, Oil, and Millionaires
items.description: Host Todd Hansen kicks off the season in Naples, Utah where Bill Martin shares his inspiring rags-to-riches story.

items.title: America, the Best of the Best
items.description: In Western Nebraska, Todd interviews Dr. Mark Chu and learns how faith and service brought the Hong Kong native to the rural Midwest.

items.title: Not So Typical
items.description: Todd finds his way to Dixon, Wyoming where he meets Keith Duncan, an introverted rancher with a passion for inventing new tools and making saddles by hand.

items.title: When Life Throws You a Curve Ball
items.description: In Salt Lake City, host Todd Hansen meets Darry Duran, a man trying to piece his life back together after a series of bad decisions in his youth changed him forever.

items.title: Just One Decision
items.description: David Hardy shares his journey of being a teenage symphony composer to becoming a full-time artist under the direction of one of the greatest sculptors of the 20th century, Colin Webster-Watson.

items.title: Chasing Your Dreams
items.description: In Peabody, Massachusetts, Todd meets aspiring radio personality Derek Shapiro who turns the tables and asks Todd to be a guest on his radio show.

items.title: The Diagnosis
items.description: Shelby and Michael Ronan of New Boston, New Hampshire share their commitment to live life to the fullest after Shelby’s recent diagnosis of multiple sclerosis.

items.title: The Cookie Jar Marriage
items.description: Down in Scipio, Utah, host Todd Hansen meets Dean and Connie Larsen and learns the sweet secret behind their marriage of sixty years.

items.title: The Diva and the Strong Silent Type
items.description: A visit to Augusta, Georgia has host Todd Hansen meet two young siblings with strikingly different personalities—Josie and Sam Engler.

items.title: A Junk Mail Miracle
items.description: Todd makes his way through sunny South Carolina, where he meets Virginia Miles, a golf-cart-driving grandma who's known as the troublemaker of her small town.

items.title: Hollywood in the Desert
items.description: Todd meets foreign exchange student Vivi Lin and learns about her journey of coming from Taiwan to work at Clines Corners–New Mexico’s famous rest stop.

items.title: One Tough Girl
items.description: In Northern Utah, Todd visits with Chrystal Julius who shares how a near-death experience inspired her to face the challenges of life head on.

items.title: The Aloha Spirit
items.description: In the season finale, host Todd Hansen randomly ends up in Hawaii where he interviews Warren Baba, a legacy islander whose family created one of the most successful shoe companies on the island.

items.title: In Love with the Past
items.description: Host Todd Hansen kicks off the season with a trip to Colorado where he meets Fred Holly, a down-to-earth cowboy with a collection of over 700 pairs of cowboy boots.

items.title: You Just Do It
items.description: Shirley Prettyman shares how she learned to provide for her family after becoming a young widow with eight children.

items.title: The Dream
items.description: A trip to Southeastern Idaho has host Todd Hansen meet local resident Ashley McQuivey who shares the story of her fight with chronic lyme disease.

items.title: I Prayed He Would Die
items.description: Host Todd Hansen finds his way to southern Utah where he meets Charlie Helquist and hears his story of overcoming addiction and finding joy in sobriety.

items.title: Color Blind
items.description: Down in Starkville, Mississippi, Natoya Edison-Tate shares how a recent diagnosis has challenged her ability to work and travel the world with her friends.

items.title: Cowboy Heaven
items.description: Cheyanne Talbot of Palmyra, Utah shares how her family has put the pieces back together following her son’s unexpected death.

items.title: The Heart of Dixie
items.description: Todd sits down with Kim and Rob Rose of Wetumpka, Alabama, who share how their romance in Japan led them to become parents of talented scholars and athletes.

items.title: Our Angel
items.description: In the small town of Erda, Utah, Emily Canton details how taking care of her niece with Dandy-Walker syndrome has changed her life.

items.title: Riding the Rails
items.description: Larry Crowley of Spring Brook, Wisconsin, tells Todd of the years he spent riding the rails across the country to find work.

items.title: I Wish I Could Go Back
items.description: Todd sits down with Eric Sether of Zimmerman, Minnesota who shares a cautionary tale about the choices he made that destroyed his marriage and family.

items.title: The Best of the Story Trek
items.description: Host Todd Hansen takes a look back at season five and shares some of his favorite stories from his travels.

items.title: In Seven Minutes
items.description: In Shawnee, Kansas, 17-year-old Daniel Messick shares how he left a world of alcohol, drugs, and parties behind to follow his calling and become a missionary.

items.title: $100 a Day
items.description: Tina Davis of Cedar City, Utah shares her wisdom in living each day as though it is $100 and she has the choice of how to spend it.

items.title: Changing Directions
items.description: Denita Conway tells her story of working hard to honor her mother’s legacy and create a bright future for her daughters.

items.title: I Should Be Dead
items.description: In Elberta, Utah, Todd meets Davey Smith and hears how a tragic shotgun accident when he was younger gave him a new perspective on life.

items.title: Old Dominion
items.description: Janie Overby of South Boston, Virginia, takes Todd by surprise with her “chicken dance” and her touching commitment to raise her sick nephew.

items.title: The Fight Back
items.description: Host Todd Hansen meets Melinda Roalstad of Kamas, Utah, who shares her groundbreaking work in researching and treating concussions.

items.title: Role of a Lifetime
items.description: David Cioffi of Rutland, Vermont, describes leaving behind his dreams of being an actor so he could run the family business and support his family.

items.title: The Cat That Saved My Life
items.description: In Kaysville, Utah, Todd meets florist Robert Waite and learns how an encounter with a friendly stray cat changed his life.

items.title: Upstate Cinderella
items.description: Todd finds his way to upstate New York where he meets Paula Towne, an artist healing from her abusive childhood by blessing people’s lives with her beautiful artwork.

items.title: Pennies from Heaven
items.description: Todd’s visit to the Bluegrass State has him meet Judy Jett who details the ways her husband communicates with her from the afterlife.

items.title: No Complaints
items.description: Host Todd Hansen kicks off the season in New Jersey where he struggles to find people who will share their stories.

items.title: Medals Don't Matter
items.description: Decorated veteran Roy Huff shares how medals and a successful career pale in comparison to the years he spent with his beloved wife.

items.title: The Torrey Trek
items.description: The Story Trek lands in Torrey, Utah, where Todd meets Adus Dorsey, a man committed to preserving the histories of the people in his town through interviews and videos.

items.title: Hidden Treasure
items.description: Todd meets Chris Fannin of Osage, Iowa, and learns how she donates all of the proceeds of her thrift store to nonprofits in her community.

items.title: Blind Optimism
items.description: In Salt Lake City, Todd sits down with Matt Burn and learns how he has adapted to life without vision.

items.title: The Last Frontier
items.description: Host Todd Hansen winds up in Ketchikan, Alaska, where he meets 11-year-old Patrick Garcia, an aspiring NBA star.

items.title: The Years Play On
items.description: In Henefer, Utah, Todd meets organist Arvilla Fawcett who shares her story of serving others through music over the past 70 years.

items.title: A Higher High
items.description: Todd finds himself in Warwick, Rhode Island, where Dave Cunetta shares his redemption story following years of drug abuse.

items.title: 100 and Counting
items.description: Todd celebrates the 100th episode of The Story Trek with a visit to his very first guests, Damien and Liz Bear, and shares memories of his favorite moments on the show.

items.title: Habit Forming
items.description: In Brunswick, Maine, Todd meets Trista Doll and Wonu Ogunfowora, two young actresses making a name for themselves in the musical Sister Act.

items.title: Burning Trust
items.description: Robert Rippley of Sterling, North Dakota, shares the experience that led him to lose trust in his company and gain a new outlook on life.

items.title: Everyday Heroes
items.description: In Riverton, Utah, Jen Jones shares how her brother Mike Brower changed her life by taking her in when she was a teenager and giving her a stable home.

items.title: Take This From Me
items.description: In Carmel, Indiana, host Todd Hansen meets Blair Clark, a musician and vocal coach who turned his life around after years of addiction and homelessness in order to start a music school for the youth in his community.

items.title: Doctor in the Desert
items.description: In the small town of Pastura, New Mexico, Bazan Romero shares why he left academic life behind to take care of his mother as she battles cancer.

items.title: Who Is My Brother?
items.description: In Garden City, Utah, Scott Livingston shares how his faith led him to donate a kidney to a stranger and describes the impact his decision had on his life.

items.title: A Flower and a Pound Cake
items.description: Host Todd Hansen winds up in Calvander, North Carolina, where Dr. Lorna H. Harris describes her difficult battle with breast cancer.

items.title: Border Deal
items.description: In Wendover, Utah, host Todd Hansen meets Mary Delgadillo who shares her story of coming to America to work two jobs in order to give her daughters a solid future.

items.title: It Broke Me
items.description: Tina Craig of Union City, Tennessee, shares how she’s turning her heartbreak into hope following her unexpected divorce.

items.title: Art of Mine
items.description: Tom Williams of Helper, Utah, shares how a mining accident led him to become a full-time artist and commemorate his town’s rich history.

items.title: One Normal Day
items.description: In Lenwood, California, Todd meets Barney Florez who tells of his time in prison and how it inspired him to serve others.

items.title: Believe in Santa Claus
items.description: In this special holiday episode, host Todd Hansen travels to Santa Claus, Indiana, and learns about the town that celebrates the Christmas spirit all year round by giving back to the community and writing letters to children from across the globe.

items.title: A New Normal
items.description: In Northern Arizona, Todd meets the Cantrell family who share how losing their daughter brought their family closer together.

items.title: Holding On to A Good Name
items.description: In Alexandria, Louisiana, Kieven Williams describes the day his father saved him from a house fire and how he honors his legacy by giving back to his community.

items.title: Held by an Angel
items.description: In Enterprise, Utah, host Todd Hansen hears a story of courage and faith as Ryan Christensen describes his daughter’s recent health scare and how he’s learned to cope with her condition.

items.title: Starsky
items.description: A trip to York, South Carolina, has Todd meet Kevin “Starsky” Montgomery, the most famous person in his town known for his cheer and the service he gives to those in his community.

items.title: Motivations
items.description: In Eagle Mountain, Utah, Todd meets a family full of all-star athletes, the Moimois, and learns how their sister’s disability motivates them to succeed on the field.

items.title: Only in the Movies
items.description: Ben and Jayme Kendrick of Knob Noster, Missouri, share their movie-like romance and their love of their blended family.

items.title: 25 Miles to a Stick of Gum
items.description: In Billings, Montana, host Todd Hansen meets young lawyer and mother of two Scotti Moser and hears how she came from humble beginnings in rural Ismay to opening her own law firm in her 20s.

items.title: American Dreamer
items.description: Todd meets Ruben Puff, a young Italian who shares his love for the United States and tells of his dream to one day live in America.

items.title: "Oops"
items.description: Carol Kurka tells Todd about her late husband’s legacy and the impact he had as a pastor in their community.

items.title: A Hard Right
items.description: Bryan Stockdale of Vantage, Washington, shares how his father’s unexpected death brought him back to his hometown and gave him a new purpose in life.

items.title: Garage Save
items.description: In Massillon, Ohio, Todd meets Tamara Schreck who shares how a chance encounter at a garage sale changed her life.

items.title: Power Through
items.description: Host Todd Hansen meets Jackie Martin of Ogden, Utah, who shares how a tragic accident that took his leg helped set him straight.

items.title: The Boys Club
items.description: A trip to Redmond, Oregon, has host Todd Hansen sit down with Eldon Searles who shares how one man from the local Club for Boys helped him heal from years of abuse.

items.title: Forgotten
items.description: In Pleasant Grove, Utah, Todd runs into an old friend, Andrea Timothy, and learns about her mother’s struggle with Alzheimer's.

items.title: Leave No Man Behind
items.description: Ben Beach and Bert Woolsey sit with host Todd Hansen and share how they became lifelong friends following their service in the Gulf War.

items.title: The Day Before
items.description: Rick Bell of Blue Springs Village, Arkansas, shares how he’s learned to enjoy life after a diagnosis of end-stage emphysema.

items.title: Life: There's Nothing Like It
items.description: In Stone Mountain, Georgia, Todd meets Al Batts who explains how the tragedies of 9/11 impacted his life and his career.

items.title: Miraculous Healing
items.description: Kirk Shipley of Fairfield, Utah, describes the time when his faith saved his life during a medical emergency.

items.title: Paradise
items.description: Todd is introduced to the Aloha spirit when he meets Ikaika Kam, a fisherman in Wailua who shares how his late grandmother inspires him to give back to his community.

items.title: We Envisioned Kids
items.description: In Auburn, California, Todd reunites with Cerissa and Daniel Patterson and learns about their journey to parenthood after adopting five girls.

items.title: He's Still Here
items.description: Todd reunites with Kristie and Aubrey Brown of Gustine, Texas, five years after they first met to learn how their lives have changed since first appearing on the show.

items.title: Where Life Takes You
items.description: After appearing on the show six years ago, Todd catches up with Hannah Hogan and learns how she came to be a Specialist with the 311 Causeway Company.

items.title: Never Give Up
items.description: In Murray, Utah, Todd reunites with Josh Hurst and learns how he found his purpose in life after recovering from a traumatic brain injury.

items.title: I Came From Nothing
items.description: A visit to Muskogee, Oklahoma, has Todd meet with past guest Bindi Barnett to hear how she has defied the odds since they first met.

items.title: The Transformation
items.description: Todd checks in with former Story Trek guest Shelby Ronan to hear how she’s focused on her health following her MS diagnosis.

items.title: The Power of a Story
items.description: Todd reunites with past Story Trek guest Allie Phillips and learns how her appearance on the show has inspired the young women in her community.

items.title: The Happy Lady
items.description: Todd returns to Ridgeway, South Carolina, to catch up with the happiest woman he’s ever met, his old friend Virginia Miles.

items.title: Down Under
items.description: Danny and Vikki Rosploch share how their lives have changed since meeting Todd three years ago.

items.title: The Ripple Effect
items.description: Todd returns to McCammon, Idaho, where he reunites with Ashley McQuivey and learns how sharing her story on The Story Trek has saved lives across the country.

items.title: After The Storm: Houston Rebuilds
items.description: Host Todd Hansen travels across Houston to hear stories of neighbors and volunteers coming together in the wake of Hurricane Harvey.

items.title: After The Storm: Refugio Strong
items.description: Host Todd Hansen revisits Refugio, Texas, and learns how the community has banded together to rebuild their city following Hurricane Harvey.

items.title: Justin & Um
items.description: Genesis helps a terrier who needs its sutures removed from a past surgery; Dr. Kwane performs an emergency surgery on a cat who was involved in a car accident.

items.title: Bill & Eli Manning
items.description: Dr. Kwane examines a dog with several skin tumors and an eye condition that requires surgery to fix; Genesis gives vaccinations to animals in need.

items.title: Andre & Kuma
items.description: Kwane meets Andre and his puppy Kuma on the streets, and gives Kuma his vaccines.

items.title: Barbara’s Birds
items.description: Dr. Kwane meets ex-bird breeder Barbara and her two cockatoos who live on the streets and in temporary housing.

items.title: Mike & Crazy Girl
items.description: Dr. Kwane and Genesis help a dachshund who has received an eye injury; the duo meets a shelter dog who lives with two hitchhikers.

items.title: Mike & Goldie
items.description: Dr. Kwane meets Mike, and offers to give his little dog Goldie a health check.

items.title: Shay & Shilo
items.description: Dr. Kwane examines a cat with painful skin issues before performing a surgery on a dog with a hernia.

items.title: The Monterey Zoo
items.description: Genesis becomes emotionally overwhelmed after hearing the story of Carl and his dogs, so Dr. Kwane treats her to a visit to an animal sanctuary that rescues exotic animals where she can get up-close with her favorite animals, elephants.

items.title: Lawrence’s Dogs
items.description: Dr. Kwane examines an older dog whose teeth are infected, but its owner disappears before he can perform the surgery.

items.title: Antonio & Piglet
items.description: Dr. Kwane assists a bullterrier with an injured leg; Genesis adopts a rescue puppy but suffers from painful memories of her first dog.

items.title: The Mercer Clinic
items.description: Genesis helps a dog who has been scooting around on its rear; Dr. Kwane visits a clinic run by volunteers that treats homeless pets.

items.title: The Ultimate Gift
items.description: When billionaire Red Stevens passes away, he leaves behind several challenges for his grandson Jason to complete before he can receive his inheritance. As Jason completes the challenges, he learns about hard work, true friends, and gratitude.

items.title: The Ultimate Legacy
items.description: Joey must carry on the Anderson family legacy despite the anger he holds about his past. His late grandmother left Joey tasks to complete designed to help him value the family business, aided by Jason who guides the young man with his own wisdom.

items.title: The Ultimate Life
items.description: As Jason continues to run the foundation, he studies his late grandfather's journal, seeking advice on balancing love and business. Red's life was full of hard work and challenges. Can Jason use this knowledge to change his life before it's too late?

items.title: Lightning
items.description: Lighting is a pony with deformed hooves who struggles to live life to the fullest. He needs Derrick's help to get back on his feet and improve his health and quality of life.

items.title: Avery
items.description: Derrick helps Waddles the duck regain mobility. Derrick then creates prosthetics that will help Avery get back on all four paws.

items.title: Turbo-Roo & Thor
items.description: Derrick helps two chihuahuas, Turbo Roo and Thor, get new sets of wheels to keep up with their loving family.

items.title: Ferdie
items.description: Derrick makes a special prosthetic for Ferdie, a goat who lost his back leg in an accident.

items.title: Bert
items.description: Derrick gets creative as he makes four new braces for Bert, a potbelly pig with a disorder that limits his walking abilities.

items.title: Pearl
items.description: Derrick gives Pearl, a rescue bulldog, some pawsitive reinforcements.

items.title: Elsa
items.description: Having no paws makes mobility difficult for Elsa the dog Derrick creates four prosthetics to help her walk with less struggle.

items.title: Gracie
items.description: Gracie already tried a prosthetic that failed her. Derrick works even harder to help her find her footing again.

items.title: Bear
items.description: Derrick helps three barnyard animals find new life through specialized prosthetics.

items.title: Yusi - Part 1
items.description: Derrick travels to the Barnyard Bhutan Animal Rescue to build a prosthetic for a horse named Yusi. Yusi lost her leg in a car accident, and if Derrick can't help her, she may not survive.

items.title: Yusi - Part 2
items.description: Derrick is in Bhutan to build a new leg for Yusi, a special horse who lost her leg in a car accident.

items.title: Toto
items.description: Derrick Campana makes prostheses for Toto’s sensitive front legs. He personalizes them to match her owner, Jorja.

items.title: Lacie
items.description: Derrick returns to see Lightning, the dwarf pony he helped in season one. He makes braces for another dwarf pony named Thunder and a mobility cart for a recently paralyzed dog named Lacey.

items.title: Aries
items.description: Derrick visits an animal sanctuary to help an Icelandic sheep named Aries and a cow named Lois. Aries gets a mobility cart and Lois gets braces for her front legs.

items.title: Shadow
items.description: Derrick goes to Los Angeles and hears the story of Shadow and her owner, Jamie. Shadow gets a mobility cart and finds the freedom and independence she needs.

items.title: Frida
items.description: After a tragic accident in Thailand, a dog named Frida learns how to walk with her new leg braces.

items.title: Zoey
items.description: A dog named Zoey gets a prosthetic leg just like her owner, Cindy. Zoey trains to be a therapy dog to encourage and comfort other amputees.

items.title: Trigger
items.description: Trigger is in urgent need of a prosthetic leg so he can stay healthy and strong. Derrick visits Ziggy’s Refuge Farm Sanctuary to help out a pig named Hope.

items.title: Menina
items.description: Derrick travels all the way to Hawaii to help Magical Creatures Sanctuary with a sheep named Menina and a dog named Hank. Menina finds independence with her leg braces.

items.title: Gaia
items.description: Derrick visits Aloha Animal Sanctuary and meets a sheep named Gaia. Gaia has overcome abuse and neglect, but she needs a prosthetic leg to keep up with her lamb, Felicio.

items.title: Hope
items.description: Derrick travels to Utah and makes a leg prosthesis for a goat named Hope. He mentors Hope’s owner, Gentry, throughout the prosthetic-making process.

items.title: Boots
items.description: Derrick travels to Mooresville, North Carolina to meet the Russell family and build a custom cart for their 11-month-old corgi, Boots, who was born with front limb deformities. Derrick and the Russell family are eager to see if Boots will accept the

items.title: Teo
items.description: A familiar face joins Derrick at the shop before he travels to San Diego, California to help a bouncy puppy named Teo. Derrick must come up with a new cart design so Teo’s owners, frontline workers Milton and Vannessa, can take him on beach trips.

items.title: Colby
items.description: Derrick travels to Long Beach, California to help the Wackerman-Nulty family and their new puppy, Colby. Colby was born with a front limb deformity called ectrodactyly. Derrick will try to make Colby a custom prosthetic to help get him on his feet.

items.title: Penny
items.description: Derrick helps out a dog named Rex who was born without his two front legs and needs a custom cart. Then he heads to Fort Worth, Texas to meet Penny who lost a leg in a traumatic car accident and without Derrick’s help may become paralyzed.

items.title: Debbie
items.description: Derrick travels to a farm hidden amongst the lights of Las Vegas to help an alpaca who was born with front limb deformities. Debbie’s legs will continue to break down unless Derrick can build custom braces to stabilize and correct her legs.

items.title: Penelopes
items.description: Derrick and Henry travel to Texas to help neighbors Monica and Robert with a cow and a dog, both named Penelope. Penelope the cow needs a boot to graze freely, while Penelope the dog has severe nerve damage and can’t control her back legs.

items.title: Marvel
items.description: Derrick helps a dog named Buddy Love, who has a front limb deformity and needs a cart to help him get around. Then Derrick heads to Minnesota to meet Marvel, who was born without her front paw and needs a prosthetic.

items.title: Gunner
items.description: Derrick travels to Savannah, Georgia to help a war hero and his service dog, Gunner. After losing his front paw to cancer, Gunner has not been able to perform his duties as a service dog. Derrick builds a prosthetic limb that will get Gunner walking

items.title: Bella
items.description: Derrick helps Bella, an older dog battling cancer. Derrick builds her a cart to help her stay active during these rough cancer treatments.

items.title: Indy
items.description: Derrick travels to North Carolina to help John and Brittany and their rescue dog, Indy, who lost his front leg in a car accident. When Derrick discovers Indy’s shoulder is severely underdeveloped and not suited for a prosthetic, he refuses to give up

items.title: Ski Pawtrol
items.description: Derrick heads to Colorado to build a custom prosthetic for Wesley, a two-year-old rescue dog born with a front limb deformity. Derrick hopes a new leg will help Wesley keep up with his adventurous family for years to come.

items.title: Raccoon-ing and Rolling
items.description: Derrick travels to Glendale, Kentucky to help out a cuddly raccoon named Boone, who needs a custom cart so he can freely move around his home at an animal sanctuary.

items.title: Mission: Im-paw-sible
items.description: Derrick visits a family in New Jersey to help two rescues: Angus, a cat with multiple amputations; and Lux, a dog who lost his front leg. Derrick's devices will help Lux and Angus keep up with their family.

items.title: Sweet Peaches
items.description: Derrick gives a dog named Watson the chance to walk with a full limb prosthesis. Derrick then heads to Connecticut to help Peaches the goat with a custom cart.

items.title: Marvelous Millie
items.description: In Lancaster, Pennsylvania, Derrick meets the Hicks family and builds a custom prosthesis for their dog, Millie, who was born with a front limb deformity.

items.title: Rolling in the Sheep
items.description: Derrick visits California to help a sheep named Timmy and his goat friend, Poppy. Timmy and Poppy share a stall and also share front leg mobility issues.

items.title: We Love Roo
items.description: Derrick helps a pup named Rosie who is missing a paw and needs a custom prosthetic. Then, Derrick travels to Los Angeles to meet a chihuahua named Roo, who was born with two legs and needs a custom cart to help her keep up with her best friend, Chase

items.title: A Moe-ment Like This
items.description: Derrick travels to Sheridan, Illinois to help a camel named Moe. Due to his collapsed legs, Moe has been confined to his stall for four years and unable to go outside. For the first time, Derrick builds a set of braces for a 1500 pound camel.

items.title: Kala Me Mine
items.description: Derrick helps a big dog named Bently with his back leg issues; Derrick then heads to Florida to help Ujwala and her foster dog Kala. Kala is a rescue from the streets of India who must learn to trust Derrick and the new prothesis.

items.title: Love & Elephants, Part One
items.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park to help Mae Mai, an elephant with a painful dislocated knee. Derrick also helps a young bull elephant named Khun Dej who has an injured foot.

items.title: Love & Elephants, Part Two
items.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park. Derrick works to improve the prosthetics he created for the elephants. He also fits two new front legs on a bull named Mr. Cow, giving him the ability to walk.

items.title: Love & Elephants, Part Three
items.description: Derrick and his wife, Kelly, travel to Thailand to visit Elephant Nature Park. Derrick fits Khun Dej and Mae Mai with improved prothesis, and watches Mae Mai step into her new freedom.

items.title: Sister, Sister
items.description: In Raleigh, North Carolina, host Derrick Campana helps Kaitlyn surprise her sister Kamryn by creating a full-limb prosthetic for Kamryn’s dog Amiri after he lost his leg in a golf cart accident.

items.title: The Karate Dog
items.description: Host Derrick Campana travels to California to meet Martin and Jesse Kove, stars of the “Cobra Kai” franchise, and help create a prosthetic limb for their 3-legged dog, Bubba.

items.title: Saving Amelia
items.description: Derrick travels to an animal sanctuary in Renton, Washington to build a brace for Amelia, a cow born with leg deformities. Derrick hopes that building Amelia a prosthetic leg will lengthen her life.

items.title: Two Peas in a Pod
items.description: Derrick travels to Ontario, Canada to meet best friends Winnie, a two-year-old dog, and Chip, a six-month-old sheep. Derrick builds them both a custom cart that will allow them to explore the farm together.

items.title: This Little Piggy Wants Wheels
items.description: In Deltona, Florida, Derrick brings hope to a mother and daughter as he crafts a custom cart for their potbelly pig named Valentine.

items.title: Super Cow
items.description: In Austin, Texas, Derrick faces his greatest challenge yet as he creates a custom lift to offer quadriplegic cow Champion a new sense of mobility.

items.title: Ready, Set, Hanabi!
items.description: Host Derrick Campana travels to Louisville, Kentucky to create prosthetic legs for Hanabi, a pit bull terrier born without front paws.

items.title: Story's Magic Leg
items.description: Derrick Travels to California to meet Story, a puppy found with a missing paw. her tender stump makes walking painful and puts pressure on her other limbs. Derrick hopes that a custom prosthetic will give her story a happy ending.

items.title: Boundless Birdie
items.description: Derrick revisits Chicago, Illinois to meet a 10-year old dog named Birdie, who has never walked with four legs. He's challenged with building a full limb prosthesis that Birdie will accept and use to prevent further injury to her front leg.

items.title: Derrick versus LA (Part 1)
items.description: Derrick travels to LA to host a pop-up workshop for animals in need. This proves to be one of the biggest challenges yet in Derrick's career as he builds more prosthetics in three days than he ever has before.

items.title: Derrick versus LA (Part 2)
items.description: Derrick races to finish building 13 unique devices in three days at his pop-up workshop in LA, leading to the single biggest night of his career at The Frida Project fundraiser where each dog he helped walks down the red carpet.

items.title: Tails
items.description: Host Derrick Campana lights the world by donating his time at an animal rescue shelter.

items.title: The Happiest Fox
items.description: At the Juniper Wildlife Refuge, Derrick helps Jessika Coker's fantastic fox named Fig. This internet-famous fox was born with a deformed leg, and his good leg has collapsed. If Fig doesn't get help soon, he'll become immobile.

items.title: Ollie, Ollie, Running free!
items.description: Derrick helps a family who struggled during COVID. The family's corgi, Ollie, was born with a deformed limb. Before building the young dog's prosthetic, Derrick has a special surprise for Ollie that involves getting wet.

items.title: Agatha, the G.O.A.T. Goat
items.description: Derrick meets his match with Agatha, a sassy two-legged goat. He builds Agatha a custom cart to take her from a handstand position back to something more comfortable. Derrick also helps a three legged cow named Mateo from Broken Shovels Farm Sanctuar

items.title: Ivy the Miracle Cow
items.description: Derrick helps Ivy, a miniature cow who was born with limb deformities in her front legs. Derrick builds two devices for Ivy: a brace and a lift. Both will hopefully help level out Ivy's shoulders and improve her mobility around the pasture.

items.title: Layka, An American Hero
items.description: Layka, the first dog to receive the Purple Heart since WWII, lost her leg while on a mission in Afghanistan. Upon returning to the US she was adopted by her handler, Julian. Now, years later, Derrick arrives to help regain some of Layka's mobility.

items.title: Loretta the Miniature Zebu
items.description: At the Lazy J Rescue Ranch in Humboldt, Iowa, Derrick helps a miniature zebu cow named Loretta regain mobility after an accident caused permanent damage to one of her front legs. Derrick also builds a prosthetic for a Doberman Pinscher named Holly.

items.title: Second Chances for Lenny
items.description: In New York City, Derrick helps Lenny, an energetic eight year old dog with three legs. Lenny's family, Cassidy and Scott, notice he's not the dog he used to be. Derrick hopes a custom made full limb prosthetic will give Lenny a new lease on life.

items.title: A Buddy for Jojo Tidd
items.description: Jojo Tidd was born without his left arm, and his Labrador puppy, Buddy, has a similar condition. Derrick builds a prosthetic for Buddy. The Tidds family shares its feelings about Lucky Fin, an organization that celebrates limb differences.

items.title: Miracle in Honduras (Part 1)
items.description: Derrick is in Honduras to assist Karen, Tonya, and Jimmy in finding homes for 200 dogs before their shelter closes. He works on mobility devices and posts about the animals on social media to help get as many dogs adopted as possible.

items.title: Miracle in Honduras (Part 2)
items.description: Derrick's family joins him in Honduras, where he is building mobility devices for several dogs, as well as using his social media presence to raise awareness for the 200 special needs animals searching for homes before the shelter closes.

items.title: A New Chance
items.description: Derrick goes to Kentucky to help Chance, a tripod therapy dog who helps patients at Shriners Hospital for Children. Chance is big and his joints are wearing down. Derrick has to bring all his skills to bear to keep Chance in good form for the future.

items.title: Scooter & Bella
items.description: Derrick visits Aimee’s Animal Sanctuary to help two disabled goats—Scooter, born paralyzed, and Bella, missing a leg. With help from Aimee and volunteer Collette, he hopes to get them out playing & grazing with the herd, finally free to roam together

items.title: Buddy the Chihuahua
items.description: Derrick visits Minnesota to help Buddy, a thirteen-year-old tripod Chihuahua. Buddy's parents are first responders who depend on his unconditional love to help them manage stress. Buddy's lost a leg, and they're hoping Derrick can help.

items.title: Saint Goes Marching In
items.description: Derrick travels to Houston to help Sydney with her dog, Saint, a red toy poodle missing a back paw. While there, he meets Sydney’s cousin Tracey, who has a dog named Joy. Joy has a partial front paw, and Derrick steps in to assist both dogs.

items.title: Loni's Leg Up
items.description: Derrick travels to PA, to Indraloka Sanctuary to meet Loni, a three-legged lamb who needs urgent help. As Loni grows, he risks losing mobility. Derrick steps in to help give Loni the freedom he needs and support the sanctuary’s mission of compassion.

items.title: Pop-Up in Sydney
