items.description: Derrick is in Sydney, Australia to team up with Dr. Rhys Donovan, an osteopath, to create as many custom devices for the local population as he can. He feels the pressure, working at break neck speed to get these animals the help they need.

items.title: Buster's New Kicks
items.description: On Derrick's final stop in Australia he pays a visit to an emu named Buster. Buster was rescued by Josh, Amber and their daughter Ashlee after his feet were burnt in a fire. Derrick's excited to build his first ever pair of emu shoes.

items.title: Atticus Finch's New Leg
items.description: Derrick travels to Australia’s outback to help a calf named Atticus and a lamb named Colette. For sanctuary owners Richard and Kym, these prosthetics are a way to give back to the animals that helped them through the 2019 bushfires.

items.title: The Wizard of Claws
items.description: Derrick travels to Bangalore, India, to help Vasi, a three-legged wild sloth bear that was rescued by a wildlife organization. They hope that Derrick can improve Vasi's quality of life, but this will be Derrick's first time working on a wild bear.

items.title: Frodo of the Backwater
items.description: In the season finale, Derrick is in India to help Frodo, a horse who lost the use of one leg. Rescued by Zoha at the Backwater Animal Sanctuary, Frodo now faces a critical moment— without a new prosthetic, he may become completely immobile.

items.title: Theodosia Trailer
items.description: Watch the trailer for Theodosia.

items.title: The Eye of Horus
items.description: When she unearths an ancient amulet while in Egypt with her family, Theo begins to suspect that the relic might be cursed.

items.title: The Curse
items.description: Now certain that her father, Alistair, has been cursed, Theo's desperate search for answers is interrupted by the arrival of Safiya.

items.title: The Missing Princess
items.description: After recovering an ancient book of spells, Theo puts her newfound powers to the test to defeat her father's curse; however, her powers are more effective then she thinks.

items.title: An Accidental Odyssey
items.description: After falling through a magical portal, Will and Henry are whisked away to the Valley of the Kings; back in London, Theo and Safiya must work together.

items.title: The Games People Play
items.description: After experiencing a vision of her favorite haunt engulfed in flames, Theo rushes to the Penny Arcade to find a table-tennis tournament.

items.title: Cleaning Catastrophe
items.description: As the Throckmortons prepare for a visit with an important official who could ensure their ticket back to Egypt, Theo contends with visions.

items.title: The Head of the Snake
items.description: As the Serpents of Chaos close in, Theo and Henry must work to protect both the museum and the Eye of Horus.

items.title: The Sound of Magic
items.description: Theo and her friends begin a desperate search to recover the Eye of Horus and prevent the Serpents of Chaos from gaining control of the powerful artifact.

items.title: Double Danger
items.description: With the eclipse just days away, Theo hatches a daring plan to infiltrate the Serpents of Chaos' lair and take back the Eye.

items.title: The Darkening
items.description: With a total eclipse imminent, the Throckmortons prepare the museum for a celebratory fundraiser that draws the attention of the Serpents

items.title: The Pit of Despair
items.description: When Theo and Safiya are magically whisked away to Egypt, the Eye of Horus guides them inside Hatshepsut's Mortuary Temple.

items.title: Wild Child
items.description: Hoping life can get back to normal, Theo finds herself channeling her magical abilities for protection against the Serpents.

items.title: The Eye of the Needle
items.description: After the Serpents unleash the power of chaos across the globe, it's up to Theo, Will, and Safiya to save Henry and all of London from certain doom.

items.title: A Date with Destiny
items.description: The Serpents of Chaos are defeated and the only cloud on the horizon is Alistair and Henrietta’s upcoming return to Egypt, leaving the museum, Theo and Henry in stuffy Lady Throckmorton’s care.

items.title: Time Waits for Nobody
items.description: When Henry sets off a trap, Will and Safiya are caught inside the secret room. Worse, the walls start to rush in! Theo must take up her magic once more to save her friends.

items.title: The Age of Wisdom
items.description: With Lady Throckmorton in charge, life at the museum is no picnic. Worse, Theo can’t unlock the secrets of the mysterious journal she found in Sir Harold’s hidden room. She’ll need all the help she can get to put things right.

items.title: The Nightmare at the Museum
items.description: When an unlucky stumble cracks the mysterious pyramidion, Will, Safiya and Henry are all swept away into strange dreamworlds, where each of them faces a terrible test, while Theo and Nigella can only look on.

items.title: The Amazing Will
items.description: Theo and Nigella work to uncover the secrets of the pyramidion at the museum while, at the Penny Arcade, Safiya and Henry help prepare for Will’s big debut as a stage magician.

items.title: The Magic Flute
items.description: The pyramidion’s dangerous secret is revealed – it holds the key to the prison of the giant chaos-snake Aapep himself. Theo is desperate to seal it away but the others insist she enjoy her party first – it is her fifteenth birthday, after all!

items.title: An Impossible Choice
items.description: The truth is out! One of Theo’s closest friends is a Serpent and they mean to free the giant chaos-snake Aapep! Worse, the Serpents of Chaos have caught Theo’s parents in a deadly trap beneath the Great Sphinx!

items.title: What Big Teeth You Have
items.description: When an unusual key is discovered in Nigella’s abandoned belongings, Theo and Will set off to discover exactly what Aapep and the Serpents of Chaos are planning. Meanwhile, back at the museum Safiya, Henry and Lady T deal with a familiar foe.

items.title: Snake and Ladder
items.description: Theo’s parents are back from Egypt at last, but Henrietta is distinctly unwell. At the same time, someone or something has been stealing magic from the artefacts in the museum.

items.title: Mummies Alive!
items.description: Aapep is loose in London and museum mummies have been seen wandering at night. Blaming Aapep, Theo and her friends decide to follow the mummies to the chaos-snake’s base.

items.title: In Her Shoes
items.description: The trip to Aapep’s lair has left Safiya extremely sick. To undo her friend’s illness, Theo uses a powerful spell which accidentally swaps her and Safiya’s bodies.

items.title: Once Bitten
items.description: As Lady Throckmorton follows a trail of clues through Paris to find the Flail of Hemiunu, Will risks a return to Aapep’s lair.

items.title: The Last Sunrise
items.description: As they battle to stop the sun being swallowed, Theo and her friends must face Aapep’s unbelievable power without their most important weapons. Soon, Theo and Will are caught in a deadly-game of cat-and-mouse beneath the Great Pyramid.

items.title: Magic Memories
items.description: When the barge of Rameses II is loaned to the museum, Theo's magic grows out of control.

items.title: New Blood
items.description: Theo faces the unexpected challenge of starting life at a new school.

items.title: Bugs and Kisses
items.description: Rameses II's barge unleashes a magical plague on Theo's beloved museum.

items.title: The Ruin
items.description: Theo and Maya are carried off to Egypt by the magic of Rameses II's barge.

items.title: Stop the Press
items.description: Maya's attempt to publish the story of her trip to Egypt is thwarted by strange figures.

items.title: Into Darkness
items.description: When Theo's magic goes into overdrive at school, she ends up accidentally hurting Darius.

items.title: The Names of the Game
items.description: Henry throws a secret party at the museum; people disappear.

items.title: The Zodiac
items.description: On her hunt for the Oasis of Magic, Theo faces a perilous journey into a sunken temple.

items.title: The Phoenix
items.description: Jealous of Darius' adventures with Theo in Egypt, Will performs a death-defying trick.

items.title: A Fête Worse Than Death
items.description: Theo plans to unmask the Eternal Flame once and for all at the school fête.

items.title: In the Balance
items.description: The Eternal Flame moves through the school fête, playing mind games and sowing confusion.

items.title: Monsters of the Underworld
items.description: Theo and Darius travel through the Underworld and must face its dangerous guardians.

items.title: The Oasis of Magic
items.description: Theo guides the Eternal Flame to the Oasis, facing judgement by an ancient god.

items.title: The Sisterhood
items.description: After spotting a museum thief, Theo finds herself dangerously out of her depth.

items.title: No Rest for the Wicked
items.description: Theo begins training to become a true ankh mage with the Sisterhood of the Chosen Keepers.

items.title: In Plain Sight
items.description: Theo heads out to Egypt to stop a powerful artifact from falling into the wrong hands.

items.title: The Fog
items.description: As Darius tries to build a time machine, a terrible time fog is unleashed across London.

items.title: The Frosty Sands of Time
items.description: Theo is on a mission to an ice-bound desert tomb when familiar faces surprisingly turn up.

items.title: Weather or Not, Here I Come
items.description: After losing vital time machine artifacts, Theo is sent home by the Sisterhood.

items.title: The Prophecy
items.description: Darius needs Theo to activate the time machine, and he has the perfect bait for a trap.

items.title: Time Warp
items.description: Maya, Henry and Alistair must get past the Sisterhood and an ultra-tricky time loop.

items.title: Too Much Magic
items.description: Theo fights to halt Josie's unstoppable powers after she steals everyone's magic.

items.title: Prison Break
items.description: In order to restore the time machine, Theo and Will must free Darius from the Sisterhood.

items.title: Power Move
items.description: Theo and Maya must face off against a dangerously powerful Josie at the penny arcade.

items.title: For Better or Worse
items.description: Theo and Will travel back to ancient Egypt with Darius to recover the Djed Stone.

items.title: Climate of Fear
items.description: Theo finally battles Darius in Egypt, while Clive and Elena's wedding is crashed by Josie.

items.title: Trailer
items.description: Watch the trailer for "The Primrose Railway Children", a new family classic from BYUtv and BBC Studios.

items.title: Trailer: Exploring Turkey: Modern Believers in an Ancient Land
items.description: Explore the history, culture, and religions of this ancient land and modern nation.

items.title: Mouse Multiplication
items.description: Eric helps Julia trick her daughter Lola in an epic ice cream prank that blows her mind. Necole visits a pet store and is shocked by a mouse duplication machine.

items.title: Moving Magic
items.description: Eric helps Amy to trick her son Michael. Eric wows Michael in an ice cream shop with a new toppings app on his phone. Eric surprises kids with magical toys in a toy store and they don’t believe their eyes.

items.title: Balloon Donut
items.description: Christina tricks her boyfriend Adam with Eric’s help and a bakery with magical donuts. Eric goes to a pizzeria and shocks the customers with a new “instant pizza” machine.

items.title: Phone Meltdown
items.description: Emily wants to trick her friend Kyle who’s always on his phone, so Eric tricks him with a special “charging spray.” A kid is amazed by a voice-activated dog bowl that makes its own dog food.

items.title: Big Burger
items.description: Eric helps Richard to trick his sons Kenyon and Titus with a magical size-changing burger. A robotic fish blows Skyler’s mind.

items.title: Tube Chips
items.description: Eric wows customers at the grocery store with a chip can that refills itself. Pizza delivery guys are shocked when they realize the pies they’re delivering have been frozen in a block of ice.

items.title: Necklace Bust
items.description: Eric helps Lulu prank her roommate Youko with a broken necklace that he repairs with a special fix-it spray. Eitan gets tricked when Eric turns paper into a necktie.

items.title: Key Hanger
items.description: Eric tricks people into thinking they ruined priceless art, but he has the perfect solution. He helps Mollie prank her new roommate Jackie by losing her one apartment key.

items.title: Book Worm
items.description: Isuri volunteers at a library, but Eric shocks her by pulling fishing supplies out of the books. He leaves a customer speechless at a hardware store when he bends a hammer.

items.title: Broken Tray
items.description: People think they broke a priceless vase, but Eric has a trick up his sleeve. Eric helps Matthew to surprise his friend Josh by instantly cooking a hot dog in front of Josh’s eyes.

items.title: Big Golf
items.description: Braeden is a prankster himself, so Eric surprises him with a trick at a mini golf course. At a florist’s shop, employees are shocked to see a plant that grows instantaneously.

items.title: Bag of Treats
items.description: At a candy shop, Eric makes gummy bears get bigger and bigger to surprise a child. He wows a customer in a shop by producing a golden gilded tape dispenser, a banana, and even his own neck tie.

items.title: Already Been Chewed
items.description: Eric shows a kid how to restore chewed candy using a magical machine. He demonstrates a new instant way to send flowers to shocked onlookers.

items.title: Instant Instrument
items.description: Eric amazes Terrance by showing a revolutionary new way to play music using paper and a music marker. At a restaurant, Eric startles customers with hot sauce that’s so hot it produces actual flames.

items.title: Really Sticky Glue
items.description: Eric tricks Thomas, an aspiring magician, with a sticky situation. Candy shop customers are shocked when Eric matches their random orders.

items.title: Prize Surprise
items.description: Kelsey Nixon from Dinner Takes All guest stars and appears out of thin air with frittatas. Eric surprises a grocery store customer with big prizes out of a cereal box.

items.title: Mouth To Mouse
items.description: Pretending to be a cashier, Eric brings a mouse to life in front of shocked customers. Eric poses as a bad dentist to trick Sofia at the dentist office.

items.title: Jungle Board Game
items.description: Eric plays a board game with a mind of its own with a stunned little girl. A haunted bell spooks people when they least expect it.

items.title: Lights Out
items.description: A decorating assistant helps Eric to decorate for a party but is confused when the lightbulbs start going haywire. A magical tie wows kids at a clothing store.

items.title: Quick Change
items.description: A model changes lightning fast at a clothing store leaving customers baffled. Eric teaches the trick to cutting a lady in half, using only paper, a pen, and scissors.

items.title: Time Travel Cooking
items.description: A microwave somehow cooks food instantly and stumps customers. At a movie theater, Eric sells magic concessions with stretching chocolate bars.

items.title: Concessions Through Glass
items.description: Eric, the clumsy movie theater employee, loses his key and has to use magic to get it back. He pulls a hamster from a bowling ball and wows the kids at the bowling alley.

items.title: Bag Name Change
items.description: Kids get backpacks with their names embroidered on them, but the bags are full of surprises. Eric uses magic shoe polish that lets shoes stretch to any size.

items.title: Origami Dove
items.description: Eric uses a special fabric that folds itself into magic origami, but it turns into real animals. At the cash register, customers are livid to lose their IDs to a shredder but Eric saves them miraculously.

items.title: Intermountain Therapy Animals
items.description: Patients in need of a little extra love receive visits from the volunteers at Intermountain Therapy Animals, a nonprofit determined to help provide emotional and physical healing to those in need with their friendly service animals.

items.title: Whitney Elementary
items.description: Sherrie Gahn, Principal at Whitney Elementary School in Las Vegas, Nevada, finds her purpose in providing support and resources to families in the surrounding community that are impacted by recent economic turmoil.

items.title: Circus Project
items.description: Jen Cohen, director and founder of The Circus Project, makes the impossible possible as she helps homeless and at-risk youth get off the streets through learning professional circus skills.

items.title: LILY's Morningside Village
items.description: Volunteers at LILY’s Morningside Village in Manhattan give a helping hand to the seniors in their community. The organization’s founder Irene Zola shares the story that inspired her to begin devoting her time to serving the elderly.

items.title: Heart2Home
items.description: Greg Adamson, president of Heart 2 Home, sets out to help make homes more accessible and accommodating by bringing the community together to perform home renovations for those with disabilities.

items.title: Archi's Acres
items.description: Karen and Collin Archipley of Archi’s Acres assist veterans suffering from PTSD in their transition to life in the private sector through their six week Veteran Sustainable Agriculture Training program.

items.title: Out 2 Play
items.description: Andrea Wenner, founder of the Out 2 Play foundation, aims to transform the deteriorated schoolyards at public elementary schools in New York City by providing them with new playgrounds, equipment, and a new sense of safety.

items.title: Have Justice, Will Travel
items.description: Wynona Ward, founder of Have Justice Will Travel, shares the stories that inspired her to create a legal organization in rural Vermont that provides free legal services for victims of domestic violence.

items.title: Musicians on Call
items.description: Musicians on Call brings joy and relief to patients across New York City hospitals by using music to compliment the healing process. Co-founders Vivek Tiwary and Michael Solomon share the experiences that inspired them to start the organization.

items.title: BAADS
items.description: Ed Gallagher, commandeer of the Bay Area Association of Disabled Sailors or BAADS, shares how the organization uses sailing to instill confidence and create strong communication skills for its members with disabilities.

items.title: The Gentle Barn
items.description: The Gentle Barn rescues severely abused animals, rehabilitates them, and creates powerful connections with children in various therapeutic programs. Founder Ellie Laks shares the life-changing connection that inspired her to start the organization.

items.title: Homeboy Industries
items.description: Founder of Homeboy Industries Greg Boyle shares how his faith and the struggles facing his community inspired him to create the largest gang intervention rehab and re-entry program in the country.

items.title: Diveheart
items.description: Founder and President of Diveheart Jim Elliott shares his mission to build confidence and self esteem for children, adults and veterans with disabilities using the craft of scuba diving as a means of physical and emotional therapy.

items.title: Angel Flight West
items.description: Alan Dias, Executive Director of Angel Flight West, shares the mission of his nonprofit to provide free air transportation for non-emergency medical needs with a fleet of volunteer pilots.

items.title: Operation Finally Home
items.description: Operation Finally Home founder Dan Wallrath shares the story that inspired him to dedicate his life to building free custom homes for wounded veterans and their families.

items.title: Domus
items.description: DOMUS strives to help at-risk youth reach their full potential through the power of education, free-after school programs, and vocational workshops in Stamford, Connecticut.

items.title: Wasatch Adaptive Sports
items.description: Peter Mandler, founder of Wasatch Adaptive Sports, provides a free therapeutic recreational program for children, adults, and veterans with special needs to enjoy winter sports like skiing and snowboarding.

items.title: Intersect Fund
items.description: Joe Shore and Rohan Mathew, founders of The Intersect Fund, share the mission of their nonprofit to help community members build small businesses by offering free training programs and microloans.

items.title: The Bread Lady
items.description: Shauna Devonport, known to residents of Salt Lake City as “The Bread Lady,” has provided free food and household items for those in need for over 20 years.

items.title: Sweet Beginnings
items.description: Brenda Palms Barber shares how she was motivated to give back to her community by creating Sweet Beginnings, a social enterprise designed to train and hire previously incarcerated men and women in Chicago.

items.title: South Shore Drill Team
items.description: Founder of The South Shore Drill Team of Chicago, Arthur Robertson, describes his role in providing inner-city youth with a sense of structure, support, and a creative outlet through his organization.

items.title: Phoenix Multisport
items.description: Phoenix Multisport founder Scott Strode provides a safe space for recovering addicts to connect and support one another through the power of exercise and sports.

items.title: Eagle Eyes
items.description: Jim Gibbs, founder of Eagle Eyes, dedicates his time to developing technology that provides children with severe disabilities a way to connect with the world around them.

items.title: Erin Kimball Foundation
items.description: The Erin Kimball Foundation offers multiple resources for victims of domestic abuse to start a new life. Founder Sue Kimball shares the story that moved her to dedicate her life to supporting women and children who have been abused.

items.title: Adopt a Native Elder
items.description: Linda Meyers discusses Adopt a Native Elder, a program she created to pair Navajo elders with sponsors who donate food, healthcare, and supplies to foster creativity and connection in the aging Navajo community.

items.title: Free Wheelchair Mission
items.description: Don Schoendorfer, founder of Free Wheelchair Mission, shares how he adapted his engineering skills to create a nonprofit that builds and donates wheelchairs to those in need around the globe.

items.title: Dogwood Restaurant
items.description: Galen Sampson provides individuals transitioning from addiction, incarceration, and homelessness the opportunity to start a new life through an apprenticeship program at his restaurant, Dogwood.

items.title: Thistle Farms
items.description: Becca Stevens shares the story behind her organization Thistle Farms, a natural bath and body care company owned and operated by women recovering from addiction and sexual abuse.

items.title: San Pasqual Academy
items.description: The founders of San Pasqual Academy–Ron Roberts, Greg Cox, and Jim Milliken–provide hope to the youth in the foster care system of San Diego through their innovative boarding school.

items.title: Sister Tesa
items.description: Sister Teresa Fitzgerald of Hour Children strives to help women in the New York Prison system be reconnected with their children and rebuild their lives through multiple support services.

items.title: Global Medical Relief Fund
items.description: Elissa Montanti, founder and director of the Global Medical Relief Fund, aims to help children around the world who are affected by wars and natural disasters to receive the critical medical attention they need.

items.title: The Clarks
items.description: Scott and Mary Beth Clark, parents of 21 children, describe their journey in adopting children from broken homes across the globe in need of a better life.

items.title: Fullmer Bros. Boxing Gym
items.description: Gene, Don, and Jay Fullmer of The Fullmer Brothers Boxing Gym provide young men the ability to mentally and physically challenge themselves as they work to overcome their troubled pasts.

items.title: First Descents
items.description: Brad Ludden, founder of First Descents, helps young cancer patients reclaim their lives and gain increased confidence through thrilling outdoor adventures throughout the western United States.

items.title: Harmony Project
items.description: The Harmony Project gives the youth of Los Angeles an opportunity to reach new heights with the power of a free, high quality music education. Founder Margaret Martin shares what inspired her to start the organization.

items.title: Godparents for Youth
items.description: Tanya Walters inspires her community in Los Angeles with her foundation Godparents Youth Organization, a mentoring travel organization that allows inner-city youth the chance to travel across the country.

items.title: Street Soccer
items.description: Street Soccer USA uses soccer as a development tool for homeless youth across the country. Founder Lawrence Cann emphasizes the importance of creating a community for young adults to attain their goals and leave homelessness in their pasts.

items.title: Echo Clinic
items.description: Volunteers at the Echo Clinic in Eureka Springs, Arkansas, provide free healthcare to those in need. Founders Dan and Suzie Bell share what inspired them to help the less fortunate members of their community access medical care.

items.title: Car Santa
items.description: Terry Franz, known as the “Car Santa” in Kansas City, Missouri, fixes and donates cars to those in need with his organization Cars 4 Heroes.

items.title: Surfers Healing
items.description: Izzy and Danielle Paskowitz share what inspired them to start Surfers Healing, a non-profit designed to teach children with autism around the world how to surf.

items.title: Island Dolphin Care
items.description: Deena and Peter Hoagland share the story behind Island Dolphin Care, a non profit therapeutic program aimed to help children with special needs engage in multiple new activities alongside a family of dolphins.

items.title: Camp to Belong
items.description: Camp to Belong reunites siblings who have been separated by foster care across the United States for one week of reunion and fun. Founder Lynn Price shares the personal experience that inspired her to bring siblings together.

items.title: Rocking the Boat
items.description: Adam Green, founder of Rocking the Boat, uses boating and environmental education as a way to inspire high school students in the South Bronx to create and achieve their goals.

items.title: Irish Men's Sheds
items.description: John Evoy, founder of Irish Men’s Sheds, shares the importance of creating an organization that allows local men to come together as a collective of craftsmen with the purpose of giving back to their community.

items.title: Brighter Future Workshop, UK
items.description: Brighter Future Workshop refurbishes mobility equipment to make it more accessible for those with disabilities. Chairman Peter Cousens and co-founder Jackie Tittle share the positive impact of the organization in their community.

items.title: Akshaya Trust
items.description: Narayanan Krishnan of Madurai, India, uses his organization Akshaya Trust to combat hunger among the aging homeless population in his community.

items.title: Floating Doctors
items.description: Benjamin and Sky LaBrot bring healthcare to people in rural communities with their organization, Floating Doctors. Using a boat, free clinics and a crew of volunteers, Floating Doctors has helped thousands of people globally.

items.title: Row New York
items.description: Row New York brings together competitive rowing and academic support for girls from under-resourced schools across New York City. Founder Amanda Kraus describes the significance of the organization in the lives of its young members.

items.title: 4 Paws for Ability
items.description: Karen Sherk, founder of 4 Paws for Ability, helps children with disabilities receive their own personal service dogs.

items.title: Stepney Bank Stables
items.description: Susan Tron shares the story behind Stepney Bank Stables, the nonprofit she created to teach important life skills to disadvantaged youth through horseback riding.

items.title: The Happiness
items.description: De Vrolijkheid or “The Happiness,” brings joy to children staying in refugee centers across the Netherlands by using art as a means of communication.

items.title: Parkour Generations
items.description: Dan Edwardes, founder of Parkour Generations, uses parkour to inspire London’s inner city youth to physically challenge themselves and discover their true potential.

items.title: City of Angels Ballet
items.description: Mario Nugara uses his foundation, City of Angels Ballet, to give inner city youth in Los Angeles the opportunity to pursue ballet with free professional instruction.

items.title: Camden Sophisticated Sisters
items.description: TaWanda Jones offers structure, guidance, and a safe space for the young women of her New Jersey community with her program, the Camden Sophisticated Sisters Drill Team.

items.title: Naskarz
items.description: The NASKARZ program in Vancouver, Canada, helps young men leave behind a life of crime by offering guidance and teaching auto mechanic skills.

items.title: Hana Build (Ma Ka Hana Ka 'ike)
items.description: Rick Rutiz, founder of Ma Ka Hana Ka ‘Ike, teaches the youth of Hāna, Maui, important life skills that inspire them to give back to their community.

items.title: The Willy the Plumber Foundation
items.description: Karl Williams Winsness shares the moving experience that inspired him to start the Willy the Plumber scholarship. Through his support, Karl has enabled children of inmates to chart their own paths in pursuit of higher education.

items.title: The Missouri Star Quilting Company
items.description: The Doan family breathes life back into their small town of Hamilton, Missouri, by offering employment and a sense of community through their quilting business, The Missouri Star Quilting Company.

items.title: Continue Mission
items.description: Founders of Continue Mission, Laura Cantin and Josh Hansen, provide veterans with multiple programs, activities, and support groups as they return from combat and transition to civilian life.

items.title: ENACTUS
items.description: Sery Kouma Kone shares how support from ENACTUS enabled him to start his own non-profit to fight child slavery in the Ivory Coast. Founder of ENACTUS Alvin Rohrs shares his mission to use education to support emerging countries around the world.

items.title: Ronald McDonald House
items.description: The Ronald McDonald House provides free housing and food for families with children receiving critical treatment at nearby hospitals. Co-founders Francis and Fred Hill share how their story inspired McDonald’s to become the program’s sponsor.

items.title: Acres of Love
items.description: Acres of Love provides a permanent home and loving family for South African children orphaned by HIV/AIDS. Founder Gerda Audagnotti shares how Acres of Love has impacted the lives of hundreds of children across South Africa.

items.title: Ambulance Wish Foundation
items.description: Kees Veldboer shares the story behind Ambulance Wish, a non-profit he created to allow terminally ill patients to travel with their families across Europe for one final holiday.

items.title: Heart & Soul
items.description: Janna Lauer brings music and life to nursing homes and hospitals with her organization, Heart & Soul. Using a highly talented crew of volunteers, Heart & Soul performs music of all kinds to uplift people experiencing isolation and loneliness.

items.title: The Sparkle Effect
items.description: Sarah Cronk shares the inspiration behind The Sparkle Effect, a nationwide program that allows youth with disabilities the opportunity to participate in cheerleading at their high schools.

items.title: Streetwise Opera
items.description: Streetwise Opera uses opera as a tool to help encourage and inspire homeless individuals to move forward in life. Founder Matt Peacock shares what motivated him to use art as a means of support for those facing homelessness.

items.title: Conetoe Life Center
items.description: Founder Rev. Richard Joyner shares the inspiring story behind the Conetoe Family Life Center, the organization he created to provide multiple resources for his small community to pursue healthier lifestyles.

items.title: Bike & Build
items.description: Marc Bush organizes charity bike tours for young adults through his organization Bike & Build. Volunteers bike along the East Coast for weeks at a time and offer their service to multiple affordable housing organizations along the way.

items.title: A Sense of Home
items.description: A Sense of Home completely furnishes the new homes of youth who have aged out of the foster care system. Founders Melissa Goddard and Georgie Smith share the unique journey they took to make their nonprofit a reality.

items.title: Cambodian Children's Fund
items.description: Cambodian Children’s Fund provides life-changing education to empower at-risk youth in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Founder Scott Neeson shares what inspired him to dedicate his life to educating impoverished communities in Cambodia.

items.description: Discover the story of remarkable Florence doors whose art, history, and symbolism create opportunities for reflection, dialogue, and connection bringing students, communities, cultures, and people from around the world together.

items.title: Elder and Sister Uchtdorf (8-4-24)
items.description: Hear from Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the 12 Apostles.

items.title: Utah's White Palace: The Legacy of Hotel Utah
items.description: The Hotel Utah served as a landmark in the center of Salt Lake City for over a century. Historians, authors, and first hand witnesses discuss the hotel’s past, and its current use by the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints as the Joseph Smith

items.title: And Then There Were 6
items.description: Emmy winner Wayne Brady kicks off his epic search for America’s first teen comedy sensation. Wayne chooses his final six to undergo a comedy boot camp based on the lessons learned throughout his iconic career.

items.title: Hooray for (North) Hollywood
items.description: The six teen comedians arrive at the Academy, where Wayne Brady has their work cut out for them. Their first challenge: learn guest mentor's Marcel Wilson's choreography and perform at a huge Hollywood birthday party.

items.title: Dane vs. Wayne
items.description: Wayne Brady and Jonathan Mangum head up two teams in an improv battle at ComedySportz for their very own “Whose Line is it Anyway?” experience. One teen must face off in an improvised rap battle against Wayne Brady himself.

items.title: Contagious Laughter Syndrome
items.description: Wayne Brady and Jonathan Mangum team up with friend and collaborator Joel McCrary (Baldric from BYUtv's Dwight in Shining Armor) to challenge the kids to develop three unique characters. The teens are thrown for a loop when they must improvise in cha

items.title: The Golden Rule of Improv
items.description: Special guest comedian Lauren Pritchard helps the kids discover their “superpowers,” and how to work as a team to make each other look good. They present their sketches at Second City.

items.title: Epic Rap Battles
items.description: The teens work with YouTube sensation Epic Lloyd (Epic Rap Battles of History) to write and perform their own raps for a music video. Some rise to the challenge while others struggle to find their voice.

items.title: Stand up For Yourself
items.description: Wayne Brady brings legendary stand-up comedian Sinbad to help the young comics shape their three-minute sets for a live audience at the iconic Improv comedy club. One cast member is eliminated.

items.title: Dance Fo' Yo Life!
items.description: B-boy Flo Master gives the young comics a dance lesson and a challenge to create their own viral dances. With another elimination looming, the teens must use their knowledge of content creation to win over the online community.

items.title: Making a Mochrie
items.description: Whose Line Is It, Anyway? star Colin Mocherie mentors the young comics as they face their biggest improv challenge yet. Two teens are eliminated, leaving only three into the finale.

items.title: The Final Showdown
items.description: The three finalists are put to the test in a one-of-a-kind performance at the acclaimed Upright Citizens Brigade theater in the heart of Los Angeles. The eliminated cast returns to help the finalists perform in their sketches for a packed house.

items.title: Wedding Cake Dreams
items.description: At ten years old, Carrie dreamt of the man she is going to marry. Years later, she is shocked that the best man at her sister’s wedding is the man from that dream. So starts a weekend full of secrets to see if one happily ever after turns into two.

items.title: Four Kids, One Inflatable Mattress
items.description: Mary and her four children have finally moved out of a shelter into a small house, but they only have one inflatable mattress to sleep on. Rob, Trager, and a team of designers help make Mary's house a home.

items.title: Katlyn's Journey Home
items.description: Katlyn is finally getting back on her feet and has moved out of a homeless shelter into a new home. Rob, Trager, and a team of designers furnish the house to give Katlyn and her son, Gio the fresh start they need.

items.title: Mom Gets Much Needed Rest
items.description: Raina was living in an unhealthy environment when she left with her five children, and they all ended up in a shelter. She worked tirelessly to save up for a house, and now the family is finally safe. Treger, Rob, and volunteers help fill the house w

items.title: A Veteran Finds Hope
items.description: When he found out he was going to be a father, veteran Sterling turned his life around. Currently, he sleeps on the floor so that his son can have a bed. Rob, Treger, and the team help this deserving father have a fresh start.

items.title: A Medical Crisis Changes Everything
items.description: Sonya was about to buy a house when a medical crisis struck. After living in abandoned houses and apartments, Sonya and her kids finally have a permanent living space but need Trager and Rob's help to make it a home.

items.title: The Family That Sticks Together
items.description: After facing multiple traumas and struggling to raise five children on her own, Marinna lost her job, and subsequently their home. The whole family bounced between shelters, but finally Marinna and her kids have a roof over their head.

items.title: A Double Dose of Kindness
items.description: After years of addiction and homelessness, Luke has finally turned his life around and is in his first apartment. But when Treger and Rob offer their help to furnish his place, he'd rather pay it forward.

items.title: Just the Three of Us
items.description: Joe and Tiffany have made enormous progress in their battles with addiction and have been able to rent a home for their small family. Treger and Rob help furnish their home and celebrate Joe and Tiffany’s progress.

items.title: A Supermom and Two Superheroes
items.description: Quiana and her two young sons lived in shelters across three different states trying to make ends meet. Treger and Rob help furnish the family's new townhome and give the family a fresh start.

items.title: It Could Happen To You
items.description: Shaqueena experienced sudden trauma and loss that left her and her four kids homeless. After a lot of hard work, the family is back on their feet. Treger and Rob help furnish the apartment and make it feel like home.

items.title: Helping Hands
items.description: Three families from Detroit are featured in this special episode: Katlyn and Gio get help furnishing their house; Sonya and her kids experience homelessness after a medical crisis strikes; a young man pays it forward to another family in need.

items.title: Family First
items.description: Stacy and her family are finally back on their feet after leaving a troubling situation and living in numerous homeless shelters. Rob and Treger furnish their new home and help them find a fresh start.

items.title: We are Family
items.description: After experiencing the loss of loved ones, the Preyer family came together only to face a dangerous living situation. Alicia and her children escaped with what they could and moved into a shelter until they could get back on their feet.

items.title: Back on Track
items.description: Laura has overcome addiction and moved out of a homeless shelter with her daughter, Julia, into a new apartment.

items.title: People in Need
items.description: The Hardins have a brighter future after tragic events left them homeless; Joe, Tiffany, and their son are moving into their first home together; Raina has finally saved enough to find a permanent place for her family.

items.title: And Baby Makes Two
items.description: After surviving years of neglect and homelessness, Symone was determined to pave a new path for herself and her toddler.

items.title: Forever Family of Love
items.description: Zockie was going through a rough patch when she found out her niece and nephew needed a new living situation. After living in their car for years, Zockie finally saved enough to rent a home.

items.title: A Home Fit for Mermaids
items.description: After twenty-six moves in and out of homeless shelters, Vanessa and her two daughters have found a stable home. Rob and Treger give this family the fresh start they have been looking for.

items.title: Three Stories of Hope
items.description: After serving in the Marines, Sterling found himself homeless but turned his life around for his son; Laura and her daughter are finally leaving a shelter; Stacy has saved enough to move her kids from the shelter to a townhome.

items.title: From Homelessness to HomeOWNers
items.description: After battling addiction and homelessness, Marcay and Christopher have worked hard to start fresh and purchase a townhome for them and their two kids. Treger and Rob step in to furnish the house and make it a home.

items.title: Mother and Daughter, Best Friends
items.description: Leslie and her daughter, Nicole, escaped an abusive situation and ended up homeless. Leslie has finally saved up enough for a two bedroom apartment. Treger and Rob help make the apartment the safe space Leslie and Nicole need.

items.title: A Tale of Two Strangers
items.description: Though they don't know each other, Harold and Anthony have two things in common: they both have moved out of shelters and are starting fresh in the same apartment complex. Treger and Rob help them furnish their apartments.

items.title: A Mother's Love
items.description: When Mary escaped a troubled past with her special needs daughter, she left everything behind. Finally, Mary is back on her feet with a roof over their heads but needs extra help furnishing her house.

items.title: Mom Gets a Much Needed Break
items.description: Aidee grew up in the foster care system and fled a dangerous living environment when she was only a teen. After struggling for years to get on her feet, she and her three kids finally have an apartment.

items.title: Hope for the Future
items.description: Three stories from San Diego and Detroit showcase Treger and Rob's continued mission to help families coming out of homelessness.

items.title: 22 Kids and Counting

items.title: 22 Kids and Counting
items.description: Keeping their rambling 10-bedroom house clean and tidy is a never-ending task, and Sue has had enough, so Noel announces a girls v boys chore war; Tillie is due for a check-up at Alder Hey Children's Hospital.

items.description: Sue calls in a dog behaviorist to help with the three unruly French bulldogs, especially 2-year-old Bluebell.

items.title: Live, Laugh, Blush
items.description: Colton Dunn brings the laughs, the love, and the not-safe-for-work moments, all in less than 45 seconds.

items.title: Meredith Is in the House … Literally!
items.description: Meredith leaves her basement in New York and returns to the Los Angeles studio.

items.title: Hair We Go!
items.description: Colton Dunn kicks off the season with a "bang" — because there's nothing "random" about his clever choice of clues.

items.title: Sold to the Lowest Bidder
items.description: Matt Iseman's risky bidding may impress his teammates -- or leave them going, going, gone.

items.description: "25 Words or Less" superfan Rosie O'Donnell is in studio and ready to play -- but not before reminiscing with her longtime pal Meredith.

items.title: Shantay, You Stay?
items.description: Losing is a drag, so Rosie O'Donnell relies on some RuPaul-inspired clues to ensure that her team doesn't "sashay away."

items.title: Brain Freeze
items.description: Jaleel White hopes to think fast and start strong so his team won't be left experiencing some brain freeze.

items.title: Practice Makes Perfect

items.title: This Game Is No Joke
items.description: Jaleel White learns it's tough to ace a round with only 12 words.

items.title: No Pain, No Gain?
items.description: Rosie O'Donnell tries to avoid the pain of losing with some clever clues.

items.title: Easel Does It!
items.description: Matt Iseman realizes that his teammates just needed a palette cleanser when they couldn't guess his artistic clues.

items.title: 2nd Chance for Christmas
items.description: After trading love for fame and fortune long ago, a spoiled pop star is visited by the spirits of Christmas past, present and future.

items.title: 3 Generations
items.description: Hoping to get support from his mother (Naomi Watts) and grandmother (Susan Sarandon), a New York teen (Elle Fanning) prepares to transition from female to male.

items.title: 3 idiotas
items.description: Two lifelong friends embark on a quest to find a college buddy who disappeared without a trace the day before graduation.

items.title: 3-Headed Shark Attack
items.description: Passengers aboard a cruise ship fight for their lives when a mutated, three-headed shark goes on a rampage.

items.title: 3:10 to Yuma
items.description: Outlaw Ben Wade (Russell Crowe) terrorizes 1800s Arizona, especially the Southern Railroad, until he is finally captured. Wade must be brought to trial, so Dan Evans (Christian Bale), the owner of a drought-stricken ranch, volunteers to escort him to the train. Along the trail, a grudging respect forms between the men, but danger looms at every turn, and the criminal's men are in pursuit.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.

items.title: A New Arena
items.description: For Gene Simmons, the fact one of the world's biggest media markets had not been the home of a pro football franchise since 1995 presented a business opportunity he couldn't ignore. So Simmons -- whose entrepreneurial instincts helped build Kiss into one of the world's most successful rock 'n' roll bands -- created the LA KISS of the Arena Football League, and "4th and Loud" chronicles that process along with the team's inaugural season. The team's co-owners include Kiss frontman and co-founder Paul Stanley, Kiss manager Doc McGhee, managing partner and owner Brett Bouchy, and president and owner Schuyler Hoversten. All appear on the series, as well as the squad's star players.

items.title: Under Pressure
items.description: After some crucial setbacks and disappointing scrimmaging, the KISS enters the season with high ambitions.

items.title: History Begins
items.description: The team has a successful home opener in spite of the players' clashing interests and distractions during the game.

items.title: The Fall Guy
items.description: Poor performances by the team members overshadow Coach McMillen's induction into the AFL Hall of Fame.

items.title: Changing of the Guard
items.description: There is a change to the quarterback position; wishful thinking may land the team in a worse position than they were in.

items.title: Paranoid Activity
items.description: After an embarrassing loss at home, Brett Bouchy thinks that firing one of the coaches will help the team.

items.title: Marked Men
items.description: Paul and Gene start their KISS tour; the team has a must-win game against their division rivals: Portland.

items.title: Prodigal Son Returns
items.description: The team and the season seem to be in turmoil for the LA KISS; quarterback J.J. Raterink returns to try and salvage the season.

items.title: Boiling Over
items.description: Tension rises between Bob McMillen and Aaron Garcia; LA KISS faces Portland for a chance to make it into the playoffs.

items.title: Day of Reckoning
items.description: The LA KISS makes their final playoff push; the coaching staff learns if they will still be working in 2015.

items.title: 5th Street
items.description: Joe (Eric Arthur Martinez) vows revenge when his wife is killed in a gang shooting.

items.title: 6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain
items.description: Former professional hockey player Eric LeMarque finds himself stranded on a mountain during a fierce snowstorm. Coming to terms with his personal demons, he soon rediscovers the power of faith while fighting for survival.

items.title: 6 Souls
items.description: Dr. Cara Harding (Julianne Moore) is a dedicated psychiatrist skeptical about the nature of certain afflictions, especially Multiple Personality Disorder. Her skepticism starts to give way when her father, Dr. Harding (Jeffrey DeMunn), introduces her to a patient named Adam (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) who consistently assumes the personalities of murder victims. Cara's work with Adam puts her and her daughter Sammy (Brooklynn Proulx) at risk of becoming victims themselves.

items.title: Unusual Suspects
items.description: Attempting to eliminate rival gangs, drugs and corruption at their facilities, chief jailers are enlisting members of the public to help; building on the tremendous success of previous undercover operations in Clark County, Ind., and Atlanta, "60 Days In" continues in Pinal County, Ariz., as law-abiding citizens live among the facility's general population for 60 days to help expose the root of the jail's many problems; filmed around the clock, A&E Network's hourlong docuseries provides a warts-and-all view of life behind bars, as the volunteers adapt to unfamiliar and terrifying surroundings.

items.title: First Timers
items.description: The experimental program begins; the first participants include a Marine, a police officer; a teacher and a stay-at-home mother.

items.title: Cell Shock
items.description: Maryum, the eldest daughter of boxer Muhammad Ali, joins the program and fits into F-pod effortlessly; the inmates grow suspicious of Robert; a mistake places Zac in peril; Barbra questions her commitment to the experiment.

items.title: Fight Face
items.description: Isaiah and Robert worry that their covers may be blown; Capt. Maples follows through with consequences for Robert makes a risky move; Zac hunts for illegal drug use in C-pod; Tami clashes with another inmate.

items.title: Friends Without Benefits
items.description: An unexpected call to court tests Zac's strength as an inmate; Barbra abandons a friendship with Tami in order to survive; a series of catastrophic mistakes endangers Jeff.

items.title: Full Inmate
items.description: The midway point of the experiment approaches; anger rises among the women of F-Pod; an inmate in C-Pod poses a danger to one of the men.

items.title: Pod Drama
items.description: Inmate Ricky attacks Jeff, jeopardizing the program; Zac and Isaiah move from the familiar confines of C-Pod to the more violent D-Pod; Barbra feels betrayed by her F-Pod bunkmates; Robert learns that he will return to general population.

items.title: Shakedown
items.description: The participants cross the halfway point of the experiment; the sheriff orders a raid due to increased tensions and drug activity in D-pod; the residents of F-pod worry about a contagious rash.

items.title: Alone for the Holidays
items.description: Thanksgiving presents new challenges and opportunities; one of the six remaining participants is pushed to the breaking point.

items.title: Institutionalized
items.description: The participants near the end of the experiment; the program is compromised when a woman in F-Pod is pushed over the edge; both men in D-Pod struggle to avoid serious criminal activity.

items.title: 11th Hour
items.description: The five remaining participants try to finish up their final days inside jail as pressure builds within the pods.

items.title: Exodus
items.description: Three participants remain in jail; Tami finds herself on the verge of a meltdown after a woman is released from F-Pod; a power struggle erupts when a boss is removed from D-Pod.

items.title: Aftermath
items.description: All seven participants discuss their experiences; the women relive a contentious moment from inside jail; Tami confronts Robert about not taking the program seriously.

items.title: Day 5
items.description: Kite-surfing brother and sister Kevin and Jalou Langeree each travel to seven different countries to compete against each other in seven challenging races.

items.title: Day 6
items.description: Jalou has to get over a fear when she goes white water kayaking in Peru; in Thailand, Kevin feels the pressure during this second-to-last race.

items.title: Day 7
items.description: Kevin and Jalou are both in Canada; they travel from Vancouver to snowy Whistler for the final challenge: ski mountaineering.

items.title: 78/52: Hitchcock's Shower Scene
items.description: An in-depth look at the iconic shower scene in Alfred Hitchcock's "Psycho" - composed of 78 setups and 52 cuts - and the screen murder that profoundly changed world cinema.

items.title: 9/11: Chaos on the Comms
items.description: Chronicling the struggles of civilians and military personnel as they fought to take back control of the sky; official aviation and military recordings paint a picture of the immediate response to the deadliest attack in American history.

items.title: 9/11: Minute by Minute
items.description: A minute-by-minute look back at the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001, with a new perspective on the frenetic communication between the flight crews of the various planes, the military, the New York City firefighters and the president.

items.title: 9/11: Stories from the City
items.description: On September 11, 2001, the skyline and the mindset of New York City changes forever.

items.title: 96 Minutes
items.description: The lives of four children collide in a moment and hurtle toward a life-changing end.

items.title: A Bucket of Blood
items.description: Nerdy Walter Paisley (Dick Miller), a maladroit busboy at a beatnik café who doesn't fit in with the cool scene around him, attempts to woo his beautiful co-worker, Carla (Barboura Morris), by making a bust of her. When his klutziness results in the death of his landlady's cat, he panics and hides its body under a layer of plaster. But when Carla and her friends enthuse over the resulting artwork, Walter decides to create some bigger and more elaborate pieces using the same artistic process.

items.title: A Christmas Blessing
items.description: A TV chef is divinely inspired to take over her late aunt's charity with help from a new friend and handsome neighbor.

items.title: A Christmas Carol
items.description: Scottish business tycoon Mr. Scrooge faces some big changes when a trio of atypical spirits pay him a visit at Christmastime.

items.title: A Christmas Carol
items.description: An animated retelling of Dickens' classic holiday tale.

items.title: A Christmas Carol Goes Wrong
items.description: Blacklisted by the BBC after ruining "Peter Pan", the Cornley Polytechnic Drama Society hijack the jewel of the Christmas schedule, a "live" production of "A Christmas Carol" staged by a professional cast.

items.title: A Christmas Carol: The Musical
items.description: Three Christmas ghosts try to inject some genuine holiday spirit into Ebenezer Scrooge's miserly soul.

items.title: A Christmas Castle Proposal
items.description: Despite busy schedules causing distance, Olivia and Prince Alexander travel to Torovia for Christmas with his family. Clashing cultures between their families lead to various mishaps.

items.title: A Christmas Horror Story
items.description: Not even Santa Claus is safe from the evil that descends on Bailey Downs, a small town that is suddenly plagued with malevolent spirits, zombie elves and Krampus -- the anti-Santa Claus.

items.title: A Christmas in Royal Fashion
items.description: A handsome prince hopes to convince an American fashion company to bring more business to his kingdom. He hosts a Christmas fashion show, where he meets an intriguing young assistant.

items.title: A Christmas Karen
items.description: Karen is an entitled middle-aged woman whose demanding nature has alienated her neighbors and family. After a series of incidents displaying her privilege and prejudice, Karen receives an 'intervention' by some unconventional spirits.

items.title: A Christmas Princess
items.description: A prince from a small European country arrives in New York City to plan his family's annual Christmas charity dinner.

items.title: A Christmas Tale
items.description: When steely French matriarch Junon learns she has leukemia, she asks her children and grandchildren at the family Christmas gathering to see if they are eligible to become bone marrow donors. This causes deep friction in the family, especially between Junon's daughter Elizabeth and son Henri, who already have a tumultuous relationship. Their mother's sickness also recalls the traumatic loss of their brother Joseph when they were children.

items.title: A Christmas Tale
items.description: After finding an injured thief, a group of young friends decides to torture her into revealing the location of her stolen money.

items.title: A Cold Hard Truth
items.description: A journalist begins to unravel a web of shaming, lies, and secrets surrounding his cousin's suicide.

items.title: A Dark Song
items.description: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.

items.title: A Flash of Green
items.description: Jimmy Wing (Ed Harris) is a Florida journalist and long-time friend of Elmo Bliss (Richard Jordan), a local businessman and politician involved in real-estate development. Bliss reveals his ruthless side, threatening Wing when the reporter becomes close to the beautiful wildlife conservationist Kat Hubble (Blair Brown), one of a group of ecologists that stands in the way of a new landfill. While Wing clashes with Bliss, his life gets even more complicated as his romance with Hubble progresses.

items.title: A Friend of the Family
items.description: A woman suspects her husband's business partner is responsible for a string of murders in their small town.

items.title: A Girl Like Him
items.description: A small-town teen makes a surprising life change. The change causes a lifelong best friend to spiral into a dark place as he realizes things will never be the same between them.

items.title: A Good Day to Be Black & Sexy
items.description: In six vignettes from Los Angeles, the subject of sexuality and relationships within the black community shatters stereotypes about black sexuality.

items.title: A Haunted House
items.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

items.title: A Haunted House 2
items.description: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

items.title: A Haunting in Ravenwood
items.description: A newlywed couple arrives at the house of the husband's late wife, where eerie events start to lead his new bride to believe she's losing her mind.

items.title: A Hero Ain't Nothin' But a Sandwich
items.description: A troubled boy becomes addicted to heroin, and his mother and foster father help him fight it.

items.title: A Hijacking
items.description: After Somali pirates hijack a Danish cargo ship and take the crew hostage, authorities in Copenhagen begin negotiations with the pirates to free the crew.

items.title: A Hot Cocoa Christmas
items.description: After Haley Lloyd has been burned by countless suitors, it's refreshing when shy but handsome Claud falls for her, unaware of her true identity: However, when that truth inevitably comes out, it puts their budding Christmas romance at risk.

items.title: A House on Fire
items.description: Brilliant doctor and mother Deborah Green had the epitome of a picture-perfect life with two children, an adoring husband and a beautiful house in an opulent neighborhood.

items.title: Olives and Onions
items.description: A host is challenged to create one dish using two ingredients that start with the same letter.

items.title: Apples and Anchovies
items.description: Chef Lauren Gulyas must use these distinct flavors in the same dish.

items.title: Cashews and Carrots
items.description: Chef Lauren Gulyas makes chicken with a nutty, buttery crust, crushing up some cashews into a powder; she puts a twist on the classic carrot cake by making rich carrot cupcakes complete with homemade cream cheese frosting.

items.title: Okra & Oats
items.description: Combine oats and okra into a single dish. What do you get? Chef Robert Jewell has a delicious idea!

items.title: A Kid Called Danger
items.description: Eager to be a policeman like his father, a young detective (Clayton Taylor) takes a case that the department has been unable to solve.

items.title: A Kind of Murder
items.description: Walter Stackhouse is rich, successful and unhappily married to the beautiful but damaged Clara. His desire to be free of her feeds his obsession with Kimmel, a man suspected of brutally murdering his own wife. When Walter and Kimmel's lives become dangerously intertwined, a ruthless police detective becomes convinced he has found the murderer. But as the lines blur between innocence and intent, who, in fact, is the real killer?

items.title: A Kindhearted Christmas
items.description: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

items.title: A League of Ordinary Gentlemen
items.description: While other minor sports like professional wrestling and auto racing boomed, the once-vibrant pro bowling circuit dwindled after its mid-20th-century heyday, so much so that it neared extinction in the 1990s. In this affectionate documentary, a quartet of professional bowlers discuss life in the big leagues, as famous bowling aficionados like basketball star Charles Barkley, journalist Bernard Goldberg and actor/director Timothy Busfield enthuse about their affection for the sport.

items.title: A Little Women's Christmas
items.description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

items.title: A Long Way Down
items.description: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

items.title: A Merry Royal Christmas
items.description: A wedding planner pulled in for a last-minute royal wedding on Christmas Day is shocked to discover the groom is the alluring stranger she met before.

items.title: A Miami Tail
items.description: The women of Liberty City protest the disrespect of women by refusing sex to their gangbanging boyfriends.

items.title: A Mother's Embrace
items.description: In 1996, a young firefighter and her team are called to help an old people's home that is at risk of a flood during the worst storm to ever hit Rio de Janeiro.

items.title: A Mother's Intuition
items.description: With help from a handsome investigator, a brilliant sculptor unravels the twisted truth behind her missing newborn baby.

items.title: A Mother's Love
items.description: A strong, independent woman (Rolonda Watts) has a taste for the good life, but it does not necessarily include her husband and daughter. Only a mother's love can pray her back down to Earth.

items.title: A New Christmas
items.description: A grieving man faces the holidays for the first time without his beloved mother, who died unexpectedly last Christmas Eve.

items.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
items.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late?

items.title: A Perfect Man
items.description: An unfaithful husband (Liev Schreiber) falls back in love with his wife (Jeanne Tripplehorn) over the phone when she pretends to be someone else.

items.title: A Place at the Table
items.description: An examination of the issue of hunger in America focuses on the plight of three individuals from different parts of the country who struggle to find adequate nutrition.

items.title: A Prince for Christmas
items.description: A prince from Europe meets a charming waitress when he travels to America during the Christmas holiday to escape an arranged marriage.

items.title: A River of Skulls
items.description: Eula fends for herself after her mother dies amid the 1870s Gold Rush. With few people she can trust, Eula tags along with an outcast searching for his bandit father and quickly realizes that the world is more dangerous than she had imagined.

items.title: A Royal Affair
items.description: A young queen falls in love with her physician, and they start a revolution that changes their nation forever.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Ball
items.description: Dateless for the Christmas ball, bachelor King Charles of Baltania tracks down Allison, his American college sweetheart, only to discover she has never been married, yet raised a 17-year-old daughter, Lily, who mathematically might be Charles' child.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
items.description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

items.title: A Savage Art: The Life & Cartoons of Pat Oliphant
items.description: Political cartoonist Patrick Oliphant used his biting wit and drawing skills to take on presidents, popes and the powers that be.

items.title: A Score to Settle
items.description: Diagnosed with a fatal condition, a mob enforcer leaves prison after 19 years and plots a bloody course of revenge against his old gang.

items.title: A Soldier's Story II: Return From the Dead
items.description: After escaping with their lives, an engaged couple set out to save their friends and family before war consumes them all.

items.title: A Song for Christmas
items.description: Two single parents stumble into the possibility of love for Christmas, only to discover that their daughters are embroiled in a nasty rivalry at school.

items.title: Boo's Birthday

Natalie's father, Dexter (Bill Moseley), realizes what's afoot, but he'll need some help if he's to prevent the witch from stealing his daughter's soul. Dexter teams with Edward Carnby (Rick Yune) and Abner Lundberg (Lance Henriksen), both of whom have previously tangled with witches, and together they set out to rid the world of the witch's brand of black magic.

items.title: Living in Art: Kaleidoscopic Homes
items.description: The notion of home has evolved from "typical" to downright head-scratching and oftentimes, jaw dropping. On Alt-Home, host Jillian Rose Reed explores the expansive and endless genres that now re-define home. From 3-D printed homes to container homes, van life to adobe life, the new generation of home is nothing short of fascinating. Take a look inside.

items.title: Container Homes: All Shapes and Sizes
items.description: Jillian discovers two homeowners who have taken containers-and creativity-to extraordinary new heights; Sean's property is a sprawling estate crafted from five containers and Kylie is in the middle of building a massive yoga retreat.

items.title: Off-Grid Living: The Creative Space
items.description: Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

items.title: Once Upon a Time: Fairy Tale Homes
items.description: Jillian explores some of the most whimsical homes in Southern California: the famed Hobbit Apartments in Culver City, a home built into a bridge, and a historic Storybook home filled with charm and a storied past.

items.title: From Cats to Co-Living: A Place for Everyone
items.description: Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

items.title: Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
items.description: Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

items.title: Alternative Investments
items.description: Dive into the somewhat underground world of trading cards to find out why they make a great alternative investment; from vintage sports cards to modern-day Pokémon, explore how collectors are turning passion into profit.

From Steve Jobs vs. Bill Gates to William Hurst vs. Joseph Pulitzer, each hourlong episode focuses on a specific rivalry, delving into fierce power struggles, deceit, fluke timing and raw ambition out of which great ideas turned into reality. The conflicts play out through re-enactments that feature interviews with modern-day visionaries like Bill Nye, Steve Wozniak, Jack Welch, Steve Wynn and Michio Kaku.

Sheen stars as Charlie, a former professional baseball player whose career was ended by an injury caused by his anger issues. Charlie went back to school after his playing career ended and now works as a therapist who specializes in anger management. Even though he now helps others control their anger problems, Charlie continues to battle his own anger issues. items.description: H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

items.description: Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

items.title: Modern Woodshop
items.description: Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

items.title: A Space For Dancing and Hanging
items.description: When space inside the house is feeling maxed out, finding solutions outside and expanding the living space by tapping into a backyard's potential can help.

items.title: Family of Five Funhouse
items.description: Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

items.title: Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop
items.description: Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

items.title: Stained Glass Studio
items.description: Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

items.title: Wellness Wonderland
items.description: Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

items.title: Life-Sized Sister Playhouse
items.description: Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

items.title: Plunge Pool Paradise
items.description: Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

items.title: Pooch Party Pavillion
items.description: Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

items.title: Social Central Sunroom
items.description: Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

items.title: Mid-Century Poolside Retreat
items.description: Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

items.title: Sports & Social Zone
items.description: France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

items.title: Nana's Wonderland
items.description: Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

items.title: Parisian Escape
items.description: Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

items.title: Country Supper Club & Coop
items.description: Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

items.title: Gentleman's Gym
items.description: Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

items.title: Creative Lounge
items.description: Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

items.title: Luxury Staycation
items.description: Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

items.title: D.J.'s Den
items.description: Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

items.description: It's a race against time to find the antidote when a girl is infected by an amphibious monster.

items.title: Bad Boys

Prison life proves even more brutal than the streets when Mick is forced to face off against reigning prison toughs Viking (Clancy Brown) and Tweety (Robert Lee Rush). Worse yet, on the outside, Paco is threatening to take revenge on those close to Mick -- including his girlfriend (Ally Sheedy).

items.title: Bad Land
items.description: College students fight for their lives when they encounter a murderous backwoods family in the Deep South.

items.description: Who is infected? Who is the AI killer among them? A group of stranded teenagers must discover the meaning of being human in order to save the world and be back home in time for tea.

items.title: Bad Tutor

items.title: Badland
items.description: Gunslinging detective Matthias Breecher is hired by one of the first African American senators to track down the worst of the Confederate war criminals. As he traverses the titular hellish badlands seeking justice, his resolve is tested when he meets a determined pioneer woman who is far more than she seems.

After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not.
