items.title: Bait Shop
items.description: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a small-town bait shop competes in a fishing tournament for the prize money to save his business.

items.title: Ballad of a Gunfighter
items.description: An outlaw (Marty Robbins) and his partner (Bob Barron) feud over the same woman (Joyce Reed).

items.title: Ballbuster
items.description: A suspended basketball player must tour with a charity league as part of his punishment.

items.title: Ballet 422
items.description: Filmmaker Jody Lee Lipes follows emerging choreographer Justin Peck as he undertakes the difficult tasks of creating and dancing in the New York City Ballet's 422nd original piece.

items.title: Ballpark Blast!
items.description: Step up to the plate with KidCity, Dan Rhodes, and Hungry FAM for a grand slam family adventure.

items.title: Balls Out
items.description: Fifth year college senior Caleb Fuller (Jake Lacy) gets his flag football team back together for one last shot at intramural football glory.

items.title: Ban the Sadist Videos!

items.title: Band Aid
items.description: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band.

items.title: Bandslam
items.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

items.title: Bare
items.description: A young woman's (Dianna Agron) friendship with a drug-dealing drifter (Paz de la Huerta) evolves into a lesbian romance.

items.title: Barking Dogs Never Bite
items.description: Frustrated with loud barking, an academic (Lee Sung-jae) wages war against dogs in his apartment building.

items.title: Bart Got a Room
items.description: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

items.title: Barun Rai and the House on the Cliff
items.description: When Harmesh and Soumili move to the sleepy town of Covid's Head, they are unaware of the suicides plaguing the area and local police. Their new abode is at the center of an unspeakable evil, and only one specialist can help.

items.title: Basket Case 2
items.description: Duane (Kevin Van Hentenryck) and his Siamese twin in a wicker basket join an eccentric (Annie Ross) and her human menagerie.

items.title: Basket Case 3: The Progeny

items.title: Batman
items.description: Kaaapowie! Holy feature film, Batman ... one based on the tongue-in-cheek, campy 1960s television series. Watch Batman and Robin battle sharks, Catwoman, The Joker and The Riddler on the big screen. Can they try to prevent the bad guys from taking over the world? With a wham! and a pow! and a zip! ... our heroes just might win.

items.title: Amphibious Armored Vehicle, Bomb Robot and Life Raft
items.description: Behind the scenes at military factories, where raw materials become products ready for combat.

items.title: Helmet/Zippo/Fuel Bladder/Simulated IED
items.description: Up until the mid-1990s, helmets hadn't evolved far from World War I, until a series of delicate, snowflake-shaped sheets of Aramid were pressed together to form a piece of headgear comfortable enough to wear and tough enough to take a bullet.

items.title: Pistols/ Firetrucks/ Ghillie Suits/ Armored Vehicles
items.description: A must-see look at the manufacturing wizardry behind pistols, fire trucks, ghillie suits and armored fighting vehicles; with troops' lives on the line, there is no margin for error.

items.title: Battle of the Bulge: Winter War
items.description: Lt. Cappa and his platoon defend a field hospital just behind the frontline near Lanzerath, Belgium, and hope to keep supplies out of German hands. They grow suspicious of a squad of American MPs with exaggerated accents.

items.title: Battle of the Bulge: Wunderland
items.description: On Christmas day in 1944, the Germans make one final push against the attacking allied armies in the Western Hemisphere. Lt. Robert Capa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers are ordered to hold a vital road junction against the German aggressors. Somehow, Capa and his men must find the strength to stand against their enemy in the fight known as "The Battle of the Bulge."

items.title: Battle Royale
items.description: 42 9th graders are sent to a deserted island. They are given a map, food, and various weapons. An explosive collar is fitted around their neck. If they break a rule, the collar explodes. Their mission: kill each other and be the last one standing. The last survivor is allowed to leave the island. If there is more than one survivor, the collars explode and kill them all.

items.title: Battle Royale II: Requiem

items.title: Knot It

Step-by-step lessons, from basic to advanced, help viewers create their own one-of-a-kind designs. Among the focuses of the show is heirlooms, with new twists on traditional jewelry-making techniques. Some projects include a rippled bracelet embellished with beads; unconventional jewelry with a variety of threads, cords and large beads; and rings and earrings with vintage and new buttons.

items.title: Design It
items.description: Color block necklace; shaping peyote stitch; beaded holiday ornaments; gluing crystal embellishments.

items.title: Hammering, Torching and Shaping

items.title: Art Inspired Jewelry Making

items.title: Modern Ingenuity

items.title: Water

items.title: Metal Elements

items.title: Techniques

items.title: Hurricane Lester

items.title: Wander Woman

items.title: Kick the Bucket List
items.description: For a thrill-seeking grandfather of two, there's no such thing as retiring from life; Bear Grylls and Art go full throttle to fulfill Art's bucket list and capture a story worth telling his grandson back home.

items.title: Beast From Haunted Cave
items.description: A gold thief and his crew hole up in a skier's lodge and come across a scary monster covered in cobwebs.

items.title: Beautiful Boy
items.description: Stuck in an unhappy but comfortable marriage, businessman Bill (Michael Sheen) and his wife, Kate (Maria Bello), are shocked when they learn that their son, Sammy (Kyle Gallner), has gone on a deadly shooting spree on his college campus before committing suicide. Struggling to avoid the media, the couple flees to the house of Kate's brother, Eric (Alan Tudyk). While the two try to remember what they might have done to drive Sammy to his desperate act, their mutual resentment builds.

items.description: Examining serial killer Ian Brady's upbringing, early life and what led him to commit murder.

items.title: Escalation and Elation
items.description: Criminal Ian Brady moves to Manchester where he meets Myra Hindley; they start planning to commit murder.

items.title: Comeuppance
items.description: Moors murderer Ian Brady kills a fifth victim; he is arrested and then spends the rest of his life in prison.

items.title: Growing Pains
items.description: Insights into the world of Orangutan Jungle School, where orphaned orangutans are nurtured by trained human caregivers and taught survival skills they need to one day survive in the wild.

items.title: Bee Gees: Everlasting Words
items.description: The journey of the Bee Gees, three brothers who wrote all of their hits and became one of the world's best-selling music groups of all time, selling over more than 220 million records worldwide.

items.title: Before We Go
items.description: A chance encounter between two strangers (Chris Evans, Alice Eve) in Grand Central Terminal sparks a life-changing, nighttime sojourn through New York City.

items.title: Begin Again
items.description: Gretta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Gretta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Gretta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Gretta's first album.

items.title: Interior Designer Explains Every Decision Behind This SoHo Loft Renovation
items.description: Overlooked and forgotten stories behind the ingenious designs of everyday objects.

items.title: Behind the Screen
items.description: An overwhelmed set dresser (Charles Chaplin) at a film studio helps a young woman (Edna Purviance) find a job there, while his co-workers strike against the tyrannical boss.

items.title: Flotsom and Jetsom
items.description: Deciding to turn over a new leaf, a group of friends who also happen to be vampires and werewolves move into a house together, only to find that it is haunted by ghosts of people who have been killed under mysterious circumstances. As they deal with the challenges of being supernatural creatures, their desire to be human bonds them.

items.title: Tully
items.description: Another werewolf befriends George and begins to take him under his wing.

items.title: Where the Wild Things Are
items.description: Mitchell tries to restrain his taste for blood; Annie deals with her past; George needs a new place to transform.

items.title: Cure and Contagion
items.description: Vampire society is about to implode following the death of Herrick; George seems like a changed man; Nina reveals a shocking secret.

items.title: Lia
items.description: The net is closing in on Mitchell; Annie is trapped in purgatory; George and Nina battle domestic challenges.

items.title: The Longest Day
items.description: The housemates must make a decision about Herrick.

items.title: The Graveyard Shift
items.description: Hal reluctantly works at the café with Tom, but his encounter with the vampires introduces an alternative proposition; Annie's determination to safeguard the baby drives her to contemplate extreme measures.

items.title: The War Child
items.description: The Old Ones have arrived and are intent on taking over the world by force; Cutler has other plans, but when they go awry, his revenge on his own kind is plotted.

items.title: The Trinity
items.description: Ghost Alex adjusts to life after death with werewolf Tom and vampire Hal; meeting poisonous pensioner Captain Hatch, behind whose foul exterior lurks an ancient evil.

items.title: Bell, Book and Candle
items.description: In the late 1950s, Gillian Holroyd (Kim Novak) is a modern-day witch living in New York City's Greenwich Village. When she encounters charming publisher Shepherd Henderson (James Stewart), she decides to make him hers by casting a love spell. Gillian takes added pleasure in doing so because Henderson is engaged to her old college rival (Janice Rule). However, Gillian finds herself actually falling for Shepherd, which poses a problem: She will lose her powers if she falls in love.

items.title: Belle
items.description: Desperate to save her sick father, Belle searches for a mythical rose that's believed to be a cure. However, as payment for the rose, she must surrender herself to a vicious beast that casts a spell on her.

items.title: Belle Starr
items.description: After the Civil War, Union troops catch Belle Shirley (Gene Tierney), a Southern belle, harboring the wanted Confederate guerrilla fighter Sam Starr (Randolph Scott). In retribution, Union major and old friend Thomas Crail (Dana Andrews) must follow orders by burning down their home and arresting Shirley's brother (John Shepperd). Incensed, Shirley springs Starr from jail and joins his rebels. But after marrying Starr, Shirley discovers the outlaw life is not what she thought it would be.

items.title: Belly Timber
items.description: John McCormick makes a settlement along White River. However, his peace is soon disturbed by an evil entity.

items.title: Below the Border
items.description: An outlaw (Charles King) murders a U.S. marshal and then flees south of the Mexican border. The Rough Riders are determined to bring him to justice, and they proceed by employing their preferred method: covert operations. Buck Roberts (Buck Jones) poses as a former criminal, Tim McCall (Tim McCoy) impersonates a cattle buyer and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) assumes the role of a saloon handyman. They quietly gather information and use it to close in on the dastardly outlaw.

items.title: Ben
items.description: A boy, Danny, befriends a rat named Ben and forms an army of his rodent friends in the city drains. Under Ben's orders, the killer rats sweep through the city. The victims are numerous, the stores are devastated, and the population is terrorized.

items.title: Choke
items.description: One can discern hockey's greatness live or by watching a game on TV, but the sport's ultimate attractions -- speed, skill, toughness, heart -- are best felt by playing it. For Paul Rosenberg and his buddies, the thrill of lacing the skates and hitting the ice to compete for local men's team The Chubbys is their bonding agent, strong enough that it's turned irrational and caused Paul all sorts of issues with his wife, Karen. Meanwhile, along for the ride are Paul's best friends Anthony, the charmer who schemes his way through life; Dicky, the wealthy hedge fund manager whose answer to everything is in his wallet; and Sebalos, the slacker on a misguided search for his purpose.

items.title: Wake 'Em Up
items.description: The guys gain a team sponsor while Paul tries to reschedule a family commitment; Karen shares a questionable new joke with her acupuncturist.

items.title: Prodigal Son
items.description: Paul, Sebalos and Dickie clean up their act to try to one-up Anthony in a higher hockey division; Karen hosts a book club.

items.title: Fight Club
items.description: Paul and Karen take a sick day after they both get the chicken pox but the Chubbys decide to crash it and teach Paul how to deal with a disruptive neighbor.

items.title: The Sport of Kings
items.description: The Chubbys get a new goalie causing an issue among the team; the team is presented with a promising new business venture.

items.title: Secrets and Lies
items.description: Paul finds out Karen has a secret journal; after doing a favor for Vito, Sebalos and Anthony receive a few massages; Sebalos is attracted to a masseuse.

items.title: Nice Day for a Boat Ride
items.description: Karen returns from a business trip in Las Vegas with a couple of surprises for Paul; Anthony tries to tune out the noise of a new relationship.

items.title: California Here We Come
items.description: Paul and Karen discuss the future after Karen receives an exciting new job offer; the Chubbys host a wild farewell party.

items.title: Beneath the Darkness
items.description: Teenagers discover a terrible secret when they break into the home of a mortician whose wife died two years earlier.

items.title: Berlin Job
items.description: After losing a shipment of cocaine, two gangsters (Frank Harper, Craig Fairbrass) plan a heist to settle their debt.

items.title: Berlin, I Love You
items.description: Ten stories of love, compassion, redemption and acceptance set against the vivid backdrop of Berlin.

items.title: Bernie the Dolphin
items.description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

items.title: Bernie the Dolphin 2
items.description: The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

items.title: The Daunting Fortress of Richard the Lionheart
items.description: English King Richard the Lionheart builds a formidable castle along France's Seine River to assert his supremacy over his rich and strategic lands in Normandy.

items.title: The Siege of Orléans, Joan's Fortress
items.description: French forces defend Orleans from an English army during a violent and pitiless siege between 1428 and 1429 during the Hundred Years' War.

items.title: The Siege of La Rochelle, the Battle of the Megastructures
items.description: Built at strategic points and fitted with impressive defenses, fortresses are thought to be impenetrable.

items.title: The Siege of Alesia, Caesar's Greatest Victory
items.description: A look at the siege of Alesia, a great battle between the Gauls and Romans that brought thousands of soldiers to the plains of France and is a classic example of siege warfare.

items.title: Best Worst Movie
items.description: This documentary reviews the making of the film "Troll 2" from the perspective of its former child actor star, Michael Stephenson. In 1989, a group of actors and an Italian production crew join forces to produce a slice of unwitting cinematic history. Stephenson and those involved with the ill-fated sequel tell the story of Italian director Claudio Fragasso's B-movie classic, among them the Alabama dentist who became a cult star because of his famous, immortal line.

items.title: Better Watch Out
items.description: Ashley travels to the suburban home of the Lerners to baby-sit their 12-year-old son Luke at Christmastime. She must soon defend herself and the young boy when unwelcome intruders announce their arrival.

items.title: Betty & Coretta
items.description: After the assassinations of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X, their widows, Coretta Scott King and Betty Shabazz, continue to raise their children and fight for the cause.

items.title: Between the Miles
items.description: A hapless musician overcomes her reckless tendencies to care for three homeless teens.

items.title: Beware: Children at Play
items.description: A disturbed teen brainwashes children, turning them into cannibalistic zombies.

items.title: Beyoncé: Beyond The Glam
items.description: A look at award-winning pop artist Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter's rise to stardom, chronicling her journey from her hometown of Houston, Texas; Beyoncé rises to fame as lead singer in Destiny's Child and embarks upon a successful solo career.

items.title: Beyoncé: On Top
items.description: As a multi-platinum, award-winning artist, actress, and businesswoman, Beyoncé's success to date is estimated at over $350 million; nearly 20 years since appearing on the scene with the group Destiny's Child, she continues to make headlines.

items.title: Beyoncé: Queen B
items.description: See how once Beyoncé released her fifth solo album in 2013, it became evident that the singer, songwriter and dancer wasn't merely an entertainer but a progressive artist as well; explore the story of modern day superstardom, as we take you through the journey of Beyoncé.

items.title: Beyond Existence
items.description: To save the human race, a government agent must protect a professor with a deadly secret from an immortal bounty hunter.

items.title: Life Behind Bars
items.description: From the team behind CNN's highly rated original series "Finding Jesus" comes "Beyond Reasonable Doubt," an unscripted offering designed to broaden HLN's true crime audience. The hourlong series takes viewers deep inside the world of crime fighting through high-profile criminal cases that were ultimately solved by advances in forensic science or technology. Driven by first-person storytelling, episodes feature the lead detectives of each case and a supporting cast of forensic scientists who highlight how technology is changing the face of criminal investigations.

items.title: Norco Bank Robbery
items.description: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

items.title: Longest Prison Terms
items.description: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

items.title: Courtroom Confrontations
items.description: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

items.title: Teen Murder Cases
items.description: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

items.title: The Tyreek Hill Incident
items.description: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

items.title: Episode 4
items.description: LA Xtreme gives you an inside look at their team and processes.

items.title: Episode 5
items.description: LA Xtreme gives you an inside look at their team and processes.

items.title: Beyond the Law
items.description: A former mobster turned businessman and a police detective must contend with a dirty ex-cop looking to bring the killer of his son to justice.

items.title: Beyond the Sky
items.description: Chris Norton attends a UFO convention to try and disprove the alien abduction phenomenon. He soon meets Emily, a woman who claims that aliens abduct her every seven years on her birthday. With Emily's 28th birthday just days away, Chris comes to the sudden realization that we may not be alone in the universe after all.

items.title: Big Driver
items.description: With her mind shattered, a novelist seeks revenge on the man who brutally assaulted her on a desolate New England road.

items.title: Trailer Park Romance
items.description: The Rev. Tony Talavera and his wife, Lou Ann, own the only wedding chapel in New Orleans' French Quarter. Prior to moving to New Orleans, the Talaveras ran an antiques business. As you can imagine, running a wedding chapel in the Big Easy is more interesting (to put it lightly) than running an antiques business. They have seen it all while in the wedding business -- from barroom brawls to quirky cemetery ceremonies. The chapel's staff includes take-no-prisoners wedding planner Maria, musician Dana, security guard Gino and feisty photographer Mia. The Talaveras and their staff are committed to making sure each couple experience an unforgettable wedding day ... Big Easy style.

items.title: Fishing Camp Fiasco
items.description: Drama for Chassidy and groom Nick; drunken wedding party.

items.title: Sunday, Bloody Sunday
items.description: Queen M has trouble deciding who will her maid of honor; tall man and short bride couple.

items.title: The Coming Out Episode
items.description: Bourbon Street parade; Wild West wedding at a bar; heavy metal theme wedding; sleeping on the job.

items.title: Swamp Wedding
items.description: A swamp ceremony ; mail order bride; stoner couple; wacky street performers; wedding at a local bar.

items.title: Curse of the Goths
items.description: A Goth's request for cemeteries and hearses; bossy bride; superhero theme wedding; airboat wedding.

items.title: Riverboat Rivalry
items.description: A Mardi Gras themed wedding; things get bizarre in the chapel.

items.title: Booty-Boucing Bash
items.description: Layla and Diamond throw a double wedding; an arranged marriage gone bad; a lesbian bride wants one last kiss.

items.title: Big Kill
items.description: A tenderfoot from Philadelphia, two misfit gamblers on the run and a deadly preacher have a date with destiny in a boomtown gone bust in the Old West.

items.title: Big Mo
items.description: Cincinnati Royals' Jack Twyman (Bo Svenson) spends years helping paralyzed teammate Maurice Stokes (Bernie Casey).

items.title: BiggerPockets Money
items.description: Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench interview those who have achieved orare on their way to achieving financial freedom. From debt-ridden credit card consumers lookingfor advice to late starters building wealth in their 50s and 60s, we talk to anyone and everyonewho's on a personal finance journey so YOU can learn from theirlessons and make moneywork for you. We highlight repeatable investing strategies to retire early.

items.title: BiggerPockets Money
items.description: In this special Part 1 episode of the BiggerPockets Money Podcast, Mindy Jensen and her husband Carl head to The Money Guy Show studio for a comprehensive portfolio review with Brian Preston and Bo Hanson.

items.title: BiggerPockets Money
items.description: Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench interview those who have achieved or are on their way to achieving financial freedom; from debt-ridden credit card consumers looking for advice to late starters building wealth in their 50s and 60s, we talk to anyone and everyone who's on a personal finance journey so YOU can learn from their lessons and make money work for you; we highlight repeatable investing strategies to retire early.

items.title: BiggerPockets Money
items.description: Kevin Scanlan, better known as the Financial Tutor, shares how he went from house hacking in Chicago to building nearly two million dollars in net worth by age 32 and leaving his six-figure corporate job.

items.title: Bill Cosby: Walking Free
items.description: Following the twists and turns of Bill Cosby's legal battles as he faces allegations from 60 women, dating as far back as the '60s.

items.title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
items.description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

items.title: Bill Hicks: Revelations
items.description: The comedian observes religion, evolution, childbirth and politics in London.

items.title: Bill Hicks: Sane Man
items.description: Live comedy performed by Bill Hicks.

items.title: Lets Get Ready to Showdown
items.description: Aspiring entrepreneurs compete in business challenges; the last mogul standing wins the grand prize of bringing the next billion-dollar business idea to the market.

items.title: Pitch Perfect
items.description: Kristen and Aaron compete in a "Start-Up Challenge" selling baseball cards; they pitch new products, Kristen proposes a no-sugar alcohol mix, while Aaron chooses sugarless spices; Kristen's tech fails.

items.title: Ray Versus the Wax Warriors
items.description: A new pair of entrepreneurs enter the fight for equity; Musa and Ray face-off in dueling car washes; both struggle, leading to low sales numbers; however, Musa's charisma and customer service lead to him winning the first challenge.

items.title: Naked and Afraid of Losing
items.description: Ray and Musa clash again at Naked Taco; in this restaurant challenge, they manage angry customers, a busy kitchen and even staff callouts. Both are successful in pivoting every obstacle.

items.title: The Great Crypto Clash
items.description: The third set of entrepreneurs face-off for the grand prize; Will and Ariana compete in a head to head yard sale; Ariana ends up winning and gains an advantage for the next challenge.

items.title: Baking With the Enemy
items.description: Will and Ariana get tasked with creating and backing a new product for No Sugar co.; Will faces a disadvantage; an impressive pitch sends Ariana to the finale, where she will face the other winners.

items.title: Level Up Ladies
items.description: Paula and Kristen get a paperclip and must trade up for something of higher value; Kristen's ability to secure headphones causes her to prevail in their first challenge.

items.title: Making a Billion Dollar Brand
items.description: The final pair of entrepreneurs enter the ring, fighting for equity of a billion-dollar company; Paula and Kristen get a paperclip and they must trade up for something of higher value.

items.title: Semi-final Showdown (Part 1)
items.description: Our finalists learn that the winner will not only receive equity in a billion dollar company, but they will also oversee the development of a kid's no sugar vitamin gummy; for their first in a series of challenges, they are tested on media skills.

items.title: Semi-final Showdown (Part 2)
items.description: For their next challenge, the finalists create a brand package for their potential new company's main product; after developing the logo, jingle and other marketing tools, they present to the judges.

items.title: Miami Heatwave
items.description: Musa's entertaining jingle and fun concept lead him to success; with his win, he now decides the fate of his fellow competitors.

items.title: Billion Dollar Champion
items.description: The grand finale showcases Musa and Ariana facing off in a fierce sales competition; using a home shopping channel, they must sell through their inventory as well as maintain a charismatic attitude.

items.title: Billy the Kid
items.description: All hell breaks loose after a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang.

items.title: Bitterbrush
items.description: In the remote and rugged mountains of the American West, two young women contemplate the future as they work alone herding cattle.

items.title: BKO: Bangkok Knockout
items.description: Friends in a fight club battle assassins after their pals are kidnapped.

items.title: Black Bear
items.description: A filmmaker plays a calculated game of desire and jealousy in pursuit of a work of art that blurs the boundaries between autobiography and invention.

items.title: Black Belt Jones
items.description: A martial artist (Jim Kelly) helps a father (Scatman Crothers) and daughter (Gloria Hendry) save their school of self-defense from Los Angeles mobsters.

items.title: Black Christmas
items.description: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

items.title: Black Cobra 3: Manila Connection
items.description: An agent (Forry Smith) teams up with his father's buddy (Fred Williamson) on a jungle mission to recover stolen weapons.

items.title: Black Death
items.description: During the time of the bubonic plague in 14th-century England, young monk Osmund is recruited by the knight Ulric to lead a group of soldiers through the marshes into a mysterious village, where rumors are spreading that a necromancer is raising plague victims from the dead. Osmund agrees, but he has an ulterior motive—to find Averill, a young woman who has gone missing. Along the way, the group encounters unimagined darkness.

items.title: Black Eye
items.description: An ex-police officer operating a private detective business comes face to face with a syndicate-backed dope ring.

items.title: Black Roses
items.description: A small-town teacher (John Martin) saves teenage souls from a heavy-metal rocker (Sal Viviano) and his band from hell.

items.title: I.
items.description: A prequel to the classic Robert Louis Stevenson novel "Treasure Island," "Black Sails" is a pirate adventure that centers on the tales of Captain Flint, who has a reputation throughout the West Indies as being the most brilliant, most feared of all the Golden Age pirates. It's 1715, and as Flint fights for the survival of New Providence Island -- a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers -- in the wake of threats from British and Spanish forces, he aligns himself with Eleanor Guthrie, daughter of the local kingpin, to hunt the ultimate prize and ensure his people's survival. But standing in the way are rival captains, Eleanor's intrusive father, and perhaps the bigger obstacle of all: John Silver, a young, fast-talking, authority-flouting sailor recently added to Flint's crew.

items.title: Black Samson
items.description: A nightclub owner (Rockne Tarkington) with a pet lion rids his neighborhood of a white mobster (William Smith).

items.title: Unfinished Business
items.description: Detective James Cormack works to solve cold cases, uncovering long-buried secrets along the way; at the same time, he's haunted by his personal quest to find his younger brother, who vanished when they were children.

items.title: Predators
items.description: After the discovery of Isabel's hair, those involved with the time capsule project from 1994 are at the forefront of Cormack's investigation. He makes a huge discovery when the blue car seen following Isabel on the night of the murder shows up in the time capsule documentary. Hazel, Isabel's sister, is unsure if she should trust Cormack or help him with the case, as she's harboring a past secret of her own that threatens to resurface.

items.title: Ezekiel
items.description: Rumors spread around Ashford, and suspicion lands on Joe, Isabel's father; as Cormack interviews the time capsule kids, more secrets emerge.

items.title: The Lost Boys
items.description: Cormack investigates the link between Ezekiel's missing cousins. "The lost boys," and Isabel's murder as a new person comes forward with evidence.

items.title: Sugar Sugar
items.description: Turner concludes that Billy's death was an accident, but Cormack suspects foul play and believes it's linked to the missing workers and Isabel's murder.

items.title: Spirits Speak
items.description: Cormack tries to track Anton down to question him, but he's disappeared, and when Cormack and Hazel discover that Kalana is also missing, they fear the worst.

items.title: Blackenstein
items.description: A war veteran (Joe DeSue) whose limbs were medically restored becomes a killer when his physician's (John Hart) aid switches his medication.

items.title: Blackway
items.description: A vengeful young woman recruits two men to help her track down a former cop who stalked and attacked her.

items.title: Blades
items.description: A peaceful country club becomes the hunting ground for a demonically possessed lawnmower with a taste for human flesh.

items.title: Blades in the Darkness

When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run.

items.description: With Jemma Mitchell arrested, police have a circumstantial case against their chief suspect in the case of Deborah Chong's murder; the filmmaker dives deep into the crime and examines how police used CCTV evidence to arrest Jemma Mitchell.

items.title: Puglia
items.description: Michael makes some Apulian classics.

items.title: Abruzzo
items.description: Michael shows us diverse regional recipes like rolled meat crêpes.

items.title: Campania
items.description: Michael prepares classics like margherita pizza and fried seafood.

items.title: Emilia Romagna
items.description: Michael prepares dishes from the culinary heart of Italy.

items.title: Calabria
items.description: Michael explores the diversity of the Italian region Calabria.

items.title: Lombardy

items.description: Michael's culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige from his own kitchen.

items.title: Piemonte
items.description: Michael shows us how to make his warm regional dishes like bagna cauda.

items.title: Umbria

items.title: Calabria
items.description: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria; for his antipasto, he cooks up a light and refreshing brioche with gelato; a spicy sausage and ricotta pasta.

items.title: San Francisco
items.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring.

items.title: Showdown
items.description: A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

items.title: The Mission
items.description: Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

items.title: Badge Without Honor
items.description: A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

items.title: The Mill
items.description: Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

items.title: The Hopefuls
items.description: Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

items.title: Denver McKee
items.description: The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

items.title: Day of Reckoning
items.description: Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

items.title: The Abduction
items.description: Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

items.title: Breed of Violence
items.description: A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

items.title: The Last Viking
items.description: For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

items.title: The Trail Gang
items.description: An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

items.title: The Savage
items.description: Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

items.title: Silent Thunder
items.description: Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

items.title: The Ape
items.description: Adam and Little Joe warn Hoss when he tries to help Arnie, a man with the mind of a child and an uncontrollable temper.

items.title: Bond of Silence
items.description: Katy McIntosh (Kim Raver) seeks answers when her husband dies while trying to subdue teenage partygoers.

items.title: Bonded in Blood
items.description: A couple return home to discover their young son has been murdered. They decide to approach a geneticist with the idea of cloning their dead son.

items.title: Bone Eater
items.description: A demonic creature of American Indian folklore embarks on a murderous rampage.

items.title: Bone Tomahawk
items.description: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

items.title: Bone: A Bad Day In Beverly Hills
items.description: A potential rapist (Yaphet Kotto) enters a Beverly Hills home and sends the husband (Andrew Duggan) to the bank while he stays with the wife (Joyce Van Patten).

items.title: Bonnie & Clyde vs. Dracula
items.description: Gangsters and vampires collide in a gory battle.

items.title: Boogeyman
items.description: As a young boy, Tim (Aaron Murphy) witnesses the horrifying event of his father (Charles Mesure) being dragged away by the boogeyman. Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

items.title: Boogeyman 2
items.description: A killer terrorizes patients at a mental institution where a woman (Danielle Savre) tries to cure her fear of the boogeyman.

items.title: Boogeyman 3
items.description: An evil entity terrorizes a student (Erin Cahill) and her friends on a college campus.

items.title: Boom Town
items.description: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart.

items.title: Boon
items.description: Mercenary Nick Boon is trying to atone for his life as an enforcer for a ruthless syndicate. Running from his past, Boon moves to a remote area in the Pacific Northwest, where he meets a struggling widow and her son. When he finds the pair living in fear of a criminal kingpin, Boon realizes the only way to protect them is to do what he does best.

items.title: Border G-Man
items.description: A federal agent (George O'Brien) catches a gangster (John Miljan), his moll and their private army shipping out to South America.

items.title: Border Patrol
items.description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and fellow Texas Rangers (Andy Clyde, Jay Kirby) free smuggled Mexicans from slave labor in a hidden silver mine.

items.title: Bobby & Jessi-Jai
items.description: Family GP Dr Dawn Harper and paediatrician Dr Ravi Jayaram help children with behavioural problems.

items.title: Born Naughty?
items.description: The doctors meet nine-year-old Thomas, who is very rigid in his thought patterns and finds change difficult; Thomas finds it hard to socialize with other children and is obsessed with Lego.

items.title: Born Naughty?
items.description: The doctors meet eight-year-old Charlie, who can be so destructive and violent that his mum Maxine has had to call the police; Dr Ravi and the experts wonder if a controversial new diagnosis might be an issue.

items.title: Born to Be Different
items.description: The pressures and joys of living with a disabled child as six families share their experiences.

items.title: Born to Be Different
items.description: As the six children turn 4, they start to become aware of the world outside of their families; where some will succeed in reaching milestones and keeping up with their friends, others will struggle to stay alive.

items.title: Born to Be Different
items.description: The pressures and joys of living with a disabled child as six families share their experiences.

items.title: Nine to Ten
items.description: This intimate reality series portrays the pressures and joys of life with a child with a disability.

items.title: Borneo's Pygmy Elephants
items.description: Campaign to save the pygmy elephant.

items.title: Balancing Like a Boss
items.description: Whether Rasheeda is showing her Pressed boutique, or cooking up new cuisines at Frost Bistro, she's always in boss mode planning her next big move.

items.title: Securing the Legacy
items.description: Rasheeda offers tips and insights, and to add to the fun, she's joined by friends, Kandi Burruss and her husband, Todd as they discuss legacy planning and securing assets for generations to come.

items.title: Boss Marketing Magic
items.description: Rasheeda invites her friend and marketing guru, Kimberley Blackwell, to discuss how to make the most of one's business, the four P's of marketing and more.

items.title: Getting Real With Real Estate
items.description: When it comes to real estate, one should have an open mind; Rasheeda and her husband, Kirk, are sharing what they've learned when it comes to looking for property; Virgil Gordon joins them to share his tips on how to start investing in real estate.

items.title: Triumph
items.description: A look inside Rasheeda's home recording studio as she shares the lessons learned as a music artist and advice for aspiring new artists today; joined by her friend and producer, DJ Jazze Pha, Rasheeda shares what led her to triumph in her career.

items.title: Boss Building Blocks
items.description: Rasheeda discusses the importance of discipline and taking care of your body so you can achieve your goals; there's also a visit from her good friend and celebrity wellness expert, Eboni Elektra.

items.title: Designing the Dream
items.description: Rasheeda designs her dream homes like a boss; she is joined by interior designer Sharie Reid to share easy tips on decorating spaces; Rasheeda gives an exclusive look inside her gorgeous ranch house.

items.title: Boss Up: The Musical
items.description: A sartorially complicated woman goes on a mission to discover her true purpose.

items.title: Win Some, Lose Some
items.description: There's money to be made in commercial fishing, even if the job is to catch freshwater fish that other trawlers rarely want -- bottom-feeding fish like carp and suckers. "Bottom Feeders" follows the lives and struggles of a group of fishermen as they battle the working conditions and one another while riding the lakes and rivers of the Midwest for the chance to net thousands of pounds of carp, sheepshead and buffalo fish. The operations are a mix of small-time businesses and multiman, automated teams, but all share the same goal: to catch the big haul and put food on the family table.

items.title: Family Ties
items.description: Commercial fishermen continue to endure a difficult season in the upper Midwest.

items.title: Summer
items.description: Due to a poor spring, Mike, Tim, Jedd and their crews fish well into summer.

items.title: New Beginnings in Autumn
items.description: As Fall begins, one man is just starting out, one is just getting by and one looks to start over.

items.title: Nicholas Braun and Riley Keough
items.description: Colman Domingo invites friends into his home for a Sunday brunch that includes cocktails, food and conversation.

items.title: Common and Yahya Abdul Mateen II
items.description: Colman is joined by rapper Common and architect Yahya Abdul Mateen II for a bonding session full of freestyle raps, freehand sketching, five-hour ribs, and a tutorial on how to make delicious sangria out of whatever is lying around.

items.title: Anika Noni Rose and Jay Ellis
items.description: Colman Domingo is joined by actors Anika Noni Rose and Jay Ellis to share homemade Lunchables and a cocktail called The Black Orchid and to solve the mystery of Colman's missing sweatpants.

items.title: Jesse Williams, Taylour Paige, and Mj Rodriguez
items.description: Colman Domingo is back with actors Jesse Williams ("Grey's Anatomy"), Taylour Paige ("Zola") and MJ Rodriguez ("Pose"); they learn to make a Negroni cocktail and discover who is the human lie detector of the group.

items.title: Alycia Debnam-Carey, Kim Dickens and Brett Gelman
items.description: Colman brings together actors Alycia Debnam-Carey and Kim Dickens ("Fear the Walking Dead") and Brett Gelman ("Stranger Things") for a revealing conversation.

items.title: Julia Stiles and Daveed Diggs
items.description: Colman Domingo teaches actors Julia Stiles ("Riviera") and Daveed Diggs ("Hamilton") how to make a Bloody Mary, and Julia recounts an unbelievable moment on stage with Prince.

items.title: Leisha Hailey and Ledisi
items.description: Actress Leisha Hailey and music artist Ledisi join to find out who is George Foreman's second cousin, who hung out with John Gotti, and how to make a Don Julio Mojito.

items.title: Barry Jenkins and Lulu Wang
items.description: Filmmakers Barry Jenkins ("Moonlight") and Lulu Wang ("The Farewell") discuss what's helped them find success in their careers and their shared love for animal onesies.

items.title: Jon Batiste and Janicza Bravo
items.description: Musician Jon Batiste ("The Late Show With Stephen Colbert") and filmmaker Janicza Bravo ("Lemon," "Zola") join Colman for an off-the-rails brunch with megaphone music, outfits that resemble sensual hot dogs, and a very refreshing cocktail.

items.title: Sundance Film Festival With Radha Blank and Júlio Torres
items.description: Host Colman Domingo, director Radha Blank ("The 40-Year-Old Version") and actor Julio Torres ("Together Together") take turns fielding "audience questions," share their past experiences at Sundance and whip up a Bulleit Rye Hot Toddy.

items.title: International Women's Day With Victoria Mahoney and Kelly McCreary
items.description: Colman welcomes actors Victoria Mahoney ("Lovecraft Country") and Kelly McCreary ("Grey's Anatomy") to celebrate International Women's Day with a signature cocktail, The Cool Jane, and a conversation about working as a woman in Hollywood.

items.title: Cinco de Mayo With Raúl Castillo and Gabriel Luna
items.description: Colman welcomes actors Raúl Castillo ("We the Animals") and Gabriel Luna ("True Detective") for a Cinco de Mayo celebration during which they chat about growing up in Texas and make a tequila cocktail, the Blanco Agave Drop.

items.title: Pride Month With Lea DeLaria,J. August Richards, and Kate Moennig
items.description: Colman welcomes comic Lea DeLaria, and actors J. August Richards and Kate Moennig for a Pride celebration, during which they rebel against the brunch requirement, talk about coming out and make a signature cocktail, the Smirnoff Pride Martini.

items.title: Juneteenth With Regina King
items.description: Colman welcomes actress and director Regina King to celebrate Juneteenth with a discussion about what the day means to them, how they build the characters they play and to make a signature cocktail, the Summer Citrus Sunrise.

items.title: Fourth of July With D.J. Jazzy Jeff and Patti LaBelle
items.description: Colman welcomes DJ Jazzy Jeff and singer Patti LaBelle as they celebrate the Fourth of July with lots of Philadelphia pride and a rum punch cocktail.

items.title: Friendsgiving With Elaine Welteroth and Aja Naomi King
items.description: Elaine Welteroth and Aja Naomi King join Colman to celebrate Friendsgiving, discuss their creative inspirations and share a signature seasonal cocktail, the Crown Royal Cinnamon Apple.

items.title: The Return of Broadway With Chita Rivera, Danielle Brooks and Ephraim Sykes
items.description: Chita Rivera ("West Side Story"), Danielle Brooks ("The Color Purple") and Ephraim Sykes ("Ain't Too Proud") gather for the holidays to celebrate the return of Broadway, share their stage stories and make a cozy cocktail, the Baileys Hot Chocolate.

items.title: Women's History Month With Audra McDonald and April Reign
items.description: Audra McDonald and April Reign join Colman to discuss Women's History Month.

items.title: Awards Season With Adam McKay and Laverne Cox
items.description: Adam McKay and Laverne Cox join Colman to discuss awards season.

items.title: Pride With Brandon Kyle Goodman and Tom Ellis
items.description: Colman is joined by good friends Brandon Kyle Goodman ("Big Mouth") and Tom Ellis ("Lucifer") to talk about pride, allyship and the importance of leaning into one's vulnerabilities, all while sharing a signature cocktail, the Smirnoff pink cosmo.

items.title: Juneteenth With Sheila E. and Harvey Mason Jr.
items.description: Colman and his guests, renowned percussionist Sheila E. and CEO of The Recording Academy Harvey Mason Jr., they connect on their passion for music while sharing a signature cocktail, the Johnnie Walker Black Label penicillin.

items.title: Boyhood
items.description: The joys and pitfalls of growing up are seen through the eyes of a child named Mason (Ellar Coltrane), his parents (Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke) and his sister (Lorelei Linklater). Vignettes, filmed with the same cast over the course of 12 years, capture family meals, road trips, birthday parties, graduations and other important milestones. Songs from Coldplay, Arcade Fire and other artists capture the time period. Directed by Richard Linklater.

items.title: Brad Pitt: Breaking Hollywood
items.description: Brad Pitt is one of the most well-known leading men in Hollywood who has played a diverse range of roles. He has gone from rags to riches and has been through all sorts of adventures, always reaching new heights and overcoming expectations.

items.title: Brain Dead
items.description: A host of alien-infected, mutant amoeba-controlled zombies try to break into a deserted fishing lodge that six people are stranded in.

items.title: Braking for Whales
items.description: A dysfunctional brother and sister are forced to come to terms with each other and themselves over their recently deceased mother's final wish.

items.title: Brawl in Cell Block 99
items.description: A former boxer loses his job as an auto mechanic, and his troubled marriage is about to expire. At this crossroads in his life, he feels that he has no better option than to work as a drug courier. He soon finds himself in a gunfight between police officers and his own ruthless allies. When the smoke clears, Bradley is badly hurt and thrown in prison, where his enemies force him to commit acts of violence that turn the place into a savage battleground.

items.title: Speed Skating
items.description: An in-depth look at how technology and science empower athletes to overcome physical and mental barriers in extreme sports like speed skating and snowboarding.

items.title: Snowboarding
items.description: Innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe.

items.title: Breathing In
items.description: On a dark and stormy night during the last days of the Anglo-Boer War, a wounded Boer General is nursed by Anna, a herbalist with powers.

items.title: Summer Is Ours
items.description: Following Newark, N.J.'s charismatic Mayor Cory Booker as he fights to raise the city out of nearly a half-century of violence, poverty and corruption; Booker aims to keep the streets safe for summer.

items.title: Struggle
items.description: Creep struggles to take care of his and Jayda's children while she is in jail; Mayor Booker faces budget problems and skepticism from the middle-class North Ward; senseless murders continue.

items.title: Central
items.description: Newark's new school building may not be ready in time for the fall; Jayda prepares her defense; the city faces a budget crisis.

items.title: Circus
items.description: A famous circus comes to Newark for the first time in over 50 years; an internal police clash may come to a head with a potential coup against McCarthy.

items.title: Red October
items.description: Newark's 50th murder of 2008 raises questions about the public safety policy; McCarthy works on a plan for an intra-gang war; Jayda faces difficult decisions regarding her future.

items.title: To Plea or Not to Plea
items.description: A gang member accused of murder must make a difficult choice.

items.title: Arrested Development
items.description: Jayda and Creep are dogged by their pasts and become entangled in legal troubles; Director McCarthy feels the heat as criticism mounts over police conduct; governor Chris Christie comes to Newark in an unexpected gesture of goodwill and diplomacy.

items.title: The Haunting
items.description: The shooting of a young filmmaker sparks a massive response by Newark police; Jiwe and lawyer Brooke Barnett gear up for Jiwe's trial; Brooke works to straighten out the mess surrounding Jayda's arrest.

items.title: Game On
items.description: With the help of a local pastor, Jiwe attempts to organize a Blood v. Crip peace basketball game.

items.title: Election
items.description: Mayor Booker tries to reclaim public support.

items.title: Judgement Day
items.description: Mayor Booker convincingly wins a second term, but the drama continues when Newark's fiscal woes come to a head.

items.title: Bride of the Monster
items.description: Dr. Eric Vornoff is a scientist trying to use nuclear energy to transform people into superhuman beings. Despite his efforts, the abducted subjects he uses die during the experiment -- except for his assistant, Lobo, who gains monstrous powers. Vornoff's mansion is protected by a murderous octopus, but somehow, reporter Janet Lawton makes her way inside and discovers the truth. She's taken prisoner, but the police are close behind.

items.title: Shelly & Anthony vs. Kristen & Ed
items.description: Brides, grooms and members of their wedding parties compete with other brides, grooms and family in mental and physical challenges to win a cash prize for their big day.

items.title: Maria & Craig vs. Chrissy & Jason
items.description: Maria and Craig take on Chrissy and Jason in the Icing on the Cake, Treasure Hunt and the Old Ball and Chain competitions.

items.title: Rebekah & Steve vs. Sabrina & Max
items.description: Rebekah and Steve face Sabrina and Max in the Here Comes the Bride, Just Married and Shotgun Wedding challenges.

items.title: Suzanne & JJ vs. Allana & Jason
items.description: Suzanne and JJ compete against Allana and Jason in the Just Married, Toss the Bouquet and Appetizer Obstacle Course challenges.

items.title: Jillian & Zak vs. Andrea & Pete
items.description: Jillian and Zak compete against Andrea and Pete in the Champagne Toast, Icing on the Cake and Here Comes the Bride contests.

items.title: Kamesha & Craig vs. Ashley & Jon
items.description: Kamesha and Craig take on Jon and Ashley in the On Our Way to the Altar, Shotgun Wedding and Old Ball and Chain contests.

items.title: Brides to Be
items.description: Two women (Carollani Sandberg, Angela DiMarco) who are on the verge of getting married arrive at their secluded venue and begin to sense that sinister forces are at play behind the scenes.

items.title: Adrianna, Jada and Antonella
items.description: Godzilla has nothing on a bride-to-be planning her dream wedding, as evidenced by the aptly named "Bridezillas." The docu-series follows women who were perfectly normal before wedding planning took over her life. Grimly determined to realize their "dream wedding" at all costs, these out-of-control brides make the time leading up to their day of days an utter nightmare for everyone around them. In the end, they hope all the stress and meltdowns are worth it and they have the perfect wedding they've been dreaming of since they were little.

items.title: Regina; Lydee
items.description: Regina is behind in her planning but will do anything to get her fairy tale wedding; Lydee is in charge of her wedding to Irvin.

items.title: Kenya & Katrina
items.description: Texas bride Kenya Fance is pushing off nearly every task onto her coordinator and best friend; New York bride Katrina Mack is a spoiled handful who has binged her way out of her wedding dress.

items.title: DeShawn & Cari
items.description: DeShawn goes on a relentless hunt for the lady who she believes is out to steal her fiancé; Cari dreams of a rustic yet elegant wedding in the style of Country Chic.

items.title: Cari & Rebecca
items.description: Cari faces an uphill battle to pull off the rustic, outdoor wedding of her dreams; Rebecca demands that all the men wear kilts.

items.title: Courtney & Valerie
items.description: Bridezilla Courtney Cray's Clue-themed murder mystery wedding; Valerie discovers that her wedding venue is in the middle of dangerous wildfires.

items.title: Bernadette & Angela
items.description: Angela discovers a problem with the groom's tuxedo; Bernadette fires her bridesmaids.

items.title: Bernadette & Josaine
items.description: Bernadette has an emotional meltdown; Josaine refuses to stay within her budget.

items.title: Erica & Delilah
items.description: Delilah becomes annoyed with her bridal party; Erica's wedding becomes a total disaster.

items.title: Delilah & Tasha
items.description: Tasha kicks her "male of honor" to the curb; Delilah takes out her frustrations on her bridal party making them slave away.

items.title: Tasha & Molly
items.description: Molly is unsatisfied with her gown and finds issues with all the arrangements; Tasha finds another reason to throw out her "male of honor" after letting him back in.

items.title: Molly, Tasanna & Angel
items.description: Molly has a major meltdown when the wedding limousine she ordered is nowhere to be seen. Tasanna vents her spleen when the tux shop messes up the groom's order.

items.title: The Elegance of Iron
items.description: Ignite your curiosity with INWONDER, your gateway to the extraordinary.

items.title: African Animal Rescue
items.description: Short stories about science and tech, history, global issues and the personalities at the center of it all.

items.title: Message From Space?
items.description: The Green Bank Observatory in West Virginia, home of the world's largest steerable radio telescope, has been receiving a mysterious signal from deep space.

items.title: The Science of Cute
items.description: The biological benefits of cuteness.

items.title: The Wright Brothers: Bravery
items.description: Ohio bicycle mechanics Orville and Wilbur Wright change the world by flying the world's first successful airplane in 1903.

items.title: Apocalypse 101
items.description: Astrobiologist and author Lewis Dartnell explores what it would take to stay alive following a global cataclysm, and what knowledge would be needed to rebuild civilization.

items.description: A woman on the run for murder bursts into a sorority house looking for help to prove her innocence, takes hostages and summons the legendary Sandman to pose two choices: face their worst nightmares or die.

items.description: Erica and Josh to go head-to-head to see who can craft the ultimate, comforting meal inspired entirely by their own childhoods and upbringing.
