items.description: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik show that food really is the language of love.

items.title: Britney Spears: Fighting for Freedom
items.description: Unable to make her own decisions, Britney Spears' life has been out of her hands since a dramatic series of events put her in a strict conservatorship in 2008.

items.title: Britney Spears: Workin' It
items.description: A look at Britney's journey from her innocent years and release of "Baby One More Time" to starring as a judge on "X Factor."

items.title: Rally Cap
items.description: Hank Azaria and Amanda Peet co-star in "Brockmire," a half-hour comedy series that began years ago as a viral short video on the Funny or Die website. The series centers on the fall of Jim Brockmire, a once-famed major league baseball announcer who suffers an embarrassing on-air meltdown caused by his wife's serial infidelity, leading to a decade away from the booth. Older and presumably wiser, Brockmire attempts to reclaim his career, reputation and love life by returning behind the mic, but the setting -- a broken-down rust belt town, home of the minor league's Morristown Frackers -- is not quite what he envisioned. Strong-willed, hard-drinking owner Julia James has a complicated relationship with Brockmire, while whiz-kid intern Charles is simultaneously entertained by and terrified of the new announcer.

items.title: Winning Streak
items.description: Jim and Jules hook up the night before the Frackers win a game, and they attempt to keep the lucky streak going on and off the field.

items.title: Kangaroo Court
items.description: The players hold a mock trial and Jules urges Brockmire to mediate; Charles wonders why Brockmire thinks he is gay.

items.title: Retaliation
items.description: Brockmire's ex-wife, Lucy, reappears; forced to confront his emotions, Brockmire defaults to drinking.

items.title: Breakout Year
items.description: Brockmire attempts fame again; Jules and Charles work to make Brockmire a household name and their efforts pay off when he gains a very unexpected fan base.

items.title: Road Trip
items.description: Jules has a pregnancy scare; Brockmire works out his father issues with Charles; Jules and Brockmire take a road trip to Pittsburgh.

items.title: Old Timers Day
items.description: Brockmire attends an event honoring broadcasters; Charles attempts to impress a girl.

items.title: It All Comes Down to This
items.description: Brockmire must choose between staying in Morristown or returning to the major leagues.

items.title: The Getaway Game
items.description: Now calling minor league games in New Orleans, Jim is up for the major leagues in Atlanta; he competes against Raj, a likable young announcer; Charles works on the podcast despite Brockmire's antics; a friend from Morristown stops by for a visit.

items.title: Platoon Player
items.description: Despite Jim's protests, Charles needs the night off for his birthday; Jim attempts to throw him a party, but things quickly get out of hand; tensions arise when Jim shows up at Charles' birthday dinner and meets his judgmental family.

items.title: Knuckleball
items.description: Jim and Uribe go on an epic bender; Charles discovers a sad truth about Brockmire; when announcing with Raj, Brockmire has a few too many drinks.

items.title: Retirement Ceremony
items.description: Jim faces his dysfunctional family at his father's funeral; he struggles to mend his broken relationship with his sister; Brockmire must make peace with someone from his past.

items.title: Make-Up Game
items.description: Jules visits Jim, who gives her a tour of New Orleans; they reconnect for an evening, but have trouble figuring out the new terms of their relationship.

items.title: Broadcasters Jinx
items.description: Jim takes a new gig as an Atlanta major league announcer; Charles focuses on the new direction his career might take; confronted with the truth about a legendary announcer, Jim attempts to do the right thing in the most Brockmire-way possible.

items.title: Caught in a Rundown
items.description: After Jim ends up in the hospital, Charles has an intervention to stop Brockmire's destructive habits; in attendance are a rag-tag group of friends and enemies from Brockmire's past; Jim meets a dangerous new friend.

items.title: In the Cellar
items.description: Jim goes on a bender with his new nihilistic friend, Elle, who pushes him towards a new level of destruction; Brockmire ends up in the hospital again and finally takes rehab seriously; Charles approaches Jim with a new opportunity.

items.title: Brody Stevens: Live from the Main Room
items.description: Brody Stevens performs at The World Famous Comedy Store on Sunset Blvd in West Hollywood, CA.

items.title: Brothers
items.description: An innocent black youth succumbs to the brutalities of prison after being duped into pleading guilty to robbery.

items.title: Brothers of the West
items.description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found. Also trying to find out what happened is the bank president's daughter, Celia Chandler (Lois Wilde). She initially suspects Ed, who is actually being held hostage to prevent him from talking. Eventually, Celia realizes that the culprit may in fact be someone who purported to be her father's friend.

items.title: Brown Sugar
items.description: Sidney and Dre can attribute their friendship and the launch of their careers to one single childhood instant ... witnessing the birth of hip-hop on a New York street corner. Now some 15 years later, she is a revered music critic, and he is a successful, though unfulfilled, music executive. Both come to realize that their true life passions will only be fulfilled by remembering what they learned that day on the corner.

items.title: Bruce Lee: The Legend
items.description: The martial artist is seen in clips and recalled by Steve McQueen, James Coburn and others who knew him.

items.title: Bruce Lee: The Way of the Warrior
items.description: A comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him. Co-stars, long time friends and even family members share exclusive details on the life of Bruce in a bid to discover what made him so great.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: Born to Rock
items.description: Following electrifying rock star Bruce Springsteen's career from the Jersey Shore to sold-out live performances in stadiums around the globe.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: Glory Days
items.description: Bruce Frederick Joseph Springsteen, more fondly know as The Boss by his millions of fans, is widely regarded as one of the most influential songwriters of the 20th century.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: On the Road
items.description: Coming from a poor background in New Jersey, Bruce Springsteen grew to become one of the most recognizable faces in rock music. His lyrics often depict the struggles of daily American life, and he has sold more than 120 million albums worldwide.

items.title: Bruce's Deadly Fingers
items.description: Malicious gangsters capture Bruce's former girlfriend, then a young martial artist attempts to rescue her and the late master's book containing lethal techniques for killing with a finger.

items.title: Bruno Mars: The Finest
items.description: Interviews with top music industry professionals highlight a look at Bruno Mars' rise from struggling artist to international music icon.

items.title: Brutal Massacre: A Comedy
items.description: A director gets another chance to revive his career with one movie.

items.title: Thrill & Distill
items.description: Bryan Baeumler travels off the beaten path to help struggling entrepreneurs renovate their businesses.

items.title: They Bet the Farm
items.description: New-generation farmers, Samantha and Paul, have big dreams for their rural business; they want to create a farm stand to sell their home-grown products, but also to give local artisans a place to sell their goods.

items.title: Bowling for Bryan
items.description: Matt and Alicia buy their town's beloved bowling alley to save it from being torn down; but with renovations required, and only one year in hand to turn a profit, Bryan steps in to help them navigate tight finances and deadlines.

items.title: Screech Me Your Ways
items.description: With the purchase of a seaside fishing resort, Rob and Lorraine have quickly become full-time dragon slayers fixing a never-ending slew of renovation surprises.

items.title: Cabin Pressure
items.description: Dreaming of one day living a simpler life on the lake, Michelle and Jesse need to transform their new cabin into a hotspot vacation rental; they hope that this property will be the first of many rentals, but they need Bryan's help to get them back.

items.title: Three's Company
items.description: With big dreams of becoming entrepreneurs, three friends from the big city purchase a fixer-upper resort in a picturesque town; after a year of never-ending renovations, they need Bryan's help to prioritize their next few updates.

items.title: Illegal army
items.description: The Knight Sabers, a team of four female crime-fighters, battle cybernetically enhanced soldiers in 2034 Mega Tokyo.

items.title: Geo climbers
items.description: A new type of Boomer with advanced AI is stolen. It's up to the newly re-formed Knight Sabers to get it back. They will have their hands full with a group of Combat Boomers headed by a criminal scientist.

items.title: Melt down
items.description: Boomers all over MegaTokyo are rioting and throwing the city into chaos. In order to stop this disaster, the Knight Sabers must locate the mastermind behind it all.

items.title: Double Vision
items.description: A female mercenary team, armed with unique power armor suits, battles the forces of the corrupt mega-corporation, Genom in futuristic Tokyo.

items.title: Scoop Chase
items.description: An ambitious technical scientist and an aspiring reporter plan to make their names at the expense of the Knight Sabers; Nene is caught in the middle.

items.title: Buddy BeBop vs the Living Dead
items.description: Buddy Holly and his allies battle a horde of the undead.

items.title: A Pit Master Prep Station
items.description: Host and DIY expert Tyler Smith brings together craftsmanship and outdoor cooking. Tyler completes backyard upgrades before cooking family-focused meals.

items.title: Open Flame Cooking
items.description: Fire and flavor collide as Tyler builds a fire pit set up that's ideal for everything from steaks to s'mores.

items.title: Garden Bed to Dinner Spread
items.description: Homegrown veggies meet a huge handmade table as Tyler gets the whole family in on the fun.

items.title: Building a Decade: Minecraft
items.description: Since its development in 2009, the video game Minecraft has taken the digital world by storm.

items.title: Monuments and Money
items.description: Skyscrapers have dominated city landscapes for more than 100 years. Since debuting as 10-story buildings in the late 19th century, these tall towers have constantly evolved as architects and structural engineers pushed the boundaries of what's possible. This series unlocks the inner workings of these goliaths, spotlighting what cities such as Chicago, London, Melbourne and Tokyo are doing to transform their skylines with designs that seem to defy gravity. Each episode gives viewers exclusive looks at high-rises, among them Chicago's 82-story Aqua; the 1,500-feet-tall Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur; the landmark Jin Mao Tower in Shanghai; and the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest skyscraper.

items.title: Bukowski: Born Into This
items.description: This documentary chronicles the writer Charles Bukowski, who is as well known for his drinking binges as for his poetry and prose. Using interviews with Bukowski and other footage, filmmaker John Dullaghan tells the story of a man who struggles to make a living while he writes from the heart. Then, after editor John Martin of Black Sparrow Press discovers Bukowski, his work becomes much more widely read. The film also includes comments from famous fans Bono, Sean Penn and Harry Dean Stanton.

items.title: Bullets for the Bad
items.description: A down-on-his-luck bounty hunter rides into a town in the middle of a power struggle between a gang of desperadoes and the local cattle baron. When the baron's daughter is abducted, he hires the bounty hunter to rescue her by any means necessary.

items.title: Kumail Nanjiani, Ethan T. Berlin and Ben Garant
items.description: Offbeat games and bizarre challenges are the foundation for the on-the-spot comedy created in this new breed of game show. The contestants, a roster of comedians that includes Alex Borstein, Ben Garant, Thomas Lennon, Bobby Moynihan, Kumail Nanjiani and Nicole Parker, play games such as "Top This Lie," where they must out-fib host Kurt Braunohler in a rapid-fire succession of untruths, and "Wordy and the Tramp," where they provide answers to a series of disconnected questions while they and the host bounce on trampolines. The players are also challenged to -- among many other wacky tasks -- invent new sins, break harsh news to children, compose and sing original songs about grandmothers, and decide what mankind will evolve into next.

items.title: Dana Gould, Eugene Mirman and Damien Lemon
items.description: Dana Gould, Eugene Mirman and Damien Lemon compete in absurd games such as "inspiring a gospel singer."

items.title: Tom Lennon, Chris Gethard and Nicole Parker
items.description: Comics Tom Lennon, Chris Gethard and Nicole Parker play absurd games such as "inventing new sins."

items.title: Kumail Nanjiani, Tom Lennon and Eugene Mirman
items.description: Kumail Nanjiani, Tom Lennon and Eugene Mirman play absurd games such as "naming racehorses."

items.title: Dana Gould, Michael Che and Andy Daly
items.description: Dana Gould, Michael Che and Andy Daly play absurd games such as "designing back tattoos."

items.title: Kumail Nanjiani, Bobby Moynihan and Ben Garant
items.description: Kumail Nanjiani, Bobby Moynihan and Ben Garant play absurd games like "creating new art pieces."

items.title: Nicole Parker, Michael Che and Ethan T. Berlin
items.description: Nicole Parker, Michael Che and Ethan T. Berlin play absurd games such as "creating gravestones."

items.title: Alex Borstein, Ethan T. Berlin and Jordan Klepper
items.description: Alex Borstein, Ethan T. Berlin and Jordan Klepper play absurd games such as "insult the injured."

items.title: Matt Oberg, Michael Che and Alison Rich
items.description: Matt Oberg, Michael Che and Alison Rich play absurd games such as "fixing animals."

items.title: John Gemberling, Alex Borstein and Andy Daly
items.description: John Gemberling, Alex Borstein and Andy Daly play absurd games like "belittling historic events."

items.title: Burden
items.description: Illustrated with performances, private videos, and recollections from those who knew him, we observe the life of the always provocative artist Chris Burden, whose work consistently challenged ideas about the limits and nature of modern art, from his notorious performances in the 1970s to his later assemblages, installations, kinetic and static sculptures, and scientific models.

items.title: Burial Ground
items.description: Skeletal ghouls greet visitors at the mansion of a professor studying the ancient Etruscans.

items.title: Burning Blue
items.description: An investigation into a series of fatal accidents leads to the exposure of a clandestine affair between two Navy pilots (Trent Ford, Rob Mayes).

items.title: Burning Man
items.description: After the death of his wife (Bojana Novakovic), a father (Matthew Goode) gives in to grief and anger and uses casual sex to cope with his pain.

items.title: Bury the Past
items.description: The past comes back to haunt a woman in hiding who killed her abusive husband in self-defense.

items.title: Burying the Ex
items.description: A horror fan's (Anton Yelchin) dead girlfriend (Ashley Greene) comes back as a zombie and wants to continue their relationship forever.

items.title: Bushwick
items.description: When Lucy steps off the subway, she walks into an utter bloodbath on the streets of Brooklyn's Bushwick neighborhood. Texas is attempting to secede from the Union, and militia forces have descended upon New York City to claim it as an East Coast base of operations and negotiation tool. Lucy takes shelter in Stupe's basement, a burly war veteran who reluctantly agrees to help her traverse the treacherous five-block stretch to reach her destination.

items.title: Business of Beauty
items.description: Cheddar's Business of series takes you behind the scenes of industries from food to fashion, showing how companies expand and innovate.

items.title: Business of Defense
items.description: Taking you behind the scenes of industries from food to fashion, showing how companies expand and innovate.

items.title: But Deliver Us From Evil
items.description: Lilith, a succubus, emerges in the present day to seek revenge against mankind for her expulsion from the Garden of Eden.

items.title: Butcher, Baker, Nightmare Maker
items.description: An obsessive and murderous woman (Susan Tyrrell) tries to control her nephew, a 17-year-old basketball player (Jimmy McNichol).

items.title: Bye Bye Birdie
items.description: When the draft selects rock star Conrad Birdie, his fans are devastated, but none more than struggling songwriter Albert Peterson (Dick Van Dyke), whose song Birdie was just about to record. Albert's longtime girlfriend, Rosie (Janet Leigh), pushes Albert to write a new tune that Birdie will perform on television to a fan selected in a contest. The scheme works, with young Ohio teenager Kim McAfee (Ann-Margret) declared the winner, but no one has counted on the jealous wrath of her boyfriend.

items.title: Byzantium
items.description: Mayhem follows when two female vampires who are on the run from a kindred group take refuge at a seaside British community.

items.title: Cabin Fever
items.description: Fresh out of college, five friends (Nadine Crocker, Matthew Daddario, Samuel Davis) face the horrors of a flesh-eating virus while staying at a remote cabin.

items.title: Cabin Fever 2: Spring Fever
items.description: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.

items.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
items.description: Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

items.title: California
items.description: As the California Gold Rush begins, Jonathan Trumbo (Ray Milland) goes AWOL from the Army and decides to lead a wagon train to the West Coast. With saloon girl Lily Bishop (Barbara Stanwyck) and Irishman Michael Fabian (Barry Fitzgerald) at his side, Jonathan arrives in California. There, he finds that rich landowner Capt. Pharaoh Coffin (George Coulouris) is trying to block California from statehood. But Trumbo's never taken kindly to men in power, and he's soon dangerously at odds with Coffin.

items.title: Camilla: My Darling Wife, Our Future Queen
items.description: A look back at Camilla's tumultuous journey toward becoming the Duchess of Cornwall; insight into the challenges that she must face as Prince Charles's wife and the future queen.

items.title: Camp
items.description: At Camp Ovation, kids of all ages spend their summer expressing themselves through dance, music and theater. Vlad (Daniel Letterle) is a singer-songwriter and first-time camper caught between talented but insecure Ellen (Joanna Chilcoat) and provocative Jill (Alana Allen). Besides romance, the campers grapple with complicated issues, including sexual identity, self-respect and parental pressure, as they grow closer together and prove their talents to the bitter camp director (Don Dixon).

items.title: Camp Dread
items.description: Cast members (Felissa Rose, Brian Gallagher) on a new reality-TV show soon learn that a devious filmmaker (Eric Roberts) has tricked them into a very real fight for their lives.

items.title: Camp Raiders
items.description: Kruger National Park; wildlife create havoc and provide amusement while rummaging through visitors' campsites.

items.title: Camp X-Ray
items.description: A female guard at Guantánamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

items.title: Can't Take It Back
items.description: Two teenage girls bring a dark curse upon themselves when they leave hateful comments on a dead classmate's Facebook page.

items.title: Canal Street
items.description: A Chicago lawyer embraces his undying faith when his teenage son is accused of murdering a classmate.

items.title: Candy Cane Christmas
items.description: A woman searches for a new tradition to lift her holiday spirits when her neighbors decide to skip the annual Christmas decoration festivities.

items.title: Cannabis: Through the Ages
items.description: Exploring the role of cannabis in the evolution of civilizations around the globe as it has been applied in more than 30,000 products ranging in use from war and exploration to medicine and intoxication.

items.title: Cannibal Comedian
items.description: Fed up with his lack of ambition, a psychopathic cannibal tries his hand at stand-up comedy in an attempt to satisfy his appetite for normalcy.

items.title: Cannibal! The Musical
items.description: A man (Juan Schwartz) convicted of cannibalism tells a reporter his story, complete with singing and dancing.

items.title: Capricorn One
items.description: Three astronauts (James Brolin, Sam Waterston, O.J. Simpson) are about to launch into space on the first mission to Mars. But when a mechanical failure surfaces that would kill the three men, NASA removes them from the Capricorn One capsule. To prevent a public outcry, NASA launches the capsule unmanned and requires the astronauts to film fake mission footage in a studio. However, the plan is compromised when an ambitious journalist (Elliott Gould) discovers the conspiracy.

items.title: Captain Kidd
items.description: British pirate William Kidd captures Adm. Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a sea captain, offers his services to the king as an escort ship. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, if he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. On his mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son, Adam (also Scott), is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

items.title: Los Angeles
items.description: Alexandra Hirschi, aka Supercar Blondie, explores alternative car cultures across the United States.

items.title: Houston
items.description: Given special access to a $2 million exclusive McLaren Senna, Supercar Blondie digs under the surface to uncover gang feuds in the SLAB (Slow, Low and Bangin') community and meets up with legendary hip hop artists Slim Thug and Paul Wall.

items.title: Las Vegas
items.description: Supercar Blondie arrives in Las Vegas in a $1 million Lamborghini SVJ roadster; taken under the wing of Patrick, founder of the Junkyard Pirates, Alex is brought into the rat rod world, home to American mavericks and outsiders.

items.title: Miami
items.description: In Miami, Supercar Blondie gets the keys to a $5 million Pagani Huayra L'Ultimo as she explores the sub-culture of lowriders with the seal of approval from Horacio Pagani himself.

items.title: Detroit
items.description: Supercar Blondie arrives in Motor City in the dead of winter, but she is given access to a new $500 thousand Ford GT, which raises her spirits; her goal is to learn more about muscle cars and her journey takes her in different directions.

items.title: New York
items.description: Supercar Blondie hits New York City in a $4 million Lamborghini Centenario; she is on a quest to track down the players in the underground drift driving scene and to visit the exclusive Manhattan Motor Club.

items.title: Cardi B: The Hustle
items.description: Cardi B is one of the most famous artists of the last decade. Despite being a "regula degula schmegula" girl from the Bronx, she became one of the most influential female artists of all time. She knew if she wanted to reach her dreams, she would have to work... Hard. On the streets, there's a fine line between wrong and right, good and bad. Her journey to the top, although successful, isn't seen as ideal. But she isn't ashamed of it. She started from the bottom and hustled her way to the top.

items.title: Carnage Park
items.description: A psychotic sniper (Pat Healy) terrorizes a bank robber (James Landry Hébert) and his hostage (Ashley Bell) in the California desert.

items.title: Carnival of Souls
items.description: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

items.title: Carolina's Calling
items.description: Two engineers cause an explosion so forceful that it demolishes their lab and sends a blast into space, striking an unsuspecting alien ship. The ship plummets from the sky and lands in a remote area of South Carolina, forcing him to find a way home.

items.title: Carrie Underwood: Country Idol
items.description: Carrie Underwood, winner of 2005's "American Idol," and her fast track to stardom.

items.title: Cashback
items.description: Would-be artist Ben (Sean Biggerstaff) realizes he has an extraordinary way of dealing with the tedium of his dead-end job stocking shelves at a store - he has acquired the ability to halt time and explore the world while the rest of the earth's population remains frozen in place. Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

items.title: Casino Jack and the United States of Money
items.description: This documentary tracks the high life and eventual downfall of wealthy lobbyist and businessman Jack Abramoff, who was convicted of conspiracy and fraud, among other charges, in a corruption scandal during the George W. Bush administration. The film details Abramoff's decadent and lavish lifestyle and reveals the shady dealings that led to his getting arrested, which ultimately resulted in a prison sentence for him and tarnished reputations for others.

items.title: Castle Freak
items.description: Terror strikes when a blind woman and her friends travel to a mysterious Albanian castle that harbors dark secrets.

items.title: Castle of the Creeping Flesh
items.description: A mad scientist tries to revive his dead daughter by an operation, but there are certain body parts he needs that he can't get. His problem is solved when a group of drunken partygoers stumble into his castle.

items.title: Cat Ballou
items.description: When hired gun Tim Strawn (Lee Marvin) kills her rancher father, Cat Ballou (Jane Fonda) becomes an outlaw set on vengeance. Enlisting the help of washed-up gunslinger Kid Shelleen (also Marvin) as well as the handsome bandit Clay Boone (Michael Callan), Cat strikes back at the land-development company that employed Strawn, and eventually targets the assassin himself. Adding to the lively comedic mood of the film are narrative song performances by Nat King Cole and Stubby Kaye.

items.title: Caught in Providence
items.description: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job. Judge Frank Caprio is the Chief Municipal Judge in Providence, R.I. and former Chairman of the Rhode Island Board of Governors. He was appointed in 1985 and has been reappointed six times.

items.title: Caught in Providence
items.description: A close-up view of cases directly from the courtroom of social media sensation and Providence Chief Municipal Judge Frank Caprio, who takes a compassionate, empathetic and no-nonsense approach to a variety of traffic, parking and other violations.

items.title: Centurion
items.description: In ancient Scotland, the Ninth Legion liberates a Roman officer named Quintus Dias (Michael Fassbender) from his Pict captors. The soldiers are in pursuit of the Pict leader, and Quintus joins their quest. Soon afterward, the Romans' Pict guide betrays them, resulting in the slaughter of all but a handful of men. The Roman survivors try desperately to reach safety, as the indigenous warriors pick them off one by one.

items.description: Five beautiful operatives must rescue a Japanese karate master's kidnapped daughter.

items.title: Charles and Camilla: Against All Odds
items.description: Prince Charles and Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall, who shared a love story fraught with challenges; marrying 35 years after they first met, they became a widely-accepted couple, despite having faced years of scandal and torment by the media.

items.title: Charlie Says
items.description: Years after the shocking murders that made the name Charles Manson synonymous with pure evil, the three women who killed for him -- Leslie Van Houten, Patricia Krenwinkel and Susan Atkins -- remain under the spell of the infamous cult leader. Confined to an isolated cellblock, the trio seem destined to live out the rest of their lives under the delusion that their crimes were part of a cosmic plan, until an empathetic graduate student attempts to rehabilitate them.

items.title: Charlie's Christmas Wish
items.description: A Christmas wish is granted.

items.title: Chasing 3000
items.description: Mickey (Ray Liotta) recounts the cross-country journey of his 15-year-old self (Trevor Morgan) and his young brother, Roger (Rory Culkin), who suffers from muscular dystrophy, to see baseball player Roberto Clemente's 3,000th hit. Their mother (Lauren Holly) doesn't know where they went, so the cops track down the stolen car as they travel to Pittsburgh. Determined to see their idol's historic event, the boys will do anything to get to the baseball stadium, including hitch a ride on a train.

items.title: Chasing Chasing Amy
items.description: Filmmaker Sav Rodgers examines the complex legacy of Kevin Smith's 1997 LGBTQ+ movie "Chasing Amy."

items.title: Chasing the Crown
items.description: Women compete in the Ethnic World Pageant.

items.title: Chawz
items.description: Korean villagers fall prey to a carnivorous wild boar's bloody tusks.

items.title: Cheerful Weather for the Wedding
items.description: On the day of her wedding, an ambivalent bride (Felicity Jones) locks herself in her bedroom while her family -- and former lover (Luke Treadaway) -- await downstairs.

items.title: Cheetah: Against All Odds
items.description: Follow two families of cheetahs struggle against heat, starvation and predators on the Serengeti.

items.title: Chelle T: It Just Got Real
items.description: Chelle T arrives with a whirlwind of imagination, stage presence, and originality.

items.title: Cher: In Her Own Words
items.description: Exploring one of the most successful, enduring and groundbreaking talents of the modern era.

items.title: Cher: Life in the Spotlight
items.description: Tracing Cher's life from her childhood stage fright to her rise as an iconic star in music, TV and movies.

items.title: Chernobyl: Hour by Hour
items.description: A look into the heart of the Chernobyl disaster and what went wrong, hour by hour.

items.title: Chernobyl: The Invisible Enemy
items.description: The devastating effects of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant accident.

items.title: Johnny Bravo
items.description: Debuting in 1955, "Cheyenne" made history as television's first hourlong western and introduced brawny actor Clint Walker to the world as the jack-of-all-trades loner Cheyenne Bodie. Raised by an American Indian tribe after the death of his parents, the physically imposing Cheyenne calls upon the many skills learned from his past as he wanders the Old West, finding action and adventure at every turn. Like many other productions during the Golden Age of Television, "Cheyenne" had its share of guest stars who would later become famous in their own right, including Rod Taylor, Dennis Hopper, George Kennedy, James Garner, Richard Crenna and Michael Landon.

items.title: Test of Courage
items.description: Cheyenne must get a herd of horses to a desolate cavalry base.

items.title: Gold, Glory and Custer-Prelude(1)
items.description: Cheyenne faces death to save another man's career.

items.title: Gold, Glory and Custer-Requiem(2)
items.description: Cheyenne is tried for desertion while trying to save the life of an innocent man.

items.title: Riot at Arroyo Seco
items.description: Cheyenne faces a murder charge in a town bent on hanging him.

items.title: Apache Blood
items.description: Cheyenne must answer a kidnapping with a killing in order to correct a blind injustice.

items.title: Outcast of Cripple Creek
items.description: Cheyenne takes the job of marshal and gets caught between a man's jealousy and a town's greed.

items.title: Alibi for the Scalped Man
items.description: Cheyenne uncovers an ancient terror and a new murder while probing for answers to a friend's disappearance.

items.title: Sweet Sam
items.description: Cheyenne reveals a bank robber masquerading as friend to every man.

items.title: Man Alone
items.description: Cheyenne helps a young amnesiac recover his memory.

items.title: The Quick and the Deadly
items.description: Cheyenne clears an old friend of a robbery charge.

items.title: Chic & Classic: Princess Diana
items.description: Refreshing the memory of Princess Diana's trendsetting and evergreen fashion choices that made her the talk of the town no matter where she went.

items.title: Chillerama
items.description: A closing drive-in theater shows four lost film prints to its cinephile patrons.

items.title: China Quake
items.description: In May 2008, a massive quake shook China's Sichuan province, killing 80,000 people; now scientists attempt to decipher the cause.

items.title: Gemma's Death By Chocolate Cupcakes
items.description: Gemma Stafford shows over-the-top delicious chocolate desserts perfect for any special occassion

items.title: Gemma's Triple Chocolate And Pumpkin Brownie
items.description: Gemma Stafford shows over-the-top delicious chocolate desserts perfect for any special occassion

items.title: Gemma's Chocolate Truffles
items.description: If you are looking for what to make your loved ones then these Homemade Chocolate Truffles are perfect.

items.title: Gemma’s Valentine’s Day Chocolate Soup Recipe
items.description: Chocolate Lovers! Gemma has simple and gorgeous Chocolate Soup recipe to get you ready for Valentine's Day along with showing you how to make homemade Fortune Cookies.

items.title: St. Patrick’s Day Bread Pudding w/ White Chocolate and Whiskey
items.description: Looking for a delicious dessert this St. Patrick's Day? Gemma Stafford's got you covered!

items.title: Gemma's Flourless Chocolate Cake Recipe
items.description: Gemma Stafford shows over-the-top delicious chocolate desserts perfect for any special occassion

items.title: Chonda Pierce: Girl Talk
items.description: Comic Chonda Pierce performs.

items.title: Chopping Mall
items.description: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

items.title: Chris & Adrianne Do Russia
items.description: Chris Knight and Adrianne Curry jet-set from Hollywood to Russia.

items.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
items.description: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

items.title: Christmas All Over Again
items.description: A mischievous boy must overcome his inner Scrooge or remain caught in a cycle where every day is a Christmas without presents.

items.title: Christmas at the Drive-In
items.description: A property lawyer finds romance during the holidays while trying to save her town's local drive-in from closing down.

items.title: Christmas Evil
items.description: Eavesdropping on mother turns a boy into a killer (Brandon Maggart) who roams the streets dressed as Santa Claus.

items.title: Christmas in Compton
items.description: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

items.title: Christmas in the Highlands
items.description: Sparks fly between a New York perfumer and a Scottish aristocrat as she tries to learn his secret formula for a rare fragrance.

items.title: Christmas in the Rockies
items.description: Romance sprouts in time for the holidays when Katie Jolly enters a lumberjack competition to save her family's business, and the paramedic who saved her father's life also joins the contest.

items.title: Christmas in the Smokies
items.description: A family must save its Smoky Mountains berry farm against all odds.

items.title: Christmas Keepsake
items.description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

items.title: Christmas on Every Page
items.description: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. As she reconnects with her roots, she starts to question whether success is measured by career milestones -- or by love, creativity, and the joy of truly belonging.

items.title: Christmas on the Range
items.description: Kendall has just one holiday wish: to keep the family ranch solvent, even though a callous neighbor wants her land.

items.title: Christmas on the Vine
items.description: A young marketing executive is assigned to help a struggling family-owned winery in a town that has lost its Christmas spirit due to a large wine conglomerate.

items.title: Christmas Story
items.description: When Nikolas loses his parents, the village residents look after him and he shows his gratitude by making toys as goodbye presents.

items.title: Christmas Time Is Here
items.description: A small-town real estate agent desperately tries to convince her widowed father not to sell the family resort to a prospective buyer.

items.title: Christmas With a Prince
items.description: A busy doctor reluctantly agrees to allow an injured prince to convalesce secretly in her pediatric ward.

items.title: Christmas With a Prince: Becoming Royal
items.description: Dr. Tasha is off to St. Navarre to spend Christmas with Prince Alex. He proposes, and they immediately begin making plans. Princess Miranda, unhappy about the news, concocts a plan to halt the nuptials.

items.title: Christmas With a Prince: The Royal Baby
items.description: Princess Tasha insists on accompanying her husband, Prince Alec, on his royal tour even though she's pregnant. When complications arise, they must figure out how to handle the situation.

items.title: Chromeskull: Laid to Rest 2
items.description: With help from a new assistant, a sadistic killer tracks the survivors of his last rampage.

items.title: Chuck
items.description: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up?

items.title: Churchill & the Queen
items.description: Historians reflect on the life of Winston Churchill, a skilled strategist and wartime personality, but Churchill's power lay in the way he used his speech and writing to leverage control of the British population.

items.title: Churchill: The Road to Victory
items.description: Military veteran and politician Winston Churchill takes office as prime minister in 1940, then leads Britain through trying times and on to victory in World War II.

items.title: Cimarron
items.description: In 1889, adventurous lawyer and newspaper editor Yancey Cravat (Richard Dix) convinces his genteel wife, Sabra (Irene Dunne), to join him in the rush to populate Osage, Oklahoma. After they begin to settle into the community, Yancey leaves to go further west. Alone, Sabra inherits his editorial duties and struggles to bring civilization to the rough frontier town. Over a tumultuous 40 years, the couple are repeatedly separated and reunited as Oklahoma makes its long journey to statehood.

items.title: Circle of Deception
items.description: A small island community is turned upside down when one of the town's citizens, Russel Douglas, is found dead the day after Christmas.

items.title: Mayan Apocalypse
items.description: A camera crew descends hundreds of feet below the streets of major cities -- such as New York, Cairo, London and Tokyo -- to explore the layered remnants of civilizations left buried deep under modern metropolitan centers.

items.title: America's Military Underground
items.description: Don explores top-secret military and government tunnels.

items.title: Murder Tunnels
items.description: Don uses brand-new mapping technology to expose the dark and deadly uncharted spaces beneath American cities.

items.title: America's Ancient Ancestors
items.description: Don goes deep beneath the great lakes and explores flooded caves as he searches for evidence of a mysterious, cave-dwelling society that may have been the first people to reach America.

items.title: The Pirate Queen's Lair
items.description: Don explores newly discovered ruins and caves in Croatia as he uncovers the true story of a formidable queen who dared to defy the powerful Roman Empire.

items.title: Templars and the Founding Fathers
items.description: Don goes deep beneath a Knights Templar stronghold in Turkey to explore a provocative theory that may link the fabled secret society to the founding fathers of America.

items.title: Secrets of the Ancient Metropolis
items.description: Don explores the massive underground cities in the mountains of Turkey that may have been home to the first civilization on Earth.

items.title: The Lost Aztec Colony
items.description: Don follows the clues hidden underground as he searches for evidence of 10,000 Aztecs who fled Mexico and disappeared somewhere in America.

items.title: City of Gold
items.description: Filmmaker Laura Gabbert follows Pulitzer Prize-winning food critic Jonathan Gold as he explores the culinary culture of Los Angeles.

items.title: The Fox & The Possums
items.description: See the teams collaborate to heal a rescued fox and care for injured songbirds.

items.title: The Raccoon and the Bats
items.description: The team at the Toronto Wildlife Center tend to ill and injured animals, with the hope of returning them to their natural habitat.

items.title: Big Cats
items.description: The lions and tigers of City Zoo in Pretoria; a tiger with a toothache; lion cubs are transported.

items.title: Rhinos
items.description: The difference between a white and black rhino; sedating and monitoring rhinos.

items.title: The Birds
items.description: The Cape Vulture breeding program is trying to ensure the endurance of this rare species.

items.title: Class of Nuke 'Em High
items.description: Tromaville's honor students are transformed into rampaging freaks when toxic waste leaks into the water supply.

items.title: Class Rank
items.description: Two high school misfits join forces in an attempt to overtake the local school board. Guided by their families, they enter the perilous word of politics and, in the process, learn a thing or two about love.

items.title: Cleopatra
items.description: "Cleopatra" is a lengthy, sprawling, spectacular love story, helmed by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, depicting Cleopatra's manipulation of Julius Caesar and Marc Antony in her ill-fated attempt to save the Egyptian empire. This threesome in one of the most famous and gloriously powerful love triangles ever to be captured on film.

items.title: Cleopatra Jones
items.description: Federal agent Jones (Tamara Dobson) tries to rescue her framed boyfriend (Bernie Casey) from a drug-queen pervert known as Mommy (Shelley Winters).

items.title: Cleopatra Jones and the Casino of Gold
items.description: Federal agent Jones (Tamara Dobson), trained in martial arts, routs a drug-dealing dragon lady (Stella Stevens) from her Macao gambling den.

items.title: Clerks II
items.description: Now in their 30s, slackers Dante and Randal find that they must change their lives and expand their horizons beyond pop culture and sex. After a disaster at their convenience store ends their employment there, they find new jobs at Mooby's, a fast-food empire.

items.title: Client 9: The Rise and Fall of Eliot Spitzer
items.description: In the late 2000s, New York Governor Eliot Spitzer is a rising star in the Democratic Party. He's a no-nonsense politician and former attorney general who holds corporations accountable for unethical business practices. But, just one year after he becomes governor, Spitzer resigns after being outed as a frequent client of an expensive and elite escort service. Along with political colleagues and friends, a remorseful Spitzer talks about how his infidelity affected his life and career.

items.title: Climate Crisis: Extinction
items.description: Greta Thunberg discusses how the current state of the world is heading towards mass extinction for both animals and humankind if governments fail to take action against the greedy companies leading humanity towards this fate.

items.title: Close Proximity
items.description: Professional drift racer Matt Field is followed across the United States as he takes on the 2016 Formula Drift Championship Series while balancing life as a business owner and navigating complex business and personal relationships.

items.title: Long Break
items.description: After a weeklong break, Matt and his crew are refreshed and ready for their next stop in Montreal.

items.title: Close Proximity
items.description: After a controversial call by the judges at the Formula Drift stop in Montreal, Matt focuses on restoring his mangled car for his next stop.

items.title: Close Proximity
items.description: Matt takes a break from the Formula Drift Championship Series and heads to Japan to compete in the D1 Grand Prix.

items.title: Closed Circuit
items.description: During a local screening of a film, a patron is hit by an unexpected bullet, leaving the police to sift through a cinema full of potential culprits.

items.title: Closing Escrow
items.description: Three quirky families collide when they try to buy the same property.

items.title: Clouds of Sils Maria
items.description: A veteran actress (Juliette Binoche) comes face-to-face with an uncomfortable reflection of herself when she agrees to take part in a revival of the play that launched her career 20 years earlier.

items.title: Clownado
items.description: A troupe of murderous circus clowns goes on a killing spree.

items.title: Cocaine Cowboys
items.description: Filmmaker Billy Corben recalls Miami drug wars of the 1970s and '80s, when Colombian drug lords turned the relatively quiet Florida city into a breeding ground for violence and excess. Corben interviews so-called "survivors" of the era, including dealers, smugglers and hit men.

items.title: Cocaine Crabs From Outer Space
items.description: When a couple of intergalactic space crabs land on Earth, they encounter the one thing they didn't expect: a duo of dumb frat boys force-feeding them cocaine.

items.title: Cocaine Godmother: The Griselda Blanco Story
items.description: Griselda Blanco becomes a pioneer in the Miami-based cocaine trade. Her willingness to use violence against her rivals leads to numerous assassination attempts, forcing Griselda to move her business to California.

items.title: Mike Evans & Kike Hernández
items.description: Kevin Hart hops in the post-game cold tub to chat up different sports personalities.

items.title: Farm Family Slain
items.description: As chronicled in Truman Capote's landmark book, "In Cold Blood," this docuseries takes a fresh, in-depth look at the legendary murder case of the Clutter family in a small Kansas town in 1959, a crime seemingly without motive. The four-hour event uses firsthand accounts of relatives, family friends, townspeople and law enforcement -- some of whom are speaking publicly about the murder for the first time. There's also never-before-seen details such as original photographs, audio recordings, and documents from the case, as well as memoirs and letters from the murderers and their families. Acclaimed filmmaker Joe Berlinger directs and co-produces.

items.title: Killers on the Run
items.description: Kansas law enforcement survey the aftermath of the seemingly unmotivated crime, while criminals Perry Smith and Richard Hickock go on the lam.

items.title: The Intruders on Trial
items.description: Detailing the resulting investigation and convictions of Perry Smith and Richard Hickock, along with the ensuing media coverage.

items.title: The Gallows and the Novel
items.description: As Perry Smith and Richard Hickock face a death sentence, Truman Capote's coverage of the infamous case and his ensuing novel, "In Cold Blood," spawns the modern American True Crime genre.

items.title: He Added Poison to His Wife's Drink, Making It Look Like Suicide
10-Year-Old Girl Found Dead Along Highway Near Cali
items.description: Cali, a city that never sleeps, kept Jacqueline's family awake for years with the haunting truth they uncovered beneath its lively surface.

items.title: Collective
items.description: Journalists uncover health care fraud in the wake of a deadly nightclub fire in Bucharest, Romania, in 2015.

items.title: Color of a Brisk and Leaping Day
items.description: Second-generation Chinese-American John Lee (Peter Alexander) feels a strong connection to the legacy of his Chinese immigrant grandfather, who built train tracks for the First Transcontinental Railroad. When John realizes the rail line from Merced to Yosemite Valley is to be scrapped, he convinces his father to back him in a risky scheme to keep it operational. John pays switchman Skeeter (Michael Stipe) and conductor Robinson (Henry Gibson) to help, but the past may prove beyond his reach.

items.title: Color of Love
items.description: An African American widow with two kids who has so much love to give, she often fosters children who need a home. She finds out that Peter and Rachel, the white siblings she fostered twice before, fled from their latest foster home.

items.title: Colorado
items.description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

items.title: Colorado Christmas
items.description: A single mom decides to follow her dreams when she meets a charming country music singer who becomes her inspiration, and more.

items.title: Canada + Greece
items.description: Chefs Bianca Osbourne and Craig Wong take a culinary trip around the world, exploring two cultures and two cuisines.

items.title: USA + India
items.description: Chef Craig Wong celebrates the tastes of India and the USA and creates delicious dishes combining their cuisines.

items.title: Come on Cowboys
items.description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) save a circus friend from a bum rap.

items.title: Zach Galifianakis Wears a Blue Jacket & Red Socks
items.description: Upon first look, "Comedy Bang! Bang!" is like any late-night talk show... until the guests sit down and the interviews commence. Then it veers off in all sorts of directions, most of which include unfiltered and improvised dialogue. The show is based on host Scott Aukerman's popular podcast of the same name (and most certainly influenced by the Internet mock-talk show "Between Two Ferns With Zach Galifianakis," which Aukerman produced and directed). In each episode, Aukerman reinvents the traditional celebrity interview by engaging his guests in ad-libbed banter, all of which is punctuated by beats from "bandleader" Reggie Watts or, in later episodes, "Weird Al" Yankovic.

items.title: Amy Poehler Wears a Black Jacket & Grey Pants
items.description: Comic Amy Poehler discusses her hair and her feud with Mad Magazine.

items.title: Jon Hamm Wears a Light Blue Shirt & Silver Watch
items.description: A film student directs Scott's segment with comic Jon Hamm and a man who eats bicycles.

items.title: Michael Cera Wears a Blue Denim Shirt & Red Pants
items.description: Michael Cera discusses not getting his dream role and the Cake Boss tells Scott the future.

items.title: Seth Rogen Wears a Plaid Shirt & Brown Pants
items.description: Seth Rogen discusses his recent vacation and Reggie interrupts the show to paint a portrait.

items.title: Paul Rudd Wears a Red Lumberjack Flannel Shirt
items.description: Paul Rudd and Scott discover they both love mime; a man who should be dead explains his missing arm.

items.title: Ed Helms Wears a Grey Shirt & Brown Boots
items.description: Ed Helms shows off his banjo skills and makes animal noises; a second talk show is also going on.

items.title: Elizabeth Banks Wears a Red Dress
items.description: Elizabeth Banks says the word of the day and Scott is forced to take action; a mind vacation.

items.title: Adam Scott Wears a Red Oxford Shirt & Jeans
items.description: Adam Scott discusses his workout regimen; Magic Window visits and Reggie's feelings are hurt.

items.title: "Weird Al" Yankovic Wears a Hawaiian Shirt
items.description: "Weird Al" smashes all musical conventions and Tenacious D. stops by to play a new song.

items.title: Andy Samberg Wears a Plaid Shirt and Glasses
items.description: Andy Samberg; Jordan Peele; what Scott Aukerman and Reggie Watts have been up to since last season; Reggie enters a cybernetic computer world; Scott is rewarded for his unintentional appetite for prunes; special guests: Selma Blair and Lance Reddick.

items.title: Aziz Ansari Wears a Charcoal Blazer
items.description: Scott is sick and an elite team is dispatched inside his body to fix him; Scott interviews Aziz Ansari and craft services coordinator Fabrice Fabrice (Nick Kroll); Scott teaches an important lesson; special guests: Chris Meloni and Cedric Yarborough.

items.title: Anna Kendrick Wears a Patterned Blouse & Burgundy Pants
items.description: Anna Kendrick time travels; Scott and Reggie preview their new movie; the studio takes on a tropical twist when a Bahama Mama Maker is purchased; Ben Schwartz; the question is asked if Scott and Reggie are ready for parenthood.

items.title: David Cross Wears a Red Polo Shirt and Brown Shoes with Red Laces
items.description: A Deputy Marshal's unexpected visit; the world's worst date; a politician that speaks the truth; David Cross; Will Forte; special guests: Tim Meadows, Bob Odenkirk, "Weird Al" Yankovic.

items.title: Zoe Saldana Wears a Tan Blouse and Glasses
items.description: Reggie swaps places with a cop; Zoe Saldaña spoils her next movie, Paul F. Tompkins; Scott hits the street to pull pranks; director Garry Marshall talks about his surprising new project; special guest: John Carroll Lynch.

items.title: Gillian Jacobs Wears a Red Dress with Sail Boats
items.description: Jason Mantzoukas; Gillian Jacobs; Reggie's new girlfriend may have a secret agenda; Scott's stolen sandwich; Bookie's blind date goes awry; a visit from Italian Chef Lugosi; special guests: Chris Hardwick, Adam Scott, and Michaela Watkins.

items.title: Andy Richter Wears a Suit Jacket and a Baby Blue Button Down Shirt
items.description: Andy Richter; Mike Hanford; Scott and Reggie visit the Big Apple and try to keep up with their special guide; Scott and Reggie try investing their money; Reggie's bike; special guest: Michael Ian Black.

items.title: Sarah Silverman Wears a Black Dress With a White collar
items.description: Sarah Silverman; Joe Lo Truglio; Scott gets tongue-tied during his interview with Sarah; the world's fastest talker goes for a record; Scott reveals his secrets to getting camera-ready; special guest: Adam DeVine.

items.title: Bill Hader Wears a Grey Button Down Shirt and Sneakers
items.description: Bill Hader; Bobby Moynihan; Reggie joins via satellite while America's favorite game show interrupts "Comedy Bang! Bang!"; information about who adopts the little orphan; special guest: Jimmy Pardo.

items.title: Casey Wilson Wears a White Lace Dress and a Black Blazer
items.description: Casey Wilson; Paul F. Tompkins; Casey Wilson performs in a musical extravaganza written by Andrew Lloyd Webber with a live-in studio phantom and tuneful guests; Reggie learns a lesson about the importance of talking; special guest: Thomas Lennon.

items.title: Pee-wee Herman Wears a Halloween Costume
items.description: Pee-wee Herman casts spells and saves Scott's life for Halloween; Reggie has a surprise costume of his own; Scott finds a killer from his past; Reggie Watts; Pee-wee Herman.

items.title: Jessica Alba Wears a Jacket with Patent Leather Pumps
items.description: Jessica Alba hosts a game show and discusses her childhood; Scott travels the country helping women with their sweater woes; a visit from the King of Cards; Reggie Watts; Jessica Alba; Kristen Schaal; Nat Faxon; Tony Hale; Jim Rash.

items.title: Jim Gaffigan Wears a Blue Jacket & Plum T-Shirt
items.description: Jim Gaffigan eyes a new invention while Scott's boss gets angry; a lazy friend crashes on the set; Billy Big Mouth Bass; Reggie Watts; Jim Gaffigan; Matt Walsh; Matt Besser.

items.title: Andy Dick Wears a Black Suit Jacket & Skinny Tie
items.description: Scott thinks about the consequences of missing a bus; Andy Dick and Reggie Watts split realities; a mysterious stranger gives advice; Scott's mechanic reveals underground comedy; Reggie Watts; Andy Dick; Todd Glass; Bobcat Goldthwait; Matt Walsh.

items.title: Cobie Smulders Wears a Strapless Black & White Dress
items.description: Cobie Smulders visits "Comedy Bang! Bang!" for the lost pilot episode; a master magician wreaks havoc on the set; Reggie Watts; Cobie Smulders; Zach Woods; Topher Grace; Phil LaMarr; Matthew Sweet.

items.title: Zach Galifianakis Wears a Santa Suit
items.description: It's a Christmas Miracle until Zach Galifianakis upsets an elf; Scott learns the meaning of Christmas when the bonuses get lost; Scott's mom visits; Reggie Watts; Zach Galifianakis; Dave Thomas; Lynne Stewart.

items.title: Uzo Aduba Wears a White Blouse and Royal Blue Heels
items.description: Uzo Aduba shows off her comic skills; concerned citizen Tim Landers explains his plan to get back at some kids; future Scott and future Cudi take a time machine back to the present to save comedy from total destruction.

items.title: Kaley Cuoco Wears a Black Blazer and Slip on Sneakers
items.description: The crew is visited by some American heroes to try to bring the country back to its moral foundations; Kaley Cuoco finalizes her will; lifestyle coach Karen helps Scott style his inside.

items.title: Malin Akerman Wears a Black Blouse and Cropped Jeans
items.description: Malin Åkerman reveals all her deep dark secrets; Slow Joey tries to juggle his new business venture with falling in love.

items.title: Mike Colter Wears a Pink Button Up and Black Boots
items.description: Scott is excited to spend Thanksgiving celebrating with the "Comedy Bang! Bang!" crew, but a group of outsiders could disrupt his plans; Mike Colter discloses a shocking revelation; teacher Joe Bongo discusses his extracurricular activities.

items.title: Reggie Watts Wears a Purple and Yellow Quilted Sweatshirt
items.description: Reggie Watts returns to the show just in time to try to prevent a disaster; Weird Al has a surprising announcement; Adam Scott tries to give Scott some assistance.

items.title: Lord Andrew Lloyd Webber Wears A Purple Top Hat & Fabrice Fabrice Wears One Pink Fur Leg Warmer
items.description: Scott receives some disturbing news that may mean the end of "Comedy Bang! Bang!" forever, but before the end, old chums Lord Andrew Lloyd Webber and Fabrice Fabrice stop by to wish the gang goodbye.

items.title: Comfort Eating
items.description: Nick Helm explores the foods of the United Kingdom in a program that is part comedy, part travelogue, and part restaurant review.

items.title: Camden
items.description: After his break-up, Nick wakes up in Camden; to thank his friend for crashing on his sofa, Nick takes him to breakfast; a liquid lunch at an underground speakeasy where he invents his own cocktail before sampling food stalls at a street market.

items.title: Leeds
items.description: A mouth-watering 16-course menu is the pinnacle of Nick's culinary pilgrimage to Leeds, where he meets chef Michael O'Hare.

items.title: Brighton
items.description: Nick goes back to Brighton to catch up with some old friends and take his mind off his ex; first stop, Nowhere Man, a café specializing in American pancakes, followed by a heart-to-heart over fish and chips on the beach with one of his best friends.

items.title: Berlin
items.description: Funny foodie Nick Helm sets sail for Berlin with Yara Greyjoy, aka actor Gemma Whelan; currywurst, Korean BBQs and Turkish tapas are on the very multicultural menu.

items.title: St. Albans
items.description: Newly single comic Nick Helm mends his broken heart by pumping it full of tasty food when he returns home for waffles with bacon, curry and his mother's prawn lasagna.

items.title: Paris

items.title: Junk
items.description: AMC dives into the comic book culture with this unscripted series that follows the antics of the "fanboys" in and around Jay and Silent Bob's Secret Stash, a New Jersey comic shop owned by writer-director Kevin Smith. Cameras capture the banter of the shop's employees and its customers as they collectively discover the treasures of the comic collecting world, and the staff -- de-facto leader Walt, shop whipping boy Ming and comic book virtuoso Mike among them -- shares all the details with Smith via a podcast that is woven throughout the series. Smith has been a comics fan since his youth and has written several comic books based on his movies, including "Clerks," as well as story arcs for the legendary "Green Arrow" and "Daredevil" comics.

Hector takes to the admiration, and the two become unlikely pen pals, however, when Hector has to flee his country during a coup, he seeks refuge in the house of his only remaining friend.

items.title: Deep Red
items.description: A psychic medium (Macha Méril) is brutally murdered, and musician Marcus Daly (David Hemmings) feels a need to solve the case, since he was the one who discovered the body. Working with him is reporter Gianna Brezzi (Daria Nicolodi), who hopes for a big scoop by solving the case. When one of Marcus's own friends ends up murdered at the hands of the same killer, the resourceful pair realize they must work fast to uncover the murderer's identity, or they might serve as the maniac's next victims.

items.title: Def by Temptation
items.description: Joel (James Bond III), a quiet divinity student from North Carolina, starts to question his faith. So he heads to New York to visit his friend K (Kadeem Hardison), a struggling actor, who takes him out bar-hopping. They meet a gorgeous seductress (Cynthia Bond) who turns out to be a succubus, a demon spirit luring black Lotharios to their deaths. When she sets her eyes on Joel, K turns to the help of Dougie (Bill Nunn), a drunken cop who specializes in supernatural investigations.

items.title: Defense News Weekly
items.description: Army Sec. Daniel Driscoll discusses the Army Transformation Initiative and details how the largest branch will navigate the defense industry in years to come.

items.title: Dementia
items.description: Hired as a live-in nurse, a seemingly sweet woman (Kristina Klebe) unleashes her dark side as she torments a Vietnam War veteran (Gene Jones) who has dementia.

items.title: Dementia 13
items.description: After John Haloran dies, his wife, Louise, fears that she will be denied his inheritance. Fabricating a story about John traveling to the United States, she joins the rest of the Haloran family at their Irish estate as they hold a memorial for John's sister, who died in a lake eight years ago. Louise schemes to convince Lady Haloran that she can speak with the dead child. However, this plan is interrupted by an axe murderer loose on the estate.

items.title: Dementia Part II
items.description: Out on parole, a maintenance worker comes face-to-face with true evil when he uncovers a seemingly benign woman's dark secret.

The series explores a multitude of issues women face today -- including patriarchy, misogyny, rape culture and unrealistic beauty standards -- by following Plum Kettle's journey to self-awakening. A ghostwriter for the editor of one of New York's hottest fashion magazines, Plum has waged a lifelong battle with her image. Fed up, she turns to weight-loss surgery but ends up in the middle of two rival feminist factions -- one that may be responsible for the attacks on male harassers, and the other that preaches female empowerment. As she straddles the two groups, Plum must decide what part she plays in a wildly complicated, changing world.

The story centers around four ordinary people - Peter, Simone, Janice, and Fredwynn -- who are brought together by chance after they all respond to a flyer. Feeling as though something is missing in their lives, the characters are drawn into a game that unfolds in a serpentine series of events, taking them from parades to shareholders' meetings. As they piece together the puzzle to find a path forward, they come to delve deeper into a mind-boggling mystery hiding just behind the facade of everyday life and their eyes are opened to a world of possibility, whimsy and wonder. The 10-episode series features an ensemble cast including Sally Field, Richard E. Grant, André Benjamin, and Eve Lindley.

items.title: Incredibly Dangerous
items.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.

The only hope of survival lies with a grizzled demon hunter (Dolph Lundgren) who has faced this terror before. With the help of a reluctant FBI agent (Kristina Klebe), he must figure out how to destroy a demon that has the ability to possess its killer.

After spending a few days in jail, they return home and realize they may have a rat in their midst. As they try to pick out the informant from a group that includes a corrupt politician (Mark Kempner) and an unpredictable hit man (Michael Smiley), Karl learns his girlfriend (Kerry Peacock) is pregnant and deals with his wife's anger, as well as his parents' disapproval.

items.title: Down But Not Out
items.description: Five-minute showers. Changing the car's oil at home. Hair cuts from your sister/daughter. These are the new realities of life for the Bruce family. They were living the American dream until the economy took a nosedive; suddenly, money got tighter and investments vanished. So this blended family with seven children had to make serious adjustments to get out of debt and back on track. Their journey may look familiar to many, and may make others realize how lucky they are. Each episode also offers some of the family's money-saving tips.

items.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
items.description: Scientist Dr. Henry Jekyll (John Barrymore) is intelligent and diligent, but also uptight and extremely serious about his work. When his friend, Sir George Carew (Brandon Hurst), takes him to a show featuring the sensual Miss Gina (Nita Naldi), an aroused Jekyll sets out on a quest to separate man's saintly and sinful sides. His experiments succeed, and his evil alter ego, Mr. Hyde, is created. As the doctor uncontrollably alternates between Jekyll and Hyde, danger looms.

items.title: Plastic Makes Perfect
items.description: There's no shortage of attractive people in Miami, but some of them needed some artificial help to get that way, and many of those folks probably went to Dr. Michael Salzhauer. He is such a prolific plastic surgeon around the city that he has earned the nickname Dr. Miami. The surgeon has even gained a worldwide following by sharing the uncensored, and sometimes unconventional, procedures that he performs on his patients, who he calls "beauty warriors." Whether it's a tummy tuck, a breast augmentation or a nose job, Dr. Miami isn't afraid to livestream it on social media, which is the job of social media coordinators Brittany and Ashley -- who are always vying for the doctor's attention. Dr. Miami's sister-in-law Rosy runs the practice as its COO, and her responsibilities include being the unofficial staff therapist.

items.title: Downsized & Daddy Issues

items.title: Lessons in Pimple Popping
items.description: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

items.title: A Juicy Secret

items.title: Lump in My Throat

items.title: The Big September Man
items.description: Just the facts, ma'am. Every week, Sgt. Joe Friday follows the clues, interviews witnesses and spews a lot of crime jargon as he tries to catch one perp or another. For the majority of the show's 1950s run, he was partnered with Officer Smith, but when the show was brought back in 1967, he had Officer Gannon as a partner.

items.title: The Big Seventeen

items.title: Dressing Like Diana

items.title: Drinking Buddies

items.title: Drive Hard
items.description: A driving instructor (Thomas Jane) who used to race autos is forced to drive a getaway car for a thief (John Cusack) who plans to steal $9 million.

items.title: To Freak or Not to Freak
items.description: There's no shortage of dating shows on cable, so shows need a unique aspect to stand out from the crowd. "Driven to Love" has that in the form of a "tricked-out love taxi," to use the network's term for the vehicle. Host Ray J serves as the driver as he helps a single person find love through five potential dates while cruising along the streets of New York City. Ray J also serves as the dater's wingman, offering advice and choosing prospective mates for the romantic meetings that happen both inside and outside the vehicle. But it's ultimately up to the dater to decide which potential suitors to give a chance. When Ray J drives up to a potential date, the single decides whether to drive past, let the suitor into the vehicle, or even kick out the current mate to let in the new one. In the end, the contestant chooses one mate with whom to go on a romantic getaway.

items.title: Lawyer Lets Loose
items.description: Ray J is the wingman for workaholic lawyer, Mike; five hot women compete for Mike's heart and the game gets physical.

items.title: Serenade Me
items.description: Ray J finds Broadway actress Natalie the leading man of her dreams.

items.title: Naughty or Spice

items.title: King for a Beauty Queen

items.title: Church on the Mountain
items.description: Decisions made in the Yukon can make or break any situation in a second and are magnified in this rugged terrain; the brothers ascend and stalk the mountain grizzly and are now within 500 yards; the decision rests with Chris.

items.title: Valley of Snow
items.description: The snow continues to pommel the Keefer brothers at Church Camp and visibility is at an all-time low; they are snowed in and have no definite timetable to continue the hunt; problems begin to arise.

items.title: End of the Line
items.description: As the bull closes in on the calling, Chris can hear the bull but cannot see him, Casey, on the other hand, can; as they try to communicate using hand signals, the bull disappears over the mountain top and gone.

items.title: Divide & Conquer
items.description: Chris closes the distance to 300 yards and drops the big bull.

items.title: Weathered & Worn
items.description: The brothers move toward the bull; midway through the stalk, the bull walks toward them.

items.title: Dropped Best Moments, Part 1
items.description: Chris and Casey Keefer reflect on standout moments from the first two seasons; they discuss their most memorable individual hunts and the evolution of the show over the years.

items.title: Dropped: Best Moments, Part 2
items.description: Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer reflect on some of the greatest moments from the first two seasons; topics include never before seen behind the scenes footage and a look ahead.

items.title: Drums in the Deep South
items.description: Before plantation wife Kathy Summers (Barbara Payton) can run off with her lover, Clay Clayburn (James Craig), civil war breaks out, and he must report to the Confederate Army. However, within a few years he returns to Georgia, and Kathy is still in her old home -- which the Union Army, led by Clay's best friend, Maj. Will Denning (Guy Madison), is using for a base. Kathy begins spying for Clay, but she struggles with the idea that one of these two friends may kill the other in battle.

items.title: Dual
items.description: Upon receiving a terminal diagnosis, Sarah opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a sudden and miraculous recovery, her attempts to decommission her clone fail, leading to a court-mandated duel to the death. Now, she has one year to train her mind and body for the fight of her life.

items.title: Episode 101
items.description: Detectives Rob Reilly and Cassie Maddox find themselves dispatched to investigate the murder of a young girl on the outskirts of Dublin, Ireland. Based on the books "In the Woods" and "The Likeness" by American-Irish writer Tana French, this psychological thriller features a cast of mostly Irish actors, including Killian Scott and Sarah Greene as the leads. The series follows the detectives, who put their friendship to the test, as they are pulled deeper into the intrigue and darkness that surrounds the case.

items.title: Dumbstruck
items.description: Five ventriloquists discuss their emotional attachments to their dummies.

items.title: Dwayne The Rock Johnson: No Pain No Gain
items.description: From humble beginnings to one of the highest grossing actors today, Dwayne Johnson remains grounded, charismatic and enjoyable to watch in any form of media.

items.title: Dying to Play
items.description: Two women rob their wealthy, mentally unstable friend who lives in a fantasy world they created.

items.title: Dynamite Warrior
items.description: In the 1920s Thailand a young man sets out to avenge his parents' murder at the hands of vicious cattle rustlers.

items.title: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers
items.description: A space scientist (Hugh Marlowe) figures out how to down a fleet of alien spacecraft looming over Washington, D.C.

items.title: Iceland: The Dane on the Volcano
items.description: Earth's Eternal Wonders explores spectacular landscapes and Earth's formation with scientists, using CGI to bring the planet's history to life.

items.title: Halong Bay - The island labyrinth of the dragon bay
items.description: Advanced graphics turn back time to show how rising post-ice age sea levels flooded a cliff-lined valley to create Vietnam's unique karst maze.

items.title: Grand Canyon: The Window Into the Earths History
items.description: Scientists rappel deep into the canyon to read geological layers, tracing its shifts from a primeval mountain range and desert into a giant gorge.

items.title: East African Rift Valley
