items.title: Cell Phone
items.description: Environmental impact of cell phones.

items.title: Chocolate
items.description: David reveals the not-so-sweet impact of the world's favorite candy.

items.title: Cotton T-Shirt
items.description: Environmental concerns.

items.title: Gold Ring
items.description: Consequences of mining and refining gold.

items.title: Light Bulb
items.description: Energy consumption of different kinds of lights.

items.title: Paper Napkin
items.description: Environmental consequences of mass paper production.

items.title: Salmon
items.description: Environmental impact of salmon.

items.title: Water Bottle
items.description: Environmental impact of plastic bottles.

items.title: Eddie Izzard: Unrepeatable
items.description: Highlights of comedian Eddie Izzard's one-man show at London's Albery Theatre in March 1994 when Izzard was playing a limited seven-week run of his celebrated stand-up show.

items.title: Eden Log
items.description: An amnesiac awakens inside a cave.

items.title: Edward VIII: Never Crowned King
items.description: Edward VIII, the king never crowned, abandoned his throne for the woman he loved and went from being a man of honour to a man of nothing and even a scorned man. His life was a tumultuous one, full of romance and mystery.

items.title: Eerie Fairy Tales
items.description: An anthology of bizarre, fantastic and uncanny tales of the past and future about love, fear, this world and the beyond.

items.title: Ejecta
items.description: Two men witness an unexplainable event in the sky as a historic solar storm approaches, and they try to survive as a terrifying life form hunts them.

items.title: El Condor
items.description: After escaping from a chain gang, Luke (Jim Brown) partners with tough prospector Jaroo (Lee Van Cleef) to search for gold in a Mexican fort. The enterprising duo manage to convince Apache chief Santana (Iron Eyes Cody) and his tribe to help them infiltrate the fort, which is defended by Mexican military officer Chavez (Patrick O'Neal) and his men. While things don't go according to plan, Chavez's lover, Claudine (Mariana Hill), falls for Luke, which proves helpful to the scrappy bandits.

items.title: Electrick Children
items.description: A Mormon youth (Liam Aiken) is accused of raping and impregnating his sister (Julia Garner), even though she insists that a voice she heard on a cassette tape actually did the deed.

items.title: Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon: Mother of the House

items.title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer

Against all odds, Elliot and his best friend, Hazel, set out to prove that he is the horse for the job. As Elliot and Hazel take on the North Pole reindeer try-outs, Hazel learns that Christmas, as we know it, may be headed for disaster. Meanwhile, back at the farm, a sinister lady threatens the lives of their friends, and Elliot is faced with the biggest decision of his life.

items.title: Elton John: Becoming Rocketman
items.description: Exploring the career of Elton John, one of the most successful musicians of the past century.

items.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills

items.title: Monstroid

items.title: Frankenstein's Castle of Freaks

items.title: Elvis & the Memphis Mafia
items.description: Exploring Elvis' life through the eyes of The Memphis Mafia — a select group of friends he entrusted with his life — from the highs to the lows.

items.title: Elvis Presley: The Final Hours
items.description: Elvis Presley's closest friends and confidants share their memories and discuss his last hours.

items.title: Elvis Presley: The Last 24 Hours
items.description: The true story of Elvis Presley's last 24 hours is told by the men who knew him best, his Memphis Mafia; Elvis' closest friends and confidants share their memories and experiences about the king and what really happened during his final hours.

items.title: Elvis: The Other Side
items.description: Elvis Presley made an enormous impact on people's lives with his music, shows, and lovable personality, but he had a hidden side that very few people were allowed to see.

items.title: Elvis: Tortured Soul
items.description: Elvis Presley captured the hearts of millions through his chart-topping music and untouchable charisma; however, behind the gates of Graceland, the King faced battles on several fronts that threatened his career, his love and even his life.

items.title: New Year in the Emergency Room
The Slums
items.description: In Mumbai, more than half of its inhabitants live in slums, the conditions create various public health problems; in Buenos Aires, ambulances refuse to enter the narrow streets of some of the capital's villas.

items.title: Emergency In The Middle Of Traffic

items.title: Ian McNulty

items.title: Janie Glades
items.description: Janie Glade inspires a delicious and economical meal.

items.title: Far Haven
items.description: In 1887, Hunter Braddock moves back to Far Haven, Ariz., to start over with his two young children. When his father-in-law is brutally attacked, he must take on the corrupt forces strangling the town to protect what he loves most.

items.title: Fatal Addiction: Amy Winehouse
items.description: Witness the rise and fall of Britain's most iconic star and the lead-up to her devastating death.

items.title: Fatal Addiction: Michael Jackson
items.description: Family, friends and fellow musicians describe the life of the child prodigy turned King of Pop Michael Jackson over his four-decade career, from his rise to fame to his later battle with tabloids.

items.title: Feast of the Flesh
items.description: Michael Douglas and Glenn Close are nowhere to be found in this docuseries that explores the potential consequences when an all-consuming romance causes people to commit unthinkable criminal acts in the name of love. Each hourlong episode brings together first-person testimonials with evocative cinematography and interrogation footage to illustrate the crime and the incidents that led up to it. The show opens with the crime before entering flashback mode and using re-enactments to provide a glimpse into the heart of the dangerous romance prior to the act being committed.

items.title: AWOL Abduction
items.description: Elihue's disappearance uncovers a twisted ring of greed and deception that leads investigators face to face with pure evil.

items.title: Shot to the Heart
items.description: Life resembles a fairytale come true for high school sweethearts Re'Mano and Eugenia Campbell.

items.title: Lying in Wait
items.description: When a decorated Navy commander is found dead in a hotel room, those close to him suspect suicide; when autopsy results point to homicide, investigators sort through numerous lies to uncover a calculated plot fueled by lust and greed.

items.title: Murder Most Foul
items.description: When a Miami man's wife reports him missing, police set out to learn what happened to him; they learn troubling secrets of addiction and infidelity; when a foul odor permeates the neighborhood, they wonder if the truth is closer to home.

items.title: Twice the Terror
items.description: After single mother, Shania Copeland, and her neighbor Leotis Lester are shot dead, detectives use witness testimony and surveillance to piece together the truth behind a senseless crime that never should have been committed.

items.title: Sister Act
items.description: After a young bus driver suddenly vanishes, his body is discovered in a San Antonio cemetery; as investigators attempt to dig deeper, the truth comes to light as they uncover an elaborate murder plot, meticulously engineered by a master puppeteer.

items.title: Walking in Her Truth
items.description: When a 17-year-old transgender girl goes missing, her journey of walking in her truth comes to a tragic end; as investigators track her killer, they learn that she suffered bullying and misunderstanding; whether it led to her death.

items.title: Driven by Jealousy
items.description: When an up-and-coming rapper is killed in a hit-and-run in East Chicago, police suspect jealousy fueled the crime; the victim had multiple women in his life, but detectives soon realize the killer will do anything to get away with murder.

items.title: Open to Love
items.description: With a bound body of a missing man recovered from the river, foul play becomes immediately obvious; detectives quickly uncover a dangerous love triangle, hidden bloodstains, and an informant who brings the twisted truth to light.

items.title: A Monster in the Making
items.description: When a woman at the peak of her career is found brutally murdered, investigators struggle to make sense of it all; as the evidence leads them to her killer, it's apparent he has tasted blood and now he wants more.

items.title: Deadly Dating Game
items.description: When a beloved cancer survivor is found dead on the side of a rural highway, police fear her blossoming dating life played a role in her tragic demise; as detectives retrace her final days, they discover an obsessive killer hiding in plain sight.

items.title: Devil's Playground
items.description: When a young woman goes missing, detectives work with her family to unearth a voicemail from an unknown number; but when it leads detectives to a disturbing scene and an unexpected killer, they must have the evidence to put him away.

items.title: Toxic Intentions
items.description: When a dedicated educator is found unresponsive in his home, family and friends are left puzzled by his unexpected passing; after receiving a tip suggesting his death was no accident, police uncover a sophisticated killer with a chilling motive.

items.title: Familial Lies
items.description: When a dedicated security guard is found murdered in her apartment, police initially suspect a fatal home invasion; but as detectives interview their victim's friends and family, they discover an unassuming assailant consumed by jealousy and greed.

items.title: Fame and Felony
items.description: A rising young rap star is reported missing, and detectives find evidence of a violent attack in her home; yet when their prime suspect goes on the run, they are left scrambling for answers, until they get a call that breaks the case wide open.

items.title: Fatal Beauty
items.description: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

items.title: Fallen Hero
items.description: Exploring murders committed using the world's deadliest weapons -- guns.

items.title: Killer Gambit
items.description: When the wife of a famous New Orleans sportscaster is shot in the face point-blank, the killing looks random, but the play-by-play becomes more scandalous with time.

items.title: Unholy Murder
items.description: When a congregant is found in the church office bleeding from gunshot wounds to the head, police question the new pastor who leads the investigation to an ungodly discovery.

items.title: Bullet on a String
items.description: In Pensacola, Florida, ex-cop and private investigator, Taylor Wright, is moving into a new home with the love of her life when she inexplicably disappears without a trace; it appears at first as if she may have simply run away.

items.title: The Sins of the Amish
items.description: When the Amish circle their wagons around a brutal murder amongst their own, investigators must dig deep to unearth the chilling secrets behind the simple facade of Amish country.

items.title: Killer Walking
items.description: A carjacking murder is far more than it appears when police piece together surveillance videos and track the killer who parked the car and walked away.

items.title: The Orange Tree Murder
items.description: When Jennifer Cave fails to show up at her new job, her family fears the worst; their fears are confirmed when they take their search for her into their own hands.

items.title: Knock. Talk. Enter. Kill.
items.description: Prominent community leaders from a Washington D.C. neighborhood are murdered when they answer a knock at their front door.

items.title: Misery in Missouri
items.description: After a Midwestern insurance salesman is discovered on the floor of his office with an extra hole in his head, his wife, family, community, and church are drawn into a web of greed, infidelity, and murder.

items.title: Sex, Lies, and Murder
items.description: When a family woman is gunned down outside her church after choir practice, police uncover a network of corruption and illicit sex lie just below a flawless surface.

items.title: Killer Grandma
items.description: A condominium manager finds a body left in one of her suites; when an investigation begins, the police discover this isn't the first victim.

items.title: Shot in the Dark
items.description: A home invasion gone wrong ends with the shooting death of a young man, but what seems like a clear case of self-defense starts to unravel as investigators look closer.

items.title: Cross Country Killer
items.description: When police find a young college student murdered in Mission Viejo, they have no idea that it is the start of a cross-country killing spree.

items.title: Deadlift Killer
items.description: A missing bodybuilder is found encased in cement.

If a contestant refuses a challenge, fails in a challenge, or has the worst performance in a challenge, that contestant is eliminated from the competition. The contestant (or team) that manages to complete all of the stunts, including finishing the final stunt in the fastest time, wins the $50,000 prize. The rest? Well, they get nothing (except maybe a mouthful of worms). Joe Rogan hosts.

items.description: Examining Operation Watchtower, a military campaign that took place between Aug. 7,1942 and Feb. 9, 1943, on and around the island of Guadalcanal in the Pacific theater of World War II.

items.description: Benito Mussolini declared war on France and Britain, and it brought the war to the Mediterranean. This was Mussolini's war as Hitler was focused heavily on his ambitions in Eastern Europe.

items.title: Tree Stand Nightmare
items.description: Faith, determination and human spirit abound in "Fight to Survive," which recounts stories of people's deadly ordeals in the outdoors. Accompanying survivors back to where harrowing events occurred is rock-climber Craig DeMartino, who is featured in the premiere episode. His right leg was amputated below the knee after a climbing accident, but he continued in his sport. In 2006 he became the first amputee to free-climb the 3,200-foot face of Yosemite's El Capitan in one day. Other stories tell of sailor Steven Callahan clinging to a raft in the Atlantic, fisherman Dean Ririe trapped by a boulder in icy water, and hiker Ted Porter falling into a glacial crevasse.

items.title: Crushed by a Boulder: Part 1
items.description: While solo climbing Mt. Goddard, a remote peak in the California Sierra, Gregg Hein's leg is crushed by a boulder, and he's sent careening down the mountain. Barely able to stop his fall, he's now faced with a horrific compound fracture.

items.title: Crushed by a Boulder: Part 2
items.description: After his leg is crushed by a boulder, Gregg Hein is stranded on a high Sierra peak with an infected compound fracture. Knowing he won't be reported missing for days, Gregg attempts to crawl off the mountain and rescue himself.

items.title: Under the Desert Sun
items.description: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

items.title: Filth

items.title: Final Summer

Creating mass destruction with huge glaciers, Nekron and Juliana incur the wrath of Larn, a warrior whose entire village was destroyed by ice. When Nekron's underlings kidnap the beautiful Princess Teegra, Larn sets out to rescue her, assisted by the fierce and enigmatic Darkwolf.

items.title: First Date
items.description: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

items.title: Rich and Delicious

items.title: Magic in the Middle

items.title: Impress Your Kids
items.description: Jessica offers tips to impress both kids and adults with three over-the-top desserts.

items.title: Pretty Shower Goodies
items.description: Jessica offers tips on how to prepare treats for any shower party.

items.title: Desserts You Can Eat With Your Fingers
items.description: Jessica shares how to make desserts that you can eat with your fingers.

items.title: All About Eggs
items.description: Jessica shares the versatility of eggs by baking up some egg-centric desserts like crème brûlée and Lemon Meringue Pie.

items.title: DIY Wedding
items.description: Jessica bakes some DIY recipes that will spice up any wedding.

items.title: Around the World
items.description: Jessica travels around the world with diverse desserts.

items.title: Winter

items.title: Country Fair
items.description: Jessica makes fair-inspired desserts, including classic funnel cake.

items.title: Paris
items.description: Jessica makes classic French desserts.

items.title: Rainbow Galaxy Party
items.description: Jessica bakes delicious desserts with a galaxy-inspired twist.

items.title: Sweet & Salty Desserts
items.description: Jessica creates her favorite sweet and salty treats.

items.title: Floyd Money Mayweather
items.description: Floyd "Money" Mayweather always puts on a show whether he's boxing Manny Pacquiao or MMA star Conor McGregor.

items.title: Flyboys
items.description: Before the United States enters World War I, some American youths volunteer for the French military. Subsequently, they become the first U.S. fighter pilots and form a squadron known as the Lafayette Escadrille, whose exploits and heroism become the stuff of legend.

items.title: Fog Island
items.description: A strange assembly of people gathers together at an island mansion where they begin to suspect one another of murder.

items.title: Followers
items.description: A struggling social media influencer discovers the haunting of the house he shares. The ghost brings him and his friends fame and fortune, but with deadly consequences.

items.title: Smokey Robinson Pt. 2
items.description: Smokey opens up about his life, his journey from addiction to healing and freedom, the toll that years on the road can take, his time with Motown, and even a brief period of retirement that, thankfully, didn't last long.

items.title: Trai Byers
items.description: Getting a glimpse of the man behind the screen: from why he treasures a private life, to his role as a big brother of six, and his heartfelt perspectives on friendship, marriage, manhood and his walk with God.

items.title: Cedric The Entertainer
items.description: Cedric the Entertainer shares what prompted him to write a fictional novel and what's always kept him relevant.

items.title: Thu Has a Normal Day
items.description: A surreal adventure through space and time with multi-course, out-of-this-world gourmet meals brought to life by hostess Thu Tran with a cast of color puppets and celebrity guests.

items.title: PBJ Love
items.description: Things go awry when Grape Jenny falls in love with Peanut Butter Jerry.

items.title: The Emperor's New Dinner
items.description: Thu tries to improvise when King of the World comes to eat at her restaurant.

items.title: Deja Thu
items.description: While having lunch with her father, Thu discovers she is adopted.

items.title: Turkeys
items.description: After winning turkeys in a game show, Thu uses them to cook a unique stuffing.

items.title: Nosferathu
items.description: Vampire Thu offers blood-inspired dishes.

items.title: Poopisode
items.description: A giant rat eats Thu's gingerbread house.

items.title: The Oregano Garden
items.description: The harvests oregano buds with help from her celebrity grandfather.

items.title: Cannibal Holiday
items.description: After a storm, Thu resorts to the only food she has left.

items.title: RV Episode
items.description: The takes a ride in an RV to find a cheap meal.

items.title: Food Zombie
items.description: Thu and her friends encounter a donut-loving zombie.

items.title: Eggcino Man
items.description: The battles a wizard in an egg fight.

items.title: Mirror Diet
items.description: She uses mirrors while preparing food to control the amount she makes.

items.title: Zit Butter
items.description: The creates food using zit butter.

items.title: Sweet Sixteen
items.description: Thu gets a birthday gift from her father.

items.title: Ad Lib Episode
items.description: After eating bad meat, Thu is saved by a tonic.

items.title: Koalisode
items.description: The experiments with vegan recipes.

items.title: Thu & Bu -- Part 2
items.description: The King is unhappy, soon realizing something is wrong after marrying his new bride; he then sets out for revenge.

items.title: Food, Inc.
items.description: Documentary filmmaker Robert Kenner examines how mammoth corporations have taken over all aspects of the food chain in the United States, from the farms where our food is grown to the chain restaurants and supermarkets where it's sold. Narrated by author and activist Eric Schlosser, the film features interviews with average Americans about their dietary habits, commentary from food experts like Michael Pollan and unsettling footage shot inside large-scale animal processing plants.

items.title: Footprints on the Moon
items.description: A woman becomes possessed by the mental screams of an astronaut who was stranded on the surface of the moon.

items.title: Ocean City, Md.
items.description: The best Footvolley action from around the world.

items.description: Episode 23.

items.title: Pro Tour: Stop 3 from Hollywood Beach, Fla.
items.description: The best Footvolley action from around the world.

items.title: Dunigan; Ikpoh
items.description: When people get married, they often promise to do anything for their new spouses. When the women profiled in this docuseries say they'll do anything, they mean anything. "For My Man" tells stories of women who have been arrested -- part of the growing female population in the criminal justice system -- for crimes that they committed in the name of love. The crimes committed range from becoming an inside informant at the DEA for a drug-addicted partner to turning on one's own family members at a jealous boyfriend's request, and even as extreme as going on a killing spree across the Midwest.

items.title: Tiffani Jacobs; Jackie Wortham
items.description: After falling ill, Tiffani Jacobs looks for a man to help her feel normal; Jackie Wortham scorches a path of destruction with a lover who fuels her fire.

items.title: Risking It All
items.description: Brazen armed robberies strike local businesses in a tranquil community in Wisconsin, and detectives find themselves with few clues to help them identify the perpetrators.

items.title: By Any Means Necessary
items.description: A young woman finds solace in a new boyfriend after her father passes away; he ropes her into one of his criminal schemes; she finds herself in the midst of a brutal bloodbath.

items.title: Love and Lies
items.description: Sparks fly when a young mother reunites with her childhood crush, but her new man is guarding a deadly secret that will put her and her son's lives in danger; when she gets caught in the crosshairs, she must choose to save her man or herself.

items.title: Man, or Monster?
items.description: A heartbreak sends a vivacious mother of seven into the arms of a wealthy gentleman; after nearly a decade together, she discovers the monster under the mask, a notorious gang leader being hunted by the FBI and leaving a trail of bodies behind him.

items.title: Dancing with Danger
items.description: After a stint of living on the streets, a teenage girl finally finds security in the arms of her new boyfriend; in return, she'd do anything for him, but when a small favor takes a deadly turn, she loses her friend and her freedom, all for her man.

items.title: Rooted in Revenge
items.description: After a loving mother and spiritualist meets her soul mate, they quickly start a happy life together; when a curse is threatening to destroy their marriage, the devoted wife will do anything to keep her man.

items.title: Silent Lies
items.description: When a young mother starts a family with the man of her dreams, she believes nothing will tear them apart; when her man puts a child's life at risk, she has to choose between protecting the one she loves and listening to her maternal instincts.

items.title: The Sting of Betrayal
items.description: A single mother meets a suave and loving provider, and she looks the other way when she learns the source of his income.

items.title: Drive of Death
items.description: Sparks fly when a woman with a checkered past meets a man with a similar history, but old habits die hard; when her man falls back into a life of crime, she must decide to either follow her man into darkness or to finally do the right thing.

items.title: Forbidden Trails
items.description: Upon their release from prison, ex-convicts Fulton (Charles King) and Howard (Bud Osborne) seek revenge on Marshal Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), the man who put them away. Buck, now retired, is injured in an attack by the men, but he survives and is helped by friends Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) and Tim McCall (Tim McCoy). While Buck recovers, Sandy and Tim, hoping to get proof of Fulton and Howard's guilt, ingratiate themselves with the criminals but soon end up in over their heads.

items.title: Colchester Rapist
items.description: Based on true crimes solved by an elite team of investigators, "Forensic Factor" details the trade secrets used by the world's best sleuths to nab the most elusive criminals, with re-enactments of crucial incidents and firsthand accounts from the experts providing depth and insight.

items.title: Eclectic Murders
items.description: A small town encounters satanic rituals and a savage killer.

items.title: Smiley Face Killer
items.description: A serial killer in Spokane, Wash. murders prostitutes and leaves a bag with a smiley face on the victim's head.

items.title: Million Dollar Murder
items.description: A Texas playboy is murdered and police uncover X-rated photos, shocking videos and an object hidden inside the victim's body.

items.title: Jack
items.description: A killer who leaves messages signed "Jack" terrorizes East Point, Ga.

items.title: Love Bites
items.description: Police discover a murdered teenage girl was involved in a love triangle.

items.title: Fortnite: Battle, Build, Survive!
items.description: Exploring the game "Fortnite," which has more than 125 million active players around the globe.

items.title: Robertsbrook Guesthouse
items.description: Four pairs of Bed and Breakfast owners compete for the best establishment.

items.title: Eden Lodge
items.description: Competitors James and Maria, the parents of Charlotte Church, object to the star rating of Ziggy's Eden Lodge in fabulous Falmouth.

items.title: Dexby Townhouse
items.description: Dexby Townhouse in Cardiff is run by Charlotte Church's parents, James and Maria, who lay on a day of white-water rafting in tight wetsuits and some magic tricks courtesy of Maria's young nephew Elliot.

items.title: Muddifords Court Country House
items.description: It is the last stay of the competition, and it is the turn of newlyweds Pip Easby and Nicky Lesser-Easby, who run Muddifords Court Country House in Devon.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: The group meet one last time to find out exactly how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers, and to air their grievances face to face.

items.title: Gorse Meadow
items.description: The first to host is Mrs. Tee of Gorse Meadow, a four star B&B in the New Forest; her eccentric personality charms the guests on arrival but not everyone's room is up to scratch.

items.title: Castle Hill Guesthouse
items.description: Alistair and Emma Mundell's four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse in sleepy Lynton, Nroth Devon only opened three months ago, and the B&B newbies are desperate to impress with their recently renovated rooms.

items.title: Vidella
items.description: The competition heads to Blackpool and the three-star Vidella, run by best friends and business partners John and Neil, where to pay back Alistair for being a self-confessed Blackpool-hater, the Vidella boys have rigged his room with practical jokes.

items.title: Urban Beach
items.description: For the final visit the group checks into the boutique B&B Urban Beach in Bournemouth, run by local entrepreneur Mark Crib.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: Another fearsome battle draws to a close as the proprietors reconvene to find out how much they have been paid, and Mrs Tee finds out who gave her one point for cleanliness.

items.title: Derwent House
items.description: The first to host are exuberant Jon Shorrock and his wife Julia, who run the four-star B&B Derwent House in West Sussex; whereas the guests take a quiet gander at their rooms, Andy and Julian have concerns over their carpeted bathroom.

items.title: Kirkby Park B&B
items.description: On arrival at Peter and Sharron Sorsky's Kirkby Park B&B in Liverpool, Annette is immediately on her guard after noting the CCTV on the outside of the house.

items.title: Plas Dinas Country House
items.description: Andy and Julian Banner-Price host the competition at their swanky Plas Dinas Country House in Snowdonia, where they've allocated their guests their priciest rooms.

items.title: Hazelwood Farm
items.description: The final B&B of the week, Hazelwood Farm in Crake, Yorkshire is run by Annette, a one-woman whirlwind as she cleans and cooks everything herself in her four-star silver B&B and also provides homemade biscuits in each room.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: It's crunch time for the hoteliers as they return to Hazelwood Farm to find out who has cracked the nut and taken the top prize, and how much they have been paid.

items.title: The Pit Stop
items.description: Melvyn and Sindy kick-start the latest competition with their Morgan sports-car-themed B&B, The Pitstop, in Hertfordshire.

items.title: The Victory at Mersea
items.description: Melvyn has a reason to pick holes in Gill and Peter's bed-and-breakfast when he discovers a fissure in a bedsheet.

items.title: Butterfly Paragliding B&B
items.description: At Butterfly Paragliding B&B, on the Isle of Wight, tension builds from the outset as Wayne and Deborah discover that they will be spending the night in one of Dave's tepees in the garden.

items.title: Braddon Hall
items.description: Deborah Morrison and Wayne Bingham host at their B&B, Braddon Hall in Torquay; Melvyn and Sindy are curious to know if the B&B's chandelier is sturdy enough to do some swinging from and find their four-poster bed a little squeaky.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: The B&B owners gather for one last time - to find out how much they've been paid and reveal the winner.

items.title: The Old Hall Country House
items.description: Simon White and friend and neighbor Shirley Boyle are first to host at The Old Hall Country House, a historic 16th century B&B, in the picturesque village of Madeley in Cheshire.

items.title: Thornley House
items.description: It's day two in the competition and the turn of cat-lover Eileen Finn to cater for her B&B competitors at the four-star Thornley House in Allendale, Northumbria.

items.title: Chy Conyn
items.description: Jessica and Adrian Rashleigh, third to host, hope that they will make up for the lack in size with stunning surroundings at their three-bedroom establishment Chy Conyn in St Ives, on the beautiful Cornish coast.

items.title: The Cavendish
items.description: The guests are initially impressed with the Cavendish in Bournemouth, the 16-bed 'pink palace' from final hosts Tim and Karen, but things go downhill when Simon and Shirley vigorously test their bed - and break it.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: The rivals reconvene for one last time to find out how much they've been paid by their fellow B&B owners, and to sort out their differences; Simon White of Old Hall Country House is stunned by a generous overpayment.

items.title: Godshill Park Farm House
items.description: Mark and Kathy start the competition at their Godshill Park Farmhouse on the Isle of Wight, and their hosting skills immediately come into question as Kathy asks Kalpana and Joseph from The Address to remove their shoes because of the cream carpets.

items.title: Butterfly Guest House
items.description: Some guests at the Butterfly Guest House get worked up when they find two hairs in the bathroom, while others rejoice at finding matching spoons.

items.title: The Address
items.description: The hoteliers descend on Blackpool to check out Kalpana and Joseph's four-star townhouse; a bothersome security light blackens the experience for Ruth.

items.title: Crake Trees Manor
items.description: The group head to the Cumbrian hillsides to stay at Ruth and Mike's Crake Trees Manor; Teresa looks forward to relaxing, but she and her husband Clive are in the Shepherds Hut - outdoor accommodation without water, toilet or electricity.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: Mark and Kathy suffer a blow in the form of an underpayment, and accusations of game-playing shatter group harmony.

items.title: Slimmeria
items.description: There's a fat chance of the weight-loss retreat Slimmeria impressing all the guests with its hefty price tag.

items.title: 38 St Giles
items.description: Jan and William Cheeseman have achieved a Five Star Gold rating at 38 St Giles in Norwich, but the pursuit of perfection has been known to take its toll on this volatile pair.

items.title: Bosvean House
items.description: In Bude, Cornwall, the owners of the four-star Bosvean House have the luxury label of their establishment challenged by guests.

items.title: Ombersley B&B
items.description: Gluten-free bread causes a ruckus between Galia and Ann at the Ombersley Bed & Breakfast; the conveniences are inconveniently located.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: It's payment day, and Diane and Max feel that their rivals have stabbed them in the back; the winners are revealed.

items.title: Silverwood Lodge
items.description: Husband and wife Paul and Flora, the only couple in competition, host from the Silverwood Lodge in Cambridgeshire.

items.title: Seashells Guesthouse
items.description: In Sue's dog-themed Great Yarmouth guesthouse, Nancy brings up the issue of man's best friend sleeping in the beds.

items.title: The Old Court Guesthouse
items.description: In Bath, forthright American ex-banker Nancy Hampson isn't everybody's favorite person, so there's trouble for her from the beginning at The Old Court Guesthouse.

items.title: The Dean
items.description: Jolly Caroline treats guests to a jig, complete with bagpipe accompaniment, at The Dean on the Firth of Forth.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: It's payment day for the latest batch of hoteliers where Nancy is free with her negative comments, and comes under fire from all sides.

items.title: Watersedge Guest House
items.description: Alan and Sylvie of Watersedge Guest House in Barton on Sea, Hampshire vie for the title of best value B&B.

items.title: Nearwater
items.description: Tim and Amelia host the rival B&B owners at their non-star-rated boutique accommodation at Nearwater in Cornwall.

items.title: Roundhouse Hotel
items.description: It's Austrian-born Eva Buschmann's turn to host in her cosmopolitan boutique B&B on the Weymouth seafront, the Roundhouse Hotel.

items.title: Homecliffe Hotel
items.description: Showmen Mike and Danny host their rival B&B owners on day four at their four-star rated guest house, Homecliffe Hotel, in Blackpool.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: Tensions rise as the hoteliers reconvene to find out how much cash they can expect to see; Alan and Sylvie want to know why Tim and Amelia were complaining about their room.

items.title: Centery Farm
items.description: Steve and Beverly Green from Centery Farm in North Devon greet their guests with a warm welcome before making their way around the farmhouse to examine their rooms.

items.title: Little Gloster
items.description: The second visit of the competition is to the Little Gloster on the Isle of Wight, owned and run by 27-year-old professional chef Ben Cooke and assisted by his 81-year-old Danish grandmother Lilian, who has over 50 years' experience in the trade.

items.title: Old Hall House
items.description: It's the third day of the week's competition and Stephen's turn to host; Stephen hasn't opened up to the group yet, much to the chagrin of some of the other guests, who seem to have taken a dislike to him.

items.title: House of Agnes
items.description: The final visit of the competition is to the House of Agnes in Canterbury, run by ex-hotel inspector Sandie De Rougemont.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: On the final day, all the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid.

items.title: The Pavilion
items.description: The Pavilion is a London fashion and rock 'n' roll hotel owned by former pop singer and Lamborghini lover Danny Karne; guests are wowed by the flashy sports car parked out front and impressed by the colorful decor in the themed rooms.

items.title: Fox and Duck
items.description: The Fox and Duck in Therfield, Hertfordshire, is a country inn owned by John Luce and partner Pat Sutton; guests take lessons at the local golf club.

items.title: The New Inn
items.description: The New Inn is in Newbridge-on-Wye and is run by Dave and Debbie Lang; as a keen pig breeder, Dave likes to get his guests in the mood for breakfast with pig ornaments.

items.title: Westleigh Farm
items.description: Upon inspecting the rooms at Robert Kerstin's establishment in Somerset, Danny finds dust, cobwebs and some wrong hangers.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: As the group meets for the last time, the payments are revealed and the winning B&B is announced, but old tensions surface and there are heated exchanges around the table.

items.title: Guest and the City
items.description: Dan and Mardi Leonard welcome the others to their Brighton B&B, Guest and the City, where the guests have mixed reactions to the contemporary décor and stained-glass windows.

items.title: The Farmer's Boy Inn
items.description: Phil Kiernan, entrepreneur and proud owner of the Farmer's Boy Inn in Gloucestershire, welcomes his guests and quickly introduces them to his latest business venture: pies.

items.title: Geanna Hotel Boat
items.description: Alan and Jane welcome their first guests to their brand-new hotel boat, the Geanna; guests enjoy the novelty factor, but Dan and Mardi think that space is too tight.

items.title: Sentry Mead
items.description: Connoisseurs Sarah Langford and Jean-Pierre Kujawa have been running Sentry Mead, their 11-bedroom, five-star B&B for the past six years.

items.title: Payment Day
items.description: It's the final day and the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid; some of the hosts let their emotions get away from them.

items.title: Four Lions
items.description: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

items.title: Durst Girls Gone Wild
items.description: Calli, Kendra, Megan and Sarah Durst are identical quadruplets in their senior year of high school in Minnesota. The show chronicles the trials and tribulations the sisters experience while trying to juggle school with their personal lives. The girls deal with the possibility of splitting up as they decide which colleges to attend. Their mother, Naomi, faces potentially having an empty nest for the first time in many years as the quadruplets' older brother, Travis, is also heading to college.

items.title: FrackNation
items.description: Proponents of the drilling process known as fracking claim that activists and the media have suppressed facts and that the process does not harm the environment.

items.title: Frances Ferguson
items.description: A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

items.title: Frank
items.description: An aspiring musician (Domhnall Gleeson) finds himself way out of his element after he joins a pop group led by an enigmatic figure (Michael Fassbender) who wears a giant fake head.

items.title: Frank and Jesse James
items.description: Author James P. Muehlberger talks about the 1869 killing of a bank cashier in Missouri; this has been considered the first in a long line of robberies by Jesse and Frank James.

items.title: Frank Serpico
items.description: The life of Frank Serpico, the former NYPD officer and whistleblower who exposed rampant corruption in the department in the '60s and '70s. The reclusive Serpico talks about his life, from childhood through retirement.

items.title: Frankenstein '80
items.description: Dr. Frankenstein creates a monster in a secret laboratory. The monster soon breaks loose and starts to kill beautiful women in gory ways.

items.title: Frankenstein vs. The Mummy
items.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein reanimates a sadistic madman while his colleague uncovers the mummy of an evil pharaoh. When the two monsters come face to face, no one is safe from their rampage.

items.title: Frantic
items.description: An audience in a Japanese theater is taken hostage and forced to watch a stage play, but the show soon goes off-script as the creators find themselves entrapped by their own work.

items.title: Freak Show
items.description: Billy Bloom is one-of-a-kind: a fabulous, glitter-bedecked, gender-bending teenager whose razor-sharp wit is matched only by his outrageous, anything-goes fashion sense. When his glamorous mother is forced to send him to live with his straight-laced father, Billy discovers that he's like a diva-out-of-water at his new ultra-conservative high school. Undaunted by the bullies who don't understand him, the fearless Billy sets out to make a big statement in his own inimitable way.

items.title: Freakonomics
items.description: Vignettes explore concepts put forth in a best-selling book, including cheating, bribery, and the importance of names.

items.title: Two-Headed Bearded Dragon Birthday
items.description: The people employed by Todd Ray don't mind being called "freaks." In fact, they might even take it as a compliment. That's because "freak," according to Ray, means the most special, the unique, the magical creatures of the universe. And Ray looks all over the world for such creatures to add to his business, the Venice Beach Freakshow, a carnie-style attraction with an attached museum of strange, wondrous oddities. This reality series follows Ray, his wife, Danielle, and their two kids, Asia and Phoenix, as they operate the Freakshow on the boardwalk of Venice Beach, Calif. The Rays also open their home to their employees, who include Brianna Belladonna ("The Indestructible Woman"); body-modification artist Marcus "The Creature"; Morgue, who specializes in "shock" performances; and Murrugun "The Mystic," a veteran sideshow star known for sword-swallowing and human pincushion acts.

items.title: Swords a Plenty
items.description: Asia attempts to swallow a sword for sword swallower's day; competition heats up among the performers.

items.title: Two-Headed Baby
items.description: "The Lobster Boy" joins Todd on a family trip to obtain a two-headed baby; a performer panics.

items.title: Human Pin Cushion
items.description: Murrugun performs a human pin cushion stunt; Creature tries to reunite with his daughter.

items.title: The Littlest Wedding
items.description: Todd throws a wedding; The Sadhu Hobo drops in for an unexpected visit.

items.title: Strongman Competition
items.description: Todd hosts a "Freakshow" strongman competition; a new performer's story strikes a chord.

items.title: Freaks of Nature
items.description: Jesse the Half Man and Jim the Armless Wonder show off their abilities; Todd must make a difficult decision.

items.title: Freakshow Festival
items.description: Todd wants to ban the word "normal"; "Freaks" travel to Venice to support the cause and hold a parade.

items.title: Freakshow Auditions
items.description: Todd needs to find new performers for the show; a man with stretchy skin makes an appearance.

items.title: Boobzilla Comes to Town
items.description: The Amazing Boobzilla performs at the show; Ali goes through surgery.

items.title: Tattooed Vampiress
items.description: Todd brings in people from around the world for a tattoo event; Creature considers a place to live.

items.title: Electric Women
items.description: Asia wants to expand her electric act by adding a deadly Tesla coil stunt.

items.title: Florida Freakshow
items.description: The show travels to Gibsonton, Fla., to learn about its carnival history.

items.title: Lobster Family Secrets
items.description: Todd learns about Lobster Boy's family history; Asia searches for an apartment; George considers leaving his job.

items.title: Giants, Babes and Box Cutters
items.description: Morgue attempts a bed of box cutters stunt; George searches for love.

items.title: Hobo Wedding
items.description: The gang tries to attend a camp-out, hobo wedding for Digger and Paige; Ali and Matt have marital issues.

items.title: Creature's Daughter
items.description: Creature meets his daughter face-to-face; Todd wants to throw a surprise party for Asia's 21st birthday.

items.title: Breaking World Records
items.description: Space Cowboy tries to break a world record; Danielle invites neighbors to dinner.

items.title: Little Baby Fever
items.description: Zamora the Torture King tests the skeptics; Ali and Matt consider the possibility of parenthood.

items.title: Freakshow Pop-Up
items.description: Todd tries to organize a pop-up show at a suburban mall; Short E. Dangerously visits.

items.title: Control Freaks
items.description: Todd wants everyone to take on new responsibilities in order to expand.

items.title: Freakshow Magic
items.description: Danielle and Asia argue; Todd gets a tour of the Magic Castle; Todd considers incorporating magic into the show.

items.title: Vegas Gets Freaky
items.description: Todd announces that he wants to open a location in Las Vegas.

items.title: The Acid Bath Murderer
items.description: A documentary series focusing on British criminals and serial killers.

items.title: John Christie and 10 Rillington Place
items.description: The tale of John Christie who killed six women and stored them in his home in Rillington Place.

items.title: Harold Jones: The Welsh Child Killer
items.description: In 1921, Harold Jones is too young to hang for murder at age fifteen.

items.title: Derek Bentley - Let Him Have It!
items.description: Although Derek Bentley was hanged for murder, his accomplice was the one who shot the PC during a burglary in 1952.

items.title: Ruth Ellis
items.description: Retracing the story of Ruth Ellis, who shot her lover in 1955. The last woman hanged in the UK, many say her death led to the end of capital punishment.

items.title: Freddie Mercury: The King of Queen
items.description: The story of how a shy boy from Zanzibar became an iconic rock star.

items.description: A look at the life and achievements of Freddie Mercury, the lead singer of Queen, and how a boy from Zanzibar grew to become one of the most iconic figures in music history.

items.title: Curves and Strips
items.description: Modern quilters take traditional designs and apply their own fresh twist in this series co-produced by the Modern Quilt Guild and KS Inc. Productions. Inspiring viewers to create high-impact quilts, the series also features segments on community sewing, including tips and tricks from Modern Quilt Guild members and leaders. Some topics covered include charity quilting events; using templates to create contemporary curves; graphic quilt samplers with bold-colored triangles; whimsical quilted designs; and designs made with die-cut shapes.

items.title: Triangles and Wedges
items.description: Creating graphic quilt samplers with bold-colored triangles; organizing quilting retreats that refuel creative energy; creating versatile blocks with 10-degree triangles.

items.title: Finding Precision
items.description: Building quilts with foundation piecing; multicolored binding to match the piecing in the quilt.

items.title: Sewing Creatures
items.description: Combining colorful shapes to create fish faces; leading a local quilt guild; sewing a regal lion using English paper piecing.

items.title: Piecing
items.description: Strip piecing; creating pieced modern letters and making a whole alphabet with just three blocks; walking foot curves.

items.title: Theory
items.description: Color schemes using basic color theory; making a plan to use pressing for a professional finish; various ways to mark fabric in the machine.

items.title: Friends With Kids
items.description: In the wake of their friends' marriages and eventual offspring, longtime pals Julie (Jennifer Westfeldt) and Jason (Adam Scott) decide to have a child together without becoming a couple. By becoming "time-share" parents, they reason, they can experience the joys of parenthood without significantly curbing their personal freedom. However, when Julie and Jason both become involved with others, they discover that they secretly harbor romantic feelings for each other.

items.title: Frightmare
items.description: College movie buffs (Luca Bercovici, Jennifer Starrett) steal a horror-film star's (Ferdinand Mayne) corpse, and a medium brings him back.

items.title: From Darkness
items.description: Park ranger Angelica enlists the help of her ex, Viktor, a dog handler, to search for a missing woman in a dangerous nature reserve in Sweden.

items.title: Frostbiter

items.title: Frozen North -- Sir Hubert's Forgotten Submarine Expedition
items.description: Oceanographer Hans Fricke searches for the wreck of Nautilus, the World War I submarine used by Hubert Wilkins on an expedition to the North Pole.

items.title: Führerbunker: Adolf Hitler's Final Days
items.description: Nazi Germany leader Adolf Hitler, who unleashed the horrors of World War II and caused his country to crumble, spends his final days in an underground bunker as Soviet Red Army forces fight their way into Berlin in April 1945.

items.title: Joey Goes Hunting
items.description: Joey and Pete go hunting, but what they find is trouble when an escaped criminal crosses their path.

items.title: Killer Stallion
items.description: After he is taken into custody following a police fight, troubled city orphan Joey finds new purpose in his life when he moves to the Broken Wheel Ranch. Jim Newton, a recent widower, owns the ranch, and adopts Joey, also giving the boy a beautiful black horse named Fury. The horse frequently saves the day when visitors get into trouble on the ranch.

items.title: The Horse Coper
items.description: Jim must sell some horses or lose the ranch, but he refuses to sell Fury, leading Piggott to trick him onto free government land with the horse, allowing Piggott to claim the stallion.

items.title: Scorched Earth
items.description: During a drought, Joey becomes a junior ranger and tries to protect a couple of hunters from starting a forest fire.

items.title: Joey's Dame Trouble
items.description: Fury keeps running off to be with a white mare; Joey gets in trouble when he tries to solve the relationship.

items.title: Joey and the Gypsies
items.description: Fury is missing.

items.title: Joey's Father
items.description: A man claiming to be Joey's father shows up at the ranch.

items.title: Joey Saves the Day
items.description: A stranger claims to be Joey's father, and threatens to take the boy away from Jim and Fury.

items.title: The 4-H Story
items.description: Joey and Frankie Watson both enter lambs in the 4-H Club Livestock Show.

items.title: Junior Rodeo
items.description: At a junior rodeo, a competitor underhandedly switches horses with Joey.

items.title: Ghost Town
items.description: Bank robbers hide their ill-gotten gains at a local ghost town.

items.title: The Hobo
items.description: A man on the run from the law takes a job at the ranch, but when he's discovered he must decide whether to flee or stay and help Fury.

items.title: Tungsten Queen
items.description: Joey and Hank go after some claim jumpers at a local tungsten mine. Jim Newton: Peter Graves.

items.title: Joey Sees It Through
items.description: The spoiled daughter of a deceased veteran comes to stay with the Newtons.

items.title: Survivors Of A Lost Island
items.description: Twenty years after a terrible war destroyed civilization, a boy named Conan and his new friend Lana set out to stop shadowy operatives from gaining control of what's left of the world.

items.title: The Journey
items.description: Conan travels by plane and sea as he tries to rescue Lana from the clutches of Industria soldiers.

items.title: The First Friend
items.description: Conan arrives on a small island and meets Jimsy, a boy who has been living in the wild; as Conan gets to know his new friend, the ship Barracuda offers an opportunity to finally reach Industria.

items.title: The Barracuda
items.description: Conan and Jimsy attempt to stow away aboard the Barracuda, but are caught and punished by the ship's captain Dyce; they get to work as the ship heads for Industria.

items.title: Dyce's Rebellion
items.description: Conan and Lana are finally reunited but the villainous Lepka continues to pursue them; shocked by Lepka's brutality, Captain Dyce's allegiances begin to shift.

items.title: Chase
items.description: Dyce leaves Conan trapped in an Industria holding cell and escapes with Lana to the Barracuda; he finds cover in a dense fog but Lepka is close behind.

items.title: Escape
items.description: With Lepka's gunboat in pursuit, Lana uses a lifeboat to rescue Conan from the open sea.

items.title: The Salvage Ship
items.description: As they navigate a vast desert, Conan and Lana are discovered by a salvage ship captain named Patch.

items.title: Doctor Lao
items.description: Earthquakes rattle Industria as Lepka continues his search for Lana's grandfather Dr. Lao.

items.title: Flight
items.description: Conan, Lana, and Dr. Lao take to the skies in Dr. Lao's flying machine.

items.title: Core Block
items.description: Trapped by Lepka, Lana and Dr. Lao must navigate Industria's Core Block in search of machine parts.

items.title: High Harbor
items.description: Conan, Jimsy, and Lana reunite with Dyce on the Barracuda; meanwhile Dr. Lao must return to Industria to help save its residents.

items.title: A Day on the Island
items.description: Conan, Jimsy, and Lana explore High Harbor and meet the villagers but Jimsy can't help but get into mischief.

items.title: Wasteland
items.description: Conan and Jimsy must catch a wild pig in order to redeem themselves with Orlo, the leader of a local gang.

items.title: Their Hut
items.description: Lana has a nightmarish vision that Dr. Lao's flying machine is engulfed in flames and fears an attack; Conan does his best to try and ease her worries.

items.title: Battle
items.description: When Industria soldiers reach High Harbor, the villagers must band together to defend their home.

items.title: Gunboat
items.description: Conan and Lana try to evade Industria's soldiers, but Lana is captured.

items.title: Giant Tsunami
items.description: As the fight for High Harbor continues, Lana fears the arrival of another earthquake.

items.title: To Industria Again
items.description: In the wake of the tsunami, the villagers allow the Industria soldiers to join their community.

items.title: The Citizens Underground
items.description: Conan is captured; Lana, Dyce, and Jimsy navigate Industria's underground barracks and learn more about life during Lepka's rule.

items.title: Rescue
items.description: Conan rushes to stop Lepka from flooding the underground community while Lana contemplates how she can help save the residents.

items.title: Solar Tower
items.description: Lepka attempts to escape with his hostage Lana in tow, but Conan won't give up on his friend.

items.title: Gigant
items.description: As earthquakes rattle Industria, its residents fear that another cataclysm will occur; Lepka seeks to revive the massive warplane, Gigant, to make the world his own.

items.title: The End of Industria
items.description: As Lepka attacks, Conan infiltrates Gigant to try and stop him.

items.title: Finale
items.description: The people of High Harbor rejoice as Dyce and Jimsy are finally rescued.

items.title: Industria
items.description: Twenty years after a terrible war destroyed civilization, a boy named Conan and his new friend Lana set out to stop shadowy operatives from gaining control of what's left of the world.

items.title: Cyber Warfare
items.description: The world is entering a new era of warfare, with cyber and autonomous weapons taking center stage. These technologies are making militaries faster, smarter, more efficient. But if unchecked, they threaten to destabilize the world.

items.title: The New Beginning

items.title: Galentine's Day Nightmare
items.description: A woman's life becomes a living nightmare when she becomes the prime suspect in her boss's murder.

items.title: Gallowwalkers
items.description: Aman (Wesley Snipes) is cursed in the womb, and as an adult, anyone he kills rises as the walking dead. Being relentlessly pursued, the gunfighter enlists the aid of a young warrior to confront the zombies.

items.title: The Battle Begins...
items.description: There really is such a thing as organized arm wrestling tournaments. "Game of Arms" takes viewers a long way from the days of duels at the end of the bar after a night of drinking. The series follows the members of arm wrestling clubs in such cities as Erie, Pa., Kansas City, Kan., Sacramento, Calif., Baton Rouge, La., and New York, as they hit the road to compete for money, personal pride, and the reputation of their clubs. Episodes feature organized regional matches -- interspersed with scenes of arm wrestlers in more personal settings -- leading to a winner-take-all tournament involving the entire cast in the finale.

items.title: Southern Inhospitality
items.description: Cobra Rhodes joins the Kansas City team and battles Louisiana.

items.title: The Cold War
items.description: Fathers compete when the Erie team battles California Arm Benders.

items.title: Bloodlines
items.description: Rob Bigwood trains for a match against Chop Bertrand.

items.title: Welcome to the Slaughterhouse
items.description: Nick Zinna and Mike Selearis compete when Kansas City faces New York.

items.title: End of the Line

items.title: Playing Hurt
items.description: Mike Selearis faces Bart Wood with a broken hand; Travis reflects on earning money through arm wrestling.

items.title: War Horses
items.description: Allen and Craig's families are affected by arm wrestling in different ways; Kenny and Chop face interventions.

items.title: Battle for the Belt
items.description: Don and Travis put a championship belt on the line; Cobra considers how losing to Bart would influence his career.

items.title: Final Showdown
items.description: The arm wrestlers compete in a Los Angeles tournament.

items.description: Vance teams with Jules to play in a basketball championship duel.

items.title: Gamera 2: Attack of the Legion

items.title: Gangster Land
items.description: Al Capone recruits Machine Gun Jack McGurn to help protect his criminal empire in the 1920s Chicago. McGurn soon rises through the ranks of the Italian mob, igniting the most brutal gang war the country has ever seen.

items.title: The Fadeaway
items.description: The comic/folk duo Riki Lindhome and Kate Micucci hit prime time with their act in this scripted series for IFC. It follows hard-working underdogs trying to make their mark in comedy while muddling through messy dating scenarios, and doing so by performing one satirical (and often quite saucy) song after another. Nothing stops the ukulele- and guitar-wielding twosome from singing about life's unspoken truths, despite it leaving them detached from their peers. The series is titled after Lindhome and Micucci's band name, inspired by "two famous rock 'n' roll second bananas," Art Garfunkel and John Oates.

items.title: Rule 34
items.description: Riki and Kate find out there is a porn star version of their musical act; Garfinger and Butts.

items.title: Speechless
items.description: Riki and Kate try an experiment by going on dates without talking to see if men are attracted to women who don't speak.

items.title: Road Warriors
items.description: Riki and Kate have to deal with a heckler and a calculator magician at their 1000th show.

items.title: Hair Swap
items.description: Riki and Kate want to see how the world is different for blondes and brunettes so they trade hair colors.

items.title: Third Member
items.description: A bitter ex-bandmate turned movie star visits Riki and Kate; a bandaversary celebration; getting weed cards.

items.title: Eggs
items.description: Riki attends a baby sprinkle and afterward gets examined by a fertility doctor; Kate finds out she has Peter Pan Syndrome.

items.title: Maturity
items.description: Riki's libido increases so she seeks out her ex-boyfriend.

items.description: This last year has been unlike any other: COVID, lockdowns, and for Gary, it has also included a divorce and family insanity unlike any other; up until now, Gary hasn't been able to speak about what really happened.

items.title: Cozy Foods
items.description: Lan explains the science behind braising meat and also gives us reasons to overcook our vegetables.

items.title: The 3.5
items.description: Husband and wife team Ralph and Kelly Biase own one of the best "resto-mod" shops in the business.

items.title: Pinky
items.description: A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom-built engine, new paint, new wheels and tires.

items.title: Benzilla
items.description: A slow, outdated 1959 Mercedes-Benz 180 D is modified with a bargain budget to include new wheels and an American V8 muscle motor.

items.title: The Track T
items.description: A 1927 Ford Track T Roadster is incomplete and needs Titan Restoration's finishing touch with its flathead V8 engine.

items.title: Comic-Con
items.description: Kevin Smith ("Comic Book Men," "Clerks") and Greg Grunberg ("Heroes," "Star Wars: The Force Awakens") share their deep passion for all things pop culture by taking a timely look at the genre through a fanboy lens. The 30-minute show features discussions, clips, celebrity interviews and out-of-the-studio segments.

items.title: Nathon Fillion; Alan Tudyk; J.J. Abrams
items.description: Greg and Kevin grill Nathan Fillion and Alan Tudyk on their current and past projects; they interview J.J. Abrams at Universal Studios.

items.title: Jeph Loeb; Charlie Cox
items.description: Jeph Loeb discusses overseeing Marvel's television properties; Kevin and Charlie Cox discuss "Daredevil."

items.title: Jim Lee; Rhett Reese; Paul Wernick
items.description: Kevin and Greg talk with the writers of "Deadpool"; Kevin interviews DC co-publisher Jim Lee about "Suicide Squad" and DC's "Rebirth."

items.title: Adam Savage; The Flash; Star Trek 50th
items.description: Greg builds a prop replica with Adam Savage; Greg and Kevin discuss the 50th anniversary of "Star Trek"; Kevin directs The Flash.

items.title: Antoine Fuqua; DC Toys; Blizzard Entertainment
items.description: Kevin takes a tour of DC Direct toys; Tiffany explores video games at Blizzard Entertainment; Greg and Kevin talk to Antoine Fuqua.

items.title: Bryan Cranston; Stranger Things; McFarlane Toys
items.description: Greg visits Bryan Cranston then joins Tiffany for a chat with the kids from "Stranger Things;" Tiffany takes a tour of McFarlane Toys.

items.title: Mike Colter; Simone Missick; Lucasfilm; Valiant Comics
items.description: Greg and Kevin interview Mike Colter and Simone Missick from "Luke Cage"; Tiffany visits the set of Valiant's new project while Kevin tours Lucasfilm.

items.title: Robert Kirkman; David Alpert; Greg Nicotero; Kim Dickens
items.description: Greg and Kevin talk to the creative minds behind "The Walking Dead;" Tiffany and Greg talk with Kim Dickens about "Fear the Walking Dead."

items.title: Generation Z
items.description: When an army truck crashes outside a care home and infects the residents, four teenage friends must deal with the deadly consequences while also coping with their family and relationship problems.

items.title: Generation Z
items.description: Charlie and Kelly deal with Kelly's nan, as Kelly battles with her conflicting feelings; Steff heads off on a dangerous quest with Finn; Cecily incites the hungry OAP horde, while Frank gets lost, and Jason is attacked.

items.title: George Harrison: All Things Pass
items.description: Charting the life of George Harrison from his rise to fame as lead guitarist of The Beatles to him being brutally stabbed and his tragic struggle with cancer.

items.title: George Michael: Got to Have Faith
