items.description: Having fun with HobbyKidsTV and HobbyKids adventures.

items.title: Minecraft Survival!
items.description: Having fun with HobbyKidsTV and HobbyKids adventures.

items.title: Roblox Piggy!
items.description: Having fun with HobbyKidsTV and HobbyKids adventures.

items.title: Halloween
items.description: Chef Kimberly Lallouz demonstrates fun and accessible meals for various holidays.

items.title: Tiana Makes Sweet Potato Gnocchi And More...
items.description: Bon Appétit presents a holiday recipe marathon.

items.title: $207 vs $16 French Toast: Pro Chef & Home Cook Swap Ingredients And More...
items.description: Join Bon Appétit for a holiday recipe marathon.

items.title: Holiday Highlights Marathon: Cookies
items.description: Join Bon Appétit for a holiday recipe marathon.

items.title: Holiday Home Invasion
items.description: A team of decorators, carpenters and chefs transforms a home for the holidays.

items.title: AD: Bespoke: Holiday Special #2 (Rockefeller Center) [FAST TV] and More...
Royal Florist Philippa Craddock's Christmas Wreath Making Tutorial and More...
AD: Bespoke: Holiday Special #1 (Kris Jenner) [FAST TV] And More...
Hollow Gate
items.description: Four teenagers go to a Halloween party hosted by a dog owner with mayhem on his mind.

items.title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
items.description: Since first donning a tattered fedora and a glove of eviscerating blades in 1984, Robert Englund has become a beloved horror icon. His portrayal of Freddy Krueger is without doubt a moment as visceral to the horror genre as Chaney's werewolf or Karloff's groundbreaking realization of Frankenstein's monster. However, few realize the depths of Englund's true power as a character actor away from the latex mask and iconic red and green jumper.

items.title: Meet the Smiths
items.description: Some of the most thrilling weapons action sequences from TV and movies are put to the test, with weapons expert Larry Zanoff breaking down some of the most explosive action scenes in Hollywood history.

items.title: Nightmare on Hollywood Weapons
items.description: Terry wants to test the best way to kill a zombie, just in case he ever ends up in a zombie apocalypse.

items.title: All for One!
items.description: Terry travels back in time to see if he has what it takes to be a musketeer.

items.title: RED-ish
items.description: Terry takes himself out of retirement to test some scenes from "RED" that will be extremely dangerous.

items.title: MacSchappert
items.description: Larry and Terry test several scenes from MacGyver.

items.title: Terry's Lethal Weapon
items.description: Terry and Larry tackle the epic Lethal Weapon series testing 4 different scenes. Can a Surfboard act as a projectile going through a car windshield and killing the bad guy?

items.title: Jean Claude Van Schappert
items.description: Terry enters the world of slo-mo and explosions trying to imitate Jean-Claude in "Hard Target." Terry and Larry will be testing five scenes from the "Hard Target" films.

items.title: Bond-ing with Larry
items.description: Who is the greatest international action hero of all time, Terry Schappert? No. Terry and Larry get to test some scenes from James Bond films and other great action heroes.

items.title: Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River
items.description: Everybody loves a great western except Larry; Terry gets Larry to test more scenes from classic western movies.

items.title: Down Mexico Way
items.description: Don't mess with organized crime. The dynamic duo tackles scenes from the Mexico cartel series Queen of the South, but take a pit stop at the restroom to test a scene from The Foreigner with Jackie Chan.

items.title: Terry Alone at Home
items.description: Who left Terry Home Alone! Larry did. Terry and Larry test several scenes from the classic film series Home Alone.

items.title: Home at Last: Runway/Closet + Open Doors
items.description: Join Tan France and Architectural Digest for a new series, Home At Last.

items.title: Inside Tan France's Dream Home in Salt Lake City
items.description: Tan and Rob France give a tour of their new home in Salt Lake City; Tan and Rob have built a grand Tudor-style home that blends South Asian, English and American interior touches with the help of The Fox Group.

items.title: Tan France's Dream Kitchen
items.description: Join Tan France and Architectural Digest for a new series, Home At Last.

items.title: Home Sweet Home
items.description: When Gwen goes broke, she has to move back into her abandoned childhood home. However, she discovers that someone else is already living in the remote house, and she must fight to protect the only thing she has left -- her life.

items.title: Home Town Story
items.description: A newspaper editor (Jeffrey Lynn) blasts big business, then needs a big-business man's (Donald Crisp) help.

items.title: DIY Coat Rack
items.description: Interior Designer Claire Zinnecker shows quick and easy decorating projects for personalizing your home

items.title: DIY Dog Bed
items.description: If you’re a dog owner and lover like Claire, you know how impossible it is to find an affordable and tasteful dog bed! In today’s “HomeWorks” episode, Claire offers up an inexpensive DIY solution that you can still leave out when guest come over!

items.title: Wall Art Three Ways
items.description: Wall art comes in many shapes and sizes! In the latest "HomeWorks" episode, Claire demonstrates three ways to elevate her everyday objects into art.

items.title: How-To Make a Lamp
items.description: Learn how to make a decorative lamp from scratch in this week's "HomeWorks" episode! Ever thought a copper pipe could turn into a chic table lamp? Neither did we. Watch and find out how to make it yourself!

items.title: DIY Small Bathroom Organizer
items.description: Small bathrooms can be difficult to organize. Learn how to make a DIY Hanging Bathroom Organizer for your accessories that both maximizes space and time in the morning!

items.title: Copper Light Cover
items.description: A chic hack for turning a basic light switch into a rose gold work of art! Claire Zinnecker shows you how to achieve the look with a copper sheet in this week's episode of "HomeWorks."

items.title: Living Room Makeover for Summer
items.description: Claire Zinnecker, host of Kin's original series, "HomeWorks," shows you how to pull off a living room makeover that's summer-proof and totally within reach!

items.title: How To Make Paper Flower Garlands
items.description: Claire Zinnecker shows you how to make boho chic paper flower garlands perfect for hanging above your bed. Try this one with the help of a friend and a bottle of wine.

items.title: DIY Hanging Planter
items.description: Claire Zinnecker builds a hanging planter perfect for displaying vibrant flowers to brighten your space. Bring the fresh smells of your flower garden indoors with this easy DIY project!

items.title: How To Make Marbled Flower Pots
items.description: This week on "HomeWorks", Claire Zinnecker uses a fun marbling technique to turn an ordinary flower pot from drab to fab! Check out this tutorial and learn how easy it is to marble vases using only a hand full of materials.

items.title: Tiny House Tour
items.description: This week on "HomeWorks", Claire Zinnecker gives us an insider look at her chic home and tips on how to make the most out of any smaller space!

items.title: Homebound
items.description: A trip to the countryside turns frightening for a father and his new fiancée when they arrive to find his ex-wife missing and the kids acting strange.

items.title: Homeless to Harvard: The Liz Murray Story
items.description: Living on the streets, a teenager (Thora Birch) returns to high school, earns her diploma and gets a college scholarship.

items.title: A Salute to Operation Song
items.description: In this first-of-its-kind celebration of community leaders, celebrities return to their hometown to spotlight unsung heroes dedicated to important community initiatives and to raise awareness for their organizations. With the help of a passionate local design team, a major makeover is in store to support each charity's mission, culminating in a jaw-dropping, feel-good reveal.

items.title: A Celebration of Covenant House
items.description: International model Nicole Williams English heads to the Bronx to celebrate Covenant House, a neighborhood institution that opens its doors to young people experiencing homelessness, providing shelter, food, and health and wellness services.

items.title: The Imagination Library's Magical Makeover
items.description: One of Dolly Parton's most heartfelt legacies is the Imagination Library, sparking a love of reading in children across the globe. Now, actress and author Danica McKellar and designer Julie Couch give the headquarters a heartwarming makeover.

items.title: A Tribute to The Brett Boyer Foundation
items.description: In Franklin, Tennessee, family is at the heart of everything-and it's also at the core of The Brett Boyer Foundation's mission. Nashville designer Julie Couch transforms their headquarters to radiate the same joy and hope they bring to so many.

items.title: Home of a Design Icon: The Country Home & Gardens of Bunny Williams
items.description: A look inside the world's most extraordinary private residences, from storied historic estates to ingenious modern retreats. Join legendary designers, visionary artists, and passionate collectors as they reveal the deeply personal narratives woven into their four walls. Whether it's a meticulous restoration of a landmark or the transformation of a humble boat shed, this series explores the intersection of heritage, architecture, and the curated objects that turn a house into a soulful haven. It is a masterful celebration of the creative spirit, proving that every home has a story and every room is a chapter of a life well-lived.

items.title: An English-Inspired Home With a Farm in New Jersey
items.description: In New Jersey, antique enthusiast Caley Svensson has transformed a former Italian-Tuscany style residence into an English countryside haven; it is a charming reimagining of suburban acreage where history and family life coexist.

items.title: A Converted Boathouse Becomes a Beautiful Home on Nantucket
items.description: Step inside designer Gary McBournie and Bill Richards's Nantucket oceanside escape; see the boat shed transformed into a breezy summer sanctuary perfect for entertaining; every corner is infused with a sophisticated yet delightful nautical flair.

items.title: Collected Chic: Genevieve Gorder's NYC Apartment
items.description: Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

items.title: Caroline Winkler's Cozy Space in DC
items.description: Step inside the charming 600-square-foot Washington, D.C., apartment of interior design YouTuber Caroline Winkler; bathed in natural light, every corner reflects a keen eye for detail and a passion for making a house entirely one's own.

items.title: London Living With a Fashion Icon
items.description: Step inside the London home of fashion designer Wiggy Hindmarch, a sanctuary celebrated for its use of print, texture and color; every room acts as a playful narrative, blending the property's storied history with Wiggy's own expressive flair.

items.title: DIY-Inspired Brooklyn Townhome
items.description: Travel to the Brooklyn townhouse of hair & makeup artist and interior designer Kim White; using her signature flair and a penchant for high-end DIY, Kim has transformed her space into a masterclass in colorful, small-scale living.

items.title: Honeymoon
items.description: A honeymooning bride (Rose Leslie) goes sleepwalking into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns she looks the same, but something about her is frighteningly different.

items.title: Horns
items.description: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

items.title: Hostel
items.description: Best friends Josh (Derek Richardson) and Paxton (Jay Hernandez) decide to spend the summer after college graduation on an all-out backpacking trip across Europe. While stopping in Amsterdam to indulge their tastes for drugs and sex, they meet Oli (Eythor Gudjonsson), a like-minded traveler from Iceland. When the three bachelors set off to investigate enticing rumors of a Slovakian hostel in a city populated by lusty women, they find themselves drawn unwittingly into a deadly game.

items.title: Hostel Part II
items.description: Beth (Lauren German), Lorna (Heather Matarazzo) and Whitney (Bijou Phillips), three young American women traveling abroad in Rome, decide to take a weekend excursion. Lured from their intended destination by a beautiful acquaintance (Vera Jordanova), the women anticipate a stay at a luxurious spa. Instead, they become pawns in a grisly game designed to entertain wealthy deviants from around the world.

items.title: Hostile
items.description: A survivor of a worldwide epidemic must fight for her life when she encounters a mysterious creature in an apocalyptic wasteland.

items.title: Hot Chocolate Holiday
items.description: A coffee shop owner finds herself in competition with the handsome owner of a dessert shop whose hot chocolate tastes just like her grandmother's secret recipe.

items.title: Hot Potato
items.description: A karate expert (Jim Kelly) and two cohorts must save a senator's kidnapped daughter.

items.title: Juniper Hill Inn, Part One
items.description: Chef Gordon Ramsay is expanding his brand into another branch of the service industry in this new show. Along with a team of hospitality experts, Ramsay will travel the country applying his high standards to struggling hotels, motels, and bed and breakfasts in an effort to get the owners and staff to turn their establishments around. Ramsay's signature no-holds-barred style will make it clear to those he coaches that there is no place for dirty rooms or incompetent staff if one hopes to remain in business.

items.title: Cambridge Hotel
items.description: Ramsay tries to help the inexperienced owners of The Cambridge Hotel turn their business around.

items.title: Keating Hotel
items.description: Ramsay visits The Keating Hotel in San Diego in hope of helping the owner turn the business around.

items.title: River Rock Inn
items.description: Ramsay visits Milford, Pa., to check out the River Rock Inn, which is in desperate need of cleaning and repairs.

items.title: Roosevelt Inn
items.description: Ramsay visits the Roosevelt Inn and learns the owner is more interested in preparing for murder mystery nights than updating musty decor.

items.title: Meson De Mesilla
items.description: Ramsay visits Las Cruces, N.M., luxury hotel Meson De Mesilla, where the owner seems more interested in her singing career, than managing the business.

items.title: Monticello Hotel
items.description: Gordon helps the owner of the Hotel Monticello in Longview, Wash., get back on track both professionally and personally.

items.title: Applegate River Lodge
items.description: Ramsay travels to Oregon to help a contentious divorced couple focus on fixing issues with their business, the Applegate River Lodge.

items.title: Hotel Chester
items.description: Ramsay heads to Starkville, Miss., to help David and Sukie revamp their formerly thriving business, Hotel Chester.

items.title: Calumet Inn
items.description: Gordon travels to Pipestone, Minn., to help two sisters save their once-historic hotel, the Calumet Inn.

items.title: Four Seasons Inn
items.description: Gordon Ramsay goes to Vermont in hope of transforming the dog-friendly Four Seasons Inn -- which proves to not share any likeness to the popular luxury chain.

items.title: Curtis House
items.description: Gordon travels to Woodbury, Conn., to help a pair of siblings whose difficult relationship is threatening to bring down their inn, the Curtis House.

items.title: Murphy's Hotel
items.description: Gordon heads to Northern California where he works to get the owners of Murphy's Hotel to focus on the guests' experience in order to keep the establishment in business.

items.title: Angler's Lodge
items.description: Gordon visits a lodge in Idaho that was built by the owner's own hands before the entrepreneur lost his passion due to a family tragedy.

items.title: Vienna Inn
items.description: Ramsay helps the married owners of a Southbridge, Mass., inn modeled after an historic Austrian bed and breakfast update their business.

items.title: Town's Inn, Part 1
items.description: A West Virginia inn owner hoards personal items throughout the premises and displays some of the worst practices Gordon has ever seen.

items.title: Town's Inn, Part 2
items.description: In Harper's Ferry, W.V., Gordon tackles one of his biggest personal and hotel makeovers when he tries to help an owner who is stuck in the past.

items.title: Lakeview Hotel
items.description: Gordon urges the owners of a hotel, restaurant and ice cream parlor in Washington to look more closely at their business and relationships and get involved with the community.

items.title: Brick Hotel
items.description: Gordon attempts to get the owner of a hotel and event space in Newtown, Pa., to address various issues with the business.

items.title: Beachfront Inn & Inlet
items.description: The young owner of a Florida beachfront inn struggles to keep control of his business and repay a loan from his brother.

items.title: Landoll's Mohican Castle
items.description: Gordon encourages the son of a Loudonville, Ohio, hotel owner to learn the business and take the reins from his mother; the hotel hosts a fairy-tale wedding.

items.title: Jeremy Lee Delivers a Festive Meringue Masterclass and More...
Freak Accidents
items.description: Scientist Francesca Garigue, engineer Dan Dicaire and special-effects engineer Brendan Callaghan test potential home hazards in a real house. Blazing kitchen fires, erupting vacuum cleaners and bursting helium tanks are all in a day's work. In each episode, Garigue, Dicaire and Callaghan re-create some of the most dangerous home hazards, using state of the art technology and scientific experiments. The three hosts set out to discover just how much a house can endure when human error results in disaster.

items.title: Cleanliness
items.description: Killer laundry; explosive household cleaning.

items.title: Party Peril
items.description: The House Hazards team inspects home entertainment.

items.title: Reckless Abandon
items.description: Crash test dummies demonstrate the science behind hidden dangers.

items.title: Security Overload
items.description: Sounding the alarm on things designed to protect homes.

items.title: Full Fashion Frenzy
items.description: Kenyatta Jones, an Atlanta-based fashion designer who specializes in designing clothes for plus-size women, is the CEO of clothing boutique Bella René, named after her mother and main investor. Jones and her team, which includes her two close friends from college and an assistant with attitude, go to great lengths to expand the brand, but mishaps and in-house bickering hinder the dream. The ultimate test comes when the team competes for recognition in one of the world's top cities for fashion: New York.

items.title: Who's the B in the Skinny Jeans
items.description: Egos flare when Kenyatta hires a new Bella Rene team member; Kendra and Kelli rumble at the spring lookbook photo shoot and Kenyatta reveals her high-fashion line.

items.title: Chubby Chasers
items.description: Team Bella Rene recruits plus-size models; Kenyatta and the girls stake out Phil at a nightclub.

items.title: Junk in the Trunk Show
items.description: Mama Rene puts a stop on spending; Sherlynda finds ways to rock the high-fashion fall line.

items.title: Drama at the Big Show
items.description: Kenyatta debuts Bella Rene's high-fashion fall line; Sherlynda takes aim at Kendra's job.

items.title: Fat Chance in New York
items.description: Kenyatta looks to impress NYC's plus-size fashion world; Kendra is demoted.

items.title: House of Dolls
items.description: A family reunion turns deadly when three estranged sisters are summoned by their father to fulfill his last wishes and collect an inheritance. However, a maniac wielding two knives arrives with his own plans.

items.title: House on Haunted Hill
items.description: Rich oddball Frederick Loren has a proposal for five guests at a possibly haunted mansion: show up, survive a night filled with scares and receive $10,000 each. The guest of honor is Loren's estranged wife, Annabelle, who, with her secret lover, Dr. Trent, has concocted her own scheme to scare Loren's associate, Nora Manning, into shooting the potentially crazy millionaire. However, more spooks and shocks throw a wrench into the plan.

items.title: Housebound
items.description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

items.title: Axes, Messenger Bags; Fast-Rescue Boats
items.description: After watching this series you may never look at ordinary objects in the same way again. A tube of toothpaste? Car tires? Tea bags? A lot of technology goes into even the simplest of consumer goods, and this program offers viewers a glimpse at just what that entails.

items.title: Wensleydale Cheese; Paintbrushes; Eucalyptus Oil; Plastic Wrap
items.description: Churning out Wensleydale cheese; turning pig hair into the world's finest paintbrushes; distilling aromatic oils from the koala's favorite food.

items.title: The Tesla; Horse-Hair Fabrics; Pool Cleaners
items.description: Building the 700 horsepower Tesla Model S; turning horses' tails into fine fabrics; cleaning the largest swimming pools in the world.

items.title: Snails Cutlery Fishing Kayaks
items.description: Feeding France's appetite for snails; turning slabs of steel into shiny cutlery; crafting a kayak that is paddled by foot.

items.title: Emergency Bridges, Marker Pens
items.description: Building emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank; a marker pen that never fades; a 200 mph super bike.

items.title: Crystal Glass; Flat Screen Tvs; Deepest Pool; Ketchup
items.description: A look into how the world's finest crystal wine glasses are made; how the world's slimmest TVs are made; how the world's deepest swimming pool is heated; how a million bottles a day of the world's favorite ketchup are filled.

items.title: Pulverizers: Bomber Jackets; Beer
items.description: Jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks; stitching the historic airman's bomber; brewing the oldest beer in the Western World.

items.title: Sydney Opera House, Handsaws
items.description: Sydney Opera House; turning Sheffield steel into a carpenter's handsaw; making a microphone that can pick up a whisper; steering a safe course through a frozen river.

items.title: Assassins Greed
items.description: Profiles the work of police officers who are tasked with investigating some of the toughest murder cases in criminal history.

items.title: Til Death Do Us Part
items.description: Investigators track data in the murder of a pregnant woman.

items.title: Fire and Ice
items.description: An unlikely informant holds the key to justice when 59-year-old antique dealer, Michael Griffiths, is targeted and brutally killed in his home.

items.title: Body in the Ditch
items.description: A computer at Vogue magazine holds the key to identifying Julie Clayton, an ex-cult member who is assaulted and murdered upon leaving.

items.title: Canal Murders
items.description: It takes 18 years to identify Melissa Halstead after her torso is found in a Rotterdam canal, but detectives never stop working to catch her killer.

items.title: How I Live Now
items.description: As conflict in Europe escalates, an American teen (Saoirse Ronan) fights to survive in the English countryside.

items.title: How the Gringo Stole Christmas
items.description: A Mexican father's Christmas celebration goes from merry to messy when his daughter shows up with her new boyfriend.

items.title: Chainsaws, Jukeboxes and Fishing Reels
items.description: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

items.title: Escalators, Leaf Blowers and Music Boxes
items.description: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box; using realistic CGI animation, we explode these objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

items.title: Lawnmowers, Pinball Machines and Padlocks
items.description: Lawn mower, pinball machine, padlock, watch, toilet, yo-yo; using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

items.title: How to Start a Small Business
items.description: Skyler Ward wants to create the next World Wrestling Phenomena, but with little people.

items.title: How to Survive a Plague
items.description: In the late 1980s, members of Act-Up and other AIDS activists battle indifference and hostility to bring attention to the disease and play a huge role in reducing the number of AIDS-related fatalities in the U.S.

items.title: Howards End
items.description: Based on E.M. Forster's classic novel, the miniseries adaptation of "Howards End" is a portrayal of England at the turn of the 20th century told through the lens of three families: the intellectual Schlegels, the wealthy and prejudiced Wilcoxes and the working-class Basts. In the evolving landscape of social and class divisions, idealistic Schlegel sisters Margaret and Helen seek to help the impoverished Bast family while simultaneously ridding the Wilcoxes of their preconceived notions of class and welfare.

items.title: Howling III
items.description: An Australian scientist (Barry Otto) finds marsupial werewolves, one of whom (Imogen Annesley) finds work in a horror movie.

items.title: Hubble's Enduring Legacy
items.description: A look back at the Hubble Space Telescope's major accomplishments since its launch in April 1990.

items.title: Humanoids From the Deep
items.description: A fisherman (Doug McClure) and a scientist (Ann Turkel) fight back when mossy sea monsters assault women.

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Humans vs. Nature
items.description: Mother nature always runs on her own agenda.

items.title: Humans vs. Water
items.description: Water reigns as the ultimate challenger.

items.title: Humans vs. Adventure Sports
items.description: Thrills and spills! Watch humans hilariously fail at daring adventure sports in wild landscapes!

items.title: Humans VS. Grooming
items.description: Grooming gone wrong! Witness humans face unexpected mishaps while trying to look their best!

items.title: Humans vs Workouts
items.description: From lifting weights to lifting egos, see how workouts go wildly off course!

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Human vs Emotions
items.description: Feelings run wild! Watch humans hilariously lose control in battles with their own emotions!

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Human vs Employment
items.description: Career chaos incoming! Join the fun as humans tackle jobs with hilarious results!

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Human vs City
items.description: Urban life, unfiltered! Join the chaos as humans take on the city-and lose, spectacularly!

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Humans vs Landscapes
items.description: From scenic slips to outdoor wipeouts, the terrain strikes back!

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Humans vs Social Expectation
items.description: From dress codes to awkward trends witness hilarious fails under pressure to fit in.

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Humans vs Laws of Physics
items.description: Gravity, inertia, and buoyancy team up to take humans down - spectacularly.

items.title: Humans VS. Everything ----- Humans vs Weekend Gateaways
items.description: From carnivals to campgrounds, the great outdoors loves a good fail.

items.title: Humboldt County
items.description: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

items.title: Humpday
items.description: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

items.title: Hunger
items.description: Focusing on the 1981 hunger strikes by Republican prisoners in Northern Ireland. Bobby Sands is one of a group of prisoners who first "took to the blanket" with a "dirty protest" in pursuit of their claims for recognition as political prisoners. Sands then became the first one of the group to embark on a hunger strike that was to end in his death.

items.title: Welcome to the Tundra
items.description: Katmai National Park's bears have just 150 days to consume three million calories and pack on 200 pounds to ensure their winter survival. First-time moms BoldFace and QuadMom must try to keep their chaotic cubs out of harm's way as scrappy male Stomper fights with mysterious challenger BigBoi for Blondie's attention. Grizzled vet Bernie takes teen Casanova under his wing before facing off with the legendary Brooks Falls behemoths (Denali, Scarface, Rizzo and Blonde Ears), who are odds-on favorites in this rivalry. Contenders gorge their way to the top BIG (beefiness, ingenuity and grit) score, vying for the crown as the park's most valuable bear (MVB), just in time for a long winter's nap.

items.title: Slammin' Salmon
items.description: The Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits dash to cash on July's salmon feast; BigBoi embarks on a food-finding road trip, QuadMom and RedBack are welcomed to the feast and BoldFace keeps her surviving cub safe.

items.title: Hungry Hearts
items.description: A new mother's increasingly unstable behavior threatens her relationship with her husband (Adam Driver) and the life of her infant.

items.title: Gran Canaria - Part 2
items.description: Thom Hunt is challenged to hunt the mighty pike in the UK's Norfolk Broads.

items.title: Norway
items.description: Thom Hunt decides to leave his comfort zone behind and test himself as an angler.

items.title: Girls Just Wanna Eat Some Chicken!
items.description: Chef Lawrence Page moved his Pink Tea Cup restaurant to Brooklyn to try to bring his soul-food concept to the next level in the hopes of landing a coveted Michelin star. He and his team quickly learn that it takes more than good cooking to reach the level he wants to achieve. While running the eatery, Page has to manage cat fights, power moves and love triangles between members of his staff. General manager Ana -- also Page's hot-tempered girlfriend -- leads the crew, which includes flirty hostess Sana, who's not afraid to stand up to Ana; lead server Thandi; and head bartender Candice, who is as sweet as her drinks but not yet up to Michelin-star standards. Providing much-needed comic relief at the restaurant are twins Dominic and Stef, who can't seem to get much right. Page must keep his eye on the prize while trying to successfully manage his personal and professional lives if he wants to join the ranks of chefs who have a Michelin star attached to their name.

items.title: Five Stars of Shade
items.description: Lawrence brings his staff to a fine dining restaurant to encourage them to step up their game; old tensions surface among staff members; Candice is left off the invitation list.

items.title: The Mother of All Meltdowns
items.description: The PTC prepares for Mother's Day brunch, the biggest day of the year; Ana hires a new bartender to spite Candice; staff tensions and kitchen confusion leads to the "mother of all meltdowns."

items.title: Wine & Dine & Grind
items.description: Candice becomes jealous when Lawrence flirts with Sana and makes her a shocking offer; a big delivery to a radio show may be a huge fail.

items.title: Today's Menu: More Beef
items.description: Ana explodes at a brunch for radio DJ Angela Yee; Thandi loses it over Sana's promotion; Sana reveals the shocking truth about what really happened at the winery.

items.title: The Worst Staff Meeting Ever
items.description: Lawrence, understaffed and stressed, must prepare for an important food critic's visit; shocking accusations and wine glasses fly at a disastrous staff meeting, with the future of the PTC on the line.

items.title: Let's Get This Fried Chicken!
items.description: Chef Lawrence has a mysterious new plan to elevate the Pink Tea Cup; Lawrence tries to win his family back, but Ana explodes over his affair with Thandi; a new hire causes chaos, Sana schemes to get Candice back; the twins hatch a secret plan.

items.title: The HBIC Is Back
items.description: Lawrence apologizes to Candice, but on terms she may not accept; Ana shocks everyone when she returns to the Pink Tea Cup to take back her spot and her man from Thandi; Lawrence's mysterious plans are revealed.

items.title: Party Crasher
items.description: Ana and Candice conduct a tension-filled sit-down; Cola draws a battle line when her boyfriend flirts with Sana; an uninvited guest melts down at Lawrence's all-important Miami investor party.

items.title: Dinner Party Disaster
items.description: Lawrence deals with the aftermath of his ruined investor party; Cola's beau causes major drama on his first day; after her fight with Ana, Candice turns to LP, but he leaves after she bashes his baby mama.

items.title: Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner
items.description: Ana fights to save Lawrence's dream; a food competition pits the staff members against each other; Cola makes a confession about her hookup with Stef, shocking Jon Jon; Lawrence breaks up with Thandi.

items.title: Miami Mayhem
items.description: The Pink Tea Cup staff brings the party to Miami; after an uninvited guest arrives, an all-out pool fight threatens Lawrence's Miami dream; Ana takes back Lawrence; Thandi plots revenge.

items.title: Iron Fork in the Road
items.description: Lawrence's confession backfires when Ana freaks out; shocking staff firing shakes up the team and divides loyalties; Candice drops a bombshell about a threesome with Lawrence and Ana.

items.title: A Chicken & Waffle House Divided
items.description: Lawrence and Ana's engagement is off to a rocky start; Ana confronts Thandi over a Miami hookup with her man; fists fly at the twins' fashion show; a secret alliance plots revenge to take down the Pink Tea Cup.

items.title: I Am Love
items.description: At a dinner -- during which her husband, Tancredi (Pippo Delbono), learns that he and his son Edoardo Recchi Jr. (Flavio Parenti) are about to assume control of the Edoardo Recchi Sr.'s (Gabriele Ferzetti) lucrative business -- Emma (Tilda Swinton) meets a chef named Antonio (Edoardo Gabbriellini). Antonio and Emma soon find themselves in bed together. With the family already divided over the elder Recchi's unusual plans, Emma's affair is the wild card that might divide the family for good.

items.title: I Am Not Your Negro
items.description: In 1979, James Baldwin wrote a letter to his literary agent describing his next project, "Remember This House." The book was to be a revolutionary, personal account of the lives and assassinations of three of his close friends: Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, Jr. At the time of Baldwin's death in 1987, he left behind only 30 completed pages of this manuscript. Filmmaker Raoul Peck envisions the book James Baldwin never finished.

items.title: I Bury the Living
items.description: Robert Kraft (Richard Boone) inherits a familial post as the chairman of a small-town cemetery. The centerpiece of the cemetery office is a map of all the plots: White pins signify those claimed, black pins those occupied. When Robert accidentally puts a black pin in the just-purchased plots of a friend (Glenn Vernon) and his new wife, they die in a freak accident. Robert's uncle (Howard Smith) convinces him to make another switch, to see if it's coincidence or something more sinister.

items.title: I Can't See Her
items.description: After her husband disappears, a woman turns to the man's flirtatious colleague for help and finds herself falling in love again.

items.title: I Do
items.description: A gay Briton living in New York risks losing his family and residency in the United States. He marries a lesbian friend to remain in the country, but things get complicated when he meets the love of his life.

items.title: Striptease Wedding
items.description: Ever wish you could have a mulligan for your wedding day and do the ceremony over again? "I Do Over" gives couples a second chance at their wedding. Renowned wedding and event planner Diann Valentine plans a second wedding ceremony for couples who had a disastrous walk down the aisle the first time around. Diann transforms bad bridal memories -- plagued by natural disasters, fainting grooms and missing dresses -- into dream ceremonies that try to wipe away the memories of the disastrous first ceremonies. Diann and her team have just five days to pull everything together for each ceremony, with designer wedding dresses, whimsical cake designs and breathtaking venues.

items.title: Fainting Fella
items.description: Tasha and Wes Owens' second wedding due to a melted cake and a fainting groom the first time around.

items.title: Make or Break Wedding
items.description: Lindsay wants another chance after she breaks her foot a week before the wedding.

items.title: Weddng Weather Woes
items.description: Tsunami warnings and a storm in the middle of the Tumbagas' first wedding.

items.title: Up in Smoke
items.description: Diann's second chance at happiness after a wedding that went up in flames.

items.title: Stopped Dead at the Altar
items.description: Groom Jason's brother-in-law's revival; tension-free do-over wedding.

items.title: I Eat Your Skin
items.description: A writer (William Joyce) meets a girl (Heather Hewitt) whose mad-doctor father turns Caribbean islanders into zombies.

items.title: I Had a Bloody Good Time at House Harker
items.description: In order to save their family home, two awkward brothers and their idiot friend hire a vampire-actor to scare the townspeople, but things get crazy when the vampire turns out to be the real thing.

items.title: I Kill Giants
items.description: A teen must face her fears in increasingly dangerous ways when horrible giants threaten to destroy her small town.

items.title: I Love You Both
items.description: Krystal and her twin brother have been codependent their entire lives, still living together in their late 20s in a one-bedroom house. When they both meet and start dating the same guy, they remain in denial about the situation until he picks only one of them, forcing them to confront that they can no longer live the same life. With nowhere to turn for advice, the twins are finally forced to look within for answers.

items.title: I Saw the Devil
items.description: On a dark road, taxi driver Kyung-chul comes across a scared female motorist stranded in a broken-down vehicle. He pulls over -- but not to help her. When the woman's head is discovered in a local river, her devastated fiancé, Kim Soo-hyeon, a trained secret agent, becomes obsessed with hunting down her killer. Once he finds Kyung-chul, things get twisted. After brutally beating the murderer, Kim lets him go free, and a demented game of cat and mouse begins.

items.title: I Trapped the Devil
items.description: Hoping for a joyful family reunion, Matt and his wife pay a surprise visit to the home of his estranged brother, Steve, to celebrate Christmas. To their shock, they soon learn that Steve has a hostage in his basement -- a man he claims is the devil.

items.title: I Want My Name Back
items.description: The rise, fall and rise again of original members of The Sugarhill Gang.

items.title: Jennifer
items.description: Charles Stuart Platkin, also known as the Diet Detective, stages undercover health interventions. His mission is to coax Americans back to a more healthy lifestyle. "Do you want to see your daughter graduate from college?" he bluntly asks one target. Another woman is forced to walk 2.5 miles -- the distance she'd have to go to burn off the calories in the slice of chocolate cake he makes her carry as she walks. And no, she doesn't get to eat the cake after the walk. He works with each person to help them find out why they've developed the weight issues they struggle with, and then he helps them develop more effective ways to deal with their problems.

items.title: Micah
items.description: Micah compensates for his weight using humor and charm.

items.title: Sussy
items.description: The pressure of being a single mom has Sussy turning to food for comfort and sends her life-long dream of being a singer to the back burner.

items.title: Diana and Juan
items.description: Diana and Juan discover some serious medical news from the Diet Detective.

items.title: Caro
items.description: Caro is a passionate young woman who cannot live her life due to being a couch potato.

items.title: Shari
items.description: Shari must change her eating habits to get her career on the right path.

items.title: Stephanie
items.description: The Diet Detective comes to Stephanie's aid when her late-night eating habits hurt her health.

items.title: Mindy
items.description: A non-profit attorney spends all of her time battling for innocent victims.

items.title: I.T.
items.description: Mike Regan is a self-made man who has it all: a gorgeous wife, a beautiful teenage daughter, and a sleek, state-of-the-art smart home. But he soon finds himself in a deadly, high-stakes game of cat-and-mouse when his I.T. consultant, Ed, starts using his skills to stalk Mike's daughter and endanger his family, his business, and his life. In a world where there is no privacy, Mike needs to rely on his old connections to defeat a new kind of nemesis.

items.title: Main Character Energy
items.description: A comedy series combining themed stand-up performances and candid reflections, revealing real-life experiences behind the laughs.

items.title: Poly, Pan, and Poor Decisions
items.description: Seth, Keira, and Adario joke about the highs and lows of relationships.

items.title: Excuse My Beauty (Ignore My Anxiety)
items.description: Identity, perception, and keeping it together in public.

items.title: CTRL+ALT+DELUSION
items.description: Tech fails, TSA tales, furry fandom, and parenting chaos collide in queer comedy.

items.title: I'm in Love With a Church Girl
items.description: The past of a former drug dealer (Jeff "Ja Rule" Atkins) proves problematic as his love for a devout woman (Adrienne Bailon) grows.

items.title: Ice Cream Man
items.description: Some children alert the police to a disturbed vendor who blends human parts into his frozen confections.

items.title: Iced with Sylvia Weinstock
items.description: Two wedding cake designers compete to win time with top cake designer Sylvia Weinstock.

items.title: Ichi the Killer
items.description: A bloodthirsty hoodlum (Tadanobu Asano) sparks a series of violent reprisals after his boss is apparently taken by a mysterious assassin (Nao Ômori).

items.title: Alfa Romeo
items.description: Tracing the lineage of the most famous motoring marques by highlighting five key machines, and five key moments that brought them to prominence.

items.title: Porsche
items.description: Features a definitive look at the machines and moments that make Porsche famous.

items.title: Ford
items.description: Henry Ford's application of the moving assembly line to automotive production alters the car industry forever and helps his eponymous redefine cars for the masses.

items.title: Bentley
items.description: This is the story of Bentley's rise from humble origins to reshape the high-end luxury motoring world.

items.title: Audi
items.description: The story of Audi's rise to fame is a harrowing tale of perseverance, persistence and engineering excellence.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz
items.description: Mercedes-Benz can lay claim to inventing the world's first car; the advanced high-end luxury saloon of its age, the sports car and high-end luxury off-roaders ever made.

items.title: Lamborghini
items.description: Explore the journey of Lamborghini, the Italian supercar manufacturers.

items.title: BMW
items.description: Founded in 1916, Bavarian Motors Werke, better known today as BMW, was originally an aircraft manufacturer.

items.title: Aston Martin
items.description: Founded in 1913 by Lionel Martin and Robert Bamford, Aston Martin has a rich history of machines.

items.title: Chevrolet
items.description: Chevrolet becomes one of the largest carmakers in the world; its journey includes surviving two World Wars, a Great Depression and multiple economic collapses to produce the Silverado pickup truck, the Camaro sports car and the Corvette supercar.

items.title: Rolls Royce
items.description: On a quiet evening in 1904, Charles Stewart Rolls and Frederick Henry Royce have dinner together; that is how Rolls-Royce is born.

items.title: Volkswagen
items.description: Explore how Volkswagen rose from the ashes of the war to transform itself into the icon of the peace and free love sixties; it's a key product of eighties excess and today, it's one of the world's largest carmakers.

items.title: Cat Lovers vs. Dog Lovers
items.description: If you buy into the title of this game show, you might be an idiot if you can't answer the questions asked of contestants. Each episode features two pairs of competitors, sometimes from a particular rivalry -- for example, UCLA vs. USC or Trekkies vs."Star Wars" fans -- participating in several rounds of simple, rapid-fire questions testing people's observational skills, attention to detail, and general knowledge. The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots.

items.title: Married Marines vs. Friends
items.description: Two U.S. Marines face off against a former Marine and his friend.

items.title: Kidiotest
items.description: Two teams of kids compete against each other by answering brain-teaser puzzles.

items.title: Model Friends vs. Roommates
items.description: A gymnast and a model against roommates.

items.title: Celebrity Hosts
items.description: TV and radio hosts Mike Catherwood and Dr.Drew face off against YouTube stars Glozell and Gaby Dunn.

items.title: Nerds vs. Thugs
items.description: Friends compete against a married couple.

items.title: 70s Night
items.description: A married couple compete against friends in a 70s special.

items.title: Co-workers vs. Dating Couple
items.description: Ashley and her boyfriend John compete against co-workers Trego and Nemanja.

items.title: Celebrity Comedians 2
items.description: A reunion of "Chelsea Lately" panelists; comedians Sarah Colonna and Fortune Feimster face off against Josh Wolf and Adam Conover.

items.title: Models vs. BFFs
items.description: A pair of models compete against BFFs.

items.title: Cosplay Co-Workers vs. Dog-Walking Daters
items.description: A Quidditch player and his belly dancer friend compete against a dating couple.

items.title: Family Face-Off 2
items.description: A mother and son compete against a father and his son.

items.title: Blind Dates
items.description: Both teams go on blind dates with their teammates while competing.

items.title: Ballet vs. Burlesque
items.description: Burlesque dancers Kat and Julia face off against ballet dancers Brittany and Chantal.

items.title: Celebrity Comedians 3
items.description: Affion Crockett and Jeff Dye face off against Jade Cata-Preta and Shelby Fero.

items.title: Sisters vs. Daters
items.description: Sisters Riana and Rachel compete against dating couple Kailey and Tyler.

items.title: Secret Shopper vs. Zombie Wannabe
items.description: Two teams of friends compete against each other.

items.title: Battle of the BFFs
items.description: Battle of the BFFs with Stacy and Ashlyne facing off against Christophe and Kyle.

items.title: America vs. Canada
items.description: Canadians face off against Americans.

items.title: Battle of the Body Artists
items.description: Mentors from "Skin Wars: Fresh Paint" face off; Rio and Aryn against Natalie and Dutch.

items.title: High School Sweethearts vs. Sisters
items.description: A married couple and two sisters with an adorable tiny dog compete.

items.title: Harry Potter Fans vs. Twilight Fans
items.description: Twilight fans face off against Harry Potter fans.

items.title: Kidiotest 3
items.description: Two teams of kids compete against each other.

items.title: Street Smarts vs. Book Smarts
items.description: A rivalry edition pits street smarts against book smarts.

items.title: Teachers vs. Students
items.description: Teachers face off against students to answer difficult brain-teaser puzzles.

items.title: Celebrity Comedians 4
items.description: Tiffany Haddish and Sarah Tiana face off against Michael Kosta and Drew Lynch.

items.title: Fraternity vs. Sorority
items.description: Sorority sisters face off against fraternity brothers to answer brain-teaser puzzles.

items.title: Scary Idiotest
items.description: Vampires compete against zombies.

items.title: Millennials vs Baby Boomers
items.description: Millennials face off against baby boomers.

items.title: Former Spelling Bee Champ vs. Juggler
items.description: A former spelling bee champion and her cousin face off against a juggler and his trilingual girlfriend.

items.title: Hipsters vs. Fashionistas
items.description: Hipsters face off against Fashionistas.

items.title: Tour Manager vs. Bartender
items.description: A tour manager and her friend face off against a bartender and his former co-worker.

items.title: Brains vs. Brawn
items.description: Two teams face off to answer difficult puzzles.

items.title: Kanye Haters vs. Kanye Fans
items.description: Kanye haters face off against Kanye fans.

items.title: Songwriter vs. Flight Attendant
items.description: A songwriter and her husband face off against a flight attendant and her friend.

items.title: Bad Girls vs. Nice Guys
items.description: Bad girls face off against nice guys.

items.title: Igor and the Lunatics
items.description: A dangerous cult leader and his henchmen resume a grisly murder spree following their release from prison.

items.title: Immanence
items.description: Radio astronomers discover a mysterious signal in the deep sea that could be contact with extraterrestrials. After several terrifying manifestations threaten their beliefs, they must fight to survive the ultimate evil.

items.title: Immortal Demon Slayer
items.description: Five hundred years before the Monkey King wreaks havoc on the heavenly kingdom, Wukong refuses to bow down to his destiny when he sets out to rebel against the gods.

items.title: Size Matters

With the help of trained assassins like Sunny, the area is ruled by rival barons, and for decades Quinn has consistently outflanked and outmaneuvered his fellow barons to keep the upper hand. His invincibility, however, begins to fade in light of brazen attacks by the newest baron, The Widow, who believes M.K. is the key to her success. As the battle for control of the Badlands heats up, the destinies of the stoic assassin and the impetuous teenager become intertwined.

Danger surrounds the hunters, trappers and traders who lead the way into the unknown frontier. As they push deeper into the wilderness, crossing impenetrable forests, vast mountain ranges, and unforgiving deserts, they face starvation, deadly weather, ferocious predators, and Native American forces. Their descriptions of the frontier's natural wonders encourage a tide of settlers to head West, and their epic tales of adventure and survival become the stuff of myths and legends.

items.title: Judge Mathis
items.description: Judge Greg Mathis is unlike most adjudicators you'd see in a courtroom. The former Detroit-area district court judge infuses his court sessions with a generous dose of humor as he listens to diverse litigants plead their small-claims cases in his TV courtroom. A regular segment, Ask Judge Mathis, features the judge answering viewer questions to advise people with legal situations that they face. Prior to entering the legal world, Mathis was involved with gangs and spent time in jail as a young man before turning his life around.

items.title: Living the Dream
items.description: "Kevin Can F... Himself" is a dark comedy that alternates between traditional multi-camera sitcom and single-camera drama. Set in Worcester, Mass., the series follows the journey of Allison McRoberts, a stereotypically smart and beautiful sitcom wife, who is married to Kevin, a husky, self-centered man-child who is clearly punching above his weight. After making a dark discovery, Allison teams up with neighbor Patty O'Connor as she attempts to escape the confines of her life and take control of her fate.

items.title: New Tricks
items.description: Allison witnesses an overdose and has an idea; it's Belichick hoodie day and Kevin feuds with the neighbors over a stolen package; following a mysterious business card, Allison is led to Patty's Salon in town.

items.title: We're Selling Washing Machines
items.description: Allison discovers the truth about Patty's Salon; after a fight, Kevin and Neil compete in a chili cook-off; Allison's revenge inadvertently dries up the towns pill supply; Patty almost gets busted in a local pharmacy raid and confides in Allison.

items.title: Live Free or Die
items.description: A detective questions Patty about the pharmacy bust; Allison and Patty go on a road trip; Kevin comes up with a new moneymaking scheme in the basement of the McRoberts home; after multiple setbacks, Allison admits the truth about her plan to Patty.

items.title: New Patty
items.description: Allison pushes the limits to see what she is capable of; Kevin, Neil and Pete attempt to replace Patty after kicking her out of the group; an ominous Nick shows up at Patty's salon; a new job opportunity opens up for Allison at Bev's Diner.

items.title: The Grand Victorian
items.description: Allison and Patty make a deal with Nick; Kevin celebrates his birthday with two dinners; to Patty's surprise, she goes on a date with Tammy at the Vic House; Allison confronts Nick about going through with the plan her way.

items.title: Broken
items.description: Nick's timeline shifts as Allison and Patty prepare for the big night; Kevin, Neil and Pete start a band, but Neil gets paranoid that Kevin has other plans when he finds a fertility clinic brochure in the trash; Tammy and Patty get closer.

items.title: Fixed
items.description: Detectives question Allison about the night before; after the trauma of the break in, Kevin searches for meaning by running for city council; Kurt plants a seed of doubt, while Allison and Patty deal with the repercussions of their actions.

items.title: Jackson
items.description: When tour-de-force entertainer Kevin Hart is not on a set filming a major movie or in a studio doing voice-over work for an animated project, he's likely on the road working the stand-up circuit. It's the latter that's the focal point of "Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City," a stand-up series with a distinct travelogue bent. Across eight episodes, Hart visits Atlanta, Houston, Chicago, Sacramento, Miami, Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and Birmingham, Ala., to find fresh talent and see what makes the comedy scenes special. Each episode features stand-up sets from a different group of local performers and segments featuring Hart and those comics discussing the comedy climate in their city.

items.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Keith Robinson Back of the Bus Funny
items.description: Keith Robinson describes the long-term dangers of being racist, the pitfalls of aging and the difference between the ways that men and women cheat.

items.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery Relevent

items.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
items.description: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

items.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Plastic Cup Boyz
items.description: Stand-up comics Joey Wells, Will Horton and Na'im Lynn make up the Plastic Cup Boyz, who have opened for Kevin Hart for many years, but now they step into the spotlight with headlining sets of their own.

items.title: Donald Mac Thinks Fake News Is Real
items.description: Undercover as Donald Mac, Kevin Hart pranks Lyft passengers.

items.title: Kevin Jordan: Cause I Said So!
items.description: A former Los Angeles police officer, Kevin has thrilled audiences at clubs, on cruise ships, and for the troops worldwide.

items.title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly

items.title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
items.description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

items.title: Kickboxer

But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee).

items.title: Kickboxer: Vengeance
items.description: Kurt Sloane (Alain Moussi) has always been there for his brother, Eric (Darren Shahlavi), who's known in the martial arts world as a modern-day warrior. Villanelle is a very talented killer, mercurial in mood, who clings to the luxuries of her job. Eve and Villanelle go head to head in a fierce game of cat and mouse, each woman equally obsessed with the other as Eve is tasked with hunting down the psychopathic assassin. Sarah Barnett, BBCA president, says, "'Killing Eve' stands out in a sea of scripted stories as refreshingly entertaining and great fun."

items.description: Do you ever wonder how to keep air bubbles from forming in your polish, how to make your polish dry faster or where you should store it? Your questions are about to be answered!
