items.description: Learn how to apply bronzer the right way to contour your features.

items.title: Copper Eyes
items.description: If you're searching for a beautiful make-up look that can take you from day to night, you should definitely give copper eyes a try! Beauty expert, April Corley, shows you how to properly apply this stunning eye-shadow trend.

items.title: How to Create a Photo Booth
items.description: Fun and clever DIY projects to give your home a touch of the handmade

items.title: How to Decorate a Dessert Bar
items.description: Next time you are planning a party and need to brighten up your space, think paper! Paper decorations are easy, inexpensive and can pack a bold punch. See how Rachel Kashon created some charming decorations for a simple dessert party.

items.title: How to Create a Puppet Theater
items.description: Who doesn't love a good puppet show? See how Rachel Kashon creates a charming theater out of an inexpensive tri-fold presentation board.

items.title: How to Create Paper Hats
items.description: Today we've got you covered with a great idea to keep the kids entertained. Paper hats! See how Rachel Kashon keeps the kids enthralled with this simple, inexpensive project.

items.title: Mother's Day Flower Basket
items.description: Mother's Day is approaching and if you still don't have a gift idea, here's a quick and easy gift that Mom will love, give this a try!

items.title: How to Create Paper Puppets
items.description: Who doesn't love a good puppet show? See how Rachel Kashon creates a charming theater out of an inexpensive tri-fold presentation board.

items.title: How to Make Paper Garlands
items.description: Let Rachel Kashon show you how to twist, stick, stack & slice your way into a celebratory sensation!

items.title: How to Create Origami Treat Containers
items.description: Learn how to create a clever "parting gift" for friends with this adorable origami party favor. Join Rachel Kashon as she shows you how!

items.title: How to Dress Up a Pair of Heels
items.description: Looking for a way to add a little pizzazz to that plain pair of heels? Tabitha Johnson shows you how!

items.title: How to Add Neon to Your Wardrobe
items.description: Neon is a big trend right now. But if the thought of wearing it makes you squirm, here's an idea from Tabitha Johnson. She'll show you how to incorporate "just a touch".

items.title: How to Make a Polka Dot Purse
items.description: If you've fallen in love with those Marc Jacobs polka dot bags, but their price is a bit hard to swallow, here's an idea from Tabitha Johnson. She'll show you how to make your own "DIY" version, using a carrot! Yes, a carrot.

items.title: How to Make a Skirt from a Dress
items.description: We all have that dress, that we love, but aren't able to wear anymore. Perhaps there is a stain on it, or it doesn't suit us anymore. Well before you toss it in the Goodwill bag, consider turning it into a skirt!

items.title: How to Make a Handmade Stylish Scarf
items.description: A scarf is one of the easiest things to make yourself, and if you have any old sheer curtains lying around, it gets even easier! Watch how Tabitha Johnson of www.glitterandganache.com, shows you how to create a stylish scarf out of curtains, and some old potatoes!

items.title: How to Dress Up a Tote Bag
items.description: Summer is coming and we all need a stylish summer tote. Watch how Tabitha Johnson dresses up a store bought tote by personalizing it with a little fabric paint and new leather straps!

items.title: How to Make a Photo T-Shirt
items.description: Do you ever find yourself wondering what to "do" with all those photos you end up taking? Why not wear them? Tabitha Johnson shows you how.

items.title: How to Dress up a Summer Shirt
items.description: Looking for a way to dress up a summer shirt? Tabitha Johnson shows you how!

items.title: How to Make Citronella Sand Candles
items.description: Warmer weather is upon us and our new DIY producer Robert Mahar has found a way to both combine a favorite summer camp craft and keep those pesky mosquitoes away from the backyard BBQ! Make citronella sand candles using small vintage gelatin molds (found at a flea market) like we did or experiment with shapes created from small glasses, bowls or even kid's beach sand play molds!

items.title: How to Dye Golf Balls
items.description: Lest you think we're phoning in a rehashed Easter craft, know that there's actually a very practical purpose for dying golf balls! When dad is at the driving range or on the course, help him easily identify his golf balls from the countless other white ones sailing across the green. Our DIY producer Robert Mahar has pulled together this simple tutorial for a fun Father's Day gift.

items.title: How to Carve a Rubber Stamp
items.description: Carving your own rubber stamps is deceptively simple using soft rubber carving blocks and linoluem carving tools. Print text and images from your computer or draw your own to personalize stationery and gift tags, or stamp your own wrapping paper! Our DIY producer Robert Mahar has put together a step by step tutorial for transferring and carving your images, making rubber stamps uniquely your own.

items.title: How to Create Paper Punch Tissue Flowers
items.description: Looking for a gorgeous and simple party decoration? These punched paper flowers from our DIY producer Robert Mahar are designed for the beginner crafter but yield impressive results. Inspired by camellia flowers, these tissue paper blooms can serve as table decorations and cake toppers.

items.title: How to Create Felted Wool Knit Bracelets
items.description: Never learned to knit? Never fear! Readily available automatic spool knitters make quick work of creating soft knit bracelets. When made from wool yarn, these bangles can be machine washed in hot water to mat the natural fibers for a felted look. From our DIY producer Robert Mahar, this easy to make accessory can be created in any color with a coordinating wood bead to disguise the tied seam.

items.title: How to Create a Rubber Stamped Heat Embossed Journal
items.description: Stamp embossing is like magic! There we said it. This simple process creates the look of engraving without the expense. Our DIY producer Robert Mahar created this tutorial for personalizing blank journals you'll want to use for everyday lists and notes or bundle up as thoughtful one-of-a-kind gifts or party favors.

items.title: How to Make Washi Wrapped Pencils
items.description: Add a little charm your everyday no. 2 pencil with this incredibly easily tutorial from our DIY producer Robert Mahar. Standard 6" square origami paper minimize the amount of measuring and cutting, and comes in an amazing array of colors and cute patterns. We suggest bundling a half dozen together, binding with a paper sash and tying in coordinating ribbon for a thoughtful handmade gift!

items.title: How to Make Decoupaged Storage Jars
items.description: Give those glass jars another life before they head off to the recycling bin! This eco-friendly craft from our DIY producer Robert Mahar creates a lovely set of storage jars with decoupaged lids and washi tape labels to keep office supplies neat and tidy. We used recycled wrapping paper, but encourage you to experiment with other materials like newspaper, origami paper, or drawings your kids created!

items.title: Embroidery 101
items.description: Friends, this is your opportunity to learn an old school craft and make it entirely your own - this ain't your gramma's embroidery! This video is your introduction to embroidery basics and your guide is embroiderer extraordinaire Jenny Hart, founder of Sublime Stitching, the original, independent DIY company that introduced pinups, robots, tattoos and some rock-and-roll to embroidery design. Be certain to watch the other videos in our Embroidery Playlist and prepare to get your stitch on!

items.title: 5 Most Common Embroidery Stitches
items.description: These five stitches are about to become the new favorites in your cache of craft skills! Embroiderer extraordinaire Jenny Hart guides you through the split stitch, back stitch, stem stitch, running stitch and satin stitch - when used in combination the creative possibilities are endless. Be certain to watch the other videos in our Embroidery Playlist and prepare to get your stitch on!

items.title: Three Ways to Transfer Embroidery Patterns
items.description: Most any image can be recreated in embroidery - the trick is getting that image onto your fabric! Problem solved. Embroiderer extraordinaire Jenny Hart guides you through using store-bought iron-on transfers, working with carbon transfer paper and tackling the versatile combo of tracing paper and transfer pens. Be certain to watch the other videos in our Embroidery Playlist and prepare to get your stitch on!

items.title: How to Embroider a French Knot
items.description: Perhaps the loveliest and most feared of embroidery maneuvers - the French knot. Armed only with a needle and hoop, our fearless guide Jenny Hart of Sublime Stitching leads the charge to conquering this knotty detail. Her unique technique will have you comfortable in no time and knotting up a storm. Be certain to watch all of Jenny's videos for embroidery basics to more advanced stitching projects.

items.title: How to Embroider a T-Shirt
items.description: Stretchy fabrics, like stormy seas or the knit cotton t-shirt in this video, can be tricky to embroider. In sails the magical material known as iron-on, tear-away stabilizer! Embroidery captain Jenny Hart of Sublime stitching steers us through this clever tutorial and drops anchor on a very cute project.

items.title: How to Embroider on Paper
items.description: Jenny Hart of Sublime Stitching shows you how to create and personalize your next paper card.

items.title: How to Frame Your Embroidery
items.description: Jenny Hart of Sublime Stitching shares a clever way of framing your embroidery without damaging your work. No gluing! No cutting!

items.title: How to Build a Fort Kit
items.description: We love children's gifts that challenge imaginations and spur creativity! Rae Friis has designed a clever, thoughtful and inexpensive gift to assemble for any kid. Her versatile Build a Fort Kits allow for group play, grand adventures, quiet solitude and a place to nap!

items.title: How to Make Place Setting Placemat for Kids
items.description: Rae Friis of ARMOMMY brings us this clever way to coach kids on how to set the table! The blackboard surface allows your kiddo to customize their place setting and the painted outline shows them where everything goes.

items.title: How to Make a Leather Tassel Pendant Necklace
items.description: Join Rae Friis as she walks us through this simple and sweet fashion DIY tutorial. Create a tassel pendant from leather or re-purpose material from an old garment!

items.title: How to Make All Purpose Household Cleaning Solution
items.description: Rae Friis shares a simple recipe for an effective, all-purpose household cleaner that is made from safe, non-toxic ingredients. This effective solution will leave your home sparkling clean and smelling great!

items.title: How to Create a Monogrammed Doormat
items.description: There is something wonderful about DIY projects that bring style and beauty to simple everyday objects. We're so pleased to bring you this elegantly simple tutorial from Rae Friis. Welcome friends and family to your home with this custom monogrammed doormat!

items.title: How to Make Salted Caramel Syrup for Your Coffee
items.description: Coffee lovers rejoice! Rae Friis provides a sweet treat to dress up the occasional hot or iced coffee break. (Personally we also think it's amazing over ice cream as well!) This simple tutorial walks you through the creation of a delicious salted caramel syrup which makes a lovely gift when presented in a glass storage jar and festooned with our free downloadable gift tags.

items.title: How to Make Party Clips
items.description: Join Rae Friis of ARMOMMY as she shows us how to create a sweet and useful detail for your next party. Cleverly dressed-up clothespins serve as reusable drink clips and a decorative way to close favor bags! Make certain your guests receive the beverage they requested, and then the clips can navigate to lapels or shirt pockets as name tags or serve as place cards for larger events.

items.title: Ring Toss Game: How to Make
items.description: What to do while we wait for the BBQ? Include this simple, backyard activity in your 4th of July festivities! Designer, entrepreneur and mother of four, Rae Friis shows us how to create a kid-friendly ring toss game.

items.title: How to Make a Map Accordion Travel Book
items.description: Taking a road trip this summer? Heidi and Susie Bauer of Rock Scissor Paper show you how to transform your travel map into a clever accordion book to fill with snapshots, ticket stubs and hand written memories - a sweet and simple souvenir!

items.title: How to Make a Rainbow Showers Mobile
items.description: No one wants to see rain clouds hovering above their celebration, that is unless they're the magical meteorological variety designed by Heidi Bauer and Susie Bauer of Rock Scissor Paper! Shower someone special with these amazing party decorations - sewn rainbow showers falling from sweet tissue paper clouds.

items.title: How to Make Flower Cupcake Toppers and Party Badges
items.description: Heidi and Susie Bauer are throwing a Neon Party and you're invited! Utilizing easy to find neon colored office supplies they create sweet heart flowers for cupcake toppers and party badges. Decorate your desserts and your guests in bright and festive way!

items.title: How to Make Neon Party Decorations
items.description: Heidi and Susie Bauer are throwing a Neon Party and you're invited! Utilizing easy to find neon colored office supplies they transform simple party supplies into a special celebration. Polka dot cups, drinking straw flags, napkin rings and favor bags -- all bright, festive and fun!

items.title: How to Make Powdered Sugar Stencils
items.description: In this video, there is a great idea of Powdered Sugar Stencils.

items.title: How to Package Food For a Bake Sale
items.description: Bake sales are as American as apple pie and an annual event for many schools and non-profits! The dynamic duo Heidi and Susie Bauer at Rock Scissor Paper have cleverly crafted ways to package some of the most common goodies -- cookies, caramel corn, cupcakes and mini loaves of bread. Adorable, oh so sweet and certain to make your next bake sale a big hit!

items.title: How to Make a Tissue Paper Collage
items.description: We're head over heels for this versatile project from the talented duo of Heidi and Susie Bauer of Rock Scissor Paper! The translucent nature of tissue paper creates new colors when overlapped making it a wonderful material for collage full of happy surprises. Learn the basics here and then experiment with text, images and abstract designs - the sunny sky's the limit!

items.title: How to Make DIY Paper Envelopes and Liners
items.description: Learning how to make your own envelopes and envelope liners will alter your crafting world! Utilizing Paper Source's ingenious template kits, you simply trace, cut and assemble -- easy peasy.

items.title: How To Make a Rolled Birthday Banner
items.description: Hip hip hooray! Here's a clever way to celebrate someone special's big day. This rolled birthday banner is a fun three-dimensional take on the classic party sign!

items.title: How to Wrap a Gift & Tie a Bow 101
items.description: How to gift wrap and tie a bow presented by Rachel Kashon

items.title: How to Make a Maritime Knot
items.description: Ahoy, matey! Learn how to tie a classic maritime knot and add a nifty nautical touch to your gift wrapping!

items.title: How to Make Fox Favor Boxes
items.description: We're not certain these sweet forest friends could be any cuter! Adorable festive fox favor boxes are easy to assemble and a guaranteed hit at your next event.

items.title: How to Make Favor Bags From Envelopes
items.description: Learn a simple and clever technique that transforms a plain paper envelope into a festive favor bag! Easy to customize to your event colors, this is sure to become a go-to party planning craft.

items.title: How to Create Three Styles of Food Labels
items.description: Learn three sweet and simple ways to label Food on your buffet table at your next event or large family gathering! Creative ways to combine Paper Source paper source labels and papers that you can easily customize in your choice of colors and motifs.

items.title: How to Make Soap Pops
items.description: Blast off to a cleaner kid! Debbie Chialtas show us how to recreate the classic rocket pop as a clever soap on a stick. Easy to make, these are sure to be a hit with young astronauts and aliens alike!

items.title: How to Make All-Natural Lip Balm
items.description: Pucker up! Debbie Chialtas shares the simplest of sweet recipes to create your own all-natural lip balm. Simply melt, mix and pour this beeswax and honey based balm.

items.title: How to Make Mini Soap Favors
items.description: Create adorable little soap favors using fondant cutters (like teeny, tiny cookie cutters!) and glycerin soap customized to the color and fragrance of your choosing! Debbie Chialtas walks us through this simple melt and pour soap craft. Perfect favors for any celebration.

items.title: How to Make Sugar & Salt Body Scrubs
items.description: Body scrubs are key to smooth and soft skin! Debbie Chialtas of Soapylove.com shares two recipes for easy to assemble scrubs using ingredients you're likely to already have in your pantry. Perfect as gifts or to pamper yourself!

items.title: How to Make Exfoliating Soaps
items.description: Debbie Chialtas of Soapylove.com provides a wonderful introduction to the world of melt and pour glycerin soap. Follow her simple directions to create custom exfoliating soaps that will keep your skin clean and smooth.

items.title: How to Make Halloween Soap Slime
items.description: Even creepy crawlies need to keep clean! Debbie Chialtas brews up a batch of gooey soap slime -- sure to appeal to the little ghouls and goblins in your life.

items.title: How to Make a Toy Embedded Soap
items.description: Sweet treats! Debbie Chialtas shares an adorable and easy to follow tutorial for embedding little treasures in a bar of clear glycerin soap. She used cute Japanese erasers, but any little plastic or rubber toy would work. Oh the possibilities for soapy sweet favors and gifts!

items.title: How to Make Relaxing Bath Teas
items.description: Imagine soaking in a giant cup of relaxing herbal tea! Debbie Chialtas of Soapylove.com combines lovely ingredients like chamomile and lavender in her bath tea recipe. Easy to assemble and packaged like giant tea bags, they make a wonderful presentation and a very thoughtful gift.

items.title: How to Make a Pom Pom Garland from Cupcake Liners
items.description: Whether you're hosting a birthday party, a shower or a summer picnic, this recipe for pom pom garland is a simple way to spruce up your digs. I bet you already have the ingredients necessary: string, cupcake liners (yes, cupcake liners!), glue stick & tape!

items.title: How to Make Event Table Numbers
items.description: Undertaking a large event DIY style can feel overwhelming. This video tackles table numbers - these are the number signs you typically find on each table in event dining hall. Guests follow the table numbers found on their escort cards to find their seats. Rachel Kashon of Lupa and Pepi breaks down this specific event detail and offers up simple, stylish and practical DIY suggestions.

items.title: How to Make Event Escort Cards
items.description: Undertaking a large event DIY style can feel overwhelming. This video tackles escort cards - these are the cards you typically find at the entrance to an event dining hall that indicate where each guest is to be seated. Rachel Kashon of Lupa and Pepi breaks down this specific event detail and offers up simple, stylish and practical DIY suggestions.

items.title: How to Make Event Place Cards
items.description: Undertaking a large event DIY style can feel overwhelming. This video tackles place cards - these are the cards you typically find at each individual place setting that indicates where each guest is to be seated at the table. Rachel Kashon of Lupa and Pepi breaks down this specific event detail and offers up simple, stylish and practical DIY suggestions.

items.title: How to Make Sewn Favor Bags
items.description: Undertaking a large event DIY style can feel overwhelming. This video tackles party favors - often hosts like to send their guests home with a small treat as a thank you for attending. Favors need not be expensive, but can be fun to package and personalize. Rachel Kashon of Lupa and Pepi breaks down this specific event detail and offers up simple, stylish and practical DIY suggestions.

items.title: How to Make Personalized Party Horns
items.description: We have an idea for customized party horn for you! Check it out.

items.description: How to use scrap fabric to make colourful bean bags by mother daughter duo of Tere Jensen and Bethany Jensen.

items.title: How to Make Patchwork Belt
items.description: Creating a sweet patchwork belt is a wonderful project for someone just learning to sew or a seasoned pro!

items.title: How to Make a Classic Flag Banner
items.description: Simple, classic designs are given life with color, pattern and texture, using vintage fabric and working until only the smallest bit of scrap fabric remains.

items.title: How to Make a Child's Apron from a Kitchen Towel
items.description: If you've never sewn a piece of clothing before, it doesn't get much simpler than this! Tere Jensen, clothing designer and co-founder of the brand m.o.m. magically creates an adorable child's apron from a standard kitchen dish towel. So simple, so practical, so inexpensive, so cute!

items.title: How to Make a Crazy Patchwork Bib
items.description: In this video it shows you how to make a crazy patchwork bib with different sizes of fabric to create a fancy bib in just a short time.

items.title: How to Make a Children's Art Rail
items.description: The mother daughter duo of Tere Jensen and Bethany Jensen are the design force behind m.o.m - a line of children's clothing ("nerdy stuff for cool kids"). Check out this cool DIY and display your children's artwork on mounted clotheslines.

items.title: How to Make Wrapped Hangers and Hanger Covers
items.description: Simple, classic designs are given life with color, pattern and texture, using vintage fabric and working until only the smallest bit of scrap fabric remains. Give new life to those hangers in your closet.

items.title: Bath Fizzies
items.description: A bath and body DIY brought to you by Robert Mahar. Perfect to treat yourself or give to someone special.

items.title: Homemade Watercolor Paints
items.description: Easy and fun DIY for you and the family. Learn to make your very own water colors.

items.title: Sewn Paper Garland
items.description: Have you Tried Paper Garland? If not, then here is a video where Robert shows you the making of decorative Paper Garland.

items.title: Gelatin Prints
items.description: A fun printing project that your kids will love using foliage found in your very own back yard.

items.title: How to Make a Seed Capsule
items.description: Robert Mahar brings you an easy gardening DIY project. Make your very own seed capsules and beautify your garden.

items.title: Pom Pom Tutorial 101
items.description: Are you fond of Pom Pom, give a try with Robert's tutorial of Pom Pom making.

items.title: No-Sew Favor Bags
items.description: In this DIY video, we see the process of making No Sew Favor Bags.

items.title: Wood & Felt Table Trivets
items.description: Robert's simple do it yourself project of making Felt Table Trivets.

items.title: Paper Lantern Chandelier
items.description: Robert Mahar shows you a fun and festive party DIY. A great wow factor and focal point for your next event!

items.title: Festive Cake Toppers
items.description: Robert Mahar shares another quick and easy party DIY project. Turn those party decorations into sweet and festive cake toppers.

items.title: Tassel Tutorial 101
items.description: Robert walks you through this simple fashion DIY tutorial. Create a tassel or re-purpose material from an old garment!

items.title: Wood Veneer Chain Garland
items.description: Use wood veneer edging to create a new twist to that old paper chain.

items.title: Robert's Fruit & Vegetable Container Garden - April Fools
items.description: New fruit hybrids are often a hit and miss process of experimentation and results are not guaranteed. However, if you are able to successfully grow the beautiful banana and kiwi combination demonstrated in this video, we recommend you proceed directly to your corner market and purchase a lottery ticket. Wishing you a very happy April Fool's Day!

items.title: Living Easter Basket
items.description: ThisDIY project celebrates spring with a little bit of twist on a holiday tradition. I want to show you how to assemble living Easter basket.

items.title: Robert's DIY Easter Chicks (Easter Collab!)
items.description: How are you celebrating your Easter? Here is an adorable Easter chick DIY idea by Robert.

items.title: Robert's Tissue Paper Toadstools
items.description: Quick and simple party decoration where how you can transform standard tissue into paper decoration fairy style toadstool by Robert Mahar.

items.description: Video tutorial for making clothespin doll by Robert Mahar.

items.title: Robert's Crepe Paper Carnations
items.description: Robert demonstrates how to make crepe paper carnations.

items.title: Robert's Recycled Seed Starter Pots
items.description: What do you do with your home trashes? Here is a nice DIY with these home trashes. Robert is guiding you to make Recycled Seed Starter Pots.

items.title: Robert's Crayon Cupcakes and Candy Bars
items.description: Robert is going to show how you can make your custom shape crayon that look like miniature cupcake and full size candy bars.

items.title: Robert's Dominoes Set (Father's Day DIY)
items.description: This video tutorial shows the process of making father day's special Dominoes Set.

items.title: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Casserole
items.description: Home cooks from the Kin Community demonstrate easy meals that will please the whole family

items.title: Holiday Decorated Sugar Cookies
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Eat them. Gift them. Make them into ornaments. You'll definitely get a bang for your buck with these delicious and versatile sugar cookies. . What are you waiting for? Get the little ones in the kitchen and get baking! Happy holidays!

items.title: Caramel Corn with Toasted Hazelnuts
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com) says: The perfect gift to make for family and friends around the holidays, because it's fairly inexpensive and can be dressed up with pretty packaging. And who doesn't love a homemade gift? (Especially one that tastes this good!) Happy holidays!

items.title: Spicy Shrimp Scampi with Crostini Recipe
items.description: Having dinner guests this weekend? Try this quick and easy shrimp scampi recipe and wow your guests. It's the perfect communal dish served with crostini. Watch as Jenny Park of http://spoonforkbacon.com demonstrates. Mangia!

items.title: Garlic Steamed Mussels Recipe
items.description: Have you ever tried to make mussels at home? We strongly suggest you try it. This delectable dish from Whitney Webster is one of the easiest recipes you could ever attempt and it's sure to impress your guests! Don't forget to soak up that garlic and wine broth with your crusty bread...it's the best part!

items.title: Star Anise & Cinnamon Infused Eggnog
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Tis the season for friends, family, and a delicious glass of egg nog! Don't make the mistake of serving a store-bought variety. This festive holiday cocktail is actually quite easy to prepare, and you'll love this recipe which adds a little spice with the addition of star anise and cinnamon. Bottoms up! Cheers!

items.title: Pomegranate Champagne Cocktail Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Looking for a way to jazz up the bubbly this new year's eve? Try this refreshing take on a champagne cocktail that incorporates pomegranate seeds and brandy. This cocktail is easy to make and tasty, too! It's the perfect way to ring in the new year. 3...2...1... Cheers!

items.title: Roasted Eggplant Roulade
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): For my non-meat eating friends, this is a dish I like to serve that makes them feel special. It looks like something that took a lot of time, but with a few short-cuts and a simple rolling technique, you'll have a welcoming dish that everyone will enjoy.

items.title: Cherry Tomato Tart Appetizer
items.description: Need a quick and beautiful appetizer for your next cocktail party? or maybe a hearty finger food to serve with a bowl of soup? This simple tomato tart is a colorful, delicious treat...give it a try!

items.title: Chocolate Coconut Macaroons
items.description: Jenny Park of http://spoonforkbacon.com says: I find the tendency during the holidays is to spend a lot of money on fancy desserts when entertaining. But these cookie can be made for just under $10 and the recipe makes 20! So, grab a friend and spend a lazy afternoon in the kitchen baking.

items.title: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Roasting a whole chicken may seem intimidating to a home cook, but it really couldn't be easier. It's just a few easy steps to prep the bird and into the oven it goes. Not to mention, the leftovers can be used for lunches and dinners in the subsequent days. It's a meal that just keeps on giving!

items.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Who can deny the popularity and tastiness of a piping hot spinach and artichoke dip? It's a snap to prepare and rich in flavor so it's not surprise that it's a party staple. Our tip: ditch the carbs and serve it alongside fresh cut veggies.

items.title: Homemade Chocolate Truffles
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Chocolate truffles are perfect for holiday parties and make great gifts because they are so versatile. Once you've made the chocolate ball, you can coat them in just about any topping -- shredded coconut, chopped nuts, cocoa powder. Just be sure to save some for yourself because they'll go fast! Happy holidays!

items.title: Turkey Panini Sandwich Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): A lazy weekday dinner doesn't have to mean deciding between cheap take-out or microwaving a packaged dinner tray. You'll be surprised how fast you can whip up this delicious turkey panini. All the ingredients can be purchased at your supermarket and it only takes a few minutes to build your sandwich. Buon appetito!

items.title: Snickerdoodle Cookies Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Next time your kids are begging you for homemade cookies, try these. Snickerdoodles are a classic cookie. I like them because they are not too sweet. Just the right amount of sugar and cinnamon to please any sweet tooth. And the best part is they can help. Have them roll the dough into balls and then roll in the sugar mixture. It's the perfect job for little hands.

items.title: Beef Bourguignon Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Beef Bourguignon may seem like an intimidating dish. Perhaps one that you would have at a fancy French bistro with a glass of red wine or one that only Julia Child could tackle ... but it's actually quite simple to prepare and best of all it can be done in one pot! C'est magnifique!

items.title: Herb Deviled Eggs Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): I know, deviled eggs are pretty retro, but IMO they deserve a second chance. I give them a modern spin by brightening them up with fresh herbs and spices. They're also fun for the holidays because they look so fancy. And strangely they're the first to go at parties. I guess they have staying power for a reason. Enjoy!

items.title: Bourbon Spiked Mulled Apple Cider
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com) says: Mulled apple cider is a classic holiday drink. But we say, skip the pre-packaged sachets and make your own. It's quick, easy and so very festive!

items.title: Spinach Linguini with Sun Dried Tomatoes Recipe
items.description: Here's a great pasta recipe that has all the flair of a restaurant dish, but is easy to make at home. The spinach, goat cheese, and sun dried tomatoes pack this dish full of flavor but are friendly to the waistline. It's perfect for a weeknight meal.

items.title: The Perfect Omelette with Arugula
items.description: Beth Le Manach shares her tips on making a perfect omelette. Of course, you can enjoy the omelette for breakfast or brunch, but don't count it out when it comes to lunch or dinner, especially if you're looking to whip something up quickly. Enjoy!

items.title: Brie Pecan Fig Jam Crostini Recipe
items.description: Beth Le Manach ( http://www.youtube.com/KinCommunity ): The idea for this dish began with a humble jar of fig jam. I added a few culinary complements and voila! A crowd-pleasing appetizer was born. It's so simple and elegant that you'll make this your go-to entertaining dish!

items.title: Beth's Herb Roasted Pork Loin Recipe
items.description: Beth Le Manach: This is a great Sunday night dinner. It's a hearty one-pot meal and, best of all, there's usually enough for leftovers! That means you cook once, but eat twice. Now, that's smart cooking. Hope you enjoy the recipe!

items.title: Spinach Tortellini, Pesto & Peas Recipe
items.description: Some times a lazy night dinner made from frozen foods and pantry staples can be a delicious treat. Just like this super simple and super delicious tortellini dish by Beth Le Manach. It's easy to whip up and is a family pleaser! Yum!

items.title: Smoked Salmon on Toast Points
items.description: Beth Le Manach: I didn't always love smoked salmon. In fact, it took a Christmas dinner with my in-laws (in France!) for me to discover how much I love it. Now, I find that it's the perfect dish for festive occasions and also a simple and delicious solution to lazy night dinners. Just toast a few slices of bread, whip up an easy crème fraîche, and voila! Dinner is served.

items.title: Mommy's Mac and Cheese
items.description: Let's face it, if we gave our kids the option, they'd probably eat mac and cheese for every meal. This recipe uses real ingredients like milk, peas, brown rice pasta and REAL cheese -- not the bright orange powder that comes in a packet. The best part it is it doesn't take much longer to prepare than the boxed varieties. Now that's what you call a win-win!

items.title: Antipasto Platter Appetizer
items.description: Beth Le Manach says: For me, the most stressful part of entertaining is that moment when guests arrive. They end up gathering in the kitchen while I'm trying to get the dinner ready. And if you have an open kitchen, it's even worse. So, I've devised this handy little appetizer platter that keeps guests busy and in their seats! :) (Trust me, it works!)

items.title: Olive Stuffed Cheese Puffs
items.description: Dana Joy Altma says: When I had my first grown-up party, this is the appetizer I served. It comes from my mom, who served these when I was growing up. It reminds me of her glamorous cocktail parties of the 70’s. It's the perfect little bit to serve with a glass of chilled wine.

items.title: Middle Eastern Chicken Wraps
items.description: This lazy dinner idea from Dana Joy Altman is such a winner. Just roll up some rotisserie chicken and veggies in a pita, slather on some lemon tahini sauce (the magic ingredient) and enjoy! We don't know about you, but we're sold!

items.title: Chocolate Dessert Board: Party Platter
items.description: Dana Joy Altman: Tis the season for entertaining ... which means you're probably tired of preparing elaborate appetizers, entrees and desserts, right? Well, this chocolate board is just thing you need for your next party. It's a no-cook, easy to prep dessert platter that is also unique and delicious.

items.title: Red Lentil & Rice Soup Vegan Recipe
items.description: Dana Joy Altma: This is a great one-pot comfort meal. It's a flavorful and seemingly exotic lentil and rice soup that can be garnished to please any diner's palette. Also, it's a vegetarian (vegan, even) dish that is both filling and tasty. So, your omnivore friends won't miss the meat. It's okay if you don't want to share. The leftovers are just as delicious! Enjoy.

items.title: Healthy Apple Banana Smoothie
items.description: Dana Joy Altman: Sugar here. Sugar there. Sugar is everywhere these days ... and your kid is happily eating it. Maybe even craving it. Here is a great smoothie recipe that tastes as sweet as their favorite sugary treat but has none of that refined stuff. They'll never what they're missing and you'll be happy knowing that they're eating -- or rather drinking -- healthy!

items.title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
items.description: Salads are generally not hearty enough for dinner. I think we can agree on that, right? At least not the healthy ones -- you know, the ones without the fried chicken pieces and the ranch dressing and the bleu cheese crumbles. Well, Pace Webb of http://tasteofpace.blogspot.com provides the exception with this recipe. By roasting seasonal vegetables and combining them with chick peas and shaved parmesan, this salad is in fact warm, filling and quite hearty. It's also perfect for those lazy nights when you just don't feel like cooking up a big meal.

items.title: Gourmet Mac N Cheese
items.description: If you ask any kid what their favorite dish is, chances are they'll say mac 'n cheese. I wanted to make a version that had a little more nutrition to it, but also add some sophisticated flavors for the parents. I think this is a winning combination that everyone in the family can enjoy. Let me know what you think!

items.title: Lamb Stew
items.description: Lamb may not be the first choice of meat for most people, but it's quite tasty if you give it a chance. This stew is a perfect introduction to lamb. It's a delicious comfort dish, and braising the lamb in red wine helps get rid of the gamey taste that turn people off of it. Also, it's basically a one pot meal which means it's fairly easy to cook and a breeze to clean up!

items.title: Veggie Frittata with Goat Cheese
items.description: Pace Webb: This is my favorite Christmas morning breakfast because I can make it the day ahead. It's filling, but light enough so I can enjoy a big family meal later in the day. The dish can be served slightly warmed or at room temperature so you can take your time opening gifts in the morning! Happy Holidays!

items.title: Acai Champagne Cocktail
items.description: This is a refreshing and bright take on a champagne cocktail. It's simple to prepare. You make it right in the glass so no messy shakers. Best of all, it only uses three ingredients: champagne, acai juice which adds a nice berry flavor (and is also good for you!), and fresh squeezed lime which balances the sweetness. It's the perfect cocktail for a party or even a lazy Sunday brunch. Cheers!

items.title: Grilled Vegetable Pizza
items.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com): My husband loves pizza, but pizza delivery gets pretty expensive ... not to mention all the added calories! So, I created this healthy alternative using simple ingredients and store-bought dough. This recipe is the perfect weeknight meal. It's quick and easy to make and a great alternative to delivery. Your kids - and picky eater hubbies - will love it!

items.title: Kahlua Peppermint Coffee Cups
items.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com) says: With all the hustle and bustle of the holiday season, I love to serve festive drinks that can double as a pick-me-up. This drink is kind of like an adult hot cocoa. The coffee in it will perk you up, and with a good dose of Kahlua, it will settle your holiday nerves. Bottoms up!

items.title: White Chocolate Ginger Mice Truffles
items.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com): This is a fun twist on homemade truffles. It uses a basic recipe, but instead of shaping the truffle into a standard sphere, they become cute, playful mice. It's the perfect treat to prepare with friends or family, especially little ones, and they make a great gift!

items.title: Pulled Pork Sliders
items.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com) says: I nicknamed this dish 'ZZ Top Pulled Pork' -- mostly because it's a dish that is inspired by my Texas-born husband. He likes his southern pork, rock 'n roll, and good times. Rock on…

items.title: Corn Chowder In Mini Bread Bowls
items.description: Not every recipe has to break the bank. In fact, some can give you a bang for your buck. Sienna DeGovia's ( http://siennacake.com ) corn chowder is the perfect example. You can make an entire pot of warm, hearty soup for a big family dinner or a single meal with leftovers. It's a one-pot meal that keeps on giving. Yum!

items.title: Broccoli and Cheese Casserole
items.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): As with any great casserole, this broccoli and cheese bread pudding is a delicious, family-friendly dish that uses simple ingredients but makes for a satisfying and hearty dish. It's perfect for a weeknight meal or for a casual dinner party.

items.title: ChocoloEveryday Cookie
items.description: This is a great everyday cookie recipe in that you can make it any ole day of the week ... and it's also okay to enjoy them every day of the week! The recipe calls for oat flour and eliminates the butter and eggs. You can easily make this cookie gluten-free and vegan as well. Give them a try.

items.title: Vanilla Roasted Fruit
items.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): This is a sweet treat that's actually friendly to your waistline. The trick here is fresh vanilla bean. Vanilla is a great low calorie, rich tasting ingredient that will leaving you feeling like you've enjoyed a decadent creamy treat but without the need to hit the treadmill afterwards.

items.title: Sheet Pan Chicken
items.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): Sheet pan chicken is one of those lazy -- and super affordable -- recipes that is easy to prepare and is quite delicious to eat. Basically, it's the crown jewel in your weeknight culinary oeuvre. The secret is in the chicken thighs. Remember: “the chicken thigh never dies.” Happy cooking!

items.title: Triple Berry Danish Cheesecake
items.description: This dessert tastes like the best part of a cheese danish. You know, the ooey gooey center part that's both creamy and cake-y. Basically, it's heaven on a plate. Mmmm....

items.title: Baked Bacon Candy
items.description: Kelly Bryon Pearce: This is a super simple recipe. It only calls for two ingredients -- bacon and sugar. The two best ingredients in any food, right? You'll be amazed how delicious this sweet and savory treat is. It's truly a crowd-pleaser and perfect for your game day party! Goooo team!

items.title: Banana French Toast
items.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: Saturday mornings are the best! Our family gets to sleep in, spend quality time together ... in our pajamas, and, best of all, we get to make and enjoy a delicious, hearty breakfast. Our favorite go-to meal is French toast with bananas and whipped cream. Mmm... Here's to the weekend!

items.title: Skinny Margarita Cocktail
items.description: Just a few fresh ingredients and a quality tequila is all that is needed for some great margaritas. Try Kelly’s Skinny margarita cocktail. Cheers!

items.title: Couscous Recipe with Sausage and Feta Cheese
items.description: Couscous is generally seen in many side dishes, but did you know that it can make a hearty and delicious entree as well? Kelly Bryson Pearce shares her recipe for a filling couscous dish that is prepared with sausage, onion and feta! Brilliant!

items.title: Kelly's Red Berry Trifle No Bake Dessert Recipe
items.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: Baking can seem like a daunting task. Between the exact ingredients and precise measurements, it sometimes starts to feel more like a science project than a fun afternoon of cooking. On those days, this no-bake trifle is the perfect solution. It uses store bought angel food cake and a few other ingredients to create a sophisticated looking dessert that is absolutely delicious!

items.title: Homemade Chex Mix
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Homemade Chex Mix is one of those foods that is so easy to throw together, and something everyone always seems to love. It's no wonder why it's been a party staple for generations! Try making a batch for your next get together.

items.title: Lobster Ravioli with Tarragon Cream Sauce Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): This is one of my favorite recipes to throw together when I don't have a lot of time to cook dinner. It's quick, easy and delicious, plus it's a great crowd pleaser for small get togethers.

items.title: Pound Cake Topped with Toffee Sauce & Pecans
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Move over, Sandra Lee! We have a semi-homemade treat that is dressed to impress ... dressed with a layer of ooey gooey toffee sauce, that is. Try this dessert for your next dinner party and your guests won't even notice you didn't plan a tablescape. Yum!

items.title: Mushroom and Roasted Pepper Quesadilla
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Sometimes after a long day of work you just want to cook and eat something that's low maintenance, but satisfying. We've all been there, right? Well, this recipe is exactly the go-to recipe you need when you're in that kind of mood. You're welcome ,)

items.title: Ham & Cheese Crescent Rolls
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Ham and cheese crescent rolls are a fun recipe that parents can make with their little ones. They look cute and taste delicious, which makes them a great snack for kids ... and adults love them, too! They also make a great finger food for parties. Just be sure to make enough because they'll go fast!

items.title: Vegetarian Chili Recipe
items.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): This is a recipe I dedicate to my sister, the vegetarian of the family. I think this is a great recipe to satisfy both meat lovers and vegetarians alike. It's a hearty chili, filled with vegetables, spices and three different kinds of beans. Enjoy!

items.title: Mexican Quinoa Salad
items.description: This easy and healthy recipe by Jenny Park is one you can feel good about. It's high in protein, filled with vegetables, and packed with flavor! Happy eating!

items.title: Banana Nut Pancakes Recipe
items.description: Pancakes for breakfast may seem like a weekend luxury -- and they definitely should be -- but we think you should be able to enjoy them during the week as well! Liesl Maggiore shares a great pancake recipe that's both delicious and healthy. Her best tip: make a big batch on the weekends and refrigerate the rest for a weekday breakfast. Just pop them in the toaster oven or microwave and voila!

items.title: Linguine with Prosciutto and Brown Butter Sauce
items.description: Liesl Maggiore shares this easy and scrumptious recipe that is chock full of ingredients that both kids and adults LOVE -- pasta, butter and cheese! The secret is in the butter which you brown (not burn). You'll love the rich, nutty flavor it adds to the dish. Enjoy!

items.title: Liesl's Homemade Chicken Fingers Recipe
items.description: Liesl Maggiore: This is one of my favorite dishes of all time. Its clean flavors and textures are classic and simple: good quality chicken, crunchy panko coating with flavorful aged parmesan, tart lemon and peppery arugula.

items.title: Blood Orange Almond Rice Pilaf
items.description: Liesl Maggiore: I am a huge fan of adding seasonal ingredients to spice up otherwise kind bland foods like rice, couscous, or quinoa. Right now blood oranges are just amazing, and I love to use them when they are in season. In this recipe, I added them to a basic rice pilaf with some crunchy toasted almonds for texture ... you can serve this as a side dish with just about anything!

items.title: Farro Veggie Risotto Recipe
items.description: Jess Dang (http://www.cooksmarts.com): This recipe is incredibly versatile and the zucchini can be swapped with a whole range of vegetables, such as chopped up broccolini, eggplant, asparagus, beans, etc. The protein can also be substituted for other vegetarian proteins like diced tofu or meat proteins such as grilled chicken breast.

items.title: Tortellini with Smoked Salmon, Crème Fraîche Recipe
items.description: We called for your favorite recipes and you all responded with such yummy dishes! Here is a tasty one from Sabrina -- http://www.youtube.com/Nemien09 -- who hails from Norway! She created this dish using left-over smoked salmon from Christmas. And we're so glad she did because it looks amazing! Takk, Sabrina!

items.title: Easy Lasagna Recipe
items.description: Subscriber sweetfactory20 asked for our take on a weeknight lasagna and we think this will definitely please. Layers of store bought sauce, no boil lasagna sheets, and a delicious cheese mix make this casserole a hearty dish that is easy to prepare and a quick family favorite.

items.title: White Bean & Butternut Squash Soup Recipe
items.description: A simple but hearty white bean and butternut squash soup. It's the perfect one-pot meal for a lazy night and so delicious!

items.title: Easy Osso Bucco with Gremolata
items.description: An Osso Bucco recipe that does not take as much effort as you think, It’ a grand meal and hearty. Yum

items.title: Spicy Crab and Artichoke Dip Recipe
items.description: The big game is quickly approaching. What will you be making to feed your favorite football fans? Subscriber Samantha from Alaska ( http://www.youtube.com/dianau333 ) shares a great recipe that's perfect for parties. Forget your standard ho-hum artichoke dip and follow Samantha's lead. Add fresh crab and spice it up with a little sriracha! Now, that's a touchdown!

items.title: Chocolate Ganache Cake with Strawberry Frosting
items.description: Will you be our valentine? No, seriously. Since we launched Kin Community a few months ago, we've been overwhelmed by your inspiring comments and your enthusiasm for our videos. We are moved by your devotion and we want you to know that we love you, too! So, here's a tasty treat from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you for watching and stay tuned for more! Happy Valentine's Day! xoxo

items.title: Pot of Gold St. Patrick's Day Dessert
items.description: There are so many other ways we can celebrate this festive Irish holiday that don't involve green food coloring. For example, take Sienna's delicious pot de chocolat recipe which can be turned into a cheeky pot of gold. Now that's cute AND delicious. So, step away that bottle of edible dye and give this tasty treat a try! Happy St. Patty's Day!

items.title: Homemade Marshmallow Bunnies
items.description: No treat says "Easter" quite like those little sugar coated marshmallow bunnies. This homemade version is much healthier than the store bought kind...and what an adorable, fun project! Try them out!

items.title: Grandma's Cheesecake
items.description: We love this rich, decadent cheesecake recipe from Sienna. It's got that traditional graham cracker crust and all the creamy flavors you want in a cheesecake...and it's topped with her grandmother's secret weapon! Beautiful and delicious!

items.title: Strawberry Shortcake with Homemade Biscuits Recipe
items.description: Sweet, tangy strawberries...smooth, creamy whipped cream...and light, fluffy biscuits...simply irresistible! Sienna shows us the secret to perfect homemade biscuits. Thanks Sienna!

items.title: Chocolate Cream Pie
items.description: Here's another delicious recipe inspired by this year's Academy Awards. If you've seen Best Picture nominee "The Help" then you'll know there is a very special pie in the film. Don't worry, this version eliminates Minny's 'special ingredient'. Instead, you'll love the added crunch of the Heath bar. Mmmm...

items.title: Fried Mac 'n Cheese "Moneyballs"
items.description: We asked for recipes inspired by this year's Academy Award nominees and subscriber saltcatering (http://www.youtube.com/saltcatering ) answered with a cheeky recipe for fried mac and cheese nuggets called ... Moneyballs. Get it!? Well, we love it! It's macaroni and cheese. It's fried. It's coated in panko crumbs. It really doesn't get much better! Fry up some of these babies for your Oscar party and you'll be awarded Best Host!

items.title: Cucumber Mint Absinthe Cocktail
items.description: This cool and refreshing cocktail is inspired by Best Picture nominee "Midnight in Paris". Woody Allen brought the sights and sounds of 1920's Paris to life in this darling film, and now we're giving you a taste of it! Try serving this easy-to-make cocktail at your Oscars party. Cheers!

items.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
items.description: This hearty pasta recipe is great for a family dinner because both the kids and the adults will love this comfort dish. Let us know what you think!

items.title: Grilled Cheese Skewer Recipe
items.description: Skewers are always a fun finger food... and really, who doesn't love grilled cheese? This recipe combines both! Try these colorful skewers when you need a quick and easy appetizer to serve at a BBQ, a cocktail party or really, any night of the week!

items.title: Chocolate Banana Bourbon Crepes
items.description: Adrianna Adarme (http://acozykitchen.com) thinks crepes are the perfect culinary homage to Best Picture nominee "Hugo". However, her twist on the crepe introduces bananas sautéed in brown sugar and bourbon. YUM!

items.title: Banana Bread with Blueberry and Oats
items.description: Adrianna Adarme (http://acozykitchen.com) shares a delicious recipe for banana bread. Her twist includes blueberries and oats which makes this loaf a powerhouse for nutrition. Bake one this weekend and you'll be looking forward to your breakfast every day next week!

items.title: Arroz Con Pollo: Chicken with Rice Recipe
items.description: Adrianna Adarme of (http://acozykitchen.com) shares a family heirloom recipe for Arroz Con Pollo. This one-pot meal is a true comfort food that is easy to make and quite tasty. Spice up your next chicken dinner with Adrianna's recipe!

items.title: Eggs In Spicy Tomato Sauce
items.description: Eggs aren't just for breakfast, they're also the ultimate “fast food” when you need to whip up a quick meal. So go ahead.. add a little spice to your week nights with this go-to egg recipe from Adrianna Adarme. It's a great one to add to the rotation!

items.title: Cinnamon Bun Pancakes
items.description: This recipe has some serious WOW factor! If you like to start your day with over-the-top, sweet, ooey-gooey JOY...this is the dish for you! It combines all the flavors of a cinnamon bun with the light, fluffy texture of pancakes. But lets face it, that GLAZE is the real star of the show! We dare you not to try this one :)

items.title: Easy Matzo Ball Soup
items.description: Passover is coming up and many people will be serving delicious, traditional Matzo Ball soup. So get in on the action! This recipe gives you a few short cuts to create that warm, comforting broth and those light fluffy matzo balls in a fraction of the time! It doesn't have to be Passover to enjoy this dish...who doesn't love chicken soup? Give it a shot.

items.title: Cheddar Apple Pies
items.description: This warm, cozy, comforting recipe is a whimsical take on all American apple pie. Why not skip some steps and bake it right IN the apple!? Plus, this one has some yummy southern flare with the addition of sharp cheddar cheese. It's one part baked apple...one part apple pie...all parts delicious! Give it a try and tell us what you think.

items.title: Easter Basket Salad Cups
items.description: Looking for the perfect recipe to serve this Easter? You've got to try these edible Easter Baskets! This is NOT your basic side salad.These beautiful “baskets” are filled with healthy Spring veggies, slathered with a scrumptious vinaigrette and they even have cute little handles! Come on...you have to admit these are pretty adorable!

items.title: Honey Glazed Carrots with Orange and Thyme
items.description: When you need a bright, beautiful side dish with sweet, bold flavors...look no further than these honey glazed carrots. They are such a breeze to whip up and couldn't be more delicious. This recipe really says 'Spring'...we love it!

items.title: Asian Chicken Meatballs
items.description: Asian chicken meatballs - the perfect appetizer for your next event!

items.title: Spring Veggie Orzo
items.description: Spring is such a great time to incorporate fresh, flavorful veggies into as many dishes as you can. This orzo recipe is filled with bright green vegetables, creamy feta and crunchy almonds. Serve it as a delicious vegetarian entree or it makes the perfect side dish for any meat. Enjoy!

items.title: Baked Scallops with Spanish Ham
items.description: These elegant baked scallops from Louise Leonard of thelusherie.com are are a beautiful, impressive dish to serve for any nice occasion. Seafood and Spanish Ham is a match made in heaven. Enjoy!

items.title: Bathtub Gin Cocktail
items.description: Looking to get creative with your cocktails? Try this lavender infused gin recipe...it's light, refreshing and it smells amazing! Why stick with beer and wine when you can offer your friends a specialty drink with some serious flare!

items.title: Ricotta Cheese Recipe
items.description: Cheese is one of those fridge staples that we all pick up at the store, but you might be shocked to see how easy it is to make from scratch! Whitney Webster shows us her simple recipe for light, fluffy creamy ricotta cheese right in your own kitchen! Spoon it on top of grilled peaches with balsamic glaze...mmmmm, a summertime delight!

items.title: Potato Cakes with Goat Cheese & Thyme
items.description: As far as easy, impressive appetizers go...this is a MUST MAKE! It's sophisticated, stunning and simply delicious. The cute little stacks of purple potatoes are perfectly complimented by the creamy goat cheese and a sprig if thyme. Serve this earthy dish to your guests at your next party and watch them delight in every last drop!

items.title: Lamb Chops with Cilantro, Mint & Honey Sauce
items.description: Want to impress someone? How about trying this lamb dish.

items.title: Roasted Tomato & Basil Soup Recipe
items.description: There's nothing more comforting than a classic roasted tomato soup, especially as the weather turns and there's a chill in the air. This recipe is easy and delicious, and definitely a dish worth making from scratch. Enjoy!

items.title: Spicy Mama Cocktail Recipe
items.description: Whitney Webster says ditch the beer and wine and serve your guests a specialty cocktail. This one is sweet and sour with some serious KICK and it's beautiful too! Add some flare to your next party with this spicy mama!

items.title: Brie w/ Brown Sugar, Maple Syrup & Pecans Recipe
items.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: The next time you entertain, you HAVE to try this amazing appetizer. There isn't even any cooking involved, it's just an easy to assemble party platter of pure JOY! It's Warm, Ooey, gooey cheese covered in sweet syrup and crunchy pecans...serve it up with fresh fruit and a sliced baguette and watch your guests go nuts for it!

items.title: How To Make Homemade Whipped Cream
items.description: Yes, it's easy to pick up whipped cream at the store...but this is seriously one of the fastest things you could ever make from scratch and the fresh kind is really SO much better!

items.title: How to Cook Artichokes
items.description: Artichokes are delicious! But if you've never worked with them before...they can sharp, tough and a little daunting! Louise Leonard is back to show you how to properly prep and cook this green, leafy vegetable.

items.title: 2 Ways To Cut A Mango
items.description: Mangos are sweet, beautiful and delicious! But the flesh tends to cling to the pit and can be difficult to get off. Whether you prefer nice thin slices or perfect little cubes...Louise Leonard shows you two fail proof ways to cut this tropical fruit.

items.title: How To Cook Eggs
items.description: There are many ways to cook an egg! It's not hard at all, but there's a definite technique to the different styles...eggs over easy, sunny side up, poached, etc. Louise Leonard gives a quick tutorial on how to cook your eggs perfectly every time. Thanks Louise for more great tips!

items.title: Braised Chicken Thighs
items.description: Who doesn't love a creamy, inexpensive one pot wonder? This one from Louise Leonard will have your mouth watering! The braised chicken with yellow raisins, pearl onions with a touch of cream is such a satisfying flavor combination. Simply Divine!

items.title: Strawberry Rhubarb Fool Recipe
items.description: Looking for a unique dessert that's bursting with bright flavors? Louise Leonard shares this creamy, delicious recipe that pairs fresh rhubarb and sweet strawberries with homemade whipped cream. Is it a parfait?...is it a sundae? You decide!

items.title: Bloody Mary with Dark Lager Malt Beer Recipe
items.description: The classic bloody Mary is a “go to cocktail” for weekend mornings. This pumped up version from Louise Leonard has so many good ingredients in it...it's like a meal in itself! Try it out at your next brunch or any time you want a fun cocktail!

items.title: Chocolate Stout Float With Homemade Peanut Butter Ice Cream
items.description: Move over root beer float...there's a new float in town! Louise shares her amazing recipe for a chocolate stout float with homemade peanut butter ice cream and chocolate dipped pretzels. WOW! It's rich, creamy, decadent and definitely a whole new way to enjoy a float!

items.title: Beer Brats Perfect BBQ Dish Recipe
items.description: As if beer brats on a warm roll with spicy mustard weren't already scrumptious enough...Louise Leonard kicks them up a notch by soaking them in beer! Check out her hometown recipe with pickled onions....it's the perfect BBQ dish!

items.title: Scandinavian Gravlax - Salmon Recipe
items.description: Gravlax is a Scandinavian dish usually served as an appetizer or it's perfect for brunch! It's a beautiful piece of Salmon cured with salt, sugar and herbs...then thinly sliced and paired with bagels, dill, capers, etc. This is something most people buy at the store, but Louise Leonard says it's worth it to make it at home! Curing the fish is not as hard as you might think and the amazing flavors make it well worth the effort.

items.title: How To Cut an Apple
items.description: Whether you're slicing or dicing... Louise Leonard is back to show you two easy ways to cut an apple properly.

items.title: How to Cut A Pepper
items.description: Peppers are colorful, delicious and can be used in a wide range of recipes. Louise Leonard shows you how to properly clean and dice this versatile veggie!

items.title: Recipe For A Magical Mother's Day Morning
items.description: Want to make Mother's Day as special as possible for the mom in your life? You don't need to get fancy, It's the simple things that truly mean the most. A basic breakfast made with love...hand made cards and plenty of snuggles. Nothing can beat that.

items.title: Greek Style 7 Layer Dip Recipe
items.description: If you love Mexican 7 layer dip with tortilla chips...this is the Greek version served with Pita chips! It's layer upon layer of delicious Greek spreads topped with fresh veggies and zesty herbs. This appetizer could not be easier to put together and it's something really unique to serve to your guests. Try it out!

items.title: How To Make Lime Sorbet Margaritas
items.description: This sweet, refreshing recipe is part cocktail, part dessert....and totally delicious! You can use Tequila if you're making them for adults only or sub in some lime soda if kids will be joining you. Either way, you can't go wrong! Try these out the next time you need an elegant summer treat to serve your guests.

items.title: Apple Nachos
items.description: This dish is a really fun take on classic nachos. Instead of tortilla chips and cheese, you use green apples and top them with all sorts of sweet, gooey treats! Yes, they're completely decadent...but hey, at least you're starting with fresh fruit, right? This is a good one for both kids and parents, you really can't go wrong.

items.title: Avocado Bruschetta
items.description: Kelly shares her easy to make and assemble Avocado Bruschetta. It is light and delicious and you should give it a try!

items.title: Creamy Sausage Gravy Recipe
items.description: This hearty, comforting dish is basically a modern twist on classic biscuits and gravy. It's super simple to make and couldn't be more satisfying...give it a try!

items.title: How To Make Miso Salmon
items.description: This mouthwatering recipe from Louise Leonard is much more than your basic fish and veggies. The unique flavors and creative preparation really make this dish something special...give it a try!

items.title: Mint Julep Cocktail Bourbon Classic Recipe
items.description: There's only one cocktail you should enjoy on Derby weekend...and that's the classic mint julep! Louise Leonard shows you how to whip up this sweet, minty southern specialty. Get ready to get your Bourbon on!

items.title: How To make Cardamom Rice Pudding
items.description: Louise Leonard gives us a delicious twist on classic rice pudding by adding cardamom, raisins and mango. This creamy dessert has plenty of sweet and a hint of spice...it's sure to please!

items.title: How To Make Baked Curry Fries
items.description: If you love fries (and really, who doesn't??) you won't want to miss this recipe from Louise Leonard. These zesty, curry fries are baked instead of fried, so they're a bit healthier...but the spicy orange ketchup makes them burst with flavor. YUM!

items.title: How To Make An Avocado Milkshake
items.description: Louise Leonard shares her recipe for a smooth, creamy milkshake with an unexpected ingredient...avocado! Try this one out, it's healthy and delicious!

items.title: Watermelon Margarita
items.description: If you're a fan of margaritas, you'll really love this fun twist on the classic cocktail that includes fresh watermelon. It's light, refreshing and the perfect way to celebrate on a beautiful spring or summer day. Cheers!

items.title: Blueberry Cream Cheese Puff Pastry
items.description: If you love tangy blueberries, luscious cream cheese and warm, flaky puff pastry...you won't want to miss this yummy dessert recipe from Louise Leonard. It would even make a good breakfast if you're feeling the need to indulge!

items.title: Ultimate Breakfast Sandwich
items.description: This warm, cheesy egg sandwich is a "go to" weekend breakfast for Liesl and her family. It's got salty meat, fresh arugula and a dash of hot sauce at the end for some kick. Try this one out for breakfast or dinner, it's a winner!

items.title: How To Make Chicken Paillards
items.description: Everybody needs a few great recipes that only require five ingredients and 15 minutes or less to prepare. Life is busy and shortcuts like that are a must! This one from Liesl Maggiore is really fast, but packed with fresh ingredients and bright flavors. Add it to your week night mix and save the extra time for something else!

items.title: How To Make Homemade Buttermilk Ranch Dressing
items.description: Liesl Maggiore shows you how to make fresh, tangy, homemade buttermilk ranch. This super simple dressing is much healthier than the store bought kind...and it's perfect for salads or dipping. She pairs it with an amazing BBQ chicken salad that you won't want to miss. Put this one on your summer menu!

items.title: How To Make Fresh Berry Frozen Yogurt Pops
items.description: Summer's here and what better treat to give your kids (or enjoy yourself!) on a hot day than a perfectly delicious Popsicle? These healthy pops from Liesl Maggiore are made with fresh berries and yogurt...they're cold, creamy and delicious!

items.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Skewers

items.title: Whiskey Spiked Arnold Palmer

items.title: How To Make Red Curry Shrimp
items.description: Cooking is such a creative process and it's always fun to branch out and try new ingredients. If you're not too familiar with coconut milk and curry...you should be! This recipe from Jess Dang really is a must try! It's sweet and spicy...warm and comforting...and it couldn't be easier to make. Enjoy!

items.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
items.description: These delicious lettuce cups from Jess Dang are filled with chicken in a scrumptious sauce and topped with fresh mint. They make the perfect appetizer or a really nice, light dinner as well. They're especially great for anyone trying to watch their carbs!

items.title: How To Make Ice Cream Sandwiches
items.description: Who doesn't love a good old fashioned ice-cream sandwich? The sky's the limit when it comes to different cookie, ice cream and topping combos you could experiment with...and as Jess Dang says, they bring you right back to your childhood! This simple dessert really is the perfect treat for your whole family or a fun way to end a dinner party. So what are you waiting for?

items.title: How To Make Homemade Berry Vinaigrette Dressing
items.description: Why buy salad dressing at the market when it's SO easy to make at home!? This sweet, berry vinaigrette from Jess Dang is the perfect dressing to keep in your fridge all week. It's light and tangy...the perfect topping for a summer salad. Enjoy! Berry Vinaigrette
