items.description: Join Samantha Kurtzman-Counter, from The Mother Company (www.themotherco.com), as she shares her prescription for "multi-tasking fatigue". Enter, "Special TIme", a technique all busy Moms should try!

items.title: How Cooking Can Instill Self-Confidence
items.description: Join Samantha Kurtzman-Counter, from The Mother Company http://www.themotherco.com, as she shares the rewards of allowing kids to "experiment" in the kitchen.

items.title: Room Tour: Jacks Room
items.description: Join Samantha Kurtzman-Counter, from The Mother Company (http://www.themotherco.com), as she takes you on a tour of her son's bedroom. A creative space that will grow with him!

items.title: Room Tour: Jack's Art Room
items.description: Join Samantha Kurtzman-Counter, from The Mother Company www.themotherco.com, as she takes you on a tour of her son's Art Room. It certainly has us at Kin "second guessing" the TV Room!

items.title: MOMPRENEUR: The Mother Company
items.description: Find out how two mothers started a company to promote social and emotional learning in children. Abbie Schiller CEO/Founder and Samantha Kurtzman-Counter President of The Mother Company www.themotherco.com share how they started this fascinating company in order to help parents "raise better people".

items.title: This Mom Reccomends: Book Tree
items.description: All Moms have their favorite products, companies and services that make their life "work". Kelly Bryson-Pearce shares her secret weapon: The Book Tree!

items.title: How to Make Snacks & Favors for an Art Party
items.description: Consider throwing an art themed birthday party for your kiddo! The activity possibilities are endless - play dough, finger paints, sidewalk chalk. Pair them with these cute 'paint brush' treats and 'paint can' favors and you'll create a masterpiece!

items.title: How to Make Sidewalk Chalk
items.description: Hopscotch anyone? Making your own sidewalk chalk is simple, fun and economical. Kin Producer Robert Mahar created this kid-friendly tutorial to encourage imaginative play and brighten your walkways!

items.title: How to Make a Building Blocks Travel Box
items.description: Robert shows you how build your own building block travel box to keep your children entertained this summer or on your next road trip!

items.title: How to Make the Ultimate Baby Shower Gift
items.description: Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar brings you 12 simple cotton onesies, progressively sized for each month (newborn through size 12) and each emblazoned with a cute iron-on month number graphic. So, each month the new kiddo is pictured in their new outfit, like a photographic growth chart for the baby book!

items.title: The Ultimate Camp Care Package
items.description: It's the season for summer camp! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar helps you send a little love from home with this unique collection of fun and functional treats. Create a happy camper with this thoughtful care package!

items.title: How to Make Tangram Puzzle
items.description: Do you remember playing with tangram puzzles in school? A tangram is known as a dissection puzzle composed of seven geometric shapes that are put together in various ways to form shapes. A fun way for kids (and adults!) way to learn shapes and practicing eye hand coordination skills!

items.title: MOMtrepreneur: Mod Mom Furniture
items.description: How does a former advertising executive become a wood working entrepreneur? Wife and mother of two, Kiersten Hathcock shares her story of building modern toy boxes in her garage to producing a full furniture line with Amish manufacturers for an international clientele.

items.title: How to Make a Modern Wood Toy Bin
items.description: Put on your safety glasses and venture into the amazing world of woodworking! MOMtrepreneur, Kiersten Hathcock of ModMomFurniture.com offers an easy to follow tutorial on how to create your own wood toy bin. This versatile storage solution is not just limited to toys -- think sports equipment, blankets & pillows, pet supplies or gardening tools!

items.title: How to Make a Chicken Broccoli Casserole
items.description: MOMtrepreneur, Kiersten Hathcock of http://www.ModMomFurniture.com shares the first recipe she ever learned to cook as a girl -- and how it developed into a sweet a family tradition. A nostalgic and simple to assemble casserole her family loves and yours may too!

items.title: How to Make Snack Roll Ups
items.description: MOMtrepreneur, Kiersten Hathcock of http://www.ModMomFurniture.com shares one of her family's favorite after school snacks. This simple, no-bake snack formula can be easily customized to your kid's tastes -- and is ultimately something they could prepare on their own!

items.title: How to Make Homemade Pixie Sticks
items.description: Make a healthier homemade version of a classic childhood treat! Flavored with all-natural freeze dried fruit, these sweet treats are sure to be a hit.

items.title: How to Make a Personalized Ceramic Plate
items.description: Tackle a simple new craft and start a new family tradition! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar offers up a simple way to customize a ceramic plate designed to make appearances on special "big days" - birthdays, first day of school, celebrating a team win or a job well done!

items.title: How to Make Homemade Play Dough
items.description: Learn how to create a homemade version of the childhood classic play dough! Easy to make with ingredients found in your kitchen cabinets, this recipe assembles quickly and will keep for several months when kept clean and stored in an airtight container.

items.title: Clown Face Ice Cream Sundae
items.description: A kid's birthday party classic -- the clown ice cream sundae! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar brings us a simple, easy to assemble version that you can easily customize to your child's tastes.

items.title: How to Make Clown Favor Jars
items.description: Create a entire parade of cute clowns to decorate your kiddo's birthday table! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar helps you celebrate their special day, circus style, with these festive fellas that double as favors!

items.title: How to Make an Elephant Mobile
items.description: Decorate your next party with a parade of pachyderms! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar designed this sweet elephant mobile with simple shapes and a modern aesthetic. Perfect for baby shower decorations. PLEASE NOTE: This cute mobile is intended for decoration purposes only. It is not a toy and should not be hung above a baby's crib.

items.title: How to Make Gelatin Citrus Slices
items.description: Surprise your kiddos with this silly, tasty treat! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar serves up this easy to prepare after school snack that can be created in a wide variety of flavors.

items.title: How to Make Edible Teacups
items.description: Sure to impress the guests at your kiddos next tea party - these sweet teacups are completely edible! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar suggest waiting to fill the cups with pudding until shortly before serving to prevent the cones from becoming soggy. Adorable and delicious!

items.title: How to Make a Shirt & Tie Favor Box
items.description: An adorable and easy to assemble favor box, perfect for a “Little Man” baby boy shower or a great way to package a gift card for dad on Father's Day!

items.title: How to Make Frozen Ghost Bananas & Citrus Jack-O-Lanterns
items.description: Today's after school snacks? Not-too-spooky fruit snacks just in time for Halloween! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled these simple treats.

items.title: How to Make Jack-O-Lantern Stuffed Peppers
items.description: Surprise your family with this delicious main dish for a healthier Halloween feast! Orange bell peppers are easily carved to resemble jack-o-lanterns that pairs perfectly with mashed potatoes and steamed spinach.

items.title: How to Make Halloween Treat Eyeballs
items.description: Jeepers creepers! These semi translucent peepers make fantastic Halloween decorations and double as favors filled with sweet treats. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar designed this project that your kiddos won't be able to takes their eyes off of!

items.title: How to Make Halloween Birdseed Ornaments
items.description: These not-too-spooky Halloween decorations are fun to make and double as a snack for our feathered friends! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled this cute kid-friendly project. Hang from tree branches and bushes in view of your windows to see the birdies' banquet.

items.title: How to Make a Hanging Squash Bird Feeder
items.description: Squash are plentiful this time of year and are available in an amazing array of colors and sizes. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled this project that shares some of the season's bounty with our feathered friends! Depending on the fall and winter climate in your corner of the world this Squash Bird Feeder can last one to two months when hung outdoors.

items.title: Edible Witch Brooms & Apple Marshmellow Dentures
items.description: Healthier Halloween snacks are not always easy to come by! Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled these two silly after school snacks that simple to make and delicious to eat.

items.title: How to Set A Halloween Table
items.description: Halloween is just around the corner and our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled these ghoulish table decorations to get you ready for any Halloween themed party!

items.title: How to Make Kids Thanksgiving Table Favors
items.description: This duo of thoughtful Thanksgiving table favors will keep your kids entertained before and after your holiday meal. The Native American headbands are sized to be worn and tie easily around your little guest's heads. Pilgrim hats hold crayons to draw pictures of people, places and things for which they are grateful in their blank journals.

items.title: How to Make Mayflower Placecards
items.description: This Thanksgiving let a fleet of little Mayflowers direct your guests to their seat at the table. Include the kids in preparing these placecards - having them write out family and friend's names on the sails is a sweet touch. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled this project and suggests setting your ships on oceans of blue cloth napkins!

items.title: How to Make Snowglobes
items.description: Let it snow! Even if you live in a warmer climate you can create flurries by making your own snow globes. Your kiddos will love designing their own snowscapes. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled this project and recommends raiding your recycling bin for all shapes and sizes of jars - just be sure to wash them before using!

items.title: How to Make Thanksgiving Cupcake Toppers
items.description: Here are two simple and sweet edible cupcake toppers, perfect for Thanksgiving dessert or treats for the kid's classroom. Involve little ones in assembling these adorable decorations, created from easy to find ingredients.

items.title: After School Snacks: Fruit Cars & Veggie Boats
items.description: Healthy snacks become suddenly more appealing when shaped like cars and boats! Simple and quick to assemble, you're sure to come up with tasty variations of your own. Consider serving the cars on roads made from fruit rolls and dish up fish shaped crackers to swim alongside your boats!

items.title: After School Snacks: Homemade Microwave Popcorn, Sweet & Spicy
items.description: Who knew you could create your own version of microwave popcorn!? Free from any chemical additives, you control the ingredients and flavors. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled sweet and savory variations for you to try.

items.title: How to Make Candy Pencil Treats
items.description: These special, edible pencil treats are a sweet way to say 'thank you' to a teacher or offer up some tasty encouragement on exam day! Cut, fold and glue - they're just that easy to make.

items.title: After School Snacks: Juice Box Robots
items.description: Transform simple juice boxes into an impressive squadron of silly robots. Perfect for after school snacks, classroom treats or birthday party favors - we found most of our robot components at our local dollar store!

items.title: How to Make Textbook Covers
items.description: A new school years means a whole new set of text books! Extend the shelf life of your books with an attractive and utilitarian cover. Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar put his twist on the standard brown bag covers using colorful wrapping paper and designing it to have pockets to organize paperwork. Customize your own in any color and pattern!

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Felted Acrorn Napkin Rings
items.description: Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar compiled this beautiful napkin decoration to get you ready for any dinnertime party this fall!

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Shrink Plastic Ornaments
items.description: Robert Mahar shows you how to create adorable ornaments this holiday season starring your childs art. Give it a try!

items.title: How to Make A Magnetic Advent Calendar
items.description: Start the Holidays with this advent calendar by Robert Mahar

items.title: How to Make Family Picture Blocks
items.description: Create these nifty blocks from memorable photos shown by our very own Kin Producer Robert Mahar.

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Paper Straw Holiday Decorations
items.description: Winter is coming! Brighten up the holidays with a straw and tinsel snowflake! Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar created this tutorial with step by step instructions.

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Snowmen Ornaments
items.description: Want to make some snowmen without snow? Take a look at our nifty guide on creating this cute creation.

items.title: How to Make A Family Time Capsule
items.description: What do you think future generations will remember or find out about us? Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar shows us a nifty way to create a time capsule which can stand the test of time!

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Wood Dreidel Game
items.description: How to Make and Play a Wood Dreidel Game video tutorial by Robert Mahar.

items.title: How to Make A Bubble Wand Kit
items.description: How to Make a Bubble Wand tutorial by Robert Mahar

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Perler Bead Ornaments
items.description: How to make the season a little bit brighter with these Perler Bead Ornaments perfect for a present decoration or even the tree!

items.title: Night Light
items.description: Want to chase away the dark and keep close a date to remember? Our Kin Parents Producer Robert Mahar shows us a nifty way to create a brilliant night light!

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: New Years Cascarones
items.description: Ring in the New Years! Bring forth the confetti, and cheer! Robert Mahar shows us how to make these nifty celebratory tools perfect for when the clock hits zero!

items.title: Kid Friendly Craft: Paper Ball Ornaments
items.description: How to make the season a little bit brighter with these Paper Ball Ornaments perfect for the Christmas tree

items.title: Top Items for Spring
items.description: Quick and easy fashion ideas to keep you on trend.

items.title: Three Ways to Wear: Jeans & a T-Shirt
items.description: Nikki Pennie shows us how to spice up a classic wardrobe choice: jeans and a t-shirt. It's a great, versatile uniform, but don't forget to accessorize! It will give your favorite jeans and t-shirt combo more mileage and it will keep you looking fabulous!

items.title: The Perfect Valentine's Dress
items.description: Valentine's Day is quickly approaching. Do you know what you'll be wearing? Whether you're having a romantic dinner with your beau or drinks with the girls, you'll love our pick. Watch as Nikki Pennie from Princess For Pennies shares the look. It's a flattering and elegant lace dress from Zara (and what girl doesn't love lace, right?).

items.title: The Uniform for Preschool Dropoff
items.description: One of our favorite fashion bloggers, Piper Chuthakieo of shares her go-to look for dropping off the kids at preschool. Don't worry if you're not a mom because this is an easy and comfortable look that's suitable for any errand or even a casual day with friends.

items.title: My Summer Faves
items.description: Every stylish woman has her "go-to" summer staples. Those great pieces that you can throw on to feel breezy and comfortable yet pulled together and polished. Piper Chuthakieo (http://www.coconutandbean.com) shows us some of her summer faves!

items.title: Spring Event Look
items.description: Piper Chuthakieo shares a terrific look that is perfect for any Spring event, from Mother's Day brunch to your bestie's baby shower. The key is pairing an "investment piece" with some of your best frugal finds. It's like she says, "it looks like you're dressed to the nines even though you may only be dressed to the sixes.

items.title: Style Essentials: Packing For a Weekend in the City
items.description: You're heading off for a quick getaway to the city and you want to pack light and look great! What should you throw in one small duffel bag to make sure you're comfortable, stylish and ready for any of event? One of our favorite fashion bloggers, Samantha Hutchinson shares her must-have style essentials for a weekend in the city. We LOVE her simple, chic style vibe!

items.title: Style Essentials: A Day at the Beach
items.description: It's a beautiful morning, the sun is out and you're hitting the beach for a fun filled day of sun and sand. From your bikini and cover up to the best sunblock and beach bag...Samantha Hutchinson shows us her must have style essentials for a day at the beach.

items.title: Trend Alert: Creamy Neutrals
items.description: This season, creamy neutrals are all over the runways and Samantha Hutchinson is showing you three different shades to try. Whether you prefer ivory, blush or taupe...you can't go wrong with these light, muted, barely there hues. Head to toe neutrals is bold in a breezy, beautiful sort of way. Try them out!

items.title: 1 Trend 3 Ways: Brights!
items.description: Brights are everywhere for Spring/Summer 2012. From shocking pink and tangerine to vibrant pops of turquoise and green, these electric hues are a great way to step into style this season.

items.title: Make It Current: A Simple Sundress
items.description: Most girls have some sort of simple sundress hanging in their closet, right? Maybe you have one from a few seasons back that you don't wear very often because you don't like the print anymore and you don't feel like it's very 'current'. Well, break it out! It's all about how you style it! Samantha Hutchinson shows you how to take this wardrobe staple - a simple sundress - and create a cute, current, stylish look with the addition of some key accessories.

items.title: How To Wear: A Maxi Dress
items.description: How do you make a floor sweeping maxi dress look chic and flattering for day or night? Fashion and entertainment publicist, Alexandra Lippin, shows you how!

items.title: 2 Sisters 1 Trend: Military Chic
items.description: Current fashion trends are so fun to embrace! No matter what the trend, there's always a way to make it work for you...it's all about accessorizing!

items.title: Summer Style Session: 3 Must Have Dresses
items.description: From breezy, casual styles to sexy cocktail dresses and colorful evening gowns...summer is the perfect time to try out a wide range of beauiful dresses. Fashion stylist Nicole Diaco shows off three of her favorite looks... use them as fashion inspiration and go copy them at any price point!

items.title: Style Staple: Sunglasses
items.description: This summer...why not pick up some fun, new sunglasses to change up your look? From high glam and retro to classic and sporty....this stylish staple comes in a wide range of price points to fit everyone's budget. Stylist, Nicole Diaco shows off some of her “must have” frames.

items.title: 1 Trend 3 Ways: Leopard Print
items.description: Animal prints are a chic, timeless trend that never goes away...and leopard is our favorite! This playful print can be paired with a wide range of colors and styled for casual weekend days or the most elegant events on your social calendar. Nicole Diaco, shows you three ways to make a stylish statement with leopard!

items.title: Three Ways to Tie a Sarong
items.description: Going on a beach vacation this summer? Then you need a colorful sarong! Piper shows you 3 ways to wear this versatile summer piece.

items.title: The Chambray Shirt 2 Ways
items.description: Piper shows off one of her favorite style staples...the chambray shirt. This versatile piece can be dressed up or down to fit most stylish occasions. You've got to get one!

items.title: Daytime to Date Night Transformation
items.description: Do you tend to spend most of your time in the same old casual clothes? Want some style inspiration for that special date night or a fun girl's dinner? Piper shows us how she transforms her look from casual to sassy in just a few simple, stylish steps.

items.title: Fall Fashion Must Have with Look TV
items.description: Two of our favorite fashion bloggers have come together to count down their top 6 'must have' items for Fall. Samantha Hutchinson shares her top 3 for us

items.title: Stripes 2 Ways
items.description: Stripes really are a timeless trend that can be worn year round with all different accessories. Fashion blogger Samantha Hutchinson )shows you two simple ways to style your stripes.

items.title: How to Make Cut-Off Denim Shorts
items.description: Cut off denim shorts should be a casual staple in every stylish girl's wardrobe. Samantha Hutchinson shows you how to make the perfect pair yourself!

items.title: How to Make Ombre Jeans
items.description: Whether it's clothes, nails or hair...ombre is a huge trend right now! But when it comes to designer ombre jeans, they can literally be hundreds of dollars. Samantha Hutchinson shows you how to make them yourself for a fraction of the cost. It's a little messy...but they make a serious style statement, so it's worth it!

items.title: How to Wear Statement Jewelry
items.description: Layering on some statement jewels is a great way to add an extra splash of style to any outfit. Fashion blogger Samantha Hutchinson shows you how to mix and match them to perfection!

items.title: King of the Ants
items.description: House painter Sean Crawley (Chris McKenna) meets electrician Duke Wayne (George Wendt), who brings him to corrupt contractor Ray Mathews (Daniel Baldwin). Offered $13,000 to kill Eric Gatley (Ron Livingston), an accountant auditing Ray's finances, Sean completes his task -- only to find himself double-crossed. When Ray's thugs learn Sean has the mobster's cooked books, they try to torture the location of the files out of him. Sean escapes, taking shelter with Eric's widow, and vows revenge.

items.description: US off-road competition brings together desert racing and rock crawling.

items.title: King of the Zombies
items.description: During World War II, James Mac McCarthy (Dick Purcell) is piloting a plane over the Caribbean when he's forced to crash-land on an island. Along with passenger Bill Summers (John Archer) and his servant, Mac happens upon Dr. Sangre's (Henry Victor) mansion, where the group is offered lodging. The visitors soon uncover Sangre's terrifying secret when they see him performing voodoo on a group of zombies in the cellar. The men must escape with Sangre's niece (Joan Woodbury) in tow.

items.description: Billy is the undisputed leader of a roving band of hardened bikers who support themselves by jousting at medieval fairs and selling their intricately designed wares. As their fearsome reputation and popularity grow, commercial pressures begin tearing the tightly-knit group apart. Despite Billy's attempts to maintain his noble and chivalrous vision, his star performer entertains outside offers, while his arch-rival, Morgan, prepares for a final battle.

items.title: Sheer Ambition
items.description: Although not necessarily a household name nationwide, Kim Kimble is one of the biggest names in Hollywood when it comes to hair. The celebrity hairstylist comes up with the hairstyles worn by many on Hollywood's A-list, including Grammy-winning singers Beyoncé, Mary J. Blige and Shakira. Her clientele also includes the not-so-famous through her successful retail product line and the exclusive Hollywood salon that she runs, Kimble Hair Studio. Staffed by talented but high-strung stylists, the salon is at the crux of this reality series that documents the stylists' fierce rivalry and desire to be on top. Also featured in the series is Kim's mother, Jasmine, a hairstylist and salon owner herself who encouraged her daughter to follow in the family's hairdressing legacy after recognizing Kim's talent at an early age.

items.description: Bryan combines the homeowners' different visions.

items.title: Rocky Road
items.description: Bryan takes over a husband's reno project, and it goes wild.

items.title: Bricking Time Bomb
items.description: A couple is taking on a renovation project right before their wedding.

items.title: Tri Again
items.description: Bryan has a solution that homeowners Greg and Sheila have a hard time embracing.

items.title: High Steaks
items.description: A couple is anxious to start customizing their home.

items.title: Stone Tag
items.description: Daniel and Rachelle can't agree on their renovations; Bryan gets caught in a game of stone tag.

items.title: Worst Time Home Buyer
items.description: First-time home buyers and expecting parents Carley and Conan weren't prepared for their home's problems.

items.title: Over the Honeymoon
items.description: Newlyweds Mike and Linda want to begin renovating their home; a big gamble may not pay off.

items.title: Kill Drill
items.description: Joy and Mahmood are ready to renovate their old home.

items.title: Chapter One: Soldiers
items.description: The 5-hour controversial true-crime series seeks to uncover the inner workings of the military justice system as former Army Lt. Clint Lorance faces 19 years at the United States Penitentiary in Leavenworth for the deaths of two local men in Afghanistan in July 2012. While deployed in Afghanistan, Lorance ordered fire on three local men riding a motorcycle. Two of the men were killed, thus outraging his platoon. Lorance seeks to overturn his verdict, sparking an emotional debate across the country.

items.title: Led Zeppelin: Dazed and Confused
items.description: The band's career shows its humble beginnings to its members' status as rock gods.

items.title: Led Zeppelin: Whole Lotta Rock
items.description: Follow the band through its formation to becoming one of the most influential bands in history.

items.title: Lemon
items.description: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

items.title: Leprechaun
items.description: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold.

items.title: Leprechaun 2
items.description: A leprechaun (Warwick Davis) surfaces in Los Angeles to claim a bride, as his previous object of affection was denied to him a thousand years before in Ireland. He kidnaps teenager Bridget (Shevonne Durkin), grotesquely murdering anyone who gets in his way. It falls to Bridget's boyfriend, Cody (Charlie Heath), to rescue her. Cody enlists the aid of his perpetually tipsy uncle, Morty (Sandy Baron), who decides to go after the homicidal leprechaun's pot of gold.

items.title: Leprechaun 3
items.description: One night in Las Vegas, a pawn shop owner purchases a statue of a leprechaun from a mysterious stranger. He ignores the stranger's warning to never remove the statue's golden medallion and takes it for himself. Instantly the statue transforms into the murderous Leprechaun, who vows to kill anyone who takes his gold. Scott McCoy, who unwittingly took a gold coin from the pawn shop, and Tammy, Scott's new friend, are first on the list.

items.title: Leprechaun 4 in Space
items.description: Resurfacing on an alien planet, the Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) abducts a member of the world's royalty, Princess Zarina (Rebekah Carlton), in an attempt to wed her and become the supreme ruler. Unfortunately for the diminutive schemer, well-armed soldiers arrive to foil his plans. Not easily defeated, however, the feisty Leprechaun continues to battle the warriors while also contending with the warped scientist known as Dr. Mittenhand (Guy Siner).

items.title: Leprechaun 5: In the Hood
items.description: When aspiring hip-hop performers Butch (Red Grant), Postmaster P. (Anthony Montgomery) and Stray Bullet (Rashaan Nall) cross record producer Mack Daddy (Ice-T), their grudge against him leads to their own peril. After they break into Mack Daddy's home and swipe an ancient medallion from a grotesque statue, the evil Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) is freed from his magical prison. Soon the sinister little man is on the trail of Butch, Postmaster P. and Stray Bullet, along with Mack Daddy himself.

items.title: Leprechaun: Back 2 tha Hood
items.description: City hairdresser Emily Woodrow (Tangi Miller) finds the answer to her financial problems when she stumbles upon a chest brimming with gold. Although she and her friends quickly go from rags to riches, they discover that the gold belongs to someone else: an evil leprechaun (Warwick Davis) who has returned from hell to claim his treasure. Speaking in riddles and rhymes, the demon stalks his victims with ruthless determination -- and scores some excellent pot along the way.

items.title: Leprechaun: Origins
items.description: Not related to the previous Leprechaun films. Two young couples backpacking through Ireland discover that one of Ireland's most famous legends is a terrifying reality.

items.title: Let the Right One In
items.description: When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

items.title: Let's Be Evil
items.description: A woman (Elizabeth Morris) enters an underground bunker where gifted children use virtual reality technology to wreak havoc.

items.title: Vegan Brunch
items.description: A cooking series dedicated to everyone's favorite leisurely and decadent mid-morning meal.

items.title: Letters at Christmas
items.description: A couple facing divorce take their kids to help them renovate a historic hotel.

items.title: Letters to God
items.description: A troubled mailman (Jeffrey S.S. Johnson) befriends the family of a boy (Tanner Maguire) who copes with cancer by writing daily notes to God.

items.title: The 12 Step Job
items.description: The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

items.title: The First David Job
items.description: The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

items.title: The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
items.description: The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

items.title: The Future Job
items.description: A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

items.title: The Three Strikes Job
items.description: The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

items.title: The Maltese Falcon Job
items.description: Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

items.title: The Jailhouse Job
items.description: Former insurance investigator Nate Ford and his band of cohorts act as modern-day Robin Hoods, pulling elaborate scams targeted against the greedy and the corrupt. Nate was inspired to begin his con business when his former employer refused to pay for treatment that could have saved his son's life.

items.title: The Reunion Job
items.description: The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

items.title: The Inside Job
items.description: When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

items.title: The Scheherazade Job
items.description: In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

items.title: The Double Blind Job
items.description: Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

items.title: The Studio Job
items.description: In order to take down a corrupt record executive, the team must infiltrate the world of country and western music.

items.title: The Gone Fishin' Job
items.description: After targeting a greedy debt collector, the crew discovers that their target is also a domestic terrorist who is funding an armed militia.

items.title: The Boost Job
items.description: The team enters the world of master car thieves in order to take down a crooked car dealer.

items.title: The Three-Card Monte Job
items.description: When small businessmen are blackmailed into committing crimes, the team's investigation reveals an unlikely foe.

items.title: The Underground Job
items.description: In the aftermath of a deadly mine explosion, the team infiltrates the coal mines of West Virginia to stop the dangerous practices of the mine's owner.

items.title: The Rashomon Job
items.description: The team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years ago.

items.title: The King George Job
items.description: The team discovers that an antiquities trafficker is using refugee children to smuggle artifacts; Sophie confronts the consequences of her past.

items.title: The Morning After Job
items.description: The team tries to get a violent hedge fund manager to reveal information that could lead to Damien Moreau.

items.title: The Ho, Ho, Ho Job
items.description: The team takes over a mall on Christmas Eve and uncovers a scheme perpetrated by an old nemesis; Eliot goes undercover as Santa Claus; Parker and Hardison are Santa's helpers.

items.title: The Big Bang Job
items.description: The team infiltrates a government research lab to stop Damien Moreau from auctioning information to international terrorists.

items.title: The San Lorenzo Job
items.description: After following Moreau to San Lorenzo, the team discovers that he is the chief advisor to the current President.

items.title: The Long Way Down Job
items.description: The team must recover lost evidence from a mountain while battling hired guns and bad weather.

items.title: The 10 Li'l Grifters Job
items.description: When a mark is killed during a sting, the team races to complete the con and find the killer.

items.title: The 15 Minutes Job
items.description: The team attempts to take down a corrupt PR consultant by using his own methods against him.

items.title: The Van Gogh Job
items.description: While tracking a Van Gogh painting, the team learns the painting was the center of a World War II love story.

items.title: The Work-Study Job
items.description: Reformed criminals put their unique skills to good use by helping regular citizens fight back against corporate and governmental injustices.

items.title: The Belly of the Beast Job
items.description: The team reluctantly enlists the help of a naïve but ambitious assistant to take down a predatory music producer; told from the point of view of a regular person.

items.title: The Museum Makeover Job
items.description: When a Leverage International team's museum heist goes awry, the crew goes in to finish the job, ultimately realizing they've been lured into a trap by a treacherous old friend.

items.title: The Crowning Achievement Job
items.description: When a formidable enemy steals the Maharaja's crown and traps the crew in the museum, they must find a way out and the crown before they go down for the crime.

items.title: The Weekend in Paris Job
items.description: On the run from a busted heist in Paris, the team finds themselves taking shelter among oligarchs auctioning off their home nations' precious resources; they have to create a new con to take down the group's ringleader and save an activist.

items.title: The Digital Frankenstein Job
items.description: The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber, a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I.; they watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

items.title: The Scared Stiff Job
items.description: Our team runs the "Christmas Carol" con on a wannabe cryonics mogul who coerces dying patients into exploitative contracts bankrupting the loved ones they leave behind.

items.title: The Hustler Job
items.description: The crew takes on a phone scamming ring that uses deepfake technology to con their marks, run by an old school hustler who came up via the pool hall circuit; to infiltrate his organization, they have to best him on and off the felt.

items.title: Lewis Hamilton: The Winning Formula
items.description: As the only Black Formula One driver in history, Lewis Hamilton's journey to becoming the most decorated Formula One driver in history, is one of dreams, courage and determination.

items.title: Life Before the Crown: Princess Elizabeth
items.description: On April 21st 1926, the future Queen was born, Elizabeth Alexandra Mary; during her grandfather's reign, Elizabeth was third in the line of succession to the British throne, behind her uncle Edward and her father.

items.title: Derek Hough's Life Update Vlog
items.description: Derek Hough is sharing healthy tips, learning new skills, and catching up with friends on Life In Motion! Explore how to maintain a healthy mind and body on this energizing journey.

items.title: What I Eat In A Day
items.description: Derek Hough takes you through a full day of eating, including healthy recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in between!

items.title: Derek Hough On Touring & Dancing
items.description: Derek Hough talks about his upcoming solo tour, and what it is like behind the scenes on the road!

items.title: Derek Hough on Staying Hydrated
items.description: Derek Hough outlines just what it takes to stay hydrated! Learn how much water to drink and how hydration is beneficial for your health and energy!

items.title: Derek Hough's Post Workout Routine
items.description: Derek Hough explains his post workout routine. From food to stretching he walks you through how to recover from a workout.

items.title: Amy Purdy on Taking Action
items.description: Amy Purdy and Derek Hough talk about taking action and overcoming obstacles in your life in this interview!

items.title: Courage | Spoken Word by Derek Hough
items.description: Spoken word performance by Derek Hough on the topic of courage.

items.title: Derek Hough’s Nastia Liukin Interview
items.description: Derek Hough interviews Nastia Liukin about her journey to win a gold medal for USA gymnastics in 2008!

items.title: Derek Hough's Gymnastics with Nastia Liukin
items.description: Derek Hough learns gymnastics from Olympic Gold Medalist and former Dancing with the Stars partner, Nastia Liukin!

items.title: Derek Hough Tries Muay Thai
items.description: Derek Hough is no stranger to athletic training, but these Muay Thai boxing basics are harder than they look!

items.title: Life Itself
items.description: Filmmaker Steve James chronicles the life of film critic Roger Ebert, especially his career highlights, his battle with alcohol, and his sometimes ruthless rivalry with fellow critic Gene Siskel.

items.title: Life of Belle
items.description: Eight-year-old Annabelle Starnes is missing and there are no leads as to where she might be.

items.title: Life Partners
items.description: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

items.title: Life With Blondie
items.description: The Bumsteads' dog poses for pictures and makes more money than Dagwood.

items.title: Life With Father
items.description: In late 19th-century New York City, stockbroker Clarence Day (William Powell) strives to maintain order in his bustling household. Despite his attempts to be the chief authority over his four sons, his wife, Vinnie (Irene Dunne), is the one who truly keeps order in their home, much to Clarence's chagrin. To gain more respect, Clarence reluctantly considers making changes that will benefit everyone, including his own baptism. This slice-of-life comedy was based on a popular Broadway play.

items.title: Life's a Breeze
items.description: An unemployed slacker (Pat Shortt), his aged mother (Fionnula Flanagan) and his niece (Kelly Thornton) must overcome their many differences to find a lost fortune.

items.title: Light Up
items.description: Black, same-gender-loving men and a transgender woman find their superpower by living in their truth.

items.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
items.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate.

items.title: 2026-27: Matchday 10
items.description: All the moments from a weekend in Ligue 1, with reviews of table and results; discussing players of the week, the best play, best save, worst blooper, who is in the hot seat and who was the revelation of the round.

items.title: Like Father, Like Son
items.description: Ryota learns that his biological son was switched at birth with the boy he has raised, and he must make a life-impacting decision between his two sons.

items.title: Beauty Treatment
items.description: Worldwide superstar, Like Nastya, grows up, shares songs, stories, and adventures with her dad and friends.

items.title: Beach Toys
items.description: Nastya and Dad play with beach toys and oversized balloons; Nastya dreams of coloring hair in a salon.

items.title: New Clothes
items.description: Nastya loves shopping for new clothes with Dad and spending time with Grandpa as he babysits her.

items.title: ABC Box
items.description: Nastya brings Dad to school for show and tell and practices her ABCs by playing a fun game with giant letter boxes.

items.title: Christmas Games
items.description: On Christmas Eve, Nastya is so excited that she can hardly sleep; Nastya spins the Christmas wheel for different treats.

items.title: Joke Day
items.description: Nastya jokes with her school friends and goes on a glow-in-the-dark toy hunt with the lights off.

items.title: Feeding Animals
items.description: Nastya wakes up with a case of sticker pox and feeds ponies, puppies, and bunnies at Grandpa's.

items.title: Lil Wayne: Bling
items.description: Grammy Award-winning Lil Wayne is one of the most popular hip-hop artists working today; from his reign as president of Cash Money Records to a jail term served at the famed Rikers Island prison.

items.title: Lil Wayne: Rap Sheet
items.description: The story of American rapper and songwriter, Dwayne Michael Carter Jr., also known as Lil Wayne.

items.title: Lila & Eve
items.description: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

items.title: Limelight
items.description: Nightclub owner Peter Gatien was the undisputed king of the 1980s New York club scene with a Manhattan empire that counted tens of thousands of patrons per night in its peak years.

items.title: Lingerie Secrets Revealed
items.description: Style expert Rachel Zalis helps 10 women who have different body types find the perfect ultra-feminine lingerie to uncover their inner sex goddess.

items.title: Lionel Messi: The Greatest
items.description: Lionel Messi has proven time and time again that he is deserving of being voted the greatest soccer player of all time.

items.title: Lionfish: The New Pirates of the Caribbean
items.description: Exploring the lion fish, introduced in the 1990s, posing a threat to native species.

items.title: Lip Service
items.description: Following the interwoven love lives of three gay women living in Glasgow.

items.title: Lip Service
items.description: Following a lead that may unravel the mystery of her past, Frankie places herself in danger; elsewhere, Tess makes a fool of herself on live television.

items.title: Lip Service
items.description: Cat and Sam enjoy their honeymoon period; Tess turns up at Lou's flat unannounced and gets more than she bargains for.

items.title: Lisa Nichols' Breakthrough
items.description: The author and motivational speaker works with Marissa, a young girl on the brink of leaving home and losing her relationship with her mother.

items.title: Little Dead Rotting Hood
items.description: The residents of a small town realize that something is killing wolves and people in the woods.

items.title: Little Girl Lost: The Delimar Vera Story
items.description: While Luz and Pedro Vera are hosting a Christmas party in 1997, a fire erupts on the second floor. In the chaos, all the children escape safely except for Delimar, the couple's baby daughter. No remains are found, and Luz suspects her child has been kidnapped. Pedro, fearing Luz is delusional, eventually leaves her. Six years later, Luz runs into a six-year-old child who she becomes convinced is her missing daughter.

items.title: Little Joe
items.description: A plant created via genetic engineering appears to produce curious changes in the people and animals it comes into contact with.

items.title: Little Men
items.description: Two teens develop a growing friendship in Brooklyn, N.Y., while the feud between their respective parents (Greg Kinnear, Jennifer Ehle) continues to escalate.

items.title: Ashley vs. BrandiJean
items.description: Cameras follow 10 families -- mostly mothers and daughters -- as they prepare for competition in "Little Miss" beauty pageants. From practice sessions to shopping sessions and fitting sessions, parents prepare their little girls to compete for a crown and some cash.

items.title: Jayne vs. Katelyn
items.description: Divorced pageant parents Cristina and Robert have come together to create a routine for their daughter Katelyn; Russian pageant mom Irina struggles to pull together a Yankee Doodle Dandy-themed outfit.

items.title: Shelby vs. Hadlie
items.description: Pageant veteran Hadlie competes against Shelby and her six-foot python.

items.title: Traci & Alexa vs. Rhonda & Kendall
items.description: Two mother-daughter teams with different ideas on pageantry compete.

items.title: Emily vs. Jordan
items.description: Nine-year-old Emily, a national winner who's outgrown her local pageants, competes against veteran Jordan who has won over 100 crowns.

items.title: Sabrina vs. Amber
items.description: Tomboy Sabrina competes against girly-girl Amber.

items.title: Madison vs. Angelina
items.description: Nicole, Madison's mom, thinks that acrylic nails, hairpieces and a spray tan will help her daughter win; Angelina's mom, Dani, is shunning glitzy extras in hopes that Angelina's sparkling ways will win over judges.

items.title: Destinee vs. Shelbie
items.description: Shelbie is ready to make a comeback after a long break from pageants; pageant pro Destinee attempts to keep her winning streak.

items.title: Brianna vs. Lexi
items.description: Brianna and her family prepare for a big pageant with big expenses; Lexi's family history.

items.title: Trinity vs. Taylor
items.description: Kelly and her 7-year-old daughter, Trinity, have been doing pageants for years; 8-year-old Taylor is a seasoned competitor on the natural pageant circuit.

items.title: Asia vs. Kaylee
items.description: Asia, an accomplished beauty queen, is on a mission to impress her mom; pageant director Michael Galanes changes both Kaylee's routine and pageant clothes days before the competition.

items.title: Kiki vs. Kiersten
items.description: Eight-year-old beauty queen Kiki has another chance to take home a crown; 7-year-old newcomer, Kiersten, is just starting her pageant career.

items.title: Mayce vs. Jacee
items.description: Friends Mayce and Jacee go head-to-head for the first time when they compete in Atlanta.

items.title: Patience vs. Jayne
items.description: Six-year-old pageant veteran Patience competes against Jayne, who loves the stage.

items.title: Taylor/Madison vs. Maggie
items.description: Nine-year-old newcomer Maggie competes against Taylor and her younger sister Madison.

items.title: Kyndal vs. Alyssa
items.description: Five-year-old Kyndal, the youngest of a trio of pageant sisters, has been on a losing streak; five-year-old Alyssa comes from a military family.

items.title: Kayla vs. Aliyah
items.description: Nine-year-old Kayla competes against ten-year-old Aliyah.

items.title: Kaylee vs. Shelby
items.description: The pageant director is unimpressed with Kaylee's proposed paleontology-themed wow wear; Kaylee knows she'll need a little luck against hotshot Shelby.

items.title: Little Red Wagon
items.description: Zach (Chandler Canterbury) sets out to help the homeless of America with his wagon.

items.title: Down to the Wire
items.description: Five couples hike through Africa's most pristine wilderness in a game of survival and elimination.

items.title: The Nail in the Coffin
items.description: With Liz in exile and trying to survive Kieran, her husband Ryan and the others continue their journey and search for food along the Mababe River.

items.title: An Unexpected Turn
items.description: Kieren exchanges exile for the main camp and instantly irritates Ola, James and Ryan, whose disgust over their new companion grows by the minute.

items.title: This is It
items.description: Liz is reunited with Ryan; they have to compete against Ola and James in a thrilling semifinal.

items.title: Desert Beginnings
items.description: Fusing high-desert aesthetics with hands-on DIY, Rachel Metz transforms a rugged Joshua Tree homestead into a vibrant, animal-filled oasis - one power tool at a time.

items.title: Concrete Chaos & Joshua Tree Charm
items.description: Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

items.title: Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
items.description: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

items.title: Living With Leo
items.description: Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

items.title: A Ton of Potential
items.description: Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

items.title: Anchored in Stone
items.description: Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

items.title: Living Vegan
items.description: Five people who have embraced the vegan lifestyle provide an inside look into their day-to-day lives and share their stories.

items.title: Living With Chucky
items.description: Filmmaker Kyra Elise Gardner explores the enduring appeal of the "Child's Play" franchise and its iconic killer doll Chucky.

items.title: Liz & Dick
items.description: Actress Elizabeth Taylor (Lindsay Lohan) and actor Richard Burton (Grant Bowler) begin a roller-coaster romance.

items.title: Lizzie Lazarus
items.description: Eli and Bethany carry Lizzie's corpse through the woods. They're on a hike toward a mythical zone they believe will bring the dead body back to life. But each of them is keeping a secret about Lizzie's life, and the circumstances behind her death.

items.title: Hammer Down
items.description: Being a trucker is not an easy way to make a living. Aside from battling others to get work, truckers must deal with road hazards, mechanical breakdowns and, of course, the weather in order to get their loads delivered on time and under budget. Rain, snow and even extreme heat are among the weather conditions that can make the driver late or damage the cargo, which could cause the trucker to lose money on the contract -- or possibly even have to pay for the value of the cargo. Each episode of "Loaded" follows several truckers to see who ends up with the most cash at the end of their runs.

items.title: Deep Freeze
items.description: Brenda faces gas bandits in Cleveland; Ryan must contend with a bulldozer that's frozen to the ground; Joe gets caught in a tropical storm with a cracked windshield.

items.title: Loaded Pistols
items.description: During a dice game, the lights go out and a participant is shot to death. Larry Evans, one of the players, is accused of the shooting, so Gene Autry, a friend of the dead man, confronts Larry and his sister, Mary, who are hiding out in an old house. But Gene quickly realizes Larry is innocent and decides to protect the siblings from the law while he looks for the real killer. Gene's pursuit is sidetracked when an angry mob comes after Mary and Larry.

items.title: Logan Guntzelman: Boner Technology
items.description: Logan Guntzelman shares with an Atlanta crowd tales of her dating app standards, moving in with a boyfriend, and upgrades in male health technology.

items.title: Logan's Run
items.description: In the year 2274, young residents enjoy an idyllic, hedonistic lifestyle within the protective confines of a domed city. The general belief is that when each person turns 30, they are reincarnated for another blissful life cycle. Those who know the much darker truth become "runners" and flee to a hidden sanctuary. When law enforcement officer Logan (Michael York) goes undercover to locate the refuge, he winds up instead trying to initiate a revolution with runner Jessica (Jenny Agutter).

items.title: London Bridge is Down
items.description: London Bridge is down; in a year of unprecedented celebration of historical milestones, the second Elizabethan age has finally drawn to a close; Her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth II is dead.

items.title: Lone Wolf & Cub 3: Baby Cart to Hades
items.description: Medieval samurai Lone Wolf (Tomisaburô Wakayama) works as a hired sword, roaming with his son (Kenji Misumi) in a baby cart.

items.title: Loni Love: America's Sister
items.description: The comic's standup routine takes on the president, fat people, pirates, celebrities, and her love for those in America.

items.title: Loons: A Cry From the Mist
items.description: Biologists race the clock as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger, unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer's soundtrack or go silent forever.

items.title: Lord Shango
items.description: A tribal priest rises from the dead, unleashing his anger on non-believers.

items.title: Inventing the City
items.description: The unique story of the city of Los Angeles.

items.title: Bright Lights, Big City
items.description: The Hollywood film studios are founded by Jewish immigrants from Central and Eastern Europe who achieve their American Dream by acquiring a social status equal to the Los Angeles WASP elite.

items.title: Lost at Christmas
items.description: Two strangers stranded in the Scottish Highlands on Christmas Eve team up to try and get home in time for Christmas.

items.title: Lost Canyon

One reason for that could be because they work together, partnering on a natural hair care line called Rucker Roots. Ruby, the oldest of the three, is a former lawyer who spends her time volunteering and supporting education; youngest sister Ione, who used to be married to former NBA player Antawn Jamison, strives to be a successful philanthropist and businesswoman; and perfectionist Ellen is the middle sister, who has left her chiropractic practice to work on the sisters' hair care venture.

When human nature intercedes and a man is forced to take matters into his own hands, there's not a badge big enough that will stop him. Detroit homicide detective Frank Agnew is used to helping others, but he can't help himself when a loved one is abruptly taken from him by a corrupt element. Vengeance gets the better of Agnew, and now he finds himself and his career at the mercy of fellow detective Joe Geddes, a smart but slimy veteran cop whose misdeeds may involve covered-up murders. "Low Winter Sun" -- a gritty, dark drama played out amid Detroit's underworld -- is based on the 2006 award-winning British miniseries of the same name.

items.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

items.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

items.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

items.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

items.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

items.title: Madman

As the story goes, if his name is uttered above a whisper, he will return to the area to kill. Unimpressed and unafraid, an impudent teen, Richie (Jimmy Steele), feels compelled to test the legend -- despite the deadly consequences. Within moments, Madman Marz is back again for blood.

items.description: Derek, a fashion designer, is too shallow to settle and Traci, a DJ, harbors some major trust issues; a client begs for a second chance when their contract is revoked.

items.title: The Ice Queen and the Playboy Chef
items.description: Patti tries to thaw an Ice Queen's frozen heart; chef Roble checks in; all hell breaks loose when one client tests Patti's patience.

items.title: The Crying Virgin and the Gullible Artist
items.description: Ashley must let go of her past and open her heart; Dakota has to learn to turn a blind eye and pay attention to dealbreakers.

items.title: Immature Bridesmaid and the Ex From the Block
items.description: The delusional millionairess, Robin Kassner, returns but must drop the ditzy act and the wine straw for true love; Ojani Noa, J.Lo's ex-husband, must move past his playboy ways; one client gets suspended.

items.title: The Doormat and the Lazy Lion
items.description: Angelica Bridges, a former Baywatch babe and divorcée, must overcome her self-sabotaging ways; Ralph Rieckermann, a former rock star, must drop the groupies in order to find his soul mate.

items.title: The Cliff Diver and The Egomaniac
items.description: Patti is not in paradise with two tough clients from "The Bachelor"; Vinny Ventiera, a cliff diver who falls too hard too fast and Daniel Maguire, a judgmental narcissist with absurd expectations.

items.title: Devina A.D.D. & The Relationship Virgin
items.description: Patti matches wits with Devina Kaur, a challenging sex-obsessed author, and Peter Curti, a gay millennial entrepreneur searching for his first relationship.

items.title: Mr. Build-A-Girl and The Basketball Wife
items.description: Patti Stanger goes head-to-head with mouthy Laura Govan ("Basketball Wives LA") and her shocking behavior, and a perfectionist who only wants a "picture perfect" woman.

items.title: The Ageist and the Snob
items.description: Patti has her work cut out for her with two high intensity lawyers; ageist David Goldman and red carpet snob Rhonda Wills force Patti to pull out all the stops to find them love.

items.title: Little Lovebird & Mr. Know-It-All
items.description: Patti clashes with poker player Jason Karniol, who has yet to play his cards right in his dating life; wedding planner Kacy McInturff hopes her quest for love at the Millionaire's Club goes off without a hitch.

items.title: The Rapping Politician & The '90s Rap Icon
items.description: Shawn Isaac is a former politician and current rapper who judges women based on their resume; '90s rap icon Monie Love micromanages her men into man babies.

items.title: Bad Boy Magnet and The Insta-Ham
items.description: Patti faces off against social media addict Christopher Lourdes who picks up women by flashing his wealth on Instagram; Love and Hip Hop star Tiffany Foxx, a sexy rapper who is seduced by bad boys.

items.title: Mr. Hit It And Quit It and the Baywatch Babe
items.description: Patti battles Marcellas Reynolds, an explosive celeb stylist with a "hit it and quit it" habit; Baywatch babe Donna D'Errico dives back into dating for the first time since her divorce.

items.title: Crazy Kelly & the Desperate Housewife
items.description: Two Real Housewives check into the Millionaire's Club; New York's "Crazy" Kelly Bensimon must overcome her bad reputation; Atlanta's Claudia Jordan, a liar magnet, exposes a shocking secret.

items.title: Mr. Self-Absorbed & the Trainwreck
items.description: Patti takes on her youngest client yet, the infamous wild child Courtney Stodden who trainwrecks through her date; MMA fighter Shondo Blades, the one-man show who goes barking up the wrong tree.

items.title: Collateral Damage
items.description: The investigators hope for a breakthrough in the 2010 murder of a 59-year-old security guard who had an ill-fated encounter with armed robbers in Sydney's CBD.

items.title: A Shot in the Dark
items.description: The investigators seek answers to some pressing questions related to the 1985 homicide of a Bendigo-based haulage contractor who became the target of a sniper in the dark of the night.

items.title: Taken in the Night
items.description: The investigators look into the 1999 murder of Belinda Williams, a 36-year-old mother whose body was found in a scrub after she mysteriously disappeared one night.

items.title: Mimicry Freaks
items.description: A father wakes up in the forest with his only son to find that they are being relentlessly pursued by a terrifying Japanese monster known as Namahage.

items.title: Blue Eyed Boy
items.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000.

items.description: Follow the story of how the Minecraft phenomenon has taken the world by storm.

items.description: Exploring the legacy of a video game that, since its development in 2009, has taken the digital world by storm. The game has undeniably impacted the gaming industry and how people play video games.

items.title: Minecraft: Through the Nether Portal
items.description: A look at the game of Minecraft, including interviews with players and industry experts.

items.title: Team Travsay & Team Twinning
items.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000.

items.title: Team Dynamic Duo
items.description: Trisha and Trina are sisters playing for the Tourette syndrome foundation; watch as this dynamic duo battles against the clock to help a family member in need.

items.title: Team Moonshadow & Team TKO
items.description: Team Moonshadow continue to dominate the games and climb closer to that quarter million grand prize; married Kelvin and Toni hope to strike the games and fight the clock, earning a TKO.

items.title: Team Mr. Mean & Beauty Queen
items.description: Ro and Chloe are father and daughter; this duo of Mr. Mean and Beauty Queen are looking to raise money for orthodontist school; watch these two fight hard and flash some pearly whites as they move from game to game.

items.title: Team Golden Boys
items.description: Jeff and Roy continue their dominance in the 62 circle; see these golden boys beat the games and move closer to the quarter million dollar grand prize.

items.title: Team Bastro
items.description: Marcus and Tony are best friends with big hearts and even bigger goals; these two are playing with the hopes of winning buckets of money to help their families through college and retirement.

items.title: Team Stiletto
items.description: Family trio Camille, Chelsea and Chloe can be summed up with one name: Three C's. Watch as they take on the games to hopefully open their own mobile clothing boutique.

items.title: Team Turtle & Hare & Team Brotherly Love
items.description: Military mom Joyce knows what it takes to put everything on the line; she is teamed up with her son Cornelius, with hopes of purchasing a new home; married couple Nicole and Perris hope to win a world trip before starting their family.

items.title: Minute to Win It
items.description: Team Moonshadow competes.

items.title: Miracle on Highway 34
items.description: A trucker, a salesman and an expectant couple spend Christmas Eve getting to know each other in a small-town diner.

items.title: Mirageman
items.description: As a child, Maco was orphaned, and his young brother was seriously injured in a home invasion attack. Since then, he has tirelessly trained himself in martial arts. When he dons a ski mask to save a TV reporter, the attention he gets convinces him to turn himself into the masked crime fighter Mirageman. He advertises his e-mail address seeking people who need his help, and finds himself doing battle with a child pornography ring.

items.title: Miranda Lambert: For the Record
items.description: Following Miranda Lambert's journey to country music stardom.

items.title: Mischief Night
items.description: Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.

items.title: Mission of Honor
items.description: Polish pilots overcome prejudice to fight against the Luftwaffe with the Royal Air Force during the Second World War.

items.title: Mister America
items.description: Despite being completely inexperienced and broke and having just defeated a murder charge, a man mounts a campaign to unseat the San Bernardino district attorney.

items.title: Mister Lonely
items.description: A Michael Jackson impersonator (Diego Luna) visits a commune where residents (Samantha Morton, Denis Lavant) imitate Marilyn Monroe, James Dean, the Three Stooges and others.

items.title: Fortune Cookie Caper
items.description: Mr. T and a gymnastics team solve mysteries around the world.

items.title: U.F.O. Mystery
items.description: Woody is on his way to see Professor Andrews, who has built a robot version of Mr. T, when a UFO is sighted and the team must solve a mystery from outer space.

items.title: Mystery of the Stranger
items.description: Trouble follows Mr. T and the team while they are working on the set of a Hollywood movie shoot and Spike is kidnapped.

items.title: The Williamsburg Mystery
items.description: Mr. T and his team must spare no effort to solve a mystery that they encountered amid a reconstruction project in Colonial Williamsburg.

items.title: Mission of Mercy
items.description: When a corrupt businessman poses a threat to Mr. T's ambitious philanthropic endeavor, the team tries to save the day and learns a significant lesson.

items.title: Mystery of the Open Crates
items.description: When a threat looms over a Chicago youth center and its compassionate owner, Mr. T and his team must become an impenetrable shield to protect them.

items.title: The Playtown Mystery
items.description: Spike notices something strange at an amusement park, but others might not take his word for it. Turns out, the location is being used for some shady dealings.

items.title: Mistletoe & Menorahs
items.description: When a determined toy company executive, Christy, must learn about Hanukkah in a hurry in order to land a big account, she enlists the help of her co-worker's friend Jonathan, who happens to also be in desperate need of turning his bachelor pad into a Christmas Wonderland to impress his girlfriend's father.

items.title: Mistletoe Mixup
items.description: A workaholic with no time for romance, or the holidays, ends up meeting two potential suitors on the same day -- but unbeknownst to her, they turn out to be brothers. A sibling squabble commences.

items.title: Mistress Hunter
items.description: Jackie hires a mistress hunter to come between her husband and his mistress. But when the mistress and her husband wind up dead, Jackie becomes the number one suspect.

items.title: MK Ultra
items.description: Following the journey of Ford Strauss, a brilliant psychiatrist whose moral and scientific boundaries are pushed to the limit as he is recruited to run a subset of the program in a rural Mississippi mental hospital.

items.title: 2026: Day 3 - Encore
items.description: Pickleball coverage from MLP Nations Cup 2026.

items.title: Potato Hash
items.description: Sara Lynn Cauchon, of The Domestic Geek, approaches strangers to show how their junk food meals can be transformed into delicious more healthy options.

items.title: Smoothie Guy
items.description: In a blender, combine yogurt, mango, yogurt, pineapple, almonds, and coconut. Blend until smooth

items.title: Popcorn
items.description: In a microwave, heat butter and coconut oil. Combine brown sugar, hot sauce and chili powder. Pour over popcorn and toss to coat. Enjoy!

items.title: Pancakes
items.description: In a medium bowl, mash banana. Whisk in eggs. Heat coconut oil in large frying pan over medium-high heat. Ladle batter into pan, creating two ‘pancakes’ that are roughly 4”. On one ‘pancake’ spread almond butter, or drizzle honey and add sliced strawberries. Sandwich with second pancake.

items.title: Breakfast Pitas
items.description: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Saute red onion, red pepper and spinach until softened. Add egg whites and Greek seasoning. Scramble. Spread hummus inside pita pocket. Fill with eggs and top with olives, feta cheese. Enjoy!

items.title: Mac Daddy
items.description: In a small saucepan, combine vegetable broth, quinoa and garlic and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside for 5 minutes. In a large bowl, combine quinoa, peppers, artichoke hearts, spinach, olives and feta. Top with olive oil, lemon juice, Greek seasoning and fresh parsley. Stir to combine. Enjoy!

items.title: Quesadilla
items.description: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Cook onion, pepper and mushrooms, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic powder, horseradish, salt and pepper and cook for another 30 seconds. Set aside. On one tortilla, layer half of the cheese, roast beef and the pepper mixture. Top with the other half of the cheese and finally, the second tortilla. Return it to the frying pan and cook for one minute on each side. Enjoy!

items.title: Mommy Group Murder
items.description: A new mom joins a group to help her deal with the stress of motherhood, but she soon learns that membership comes at a price. When a member's husband turns up dead, the new mom is convinced that one of the other moms is responsible.

items.title: Mommy's Little Angel
items.description: Katie, a 12-year-old girl, has had a short but rough life. When her mother dies from an apparent suicide, her cousins decide to adopt her. Katie adores her new family and will not let anyone, including her abusive father, take her away from them.

items.title: Mommy's Little Princess
items.description: A 10-year-old adopted girl discovers that she is related to a royal German family. Feeling special for the first time, she becomes an entitled, angry child. As her fascination with being a princess grows, the girl begins to lose her sanity.

items.title: Opening Arguments
items.description: Everyone knows the big names in the hip-hop industry who perform on stage and TV, but not many people know the folks behind the scenes who help the artists reach levels of superstardom. Among those unknowns are lawyers, who help stars make deals and get paid. This docuseries profiles several high-powered attorneys in the entertainment industry who help one another, use one another, and sometimes throw one another under the bus to get ahead in their personal and professional lives. "Money Power Respect" shows how the lawyers deal with failed partnerships, cheating boyfriends, stolen clients and back-stabbing friends. The featured lawyers include former music executive Wendy Credle; intellectual property attorney Kendell Kelly; Dana Whitfield, whose husband doesn't want her mixing with "grimy" music industry wannabes; Kelly Shapiro, who is anxious to move back to New York; and Jamaica native Nakia Thomas, who attended Brown University at the age of 16.

items.title: The Mistress Is My Witness
items.description: The ladies jet to Jamaica for business and pleasure; Kendall ambushes her boyfriend with the mistress; Kelly uses Kendall's breakdown to get ahead.

items.title: Till Death Do Us Manage
items.description: Dana goes head-to-head with her husband over managing male artists; Wendy plans a new business venture; Tiffany makes a play for Dana's client.

items.title: Judging Wendy
items.description: Kendall fights to kick Kelly off of a project; Dana hosts a brunch to impress her husband; Wendy calls on Judge Mathis for help with her PSA; Tiffany and Dana's rivalry.

items.title: Breach of Contract
items.description: Kelly blindsides Kendell when she cozies up to Kendell's new celebrity client, Ryan Leslie; Wendy disses Lord Jamar and chooses a different rapper for PSA; bad blood between Dana and Tiffany ignites.

items.title: Closing Arguments
items.description: Dana takes on a male rapper despite Lord Jamar's dictates; Wendy's PSA runs amok; Kelly jets to LA for a business emergency; Nakia gets busted gossiping about Wendy; Nakia's blog party erupts into chaos.

items.title: Monster Brawl
items.description: Eight classic monsters fight to the death in wrestling matches inside a cursed graveyard.
