items.title: Dracula: Fiction and Reality: Part 2
items.description: A continuation into looking into Dracula.

items.title: Ghosts: The Unseen Presence: Part 1
items.description: Delve into the shadows and enter a world in which things go bump in the night.

items.title: Ghosts: The Unseen Presence: Part 2
items.description: Coming face-to-face with things lurking in the darkness and shedding new light on the paranormal.

items.title: Monster in the Closet
items.description: An obituary writer (Donald Grant), a professor (Denise DuBarry) and a brainy boy track a big-mouthed monster near San Francisco.

items.title: Monster Party
items.description: Three thieves plan a daring heist at a mansion dinner party. When their plan goes horribly wrong, the thieves realize the dinner guests are not as innocent as they seem, and their simple cash grab becomes a violent and desperate battle to survive.

items.title: King in the North
items.description: Revealing how the world's largest vessels operate when crossing dangerous global waters.

items.title: Cruise Ship Colossus
items.description: The Crown Princess is a titanic cruise ship that weighs more than 100,000 tons; racing the clock, its crew uses the latest technology and cutting-edge engineering to prepare for its next voyage.

items.title: Thermopylae
items.description: Traveling continually as a transport conveyor, Thermopylae is a delivery service with companies all over the world depending on her speed, efficiency and reliability.

items.title: Montana Desperado
items.description: After the fourth tenant has been murdered on his ranch, Dave Borden is accused of the slayings but cleared. A neighboring rancher is also murdered by a mysterious masked rider, and his daughter Sally Wilson inherits his ranch.

items.title: Finding Nirvana
items.description: Italian motorcycle racer Franco Morbidelli battles to the top of MotoGP racing.

items.title: Chasing Happy
items.description: The VR46 MotoRanch track created by Valentino Rossi as a place to fine tune riding skills is notoriously hard to access, until now.

items.title: A Dangerous Game
items.description: There's danger on the track at the year's biggest race, Mugello; Franco focuses on his goal of winning Rookie of the Year, while his team implodes around him.

items.title: Believe
items.description: Franco Morbidelli continues to claw back points and waits to find out if he has won Rookie of the Year.

items.title: More American Graffiti
items.description: This sequel to the nostalgic film by George Lucas revisits characters from the earlier movie, most notably nice guy Steve Bolander (Ron Howard), who has gone on to marry his sweetheart, Laurie (Cindy Williams). Also featured is car enthusiast John Milner (Paul Le Mat), who has moved into a career on the drag-racing circuit. As the characters deal with personal matters, major social issues such as the Vietnam War and the peace movement also factor into their lives.

items.title: More Money, More Family
items.description: Two cousins pretend they won the lottery to reunite their fractured family.

items.title: Springtime Favorites
items.description: Host Kimberly Lallouz shows audiences how to pull off a mouthwatering, toast-worthy, multi-course dinner for four, all in 60 to 90 minutes.

items.title: Tapas Party!
items.description: Host Kimberly Lallouz shows audiences how to pull off a mouthwatering, toast-worthy, multi-course dinner for four, all in 60 to 90 minutes.

items.title: More Swimsuit Secrets Revealed
items.description: Swimwear trends; choosing the right style; swimsuit makeovers.

items.title: Morgan Murphy: Irish Goodbye
items.description: Morgan Murphy performs her comedy routine.

items.title: Most Shocking Celebrity Deaths of All Time
items.description: A look at 10 giants of the music industry, from Elvis Presley to John Lennon, who died earlier than expected.

items.title: Mother's Day
items.description: A camping trip turns into a living nightmare when three women encounter two deranged brothers and their equally demented mother in the woods of New Jersey.

items.title: Mother's Day
items.description: Sandy (Jennifer Aniston) is a stressed-out, single mom who learns that her ex-husband is marrying a younger woman. Her friend Jesse (Kate Hudson) is a fitness freak who doesn't tell her parents that she has a family. Bradley is a widower (Jason Sudeikis) who's trying to raise two daughters on his own, while Miranda (Julia Roberts) is too busy with her career to worry about having children. When their respective problems start coming to a head, the Mother's Day holiday takes on a special meaning.

items.title: Wild North: On the Edge
items.description: Broc guides his sister Alicia on her first bear hunt in 20 years; Connor and Jen push their sled teams on a 20-mile overnight expedition across a frozen lake; Kie and Dave tackle a giant poplar tree looming over their homestead; and Rob heads deep into the frozen wilderness to trap beaver and rabbit.
categories: Shows to Save and Watch Later

items.title: Wild North: To the Bone
items.description: A hard-earned trophy is preserved in bone, generations of knowledge are passed down, a hidden hazard threatens a homestead, and a new line of defense is built against fire season.
categories: Shows to Save and Watch Later

items.title: Mr. Nobody: Extended Director's Cut
items.description: In 2092, the last mortal human on Earth reflects on his long past and thinks about the lives he might have led.

items.title: Mr. Robinson Crusoe
items.description: A playboy yachtsman (Douglas Fairbanks) makes an island paradise with his bare hands, to win a bet.

items.title: Mr. St. Nick
items.description: Santa Claus wants to pass the torch to his reluctant son who would rather stay in Miami and enjoy the nightlife.

items.title: Mr. Untouchable
items.description: Growing up as part of a poor family in New York City's Harlem, Nicky Barnes aspires to wealth and power. In the early 1970s, as drug use becomes increasingly popular, Barnes devises a plan to obtain the lifestyle he has always wanted. With help from the mob, Barnes establishes himself as a successful drug dealer and becomes tremendously wealthy. Barnes's extravagant lifestyle, however, proves to be his undoing, as he unwittingly draws the attention of the FBI.

items.title: Mrs. Santa Claus
items.description: It's a week before Christmas and Mrs. Claus (Angela Lansbury) is feeling unappreciated when Santa Claus (Charles Durning) refuses to look over her new route for distributing presents. She goes for a test drive on the sleigh, but lands in New York City due to horrid weather, injuring her reindeer. While she is incognito as "Mrs. North," she befriends neighborhood inhabitants and helps them resolve some of their own issues, which run the gamut from worker abuse to unrequited love.

items.title: Trailblazers: South Africa
items.description: A series dedicated to extreme mountain biking, following some of the world's best freeriders.

items.title: Trailblazers: Morocco
items.description: A German MTB legend decides to build a van and travel all the way down to Morocco to explore and ride the great Atlas mountains.

items.title: Trailblazers: Spain
items.description: Meeting with a Spanish MTB pro rider who decided to create his own company in order to build the most exclusive and unique carbon bikes.

items.title: Trailblazers: Bali
items.description: Travelling to Bali in Indonesia to meet an MTB professional rider who decided to start a new life dividing his time between surfing and riding active volcanoes.

items.title: Muay Thai Giant
items.description: A 7-foot-tall peaceful man learns Muy Thai and uses his skills to solve case of stolen diamonds.

items.title: Murder in Coweta County
items.description: A one-eyed soothsayer (June Carter Cash) leads a Georgia sheriff (Johnny Cash) to a big shot (Andy Griffith) who crossed the wrong county line.

items.title: Murder Party
items.description: A satanic group lures a man to a party in order to murder him.

items.title: 64 Corvette resto mod
items.description: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge; team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

items.title: 442 resto mod
items.description: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas work on gluing the front panel on the 442 Restomod. This 67 Mercury Cougar has some issues with the rear brake pads.

items.title: 1963 Corvette Z06
items.description: The team adds primer to the frame of a half-million dollar 1963 Corvette Z06; the '65 Mustang is ready for a test drive; a new customer has dropped off a 1968 Corvette for a restoration project.

items.title: 59 Ford Pickup
items.description: Vinnie and the team are working on a 63 Z06, 59 Ford Pickup and a 69 Chevy Malibu.

items.title: 69 Chevy Malibu
items.description: Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas go under the hood of the 69 Malibu. The 63 Z06 factory race car, you have to see what it takes to make this race car look like it came out of the factory. Tagging and bagging time on the 72 Corvette.

items.title: Barrett Jackson 2024
items.description: Vinnie is in Scottsdale Arizona for Barrett Jackson 2024. There is so much happening, from checking out awesome vendors, looking at awesome classic cars, and even trying amazing food.

items.title: Highlights from the Shop
items.description: Vinnie and the team are priming the 1972 Nova to help prevent it from rusting. We take a look back at all the cool stuff that has happened in the shop.

items.title: Mutant Chronicles
items.description: In the 28th century, four rival corporations are in a constant state of war for control of the Earth. During one such battle, an ancient machine is uncovered and reactivated, and starts churning out undead mutants by the hundreds. While the corporations make plans to abandon the Earth, a strike force led by Maj. Mitch Hunter (Thomas Jane) and clergyman Brother Samuel (Ron Perlman), embark on a mission to destroy the machine before the mutants overrun the planet.

items.title: Mutiny
items.description: The War of 1812 is raging and American naval captain James Marshall (Mark Stevens) is charged with sailing to France to obtain a war loan in gold. When Marshall selects salty Ben Waldridge (Patric Knowles) as his first mate, Waldridge insists on bringing aboard his own former crew. The moment news of their cargo reaches the crew's ears, however, they begin plotting a mutiny -- and when they reach France, Waldridge's old flame, Leslie (Angela Lansbury), comes aboard with the gold.

items.title: My Amityville Horror
items.description: Daniel Lutz, who was a child when the events recounted in Jay Anson's "The Amityville Horror" occurred, tells his side of the story.

items.title: Wanda
items.description: Celebrity party planner David Tutera leads a team of event professionals in remaking a bride's fantasy wedding into something less nightmarish. For example, the bride who wants a fantasy princess wedding, and adores her dress with yards of tulle, is told she must wear a different dress. A bride who wants spiders to adorn her wedding cupcakes and who plans to wear a sleeveless dress to display her tattoos is convinced to make some changes. Whether the brides go along with Tutera's advice remains to be seen.

items.title: Jennifer
items.description: Event planner David Tutera helps Jennifer achieve her dream of being a princess on her wedding day.

items.title: Mandy Ferrer
items.description: David helps a Marilyn Monroe impersonator with her 1950s-inspired wedding.

items.title: Seria Powell
items.description: David transforms Seria's one-note wedding into an elegant and memorable affair.

items.title: Amanda
items.description: A jeans and T-shirt kind of girl who loves watching NASCAR, Amanda Becvar holds strong to her Irish roots and wants her wedding day to reflect that.

items.title: Bayyina
items.description: By David Tutera's standards, Bayyina Joseph's idea of a majestic wedding falls a tad bit short; so with only a few short weeks before the big day, David decides to literally make her a queen for the day.

items.title: Bling Bride
items.description: David helps Brooklyn bride Caroline create a "Diamond White Wedding" theme for her upcoming nuptials.

items.title: Nicole O'Hara
items.description: David attempts to change Nicole's theme to something more in line with her Jamaican heritage.

items.title: Quiana Morgan
items.description: David hopes to change the mind of bride-to-be Quiana who has been planning a winter wonderland wedding.

items.title: Kricket
items.description: David hopes to transform Kricket's reception hall at the Radisson Hotel into the vineyards of Italy.

items.title: Dayira Muñiz
items.description: David helps Dayira achieve her dream of a candy-inspired wedding.

items.title: Lauren Masterson
items.description: David Tutera helps bride-to-be Lauren achieve her dream of a medieval-themed wedding.

items.title: Jamie Ferris
items.description: Bride Jamie uses the concept of Philadelphia's Mummer Parade as the theme of her wedding.

items.title: Bernadette Davis
items.description: Bernadette infuses her wedding with various shades of green, a color that makes David's skin crawl.

items.title: Christina Velez
items.description: After Christina's plans of a wedding on the beaches of Mexico are ruined, she needs to re-create the tropical vibe at an Elks Club in New Jersey.

items.title: Noelle Kane
items.description: Bride-to-be Noelle wants to combine the simple comforts of the South with the excitement of a big city for her wedding.

items.title: Corryn Conyer
items.description: David Tutera helps Harlem bride Corryn achieve her dream wedding.

items.title: Varneka Edwards
items.description: Varneka attempts to bring a New York City vibe to her Delaware wedding.

items.title: My Favorite Christmas Tree
items.description: Kyla visits a small town attempting to find her ancestry and meets a Christmas tree farm owner.

items.title: My Golden Days
items.description: A middle-aged anthropologist (Mathieu Amalric) reminisces about family, school adventures, a student trip to the USSR and the love (Lou Roy-Lecollinet) of his life.

items.title: My Grandpa Is a Vampire
items.description: When a boy from California is sent to visit his grandfather in New Zealand, he learns that the man is a vampire.

items.title: Prison Break
items.description: Telenovelas are one of the most popular genres on Spanish television. This docuseries introduces American viewers to some of the stars of the shows, taking a look at the drama, intrigue and betrayal that happens both on and off the screen. Set in Miami, "My Life Is a Telenovela" profiles the Hispanic actors and actresses whose characters captivate millions of viewers. The featured stars include Maria "Raquenel" Portillo, who was a singer before turning her attention to acting; model Sissi Fleitas; Enrique Sapena, who comes from a well-known Venezuelan media family; outspoken Liliana Rodriguez Morillo, who was once fired from a show for saying the wrong thing; singer Gustavo Pedraza; and model Alina Robert.

items.title: Breaking Brunch
items.description: A celebratory brunch for Raquenel's big new role breaks into chaos; Sissi ambushes Raquenel on set; Raquenel opens a box full of dark secrets.

items.title: The Young and the Hangry
items.description: A dinner to clear the air between frenemies turns explosive; a scandalous affair is served; Sissi faces off against Alina; Raquenel goes back to prison.

items.title: Walking Over Red Flames
items.description: An ambush on the red carpet forces Raquenel to strike back; Sissi seduces Gustavo; Enrique brings Raquenel to see a psychic.

items.title: Blood, Sweat & Revenge
items.description: Jenilca is out for blood when Gustavo reveals a sexy text from Sissi; Raquenel plots revenge; Enrique pushes Raquenel about her past.

items.title: The Devil Wears Revenge
items.description: Raquenel is rocked by her past when she tries to rebuild her music career; Alina seduces Sissi's man; Jenilca and Sissi come to blows; Pepa gets the ultimate makeover.

items.title: Don't Call Me a Prostitute!
items.description: A mysterious letter shakes Enrique to the core; Sissi fights for her next role; Raquenel's ladies night out gets crashed; Enrique plots to steal a letter from Raquenel's secret box.

items.title: The Starlet Letter
items.description: Enrique and Sissi team up to take down Raquenel; Raquenel panics when a letter from her dark past is stolen.

items.title: My Mom's a Werewolf
items.description: Bitten on the toe by a pet-shop owner (John Saxon), a housewife (Susan Blakely) with a daughter (Katrina Caspary) turns into a werewolf.

items.title: My Mom's Letter From Heaven
items.description: A rebellious teenager finds a letter from her dead mother.

items.title: My Name Is Nobody
items.description: An anonymous gunfighter (Terence Hill) follows a retired outlaw (Henry Fonda) from Santa Fe to New Orleans for one last shootout.

items.title: My Old School
items.description: In 1993, a boy named Brandon Lee enrolls at the Bearsden Academy secondary school in Glasgow, Scotland. Over time, it is revealed that Brandon Lee is not who he seems.

items.title: My Pal Trigger
items.description: Horse trader Roy Rogers has plans to breed his prize mare with legendary stallion Golden Sovereign. Unfortunately, scheming nightclub owner Brett Scoville (Jack Holt) has his eye on the same stud and steals the horse. Sovereign breaks free, however, and mates with Rogers's mare, eventually producing a spirited colt that Rogers names Trigger. When Sovereign is accidentally killed, Rogers is blamed for the crime, and he and Trigger must escape the law and track down the real killer.

items.title: My Scientology Movie
items.description: Filmmaker Louis Theroux is denied admittance into the Church of Scientology's headquarters, setting into motion a clever, confrontational and funny plan to try and reveal the inner workings of the mysterious organization.

items.title: The Lonely Surfer
items.description: In the early days of reality TV, there was a dating show on which a working-class bachelor pretended to be a millionaire while looking for a significant other from a group of female hopefuls. The premise of "Mystery Millionaire," which WE calls a social dating experiment, is the reverse of that. Each episode features a bachelor or bachelorette shedding expensive threads and fancy home for more modest clothing and living accommodations. Not to mention having to live on a much lower income than the person is used to. The featured dater goes on three blind dates, after which he or she must decide whom to pursue. The millionaire then goes on another date with the chosen person -- this time, a group date with friends -- and must decide whether or not to try to take it to the next level. But doing that means that he or she must reveal his/her identity. Then it's up to the chosen partner to decide whether or not to continue the relationship.

items.title: Fitness Mogul Strips Down
items.description: An international fitness model goes undercover as a landscaper.

items.title: Tip Your Bartender With XO
items.description: A 23-year-old executive for a candle company goes undercover as a bartender in a seedy watering hole as he searches for a soul mate.

items.title: The Phony Photographer
items.description: A spirits entrepreneur goes undercover as a struggling photographer, but fumbles his cover story and has an equipment failure.

items.title: Doggy Style
items.description: A dairy heiress and socialite goes undercover as a dog walker, but has trouble keeping her story straight.

items.title: The Art of Deception
items.description: Vito, a marketing and advertising mogul, goes undercover as a struggling artist.

items.title: The Young Girl of the Tour Eiffel
items.description: Orphan flees from thieves trying to steal the key to her past. Animated.

items.title: The Riddle of the Giant Sea Monsters
items.description: Jean and Nadia's plane crashes, and they are saved by a battleship on a mission to kill a mysterious monster.

items.title: Nautilus, The Fantastic Submarine
items.description: Jean and Nadia arrive on an island controlled by the Gargoyle Army and meet Marie.

items.title: Marie's Island
items.description: Nadia and Jean come up with a plan to escape the island.

items.title: The Fortress on the Solitary Island
items.description: After their friend Marie gets abducted by invaders, Jean and Nadia infiltrate a secret base in the center of the island to try and rescue her; they discover the base's ownership by an organization who call themselves Neo Atlantis.

items.title: The Tower of Babel
items.description: During a rescue attempt, Nadia is kidnapped.

items.title: Nadia's Rescue
items.description: Grandis, Sanson, Hanson and Jean team up to rescue Nadia and her friends.

items.title: Nemo's Secret
items.description: After escaping Gargoyle's island, Nadia and friends are taken aboard the Nautilus and Nadia has trouble trusting her former enemies.

items.title: Gratan in Action
items.description: The Nautilus is caught in a minefield in an underwater cavern and Sanson, Hanson and Jean try to remove the mines.

items.title: A New Student on the Nautilus
items.description: Sanson, Hanson and Grandis become official crew members of the Nautilus.

items.title: Grandis' First Love
items.description: Nadia tries to please Jean by dressing up for him, but he is too busy to notice.

items.title: Run, Marie, Run!
items.description: Nadia is angry and dismissive of Jean's friendly offers as she goes to extremes to preach her stand on animal rights.

items.title: The Valley of Dinictus
items.description: Marie and Nadia both fall ill, and the Nautilus sets sail for Dinicthys to find the cure.

items.title: Nautilus' Biggest Crisis
items.description: The Nautilus is trapped by Gargoyle, which claims the life of a new friend of Jean and Nadia's.

items.title: The Mystery of the Island That Vanished
items.description: The conflict caused by the Blue Water haunts Nadia; the Nautilus heads to an underwater ruin to lay some of its crew members to rest, but as the crew pay their respects, Jean spots something.

items.title: Jean's New Invention
items.description: Jean tries to prove his worthiness when Nadia asks him to build another aircraft.

items.title: Nautilus vs. Nautilus
items.description: The Nautilus sets sail for Antarctica and the crew has a run in with a nasty shellfish.

items.title: Nemo's Close Friend
items.description: Nemo introduces Nadia and Jean to his best friend, a talking whale named Irion.

items.title: Jean's Failures
items.description: Jean's latest invention goes wrong and puts the Nautilus in serious trouble.

items.title: Goodbye Nautilus
items.description: The Nautilus is cornered by Gargoyle's battleship.

items.title: Electra's Betrayal
items.description: The children leave via the Captain's cabin; Electra draws a pistol on the captain.

items.title: Little Castaways
items.description: The kids are shipwrecked on a deserted island and must learn how to survive.

items.title: Lincoln Island
items.description: Nadia runs off but returns to steal food when she realizes that she can't survive on her own.

items.title: First Kiss
items.description: Jean must use meat in the morning omelet, making Nadia very displeased.

items.title: King's on his Own
items.description: Nadia shows a newfound gratitude toward Jean, which unsettles King enough to run away; Jean and everyone goes to look for King, and when she accidentally falls into a ravine, Jean discovers a mineral vein.

items.title: Island of the Witch
items.description: A typhoon strikes Lincoln Island and a mysterious floating island drifts near.

items.title: The Floating Island
items.description: The witch and assistants that Ayerton spoke of turned out to be Grandis, Sanson, and Hanson. Again united, our pals set up camp to live on the floating island.

items.title: King vs. King
items.description: Sanson and Hanson have a race with robots.

items.title: The Underground Labyrinth
items.description: Nadia vanishes after she and Jean visit a mechanical cavern on the island.

items.title: Goodbye Red Noah
items.description: Nadia faces an entity who tells her that their island home is a spaceship.

items.title: The Secret of Blue Water
items.description: Nadia finally arrives at her lost homeland of Tartessos, where she reveals her deepest secrets.

items.title: The All-Purpose Battleship, New Nautilus
items.description: Gargoyle's battleships appear and Nadia surrenders herself to protect the others.

items.title: Emperor Neo
items.description: Gargoyle takes Nadia before the leader of Neo-Atlantis; Nemo and the others plan to fight Gargoyle.

items.title: ...To Space
items.description: The New Nautilus and Gargoyle battle.

items.title: Inheritor of the Stars
items.description: The pieces fall into place for the final stage of Jean and Nadia's journey, Nemo and Gargoyle's feud and the secret of Nadia's Blue Water pendant.

items.title: Genesis
items.description: A San Francisco police investigator (Don Johnson) uses keen instincts, wit and charm on the job but has less success in his personal life.

items.title: Home Invasion
items.description: A gang terrorizes Nash's (Don Johnson) ex-wife (Serena Scott Thomas) and daughter (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe); Joe (Cheech Marin) moves in.

items.title: Skirt Chasers
items.description: A heroin dealer sets up shop in San Francisco, but his penchant for buying time with women gives Nash and his team a shot at taking him down.

items.title: High Impact
items.description: Nash and Joe Dominguez try to protect the mayor when a religious fanatic takes fire and brimstone seriously and detonates bombs all over San Francisco.

items.title: The Javelin Catcher
items.description: A deadly military weapon stolen by gang members leads Nash to work with a military adviser before more gang violence erupts.

items.title: Vanishing Act
items.description: When a sting operation falls apart and Harvey Leek disappears with the government's money, Joe and Nash set out to prove his innocence.

items.title: Aloha, Nash
items.description: Nash puts his romantic vacation with Kelly on hold to pursue the evils behind an incriminating betting book; Ian's girlfriend is taken hostage.

items.title: Key Witness
items.description: Nash sets out to help Lisa, whose eyewitness account of a murder raises some eyebrows when no body can be found; Joe checks out his new investment.

items.title: Internal Affairs
items.description: Nash must clear his name after being suspended following an Internal Affairs accusation that he murdered a suspect in revenge.

items.title: Till Death Do Us Part
items.description: Joe is exposed to a deadly virus after a thief unwittingly releases it into the air while foraging for drugs at a chemical lab.

items.title: The Great Escape
items.description: Nash's daughter, Cassidy, is kidnapped by an escaped anti-government extremist who is out to avenge his imprisonment and separation from his family.

items.title: Wrecking Crew
items.description: Nash and Joe are taken hostage while attempting to nab a gang of professional thieves during a robbery.

items.title: Trackdown
items.description: Nash attempts to apprehend a former best friend who has become an international mercenary sent to San Francisco for a hit.

items.title: The Brothers McMillan
items.description: Dead bodies begin surfacing as two brothers vie for control of the Irish mafia in San Francisco; Joe suspects someone is stealing from his bar.

items.title: Night Train
items.description: Nash and his team take the subway home from a bachelor party and are held hostage after walking into the midst of a robbery.

items.title: Zodiac
items.description: Nash calls on his former mentor, Dale Cutter, for help in a murder case that has all the signs of the infamous Zodiac killings.

items.title: Leo's Big Score
items.description: Nash baby-sits a juvenile felon marked for death by drug dealers; Joe gives his son J.J. a job at the bar.

items.title: Hit Parade
items.description: A money launderer-turned-informant is killed, and Nash and Joe discover they are next in line unless they can find the hit man first.

items.title: Promised Land
items.description: A student accused of attempted murder leads Nash and Joe to a Chinese slavery ring smuggling illegal immigrants into the country.

items.title: 25 Hours of Christmas
items.description: Christmas is put on hold as Nash and Joe investigate the death of a store executive murdered at the site of a professional jewelry heist.

items.title: Road Work
items.description: An information leak linked to the government endangers the lives of Nash and Joe, and the federal witness they must protect.

items.title: Inside Out
items.description: Joe infiltrates a prison when all the evidence in the murder of an undercover police officer points to an incarcerated drug lord.

items.title: The Counterfeiters
items.description: Nash and Joe discover that a group is impersonating the Special Investigations Unit in order to pull off a $20 million counterfeit heist.

items.title: The Web
items.description: Nash and Joe learn that a hacker is stealing prototype computer equipment to pay the ransom on his kidnapped wife.

items.title: Knockout
items.description: Nash and Joe search for the perpetrators of a series of sex crimes when Nash's sister, Stacy, becomes a victim and can't remember anything about the attack.

items.title: Gun Play
items.description: While Cassidy recuperates after being struck by a stray bullet, Nash and Joe look for both the shooter and the gun supplier.

items.title: Lost and Found
items.description: An explosive encounter with carjackers puts Nash on their trail and into conflict with a policewoman who believes he's compromised her undercover investigation.

items.title: Payback
items.description: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) spring a convict (guest star Willie Nelson) from San Quentin so the ex-biker can lead them to a murder suspect (guest star Tobin Bell).

items.title: Shake, Rattle and Roll
items.description: Babysitters Nash and Joe must stop a hit man; Nick has an unsuitable love interest (Jennifer O'Neill).

items.title: One Flew Over the 'Cuda's Nest
items.description: An escaped mental patient goes on a literary killing spree; Joe and Inger regret hiring Nash's baby-nurse friend.

items.title: Blackout
items.description: Nash (Don Johnson) finds a murder case much more difficult to crack after a bomb blast gives him amnesia. With Cheech Marin.

items.title: Ripcord
items.description: A burglar escapes by leaping from the 35th floor with a parachute; Nick volunteers for an experimental program at the university.

items.title: Sniper
items.description: Nash and Joe track a sniper in San Francisco; a social club celebrates Halloween daily; guest Cassandra Peterson, "Elvira."

items.title: Revelations
items.description: A clash between rival drug lords uncovers new evidence on the whereabouts of Nash's missing brother, presumed killed in the Vietnam War.

items.title: Most Wanted
items.description: A convict inadvertently released by county officers targets Michelle; a TV reporter is being blackmailed.

items.title: Bombshell
items.description: Mobsters and federal agents pursue Nash's old flame; Joe films a salsa commercial in Nash's apartment.

items.title: Found Money
items.description: Bettina sets out to be a tough boss, accusing Joe of stealing $3 million from a car stopped after an armed pursuit.

items.title: Dirty Tricks
items.description: A convicted murderer's escape on his way to his sentencing hearing leads Nash and Joe to the British Consulate.

items.title: Crossfire
items.description: A convicted arsonist (Mark Rolston) uses outside contacts to keep Nash (Don Johnson) from testifying at his parole hearing. With Cheech Marin.

items.title: Live Shot
items.description: Nash gets drugged during a bust just before he and Joe are scheduled to recount their careers for Geraldo's cameras.

items.title: Downtime
items.description: A forced vacation has Nash and Joe working outside conventional channels to solve a string of armored car robberies.

items.title: Skin Deep
items.description: Nash clashes with a visiting New York detective over the handling of a stalker case; Evan loses his badge during a one-night stand.

items.title: Patriots
items.description: The Irish husband of Nash's first ex-wife is in San Francisco looking for revenge against IRA terrorists.

items.title: Cuda Grace
items.description: Drug-related murders lead to a millionaire; Evan and Bettina go undercover at a transgender beauty pageant; guest RuPaul.

items.title: Lady Killer
items.description: Nash tries to figure out who is framing Bettina for murder; someone is using Joe's stolen credit cards to live the playboy lifestyle.

items.title: Danger Zone
items.description: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) learn that a truckload of nerve gas is about to be released in downtown San Francisco.

items.title: Special Delivery
items.description: Nash must protect Lynette from Asian mobsters when she unknowingly becomes involved in a forgery ring; Joe's father visits.

items.title: Touchdown
items.description: Several armored cars and their drivers disappear; a football star needs to find "the most beautiful girl in the world"; Nick is reluctant to use a hearing aid.

items.title: High Fall
items.description: Nash's ex-lover masterminds a real estate scam that leaves him destitute; Joe destroys his own home while trying to improve it.

items.title: Impostors
items.description: Nash and Joe pose as gay detectives in San Francisco's Castro district while trying to find a Cher impersonator's stolen wig.

items.title: Hot Prowler
items.description: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.

items.title: Overdrive
items.description: Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.

items.title: Apocalypse Nash
items.description: Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.

items.title: The Tourist
items.description: Nash's ex-wife arrives from Paris and informs him that a bureaucratic snafu fouled up their divorce 12 years earlier.

items.title: Swingers
items.description: Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.

items.title: Warplay
items.description: Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.

items.title: Firestorm
items.description: Nash's mysterious friend helps in the search for a murderous arsonist; Joe tries to throw a surprise party for Nash.

items.title: Hardball
items.description: Nash and Joe attempt to prevent a zealous INS agent from deporting a baseball star who is in the country illegally.

items.title: Mystery Dance
items.description: Caitlin reveals details about her past to Nash; Joe battles a strict exercise and diet program; Cassidy and Nick team up for a tango competition.

items.title: Shoot the Moon
items.description: Caitlin accidentally shoots Nash in the posterior; his pompous nemesis (Daniel Roebuck) replaces him.

items.title: Gimme Shelter
items.description: While Nash pursues a gang of teenage carjackers, Joe goes undercover at a department store to catch a thief.

items.title: Superstition
items.description: Nash must protect a young singer from obsessed fans intent on kidnapping her; Joe's attempt to buy his wife a car at a police auction backfires.

items.title: Resurrection
items.description: Nash's daughter faces death after a car crash; a sniper is loose in the city; Joe battles rats; guest Dee Wallace Stone.

items.title: Pump Action
items.description: An undercover police officer joins forces with Nash to put a choke hold on marauding bodybuilders who are pumped up on illegal steroids.

items.title: Hide and Seek
items.description: Nash and Joe try to find the governor of California after he slips out of sight, fearing the exposure of a possible sex scandal involving his mistress.

items.title: Boomtown
items.description: Nash and Joe search for a serial bomber; Cassidy must perform topless in her new play while her father is in the audience; Nick befriends a noisy band.

items.title: Angel of Mercy
items.description: Nash and Joe search for a serial killer; Caitlin and Joe coach girls' soccer teams; Harvey reconciles with his estranged wife.

items.title: Power Play
items.description: Nash and Joe must cure an amnesiac to rescue a man from the Russian mob; Joe undergoes fertility tests.

items.title: Vendetta
items.description: Nash must protect Caitlin after she is portrayed as a kinky sex addict on the Internet by a former cop who she helped send to jail for wife beating.

items.title: Crash and Burn
items.description: A series of robberies leads Nash and Joe to a group of women whose husbands are imprisoned for similar heists.

items.title: Frisco Blues
items.description: Internal affairs demotes Nash and Joe to walking a beat; Cortez becomes a traffic officer; Leek goes to homicide; Caitlin works vice detail.

items.title: Goodbye Kiss
items.description: The unit faces permanent closure; Caitlin plans to leave; Nash and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) compete for Caitlin.

items.title: Truth and Consequences
items.description: The team searches for an actress's assassin; Caitlin moves in with Nash; Inger wants Joe to go to Sweden.

items.title: Trade Off
items.description: Nash must save an 8-year-old child who has been kidnapped; kidnappers mistakenly take a boy whose parents have no money.

items.title: Smash and Grab
items.description: Thieves pose as firefighters responding to jewelry store fires only to steal the goods; the unit must uncover a litigious in-line skater's insurance scam.

items.title: Girl Trouble
items.description: Nash must save Cassidy from drug dealers who mistake her for another woman; Joe meets the person he has been flirting with online.

items.title: High Society
items.description: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

items.title: Curveball
items.description: Nash and the team must track down a corrupt official who plans to leave the country with $5 million in pension funds; Caitlin accidentally throws one of Nash's prized possessions through a window.

items.title: Split Decision
items.description: An ex-con claims to suffer from multiple personalities when he is caught robbing banks; Nick moves to a high-class retirement home; Harvey confronts Evan about his substance abuse.

items.title: Get Bananas
items.description: Nash and Joe must protect a famous chimpanzee from animal rights activists wishing to release him into the jungle; Jake Cage searches for a wanted murderer; Evan pursues a drug dealer without Nash's approval.

items.title: Crosstalk
items.description: Nash tracks a paranoid, delusional man who randomly kills cell-phone users; Nash and Joe investigate the decapitation of a dummy; Joe's dreams about Caitlin interfere with his waking hours.

items.title: Kill Switch
items.description: Nash and the team track down a vigilante intent on bringing murderers to justice; Caitlin and Joe form a partnership to deliver doughnuts via the Internet.

items.title: Rip Off
items.description: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

items.title: Skin Trade
items.description: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

items.title: Liar's Poker
items.description: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

items.title: El Diablo
items.description: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

items.title: Hit and Run
items.description: Nash and Joe's client is killed when the building in which they are meeting explodes; Joe's mother-in-law and Nick fall in love.

items.title: Cop Out
items.description: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

items.title: Line of Sight
items.description: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

items.title: Heist
items.description: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

items.title: Hard Cell
items.description: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

items.title: Missing Key
items.description: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

items.title: Jackpot
items.description: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

items.title: Jackpot
items.description: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

items.title: Rock and a Hard Place
items.description: Fun-loving San Francisco Police Department investigator Nash Bridges is part of the elite Special Investigations Unit. He tackles crime using his keen sense of humor and charm. Joe Dominguez comes out of retirement to become Bridges' wisecracking yet more rule-abiding partner.

items.title: Jump Start
items.description: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

items.title: Lap Dance
items.description: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

items.title: Land Pirates
items.description: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

items.title: ManHunt
items.description: A drug gang knocks over a DEA evidence warehouse and proves elusive for the members of the team; Antwon has a seizure while chasing down the leader of the gang.

items.title: Double Trouble
items.description: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) find out that someone has been "borrowing" the name of their detective agency. Guest stars: Jenna Lewis, Joel Klug, Sean Kenniff and Gervase Peterson of "Survivor."

items.title: End Game
items.description: Nash and the others uncover a deadly game wherein the players try to assassinate each other; Nash's friend Boz Bishop is framed for murder.

items.title: Blow Out
items.description: Nash and Joe track down former SIU officer Rick Bettina, who escaped during his parole hearing to recover the money he stole.

items.title: The Messenger
items.description: Nash protects a newscaster from a deranged fan; Joe is caught in the middle of a crime while selling his car.

items.title: Grave Robbers
items.description: Nash takes on the case of a clever con man who fakes his own death after ripping off a dangerous organized crime boss; Joe learns that his mother-in-law smokes marijuana.

items.title: Bear Trap
items.description: Nash and Joe bear down on black market poachers selling animal gall bladders; the office buzzes with rumors of a romance between Nash and Rachel.

items.title: Slam Dunk!
items.description: Nash and Joe investigate the murder of a wealthy lawyer; Cassidy and Rachel are caught in a love triangle.

items.title: Recover Me
items.description: A wealthy accounting adviser sets Rachel up for a murder, and her lack of cooperation confuses Nash until he discovers a secret from her past.

items.title: Something Borrowed
items.description: Nash is flabbergasted to learn that he's legally married to Tamara Van Zant and comes to the conclusion that she's up to her old tricks again; Nick acts as a "beard" for a lesbian friend.

items.title: Out of Miami
items.description: U.S. Marshal Rick Hawks comes back to the Bay Area to transport a key witness in an important drug trafficking case.

items.title: The Partner
items.description: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

items.title: Blood Bots
items.description: Nash tracks the ringleader of a new technical gang who built a small army of remote-controlled robots, fully equipped with heavy artillery, to pull off a string of robberies.

items.title: Quack Fever
items.description: Painful memories and the dangers of the drug trade collide when Nick learns the truth about Nash's older brother Bobby, who was supposedly missing for more than 20 years.

items.title: Kill Joy
items.description: The murder of a newscaster begins a string of stalkings involving women of the same name, and Harvey eventually discovers the killer's motive.

items.title: Change Up

items.description: Anne (Diane Lane) is at a crossroads in her life. Married to a successful but inattentive movie producer (Alec Baldwin), she unexpectedly finds herself taking a car trip from Cannes to Paris with her husband's business associate (Arnaud Viard). What should be a seven-hour drive turns into a carefree two-day adventure replete with diversions involving picturesque sights, fine food and wine, humor, wisdom and romance, reawakening Anne's senses and giving her a new lust for life.

Each episode features a single Mexican food, ranging from familiar ingredients like vanilla to mysterious grains used by the Aztecs. Season 8 explores simple and delectable dishes from both Mexico and the United States, including street food, a seafood feast, taco recipes, lobster recipes, and a breakfast based on Sinaloan classics.

items.title: A Day With Hugo
items.description: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

items.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
items.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

items.title: Guayabera World

Sometimes these are cold, calculated attacks and other times they are spontaneous acts of vengeance born in the heat of the moment. Kanan navigates this world of glamour and grit as he comes into his own and gets out of the shadow of his mother, Raq, who runs the streets of Southside Jamaica, Queens, with her brothers, Marvin and Lou-Lou. Despite Kanan being under their watchful eyes, danger lurks just around the corner. There's Unique, a rival dealer who has his eye on the family's turf, and Detective Malcolm Howard, a pestering cop who gets a kick out of harassing community members and getting under Raq's skin.

items.title: Proscuitto & Burrata Pizza
items.description: The Peach Burrata Pizza recipe from this week's "Pretty Delicious" episode is the perfect dish for a casual dinner with friends at home. It takes less than 30 minutes to make and you'll end up with a flavorful, picturesque, and no-fuss pizza that everyone will enjoy!

items.title: Cheesy Stuffed Shells with Chicken
items.description: In this week's "Pretty Delicious", Naomi Robinson cooks the ultimate weeknight dish! It doesn't get much better than these stuffed shells with juicy tender chicken and sundried tomatoes bursting with flavor.

items.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Recipe
items.description: This ultimate pulled pork sandwich has everything in it and doesn't require any grilling whatsoever. Watch this week's episode of "Pretty Delicious" and learn how to make a mouth-watering pulled pork recipe using your slowcooker.

items.description: Food Blogger Naomi Robinson shares quick and easy recipes for weeknight meals and casual entertaining

items.title: The Ultimate French Toast Breakfast Sandwich
items.description: Calling all breakfast lovers! This twofer breakfast sandwich is the classic egg sandwich layered with hash browns, bacon, egg and cheese...then sandwiched between two slices of French toast. Serve it straight up or with a side of syrup for a little decadence!

items.title: One Skillet Chicken Dish
items.description: This week on "Pretty Delicious," Naomi Robinson whips up a One Skillet Chicken Dish that is creamy, delicious, and easy to make! Did we mention that this dish only requires one pan, AKA less dirty dishes to clean... now that's what we're talking about!

items.title: Mango Coconut Granola Bars
items.description: In this week's "Pretty Delicious", Naomi Robinson whips up healthy granola bars that are perfect to grab if you're on the go or craving a light snack. This nutty and fruity bar will blow your taste buds away!

items.title: Avocado Toast - 3 Ways
items.description: If you love avocados as much as we do, then you'll go crazy for these recipes! This week on "Pretty Delicious" Naomi Robinson whips up three different mouth-watering and flavorful avocado toasts, perfect for breakfast or a mid-day treat.

items.title: Naked Cake Topped with Flowers
items.description: Did somebody say cheat day?! This week on "Pretty Delicious" Julianna Strickland bakes a heavenly vanilla cake coated with buttercream frosting.

items.title: Apple Crisp
items.description: Apples coated with sugar, spice, and everything nice! This week on Pretty Delicious, Julianna Strickland teaches you how to make a homemade apple crisp.

items.title: Vanilla Chia Seed Pudding
items.description: Delicious vanilla chia seed pudding with a tasty fall twist! This no-fuss pudding is the perfect grab-and-go breakfast for when you're on the run.

items.title: Red Pear Tart Recipe
items.description: Red Anjou pears are in season! Show off the natural sweetness of this tasty fall fruit with this mouth-watering tart.

items.title: Cinnamon Rolls with a Brown Sugar Glaze
items.description: This week on Pretty Delicious, Julianna Strickland makes ooey-gooey sweet cinnamon rolls. These over the top rolls are generously topped with a warm brown sugar glaze and make the perfect addition to your morning coffee.

items.title: Candy Cane Cookies
items.description: Just when you thought cookies couldn't get better, Julianna Strickland proves you wrong... and you won't even be mad about it! This candy cane cookie is minty, chocolatey, and a must-bake for your holiday party.

items.title: Eton Mess Dessert with Berry Sauce
items.description: Have you ever heard of an eton mess? If not, you're missing out on arguably the worlds sweetest dessert! This week on Pretty Delicious, Julianna Strickland makes a classic eton mess with all of the works.

items.title: Prince Harry: Joker In the Pack
items.description: Prince Harry isn't your average Royal Prince; life in the British royal family is unlike any other - it is one of duty, of service, of privilege, but at a great price - freedom; since leaving not only his role as senior royal but the UK as well.

items.title: Prince Philip: A Lifetime of Duty
items.description: A tribute to Prince Philip, known for a lifelong dedication to his duties as the Duke of Edinburgh and being a supportive husband to Her Royal Highness Queen Elizabeth.

items.title: Prince: Purple Reign
items.description: The events leading up to and surrounding Prince's untimely death; a tribute to his career; exclusive interviews from psychologists, music critics, fans and an account from the Carver County sheriff.

items.title: Prince: The Last 24 Hours
items.description: The world mourns the loss of one of its most innovative performers, Prince, in April 2016; while Prince's official autopsy confirms that the singer died from an overdose of fentanyl, investigators try to clear up some additional mysteries.

items.title: Princess Diana: Romance & Rivalry
items.description: What the world saw as the perfect marriage following a fairytale romance, the reality behind palace doors was a life full of rivalry, distrust, and loneliness; Princess Diana was a new kind of royal, a young woman thrust into the spotlight.

items.title: Princess Diana: The Quiet Revolution
items.description: No one in history has ever been so universally adored as Diana, Princess of Wales. In her short life, she captivated the world with her beauty, charm and limitless compassion. Her legacy still lives on two decades after her tragic death.

items.title: Princess Margaret: From Armstrong to the End
items.description: Princess Margaret was the quintessential modern royal, caught between tradition, desire and public opinion; she maintained a love for life, not worried about how the tabloids perceived her.

items.title: Project MKHEXE
items.description: A found-footage psychological thriller. After his brother Sean's suicide, Tim, an aspiring filmmaker, uncovers Sean's obsession with a deleted urban legend tied to a secret mind-control experiment. As Tim investigates, compiling Sean's notes and interviewing family and friends, he suspects Sean was murdered. With help from Sean's friend Nicole, Tim's search for truth spirals into obsession, unraveling his grief and revealing a chilling reality: "What We Fear, We Create."

items.title: Property Brothers: Dorothy and John
items.description: Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents' basement, and with baby number two on the way they're desperate to find a home of their own. It's a race against time, and the Property Brothers step in with a plan.

items.title: Property Brothers: Monique and Carl
items.description: Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

items.title: Property Brothers: Kevin and Shirley
items.description: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

items.title: Property Brothers: Debra & Dan
items.description: Along with their three small children, Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo. And though they'd prefer to stay in the heart of the city, it's time to find the sprawling suburban home of their dreams.

items.title: Property Brothers: Lizzy & Dave
items.description: With three kids and another one on the way, Dave and Lizzy are desperate to get out of their rental and into the home of their dreams. But they've been house hunting for years already, and their due date is fast approaching.

items.title: Property Brothers: Nathan & Jessica
items.description: Tennis pros Jessica and Nathan have been living a cramped condo lifestyle for way too long. And now they're desperate to find a sprawling home in the country where they can put down roots and entertain family in style.

items.title: Property Brothers: Mark & Eugenie
items.description: Juggling after-school activities with their careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had time for house hunting. While the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, the Property Brothers warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental.

items.title: Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil
items.description: Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

items.title: Property Brothers: Leslie & Tim
items.description: Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

items.title: Property Brothers: Kyle & Jackie
items.description: Kyle and Jackie are living at her mom's until they find a home of their own. And though they've got a healthy budget, they've set their sights on one of the city's priciest neighborhoods.

items.title: Property Brothers: Emily & Ken
items.description: With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

items.title: Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre
items.description: Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

items.title: Property Brothers: George & Jenn
items.description: In order to cut down on his monster commute, George and Jenn want to move closer to family and friends. And while that's something they both agree on, they're miles apart when it comes to design.

items.title: Property Brothers - Rave & Michelle
items.description: Along with their two little ones, Rave and Michelle are staying with his parents while hunting for the perfect suburban home. And though they're a close-knit family, living under one roof is proving too close for comfort.

items.title: Property Brothers: Katie & Michael
items.description: Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

items.title: Protecting Princess Diana: The Bodyguard's Story
items.description: Inspector Ken Wharfe, Princess Diana's royal protection officer, discusses life as it really was for the princess.

items.title: Proud in a Pandemic

items.title: Pulse
items.description: After college student Taguchi (Kenji Mizuhashi) commits suicide, a number of young adults living in Tokyo witness terrifying visions transferred across the Internet. As more people disappear throughout the city, the Internet becomes a breeding ground for malevolent spirits. Three seemingly disconnected stories follow Michi (Kumiko Asô), Ryosuke (Haruhiko Katô) and Harue (Koyuki) as they attempt to solve the mystery behind the ghostly visions that are seeping beyond their computer monitors.

items.title: Puppet Master: The Littlest Reich
items.description: A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.

items.title: Puppy Star Christmas
items.description: Four lovable puppies must save Christmas when four mischievous doggies hijack Santa Claus and the North Pole for their own gain.

items.title: Purple Heart
items.description: An officer must track down a disturbed soldier whose covert mission to assassinate Saddam Hussein led to the soldier's capture and torture by the Iraqis.

items.title: Pusher
items.description: As a heroin dealer in Copenhagen, Frank (Kim Bodnia) is far from the top but earns good money pushing with a friend (Mads Mikkelsen). When he decides to up the ante, Frank goes to Milo (Zlatko Buric), a drug lord -- except he doesn't have enough money for the heroin. Instead, Milo fronts him the goods upon the condition of immediate repayment. But when Frank goes to make the deal, and the police arrive, he has to ditch the drugs. Now Frank has to find a way to repay Milo if he wants to live.

items.title: Pusher II: With Blood on My Hands
items.description: Trouble follows an ex-convict (Mads Mikkelsen) as he tries to gain his father's favor.

items.title: Pusher III: I'm the Angel of Death
items.description: Milo (Zlatko Buric) is a drug dealer and recovering addict who's slowly coming unraveled. While trying to prepare for his daughter Milena's (Marinela Dekic) birthday party, he discovers the shipment of heroin he was expecting is actually Ecstasy. Milo gives the pills to small-fry dealer Mohammed (Ilyas Agac) and, as the party begins, starts using narcotics again. Things go from bad to worse when Mohammad doesn't return, and Milo's Albanian connection demands payment for the Ecstasy.

items.title: Putney Swope
items.description: When its chairman dies, an advertising firm's executive board must elect someone to fill the position. Each member, unable to vote for himself, casts a secret ballot for Putney Swope (Arnold Johnson), the firm's only black executive, assuming he wouldn't receive any votes from the other members. But once in power, Swope makes radical changes to the firm -- like keeping only one white employee and refusing to advertise harmful products -- all under the firm's new moniker, "Truth and Soul, Inc."

items.title: Queen Elizabeth & Prince Philip: Love, Marriage & Country
items.description: Queen Elizabeth The Second has been the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom and the Commonwealth since 1952. Much like the nation she resides over, she has seen unimaginable growth and change in her time.

items.title: Queen of Earth
items.description: Tensions rise when an emotionally fragile woman (Elisabeth Moss) spends one week with her best friend (Katherine Waterston).

items.title: Queen of the Desert

items.title: Queen: How They Broke Free

items.description: Set in working-class Pittsburgh, the drama revolves around a group of gay friends and their relationships, careers, loves and ambitions.

items.title: Home Is Where the Ass Is
items.description: Brian copes with Justin's assault; Melanie and Lindsay attend a wedding; Chris Hobbs is sentenced.

items.title: All Better Now
items.description: Justin suffers from nightmares about his attacker and faces difficulty with physical contact; Michael and Emmett get jobs as naked waiters.

items.title: Meeting People Is Easy

items.title: Unfinished Business
items.description: Stuart pursues a client; Vince is set up on a date with a woman; Nathan is determined to find Stuart again.

items.title: It Happened One Night

items.title: D.I.S.C.O.

items.title: Thirty

items.title: Choke
items.description: Brodie's confidence is shaken when he returns home to New Orleans and finds that all his friends have moved on with their lives. His best friend Ruthie and her partner Shar are navigating new family commitments. His ex, Noah, is suddenly exploring a new side of his sexuality. Even his brother Julian seems unperturbed by his nearly two-year absence. But one fateful night out at a club brings Mingus, a young aspiring drag performer, into his life, redefines his relationships and rocks the very foundations of their city's queer community.

items.title: Huge Gamble, Huge Reward
items.description: Got a great idea for something that fulfills a need? Then "Quirky" is the place to go. The innovative technology company guides would-be inventors through the process of developing their ideas into designs, then to prototypes, and then, finally, if they're good enough, the fully realized product heads to store shelves. Each episode involves selection of an idea or two from their online community, and any profits made are shared among all the contributors, including a global group of collaborators.

items.title: Love Your Product
items.description: Quirky puts a twist on the can opener; a single mom's idea for an innovative dog accessory.

items.title: Sacrifice for Sex Appeal
items.description: Bracelet wallet; shower holder.

items.title: I Crush It
items.description: Camera case doubles as a tripod; unique clothes hangers.

items.title: Hell Yes
items.description: Modular coffee storage; headphone holder.

items.title: Very Messy, Very Fast

items.title: Quiz

items.title: Quiz
items.description: Charged with stealing a million pounds and persecuted by the public and the press, the Ingrams head to court; at first it seems the trial is a fait accompli, but as the defense's case gets underway, the jury learn there is far more to the story.

items.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious

items.title: R. Kelly: The Verdict

items.title: Rabbit Trap

While collecting audio samples, Darcy inadvertently creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. The discovery soon renews Daphne's creative energy, but as the echoes of her music bleed into the surrounding landscape, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.

items.title: Rabid
items.description: Horribly disfigured after a freak accident, doctors perform a radical medical procedure on an aspiring young fashion designer. But when the bandages come off, the side effects soon cause her to develop an insatiable appetite for human blood.

items.title: Rabid Dogs

items.title: Rabid Grannies

items.title: Rage

items.title: Ragnarok
items.description: A Norwegian archaeologist uncovers mysterious runes describing Ragnarök, the Viking legend of the end of the world, and accidentally awakens a giant monster.

items.title: Raiders of Red Gap
items.description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

items.title: Rainbow Valley
items.description: A federal agent poses as a prisoner in order to secure vital secrets from a fellow inmate concerning an outlaw gang.

items.title: Raise Hell: The Life & Times of Molly Ivins
items.description: The life and work of Molly Ivins, a political journalist from Texas, best-selling author, and Bill of Rights warrior.

items.title: Surviving Six
items.description: Raising kids isn't easy -- just ask Jenny and Brian Masche. They were an average young married couple until they learned they were expecting sextuplets. Cameras follow the controlled chaos, beginning when Bailey Elizabeth, Savannah Jane, Molli Grace, Blake Nickolas, Cole Robert and Grant William are just 16 months old.

items.title: Trees and Baby Bees
items.description: Grandpa Bill offers the services of his construction company to remodel the house; Jenny's determined to celebrate Halloween.

items.title: Making Over Mom
items.description: Jenny attempts to reverse the damage to her body through plastic surgery; Thanksgiving.

items.title: Christmas Chaos
items.description: Christmas tree hunt; Christmas card photo session; Vegas shopping spree; train ride on the Polar Express.

items.title: Surfside Six
items.description: Bryan and Jenny have differing ideas about how they should experience the world; Jenny and her best friend Melaina compete in a half-marathon.

items.title: Water Babies
items.description: The sextuplets head toward the terrible twos; Bryan heads to the diet doctor for his final weigh-in; the family takes a trip to a wildlife preserve.

items.title: Turning Two, Times Six
items.description: The sextuplets are all moving into their terrible twos; Bryan's new career could mean a big move; Bryan and Jenny realize they need to return to marriage counseling.

items.title: We're Moving!
items.description: Jenny and Bryan decide to move to the city; the family thinks it's a bad decision; potty training begins.

items.title: 10 is Enough

Ramsay and his team redecorate each eatery to give it a fresh new look in hopes of attracting a larger crowd. Ramsay's ultimate goal is to make the restaurants he visits profitable for their struggling owners.

items.title: Glass House

items.title: Walnut Tree

items.title: Moore Place
items.description: Moore Place.

items.title: The Fenwick Arms

items.title: Rococo
items.description: Gordon finds a chef caught in a time warp when he tackles a largely unfrequented upmarket restaurant in King's Lynn.

items.title: Piccolo Teatro

items.title: The Runaway Girl
items.description: Gordon attempts to help two friends save their failing tapas bar and nightclub from corporate competition.

items.description: Gordon attempts to help turn around a family-run bistro with hideous decor, bad food and a chef who can't face up to his mistakes.

items.title: The Fenwick Arms
items.description: Gordon returns to the Fenwick Arms to see if the owners stuck to the menu of traditional pub fair that he helped design.

items.title: Randy Rides Alone
items.description: Undercover government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) rides into a small town, happening upon a saloon that's just been shot up. Wary of the newcomer, the sheriff (Earle Dwire) arrests Randy for the murders, but the saloon owner's niece, Sally Rogers (Alberta Vaughn), helps him escape because she knows he didn't do it. Randy then sets out to find the man behind the murders and is led to an evil mastermind named Marvin Black (George Hayes), who has been passing himself off as an innocent mute.

However, this is a monstrous, evil Santa, much unlike the cheery St. Nick of legend. When Pietari's father (Jorma Tommila) captures a feral old man (Peeter Jakobi) in his wolf trap, the man may hold the key to why reindeer are being slaughtered and children are disappearing.

When the situation quickly deteriorates and much of his unit is killed, Raven realizes that he's been sent into a trap and marked for death. Barely escaping alive, Raven goes into hiding, but he emerges years later to hunt down and eliminate Martin Grant (Matt Battaglia), the former team member who double-crossed him.

items.title: Ravenstein

items.title: When Kevin Met Salli
items.description: Wouldn't you know, there aren't only "Real Housewives" parading around reality television. The BET original series "Real Husbands of Hollywood" evens the playing field somewhat -- well, not really. The program is actually the "fakest reality show ever," says BET, a satire that skewers all things "Housewives"-like. It stars Kevin Hart, Nick Cannon, Boris Kodjoe, Duane Martin, J.B. Smoove and Nelly, among others, while episodes feature guest appearances by television, film, music and sport's top stars including Jay Leno, Ed O'Neill, Shaquille O'Neal, Faizon Love, Common, Trey Songz and Cedric the Entertainer.

items.title: Claire and Present Danger

While searching for some stability, Stark forms a bond with a disturbed classmate, Plato (Sal Mineo), and falls for local girl Judy (Natalie Wood). However, Judy is the girlfriend of neighborhood tough, Buzz (Corey Allen). When Buzz violently confronts Jim and challenges him to a drag race, the new kid's real troubles begin.

items.title: Always There
items.description: Sundance Channel's first wholly owned scripted series stars Aden Young as Daniel Holden, who spends nearly 20 years on death row for the rape and murder of a teenage girl, before new DNA evidence nullifies his conviction. He returns home, but he's far from welcomed. He's an outsider now in a town that remains divided by his alleged crime, and contributing to his uncertain future is the man who prosecuted him -- riding that notoriety to become a state senator -- is plotting to reopen the case. As he struggles to adapt, Daniel is comforted by support from his younger sister, Amantha, who has always believed in his innocence and has worked her entire adult life to secure his release. Not so for Ted Jr., Daniel's stepbrother with whom he has no relationship. Insecure and manipulative, Ted is skeptical of Daniel's motives and will do anything to protect his family.

items.title: Sexual Peeling
items.description: Daniel explores the town while Amantha worries about his safety; Ted Jr. fears for the future of the family business; tensions run high at Daniel's welcome home party.

items.title: Red Cliff
items.description: In ancient China, the emperor of the Han Dynasty allows General Cao Cao (Fengyi Zhang) to declare war against the rebellious southern provinces, with the intention of unifying the entire country. Cao's large army quickly advances, killing civilians and soldiers alike. To resist Cao, the southern warlords form an alliance led by Viceroy Zhou Yu (Tony Leung). Outnumbered, Zhou relies upon elaborate formations and unorthodox strategies to fight against Cao's overwhelming forces.

items.title: Red Scorpion

items.title: Red Stone
items.description: A dangerous hitman is tasked with hunting down a teenager who witnessed the murder of his older brother at the hands of a ruthless Southern crime lord. The hired gun must track down the boy before either his rivals or the F.B.I. find him first.

items.title: Redacted
items.description: A fictional documentary discusses the effects the Iraq war has had on soldiers and local people through interviews with members of an American military unit, the media, and local Iraqis.

items.title: Rejoice & Shout
items.description: Through the words of clergy members and musicians, this documentary shows the deep connection between faith and gospel music. But this film is more than just a Christian testimonial; with insight provided by music legends like Smokey Robinson and Mavis Staples and copious doses of archival footage, it explores the history of gospel. Chronicling the genre from its early 20th-century beginnings up to the present day, the documentary also shows that the art form isn't strictly meant for the pious.

items.title: Relative
items.description: A filmmaker unearths a pervasive history of multigenerational trauma in her Italian-American family. As decades of secrets, home movies, and long-avoided conversations surface, a family once bound by tradition forges a new path forward.

items.description: Personal trainers (Guy Pearce, Cobie Smulders) are charged with whipping a newly wealthy and highly unmotivated slob (Kevin Corrigan) into shape.

items.title: Revenge
items.description: Jen is enjoying a romantic getaway with her wealthy boyfriend -- until his two sleazy friends arrive for an unannounced hunting trip. As tension mounts in the house, the situation abruptly and viciously intensifies, culminating in a shocking act that leaves Jen left for dead. Unfortunately for her assailants, she survives and soon begins a relentless quest for bloody revenge.

items.title: Reviving Ophelia
items.description: No one listens when a teenager suspects that her cousin (Rebecca Williams) is in an abusive relationship.

items.title: Revolt of the Zombies
