items.title: Rich Habits
items.description: Robert Croak and Austin Hankwitz demystify the financial habits of the rich, share their own mistakes and shortcomings and lay out the blueprint for you to succeed with money by implementing new habits for financial literacy.

items.title: Rich Habits
items.description: A financial literacy guide for anyone ready to take back control of their money by implementing new financial habits. Hosted by Robert Croak & Austin Hankwitz.

items.title: Ride
items.description: Struggling actor James pays his bills by driving people around Los Angeles for a ride-sharing service. James' shift starts out like any other, until he hits it off with a beautiful woman whom he picks up. His next fare, the fast-talking Bruno, convinces James to invite her along for a wild night out. But things take a shocking turn when Bruno, armed with a gun and a twisted idea of fun, initiates a terrifying, white-knuckle ride that quickly spirals out of control.

items.title: California: Pacific Coast Highway
items.description: Norman and his friend Imogen Lehtonen ride up the California Pacific Coast Highway to check out some dune buggies, ride a futuristic bike and do a podcast.

items.title: Death Valley: Dante's View
items.description: Traveling from Las Vegas to Death Valley.

items.title: Appalachia: Blue Ridge Parkway
items.description: A good ride from Atlanta to Asheville.

items.title: Texas: Twisted Sisters
items.description: A ride from Austin to San Antonio, Texas.

items.title: Louisiana: Crescent City
items.description: From Lafayette to New Orleans.

items.title: The Keys With Peter Fonda
items.description: Traveling from Naples to Key West, Fla., makes three rides in one.

items.title: Spain with Jeffrey Dean Morgan
items.description: Norman and his "The Walking Dead" castmate Jeffrey Dean Morgan ride through Spain; starting in Barcelona and ending at the Falles festival in Valencia.

items.title: Lowcountry with Dave Chappelle
items.description: Norman and comedian Dave Chappelle ride from Charleston to Savannah; stopping along the way to experience the culture and history of Lowcountry.

items.title: California: Joshua Tree
items.description: Norman Reedus rides from Los Angeles to Joshua Tree; visits friends including Greg Nicotero; explores Southern California's hidden gems.

items.title: New Mexico: White Sands
items.description: Norman and musician Aimee Nash ride from Albuquerque to White Sands, N.M.; they ride ziplines, eat chili and test out government-grade weapons.

items.title: Hawaii: The Big Island
items.description: Norman and photographer Patrick Hoelck ride the Big Island of Hawaii; taking in local customs like fishing, ukulele music, and exploring volcanoes.

items.title: My New York
items.description: Norman rides around his home city of New York while visiting friends and exploring the city's art, food and culture.

items.title: England: A Walking Dead Reunion
items.description: Norman Reedus and Jeffrey Dean Morgan take in the sights and sounds of London, then roam mystic landscapes to meet an old friend and a rock icon.

items.title: Bay Area With Steven Yeun
items.description: Norman Reedus and Steven Yeun hit the Bay Area of California, navigating sprawling urban centers and lush green countryside to meet a group of motorcycle legends.

items.title: Scotland With Melissa McBride
items.description: Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride traverse rolling hills and castle ruins of Scotland to uncover the mysteries of Melissa's Scottish ancestors.

items.title: Valley of the Sun With Austin Amelio
items.description: Norman Reedus and Austin Amelio explore the desert wasteland of Arizona on a heavy metal adventure to meet some of the country's bravest heroes.

items.title: Lone Star State With Sean Patrick Flanery
items.description: Norman Reedus and Sean Patrick Flanery saddle up and ride through the heart of Texas to hang out with influential tattoo artist Oliver Peck in Dallas.

items.title: Georgia With Michael Rooker
items.description: Norman Reedus explores the historic city of Birmingham, Ala., with his onscreen brother, Michael Rooker, and they have fun in Atlanta before arriving in Senoia, Ga., for a "Walking Dead" reunion.

items.title: Japan With Ryan Hurst
items.description: Norman Reedus tours modern Japan with actor Ryan Hurst, exploring its technological history and ultimately arriving at the iconic and serene Mount Fuji.

items.title: Japan With Milo Ventimiglia
items.description: Norman Reedus travels from Kyoto to Osaka, Japan, with actor Milo Ventimiglia, taking in its cultural traditions and meeting some creative locals along the way.

items.title: Costa Rica With Dom Rocket
items.description: Norman Reedus and DJ Dom Rocket traverse the jungles and coasts of Costa Rica while doing some extreme riding, and exploring its natural beauty.

items.title: Uruguay With Becky Goebel
items.description: Norman Reedus and Becky Goebel learn about the easygoing country of Uruguay while riding with locals to take in the rich culture it has to offer.

items.title: Kentucky With Clifton Collins Jr.
items.description: Norman Reedus rides from Louisville to the Red River Gorge with actor Clifton Collins Jr., embracing the quintessential Kentucky experience.

items.title: The North Island of New Zealand With Josh Brolin
items.description: Norman Reedus explores the harbor city of Auckland before meeting up with actor Josh Brolin; together they discover a rich native Maori culture and an affinity for motor sports amongst the stunning North Island landscape.

items.title: The South Island of New Zealand With Dylan McDermott
items.description: Actor Dylan McDermott joins Norman Reedus for a scenic trip along New Zealand's majestic South Island; navigating dramatic mountain roads, they take in some of the most rugged, unpredictable landscape in a remote corner of the world.

items.title: Journey Down Norman's Memory Lane
items.description: Norman Reedus looks back at his favorite moments from the previous four seasons, revisiting trips with Peter Fonda, Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Melissa McBride, and Dave Chappelle and remembering time spent in Japan, Costa Rica, Europe, and Uruguay.

items.title: America: Cross Country Adventure
items.description: From the Pacific Coast Highway to the city of New York, Norman Reedus recalls his favorite experiences traveling America from coast to coast, on rides through the country with Steven Yeun, Austin Amelio, Sean Patrick Flanery, and Dave Chappelle.

items.title: Globetrotting on Two Wheels
items.description: From his travels, Norman Reedus has discovered it's the people who make the journey; he looks back on those he's met and the lessons he's learned throughout the world with guests Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Melissa McBride, Ryan Hurst, and Milo Ventimiglia.

items.title: The Road Less Traveled: Behind the Scenes
items.description: Norman Reedus joins the crew as they revisit their most unusual and surprising experiences on the road throughout the years, telling behind-the-scenes stories and pulling the curtains back to reveal what it took to get there.

items.title: The Utah Desert With Keanu Reeves
items.description: The soft spots that fans of "The Walking Dead" have for Norman Reedus, who portrays volatile survivalist Daryl Dixon on the mega-popular series, is sure to grow after Reedus opens up on the open road. In "Ride With Norman Reedus," the motorcycle enthusiast hops on his favorite two wheelers to explore local bike culture and celebrate the best collectors, mechanics and motorcycle craftsmen around the country. Each hourlong episode begins in a different city, where Reedus hooks up with a riding companion -- an actor, musician, friend or local motorcycle fan -- to visit places like custom bike shops, tattoo parlors, collectors' depots, and roadside smokehouses. There's ample time for impromptu detours and tire changes, too.

items.title: Northern Italy With Josh Holloway
items.description: Actor Josh Holloway joins Norman Reedus for a ride through rustic Northern Italy; navigating through some of the most scenic roads in Europe, they quench their need for speed in Motor Valley before exploring Josh's old stomping grounds in Bologna.

items.title: The Eternal City With Johnny Knoxville
items.description: Accompanied by actor Johnny Knoxville, Norman Reedus navigates his way through ancient Rome, the eternal city; taking in the cuisine and culture of the birthplace of Western Civilization.

items.title: Portugal: A Journey From Lisbon to Porto
items.description: Norman Reedus and artist Adri Law explore one of Europe's hottest destinations: Portugal; on a scenic ride up the country's western shoreline, they discover the impact the recent tourist boom has had on this old world country.

items.title: Blood and Gold
items.description: Cowboys and a businessman compete to find lost treasure.

items.title: Death Marks the Trail
items.description: Jim Benton leads a group of vigilantes called the "Riders of Death Valley" that protect the local miners from the evil plans of Joseph Kirby and Rance Davis.

items.title: Flaming Fury
items.description: Some Easterners intend to seize a tract of valuable timber land; Hoppy must try to stop them before they blow up a major dam.

items.title: Plunge of Peril
items.description: In the split moment before the overtaking of the herd reaches him, Benton vaults to his saddle and safety, leaving Reade's men scattered and believing him dead.

items.title: The Avalanche of Doom
items.description: When the showboat hits town, two men use the parade as a distraction to rob the bank; their accomplice is Pop, the clown from the showboat.

items.title: The Menacing Herd
items.description: When Lucky spots Steve Langdon, a dead ringer for Collins, he arrests him.

items.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
items.description: The discovery of an invasive insect species threatens his logging business, so Bill Wright (Damian O'Flynn) murders a forest ranger to keep him from reporting his findings. Local hunter Gene Autry (Gene Autry), who had been nearby, shooting at a mountain lion, thinks he may have been responsible for the ranger's death and takes over his job out of a sense of duty to the man's daughter (Patricia White). Gene and his sidekick, Joe Lucas (Jimmy Lloyd), battle Wright and his men to save the forest.

items.title: Ridin' On
items.description: A cowboy (Tom Tyler) helps the daughter (Geraine Greer) of his father's (John Elliott) rival (Earl Dwire).

items.title: Riding the Ocean Dragon
items.description: China's first major expedition to the depths of the Indian Ocean in the world's deepest diving three-person research submarine.

items.title: Ring of Fire
items.description: June Carter (Jewel) rises to fame as a country singer, while falling in love with the legendary Johnny Cash (Matt Ross).

items.title: Riotsville, U.S.A.
items.description: Connecting the stagecraft of law and order to the real violence of state practice; recovering an obscured history whose effects have shaped the present in ways both insidious and explosive.

items.title: Rites of Passage
items.description: Anthropology students and their professor (Stephen Dorff) experience terror when they visit a sacred burial ground.

items.title: River Runs Red
items.description: A vengeful judge takes the law into his own hands when two cops kill his young son during a routine traffic stop.

items.title: Road Games
items.description: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

items.title: Road to Utopia
items.description: During the Alaskan gold rush, beautiful young Sal (Dorothy Lamour) travels to Alaska on the trail of the pair of thugs (Nestor Paiva, Robert Barrat) who murdered her father and stole the map to his gold mine. Meanwhile, genial con men Chester (Bob Hope) and Duke (Bing Crosby) unwittingly steal the wanted men's identities and get involved in an escalating series of mistaken identities and double-crosses involving Sal, the real thieves and avaricious bar owner Ace (Douglas Dumbrille).

items.title: Quite A Load of Bull
items.description: Roadways can be a wild, dangerous and unpredictable place; with violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, "road raging" is a human behavior that has become widely known and is one of the many threats to everyone on the road; "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather and insane accidents causing trouble for drivers all over the country; the series is not all rage and fury, as welcome acts of kindness also tend to arise in these dire situations.

items.title: Runaway Cowboy
items.description: A cowboy takes his mule on a getaway ride from police in Kentucky; a family in Michigan takes on an erratic driver by diving into his window; a malfunctioning railroad gate in Poland traps a van on the tracks; a lane-splitting motorcyclist collides with a lane-changing driver on an overpass in Texas; a driver in Wisconsin fails to heed cross traffic at a stop sign.

items.title: Parking Space Invaders
items.description: A family's fierce defense of a parking space turns contentious with Florida officers; an SUV passes on the shoulder of a Virginia freeway with disastrous results; a motorist in China is run over by his own sedan; a car carrier's cargo bursts into flames in a New Jersey parking lot; a glitchy stop sign on a school bus causes a traffic jam in New York.

items.title: This Boot Was Made For Drivin'
items.description: A driver clashes with parking enforcement as they boot his car in Chicago; a stunting biker on a Missouri highway gets a furious response from a pickup; a woman suffers a medical emergency on a Michigan freeway with her child in the car; a California woman loses her phone while filming out her sunroof; a plane attempts an emergency landing on a car-filled Florida interstate.

items.title: Roadie
items.description: After losing his longtime job with Blue Oyster Cult, a stagehand (Ron Eldard) returns to his hometown, where a night of partying with old friends shows him that some things never change.

items.title: Roads
items.description: A young man from the Congo teams up with a British runaway in Morocco, and they take a road trip in a stolen vehicle to France, encountering poverty and refugees and having to make decisions that will influence the lives of others.

items.title: Roarin' Lead
items.description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) round up rustlers and save an orphanage.

items.title: Robert Kennedy: In the Shadow of Success
items.description: Born Robert Francis Kennedy, on November 20, 1925, and brother to the 36th President of the United States of America, Robert was a candidate in the 1968 presidential election; however, his winning streak came to an abrupt end.

items.title: The Mighty Misfits Who Made Marvel
items.description: Executive producer Robert Kirkman ("The Walking Dead") is, first and foremost, a comic creator. His love for the craft knows no bounds, he says, and he shares that passion in this documentary series. The six hourlong episodes deep-dive into the stories, people and events that have transformed the world of comic books. Among those featured in interviews are Stan Lee, Patty Jenkins, Lynda Carter, Kevin Smith, Famke Janssen, J.K. Simmons, Michelle Rodriguez, and Todd McFarlane, among many others.

items.title: The Truth About Wonder Woman
items.description: Comic books become popular and male superheroes rise to stardom; one man creates a feminist superhero inspired by both his wife and his mistress.

items.title: The Trials of Superman
items.description: The story of how the world's first superhero came to be; how Superman's creators fought for years to receive proper credit and compensation.

items.title: City of Heroes
items.description: Exploring how the 9/11 terrorist attacks in New York fundamentally changed comic book writing and the portrayal of superheroes.

items.title: The Color of Comics
items.description: The rise and fall of Milestone Comics, an African-American-owned comic book imprint which came to life in early 1990s New York.

items.title: Image Comics: Declaration of Independents
items.description: Seven renegade artists shock the comic-book industry by starting their own company, Image Comics, to rival giants Marvel and DC.

items.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
items.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

items.title: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
items.description: The story of Robin Williams, a great comedian who struggled with mental illnesses for a long time before giving up on his life.

items.title: Robin: Watch for Wishes
items.description: A man discovers his terminally ill son's bucket list.

items.title: Destination Delta City
items.description: An in-depth look into the groundbreaking franchise and featuring new interviews with cast and crew, including Hollywood icons such as Peter Weller, Diane Robin, Ronny Cox, Nancy Allen, Ray Wise, director Paul Verhoeven & more.

items.title: Verhoeven's Mantra
items.description: With the production in full swing, director Paul Verhoeven is pushing the envelope and many people's buttons; the shoot is heating up, and with the unprecedented filming conditions, the cast and crew are pushed to their limits.

items.title: Blood, Sweat and Steel
items.description: Featuring first-hand accounts from the cast and crew, as they relive the golden era of hands-on, practical filmmaking in the 1980s.

items.title: Murphy and The Machine
items.description: "The Creation of RoboCop" shows the franchise's impact on the action and science fiction genres, blazing a trail alongside "The Terminator," into the technologically driven cinema scape we see today.

items.title: Rock and Roll Revue
items.description: Vintage clips of great jazz artists.

items.description: Unburying the Queer Roots of Rock, Punk and Metal.

items.description: Academy Award winner Dustin Lance Black exposes rock's hidden queer history.

items.title: 26_148-2_RockOut_S1E4_TV14_US
items.description: Academy Award winner Dustin Lance Black exposes rock's hidden queer history.

items.title: Rock the Kasbah
items.description: While visiting Kabul, Afghanistan, washed-up music manager Richie Lanz (Bill Murray) gets dumped by his last client. His luck changes when he meets Salima Khan (Leem Lubany), a Pashtun teenager with a beautiful voice who dreams of becoming the first female to compete on the television show "Afghan Star." With help from a savvy hooker (Kate Hudson), two war profiteers and a trigger-happy mercenary (Bruce Willis), Richie embarks on a mission to make sure his new protégée gets discovered.

items.title: Romulus, My Father
items.description: A woman's (Franka Potente) increasingly erratic behavior affects her husband (Eric Bana), her lover (Russell Dykstra) and her son (Kodi Smit-McPhee).

items.title: Splitting the Stone
items.description: Five champions in mystical armor strive to defeat a dark emperor and his four warlords to save the world from domination.

items.title: Friend or Foe
items.description: Before they can rendezvous with Sage, Kento and Mia, Ryo and Cye set out to rescue Rowen from Dais, who casts illusions that turn the warriors against each other.

items.title: Wildfire in the Sky
items.description: The team splits up to learn what Talpa has planned for Rowen, who is lost somewhere in space, hoping they can find a way to reach Rowen before Talpa's forces eliminate him.

items.title: In the Sea of the Sky
items.description: Ryo attempts to break free of the dark matrix before it crushes him while his allies on the ground battle Talpa's forces; Anubis shows signs of defiance toward Talpa.

items.title: Assault on the Dynasty
items.description: Dais plots to lure the heroes into a trap within the castle gates and separate them from their armor, leaving it up to Mia, Ully and White Blaze to come to the rescue.

items.title: Shallow Darkness
items.description: As the heroes approach Talpa's castle, the enemy attacks and succeeds in splitting up the team; Sage, Ully and Mia encounter Cale in the subway, but the lack of light underground prevents Sage from using his full power.

items.title: Fate of the Ronin Armor
items.description: Kento and Rowen meet up in the subway and search for the others while Talpa enacts a plan to turn the heroes to evil based on his knowledge of their armors' dark origins.

items.title: Armor of Life
items.description: Despite Anubis' previous failure to follow Talpa's orders, Talpa dispatches him to an amusement park where the heroes have gathered; Kento tries to fight without his armor, fearing that using it will turn him against his friends.

items.title: The Ancient's Battle
items.description: The Ancient One reveals the nature of the mystical armors and their relationship to good and evil; as Anubis rethinks his loyalty to Talpa, Talpa's other warlords launch an attack.

items.title: Raid on Talpa's Castle
items.description: The Ancient One helps the heroes reach Talpa's castle and the team faces the combined might of the dark forces in an attempt to break through and face Talpa himself.

items.title: The Legend of the Armor
items.description: Talpa easily defeats Ryo and integrates his warlords' armors into his own form, directly attacking the heroes to steal their armors for himself.

items.title: Talpa's Triumph
items.description: With the powers of all the other armors at his command, Talpa confronts Ryo, the only remaining warrior, who must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.

items.title: Wildfire's Fight Against Fate
items.description: As Ryo fights to keep Talpa from absorbing him into his armor, the Ancient One tells Ryo about Talpa's origins and helps Ryo understand the armors can be used for good as long as the heroes stay determined to fight against evil.

items.title: Ronin vs. Saranbo
items.description: Despite vanquishing Talpa and restoring the city and its people, the heroes remain unsettled due to the lingering evil forces and the toll the Inferno Armor is taking on Ryo; a new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the armor for himself.

items.title: Ryo's Mega Armor
items.description: Saranbo gathers forces to prepare to go after Ryo's armor; full of regret and not wanting his friends to get hurt in his defense, a weakened Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.

items.title: Saber Stryke's Deadly Challenge
items.description: Mia finds evidence in her grandfather's notes of special swords Ryo can use with his new armor; Lord Saber Stryke and his tiger attack the heroes over possession of the swords.

items.title: White Blaze's Sacrifice
items.description: With the heroes determined to get the Soul Swords from Lord Saber Stryke, but unable to stand up to him in combat, White Blaze risks his life to steal the swords for Ryo.

items.title: Sun Devil: Ambassador of Evil
items.description: On the way to investigate a volcanic eruption that was mysteriously halted by ice, the heroes encounter a new villain who wants to test their strength.

items.title: Torrent's Evil Twin

items.title: The Armor Must Be Destroyed

items.title: Sand Blasted

items.title: Lady Kayura and the Dark Realm

items.title: Anubis Is Reborn
items.description: The Ancient One's reappearance troubles Lady Kayura; as Ryo and Rowen seek a way into the Nether Realm to rescue their friends, they encounter a familiar face who pledges to help them.

items.title: Talpa Turns the Tide
items.description: Anubis attempts to gain Mia and Ully's trust and explains his past; Ryo and Rowen enter the Nether World in search of the other heroes; Talpa uses the energy of the captive heroes to create a new weapon.

Co-starring are Ryan's parents, and proprietary animated characters, including Gus the Gummy Gator and Combo Panda, also make appearances. items.title: Clean Entry
items.description: After a fatal shooting on the job leaves his career hanging by a thread, LAPD S.W.A.T. Sergeant Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is forced into retirement, in retaliation for refusing to bury the truth. Two years later, he's back, tasked with building a new tactical unit from the department's most talented outcasts. The team, soon nicknamed the Exiles, includes a live-streaming hotshot, a socially awkward tech genius, a fiercely disciplined operator with something to prove, a wildcard with a troubled past, and a strategist with a hidden agenda. As the squad finds its footing under fire, Hondo uncovers something far more dangerous than any street threat: a mole in his ranks, and a conspiracy reaching into the LAPD's top brass and the Mayor's office; one built to tear S.W.A.T. apart from within.

items.title: Sacred Cargo
items.description: Two brothers (Chris Penn, Martin Sheen) journey to Russia to smuggle valuable artifacts out of the country, but the elder has another secret.

items.title: Saga
items.description: While filming a movie in the woods, a director and his rocker and biker pals find a Norse legend of a zombie Viking chief who terrorized villagers.

items.title: Sagebrush Trail
items.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

items.title: Sally Jessy Rides!
items.description: Sally Jessy Raphael conducts celebrity interviews from different forms of transportation, including a water taxi, scooters in Times Square, a party bus and even a mechanical bull.

items.title: Samurai Wolf II: Hell Cut

items.title: Santa Baby

items.title: Santee

items.title: The Victory Lap
items.description: It isn't easy to win Olympic gold medals or earn Super Bowl rings -- unless you're sports power couple Sanya Richards-Ross, four-time gold-medalist runner, and two-time Super Bowl champion Aaron Ross. The athletes met as students at the University of Texas and tied the knot in 2010. A docuseries follows the couple through their busy lives. Besides being a world-class athlete, Sanya is a partner in Austin, Texas, salon The Hair Clinic with her sister, Shari. Sanya's passion for the salon, her first big business investment, shines through in everything she does and failure isn't an option. Assisting her is "Team SRR," her name for her management team, which includes father and manager Archie; mother Sharon -- who also is Sanya's agent -- and cousin/publicist/stylist Yolande.

items.title: Sealed With a Kiss
items.description: Sanya struggles with her relationship with her mother-in-law; Shari's boyfriend angers mom and dad.

items.description: Teaming up with sniffer dogs to uncover hidden stashes of illegal tobacco, Billy helps catch a notorious poacher, and joins the City of London Fraud Squad in a raid on a counterfeit luxury fashion ring. Along the way, he meets a local hero teaching.

items.title: Technology on the Trail
items.description: Billy partners with Cheshire Police as they utilize facial recognition technology and artificial intelligence to identify shoplifting suspects; he observes a business owner who operates a private surveillance system to monitor her property and assists Thames Valley Police in their search for an individual suspected of being a rogue trader.

items.title: Tackling the Threat
items.description: North Yorkshire Police launch daring dawn raids to take down ruthless organised drug gangs terrorising local communities; Billy also follows the Welsh Environment Agency's high-tech fight against illegal fly tipping.

items.title: Confronting the Underworld
items.description: The Midlands Illegal Money Lending team prepares for a surprise raid on a notorious loan shark preying on vulnerable people, with Billy joining the operation. Council officers hunt rogue landlords, and the Environment Agency tackles an illegal waste.

items.title: On the Frontline
items.description: Cleveland Police face a day of intense challenges, responding to a machete threat, dangerous trespassing, drug dealing, and theft. Meanwhile, Trading Standards crack down on illegal knife sales and rural crime teams tackle countryside offenders.

items.title: Hunting Hidden Threats
items.description: Greater Manchester Police crack one of Britain's largest illegal firearm trafficking networks, after a high-stakes operation fuelled by intelligence and digital forensics. Billy visits a Liverpool charity offering refuge and support to army.

items.title: Sasquatch Odyssey: The Hunt for Bigfoot
items.description: Professional trackers John Green, Rene Dahinden, Peter Byrne and Grover Krantz question the existence of the creature known as Sasquatch.

items.title: Satan's Cheerleaders
items.description: Cheerleaders and a teacher are kidnapped by satanists led by a sheriff (John Ireland) and his wife (Yvonne De Carlo).

items.title: Satan's School for Girls
items.description: Elizabeth (Pamela Franklin) is not convinced that her sister's death was a suicide. But since the police refuse to investigate, Elizabeth decides to enroll in her sister's school and look into the matter herself. She learns there have been a number of other student suicides and begins hearing whispers that the school has a dark, satanic secret. Knowing too much, Elizabeth and her friends Roberta (Kate Jackson) and Jody (Cheryl Stoppelmoor) must now escape the grip of the occult.

items.title: Satanic Panic
items.description: A minimum-wage delivery girl is forced into a night-long battle with the affluent leaders of a suburban community after discovering they're part of a satanic cult.

items.title: Saturday Church
items.description: Ulysses is a shy and effeminate boy who finds himself coping with new responsibilities as man of the house after the death of his father. Living alongside his mother, younger brother, and conservative aunt, Ulysses is also struggling with questions about his gender identity. He finds an escape by creating a world of fantasy filled with dance and music. Ulysses' journey takes a turn for the better when he finds a vibrant transgender community.

items.title: Savage: The Bigfoot Legend…Lives
items.description: As a blazing fire rips through Bear Valley National Park, the animals are forced out of their habitat, including a creature that was better left undiscovered. Now forest rangers, scientists and others must capture or kill the bloodthirsty beast.

items.title: Say My Name
items.description: When a one-night stand gets interrupted by a robbery, two complete strangers must navigate the seedy underbelly of a Welsh island to recover their stolen property.

items.title: Scary Bride
items.description: A lonely divorced man travels to Russia in search of a bride, but finds a witch instead.

items.title: School Life
items.description: Two inspiring teachers working at the only boarding school in Ireland for children ages 7 to 12 are followed for a year, as they begin to prepare for the end of their tenure.

items.title: Speed
items.description: Rob Bell finds out what it takes to design and build the next generation of roller coaster.

items.title: Falling
items.description: Discovering how the fear of falling is exploited by some of the world's top theme park rides to create a thrilling experience.

items.title: Height
items.description: Climbing aboard four spectacular roller coasters in Europe and America that exploit a fear of heights to create maximum thrills.

items.title: Inversion
items.description: Investigates four roller coasters in Europe and America that use inversions, or loops, to create a thrilling ride.

items.title: Different Materials
items.description: Mixed media artist and painter Julie Fei-Fan Balzer experiments with supplies and techniques to create a wide range of crafts in this series from KS Inc. Productions. Dedicated to anyone interested in preserving memories -- whether it be with scrapbooks, paper crafts or cards -- the series offers a wide range of ideas for any skill level. Projects include simple art journaling, a welcome banner featuring old photos, a family tree album, a travel journal with painted images, and stenciling.

items.title: Paint Your Way
items.description: Creating stencils; embellishing patterned paper with gesso and watercolors; "my girl" page.

items.title: Mini Books
items.description: A mini book created from a 3-D kaleidoscope; mini journal; 3-D sculptured surface for a journal.

items.title: Books
items.description: Creating an art journal page of doodled leaves with colorful paint pens; a piano hinge-style book binding; a treasures theme album with gold glittery elements; embellishing an album cover with triangle shapes.

items.title: Your Personal Touch
items.description: Adding a personal touch to a scrapbook with handwriting; a pocket scrapbook with a flower theme; embellishing a page with fluorescent pens; using watercolors to create a card.

items.title: All in the Family
items.description: A magnet board with bottle caps; family tree album; pop-up place cards.

items.title: Flowers
items.description: Embellishing tags with a floral watercolor design; using flowers on a scrapbook page; using flower designs as card embellishments.

items.title: Time
items.description: Owl clock; backgrounds for journals and scrapbooks; personalized daily planner.

items.title: DIY Embellishments
items.description: Adding depth to designs with shrinking embellishments; designs with misty effects; storing tiny letters and embellishments; 3-D designs with fringed fabric and felt.

items.title: Celebrations
items.description: Special birthday party invitations; thank you gift sets for hostesses; backgrounds; a page made with stamp rollers and sticker tape to celebrate Girls' Night Out.

items.title: Me, Me, Me
items.description: Selfies; fancy frames; adding stitches to patterned paper; photo series of everyday activities.

items.title: Turn on the Tools
items.description: Stenciling; adding texture with sewing machine stitches; painting; twinkling lights.

items.title: Details
items.description: Designing with thread; spraying paint for special effects; a review of the techniques featured throughout the series.

items.title: Scream Therapy
items.description: Five female friends head to the desert for a weekend of restorative scream therapy. Their vacation soon takes a sharp turn when they cross paths with a few deadbeats who are on a very pressing deadline.

items.title: Seance
items.description: Camille Meadows is the new girl at the prestigious Edelvine Academy for Girls. Soon after her arrival, six friends invite her to join them in a late-night ritual, calling forth the spirit of a dead former student who reportedly haunts the halls. But before morning, one of the girls is dead, leaving the others wondering what they may have awakened.

items.title: Search for the Cosmic Dawn: The James Webb Space Telescope
items.description: The James Webb Space Telescope leads a massive search for an extraordinary chain of events that launched our universe at the brink of the cosmic dawn.

items.title: Seclusion
items.description: Hoping for peace and solitude, a homeless woman breaks into an unoccupied mansion but soon discovers she is not alone.

items.title: Secret Santa
items.description: A family dinner turns into a bloodbath.

items.title: Secrets of Mercy Hospital
items.description: Returning to the working-class town she fled as a teenager, Kendra confronts the long-buried secret of the baby daughter she left behind. Facing pain, guilt and unanswered questions, she searches for healing, forgiveness and a second chance.

items.title: Time
items.description: Neuroscientist Dr. Jack Lewis gives fascinating insight into how the brain works.

items.title: The Senses
items.description: Meeting people with synesthesia; multisensory gastronomy.

items.title: Pain and Fear
items.description: Wim Hof teaches Jack how to control his pain and plunge into the ice-cold sea.

items.title: Creativity
items.description: Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output Syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

items.title: Coasts
items.description: Showcasing the raw beauty of nature while diving into our planet's water worlds, with a mix of character-driven animal stories interspersed with fascinating scientific insights into these magical habitats.

items.title: Secrets of the Heinz Factory
items.description: Showcasing today's factory workers alongside tomorrow's machines making cans of food most viewers have at home.

items.title: Secrets Of McVities Biscuits
items.description: McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and one of the oldest biscuit factories in the world.

items.title: Secrets Of Mr. Kipling Cakes
items.description: The Mr. Kipling factory in Carlton, near Barnsley in Yorkshire, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favorite cakes are made in one of Britain's biggest factories - which is also the biggest cake factory Europe.

items.title: Secrets Of Kellogg's Cereals
items.description: The Kellogg's factory in Manchester opens its doors to reveal step by step how some of the nation's favorite breakfast cereals are made in the biggest cereals factory in Europe, and the largest producer of cornflakes in the world.

items.title: Secret Life of Mini Marsupials
items.description: A look into the lives of the secretive creatures of Australia.

items.title: Secret Life of Bugs & Butterflies
items.description: A variety of insects make Australia's forests their home.

items.title: The Waterhole
items.description: Australia's waterholes are diverse ecosystems.

items.title: Section 8
items.description: Sentenced to prison for avenging the murder of his family, a former soldier gets a second chance when a shadowy government agency recruits him for an assignment. However, he soon realizes that the very people who freed him are not what they seem.

items.title: Hooked
items.description: An inside look at the Nxivm cult and its enigmatic, manipulative founder Keith Raniere.

items.title: Seeds
items.description: Ziggy receives her first internet influencer job offer to promote the seed and fertilizer company Nature's Oath. When her cousin calls her back to the reservation, she is compelled to fight to preserve the history of her people.

items.title: Selena Gomez: Living the Dream
items.description: An up-close look at Selena Gomez's dazzling ride to superstardom and how this multitalented child star became one of the most well-known women in entertainment.

items.title: Self-Help
items.description: A college student infiltrates a dangerous self-actualization community when her mother becomes entangled with its leader.

items.title: Deals in the Heels
items.description: The Atlanta real estate market was once dominated by men, but women are increasingly making themselves known in the city's housing industry. This docuseries shines the spotlight on seven such women, who use their business acumen and larger-than-life personalities to close deals in the growing city. It's a seller's market as new buyers and investors flock to the ATL, embracing a new, progressive culture that is forcing the old guard to fight to remain relevant. The ladies' client lists include everyone from professional athletes to music industry executives and even foreign diplomats. The featured agents include Tahlia, who specializes in finding high-dollar leases for musicians making albums in the city, and New York native Chrishena, who brings her Big Apple attitude to Atlanta.

items.title: Turnt Up Tour
items.description: Sarah's plan to impress A'lana; Jae and Tahlia clash again; A'lana picks her multi-million dollar investor team.

items.title: Hired and Fired
items.description: Gwen hosts a ladies' brunch to celebrate her return to real estate but rumors about the father of her son threaten her good time; Chrishenna shows a condo to A'lana's investor; Jae and Tahlia are at it again.

items.title: Business and Pleasure
items.description: After a huge fight, Tahlia leaves LaKyle; Okevia's showing is a disaster; the ladies question Tahlia's behavior with a new male client at a pool party.

items.title: Indecent Proposals
items.description: Gwen celebrates her return to real estate; Chrishena shows a luxury condo; Tahlia & Jae hash out their differences.

items.title: Deals Go South
items.description: Jae surprises Alana with shocking accusations; Tahlia's luxury listing is ruined; Chrishena's mixer puts Sarah against Tahlia.

items.title: Septic Man
items.description: A sewage worker becomes trapped in a septic tank and undergoes a hideous transformation. He teams up with a docile giant to confront the murdering madman known as Lord Auch.

items.title: Cold and Calculating Killers
items.description: An exploration of the psychological underpinnings of serial killers to better understand their specific frame of mind and psychology.

items.title: The Thanksgiving Table & More
items.description: Tip and how-to's for a memorable gathering.

items.title: Severance
items.description: Members (Danny Dyer, Laura Harris, Tim McInnerny) of the Palisades Defense Corp. sales group arrive in Europe for a team-building exercise. A fallen tree blocks the route, and they must hike to their destination. However, a psychotic killer lurks in the woods, and he has a horrible fate in mind for each of the co-workers.

items.title: Severed Ways: The Norse Discovery of America
items.description: Two Vikings (Fiore Tedesco, Tony Stone) face a battle for survival in the North American wilderness.

items.title: Let's Get It On
items.description: Rather than thinking outside the box, couples featured on this series are going inside a box in an attempt to save their troubled relationships. Each episode begins with the couple speaking candidly to a panel of experts -- psychotherapist Fran Walfish, certified sex therapist Chris Donaghue, and pastor/couples' counselor Yvonne Capehart -- about their intimacy issues. After getting the initial advice, the couple must decide whether to go into a camera-free, soundproof box located on the set, and in front of the studio audience, in which they have a private lovemaking session. That is followed by another, more revealing discussion with the panel -- because it is believed that people are more trusting and open after making love. In the end, each couple's goal is to solve their problems and save the relationship. Comic Danielle Stewart also joins the show to provide commentary and conduct on-the-street interviews.

items.title: Emotional Rescue
items.description: Taylor and Jarric's sex life comes to a halt after the birth of their son.

items.title: Intimacy & Ecstasy
items.description: A couple in an online relationship meets for the first time; a wife's anxiety over her fading libido holds a couple back; a tragic accident complicates a couple's intimacy.

items.title: Kinky or Crazy
items.description: A couple struggles with sharing their innermost sexual secrets; the desire to be a mom overwhelms a couple's sex life; a couple is addicted to sex at the expense of real communication.

items.title: Sexless in Seattle
items.description: A seemingly-perfect marriage is rocked by a secret; temptation threatens a relationship; a couple returns after trying abstinence.

items.title: Foreplay & Roleplay
items.description: A couple with communication issues look for a breakthrough; Abstinence forces a couple into new territory; and an adventurous couple faces trust issues that prevent them from moving forward.

items.title: Sex Drive
items.description: Lovable teen Ian has always been the best friend, not the boyfriend, and he thinks he's the last American virgin. Then online he meets Danielle, who is pretty, sweet, and really seems to like him. The trouble is Ian and Danielle live in different parts of the country. When she makes him an offer he can't refuse, Ian steals his brother's '69 GTO and sets out to meet her in person and lose his virginity.

items.title: Seymour: An Introduction
items.description: Pianist Seymour Bernstein, who gave up performing for teaching, discusses his passion for music and his philosophy of life.

items.title: Sgt. Kabukiman, N.Y.P.D.
items.description: The spirit of a slain Japanese superhero enters the body of a New York policeman (Rick Gianasi) who is not quite up to it.

items.title: Sgt. Will Gardner
items.description: An Iraq War veteran takes a spirited motorcycle trip across America and picks up pieces of his life that have been lost since going into combat.

items.title: Shackleton: The Greatest Story of Survival
Shadow Dancer
items.description: Arrested after a failed bombing attempt, a single mother and IRA member (Andrea Riseborough) falls into the hands of a British agent (Clive Owen) who offers her a choice: Spy on her IRA comrades, or spend a long prison term away from her young son.

items.title: Shadow Island
items.description: Strange and mysterious occurrences plague a meteorologist when he travels to a deserted island to investigate his father's death.

items.title: Life in Dark Water
items.description: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of aquatic animals residing in remote areas of the Earth where survival is paramount.

items.title: Shaft
items.description: John Shaft Jr. may be an FBI cybersecurity expert, but to uncover the truth behind his best friend's untimely death, he needs an education that only his dad can provide. Absent throughout his childhood, the legendary John Shaft agrees to help his son navigate the heroin-infested underbelly of Harlem, N.Y. Besides, the locked and loaded Shaft has his own score to settle -- both professional and personal.

items.title: Shakira: Latin Queen
items.description: As the highest selling Colombian artist of all time, Shakira's rise to the top only continues to grow with the success of her stint on "The Voice."

items.title: Shaky Shivers
items.description: Two young women find themselves at an abandoned camp in the woods with a book of magical spells, surrounded by classic monsters.

items.title: Shania Twain: Empowerment
items.description: Behind the scenes of country pop singer Shania Twain's career.

items.title: Rules of Engagement
items.description: Shannen Doherty is best known for starring in drama series such as "Beverly Hills, 90210" and "Charmed." Now the drama is real as she stars in this reality show that follows her as she plans for what she hopes is the wedding of her dreams with photographer Kurt Iswarienko. Planning a wedding is always stressful, so imagine how stressed Doherty is when she has just seven weeks to plan her big day. In a bit of network synergy, "My Fair Wedding" host David Tutera swoops in to give Doherty a wedding-planning assist when the pressure becomes too much for the actress. Among the obstacles that get in the way are a groom distracted by his career, a trip to Prague, family turmoil and wardrobe malfunctions.

items.title: Location, Location, Location
items.description: Shannen's dream wedding location runs into a roadblock; Kurt surprises Shannen.

items.title: Shannen's Ready, Is Kurt?
items.description: Shannen's search for her wedding and reception dresses; dance lessons from Louis Van Amstel of "Dancing With the Stars."

items.title: When It Comes to Kurt's Career, He's Single
items.description: Kurt accepts two jobs near the wedding. Shannen questions if the wedding will even happen.

items.title: A Wedding in Prague- Ress
items.description: Kurt and Shannen work on their differences in order to plan their wedding.

items.title: Dress Mess
items.description: Shannen's night out on the town; wedding dress dilemma; David Tutera steps in to help.

items.title: The Wedding Gift
items.description: Kurt's surprise for Shannen; designers for the dress; marriage license.

items.title: The Wedding
items.description: "All black" wedding dress code; media helicopters fly during exchange of vows; Shannen's father is remembered.

items.title: Shaquille O'Neal Presents: All Star Comedy Jam: I'm Still Laughing
items.description: Bill Bellamy hosts; featuring comedians Bruce Bruce and Huggy Lowdown.

items.title: Shayne Smith: Prison for Wizards
items.description: Comedian and former gang member, Shayne Smith performs in a stand-up special.

items.title: She Made Them Do It
items.description: Convicted of murder, Sarah Pender (Jenna Dewan Tatum) escapes from prison and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.

items.title: Eryn and Chris
items.description: Eryn and Chris attempt to come to terms about decor before moving in together.

items.title: Gina and Brendan
items.description: After dating a year and a half, Gina and Brendan are moving into his home on Oak Beach Island.

items.title: Melanie and Shaun
items.description: Melanie attempts to convince Shaun to add some color and lose the clutter before she moves in.

items.title: Nikkia and Daniel
items.description: Couples move in together for the first time and find that their interior design and ways of living clash; in come design experts to help them turn things around, find balance in their spaces and leave them with a space both partners are happy with.

items.title: Shannon and Greg
items.description: Shannon is from Seattle, Greg is from West Virginia and after a year of dating, they're moving in together to Park Slope, Brooklyn.

items.title: Tiffany and Jawanza
items.description: Jawanza's love of functionality and Tiffany's feminine style need to blend as they prepare to move in together.

items.title: You Can Run but You Can Not Hide
items.description: Cameras follow sheriff's deputies in a Northern California county.

items.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
items.description: At one time not so long ago, Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) were peaceable partners in a thriving cattle business. Now divided, the two are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling. Faithful cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) steps in to defend his old friend Brower, making him a hero in the eyes of Brower's doting and dainty daughter, Claire (Mary Hart).

items.title: Shivers
items.description: After a scientist living in a posh apartment complex slaughters a teen girl and kills himself, investigators discover that the murderer had been carrying on experiments involving deadly parasites. Roger St. Luc (Paul Hampton), a doctor living in the building, and his aide, Nurse Forsythe (Lynn Lowry), then realize that the parasites are on the loose, attacking fellow tenants. And those who become hosts turn into erotically obsessed maniacs who pass the bugs on through violent sex.

items.title: Shock
items.description: A woman (Daria Nicolodi) returns to her former home with a new spouse (John Steiner) and a son (David Colin Jr.) possessed by the ghost of his father.

items.title: Shocking Dark
items.description: A team of soldiers and civilians are sent to Venice to investigate the mysterious deaths of scientists who are trying to clean polluted waters.

items.title: Shortwave
items.description: A researcher and his wife, suffering from the disappearance of their child, become haunted by a cryptic shortwave radio signal that causes hallucinations.

items.title: SHOT! The Psycho-Spiritual Mantra of Rock
items.description: World-famous rock 'n' roll photographer Mick Rock explores his past and present, from London's glam rock to New York's snarling punk scene.

items.title: Brian Michael Smith / Cathy Shim
items.description: Celebrities and stars are revealing their pets and raising awareness for important animal charities.

items.title: Marissa Jaret Winokur / Shanna Moakler
items.description: Broadway star Marissa Jaret Winokur and her two Australian Labradoodles; former Miss USA Shanna Moakler and her three feline friends.

items.title: Holland, Michigan
items.description: Main Street, USA, is where "Showville" is playing, a celebration of everyday Americans' passion for performing. The series highlights local talent of all ages in small towns across the country -- singers, dancers, comedy acts, jugglers and other performers who compete to appear in their towns' talent shows. In each episode, actor Alec Mapa and choreographer Lisette Bustamante host open auditions in one town, select four finalists, and have two days to mentor them. The final competition takes place at a well-known town venue filled with locals, who are ultimately responsible for selecting the best act. The winner receives $10,000, a cup to signify the achievement, and a moment to cherish for a lifetime.

items.title: South Kingstown, Rhode Island
items.description: South Kingstown, R.I., locals audition for a talent show.

items.description: Walla Walla, Wash., locals audition for a talent show.

items.description: Athens, Ohio, locals audition for a talent show.

items.description: San Marcos, Texas, locals audition for a talent show.

items.description: Fairfield, Iowa, locals audition for a talent show.

items.title: Mt. Airy, North Carolina
items.description: Mount Airy, N.C., locals audition for a talent show.

items.title: Hugo, Oklahoma
items.description: Hugo, Okla., locals audition for a talent show.

items.title: Shredder
items.description: A ruthless killer stalks teenagers at a ski lodge with a shady past.

items.title: Sick Nurses
items.description: Dead patients haunt the nurses who stole their organs.

items.title: Silencer
items.description: A hit man comes out of retirement to rescue a kidnapped girl from a ruthless drug kingpin. Still haunted by the lives he took as a military sharpshooter, he sets out on a blood-soaked battle to bring the child back home.

items.title: Silent Madness
items.description: A psychiatrist (Belinda Montgomery) poses as an ex-sorority sister to stop a slasher freed by a computer error.

items.title: Silent Night
items.description: On Christmas Eve, a woman (Linda Hamilton) and her son (Matthew Harbour) welcome American and German soldiers into their cottage during World War II.

items.title: Cardboard Lumber Part 2
items.description: Taking a fun look at impractical applications of very practical sustainability science.

items.title: K-Cups: Recycled Plastic into Shoes
items.description: K-Cups have made morning routines wonderfully easier, but they create a lot of excess waste; that's why Andy from "How to Make Everything" jumps on the opportunity to recycle them into something everyone needs: shoes.

items.title: Silver Star
items.description: Fresh out of prison, 20-year-old Billie tries to help her parents by robbing a bank. When the plan goes wrong, she takes Franny, a pregnant, reckless teen, as a hostage. The two set off on a wild escape across America, chasing a brighter future.

items.title: A Place for My Stuff
items.description: Stand-up comic Sinbad, whose fame peaked in the 1990s with gigs such as hosting a short-lived talk show, enters the realm of reality TV in this show that explores his family life. Sinbad has remarried his ex-wife and moved back into their old house. Their son and daughter, both in their 20s, are trying to build their own careers but still seek financial support from their parents. Financial struggles and privacy issues are among the challenges the family faces as they try to rebuild their lives together.

items.title: A Hole in My Pocket
items.description: Hard financial times make it difficult for Sinbad to support his family of four; yard sale; Sinbad and Meredith meet with a financial planner.

items.title: The Health
items.description: Sinbad and his family adopt a healthier lifestyle; Meredith and Paige go on a master cleanse; Paige introduces Sinbad to her outdoor park workout.

items.title: Cookout
items.description: The family attempts to throw a cookout; Royce plans a special surprise for Sinbad.

items.title: Cabin Fever
items.description: The family works to come together through inspiration; Royce wants an adventure; Meredith takes up shooting; Sinbad's music career.

items.title: Can't Leave My House
items.description: Tensions arise between Sinbad and Royce between house repairs and living arrangements.

items.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
items.description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

items.title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
items.description: The comic performs at the Club Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles.

items.title: Sing a Song of Six Pants
items.description: The Three Stooges foil a group of crooks at their tailor shop.

items.title: Chicago
items.description: Exposing the dark underbelly of various cities by highlighting the mysterious crimes that changed the community forever.

items.title: Cleveland
items.description: In 2013, Cleveland is shaken when 911 dispatchers receive a call and three missing women are found in a house of horrors; investigators uncover the truth behind a horrific string of decade-old abductions committed by a city school bus driver.

items.title: They F*** You Up
items.description: Two women born continents apart, one Canadian and the other Irish, realize that they are half-sisters and embark on an eventful road trip in search of their alcoholic father.

items.title: Mind That Child
items.description: Suze realizes she has run out of options, so she reluctantly agrees to help Sare find their father.

items.title: This Too Shall Pass
items.description: The sisters are on the road, but it isn't long before they find themselves in a compromising position.

items.title: Every Time The Sun Comes Up, I'm In Trouble
items.description: After experiencing a betrayal, both Suze and Sare realize they are more alike than they initially thought.

items.title: I Can Change
items.description: Suze and Sare are back on their quest to find their father, so they travel to Carlingford where they are met by two surprise guests.

items.title: Happy Ever After
items.description: In an emotional reunion, the sisters finally find their father and realize that maybe he isn't what they needed in the first place.

items.title: Law & Disorder
items.description: This Houston-based series profiles several black, female attorneys who tackle some of the toughest legal cases in Texas. The women, some of whom have known one another for decades, form a tight bond to help themselves succeed in a male-dominated profession. The featured women include Jolanda, who aims to provide justice for poor defendants; criminal lawyer Vivian, who went to law school at age 30 after leaving her banking career; civil attorney Rhonda, who specializes in class-action lawsuits and has won cases in front of the U.S. Supreme Court; public defender Juanita, who has handled over 2500 cases and was previously a partner in a firm with Rhonda; criminal attorney Monique, who has grown to enjoy being able to help people get out of tough situations; and civil lawyer Tiye, the wife of a well-known attorney.

items.title: Murder on the Mind
items.description: Jolanda chooses between defending her son and her murder client; Monique steps in; a new sister arrives and causes havoc.

items.title: Rhonda Gets a Gun
items.description: Newcomer Tiye disrespects matriarch, Vivian; Katrina faces off with Rhonda; Jolanda interviews witnesses for her murder case.

items.title: She Said, She Said
items.description: Yolanda's murder client learns her fate; Rhonda interrogates Juanita's date; Yolanda and Vivian can't settle their differences.

items.title: Who's Left and Who's Right?
items.description: The feud between Juanita and Rhonda intensifies; Juanita tries to fire up Vivian's love life; Rhonda takes on a $40 million case; Jo's client springs a surprise on her in court.

items.title: Matriarch Under Fire
items.description: Newcomer Tiye faces off against matriarch Vivian; tempers flare at a tailgate party leaving one sister in contempt; Rhonda fights for a $40 million settlement; Juanita defends a hit-and-run driver.

items.title: A Beach House Divided
items.description: Juanita defends a client involved in a hit-and-run accident; Rhonda gets a surprising offer; the sisters face off as simmering tensions boil over during a weekend at a beach house.

items.title: Truth and Consequences
items.description: The sisters stage an intervention for Yolanda; Rhonda's client makes a life-changing decision; Yolanda's client brings her to tears; Monique turns to the others when she gets the biggest case of her career.

items.title: Site 13
items.description: Emerging from a 10-year catatonic state, Dr. Nathan Marsh watches tapes from his last outing to learn what Eldritch horrors he unleashed on the world.

items.title: Sitting Bull
items.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

items.title: Skate Kitchen
items.description: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

items.title: Skin Game
items.description: A pre-Civil War con man (James Garner) goes around selling his partner (Lou Gossett) as a slave, then helping him escape.

items.title: Skinamarink
items.description: Two children wake up in the middle of the night to find their father is missing, and all the windows and doors in their home have vanished.

items.title: World Ex
items.description: Have a look at a solar car competition; teams from around the world build their own pure solar model and compete in a race across Australia.

items.title: Energy Globe World Award 20th
items.description: A behind-the-scenes look at an awards ceremony for world-changing sustainability projects is presented.

items.title: 10 Genius Inventions -- Part 1
items.description: An award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

items.title: Slaughterhouse Rock
items.description: A student goes to Alcatraz Island to help a rock singer exorcise a cannibalistic cavalry officer.

items.title: Ryan Poston
items.description: The stories of ordinary people who met fatal ends because of jealousy, with a look at the dramatic and true events and the setbacks of the victims whose lives were forever changed.

items.title: Sleeping With Other People
items.description: Twelve years after a one-night stand, a man (Jason Sudeikis) and a woman (Alison Brie) run into each other and try to maintain a platonic relationship despite their mutual attraction.

items.title: Sleepwalk With Me
items.description: Anxiety over his stalled career and outside pressure to marry his longtime lover (Lauren Ambrose) push a commitment-shy comic (Mike Birbiglia) to sleepwalk.

items.title: Slime Time
items.description: Talisa Tossell shares slime tips, tricks and recipes.

items.title: Slumber Party Massacre II
items.description: Courtney and her friends go to their condo for a weekend getaway, but Courtney can't get rid of the haunting feeling that a supernatural rockabilly driller killer is coming to murder them all.

items.title: Joan Koplan's Forum
items.description: The unscripted "Small Town Security" follows the workplace drama of a small, family-run security and private investigation company in rural Georgia called JJK Security. While the day-to-day operations are depicted, the heartbeat of the series is found in the oddball behavior of JJK's colorful employees, led by the hilarious and inappropriate Joan Koplan, otherwise called "The Chief." There's also Joan's old-school, charming husband, Irwin; straight-laced detective and process server Brian Taylor; flighty office secretary Christa Stephens; and "The Lieutenant," Dennis Croft, who Joan reveals in the premiere episode used to be a woman. No wonder AMC describes the show as "a cross between Christopher Guest's brilliant films and the sublime absurdity of `The Office.' ".

items.title: The Testosterone Triangle
items.description: The chief tries to accept Croft's past; the captain tries to pull himself out of professional and sexual slumps.

items.title: Dr. Sandy and the Swear Jar
items.description: A business consultant tries to make the office behave more professionally; Captain tries to stop his hoarding.

items.title: Christa Pista, P.I.
items.description: Christa pursues her dream of being a private investigator; Irwin's cousin visits and insults Christa.

items.title: Sneak Attack!
items.description: The Lieutenant tests the guards with sneak attacks and pepper spray training; the Captain tackles his hoarding problem.

items.title: The Tornado Effect
items.description: Lt. Croft shares the reason he lives at the office; the staff finds Croft's refusal to shower strange; the Chief struggles to lose weight.

items.title: Romancing the Joan
items.description: Captain takes stock and rekindles his romance with Chief; Lieutenant struggles to stay awake.

items.title: Lieutenant Croft's Release
items.description: Lieutenant is urged to work on his love life; Chief is busy promoting her show; Brian lets Christa take the lead on a process serve.

items.title: The Wicked Witch of Georgia
items.description: The gang deals with the community's reaction to the television show; Chief gives Lt. a birthday present.

items.title: Elite Force!
items.description: Lt. Croft wants to create an elite force at JJK; the gang joins forces to make Chief change her diet.

items.title: JJK for Sale
items.description: Captain plans to sell Chief's mustang; Brian takes Christa on a stakeout; Lieutenant helps Chief manage her anger.

items.title: A Starr Is Born
items.description: Lt. Croft petitions for a legal name change; Captain loses a friend; Christa and Lt. try to cut back on smoking.

items.title: Old Family, New Member
items.description: Captain Starr taunts the Chief with a realistic prosthetic; Irwin reconnects with his estranged brother.

items.title: Inipi
items.description: Brian organizes a boys' trip; Captain attends his first male-only outing; Christa tries to entertain Chief.

items.title: All Hands on Deck
items.description: Capt. Starr and the force work a rave; Irwin overhauls Joan's show; the Chief adds a new dimension to the love triangle in the office.

items.title: The Man Makes the Suit
items.description: Capt. Starr goes for surgery; Chief struggles with her feelings; Christa hires a goat to mow the lawn.

items.title: Someone's Got the Meatball
items.description: Captain Starr creates a new training tape; Chief wants to capitalize on the Speecy Spicy Meatball; Irwin displays his storage room.

items.title: The Dragon Takes Flight
items.description: Captain Starr tries online dating to fill his relationship gap; Irwin tries to relieve stress.

items.title: Lambchop's Last Bite
items.description: The crew has a muddy gig; Irwin gives his time to rough young ladies; Chief deals with the loss of love.

items.title: Heady Times Part 1
items.description: The crew loses a big client; Irwin tries to ensure guard loyalty; Joan struggles with her health.

items.title: Heady Times Part 2
items.description: Joan gets a shocking diagnosis; Brian and Dennis get a gig; Christa does some dirty work.

items.title: Watch Dogs
items.description: Dennis hosts McGruff the Crime Dog; Joan starts radiation; Christa takes on odd jobs when her hours are cut.

items.title: The Belly of the Beast
items.description: The guards go on a training mission overnight in a cave; Joan addresses her bad diet habits as her recovery continues.

items.title: Hail to the Chief
items.description: Irwin relieves his stress while Joan convalesces in Los Angeles; Dennis reveals a surprise about Joan; the crew celebrates JJK's 30th anniversary.

items.title: Smash His Camera
items.description: Paparazzo Ron Galella goes to extreme lengths to snap celebrity photos, including an obsessive pursuit of Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis that twice landed him in court.

items.title: Snow
items.description: When one of Santa's reindeer is kidnapped by big game hunter Buck Seger (Patrick Fabian), Nick Snowden (Tom Cavanagh), a nerdy young man who is training to take over for Kris Kringle, travels to California to recover it. There, he meets Sandy Brooks (Ashley Williams), a kind-hearted zoologist, and begins to fall in love. With the help of a young boy named Hector (Bobb'e J. Thompson), Nick concocts a plan to retrieve the reindeer in time for Christmas.

items.title: Snow 2 Brain Freeze
items.description: When Santa (Tom Cavanagh) lands in the hospital with amnesia, his wife (Ashley Williams) must find a way to save Christmas.

items.title: Snowbeast
items.description: A skier (Bo Svenson) and his wife (Yvette Mimieux) visit a friend's ski resort during a man-beast's rampage.

items.title: Solomon King
items.description: A man (Sal Watts) declares war on the Arabs who murdered his ex-lover.

items.title: Some Kind of Hate
items.description: Once a victim of vicious bullying, a teenage girl (Sierra McCormick) rises from the grave to punish the tormentors of a new student (Ronen Rubinstein) at a remote school.

items.title: Some Like It Hot
items.description: After witnessing a Mafia murder, slick saxophone player Joe (Tony Curtis) and his long-suffering buddy, Jerry (Jack Lemmon), improvise a quick plan to escape from Chicago with their lives. Disguising themselves as women, they join an all-female jazz band and hop a train bound for sunny Florida. While Joe pretends to be a millionaire to win the band's sexy singer, Sugar (Marilyn Monroe), Jerry finds himself pursued by a real millionaire (Joe E. Brown) as things heat up and the mobsters close in.

items.title: Sorority House Massacre
items.description: Hospitalized Beth (Angela O'Neill) faces another massacre in the same house where her family was slain.

items.title: Sorority Wars
items.description: A college freshman (Lucy Hale) makes enemies when she refuses to pledge her mother's (Courtney Thorne-Smith) sorority.

items.title: Sorry to Bother You
items.description: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

items.title: Sorry, Haters
items.description: In post-9/11 New York, a Muslim cabbie (Abdellatif Kechiche) is suspicious of an American woman's (Robin Wright Penn) motives when she insists on trying to help his jailed brother. The woman's actions set in motion a chain of events that lead to the revelation of a horrible truth.

items.title: Soul to Soul
items.description: This is a filmed documentary of what could very loosely be termed the "African Woodstock." In 1971, several prominent African-Americans convinced the government of Ghana to hold a gala concert to commemorate that nation's 14th anniversary of independence. Some of the big American names participating in the resulting 14-hour event are Santana, Wilson Pickett and Roberta Flack, while African artists are represented by such acts as Kofi Ghanaba and the Kumasi Drummers.

items.title: Soul's Midnight
items.description: A man (Robert Floyd) must save his pregnant wife from a band of vampires who practice human sacrifice.

items.title: Watershed
items.description: In the very near future, a test is developed that incontrovertibly lets a person know who their soulmate is. The new science is clear, and no matter a person's current relationship status, whether they are single, dating or even married, this test will unmistakably point a person in the direction of their actual, scientifically determined soulmate. People in long-term relationships should not be content in believing they've already made the right choice. Even if a person seems to be deep in love with their current partner, this test may just prove that they are mistaken. After all, science knows best.

items.title: The Lovers
items.description: David's life is turned upside down when Alison presents him with proof she's his soul mate; they start a torrid affair, but everything may not be what it seems.

items.title: Little Adventures
items.description: Adam and Libby's happy but unconventional marriage is disrupted when Libby's test results come through; when gorgeous, fun-loving Miranda arrives in their lives, Libby struggles to draw lines between her feelings for her husband and her soul mate.

items.title: Layover
items.description: Mateo and Jonah meet at a bar and immediately hit it off; Mateo is furious when he discovers that Jonah stole his passport, sabotaging his chance to fly to Colombia to meet his soul mate the next day; they go on a wild adventure to get it back.

items.title: Break on Through
items.description: Devastated to discover that his soul mate is dead, big-hearted Kurt finds faith and opportunity in the arms of The Church of Righteous Transition, an organization that promises to help those whose soul mates have passed on.

items.title: The (Power) Ballad of Caitlin Jones
items.description: Caitlin has waited years for her soul mate match; her dreams come true when she's matched with a handsome doctor, Nathan; however, she discovers Nathan is harboring a dark secret.

items.title: Sound of Noise
items.description: A tone-deaf, music-hating cop tries to track down a group of guerrilla percussionists who are inundating the city with their anarchic concerts.

items.title: Southern Bluefin Tuna Epic
items.description: The team head to Milford Sound to try their luck after hearing reports of massive schools of bluefin tuna.

items.title: Bay of Islands Exploration
items.description: The team set off to help rookie spearo Ant bag his first-ever kingfish, before shifting their focus to more prized fish in the Bay of Islands blue water.

items.title: South Minerva
items.description: The team embark on a huge expedition to the remote Minerva Reefs, north of New Zealand, where they encounter incredible diving conditions.

items.title: Space Force: The Dawn of Galactic Warfare
items.description: Dissecting humanity's voyage into outer space in preparation for the dawn of galactic warfare.

items.title: Sparkle
items.description: In 1950s Harlem, Sparkle (Irene Cara), Sister (Lonette McKee) and Delores (Dwan Smith) are three musically gifted sisters whose mother, Effie (Mary Alice), supports them by working as a maid. Encouraged by Sparkle's boyfriend, Stix (Philip Michael Thomas), the three form a singing group and become a sensation at a local nightclub. However, tensions rise when Sister is appointed the group's lead singer and begins dating Satin (Tony King), an abusive, drug-addicted pimp.

items.title: The Red Serpent
items.description: Betrayed by the Romans; forced into slavery; reborn as a Gladiator, torn from his homeland and the woman he loves, Spartacus is condemned to the brutal world of the arena where blood and death are prime-time entertainment.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: The ultimate pickleball gear review show revealing the sport's latest technology and industry secrets.

items.title: The Royal Dutch Marines: Terror Strikes Twice
items.description: Documentary exploring the missions of commando forces around the world.

items.title: The British SAS: Attack in the Desert
items.description: Made famous in the books by Chris Ryan and Andy McNab, this is the story of a disastrous SAS mission to Iraq in 1991.

items.title: GSG-9: Jihad in the Fatherland
items.description: On 15 September 15, 1977, five masked gunmen abduct Hans Martin Schleyer and execute his three bodyguards. The Red Army Faction, in association with Germany's notorious Baader-Meinhof Gang, takes credit for the crime.

items.title: Speed Freaks
items.description: Zef needs to get to grips with traction, so he has challenged the Speed Freaks with converting a two-seater Mazda MX5 sports car into an off-road monster; Zef drives a purpose-built Dakar vehicle in an attempt to understand driving on sand.

items.title: Roast Beef Night
items.description: Chef Spencer Watts offers cooking tips and tricks for preparing meals in 30 minutes, for $30, without sacrificing flavor.

items.title: Fish & Chips Night
items.description: Tips for making fish and chips.

items.title: Pizza Night
items.description: Spencer shares his favorite recipes for quick and budget-friendly pizza.

items.title: Curry in a Hurry Night
items.description: Spencer prepares a full, family-style Indian meal.

items.title: Chinese Take-Out Night
items.description: Spencer prepares some quick and easy Chinese food.

items.title: Lasagna Night
items.description: Spencer prepares a quick, nutritious lasagna dish.

items.title: Chicken Bake Night
items.description: Spencer cooks up a quick and nutritious chicken bake meal for four.

items.title: Breakfast for Dinner Night
items.description: Spencer creates a quick breakfast for dinner for four.

items.title: Meatless Monday Night
items.description: Spencer creates a vegetarian meal in about 30 minutes.

items.title: Taco Night
items.description: Spencer creates a taco night fiesta.

items.title: Fish Night
items.description: Spencer makes a budget-friendly fish dinner.

items.title: Spaghetti Night
items.description: Spencer creates a family spaghetti dinner.

items.title: Fried Chicken Night
items.description: Spencer makes all the fixings for a fast fried chicken dinner.

items.title: Southern BBQ Night
items.description: Spencer prepares southern-style barbecue in 30 minutes.

items.title: Greek Night
items.description: Spencer offers tips on preparing a Greek feast.

items.title: Gourmet Soup & Sammies
items.description: Spencer prepares his favorite recipes for soup and sandwiches.

items.title: Comfort Food
items.description: Spencer creates a menu of comfort foods.

items.title: That's Amore
items.description: Spencer prepares a 30-minute Italian feast.

items.title: Night at the Pub
items.description: Spencer prepares pub food favorites.

items.title: French Canadian
items.description: Spencer shares a menu of French Canadian cuisine.

items.title: Fajita Night
items.description: Spencer makes a Mexican fiesta dinner for four.

items.title: Meatballs and Shakshuka
items.description: Spencer guides through a series of small simple steps to create a Moroccan dinner for four; beginning with a pearl couscous salad to pair with the shakshuka.

items.title: Burgers and Fries
items.description: Spencer makes burgers and fries in 30 minutes for 30 dollars.

items.title: Tandoori Take-Out
