items.description: Spencer makes Tandoori take-out at home.

items.title: Put an Egg on it
items.description: Spencer creates an eggs-on-everything dinner.

items.title: Spring Fusion
items.description: Chef Spencer Watts prepares a homemade Thai feast.

items.title: Lebanese Take-Out
items.description: Chef Spencer Watts creates a Lebanese supper for four in less than thirty minutes.

items.title: Indian Take-Out
items.description: Chef Spencer Watts demonstrates how to make an Indian feast for the whole family.

items.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
items.description: A team of agents in the British security intelligence service work to protect the U.K. from terrorists and other threats to national security. A repackaged version of the BBC series "Spooks," "MI-5" follows a counterterrorism unit based in the highly secure suite of offices called The Grid, where Harry Pearce oversees the team and deals with the often dirty politics of the spy game.

items.title: Love and Death
items.description: A rogue scientist threatens to deliver pneumonic plague to a mass population.

items.title: Persephone
items.description: A routine operation against Turkish gun-runners turns into a nightmare threatening to destroy Zoe's career.

items.title: Outsiders
items.description: Islamic computer-hackers are suspected of spreading chaos.

items.title: Celebrity
items.description: Two spoiled celebrities demand that MI-5 find their kidnapped baby.

items.title: The Suffering of Strangers
items.description: North African terrorists unleash a plot to kill the prime minister.

items.title: The Special
items.description: A terrorist group will detonate bombs every 10 hours until its leader is released.

items.title: The Special
items.description: The team must find a mole in its midst to catch a bomb-maker.

items.title: Divided They Fall
items.description: The team tries to undermine a racist member of Parliament, who has joined a far-right-wing party.

items.title: Road Trip
items.description: The team tries to convince a member of a terrorist splinter-group to reject its militant ideas.

items.title: The Book
items.description: The people of Whitehall try to prevent the publishing of a book that contains embarrassing secrets about British intelligence.

items.title: The Innocent
items.description: The team suspects an Algerian man of planning a terrorist attack against the British transportation system.

items.title: Syria
items.description: Fiona volunteers to go undercover and meet with a Syrian diplomat who says he is ready to begin secret talks with the British.

items.title: The Russian
items.description: A meeting with a Cold War traitor unveils a scheme to undermine Britain's National Health Service.

items.title: The Sting
items.description: The team rushes to stop a terrorist act that could put Britain at war with Iran.

items.title: Diana
items.description: An ex-agent tries to prove that MI-5 assassinated Diana, Princess of Wales.

items.title: Gas and Oil
items.description: Conspirators deliberately destabilize Britain's government.

items.title: Gas and Oil
items.description: The conspirators gain an advantage, while Harry gets caught up in the action.

items.title: The Cell
items.description: Zaf and Adam go undercover to try to stop a terrorist bomb attack.

items.title: World Trade
items.description: An assassination threat and an arms deal endanger the World Trade Organization conference.

items.title: The Message
items.description: Ruth witnesses a man commit suicide, sparking a chain of events that pose a threat to her future.

items.title: Hostage Takers
items.description: Ros is caught in the siege when the Saudi Embassy is stormed.

items.title: Hostage Takers
items.description: The hostage-takers issue demands to the Saudi king.

items.title: Agenda
items.description: A Christian extremist group plans to take retribution on a Muslim community.

items.title: The Criminal
items.description: Adam comes face to face with a spy who betrayed him in the past.

items.title: The Virus
items.description: A terror threat by a member of Iranian intelligence could jeopardize a peace deal with Iran.

items.title: The Witness
items.description: The team provides security for an emergency Middle Eastern peace summit in London.

items.title: Spooks Run Wild
items.description: The East Side Kids are sent to summer camp, and shortly after arriving they encounter a mysterious man named Nardo (Bela Lugosi). Naturally, the Kids assume Nardo is the "monster killer" they've been warned about. Their theory is strengthened when they see Peewee (David Gorcey), seemingly risen from the dead after getting shot, walking around Nardo's house in a zombie-like trance. The Kids take it upon themselves to capture Nardo before he can kill anyone else.

items.title: Springtime in the Rockies
items.description: Just out of animal husbandry school, Sandra Knight (Polly Rowles) boldly decides to make changes on the ranch she has just inherited, and to raise sheep instead of cattle. Experienced foreman Gene Autry (Gene Autry) tries to warn her against this hasty conversion, but Sandra stubbornly ignores his advice. Before long, her business is failing, and she may be forced to sell to the shifty Briggs (Al Bridge). However, Gene has a plan that he hopes can set things right just in time.

items.title: Sprung
items.description: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

items.title: Spy Intervention
items.description: The world's greatest spy decides to abandon his adventurous lifestyle for the woman of his dreams. But when a madman tries to secure a devastating weapon, he soon gives up his boring existence to save not only the world -- but his listless marriage.

items.title: Square Grouper: The Godfathers of Ganja
items.description: Filmmakers examine the 1970s and '80s pot-smuggling culture in South Florida, where the coastline and proximity to the Caribbean and Latin America made the location ideal for trafficking.

items.title: Stage Fright
items.description: A rehearsal for a play based on a real serial killer turns chaotic when the escaped felon comes for the curtain call.

items.title: Stagecoach
items.description: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.

items.title: Stake Land
items.description: After a plague turns America into a realm of vampires, a hunter (Nick Damici) of the depraved creatures travels cross-country with an orphan (Connor Paolo) he rescued, searching for a safe haven.

items.title: Stalked by a Reality Star
items.description: Kendra is thrilled to meet Brad, a handsome TV star, at a party. When she discovers that Brad is not as charming as he seems, Kendra rejects him, only to realize that he has become obsessed with her and will stop at nothing to be near her.

items.title: Dig Me Up, Dig Me Down
items.description: John C. McGinley ("Scrubs") stars in this comedy-horror series as sour, judgmental sheriff Stan Miller, who is forced to give up his job because of an angry outburst at a most inopportune moment -- his wife's funeral. Relinquishing authority doesn't come easily for Stan, especially after he finds out he must make way for Evie Barret, the strong-willed and beautiful new sheriff. However, when both soon realize something is not quite right in their sleepy New Hampshire town -- which just so happens to be built on the site of a massive 17th-century witch burning -- Stan and Evie form an unlikely alliance to bravely battle a plague of spine-chilling demons.

items.title: Know, Know, Know Your Goat
items.description: Stan's daughter, Denise, goes blueberry picking and comes home with a pet goat, which also just happens to be a demon.

items.title: Let Your Love Groan
items.description: Stan, Evie and Denise go speed dating and suddenly find themselves involved with their perfect match; they also find themselves growing weak and rapidly aging.

items.title: Life Orr Death
items.description: Evie attempts to rescue Stan's prized possession, his Bobby Orr hockey stick, from the church donation pile, only to find herself transported into the spirit world where she too, is on trial for witchcraft.

items.title: Ouija Bored
items.description: A strange crop of flowers starts growing in town, with each bloom bringing a new supernatural horror; Evie attempts to summon Stan's dead wife, Claire, to help her stop them.

items.title: I'm Gleaning My Coven
items.description: Denise gets mixed up with a group of goth kids who come to town hoping to contact a demon; the goth kids succeed in contacting a demon and Denise finds herself possessed by it, creating a tricky situation for Stan.

items.title: Spider Walk With Me
items.description: A mysterious stranger shows up at Stan's door with knowledge of the curse he and Evie are fighting; Willard's Mill residents start getting killed by a giant spider.

items.title: Level Boss
items.description: A mysterious girl runs out into the street, forcing Evie to swerve into a fatal car accident that she must relive over and over and over again.

items.title: Black Hat Society Part 1
items.description: Stan begins to solve the mystery of Evie's disappearance and along the way, he meets the descendants of a Wiccan coven known as the Black Hat Society; Stan and the coven discover a disturbing way to bring Evie home.

items.title: Black Hat Society Part 2
items.description: Stan travels back in time to save Evie, not a moment too soon, as she's in a high stakes situation; Evie's rescue hinges on whether Stan can sacrifice a trusted friend in the modern day.

items.title: Curse of the Werepony
items.description: Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, visits with a new pony and the same old tricks; Stan befriends Kenny until he discovers his unsightly qualities; a mysterious stranger visits Willard's Mill.

items.title: Girls' Night
items.description: Stan gets trapped in a life-or-death bar bet; Evie and Denise watch a dating show finale that may or may not be hypnotizing them into killing each other.

items.title: The Eyes of Evie Barret
items.description: Evie buys an antique ring and then starts dreaming of killing people, who turn up dead; Leon kills a dude who may or may not have already been dead.

items.title: Hex Marks the Tot
items.description: Denise takes a nanny job for a demon baby who feeds off her affection; Kevin gets beaten up by a baby, which is not a coincidence.

items.title: Mirror Mirror
items.description: Stan summons a spirit to help him travel back in time to save Claire, and in the process, an evil replica is created who thinks only of murder; real Stan must commit an unthinkable crime to complete his time travel mission.

items.title: A Hard Day's Night
items.description: Stan travels back in time to save Claire, and he succeeds, but dies in the process, forcing Evie to go back and save him; Leon loses his head over a new gal.

items.title: Hell Is What You Make It
items.description: Evie is arrested for murder and committed to a psychiatric hospital; Stan attempts to rescue her, but everyone thinks he's a demon; there may be a new way to free the souls cursed by Constable Eccles.

items.title: The Hex Files
items.description: Two eerily familiar paranormal investigators arrive to investigate the Black Hat Society; Stan searches for a bigger evil ally that could help defeat Constable Eccles.

items.title: Larva My Life
items.description: A disgraced birthday entertainer disrupts the peace in Willard's Mill; Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, comes to town; he transforms into a caterpillar monster and terrorizes Willard's Mill.

items.title: The Demon Who Came in From the Heat
items.description: A murderous hitchhiker terrorizes Willard's Mill; Stan befriends a laid back demon and attempts to find a spell that will free the souls captured by Constable Eccles; Denise and Kevin go on a date.

items.title: Nubbin but Trouble
items.description: An antique store owner is murdered by an evil puppet that begins summoning spirits from hell; Stan brews homemade beer with a debilitating side effect.

items.title: Vampire Creek
items.description: Denise believes she's won a contest, but instead gets trapped in the fictional world of Vampire Creek, a TV show about teenage vampires; Stan, Evie and Kevin must find and rescue her before she is turned into a vampire.

items.title: Intensive Scare Unit
items.description: Stan goes for a prostate exam but must escape when the hospital turns demonic.

items.title: Stan Against Evie
items.description: Haurus demands Stan kill Evie in return for killing Constable Eccles and ending the curse on Willard's Mill; another demon tells Stan how to defeat Haurus, but the cost could be high.

items.title: Stan Helsing
items.description: Stan (Steve Howey), a slacker video store clerk, his sexy girlfriend, best friend and an exotic dancer take a detour into a town cursed by the biggest monsters in movie history.

items.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
items.description: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

items.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
items.description: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after.

items.title: Starry Eyes
items.description: A woman's pursuit of Hollywood stardom puts her on a collision course with a satanic cult.

items.title: Vinny Turns 21
items.description: Vinny Buzzetta is a 20-something baking prodigy, having graduated first in his class from New York's prestigious French Culinary Institute at the age of 18 (at the time, the school's youngest graduate). The Brooklyn-born foodie has always had a passion for chocolate and a dream to own his own bakery. When he saw a vacant storefront while driving through Staten Island a few months after he graduated, he decided that was the perfect location for his dream bakery, which he opened thanks in part to financial support from his Grandpa Joe (affectionately known in the community as "Crazy Joe"). Since then, the bakery, The Cake Artist, has thrived and become the go-to bakery for weddings and other special occasions in the area. Even though he's a successful business owner, Vinny still lives at home with his parents, including meddling mom Cammy, and younger siblings. This series follows Vinny and his staff as they work at the bakery and he deals with his personal relationships.

items.title: It's Going to the Dogs
items.description: A birthday party for dogs is a challenge for Vinny; meat cupcakes; kickball-themed groom's cake.

items.title: Kristin Gets Cut Off
items.description: A super chic cake for Andrea's wedding; Spiro's exciting news; Kristin's credit card bills.

items.title: Celebrity Status
items.description: Vinny's notoriety is growing fast; a cake for "Bella" magazine; Kristin meets with Angelina Pivarnick from "Jersey Shore."

items.title: Spooktacular
items.description: Halloween Sweet 16 cake; Staten Island Zoo's large order; Kristin's refusal to help Vinny.

items.title: Quit Horsing Around
items.description: Vinny visits a horse sanctuary; Ron Ben-Israel offers advice to Vinny; cupcake competition; golf-themed cake.

items.title: Mambo Italiano
items.description: Vinny's cake consultation for the Carnevale Masquerade Ball; elegant wedding cake.

items.title: You Can Take the Boy Out of Staten Island...
items.description: Vinny auditions his pastries and has dreams of expanding his business; cake for Staten Island's 350th Anniversary gala event.

items.title: A League of Their Own
items.description: Accidental exposure to an experimental mutagen leaves geeky high school student Virgil with super powers. Able to control electromagnetic forces, he channels his newfound powers to fight evil, aided by his pal Osgood, who builds gadgets to help Virgil fight crime.

items.title: A League of Their Own
items.description: Static teams up with the Justice League to save his friend, Gear.

items.title: Showtime
items.description: Static becomes the star of a reality series called "Heroes."

items.title: Consequences
items.description: Daisy gets hurt in a fight between Puff, Onyx, and Static, and falls into a coma; Static blames himself, because he tried to show off instead of focusing on her safety.

items.title: Romeo in the Mix
items.description: Rapper Lil' Romeo joins forces with Static to defeat the Leech.

items.title: The Parent Trap
items.description: She-Bang enlists Static and Gear to help find her missing parents.

items.title: Flashback
items.description: Static travels through time to prevent his mother's untimely death.

items.title: Blast From the Past
items.description: Static teams up with the retired superhero, Soul Power, when the old hero's nemesis threatens Dakota.

items.title: Future Shock
items.description: Static ventures into the future and teams with his adult self and Batman.

items.title: She-Back!
items.description: When She-Bang returns to Dakota, her loud and expressive personality grinds against Static and Gear's nerves.

items.title: Out of Africa
items.description: Static joins Anansi in a quest to find the powerful golden spider.

items.title: Super Strength Kick Ass Tow Trucks
items.description: An introduction to some of the biggest, heaviest and deadliest machines ever developed and built for very specific "mega tasks."

items.title: Antonov AN-225
items.description: Thanks to six powerful turbines, the Antonov An-225 flies loads of up to 250 tons; the plane was originally destined to transport the Soviet space shuttle Buran back to Kazakhstan; when the space program ended, it was converted into a cargo plane.

items.title: Step
items.description: The senior year of a girls' high school step team in inner-city Baltimore is documented, as they try to become the first in their families to attend college. The girls strive to make their dancing a success against the backdrop of social unrest.

items.title: Stepfather II
items.description: After cheating death by surviving being both stabbed and shot, psychotic killer Jerry (Terry O'Quinn) is placed in a mental institution, but he soon murders his doctor and escapes. Taking on a dead man's identity, he moves to an upscale neighborhood in Los Angeles and sets his sights on local woman Carol (Meg Foster), slowly winning her heart. Carol's son, Todd (Jonathan Brandis), grows suspicious of his mom's new lover, however, and tensions reach the boiling point at the couple's wedding.

items.title: B2K & Bow Wow Reunite, Talk Celebrity Crushes and Beef!
items.description: Bow Wow and B2K are celebrating the Boys 4 Life Tour while reflecting on 20+ years of fame, brotherhood, and healing. The group also opens up about past beefs, ego clashes, and the work it took to move forward.

items.title: Ciara Teaches Us The Low Dance + Opens Up About Motherhood, Marriage & Manifestation
items.description: In this special episode of Stepping Into The Shade Room, R&B superstar and dance icon Ciara teaches the host, Thembi, a few of her signature moves while opening up about her life offstage.

items.title: Draya Michele On Her Rebrand, Basketball Wives, Surgeries & Everything In Between!
items.description: Draya Michele is Stepping Into The Shade Room and keeping it real while sipping tequila and spilling tea; she's opening up and sharing her experiences on Basketball Wives, business ventures, what it's like to be body goals, the qualities.

items.title: Joseline Hernandez Steps In, Spills Tea, and Writes A Lil Boppiana
items.description: Joseline Hernandez has been making waves in the entertainment industry and keeping these internet streets in a chokehold for years; now, she's stepping into The Shade Room and opening up about her struggles with fighting her way through life, Love And Hip-Hop, Joseline's Cabaret, music, public controversy and more; and on this exclusive episode she's also hitting the studio to make an original track with Thembi! Get into the full interview now.

items.title: K. Michelle On Country Music, Body Image, Industry Fall Outs & More!
items.description: K. Michelle, aka Puddin, is stepping in and talking about everything from her journey as a mother and businesswoman, to past beefs, struggles with body image and plastic surgery, her upcoming country album, and MUCH MORE!

items.title: Kash Doll Spills On Meeting Her Man, Cheating Rumors, Ocho Cinco, Her Dream Role & More!
items.description: Kash Doll is stepping into The Shade Room and holding nothing back! From how the Detroit rapper first linked with Za'Darius Smith, to clearing the air on cheating rumors, to why her dream acting role might surprise you - it's all on the table.

items.title: Kenya Moore On Dating, The Real Housewives Of Atlanta & More!
items.description: Kenya Moore is spilling all the details from her beauty queen days to being a bona fide businesswoman and one of the most legendary, vindicated and celebrated housewives on the Real Housewives of Atlanta.

items.title: Lola Brooke Cheesecake Factory Dates, Don't Play With It & More!
items.description: Brooklyn's own Lola Brooke took the internet by storm with her viral hit single "Don't Play With It" and has been putting that work in to solidify herself in the music game as the new face and voice of New York City; now she's stepping in and telling all about her journey to success, the love she has for her contemporaries, her album "Dennis Daughter," if size really matters, and more.

items.title: Raven-Symoné Opens Up About Former Castmates, Marriage & Body Image
items.description: Raven-Symoné opens up about her career, relationships, rumors and life after growing up in the spotlight; from her Disney Channel era to navigating adulthood in Hollywood, Raven reflects on the journey that made her one of the most recognizable.

items.title: Rich The Kid Spills On Infidelity Controversy, Music & Family ----- Stepping Into The Shade Room
items.description: Rapper, songwriter, proud father and label executive Rich The Kid is stepping into The Shade Room to discuss his upcoming music, future label projects, and the recent controversy surrounding his alleged infidelity.

items.title: The Braxtons Talk Family Therapy, Sisterhood, Mourning Traci & More
items.description: Trina and Towanda are Stepping Into The Shade Room to talk about their growth, sisterhood, their journey since the loss of their beloved sister, Traci Braxton, how they plan to keep her legacy alive, and their experience on their new WE TV reality.

items.title: Usher Steps In And Talks The State of R&B Confessions Turning 20 What's Next And More
items.description: Podcast by The Shade Room. Hosted by Thembi Mawema, the show features interviews with major celebrities, musicians and cultural icons.

items.title: Jasmine Crockett Talks Congress Clapbacks, Stimulus Checks & More
items.description: Roomies, we're Stepping Into The Shade Room with the queen of alliteration Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett for manis pedis and some real talk about the state of politics in this country. Whether it's her infamous congressional clapbacks stimmy checks.

items.title: Cory Booker Gets Real About the Dems, Governing In Trump's World, And Some WILD Personal Gems!
items.description: Roomies, get ready for a candid conversation with Senator Cory Booker as he's Stepping Into The Shade Room; from his days playing football at Stanford to running for President, and even saving a life from a burning building.

items.title: Evelyn Lozada Spills on Basketball Wives Drama, Throws Shade At Castmates & Plays Shoot Your Shot! ----- Stepping Into The Shade Room
items.description: Basketball Wives icon Evelyn Lozada steps into The Shade Room and nothing is off limits.

items.title: Who's That Girl?! Eve Is Stepping In And Talking Nicki Minaj, Therapy, Leaked Tape, Marriage & More ----- Stepping Into The Shade Room
items.description: Who's that girl? E-V-E ? The rap icon, actress, and cultural trailblazer is Stepping Into The Shade Room for a raw and hilarious sit-down with TSR host, Thembi! From navigating viral rumors and therapy before working with Nicki Minaj, to paying a st.

items.title: Steps
items.description: The victim of a life-altering robbery and shooting survives, but years later, he must work as a home health aide for his shooter, who is now paralyzed from a shooting.

items.title: Steve Jobs: The Man in the Machine
items.description: Filmmaker Alex Gibney examines the life and legacy of the Apple co-founder, a man of intense personal drive whose passing led to an unprecedented outpouring of grief across the globe.

items.title: Steve-O: Guilty as Charged
items.description: Steve-O goes from humble beginnings as a circus clown to finding fame on "Jackass," performing stunts and tricks.

items.title: Steven Chen: Pretty Good
items.description: Steven Chen performs a standup comedy act at his home club in Washington, D.C.; he talks about buying paper towels and vacuums and researching on the internet.

items.title: Stevie Nicks: Wild at Heart
items.description: For decades, Stevie Nicks has fronted one of the most successful bands in history, resurrecting them from the ashes; even with the trials and tribulations of being a member of Fleetwood Mac, Stevie has remained a role model.

items.title: Get to Know Me, Karrueche Tran!
items.description: Karrueche Tran is sharing all the things you didn’t know about her inspiring journey to success. From her dynamic Vietnamese-African American upbringing to her career as a personal shopper, she is spilling the tea on how she got to where she is today. And with expert tips on fashion, food, and fitness, she’ll give you a taste of everything she’s learned along the way.

items.title: Ask Me Anything
items.description: Today I’m answering your questions, no matter how crazy (or not crazy) they may be!

items.title: My Boyfriend And I Attempt The IKEA Challenge
items.description: Nothing puts love to the test like IKEA, right?

items.title: My Skincare Routine & Hollywood Beauty Secrets!
items.description: So is this how Karrueche Tran has the amazing skin she does?!

items.title: Welcome To My Home! I Karrueche's House Tour
items.description: On today's Stir It Up, we're taking a look into Karrueche Tran's house, inside and out! Now raise your hand if you now want an outdoor shower after watching this.

items.title: How I Stay Healthy and Fit
items.description: Get out your yoga mats because Karrueche Tran is showing us her favorite yoga poses!

items.title: Answering Your Assumptions About Me
items.description: Have you ever made an assumption about Karrueche Tran? Well, she's here to address them today!

items.title: What Was I Like Before Fame? I Meet My BFF!
items.description: What was Karrueche Tran like before and after fame? Let's ask her best friend Erin!

items.title: Stitches
items.description: A clown is killed at a party mishap, and he comes back from the dead seeking revenge on the people responsible.

items.title: Stop! Border Control: Cuba
items.description: An international film crew records, for the first time, the activities of the Cuban security forces.

items.title: Stop! Border Control: Cuba
items.description: A young man tries to enter with products that are punishable by law; the agents are moved by a man's life story.

items.title: Stop! Border Control: Cuba
items.description: A passenger carries strange containers hidden among her belongings; a man tries to hide details of his life to enter Cuba.

items.title: The Crossing
items.description: Witness the high-stakes games at South American checkpoints; thousands risk everything to bypass security across Mexico, Brazil and beyond.

items.title: The Network
items.description: Bolivian police bust a human trafficking ring, K9 Sombra finds cocaine in sugar and officers in Chile and Brazil seize cash and smuggled phones.

items.title: The Frontier
items.description: Agents hunt gangs on the Mexico-Guatemala border, find cocaine hidden in underwear and a pastry case, and investigate a body found in a river.

items.title: The Red Flags
items.description: Thermal cameras catch migrants in a minefield, a mother is caught smuggling drugs internally, and police find cocaine hidden in lead-lined gears.

items.title: The Indicator
items.description: K9 Sombra finds cocaine in beauty products, a nun is caught with a backpack of cash, and Mexican residents block a border to stop COVID-19.

items.title: Family & Fines
items.description: Witness the high-stakes games at South American checkpoints; thousands risk everything to bypass security across Mexico, Brazil and beyond.

items.title: Expensive Shoes
items.description: A heavily dressed traveler from Lisbon and a fake passport holder spark a desperate scene at Leonardo da Vinci Airport.

items.title: Pringles with Coca
items.description: A dancer hides drugs inside Pringles tubes, an Algerian's fake French paper stops a flight, and a woman's Panama cash sparks a probe.

items.title: Narco Model
items.description: A model's backpack straps hide cocaine, a Turkish traveler uses a fake Italian ID, and 1kg of cocaine is found in an abandoned duffel bag.

items.title: Cover Stories
items.description: An event planner carries drugs from South America, an African flyer uses a fake passport, and a mental coach clears a drug check.

items.title: STOP! Border Control: Roma
items.description: Security forces at Rome's Fiumicino Airport track down international smugglers, fake documents, and desperate lawbreakers.

items.title: Hidden Depths
items.description: An Italian from Barcelona hides 2kg of cocaine, a fake French passport sends a traveler back to Athens, and a nervous Paris flyer clears a bags check.

items.title: Diverted Plans
items.description: A fake illness fails to hide a waiter's Mexican cocaine, a Brazilian woman tears her passport for asylum, and police settle a check-in dispute.

items.title: A special jacket
items.description: Cocaine is found in jackets gifted by a Colomban date, one Venezuelan friend is turned away, and a Kyrgyz girl's neat bags clear her name.

items.title: Storage 24
items.description: A group of friends are stalked through a grueling maze of claustrophobic corridors by a terrifying, tentacle-faced creature that eviscerates its victims.

items.title: Bienvenido a Miami!
items.description: Bidding for more ratings, "Storage Wars" producers continue to expand the franchise beyond its 2010 flagship show in California. Following stops in Texas and New York, the series introduces a cast of Magic City buyers hoping to find treasures hidden within storage lockers. Local auctioneers Bob Nichols and Jerry Mahaffey officiate the "wars" that break out among longtime buyer Kevin Pew, fiery Cuban couple Jorge Gomez and Maydel Garcia, married duo Greg and Lindsey Atz, and cousins Yorgen Ugalde and Christian Fernandez.

items.title: Miami Wow Machine
items.description: The buyers head to Pembroke Pines, Fla., for a Jerry Mahaffey auction; Greg and Lindsey are ready to drink after scoring a room; an old map could bring big dollars for Jorge and Maydel.

items.title: Big Booty Foes
items.description: The buyers visit Lantana, Fla.; Jorge and Maydel uncover a piece of music history; Greg and Lindsey have a misunderstanding; Yorgen and Christian find a medical device.

items.title: Don't Hate the Gator, Hate the Gate
items.description: The buyers invade Hialeah, Fla.; Greg and Lindsey uncover a shiny treasure trove; Jorge and Maydel visit a sugary wonderland; Kevin attempts to break the other bidders.

items.title: Deuces Wild
items.description: The buyers return to Miramar, Fla.; Kevin lands a locker with bite; Greg and Lindsey take an interest in appliances; Christian's gamble leads to Yorgen's fall.

items.title: To Hell and Backpack
items.description: The buyers visit Florida City, Fla.; Maydel spots something from her past; Kevin looks for a big locker with big money; Greg and Lindsey go cuckoo over their unit; Yorgen and Christian gamble on a backpack.

items.title: Interview With the Vampirologist
items.description: Keven imposes a neighborhood tax when the buyers visit Cooper City, Fla.; Jorge and Maydel score big on a first date; Yorgen and Christian find a fancy pair of scissors.

items.title: O Brother, Where Art My Money?
items.description: Jorge arrives in Hialeah, Fla., with a manly attitude; Yorgen and Christian discover old dominoes; Lindsey keeps a hold on Greg's money; Kevin uncovers car parts.

items.title: There's No Place Like Foam
items.description: The buyers spend big in Miramar, Fla.; Yorgen and Christian devise a small plan; Jorge discovers an upscale treat for Maydel; Kevin unearths an old helmet.

items.title: Fit Lauderdale
items.description: The buyers visit Fort Lauderdale, Fla.; a strange suit intrigues Yorgen and Christian; Greg and Lindsey come up with a unique way to remove the pounds; Jorge and Maydel try to stay awake; Kevin doubles down.

items.title: Story Game
items.description: On a trip to Hawaii, three fine art students bet on who can tell the best supernatural story.

items.title: Alien Sounds
items.description: Host Alex Hannaford investigates some of the strangest phenomena of our times.

items.title: Ice Bombs
items.description: Alex searches for a scientific explanation for the terrifying phenomenon known as ice bombs, which cause fear, devastation and even injury.

items.title: Street Trash
items.description: A case of contaminated alcohol has a debilitating effect on the vagabonds haunting the streets and junkyards of Brooklyn.

items.title: Street Trash
items.description: In a dystopian future, a ragtag group of misfits must fight for survival when government officials in Cape Town, South Africa, start using a sinister chemical agent to exterminate the homeless population.

items.title: Strike Missions: Balkans
items.description: Examining the early months of 1941 in the Balkans when Italy's offensive had stalled and a Greek counter-offensive pushed into Albania.

items.title: New Orleans
items.description: Explore the geological, architectural and technological foundations of the world's largest cities.

items.title: Tokyo
items.description: Taking a look at the infrastructure that keeps Tokyo ready for a multitude of tremors and a volcano overdue to erupt.

items.title: Inside the Sun
items.description: Stripping celestial bodies layer by layer to get at the heart of what makes the universe tick.

items.title: Expedition Mars
items.description: Using CGI to strip Mars layer by layer and tear off swirling dust storms, frozen ice caps, and study the secrets that lie beneath the Red Planet.

items.title: Stuck
items.description: Passionate hospice worker Brandi Boski believes she will soon be promoted for her hard work. Meanwhile, penniless Thomas Bardo is evicted from his apartment. Their lives intersect in shocking fashion when Brandi hits Thomas with her car. Thomas, lodged in the car's partially shattered windshield, pleads for help, but a frightened Brandi ignores him and drives home. Fearing she may lose her job or receive jail time, she makes a chilling, life-changing decision.

items.title: Stuff Stephanie in the Incinerator
items.description: Rich thrill seekers (Catherine Dee, William Dane) act out a scenario of decadence and murder with another couple.

items.title: Invest In Your Kitchen
items.description: Styled follows the staging and renovation adventures of Nicole Babb and Caffery Vanhorne, best friends and design experts, as they transform spaces from drab to fab.

items.title: Every Woman's Dream Home
items.description: Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

items.title: A Dream Childhood Home
items.description: Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

items.title: Builder Basic to Modern
items.description: Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

items.title: A Modern Home and Rental
items.description: Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

items.title: A Pop of Color
items.description: Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

items.title: New Generation Style
items.description: Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

items.title: 100 Years Newer
items.description: After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

items.title: Paid Off, Styled Up
items.description: Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

items.title: An Elevated Lower Level
items.description: Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

items.title: Old Plan to Open Floor Plan
items.description: Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

items.title: Two Sisters, One Home
items.description: Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

items.title: Townhouse Transformation
items.description: Nicole and Caffrey transform a townhouse into an absolute dream for Nicole and her two daughters, while helping real estate pro Chris uncover and stage this cluttered suburban listing.

items.title: Suite Retreat
items.description: Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

items.title: Speakeasy to Me
items.description: Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

items.title: Elevated Oasis
items.description: With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

items.title: Success Story
items.description: Entrepreneur and business executive Scott Clary delves into the journeys of successful achievers - executives, celebrities, influencers and even politicians.

items.title: Sugarcane
items.description: The race against a sadistic serial killer is on as a trafficking survivor relentlessly works to track down a teenage girl whose fate becomes increasingly grim with each passing hour since her abduction.

items.title: Suitable Flesh
items.description: Psychiatrist Elizabeth Derby becomes obsessed with helping a young patient who's suffering from extreme personality disorder. However, it soon leads her into occult danger as she tries to escape from a horrific fate.

items.title: We're Retired, Not Dead
items.description: Adding a new wrinkle to reality shows, "Sunset Daze" follows a group of fun-loving friends who are spending their twilight years at the Sun City retirement community in Arizona. And they're spending them like Spring Breakers, lounging poolside, talking about sex, boozing it up at happy hour and making the nightlife scene. Included in the spotlight are sassy New Yorker Gail, a former off-Broadway actress and cabaret singer; "Mr. Romeo" Jack, who enjoys dancing and courting women; and Sandy, nicknamed "The Wild Child," perhaps because of her membership in the Blue Thong Society.

items.title: Love, Lassos and Liver Spots
items.description: Sandy asks her shooting instructor out; Gail attends her son's gay rodeo; Jack tries to advance his relationship with Kathleen.

items.title: Grannies Gone Wild
items.description: Linda moves to start a new life with her boyfriend in Arizona and things get wild when her new friend, Lawanda, throws a party.

items.title: Top Gun and Tiaras
items.description: Jack tries his luck with a new woman; Sandy thinks of changing her ways; Eileen competes in the Ms. Senior Arizona Pageant.

items.title: Every Dog Has His Day
items.description: Ron runs for the board of the Homeowners' Association; Linda helps Jack throw a party for his dog; Eileen is forced to give up her dream.

items.title: The Show Must Go On
items.description: Gail promises to dress as Marilyn Monroe to Eileen's party; Jack "Mr. Romeo" attends comedy school; LaWanda dances to cope with the stress of her husband's disease.

items.title: Fast Times at Sun City Grand
items.description: Gail auditions pianists for the cabaret she's putting on; Linda and Bruce run into relationship problems; Ann holds up end when she loses a bet with Eileen.

items.title: Hollywood or Bust
items.description: Gail's cabaret is a success; Cary's partner, George, watches her pup Pumpkin; Ann's husband must pass a vision test so he can drive a real race car.

items.title: I Do...Again
items.description: Jim proposed to renew vows with Joanne; Sandy, Joanne, and their friends reveal their wild side; Jack starts dating a single mom.

items.title: Senior Prom
items.description: Linda is selected to plan the prom; Joanne searches to find dates for her friends; Gail has two dates; Sandy hopes to bring Mark.

items.title: Sunset on the River Styx
items.description: A chance meeting of two morose lovers sends them spiraling down a surreal rabbit hole. Their relationship will be challenged by their pasts, their futures, their perception of time, and a vampire death cult.

items.title: Super
items.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

items.title: Super High Me
items.description: Comic Doug Benson conducts an experiment in which he abstains from marijuana use for 30 days, then smokes it continually for 30 more.

items.title: Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream
items.description: Charting the journey of Alexandra Hirschi, aka Supercar Blondie, as she reviews the world's most exclusive and expensive supercars.

items.title: Airbus
items.description: A team of elite truckers tackle large, challenging, or otherwise unusual jobs.

items.title: Royal Marines Landing Craft
items.description: Sergeant Major and Sully battle the elements loading two 16-tonne Royal Marines landing craft in Instow, Devon; they're a massive load for the winding roads, and the truckers have to navigate heavy holiday traffic all the way to the dockyard.

items.title: Top-Secret Tank
items.description: Sergeant Major is in Spain transporting the British army's brand-new scout vehicle from Seville to Newport, Wales; in Worcester, Broomey struggles to get a huge piece of mining equipment on a boat destined for Australia.

items.title: Supertruckers
items.description: Sergeant Major leads a squadron of truckers moving a vintage RAF English Electric Lightning through the Cotswolds; crane driver Mike gets festival fever moving the Giant Arcadia Spider stage from Glastonbury to a music event in Bristol.

items.title: Quarry Machine Tank
items.description: Sully and Sergeant Major have a dangerous balancing act transporting two enormous 18m-long quarry machines; their challenge is to move these giant machines over 290km from Hertfordshire to Port Talbot in Wales.

items.title: Helicopter Haulage
items.description: Trucker Broomey is tasked with transporting a 55 metric ton aircraft tow truck from Halifax to Yeovilton in Somerset, England, for the 75th Yeovilton Royal Naval Air Show; it needs to tow a Vulcan bomber, the highlight of the annual air display.

items.title: Support the Girls
items.description: Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

items.title: Surfwise
items.description: Forsaking a traditional home life, Dorian "Doc" Paskowitz and his wife raise their large brood in a 24-foot camper and spend their time surfing.

items.title: Surrogate Stories
items.description: Exploring the bond of a surrogate and the parent.

items.title: Surveillance
items.description: After a spree of horrific murders in the New Mexico desert, two FBI agents arrive at a small Santa Fe police station to interview the key witnesses. Using elaborate surveillance equipment to view the interrogations simultaneously, Sam Hallaway watches as his partner cross-examines the three survivors. As several inconsistencies emerge, it becomes clear that somebody in the room knows the truth behind the slayings.

items.title: Surviving a Bear Attack
items.description: Nick Mundt and Laura Schara explore the reason and science behind surviving in the outdoors.

items.title: Surviving Treestand Accidents
items.description: Finding out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how one can prevent them; cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send the hosts, stunt team and special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

items.title: Sniper Attack
items.description: In addition to marksmanship and long-range shooting, military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

items.title: Surviving a Lightning Strike
items.description: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art direct effects lightning test lab. With some "explosive" experiments, they'll determine the power of lightning, and they'll find out how hunters and fishermen can protect themselves.

items.title: Surviving Compton: Dre, Suge & Michel'le
items.description: R&B singer Michel'le lives through the turbulent days of N.W.A, being signed to Ruthless Records and becoming romantically involved with Dr. Dre and Suge Knight.

items.title: Surviving Hitler's Mad Doctors
items.description: The Nazi Regime imposed some of the most heinous forms of eugenics the world ever witnessed; Nazi concentration camps conducted so-called "medical research projects" involving cruel and often lethal experimentation on human subjects.

items.title: In the Offing
items.description: Cam Calloway is about to find out the price he'll pay for stardom, love and loyalty. A basketball star in his early 20s, Calloway's life changes after he signs a multimillion-dollar contract with a team in Atlanta. He arrives in Georgia bright-eyed and eager to begin his career, joined by cousin and confidant Reggie Vaughn, who tries to keep Cam focused and free from distractions caused by Cam's blunt-but-loyal sister M-Chuck and opportunistic mom Cassie. Feeling a responsibility to support needy family and friends, Cam wrestles with the rewards and pitfalls of sudden wealth and fame. "Survivor's Remorse" is a half-hour comedy series executive produced by Mike O'Malley ("Yes, Dear") and Tom Werner, among others.

items.title: Northern Ontario
items.description: Outdoorsman and survival expert Les Stroud permits himself to be stranded for a week in a remote location with no equipment or supplies apart from his one-man camera rig, documenting his experience and providing insight into how to manage whatever hurdles the wilderness might throw at him.

items.title: Papua New Guinea
items.description: Les is stranded in the jungles of Papua New Guinea.

items.title: Norway Part 1
items.description: Les strands himself in the Norwegian mountains to survive for ten days taking little food and no water or gear.

items.title: Norway Part 2
items.description: The series follows Les Stroud as he spends 10 consecutive days alone in remote locations around the world. Without a safety or camera crew and geared with only a bit of food, Stroud takes to the wilderness to teach viewers how to survive if they find themselves stranded alone. After being dropped in locations such as the mountains of Norway and the desert island of Tiburon, Stroud struggles to find his own food, shelter and fresh water, while avoiding dangerous predators and battling the elements.

items.title: Susan Rice: Silver Alert
items.description: With decades of stand-up experience under her belt, Susan Rice takes the stage to share quips about car troubles and the joys of getting older.

items.title: Suspiria
items.description: Suzy (Jessica Harper) travels to Germany to attend ballet school. When she arrives, late on a stormy night, no one lets her in, and she sees Pat (Eva Axén), another student, fleeing from the school. When Pat reaches her apartment, she is murdered. The next day, Suzy is admitted to her new school, but has a difficult time settling in. She hears noises, and often feels ill. As more people die, Suzy uncovers the terrifying secret history of the place.

items.title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
items.description: Cult musician Swamp Dogg, alongside housemates Moogstar and Guitar Shorty, turn their home into an artistic playground. Together, they forge a unique and inspiring path as they navigate the tumultuous waves of the music industry.

items.title: Swamp Thing
items.description: On the verge of a breakthrough in his quest to wipe out world hunger, altruistic botanist Dr. Alec Holland (Ray Wise) is placed under the protection of special government agent Alice Cable (Adrienne Barbeau). Mad outlaw scientist Anton Arcane (Louis Jourdan) wants to steal Holland's research for his own nefarious ends, but an unforeseen accident during the heist turns Holland into the Swamp Thing, an enormous plant-like creature that fights back against Arcane's henchmen to save Cable.

items.title: The Un-Men Unleashed
items.description: An experimental potion mutates Dr. Alec Holland into Swamp Thing, a part-man/part-plant superhero.

items.title: To Live Forever
items.description: Dr. Arcane travels to the Amazonian Rainforest to investigate trees that never die and enslaves a local Indian tribe to harvest their sap, causing damage to the ecosystem; Swamp Thing liberates the Indians and uses the sap to restore the rainforest.

items.title: Falling Star
items.description: Swamp Thing teams up with Bayou Jack and Tomahawk to help NASA recover the satellite before its radioactivity causes permanent harm the ecology of the area.

items.title: The Legend of Lost Cavern
items.description: Dr. Arcane desecrates an Indian burial ground in search of Lost Cavern, home of the fabled Fountain of Youth; he unearths a tablet covered with ancient pictographs and forces Tomahawk to decode the writings.

items.title: Experiment in Terror
items.description: Swamp Thing is captured by scientists, who take him to New Orleans for government experiments; J.T. and Delbert come to his aid and help him escape.

items.title: Swan Song
items.description: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

items.title: Sweet 16
items.description: Murder and mayhem seem to surround the new girl (Aleisa Shirley) in town as her 16th birthday approaches.

items.title: Sweet Virginia
items.description: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town.

items.title: Salt
items.description: A new life awaits 22-year-old Tess when she arrives friendless in New York City and lacking any specific ambitions beyond finding a job. Her charm and observational nature lead to an invitation to train at one of the city's best restaurants. She thinks it is a temporary place to wait for her life's big break, but Tess is quickly intoxicated by the people she meets and by the chaotic world behind the scenes -- tasting expensive wine, exploring dive bars, learning whom to trust. Her co-workers become her family, and through them she finds a sense of belonging that she has never encountered before.

items.title: Sweethurt
items.description: In an attempt to win back his ex, Jacob embarks on a road-trip under the pretence of dealing with his newly-deceased grandfather's stuff. Skye's perfect relationship has ended, and the only one who can pick up the pieces is her best friend Carly.

items.title: Sorry for Your Loss
items.description: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance; that is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control; Rhiannon's life transforms.

items.title: Swimsuit Secrets Revealed
items.description: Choosing the right bathing suit.

items.title: T11 Incomplete
items.description: Past mistakes haunt the present and threaten a new love affair between a troubled home health aide and her new patient.

items.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
items.description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

items.title: Tails of Christmas
items.description: Caleb gets injured in the army and begins recovering through help from shelter therapy dogs. As a sign of thanks, Caleb returns home to help Amber run the local shelter and in the process, discovers his feelings for Amber go beyond gratitude.

items.title: Take Every Wave
items.description: Filmmaker Rory Kennedy provides an account of the career of big wave surfer Laird Hamilton, a man who has spent his life conquering untamable walls of water.

items.title: Take This Waltz
items.description: A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.

items.title: Taken in Broad Daylight
items.description: Teenager Anne Sluti is kidnapped by a madman, and by manipulating her captor, she manages to negotiate her safe release after six days.

items.title: Taking Stock
items.description: Hosted by J.D. Durkin from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, Taking Stock covers market close, big money moves of the day, and industry trends from crypto to A.I. to startups.

items.title: Into the Unknown
items.description: An episodic horror anthology series based on the most viral and haunting stories from the r/NoSleep community.

items.title: Fixed Frequency
items.description: Juan's excitement at getting to hang out with his cousin Cedric and the popular guy, Kurt, quickly dissipates when he learns their ideal Friday night activity is biking through their quiet suburban town.

items.title: Starlight
items.description: Whit Barnett is obsessed with the idea of being famous; he devotes all his energy toward a vlog, and reality shows are a mainstay in his apartment.

items.title: Carry
items.description: Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother; when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

items.title: Plastic Smile
items.description: Growing up with addicts for parents, Abigail's only solace is an odd porcelain doll named Betsy, Betsy isn't like other dolls; she moves, speaks, cries and Betsy wants Abigail to bring her to a dark tunnel in middle of the woods.

items.title: Whistle in the Woods
items.description: Sawyer is beyond excited to visit her new friend Nola and her elation ratchets up a notch when she arrives at Nola's house.

items.title: Meet the Herberts
items.description: Introduced to viewers in "Braxton Family Values," Tamar Braxton is the family's sassy youngest sister. This series follows Tamar and music mogul husband Vince Herbert, whom she married in 2008, in their relationship, which centers around her obsession with achieving instant pop stardom and his attempts to keep his sanity while trying to help her reach her goal. While they have an over-the-top lifestyle, Tamar has her hands full dealing with Vince's health issues, her stagnant music career, and pet dog Miracle, who constantly barks and relieves himself everywhere. Through the highs and lows, the couple are out to prove that a husband and wife can mix business with pleasure.

items.title: Calling All Tamartians!
items.description: Tamar's solo album and clash with Vince; Vince's health and Tamar's career is threatened; 2012 ESSENCE Music Festival.

items.title: Nurse Ratchet
items.description: Vince has another health scare; Tamar puts recording on a pause; Tamar and Vince's marriage is at risk.

items.title: Trouble in Paradise
items.description: Tamar and Vince go on a lovers' retreat in Hawaii with LaShawn and April; a major blow-up between Tamar and Vince.

items.title: Clash of the Herberts
items.description: Tamar and Vince's marriage is in jeopardy; an emergency counseling session; Tamar clashes with her stylist.

items.title: Road to Recovery
items.description: Tamar and Vince meet with an interior designer; Vince's health is at stake; Tamar's album in L.A.; Vince visits his parents' graves.

items.title: Gaga for Gaga
items.description: Tamar performs the National Anthem at a football game; Vince and Tamar head to London for some business and fun.

items.title: Model Wife
items.description: Papa Braxton gives marital advice; LaShawn and April argue; Tamar struggles on a new ballad and hits the catwalk for the first time.

items.title: The Showcase Must Go On!
items.description: Tamar prepares for the release of her new single between workouts, photo shoots and fighting with her vocal coach.

items.title: Are You Ready for Tamar?!?
items.description: Tamar auditions hot male dancers; Tamar and Vince go to Vegas; Tamar takes the stage with debut songs.

items.title: It's a Herbert
items.description: Tamar and Vince hit the road on a multi-city bus tour to promote "Love and War"; Tamar's stresses out about her baby bump she's hiding.

items.title: Bump on the Road
items.description: Tamar dazzles her fans on the second leg of her tour and battles pregnancy issues; Tamar and Vince announce the pregnancy.

items.title: Posh & Pregnant
items.description: Tamar and Vince design their new house; Tamar's shoe collection; parenting tips from LaShawn and a birth specialist.

items.title: For the Record
items.description: Tamar and Vince promote their album; Tamar's pregnancy photo shoot; Tamar appears on "RuPaul's Drag Race."

items.title: What to Expect When You're Poppin'
items.description: Vince wants Tamar to shoot her next music video while still pregnant; Tamar is bummed out by the wardrobe options for the shoot. Her sisters and mom help with a belly cast. Tamar & Vince take their last birth class.

items.title: Shower With a Chance of Contractions
items.description: Tamar's backyard BBQ-themed baby shower; tensions run high at a Herbert family photo shoot; Tamar goes into labor.

items.title: Baby Herbert Arrives
items.description: Tamar has a difficult labor, and she and Vince must make a decision; the Braxton clan debates over the baby's name.

items.title: Jet Set Baby
items.description: Tamar and Vince return to Los Angeles and experience highs and lows of new parenthood; Baby has first photo shoot; Tamar can't fit into the outfits for her album cover photo; she questions the direction for her album.

items.title: Mama Works Hard for Her Coin
items.description: Tamar struggles to balance motherhood and career; Tamar's new talk show, magazine cover shoot and final decision for the album.

items.title: Welcome to the Number One Club
items.description: Tamar's new album is released, and she celebrates with an exclusive bash; Tamar and Vince clash over Tamar's success.

items.title: The Journey Begins
items.description: After nearly losing everything, including herself, the singer is determined to turn her life around and take matters into her own hands by sharing her truth.

items.title: Break Room Breakdown
items.description: Tamar's journey to turn her life around blows up when her ex-husband Vince Herbert comes between her and David; Tamar faces her fears in a recording session with J. White; Cameras continue rolling when Tamar explodes over issues with production.

items.title: Old and New Wounds
items.description: Tamar's dream life comes to a halt when cameras are forced to shut down; Tamar is caught in the crossfire between David's suspicions and relaunching her career; a long-lasting family feud hovers over Tamar, and Mona steps in.

items.title: Caught in the Middle
items.description: David confronts Goli about the nature of the Dream Work; Tamar opens for Todrick Hall, while planning David's birthday party; Goli and Tamar sit down to resolve David's issues; Tamar gets fed up with production.

items.title: Celebration and Chaos
items.description: With Goli and David at odds, and his family in from Nigeria, Tamar juggles multiple challenges at his 50th birthday party; an analysis of Tamar's dream leads to an epiphany, but the peace is shattered when Goli and David have an epic showdown.

items.title: Final Word
items.description: The Braxton family reunites at Trina's wedding; Tamar suffers the aftermath; David reveals all; Tamar's final days of production unravel, and Mona steps in.

items.title: Tangerine
items.description: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

items.title: Tapawingo
items.description: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

items.title: Pro Chefs Blind Taste Test Every Bag of Frozen French Fries
items.description: Three experts evaluate everyday food items in one room; the program identifies which brands perform well in the taste evaluation.

items.title: Pro Chefs Blind Taste Test Every Boxed Stuffing
items.description: Three experts evaluate everyday food items in one room; the program identifies which brands perform well in the taste evaluation.

items.title: Pro Chefs Blind Taste Test Every Potato Chip
items.description: Three experts evaluate everyday food items in one room; the program identifies which brands perform well in the taste evaluation.

items.title: Tasting Menu
items.description: The closing night at one of the world's most esteemed restaurants turns into a comedy of manners and misunderstandings, as well as a celebration of great food, when an eclectic mix of regulars comes to say goodbye.

items.title: Taylor Swift: Dare to Dream
items.description: The incredible journey of Taylor Swift all began with a girl, a guitar and a dream; take a look at how this ten time Grammy winner, built a childhood dream into an empire.

items.title: Tea With the Dames
items.description: Spend a delightfully bawdy afternoon with four legends of British stage and cinema -- Maggie Smith, Judi Dench, Eileen Atkins and Joan Plowright -- as they spill the tea on life, love and art.

items.title: Juggle Mark and Card Shark Strike Back
items.description: Agile Alexa shows her skills while the Sky Surfer soars.

items.title: Kid Contortionist's Twists and Turns
items.description: The Spotter looks ahead while Sucker Punch shows his right hook.

items.title: The Racket's Racket
items.description: The BMX Baller showcases their moves while the Quarantine Climber creates a course.

items.title: Tech Billionaires: Elon Musk
items.description: Elon Musk, the mind behind PayPal, founder of Tesla, and SpaceX; he is the intellectual and eccentric tech billionaire who shook the entire world with groundbreaking inventions.

items.title: Disabled Life Enhancements
items.description: Recounting how innovations in technology and breakthroughs in knowledge change lives in astonishing ways.

items.title: Vasanth
items.description: A number of teenagers from diverse families are put in control of the monthly budget so they can learn a thing or two about financial planning.

items.title: Ellenor
items.description: Ellenor is a natural at taking control, but her family budget takes hit after hit during the month she's in charge as Teenage Boss.

items.title: Byron
items.description: Byron is put in charge of his family's budget at just 13 years old, and has to put some tough rules in place when his mum and dad refuse to listen.

items.title: Susan
items.description: With a massive birthday party for her mom to pay for as part of her expenses, Susan tries to also save enough money for the headphones she dreams of buying.

items.title: Imogen
items.description: Imogen manages her father's large food budget in preparation for his bodybuilding competition.

items.title: Michael
items.description: When Michael comes home from his first shopping trip as Teenage Boss with a brand-new coffee machine and next to no food, his father and brother are in for a rocky month indeed.

items.title: Christabel
items.description: Fangirl Christabel struggles to save enough money for the guitar she wants.

items.title: Dimity
items.description: After becoming the boss of her family, 13-year-old Dimity is overloaded with unexpected bills from school and leisure.

items.title: Harry
items.description: Harry has big plans as the boss of his household, including buying an expensive camera for himself.

items.title: Mikayla
items.description: Mikayla faces a steep learning curve after she splurges on clothes and expensive food.

items.title: Nick
items.description: With his little sister Zoe along for the ride, young Nick's in for a big adventure as teenage boss for a whole month.

items.title: Elinya
items.description: Elinya's control of the family budget is jeopardised by her mother's secret spending and a vet bill.

items.title: Ula
items.description: Music fan Ula takes over her family's budget as they deal with challenges.

items.title: Mitchell
items.description: Mitchell learns that being in charge of his family's budget is about more than numbers.

items.title: Hayley
items.description: Hayley has hopes of running a business based on rescuing horses, but with such massive dreams at stake her parents want to give her an expense-filled month to help her prepare.

items.title: Tenebre
items.description: Visiting Rome on a promotional tour for his new novel, writer Peter Neal (Anthony Franciosa) is pulled into a murder mystery as someone familiar with his work begins a series of killings. While the police look into the crimes, Neal investigates on his own, aided by his beautiful assistant, Anne (Daria Nicolodi), and a tenacious young local named Gianni (Christian Borromeo). As the murderer brutally dispatches of other victims, Neal gets closer to discovering the psychopath's identity.

items.title: Tenure
items.description: A college professor (Luke Wilson) takes action when a new colleague (Gretchen Mol) threatens his chance for tenure.

items.title: Terminal
items.description: In the dark heart of a sprawling and anonymous city, two assassins carry out a sinister mission, a teacher battles a fatal illness, an enigmatic janitor and a curious waitress lead a dangerous double life. Murderous consequences unravel in the dead of night as their lives all intertwine at the hands of a mysterious criminal mastermind who is hell-bent on revenge.

items.title: Terror Train
items.description: During a hazing, a fraternity of pre-med students has a particularly sinister prank in store for one their more timid pledges (Derek MacKinnon). With the help of a coed, Alana Maxwell (Jamie Lee Curtis), they pull off the prank so well that the pledge needs to be institutionalized as a result. After several years pass and people forget the incident, those involved with the prank are ready to celebrate their graduation by having a costume party on a train, but they haven't escaped their past yet.

items.title: Terror's Advocate
items.description: Jacques Verges, a lawyer and former Free French Forces guerrilla, defends war criminals and those who deny the validity of the Holocaust.

items.title: Terry McMillan Presents: Paradise With You
items.description: An NFL superstar on the brink of retirement begins a passionate romance with an interior decorator on a Caribbean island. However, things soon turn complicated when they discover they're competing for the same coveted estate.

items.title: Texas City
items.description: Army gold shipments are being robbed, and some insider is tipping off the outlaws as to the time and route. Johnny Mack Brown is called in, and he teams up with Jim Kirby, an ex-Army Officer who was kicked out when his shipment was robbed.

items.title: Holy S... I've Got Boobs!
items.description: Stephanie's breast surgery; Jerald's mother Terri is unsupportive; Stephanie issues an ultimatum.

items.title: Husbands & Hooters
items.description: Tonia's high standards of a husband; Casey questions Candace about Tonia's motives.

items.title: Mama Drama
items.description: Tension between Candace, mama of triplets, and Stephanie, mama of twins.

items.title: Moving On
items.description: Candace meets Stephanie for lunch; drama continues for Stephanie's marriage.

items.title: Road Trippin'
items.description: Casey takes a quad road trip; Candace and Teryn go camping; Stephanie and her husband Jerald plan a garage sale.

items.title: Under the Knife
items.description: Raising one child can be a challenge for a parent. So imagine the difficulty of raising twins, triplets or even quadruplets. That's the task that the ladies on this docu-series face. The series follows a group of Texas women who are each raising multiple babies -- twins, triplets or quadruplets. The ladies, who have big personalities, staunch opinions and wild lives, support one another in their moms-of-multiples group. And although they are supportive of one another, each mother thinks that her way of parenting is the correct way to do it.

items.title: Weekend in Paris
items.description: All six mamas relax at the spa and talk about their post-multiples figures.

items.title: Who Doesn't Like Wine?
items.description: Candace plans an all day wine tour; tension on the bus; Stephanie's marriage troubles.

items.title: Texas Terror
items.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

items.title: ThanksKilling
items.description: A possessed turkey terrorizes five college students during Thanksgiving break.

items.title: ThanksKilling 3
items.description: Turkey carves his way through college students on Thanksgiving break.

items.title: That Brennan Girl
items.description: A selfish San Franciscan (Mona Freeman) loses a husband (June Duprez) in the war and marries a reformed racketeer (James Dunn).

items.title: That Summer of White Roses
items.description: World War II finally reaches a Yugoslavian lake, where a lifeguard (Tom Conti) shelters a refugee (Susan George) and her son.

items.title: That Uncertain Feeling
items.description: Jill Baker (Merle Oberon) has an incurable case of the hiccups, for which she reluctantly agrees to see a psychologist, Dr. Vengard (Alan Mowbray). During her first visit she realizes her hiccups may be related to nerves about her husband, Larry (Melvyn Douglas). Upon her second visit to the psychologist, she runs into a famous pianist (Burgess Meredith), and her doubts about her marriage are intensified when he starts courting her. Larry carries out a plan to renew his wife's affections.

items.title: The 12 Days of Christmas Eve
items.description: Santa gives a successful businessman 12 chances to relive the same day so he can repair his damaged relationships with his loved ones.

items.title: The 13th Summer
items.description: During their annual vacation to the beach, Ben and Vee encounter a mysterious hiker who draws them into a twisted web of lies, deceit, revenge and ultimately, murder.

items.title: The 19th Wife
items.description: BeckyLyn (Patricia Wettig), a member of a fundamentalist cult, is accused of killing her husband. Queenie (Chyler Leigh), another wife in the sect, thinks she is innocent, and asks her excommunicated son to help solve the case.

items.title: The 39 Steps
items.description: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith, who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela, an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth.

items.title: The 50 Worst Movies Ever Made
items.description: A look at some of the truly terrible moments in film history. This documentary consists of clips from what many believe to be some of the worst movies ever to make it - or not make it - into theaters.

items.title: Chelsey
items.description: Following ten morbidly obese individuals who collectively have a combined weight of 6,000 pounds and fight to transform their lives.

items.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 1
items.description: As identical twins, Destinee and Dynastiee have always done everything together, including gaining weight; at over a collective 1200 lbs, they both are determined to get healthy and lose the weight with Now's help.

items.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 2
items.description: Destinee and Dynastiee continue their weight loss journey, but after only one of them qualifies for surgery, the thought of moving ahead without the other is too much; they decide to do it together or not at all, knowing if one fails they both fail.

items.title: Grace
items.description: Grace has always found comfort in food; at over 600 lbs, she decides to join Dr. Now's program; that leads to the hardest decision of her life: to change her relationship with her sisters or lose the closest people in her life to get healthy.

items.title: Trista
items.description: After losing her son and her marriage, Trista turned to food, reaching over 600 lbs.; ready to heal, she seeks Dr. Now's help.

items.title: Caleb
items.description: After the deaths in his family, Caleb's struggle with his weight has gotten even worse; at only 20, he's already hit the 800lb mark; Caleb knows his health is reaching a breaking point unless he can get Dr. Now's help before it's too late.

items.title: Crystal
items.description: After Crystal's weight spiraled out of control, she became bedridden; she has to depend on her father and best friend to take care of her and her teenage daughter; she hopes to get Dr. Now's help, but traveling to him may not be possible for her.

items.title: Sam
items.description: Sam's dream is to do more with his wife and son, with his weight fast approaching 700 lbs, his body keeps him from doing that; determined to change, he tries to join Dr Now's program to get weight loss surgery before he loses any more time with them.

items.title: Lauren
items.description: Confined to her apartment for three years, Lauren's near-death experience inspires her to lose weight; Dr. Now is her last hope, but she must overcome his program's challenges to reclaim her life and reconnect with the dreams she thought were lost.

items.title: Nefi
items.description: At 25 and 626 lbs, Nefi has been a momma's boy his whole life; when he goes to Dr. Now for help, addressing their dynamic becomes the focus; will both of them be able to change their relationship for Nefi to succeed or will old habits win in the end?

items.title: The ABCs of Death
items.description: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

items.title: The Achievers: The Story of the Lebowski Fans
items.description: Fans of the movie "The Big Lebowski" hold annual conventions to celebrate the film with trivia contests, costume competitions and bowling.

items.title: The Advent Calendar
items.description: An ex-dancer is given a mysterious advent calendar.

items.title: The Adventurer
items.description: The Tramp breaks out of prison, saves a girl and her mother from drowning, and wrecks a swank party.

items.title: The Adventurer: The Curse of the Midas Box
items.description: After his parents and brother are kidnapped, a Victorian-era British teen learns about an artifact that can turn anything into gold.
