items.title: The Birth of the Blade
items.description: Wealthy planter Jim Bowie relies on the knife he invented after breaking his regular one fighting a bear.

items.title: The Squatter
items.description: Jim persuades an imperious plantation owner to allow a squatter and his pregnant wife to remain on her land.

items.title: An Adventure With Audubon
items.description: Jim is amused when his friend is mistaken for the missing son of King Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette.

items.title: Deputy Sheriff
items.description: Jim takes a turn as a volunteer deputy to guard a prisoner, but he begins to doubt the prisoner's guilt.

items.title: The Trapline
items.description: Jim believes a fur company may be trying to drive him away by killing any Cajun trapper with whom he does business.

items.title: Broomstick Wedding
items.description: A case of mistaken identity leads an angry farmer to decide that Jim must marry his daughter in a shotgun wedding.

items.title: Natchez Trace
items.description: Jim is asked to protect a group of travelers from a bandit preying on people along the road to Natchez.

items.title: Jim Bowie Comes Home
items.description: Jim's family takes on the local saloon keeper, who has different visions of the town's future.

items.title: Ghost of Jean Battoo
items.description: Jim assists farmers who are being forced to pay protection money to an old woman who threatens to unleash the ghost of a Louisiana pirate on them.

items.title: Jackson's Assassination
items.description: Jim is unwittingly dragged into a plot to assassinate President Jackson.

items.title: Gone to Texas
items.description: Jim visits the Mexican state of Texas, hoping to buy land, but he's arrested as a spy and sentenced to death.

items.title: The Road to Monterey
items.description: Kit Carson and El Toro right wrongs in the Old West.

items.title: The Murango Story
items.description: Kit and El Toro discover the body of Tad Morton's father.

items.title: Law of the Frontier
items.description: Outlaw Haggard impersonates the new sheriff of Green Valley to gain access to gold.

items.title: Pledge to Danger
items.description: A woman summons Kit to search for her missing daughter.

items.title: Highway to Doom
items.description: Bandits use a cave to store loot from holdups.

items.title: Hide-Out
items.description: An outlaw plans to take over a ranch and use it as a hideout for his gang.

items.title: The Broken Spur
items.description: Kit and El Toro (Bill Williams, Don Diamond) are held up by the Slick Ears gang.

items.title: Ventura Feud
items.description: A woman wielding an odd pair of shears exposes herself as a murderess.

items.title: Claim Jumpers
items.description: A boss of a gang poses as an assayer in order to trick a man out of his money.

items.title: Mask of the Vigilantes
items.description: An ex-outlaw decides that crooked politics are more profitable than crime.

items.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
items.description: Robin Hood and Maid Marion work to stop the evil Sheriff's thievery and return the King to his rightful throne.

items.title: The Case of Lady Beryl
items.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories.

items.title: The Case of Blind Man's Bluff
items.description: A chicken claw tied with black ribbon is left behind at the scene of several murders.

items.title: The Case of Harry Crocker
items.description: Holmes sets out to prove that a famous escape artist is not a murderer.

items.title: The Case of the Split Ticket
items.description: Holmes and Watson find Brian O'Casey waiting for them at their flat.

items.title: The Case of the Greystone Inscription
items.description: Miss Channing seeks Holmes' help after her fiancé disappears at Greystone Castle.

items.title: The Case of the Laughing Mummy
items.description: Holmes and Watson investigate a mummy that makes strange noises.

items.title: The Case of the Deadly Prophecy
items.description: People begin dying after a schoolboy writes their names on the church steps.

items.title: The Case of the Christmas Pudding
items.description: A prisoner escapes shortly after he receives Christmas pudding.

items.title: The Case of the Night Train Riddle
items.description: Holmes investigates a kidnapping after a circus clown helps a boy escape from a moving train.

items.title: The Case of the Baker Street Nursemaids
items.description: A delivery boy leaves Holmes with a baby and a mysterious note.

items.title: The Case of the Impostor Mystery
items.description: Holmes tries to catch an impostor.

items.title: The Case of the Exhumed Client
items.description: Holmes believes Sir Charles is murdered by one of his heirs.

items.title: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
items.description: Holmes is jailed after visiting the Cupid's Bow Marriage Bureau.

items.title: The Case of the Neurotic Detective
items.description: Dr. Watson is suspicious of Holmes.

items.title: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
items.description: A boy wants to find his missing father.

items.title: The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
items.description: Skip Robinson (Robert F. Logan) leads his wife, Pat (Susan Damante Shaw) ; son, Toby (Ham Larsen) ; and daughter, Jenny (Hollye Holmes) on an exodus from the concrete jungle of Los Angeles. At the site of their new home in the majestic Rocky Mountains, Skip builds a log cabin, and the children befriend wild animals. As the intrepid Robinsons make a simpler life for themselves off the grid, they discover that, in the wilderness, each day brings its own adventure.

items.title: The Age of Hubble
items.description: An army of high-tech telescopes, led by Hubble in space, has delivered an unprecedented chain of discoveries about how galaxies took shape, how stars live and die, and how life arose.

items.title: Peril At Caribou Crossing
items.description: A pair of adventurers are intent on swindling travelers bound for the Yukon Territories during the height of the Klondike Gold Rush.

items.title: Behind The Moon
items.description: No sooner has a gold prospector made plans to marry an Indian girl than his backers plot to chase the Indians off the tribal land. It seems that gold has been discovered there.

items.title: Partners
items.description: When young Jimmy arrives after his father, a sad failure, has been declared dead, Rocky and Reno tell him his father was a respected success. But when Jimmy overhears Hap being accused of cheating his father and turning him into a bum, he runs away.

items.title: Disaster At Gold Hill
items.description: Silky takes a mining job to repay borrowed money and finds himself the center of a stormy triangle between Fay, her husband Paul and their partner Arthur. Fay goads her jealous husband to kill Silky so she and Arthur can have the mine and each other.

items.title: The Amazing Adventure
items.description: A bored millionaire (Cary Grant) steps into big business without his fortune or position just to prove he can survive on his own.

items.title: The Ambassador's Daughter
items.description: Senator Cartwright (Adolphe Menjou) and his wife (Myrna Loy) arrive in Paris as the guests of Ambassador Fiske (Edward Arnold). Cartwright has a plan to restrict the city from American soldiers on leave due to their boorish behavior. Fiske's daughter, Joan (Olivia de Havilland), tries to prove that Cartwright is wrong about the soldiers by going on a date with one named Danny (John Forsythe). Although Joan does not reveal her plan, Danny acts like a gentleman, and she starts to fall for him.

items.title: Separate but Unequal
items.description: Exploring the history of the American presidency with a comprehensive look at a wide variety of presidential action that moved our country forward.

items.title: Presidential Vision
items.description: The presidents who have made the biggest impact imagined what America could be; through their rhetoric, their leadership, or their sheer force of personality, these presidents dared Americans to join them in their vision for a better future.

items.title: Building the Economy
items.description: This hour explores how some U.S. presidents have exerted power over the economy through various measures, including taxation, imports and exports and law making, and the effects those actions have had on the lives of American citizens.

items.title: Extremism
items.description: The United States was born in the flames of violence and rebellion, and extremism has always been a part of American identity; focusing on the ways in which American presidents have reacted to extinguish or fan the flames of extremism.

items.title: We the People
items.description: America's Constitution starts with the words "We the People"; every U.S. president has faced the question of who, exactly, is included in this soaring phrase; this hour examines presidential decision-making for many disenfranchised citizens.

items.title: Becoming a Superpower
items.description: This hour traces the rise of America's place on the world stage; becoming a superpower has altered not just America's fate but that of the world as well; with great power comes great responsibility.

items.title: America Divided
items.description: AMC has proven its considerable skill in producing historical Western content ("Broken Trail," "Hell on Wheels"). The network dips into the same well again with the limited event series "The American West," a docudrama that shows how, in the aftermath of the Civil War, the United States transforms into the "land of opportunity," a violent world dominated by cowboys, Indians, outlaws and law men. Across eight episodes, little-known stories are told of Western legends such as Jesse James, Billy the Kid, Wyatt Earp, Crazy Horse and Sitting Bull. The series also features exclusive interviews with notable names from classic Western films, including James Caan, Tom Selleck, Kiefer Sutherland, Ed Harris and more.

items.title: Two Front War
items.description: Jesse James targets the railroads; Custer goes on a secret mission in Sioux Territory; Grant contends with the growing unrest in the South and West.

items.title: Blood & Gold
items.description: Allan Pinkerton gets hired to bring Jesse James to justice; settlers descend upon Sioux land to mine gold; Grant tries to keep the peace.

items.title: Showdown
items.description: Custer rides to a showdown at Little Big Horn with the Sioux; Jesse James hopes to make a big statement when he targets a bank in the northern territory.

items.title: Outlaw Rising
items.description: Billy the Kid uses his talent with a gun to get what he wants; Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse make an important decision; Wyatt Earp fights for what's right.

items.title: The Big Killing
items.description: Jesse James resurfaces after years in hiding; Billy the Kid avenges the death of his friend; Wyatt Earp questions his future as a man of the law.

items.title: Frontier Justice
items.description: Wyatt Earp heads to Tombstone; Billy the Kid and Pat Garrett's cat-and-mouse game reaches a climax; Sitting Bill is back in America.

items.title: The Last Vendetta
items.description: Sitting Bull is accused of inciting a rebellion; Wyatt Earp turns his back on the law in his search for true justice; Jesse James is confronted by the Ford Brothers.

items.title: The Amusement Park
items.description: A seemingly ordinary day at an amusement park turns into a living nightmare for an elderly man.

items.title: Pollinators and Predators
items.description: Are pig pens cleaner than your kitchen? Can you see better than a cow? We're down on the farm finding out.

items.title: Campsite Neighbors
items.description: Do deer see in slo-mo? Can coyotes speak crow? Are you camping next to cougars? Tune in to find out!

items.title: The Animal Kingdom
items.description: Successful and passionate publisher Tom Collier (Leslie Howard) marries socialite Cee Henry (Myrna Loy) despite loving his open-minded mistress, Daisy Sage (Ann Harding). As Tom becomes an established member of the upper class, his deceitful wife convinces him to publish books solely for profit and sacrifice his intellectual pursuits. When Daisy sees what Tom has become, she criticizes his transformation, forcing him to choose between staying with Cee and following his heart.

items.title: The Ape Man
items.description: A doctor (Bela Lugosi) injects himself with ape fluid and turns hairy; he needs human fluid to turn back.

items.title: The Apology
items.description: Twenty years after the disappearance of her daughter, recovering alcoholic Darlene Hagen is preparing to host her family's Christmas celebration with her best friend. On Christmas Eve, Darlene's ex-brother-in-law arrives unannounced, bearing nostalgic gifts and a heavy secret. Trapped together by a dangerous storm, she soon finds herself caught between reason and ruthless instinct as a battle of wits escalates into a violent game of revenge.

items.title: Everyone Wanted to Be on This Ship
items.description: "The Ark" takes place 100 years in the future when planetary colonization missions begin as a necessity to help secure the survival of the human race; after the brave crew of Ark One reaches their destination and finds it uninhabitable, they must survive long enough to locate a new home for themselves and all the ships that follow; the spacecraft's crew must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

items.title: Like It Touched the Sun
items.description: The crew struggles to establish order; investigations uncover more questions than answers.

items.title: Get Out and Push
items.description: All hope seems lost when the crew learns an asteroid is hours away from impact.

items.title: We Weren't Supposed to Be Awake
items.description: When their psyches are put to the test by hallucinations, the crew must race to find the cause.

items.title: It Can't Be True
items.description: After an attempted murder, the crew works together to find who's responsible before it's too late.

items.title: We Don't Kill Our Own
items.description: The ship is taken under siege and the crew must outsmart the mutineers to save themselves.

items.title: Cycle of Violence
items.description: Garnet has her work cut out for her when she attempts diplomacy with a longstanding enemy.

items.title: It Should Have Been You
items.description: Garnet and Ian are trapped in the empty ship where they may remain for the rest of their lives.

items.title: It Will Be Over Soon
items.description: Strickland is presented with a hard choice.

items.title: Fortunate
items.description: The crew arrives somewhere that seems too good to be true, and it just might be.

items.title: The Arrival
items.description: After astronomer Zane Zaminsky discovers a radio transmission that originated from space, he tells his boss, Phil, who ignores him. Zane is promptly fired, and decides to investigate the signal himself. When he discovers a return radio transmission from Mexico, he goes to explore. There he meets climate scientist Ilana Green, who is studying anomalies in gases in the area. Zane soon makes a finding that puts him in great danger.

items.title: The Artist
items.description: In the 1920s, actor George Valentin (Jean Dujardin) is a bona fide matinée idol with many adoring fans. While working on his latest film, George finds himself falling in love with an ingénue named Peppy Miller (Bérénice Bejo) and, what's more, it seems Peppy feels the same way. But George is reluctant to cheat on his wife with the beautiful young actress. The growing popularity of sound in movies further separates the potential lovers, as George's career begins to fade while Peppy's star rises.

items.title: The Assessment
items.description: In a not-so-distant future where parenthood is strictly controlled, a couple's seven-day assessment for the right to have a child unravels into a nightmare, forcing them to question the very foundations of society.

items.title: The Assignment
items.description: After being double-crossed, a hit man becomes a hit woman with help from a rogue surgeon. She sets out for revenge along with a nurse named Johnnie.

items.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman
items.description: Beginning during the racial turmoil of 1960s Louisiana, 110-year-old ex-slave Jane Pittman (Cicely Tyson) grants an interview to a persistent journalist and relates the remarkable story of her life. Orphaned early, she toils on a plantation until a chance meeting with a white Union soldier named Brown changes her outlook. Jane's emancipation marks only the beginning of an arduous and heartbreaking odyssey, framed by the horrors of slavery and the justice of the civil rights movement.

items.title: The Awakening
items.description: In post-World War I England a writer and sometime-ghost hunter (Rebecca Hall) investigates a reported haunting at a boys boarding school.

items.title: The Babadook
items.description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

items.title: The Baby
items.description: A social worker (Anjanette Comer) tries to save a teen from his mother (Ruth Roman), who keeps him in diapers and a crib.

items.title: The Bad Bunch
items.description: A Vietnam veteran (Greydon Clark) encounters racial hostility when he attempts to deliver a medal to a dead soldier's family.

items.title: The Badge
items.description: A sheriff (Billy Bob Thornton) investigates a woman's death and an apparent political cover-up.

items.title: The Bang Bang Club
items.description: Photojournalists put themselves in harm's way as they shoot evidence of atrocities committed in the final days of South African apartheid.

items.title: The Bank
items.description: Charlie dreams of being a hero during a bank robbery.

items.title: The Barge People
items.description: Flesh-eating mutants terrorize two couples during a weekend getaway in the English countryside.

items.title: The Barn
items.description: On Devil's Night, several friends find an abandoned barn and awaken something evil inside it.

items.title: The Barn Part II
items.description: With the ban on Halloween lifted in her hometown, Michelle and her best friend Heather in charge of the annual haunted house. Unfortunately for Michelle, some uninvited trick-or-treaters from her past come knocking.

items.title: The Barrens
items.description: A man takes his family on a camping trip in the New Jersey Pine Barrens and becomes convinced they are being stalked by the Jersey Devil.

items.title: The Bat
items.description: A killer called the Bat has claimed many lives in the small town inhabited by novelist Cornelia van Gorder (Agnes Moorehead) and her maid, Lizzie (Lenita Lane). As Cornelia implores Dr. Malcolm Wells (Vincent Price) to help her ailing maid, $1 million in the town's bank goes missing. With greed and fear reaching new heights, police Lt. Andy Anderson (Gavin Gordon) goes to Cornelia's house to investigate additional murders committed by the Bat.

items.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
items.description: The incredible real accounts from military officers on both sides of the war as they recount harrowing true stories from their time in aerial combat.

items.title: The Bay City Rollers Show
items.description: Skits and songs from the band "Bay City Rollers" as well as episode segments from past Krofft shows.

items.title: The Beach House
items.description: College sweethearts on a romantic getaway struggle for survival when unexpected guests exhibit signs of a mysterious infection.

items.title: The Beast Must Die
items.description: When big-game hunter Tom Newcliffe (Calvin Lockhart) invites a group of people to stay at his estate, they expect a relaxing weekend. Instead, they arrive to learn he thinks one of them is a werewolf and that no one can leave until that person is exposed. Among the suspects are a piano player (Michael Gambon) and his girlfriend (Ciaran Madden), an archaeologist (Peter Cushing), a diplomat (Charles Gray) and an artist (Tom Chadbon), all of whom are subjected to a series of werewolf tests.

items.title: The Beaver
items.description: Walter Black (Mel Gibson), the head of a failing toy company, is deeply depressed. His marriage to Meredith (Jodie Foster) is broken and his oldest son, Porter (Anton Yelchin), hates him. When Meredith finally throws him out of the house, Walter begins his final tailspin. Drunk and alone, Walter is about to commit suicide -- but is saved by the voice of the beaver puppet he found in a dumpster. Wearing the puppet on his hand, Walter speaks only through it and tries to get his life on track.

items.title: The Best of Worlds: Life at Its Alpine Limits
items.description: The Alps are home to plants and animals that owe their success to an amazing capacity to live in conditions that for other species, would be barely tolerable. For them however, this is everyday life.

items.title: The Clampetts Strike Oil
items.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process.

items.title: Getting Settled
items.description: Jed and his family are mistaken for a staff of crazy servants when they move into their new mansion.

items.title: Meanwhile, Back at the Cabin
items.description: The Clampett family miss being back at their old home in the mountains; Pearl tries to win over the oil man at the cabin as he takes her to a nearby phone.

items.title: The Clampetts Meet Mrs. Drysdale
items.description: When Mr. Drysdale describes Mrs. Drysdale as being a hypochondriac, the Clampetts assume she is a drunk.

items.title: Jed Buys Stock
items.description: Jed takes Drysdale's suggestion about buying good stock to heart and quickly purchases cows, pigs and chickens.

items.title: Trick or Treat
items.description: The homesick Clampetts, unaware that it's Halloween, decide to go calling on their Beverly Hills neighbors.

items.title: The Servants
items.description: Drysdale attempts another step in the social renovation of the Clampetts by lending them his servants.

items.title: Jethro Goes to School
items.description: A private school teacher is shocked to learn that her new fifth-grade student is Jethro.

items.title: Elly's First Date
items.description: Elly May's first date in Beverly Hills ends in a riot of confusion before it even starts.

items.title: Pygmalion and Elly
items.description: Sonny tries to court Elly May, as he determines that she needs to change from a hillbilly into an upper-class lady; Granny offers the use of her love charms to spice up their affair.

items.title: Elly Races Jethrine
items.description: The Clampetts try to get Sonny to propose to Elly before Cousin Pearl can get her daughter Jethrine married to him.

items.title: The Great Feud
items.description: The Clampetts load their shootin' irons for a match with the Drysdales when Sonny jilts and infuriates Elly May.

items.title: Home for Christmas
items.description: When Granny, Uncle Jed, Elly May and Jethro decide to return to the country for the holidays, they discover airline travel.

items.title: No Place Like Home
items.description: The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.

items.title: Jed Rescues Pearl
items.description: Pearl's attempts to snag Mr. Brewster seem hopeless until he suddenly makes an outrageous public proposal.

items.title: Back to Californy
items.description: Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.

items.title: Jed's Dilemma
items.description: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

items.title: Jed Saves Drysdale's Marriage
items.description: Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.

items.title: Elly's Animals
items.description: Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.

items.title: Jed Throws a Wingding
items.description: Two of Cousin Pearl's most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills; Jed doesn't know what to suggest.

items.title: Jed Plays Solomon
items.description: Granny's plan to stop Pearl's yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.

items.title: Duke Steals a Wife
items.description: Jed's bloodhound Duke takes on the role of matchmaker for his master and a glamorous woman from France.

items.title: Jed Buys the Freeway
items.description: A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.

items.title: Jed Becomes a Banker
items.description: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

items.title: The Family Tree
items.description: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

items.title: Jed Cuts the Family Tree
items.description: Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.

items.title: Granny's Spring Tonic
items.description: Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.

items.title: Jed Pays His Income Tax
items.description: Grannie manages to chase away an IRS agent with a shotgun, prompting a story from Mr. Drysdale about how the family came to live in Beverly Hills in the first place.

items.title: The Clampetts and the Dodgers
items.description: Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.

items.title: Duke Becomes a Father
items.description: Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.

items.title: The Clampetts Entertain
items.description: The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.

items.title: The Clampetts in Court
items.description: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

items.title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
items.description: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

items.title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
items.description: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

items.title: Elly Becomes a Secretary
items.description: Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.

items.title: Jethro's Friend
items.description: One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.

items.title: Jed Gets the Misery
items.description: To humor Granny, Jed fakes illness so that she can resume the doctoring that brought her fame in the hills.

items.title: Hair Raising Holiday
items.description: Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.

items.title: Granny's Garden
items.description: Granny's neighbors try to stop her when she attempts to create a vegetable garden in the front yard of the mansion grounds.

items.title: Elly Starts to School
items.description: Elly sparks a new trend in understated fashion when she enrolls in a finishing school.

items.title: The Clampett Look
items.description: The Clampetts are taken for the new avant-garde social leaders.

items.title: Jethro's First Love
items.description: Jethro shares a heart-to-heart conversation with Jed, and goes on to find himself a girlfriend in record time.

items.title: Chickadee Returns
items.description: Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to marry Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brings home.

items.title: The Clampetts Are Overdrawn
items.description: Jed is shocked when he receives news that his multimillion-dollar bank account has been overdrawn by $34 million.

items.title: The Clampetts Go Hollywood
items.description: The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.

items.title: Turkey Day
items.description: Plans for a holiday feast at the Clampett mansion go awry when Elly makes a pet of the Thanksgiving turkey.

items.title: The Garden Party
items.description: Mrs. Drysdale, giving a lavish garden party, finds to her horror that she is losing her guests to the Clampetts.

items.title: Elly Needs a Maw
items.description: Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.

items.title: The Clampetts Get Culture
items.description: The Clampetts try to participate in some of the more civilized pleasures of Beverly Hills.

items.title: Christmas at the Clampetts'
items.description: The Clampett family is somewhat befuddled when they receive lavish Christmas presents that all seem to come from Mr Drysdale.

items.title: A Man for Elly
items.description: Quirt Manly, celebrated star of television Westerns, is invited to the Clampett mansion to try to tame Elly May.

items.title: The Giant Jackrabbit
items.description: An Australian banker sends Drysdale a kangaroo as a joke, and Granny thinks she has discovered a giant jackrabbit.

items.title: The Girl From Home
items.description: A beauty-contest winner from the hills and her father come to visit Jethro with marriage on their minds.

items.title: Lafe Lingers On
items.description: Backwoods freeloader Lafe Crick lingers on at the Clampett mansion as an unwanted guest in search of an easy fortune.

items.title: The Race for Queen
items.description: Elly May decides to enter a beauty competition to become the queen of Beverly Hills, with some help from Miss Jane and the Drysdales; when Granny hears about the race, she wants to enter as well.

items.title: The Beyond
items.description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.

items.title: The Big Body Hotel

items.description: The explosive demolition of the O.K. Allen Bridge in central Louisiana.

items.title: Lewisham
items.description: A building must come down without harming local homes.

items.title: Paris
items.description: Two high-rises must be demolished without endangering the surrounding people and buildings.

items.title: The Desert Trail
items.description: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

items.title: The Devil Incarnate
items.description: Trevor and Holly's joy when they find out she is pregnant turns into a nightmare when they begin to suspect Holly has fallen victim to an ancient curse spawned by a demon.

items.title: The Devil's Daughter
items.description: A Jamaican (Nina Mae McKinney) uses voodoo to scare her New York sister (Ida James) off their father's rubber plantation.

items.title: The Devil's Doorway
items.description: Northern Ireland, 1960: Father Thomas Riley and Father John Thornton are dispatched by the Vatican to investigate reports of a miracle, a statue of the Virgin Mary weeping blood, at a remote Catholic asylum for immoral women. Armed with 16mm film cameras to record their findings, the priests instead discover a depraved horror show of sadistic nuns, satanism and demonic possession. Supernatural forces are at work here, but they are not the doing of God.

items.title: The Devil's Music
items.description: A man meets a girl online and starts an affair of the mind. By the end, he's committed murder and is wanted by police. Will they find him in time?

items.title: The Diabolical
items.description: A scientist (Arjun Gupta) battles a malevolent spirit that haunts the home of his girlfriend (Ali Larter) and her two young children.

items.title: Legacy of Love
items.description: Exploring the life of Princess Diana.

items.title: The Diana Story - Part I: The Young Princess
Never Name a Duck
items.description: Considered to be one of television's classics, "The Dick Van Dyke Show" centers on the personal and professional lives Rob Petrie, a writer on the fictional Alan Brady Show. He's happily married to former dancer Laura, and they have a young son, Ritchie. The plots generally revolve around problems at work -- where Rob got into various comedic jams with fellow writers Buddy Sorrell, Sally Rogers and producer Mel Cooley -- or at home.

items.title: Bank Book 6565696
items.description: Rob learns Laura has a secret bank account.

items.title: Hustling the Hustler
items.description: Rob has an evening of high adventure with a veteran pool shark who pretends he cannot play the game.

items.title: The Night the Roof Fell In
items.description: A tiring day causes a spat between the Petries.

items.title: A Man's Teeth Are Not His Own
items.description: Rob feels that he has betrayed his dentist friend, Jerry, when he goes to another dentist.

items.title: Give Me Your Walls
items.description: Rob's living room needs to be painted so he hires a colorful master painter from Rome.

items.title: The Dig
items.description: A convicted murderer is released from prison with no memory of his crime and is forced to help the victim's father dig for the body.

items.title: The Dirty South
items.description: Sue Parker finds herself in a desperate battle to save her family's struggling bar, which is on the brink of collapse due to her father's neglect. When a handsome drifter comes to town, she sees him as the only chance to prevent the business from falling into the hands of a ruthless tycoon. However, her seemingly simple plan soon leads to larceny and lawlessness, with deadly consequences.

items.title: A Child Without a Name
items.description: A foster child vanishes and laws prevent naming his family; the media is now hamstrung in reporting the case.

items.title: Small Town, Dark Underbelly
items.description: The hosts shed light on the disappearance of three-year-old William Tyrrell, which sparked an extensive manhunt, yet the case remains unsolved.

items.title: The Nearby Suspects
items.description: William is still missing; Officer Gary Jubelin takes over the case and immediately zeroes in on a key suspect.

items.title: Disappearance In a Small Town
items.description: The hosts shed light on the disappearance of three-year-old William Tyrrell, which sparked an extensive manhunt, yet the case remains unsolved.

items.title: Rising Temperatures, Rising Seas
items.description: Exploring natural disasters, how scientists try to forecast them and how people living in danger zones can try to anticipate and prepare for cataclysms.

items.title: A Year of Floods and Fire
items.description: El Niño events of 2016 trigger everything from unprecedented floods to extreme droughts around the globe.

items.title: Earth Striking Back
items.description: In 2017, local weather anomalies cause flooding and mudslides in South America, wildfires erupt in Europe and America, two deadly earthquakes strike Mexico, and record-breaking hurricanes batter the Caribbean.

items.title: Potstickers
items.description: Byron and Rachel Talbott show how restaurant quality meals can be made at home.

items.title: Chicken Tacos
items.description: Make it a Taco night! Your family will love these and you'll be happy knowing they're packed with healthy ingredients.

items.title: Cinnamon Buns
items.description: Rachel and Byron share there recipe for warm cinnamon buns.

items.title: Carrot Soup
items.description: Rachel and Byron cook up some carrot soup with spiced crumble. Give it a Try!

items.title: Egg Nog
items.description: Rachel: Today's recipe is new for us but it is a traditional holiday recipe none the less. Today we are making homemade eggnog.

items.title: Hotwings
items.description: Get ready for game day with this hot wing recipe!

items.title: Nachos
items.description: Byron Talbott shows you how to make loaded nachos.

items.title: Meatballs
items.description: Byron Talbott shows you how to make one of his all-time favorite party snacks!

items.title: The Disruptors
items.description: We dive deep into the lives and minds of visionary entrepreneurs, innovators and change-makers who are revolutionizing industries and shaping the future.

items.title: The Ways Men Divide
items.description: Murders of a family in their Philadelphia home 12 years ago led to the conviction of two construction workers. The sentence quelled rising racial tension and made a name for DA Adam Page. Now, Innocence Initiative caseworker Christine Rosa believes that one of the two convicts isn't guilty, and she struggles to stop his impending execution. Working to exonerate him, she clashes with Page, who would uphold the verdict and his reputation. Faced with the question of a man's innocence but motivated by their history -- their own divide -- they struggle within the justice system.

items.title: No Such Thing as Justice
items.description: With the execution date fast approaching, Christine and the Innocence Initiative staff scramble to prove a flaw in the case.

items.title: Facts Are the Enemy
items.description: Christine has trouble focusing on her studies for the bar exam due to her preoccupation with the Butler case; Adam attempts to resolve his doubts.

items.title: Never Forget
items.description: Terry has difficulty re-entering society after his release; Adam chases down loose ends; Christine's most important test of her life.

items.title: I'm for Justice
items.description: The Page family reacts to the tragedy that has befallen Jenny; Christine looks for help in places she never thought she would.

items.title: And the Little Ones Get Caught
items.description: Adam learns the truth behind the Butler DNA evidence and Terry investigates the case on his own.

items.title: I Can't Go Back
items.description: Terry searches for DNA evidence that will prove his innocence; Adam struggles with a decision that impacts his family and political future; Christine needs Terry's help.

items.title: To Whom Evil is Done
items.description: Christine and Terry get closer; Billie's plan to protect her family; Eric is trapped in a violent event.

items.title: The Divorce
items.description: Yolanda Massey throws herself a divorce party with her best friends to celebrate the occasion.

items.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas
items.description: A crafty canine (Mario López) jumps to the rescue when two bumbling thieves target his master's (Gary Valentine) home during the holidays.

items.title: The Dog Who Saved the Holidays
items.description: A spunky dog (Joey Lawrence) learns to love his mischievous new puppy sister, and they work together to stop two thieves from breaking into a house.

items.title: The Dolly Parton Story: From Rags to Rhinestones
items.description: From her humble beginnings in Tennessee, Dolly Parton has not only conquered the Country music scene, but made her mark on the entertainment industry.

items.title: The Double
items.description: When the assassination of a U.S. senator bears the signature style of a Russian spy known as Cassius, CIA director Tom Highland (Martin Sheen) calls top operative Paul Shepherdson (Richard Gere) out of retirement to investigate. Paul's partner on the case is Ben Geary (Topher Grace), a young agent who also has studied Cassius and is certain the Russian is behind the slaying, even though Paul insists that Cassius is long dead. But, Paul may not be who he claims to be.

items.title: The Double
items.description: An awkward office drone (Jesse Eisenberg) becomes increasingly unhinged after a charismatic and confident look-alike takes a job at his workplace and seduces the woman (Mia Wasikowska) he desires.

items.title: The Draft
items.description: Five typical college students spend their weekend in a typical old villa only to find that they have to survive in a battle of wits against an absolute all-mighty all-powerful terror that is seemingly undefeated.

items.title: The Drag Roast of Heklina
items.description: Raucous, no-holds-barred roast of one of San Francisco's favorite larger-than-life drag personalities, Heklina.

items.title: The Drag Roast of Sherry Vine
items.description: The rulers of NYC nightlife unite for the drag roast of Sherry Vine.

items.title: The Dragon Lives
items.description: Tracing Bruce Lee's life from college to his fascination with martial arts and development of Jeet Kune Do to his untimely death.

items.title: The Dragon Lives Again
items.description: Bruce Lee (Siu-Lung Leung) opens a gym in hell.

items.title: The Driller Killer
items.description: Enraged by rejection and a punk-rock band, an artist (Jimmy Laine) vents his anger on winos with a power drill.

items.title: The Drowning
items.description: Tom and Lauren thwart a watery suicide attempt. The drowning young man turns out to be Danny, who was accused of the murder of an old woman many years ago. Although Tom provided psychological testimony at the trial, he seizes the chance to help.

items.title: The Duke of Burgundy
items.description: Two entomologists (Sidse Babett Knudsen, Chiara D'Anna) play ritual games of dominance and subservience.

items.title: A Worthy Opponent
items.description: Stuntman Shahaub Roudbari, freestyle skateboarder Mike Osterman, professional dancer Kyndal Harris and MMA fighter Natalie Killface Morgan are featured.

items.title: The East
items.description: A soldier, deployed to suppress post-WWII rebellion in Indonesia, finds himself torn between duty and conscience when he joins an elite task force led by an increasingly ruthless commander.

items.title: The Echo
items.description: Strange events plague an ex-convict (Jesse Bradford) when he moves into the sinister apartment of his late mother.

items.title: Newfoundland Adventure
items.description: Exploring regional and ethnic influences around various locales in Canada.

items.title: The Pitchfork Fondue
items.description: Sampling Prairie cowboy hospitality at an old-fashioned barn dance in Saskatchewan; meeting Merv the Pitchfork Fondue King for a BBQ.

items.title: The Gimli Vikings
items.description: The heritage of Icelandic cuisine on the shores of Lake Winnipeg.

items.title: Alberta Beef
items.description: Carlo rides the range, herds cattle and partakes in a campfire cookout.

items.title: The Girls Who Dish
items.description: Carlo meets up with dynamic female chefs who are breaking all the rules in the male-dominated world of professional cuisine.

items.title: Sea Goo
items.description: Carlo searches for underwater delicacies, giant sea clams and sea asparagus.

items.title: The Endless
items.description: Two brothers receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier. Hoping to find the closure that they couldn't find as young men, they're forced to reconsider the cult's beliefs when confronted with unexplainable phenomena surrounding the camp. As the members prepare for the coming of a mysterious event, the brothers race to unravel the seemingly impossible truth before their lives become permanently entangled with the cult.

items.title: The Entity
items.description: A family is haunted by what appears to be the ghost of the youngest daughter.

items.title: The Evil
items.description: A psychologist (Richard Crenna) and his wife (Joanna Pettet) turn a house of the devil into a drug-rehabilitation center.

items.title: The Evil in Us
items.description: A woman fights for her life on a remote island when a mysterious drug turns her fiancé and four friends into bloodthirsty cannibals.

items.title: The Ex
items.description: A guy's past love haunts his present and puts a question mark on his future with his betrothed.

items.title: The Exterminator
items.description: A New York police detective (Christopher George) follows a vigilante's (Robert Ginty) gory trail of justice.

items.title: The Face of Love
items.description: A lonely widow (Annette Bening) begins a romance with an art teacher (Ed Harris) who looks just like her late husband but does not tell him of the resemblance.

items.title: The Family Holiday
items.description: To claim an inheritance, a con man (Dave Coulier) must prove he can settle down and raise a family.

items.title: The Fanatic
items.description: Moose is a rabid movie fan who's obsessed with his favorite celebrity action hero, Hunter Dunbar. When cheated out of his opportunity to meet Hunter, Moose gets help from a photographer who knows how to find celebrity homes. When Moose's actions begin to take a darker turn, Dunbar soon finds himself at the mercy of his increasingly dangerous stalker.

items.title: The Search for Lisa Renee
items.description: Behind the scenes of major case investigations.

items.title: Hidden Agenda
items.description: Experts examine a bomb left by robbers on a teller's counter.

items.title: Small Town Terror
items.description: Agents link the disappearance of two people with an elderly couple's murder.

items.title: Deadly Heist
items.description: The FBI searches for a missing armored van after a money shipment fails to arrive at its destination.

items.title: Vanished
items.description: An unusual ransom note gives authorities clues about a wealthy woman's disappearance.

items.title: Lost Boys
items.description: Two young men go on a spree of robbery, kidnapping and murder, then they disappear.

items.title: Deadly Threat
items.description: The agency aids Florida investigators in the conviction of a drug dealer.

items.title: Evil Intent
items.description: A young woman is snatched from her home on a bright spring morning.

items.title: The Coffee Shop Murders
items.description: A man kills three coffee-shop employees.

items.title: Without Remorse
items.description: A parole officer's shooting death sends police on a manhunt full of murders, robberies and carjackings.

items.title: Global Pursuit
items.description: Pakistan native fires an assault rifle at cars entering CIA headquarters in Virginia.

items.title: A Family Torn
items.description: When the body of a missing 11-year-old girl washes up on a sandbar, the police take a closer look at her uncle's conflicting stories.

items.title: The Female Brain
items.description: When a female scientist studies the differences between the male and female brain, her findings dictate how she lives her life.

items.title: The Final Comedown
items.description: Out of racism rises a young militant leader (Billy Dee Williams) who thinks the only answer is armed revolution.

items.title: The Finale
items.description: An elite theater camp is all fun and games until the killing begins.

items.title: Stripped
items.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel with the intention of restoring it and breaking the land-speed record. Following the events from restoration to record day.

items.title: Dyno Test
items.description: The record attempt is only one week away and everything seems to be on track, until the results of a dyno test put a spanner in the works.

items.title: Meet the Press
items.description: The official launch of The Flying Kestrel at legendary racetrack, Santa Pod; the Kestrel team is joined by Victor Riley of Riley Cars and celebrity Rachel Riley.

items.title: Return of the Riley
items.description: Can the team behind Kestrel Beer and one of the world's best drag racing engineers break multiple land speed records in a 1930s Kestrel Riley classic car?

items.title: The Fourth Victim
items.description: A wealthy Englishman finds his third wife dead. An investigation is launched after the police discover that his first two wives had also died suddenly.

items.title: The Frankenstein Theory
items.description: A professor leads a film crew to the Arctic Circle to prove that author Mary Shelley's tale of "Frankenstein" is true.

items.title: The Free World
items.description: Released from prison for a crime he didn't commit, a man (Boyd Holbrook) goes on the run with a woman (Elisabeth Moss) who's suspected of killing her abusive husband.

items.title: The Funeral
items.description: Cemal drives a hearse for a living. He's entrusted with secretly carrying the body of a young girl at the request of her family. One night, he hears strange groans from the back of the truck, even though the girl hasn't got a pulse.

items.title: The Game of Crowns: The Tudors
items.description: A look at the real life stories that inspired "Game of Thrones" by tracing the Tudor bloodline from Henry VII to Elizabeth I; the Tudor dynasty spans little over a century, but it is filled with big personalities and battles for power and influence.

items.title: The Game of Crowns: The Victorians
items.description: A world of dynasties, blood feuds and civil war.

items.title: The Gangster
items.description: A man is released from prison and wants to live an honest life, but knowing nothing else, he returns to his old gang.

items.title: The Gate
items.description: When Al and Glen's parents leave town for the weekend, Al uses the opportunity to throw a party while little brother Glen and his friend Terry decide to explore a hole left by a tree-removal service in the backyard. When unexplainable phenomena begin occurring, Terry, with the help of his extensive heavy-metal music collection, comes to the conclusion that he and Glen have accidentally opened a gateway to hell.

items.title: The General
items.description: One of the most revered comedies of the silent era, this film finds hapless Southern railroad engineer Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers, using various modes of transportation in comic action scenes that highlight Keaton's boundless wit and dexterity.

items.title: The Girl Can't Help It
items.description: Hefty hoodlum Marty Fats Murdock (Edmond O'Brien) employs has-been agent Tom Miller (Tom Ewell) to transform his girlfriend, Jerri Jordan (Jayne Mansfield), into a singing star because he trusts Tom not to make a pass at her. However, the more time Tom spends with the stunning blonde, the more smitten he becomes. His troubles multiply when he realizes that Jerri can't sing a note, is not in love with Murdock and wants to settle down with a nice man like himself.

items.title: The Girl From Monaco
items.description: Bertrand (Fabrice Luchini), a middle-aged lawyer, is sent to Monaco to defend an old woman (Stéphane Audran) who murdered a man with ties to the mob. Against his will, Bertrand is assigned a bodyguard named Christophe (Roschdy Zem). Their relationship becomes especially strained when Bertrand meets Audrey (Louise Bourgoin), a beautiful local weather girl and Christophe's ex-girlfriend. Audrey seduces Bertrand, occupying all his time and, according to Christophe, distracting him from the trial.

items.title: The Girl Hunters
items.description: Private eye Mike Hammer (Mickey Spillane) asks a bikinied blonde (Shirley Eaton) and others about his long-lost secretary, Velda.

items.title: The Girl Who Got Away
items.description: A female serial killer who killed four young girls is sent away to prison, but a fifth victim escaped with her life. Twenty years later, the killer escapes and begins hunting for the one who got away.

items.title: The Good Doctor
items.description: A young physician (Orlando Bloom) becomes dangerously obsessed with a teenage patient (Riley Keough) and falls into an illicit romance. Things quickly spin out of control when an orderly finds out and blackmails the doctor.

items.title: The Good Heart
items.description: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

items.title: The Grand Duel
items.description: A mysterious gunfighter (Lee Van Cleef) protects a man accused of killing an Arizona big shot.

items.title: The Grand Party Hotel
items.description: The secret life of one of the most popular hotels in Britain; the hotel is situated in the heart of Liverpool and people flock there from all over the UK to celebrate important moments.

items.title: The Grand Party Hotel
items.description: The hotel braces itself for another busy weekend of almost 700 guests; but it's just another day for owners Lawrence and Katie and their three-year-old twins, who live on-site in an apartment on the 4th floor.

items.title: The Grand Party Hotel
items.description: A late booking has come in for a wedding, but the hotel's wedding suite is already booked so Director Kris and his team set about converting a luxury room into the bridal suite of dreams.

items.title: The Grand Party Hotel
items.description: Giving each guest an unforgettable experience takes an army of staff to achieve, the hotel owners Lawrence and Katie explain that they expect all 250 staff to go the extra mile for their guests.

items.title: The Grasshopper
items.description: A British Columbia teenager (Jacqueline Bisset) dreams of show business but winds up as a call-girl in Las Vegas.

items.title: The Grave
items.description: The quest for buried treasure leads two escaped convicts (Craig Sheffer, Josh Charles) to old friends, an ex-flame (Gabrielle Anwar) and one's shooting.

items.title: The Gravedigger
items.description: When a lonely gravedigger discovers Frankenstein's monster hiding in the cemetery, he must decide whether to help the creature or turn him over to the murderous Dr. Victor Frankenstein.

items.title: The Great Buck Howard
items.description: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

items.title: The Great Wall of Japan
items.description: After the disaster of March 2011, the Japanese authorities decided to build an anti-tsunami wall.

items.title: Battle of the Burgers
items.description: Morgan Bolling is on a smoky mission: to empower everyone, everywhere with the tips, techniques, and recipes that make "fear of the grill" a thing of the past.

items.title: Nacho Average Barbecue
items.description: A six-foot nacho table loaded with North Carolina pulled pork, green chile queso and candied bacon s'mores.

items.title: Backyard Tailgate
items.description: Morgan's serving smoked chicken wings, charred guacamole, and pizza dip.

items.title: Greek-Inspired Girls Night
items.description: It's a Greek-inspired girls' night with chicken souvlaki, grilled carrots, and smoky eggplant dip.

items.title: I Do Barbecue
items.description: Morgan throws a steakhouse-themed engagement party with a smoky, grilled twist on the classics.

items.title: The Crown Jewel of Texas Barbecue
items.description: Morgan tackles the holy grail of Texas barbecue: brisket; pimento mac and cheese and pineapple margaritas.

items.title: A Tribute to the Tarheel State
items.description: Morgan treats her mom to a North Carolina-inspired feast featuring fish stew cooked over a live fire.

items.title: Friendsgiving Anytime
items.description: Morgan throws a Friendsgiving dinner with irreverent, grilled twists on the classic holiday menu.

items.title: The Grim Sleeper
items.description: Journalist Christine Pelisek helps law enforcement investigate the alleged serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper.

items.title: The Gunman From Bodie
items.description: The Rough Riders, led by Marshal Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), are on the trail of cattle rustlers when they discover a family of ranchers that has been murdered. A note Roberts finds identifies rustler Bill Cook (John Merton) as one of those responsible. To investigate, Roberts travels undercover, posing as wanted outlaw Bob "Brodie" Bronson. Marshal McCall (Tim McCoy) pretends he is chasing him, but they are actually in cahoots. The two lawmen hope the strategy will expose the real outlaws.

items.title: The Guy From Harlem
items.description: A streetwise private investigator relies on his instincts to succeed when the CIA hires him to guard a visiting African princess.

items.title: The Hallow
items.description: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

items.title: The Hand
items.description: Scotland Yard sets out to capture a mysterious killer who amputates the hands of his victims.

items.title: The Hands of Orlac
items.description: A pianist (Mel Ferrer) thinks surgery his fiancée (Lucile Saint-Simon) arranged has left him with the hands of an executed strangler.

items.title: The Haunting of Alice D
items.description: In the late 1890s, a prostitute kills herself in a brothel, and her spirit haunts it. The building is abandoned until it is restored as a mansion, but the new owners have no idea the ghost is still there as they plan a party.

items.title: The Haunting of Molly Hartley
items.description: After surviving a brutal attack by her insane mother, teenage Molly (Haley Bennett) is eager to get a fresh start at a new school. Attracting the attention of one of the school's most-popular students (Chace Crawford), she thinks she is finally fitting in and getting her life on track but, on the eve of her 18th birthday, Molly learns the horrifying truth about her devilish legacy.

items.title: The Haunting of Sharon Tate
items.description: Married to filmmaker Roman Polanski, actress Sharon Tate is a rising star who's about to have her first baby. Plagued by terrifying premonitions, Tate sees her worst nightmares come true when she encounters members of the Manson Family cult.

items.title: The Heart of Christmas
items.description: Megan (Candace Cameron Bure) re-examines her priorities after she sees people decorating for Christmas in October to help a family celebrate Christmas with their dying son.

items.title: The Heart Stays
items.description: A Native American teen must choose between her own personal goals or the traditional responsibilities of the old ways.

items.title: The Hellbenders
items.description: The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.

items.title: The Hero of Color City
items.description: Crayons team up to save the day when an unfinished drawing tries to steal all the world's color.

items.title: The Hideous Sun Demon
items.description: Sunlight transforms a contaminated scientist into a man-eating lizard in this campy sci-fi classic from the '50s.

items.title: The Highest of Stakes
items.description: The real story of the most controversial figure in crypto and the fastest appreciating asset: Richard Heart and the Hex Token.

items.title: The Hive
items.description: A couple returns home from a night out to find two sadistic strangers waiting to terrorize them.

items.title: The Homesman
items.description: A frontier farm woman (Hilary Swank) saves the life of a claim-jumper (Tommy Lee Jones) and persuades him to help her escort three insane women to a safe haven in Iowa.

items.title: The Hook of Woodland Heights
items.description: An escaped mental patient replaces his missing hand with a barbecue fork.

items.title: The House by the Cemetery
items.description: Soon after moving his family into a New England house with a dark history, a doctor begins receiving warnings from a mysterious girl to get out.

items.title: The House Of The Serpent
items.description: An actress penning a play inspired by the story of a woman vanishing into thin air becomes disturbed by unexplained phenomena at her rental villa.

items.title: The House on Cuckoo Lane
items.description: A film geek is driven by horrific nightmares to seek out a copy of a notorious, supposedly real snuff film. When his obsession leads him to an abandoned house in the woods where the video was actually shot, he is haunted by masked demons.

items.title: The Houses October Built
items.description: Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

items.title: The Houses October Built 2
items.description: Still recovering from the trauma of being kidnapped on the previous Halloween by the Blue Skeleton - a group that takes extreme haunt to another level - five friends decide they must face their fears to move on. Heading back out on the road to visit more haunted house attractions, new terror begins when signs of the Blue Skeleton start appearing again.

items.title: The Howling: New Moon Rising
items.description: The peace of a desert town is shattered by gruesome murders that appear to be the work of a werewolf.

items.title: The Hunt
items.description: While making an instructional video, hunters become the prey after they trespass on government land.

items.title: The Hunter
items.description: A shadowy corporation sends a mercenary (Willem Dafoe) to Tasmania to track down a nearly extinct tiger whose genetic code holds the secret to a dangerous weapon.

items.title: The Hurricane Express
items.description: A young pilot pursues the mysterious saboteur responsible for the train crash which killed his father.

items.title: The Identical
items.description: During the Great Depression, identical twins are separated at birth. One, Drexel Hemsley (Blake Rayne) becomes a wildly successful '50s rock star, while the other, Ryan Wade (also Rayne), struggles to balance his passion for music and pleasing his parents, who want him to become a preacher. Finally, Ryan rebels against his parents' wishes and launches his own music career -- performing the hits of Drexel Hemsley. Ryan later learns the truth about Drexel when their fates tragically collide.

items.title: The Innkeepers
items.description: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.

items.title: The Boy
items.description: A group of psychic children unites to take on the shadowy organization that has kidnapped them and claims to be using their power to "save the world."

items.title: Shots for Dots
items.description: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents and begins plotting his escape; Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach; in town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

items.title: Graduation
items.description: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty; Tim loses a friend.

items.title: The Box
items.description: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

items.title: Back Half
items.description: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

items.title: Run
items.description: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

items.title: Hide
items.description: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

items.title: Fight
items.description: The characters come together for a final confrontation with unimaginable consequences.

items.title: The Interdimensional Connection
items.description: With more military data and whistleblower accounts being released, it's becoming harder to discount the UFO phenomena. For many ufologists posing the question of origination, the answer lies outside the limits of our senses.

items.title: The Invisible Ghost
items.description: Dr. Charles Kessler (Bela Lugosi), a well-to-do physician who shares his mansion with his daughter, Virginia (Polly Ann Young), has been depressed ever since his wife (Betty Compson) left him for another man, only to later die in a car accident. That's not all Kessler has to worry about, however. Unexplained murders have begun to occur around town, eventually claiming members of his house staff. Making matters worse, the authorities suspect Kessler may somehow be involved.

items.title: All Different
items.description: A deadly virus infects a small community living on the island of Sløborn, between Denmark and Germany, in the North Sea.

items.title: Yellow Man
items.description: As the comforts of civilization diminish, the battle for resources begins; on Freja's farm, tempers begin to collide.

items.title: Out There
items.description: The situation on the deserted island slowly escalates; the mystery of the yellow man is solved, but a new threat comes to those who stayed behind.

items.title: Slow Burn
items.description: Social worker Freja is having increasing trouble keeping her group of juvenile delinquents under control; the argument with Devid intensifies.

items.title: No Dreams
items.description: Evelin and her small purpose group want to leave the island as soon as possible, and they plan to capture the ship of pirates who come to pillage once a week.

items.title: Leaving Here
items.description: The escape plan of Evelin and her group is in jeopardy, as new challenges arise that threaten their plan to reach the mainland.

items.title: The Jade Pendant

items.title: The Janky Promoters

items.title: The Jeffrey Dahmer Files
items.description: Filmmaker Chris James Thompson uses archival footage and fictionalized scenarios to tell the story of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer as seen by a detective, the lead pathologist and Dahmer's neighbor.

items.title: The Joe Louis Story
items.description: As a teenager, African-American Joe Louis (Coley Wallace) gives up on the violin to try his hand at boxing. A few years later, he's the 1934 Golden Gloves champion. He goes pro, trains with Chappie Blackburn (James Edwards), and enjoys an unprecedented string of victories. But Louis faces more than just tough opponents in the ring. Prejudice follows him throughout his career, and his bouts with Germany's Max Schmeling are fraught with racial tension on an international level.

items.description: Four inner-city teens face the wrath of a Cleveland crime boss after stealing a car that's stashed with drugs.

items.title: Jimi Hendrix
items.description: A look at the final hours of some of the world's most famous people.

items.title: The Last 24 Hours: Amy Winehouse
items.description: Amy Winehouse was a singer-songwriter with a unique style and voice; an investigation into what really happened during the final 24 hours of the singer's life.

items.title: The Last 24 Hours: Michael Jackson
items.description: Michael Jackson, the "King of Pop," spends his last hours battling insomnia and pleading with his personal physician.

items.title: The Last Beyond
items.description: A man embarks on a spiritual journey when the bank forecloses on his family's ranch in Depression-era Montana.

items.title: The Last Circus
items.description: A twisted love triangle develops among a Spanish clown (Carlos Areces), his cruel rival (Antonio de la Torre) and the rival's abused -- but lustful -- wife (Carolina Bang).

items.title: The Last Days on Mars
items.description: Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.

items.title: The Last King
items.description: Two warriors (Jakob Oftebro, Kristofer Hivju) must protect the last remaining heir to the throne as civil war ravages 13th-century Norway.

items.title: The Last Lion of Liuwa
items.description: The last remaining lioness on the plain is the sole survivor of a massacre that took the rest of the pride.

items.title: The Last Race
items.description: A small-town stock car track and the drivers that call it home struggle to hold on to an American racing tradition.

items.title: The Last Thanksgiving
items.description: A family of cannibalistic Pilgrims attacks the staff and patrons at a restaurant that stays open for Thanksgiving rather than close in celebration of the holiday.

items.title: The Last Unicorn
items.description: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

items.title: The Last Will and Testament of Rosalind Leigh
items.description: An antiques collector inherits his mother's house and discovers that her involvement with a mysterious cult of angel-worshipers may have led to her death.

items.title: The Lawless Frontier
items.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

items.title: The Lawless Frontier
items.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

items.title: The League
items.description: The dynamic journey of Negro League baseball's triumphs and challenges is told through previously unearthed archival footage and interviews with legendary players.

items.title: The Legendary Barry White
items.description: Backed by The Love Unlimited Orchestra, Barry White performs his soul hits in a concert recorded in Belgium.

items.title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
items.description: An adventurer (Noah Wyle) and a brilliant archaeologist (Gabrielle Anwar) use a map to search for the fabled mines of King Solomon.

items.title: And the Apple of Discord
items.description: When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure.

items.title: And the Fables of Doom
items.description: The Librarians travel to a town where fairy tales are coming to life and attacking!

items.title: And the Rule of Three
items.description: The librarians are forced to intercede when a group of competitive high school students start undercutting each other with witchcraft.

items.title: The Librarians and the Heart of Darkness
items.description: The librarians encounter the house behind the legend of all haunted houses and set out to destroy it.

items.title: And the City of Light
items.description: An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town.

items.title: And the Loom of Fate
items.description: When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians.

items.title: And the Drowned Book
items.description: Cued by the popular "The Librarian" trilogy, this series introduces new members of an ancient group protecting mystical artifacts. Hidden below the Metropolitan Public Library, the secret society's longtime leader is Flynn Carsen, whose job has become very complicated. To help, the Library recruits Eve, a counterterrorism agent responsible for organizational security; Jacob, who has encyclopedic knowledge of art, architecture and history; Cassandra, who links auditory/sensory hallucinations to memory; and Ezekiel, a skilled thief and master technician. Overseeing them is Jenkins, the reclusive caretaker of the Library's sleepy little annex in Oregon. Noah Wyle executive produces and recurs as Flynn, the role he played in the movie series.

items.title: And the Broken Staff
items.description: Prospero summons other fictionals in order to retrieve parts of his staff; the librarians find themselves pitted against Frankenstein's monster and Sherlock Holmes' nemesis Moriarty; Flynn and Baird have a disagreement.

items.title: And What Lies Beneath the Stones
items.description: Stone, Cassandra and Ezekiel team up to investigate a cave-in at an oil rig site which has unleashed a shape-shifting god who grows in strength when lies are told.

items.title: And the Cost of Education
items.description: When students begin disappearing at Wexler College, the librarians head out to investigate; Cassandra gets an offer that is difficult to turn down.

items.title: And the Hollow Men
items.description: Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with both amnesia and a collection of the library's missing artifacts; the group pursues the Staff of Zarathustra.

items.title: And the Infernal Contract
items.description: Baird's old friend finds himself embroiled in a scandal in the form of a missing intern and a contract with the devil; Baird must battle for the souls of all the librarians.

items.title: And the Image of Image
items.description: When people begin suffering the effects of accidents and sins in which they have not been involved, the team tracks the connection to Dorian Gray.

items.title: And the Point of Salvation
items.description: The team is sent to a high-tech research facility where the researchers have been turned into mindless monsters by a bizarre power source in the center's lab.

items.title: And the Happily Ever Afters
items.description: The team scatters and each person begins living the ideal version of their life; the appearance of Ariel brings everyone together to investigate.

items.title: And the Final Curtain
items.description: The librarians discover that Prospero's magic is wreaking havoc with the technology of the world; Flynn and Baird must travel back to 1611, while the rest of the team battles Prospero in the present.

items.title: And the Ghost Train
items.description: A Librarian -- a custodian of a magical repository of the world's most powerful and dangerous supernatural artifacts -- from the past travels to the present and finds himself unable to return to his own time. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. In order to set things right, he is given a new team of Librarians to help him clean up the mess he made.

items.title: And the Thief of Love
items.description: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake; when they learn that a magical love artifact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend, Cupid himself.

items.title: And the Memory Crystal
items.description: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

items.title: And the House of Cards
items.description: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

items.title: And the Con-Con
items.description: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

items.title: And the Hangover From Hell
items.description: After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

items.title: And the Feast of the Vampire
items.description: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

items.title: And Going Medieval
items.description: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847, via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

items.title: And the Graffiti of the Gods
items.description: Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

items.title: And the Unfinished Business
items.description: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

items.title: Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It
items.description: The surprising impact of less-celebrated inventions and the moments of inspiration that made them possible.

items.title: Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World
items.description: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue; Mauve takes over the fashion industry, make food look more appetizing, and enable stunning advances in medicine.

items.title: 2026-27: Matchday 10
