With few leads and increasing public pressure, Scotland Yard assigns the case to Inspector Kildare, a seasoned detective who has a sneaking suspicion that he's being set up to fail. Faced with a long list of suspects, Kildare must rely on help from a witness to stop the murders and bring the maniac to justice.

items.title: A Daughter's Dream; The Last Sister
items.description: Siblings Wendy and Christopher enlist Troy's help to find their mother; Nycole searches for her youngest sister after learning of their mother's car accident.

items.title: The Dad Who Didn't Know...

items.description: Nicole hopes to find her father's firstborn son.

items.title: A Dying Wish
items.description: Warren attempts to find his friend's daughter, Sara.

items.description: Troy helps Cindy reunite with the child she gave up for adoption.

items.title: A Father's Amends; A Daughter's Last Hope
items.description: A father tries to reconnect with a daughter he hasn't seen in 15 years; Cindy, a terminally ill woman, searches for the father she's never known.

items.description: A foster child helps her foster mother find her biological daughter.

items.title: My Two Dads
items.description: After her father's suicide, Elaine searches for his best friend for answers.

items.title: A Daughters' Gift
items.description: Two daughters search for the brother their mother gave up for adoption.

items.title: Separated But Not Forgotten
items.description: Timothy searches for his twin sister.

items.title: A Daughter's Last Hope
items.description: Leticia hopes to reunite with her father, Gilbert.

items.title: A Soldier's Fight For Truth
items.description: After tragically fathering a stillborn child, Aaron was inspired to track down his own biological father who walked out of his life 24 years ago.

items.title: Desperate Mothers
items.description: Jennifer was abandoned with an abusive father and is now searching for her mother; Shelley tries connecting with her biological mother.

items.title: Quest for Redemption
items.description: Mother, Snjez, is getting a second chance to reach out to her daughters while fighting drug addiction and poverty.

items.title: A Father's Daughter
items.description: After her father passes away from kidney cancer, Erin searches for the half sister she had never met.

items.title: A Daughter's Disappearance
items.description: Carina fights to find out the truth about her mother now that she is a mother herself.

items.title: A Son's Promise
items.description: Steve fulfills his promise to his mother after she passed away to find his older sister he had never met.

items.title: Childhood Pursuit
items.description: Kelly tries to reunite with her birth mother after her adoptive mother passed away when helping her with the search.

items.title: Big Sister's Homecoming
items.description: Bridget searches for her half-sister Sara to find out more about her father's family.

items.title: Bittersweet Reunion
items.description: As an adopted child, Kim learns she has an older brother and reaches out to her birth family in Troy.

items.title: The Loch Ness Monster
items.description: In the area of cryptozoology, few creatures capture the imagination like the Loch Ness Monster. Several disputed photos and sonar examinations offer evidence of its presence.

items.title: Enter, the Lone Ranger

items.description: Schemers want to take over a young Easterner's inherited property.

items.title: Rustler's Hideout
items.description: Outlaws demand their leader's release in return for a boy's life.

items.title: War Horse
items.description: Madrigo captures Chief Lame Bear's horse and his son.

items.title: Pete and Pedro
items.description: A ruthless man plans to gain control over a young woman's property.

items.title: The Tenderfeet
items.description: Two greenhorns from the East are blamed for murder and claim jumping.

items.title: High Heels
items.description: The Lone Ranger teaches an important lesson to a man who's sensitive about his short stature.

items.title: Six-Gun's Legacy
items.description: Tonto and the Lone Ranger reveal an imposter's true identity.

items.title: Return of the Convict

items.title: Finders Keepers

items.title: The Masked Rider
items.description: A disguised outlaw, calling himself the Lone Ranger, commits murder.

items.description: A stagecoach driver seeks the Lone Ranger's help when her assistant is framed for a robbery.

items.title: The Man Who Came Back
items.description: Tonto and the Lone Ranger are puzzled by an old friend's disappearance.

items.title: A Message From Abe
items.description: A reformed outlaw becomes concerned when financial problems prevent him from adequately caring for his sick wife.

items.title: The Long Hair of Death
items.description: In a 15th century feudal village, a lord murders a woman and her eldest daughter; years later, the daughter reappears during a thunderstorm to avenge her murder.

items.title: The Long Island Serial Killer: A Mother's Hunt for Justice
items.description: When her daughter goes missing, Mari Gilbert's relentless pursuit of justice leads investigators to discover the bodies of numerous women on Long Island, N.Y.

items.title: The Long, Hot Summer
items.description: Handsome vagabond Ben Quick (Paul Newman) returns to the Mississippi town his late father called home, but rumors of his dad's pyromaniac tendencies follow him as soon as he sets foot there. The proud young man's determination eventually wins over civic leader Will Varner (Orson Welles), who decides Ben might be just the man for his daughter, Clara (Joanne Woodward) -- much to the displeasure of Will's gutless son (Anthony Franciosa) and Clara's society boyfriend (Richard Anderson).

items.title: The Lost City
items.description: Fico Fellove (Andy Garcia), an apolitical Havana club owner, gets caught in the middle when Fidel Castro's Communist Revolution sweeps through Cuba. He tries to keep the strife outside the walls of his popular establishment, but his family becomes divided when his brothers (Nestor Carbonell, Enrique Murciano) join the fight against Batista.

items.title: The Lost Legion
items.description: After the fall of the Roman Empire, a woman plots to make her son the new emperor, and nothing will stand in her way.

items.title: The Lost Wife of Robert Durst
items.description: Young and wide-eyed Kathie falls in love with charming, yet quirky real estate scion Robert Durst, only to find their marriage turning stranger, darker and more disturbing as time passes.

items.title: The Love Witch
items.description: Elaine (Samantha Robinson), a beautiful young witch, is determined to find a man to love her. In her gothic Victorian apartment she makes spells and potions, then picks up men and seduces them. However, her spells work too well, and she ends up with a string of hapless victims. When she at last meets the man of her dreams, her desperation to be loved drives her to the brink of insanity and murder.

items.title: The Lovers and the Despot
items.description: After their glamorous romance ends, a famous director and actress are kidnapped by movie-obsessed dictator Kim Jong-il. Forced to play along with a bizarre filmmaking project, they get a second chance at love but only one chance at escape.

items.title: The Lucky Texan
items.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

items.title: The Lucky Texan
items.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. items.description: Lucy works to attend a barbershop-quartet competition.

items.description: Lucy pretends to be a sailor to track down and get Mr Mooney's signature on some important papers but finds herself stuck aboard a submarine with him.

items.title: Lucy Goes to London
items.description: An ill-fated trip puts Lucy on a plane with Mr. Mooney.

items.title: Lucy Gets a Roommate
items.description: Lucy takes in a librarian for a roommate in an attempt to save money.

items.title: Lucy and Carol in Palm Springs
items.description: Lucy feigns illness for time off to go to Palm Springs.

items.title: Lucy Gets Caught in the Draft
items.description: Lucy is drafted into the Marines.

items.title: Lucy and John Wayne
items.description: When Mr Mooney instructs Lucy to deliver some papers regarding the financing of John Wayne's latest movie, she ignores him and finds herself having lunch with Wayne instead.

items.title: Lucy and Pat Collins
items.description: Lucy and Mr. Mooney serve as volunteers in a hypnotist's nightclub act.

items.title: Lucy and Mooney the Monkey
items.description: Lucy goes to a psychiatrist after seeing a monkey everywhere she goes.

items.title: Lucy and Phil Silvers
items.description: An efficiency expert launches a one-man assault on Mr. Mooney's bank.

items.title: Lucy's Substitute Secretary
items.description: Lucy discovers that her temporary replacement is bent on stealing her job.

items.title: Viv Visits Lucy
items.description: Lucy and visiting Viv search for a supposed derelict.

items.title: Lucy the Baby Sitter
items.description: Lucy is hired as a babysitter for three chimpanzees.

items.title: Main Street U.S.A.
items.description: Lucy goes to the aid of a small town in a war against freeways.

items.title: Lucy Meets the Law
items.description: Lucy is arrested when she is mistaken for a red-headed jewel thief.

items.title: Lucy, the Fight Manager
items.description: An ex-pug trains under Lucy's guidance in an attempt to make a comeback.

items.title: Lucy and Tennessee Ernie Ford
items.description: Lucy tries for the business of a millionaire country-music star.

items.title: Lucy Meets Sheldon Leonard
items.description: Sheldon Leonard attempts to film a scene for a TV pilot in the bank.

items.title: Lucy Meets the Berles
items.description: Lucy thinks Milton Berle is cheating on his wife.

items.title: Lucy Gets Trapped
items.description: Lucy feigns illness to have the day off to attend a department store sale.

items.title: Lucy and the French Movie Star
items.description: Lucy is enchanted when Jacques Bergerac arrives at the bank to cash some checks.

items.title: Lucy, the Starmaker
items.description: Lucy tricks a well-known producer into coming to the bank to listen to an employee sing.

items.description: Lucy designs a vault in an attempt to get Jack Benny's account.

items.title: Little Old Lucy

items.title: Lucy and Robert Goulet
items.description: Lucy tries to enter a truck driver in a Robert Goulet "look-alike" contest.

items.title: Aloha L.A.
items.description: Grammy winner Bruno Mars has taken the music industry by storm in recent years, and now his sisters -- Jaime, Tiara, Tahiti and Presley -- are looking to do the same. The ladies, collectively known as the Lylas, move from the sandy beaches of their native Hawaii to chase their dream of music stardom in the midst of the glitz and glamour of Los Angeles. But the road to the top is full of personal and professional obstacles, including the stresses of living and working together for the first time in years. The sisters' strong personalities mixed with the pressure of wanting to succeed test their ability to work together. Also complicating matters is the Lylas' early realization that they don't see eye to eye with their management team.

items.title: Bust Out or Bomb
items.description: The Lylas argue with their manager; Tahiti, Tiara and Presley settle into Jaime's house.

items.title: Life's a Pitch

items.title: Mall and Chain
items.description: Nerves run high during the first live show in Hawaii. The jitters don't stop as they land a second gig in Los Angeles, only two days later. The girls have had enough when Ben and his ego cross the line.

items.title: The Phone Call
items.description: The Lylas take their career into their own hands; Tahiti must decide what's best for her kids; the Lylas' mom visits her daughters in LA.

items.title: Headed Home
items.description: Grieving over the sudden loss of their mother, The Lylas are unable to sing and struggle to keep their band intact. They decide to do something their mom was against, in her honor.

items.title: Voices in My Head
items.description: The Lylas go into the studio with a new song; a former Pussycat Doll teaches the Lylas choreography.

items.title: The Game Changer
items.description: The Lylas hope their new music meets Bruno's standards.

items.title: The Pelagics: Eat and Swim

items.title: The Magic of Belle Isle

items.title: The Education of Lucky Luciano
items.description: Emmy-winning actor Ray Liotta -- who starred as real-life gangster Henry Hill in Martin Scorsese's "GoodFellas" -- narrates an eight-part docudrama that traces the rise of organized crime in America. The series blends dramatic scenes, archival footage and visual effects to show how notorious wiseguys like Charles "Lucky" Luciano and Benjamin "Bugsy" Siegel transformed from neighborhood gang members in the early 1900s to murderous entrepreneurs and bootleggers. Included are exclusive interviews with former New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, Meyer Lansky II, Chazz Palminteri, Drea de Matteo, Joe Mantegna, Frankie Valli, Mob attorney and former Las Vegas mayor Oscar Goodman, noted author and historian David Pietrusza, and many others.

items.title: Equal Opportunity Gangster

items.title: King of New York
items.description: "Lucky" Luciano takes over the mob, organizing the Five Families, but as his power increases, so does interest from the Feds.

items.title: A Rising Threat

items.title: Exit Strategy
items.description: "Lucky" Luciano is found guilty of running a prostitution ring, and is imprisoned; Vito Genovese becomes acting boss.

items.description: Sharon sends Ozzy, Kelly and Jack off on a tour of stars' homes so that she can have the house to herself; she discusses the enormous (and immediate) impact that the show has had on their lives, and the unexpected fame that has resulted.

items.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills
items.description: "The Osbournes" follows the day-to-day lives of Black Sabbath rocker Ozzy Osbourne, manager-wife Sharon and two of their children - volatile Jack and pink-tressed Kelly. During the show's run, the family "adopted" Rob, a friend of Jack and Kelly's. Needless to say, the Osbournes aren't your average family.

items.title: The Other Woman

items.title: We Only Kill to Survive
items.description: Talon is a survivor. The last of the Blackblood race, she also endured the destruction of her entire village by a gang of brutal missionaries. Years after that life-defining attack, she travels to a lawless fortress along the edge of the civilized world, tracking the individuals who killed her family. As she makes the journey, she discovers that she possesses a mysterious supernatural power that she must now learn to control, not only to save herself but to defend the world against the tyranny of a fanatical religious dictator.

items.title: This Is One Strange Town
items.description: Talon tries to outmaneuver her new rival while Gwynn struggles to maintain control of the outpost; a baron named Tobin marches in and makes an outrageous proposal; The Mistress bitterly reunites with a close relative.

items.title: The Outsider
items.description: A military contractor (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles to identify his daughter's body. When he discovers that it's not her, he begins an investigation to track her down.

items.title: The Outsider
items.description: A railroad worker unwittingly finds himself on the wrong side of a group of corrupt lawmen in the Old West. When tragedy forces him to seek justice, he soon sets out on a bloody quest for revenge to wipe out his ruthless enemies.

items.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang
items.description: Looking to reform the corrupt government of his Old West town, newspaperman Jeff Rose is running for mayor against officeholder Nard Lundy (Edward Andrews). Jeff's campaign lacks the incumbent's muscle and money, and his quest looks hopeless until the arrival of his father-in-law, Capt. Oren Hayes (Pat O'Brien). Joined by three fellow former Texas lawmen (Walter Brennan, Edgar Buchanan, Chill Wills), Oren and his daughter, Hannah, help Jeff fight back against his antagonist's dirty tactics.

items.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang Rides Again
items.description: Four retired Texas Rangers -- Nash Crawford (Walter Brennan), Jason Fitch (Edgar Buchanan), Amos Polk (Andy Devine), and Gentleman George Agnew (Chill Wills) -- leap to the aid of their old chum the Baltimore Kid (Fred Astaire). The Kid has become a hopeless drunk, and they aim to clean him up and install him as marshal of Waco, Texas. But in order to complete the job, the geriatric quartet will have to help the Kid defeat the outlaw gang that wants him dead.

items.title: The Pack
items.description: A farmer and his family have to fight for survival when a pack of wild dogs break into their home.

items.title: The Painted Desert
items.description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

items.title: The Painted Hills
items.description: A determined prospector, Jonathan Harvey (Paul Kelly) finds gold after years of searching. When he returns to town to tell his partner, Jonathan finds that his friend has died, leaving his son, Tommy (Gary Gray), on his own. While Jonathan's loyal collie, Lassie, stays with the boy, he goes to find help to assist him with his lucrative discovery. However, the new recruit (Bruce Cowling) proves to be a shady character, and before long the ruthless schemer has incurred the wrath of Lassie.

items.title: The Pearl
items.description: Closeted transgender women attend a conference that allows them to express their true identities.

items.title: The Pentagon UFO Files
items.description: After years of silence and secrecy, the U.S. government reveals possible evidence of extraterrestrial life, with analysis from scientific and military experts.

items.title: The People's Court
items.description: A judge hears small-claims cases in this series that served as a template for several similar courtroom series. The litigants in the case agree to drop their lawsuits and have the case heard on the show. Since the show is not a real courtroom, the decision is simply binding arbitration the litigants agree to abide by.

items.description: A crook on the run cons his way into a dinner party whose host is anything but ordinary.

items.title: The Phantom of the Opera
items.description: Aspiring young opera singer Christine Daaé discovers that she has a mysterious admirer intent on helping her become a lead performer. This masked presence is Erik, also known as the Phantom, a horribly disfigured recluse who lives underneath the Paris Opera House. When the Phantom takes Christine prisoner and demands her devotion and affection, her suitor, Vicomte Raoul de Chagny, sets out to rescue her.

items.title: Dynamite
items.description: A 15-episode serial in which Buck Grant, the Phantom Rider, helps rancher Mary Grayson fight off a band of outlaws out to seize her property.

items.title: The Maddened Herd
items.description: Buck escapes death by rolling under a water trough a split second before the dynamite explosion; Spooky tells Buck a crooked deal is planned.

items.title: The Brink Of Disaster
items.description: Bucks seems trapped in the burning jail; he whistles for Silver, who wrenches the bars loose and Buck escapes.

items.title: The Phantom Rides
items.description: Buck comes to the surface of the lake and swims ashore with Mary; Silver meets his master, and they start for the ranch chased by outlaws.

items.title: Trapped By Outlaws
items.description: Buck and Silver land on a jutting shelf of rock below the top of the precipice; Buck gives the wallet, which he took from the safe, to Judge Holmes.

items.title: The Outlaws Vengeance
items.description: Buck sees Roscoe in the nick of time; Roscoe is jailed; cowboys drive off his henchmen; Mary is thrown from her horse.

items.title: The Phantom Warrior
items.description: From young feral orphan to deadly crusader, masked vigilante Nemesis Knight balances the equilibrium between good and evil.

items.title: The Phenom
items.description: A sports therapist (Paul Giamatti) tries to help a troubled rookie pitcher (Johnny Simmons) who grew up with an abusive father (Ethan Hawke).

items.title: The Pig Farm
items.description: Filmmaker Christine Nielsen delves into the life and murders of Canadian serial killer Robert Pickton.

items.title: Subway: McKinney & WDCW
items.description: From the same production company that helmed "Undercover Boss" and "Project Runway," and on the same network that houses the ultrapopular 1960s Madison Avenue ad drama "Mad Men," "The Pitch" documents what modern advertising firms go through in their attempts to secure new clients. Each episode follows two agencies as they manage high-level stakes and killer deadlines while preparing campaigns for actual brands, and then the agencies go head-to-head with presentations known in the advertising industry as "the pitch."

items.title: Waste Management: SK/G & The AD Store
items.description: Advertising firms try to win the business of Waste Management.

items.title: Clockwork: The Hive & FKM
items.description: Two advertising agencies match wits to find the first tri-branded campaign.

items.title: Popchips: Conversation & BooneOakley
items.description: A new agency goes head-to-head with a team of industry veterans to win the business of the snack brand Popchips.

items.title: Frangelico: The Ad Store & Kovel/Fuller
items.description: The Ad Store and Kovel/Fuller Agency compete for the Frangelico liqueur brand in hopes of generating big business.

items.title: JDRF: Muse & Bozell
items.description: A Los Angeles agency and an agency from the Midwest compete for the JDRF account.

items.title: C. Wonder: WomenKind & DIGO
items.description: New York agencies compete for the business of an emerging women's fashion brand.

items.title: Autograph Collection, Marriott International: Jones Advertising & Bandujo
items.description: Up-and-coming agencies want to become Autograph Collection's agency of record.

items.title: College Hunks Hauling Junk
items.description: Rapidly-expanding College Hunks Hauling Junk become a household name.

items.title: Bliss
items.description: Spa-inspired skincare company wants to launch its latest product.

items.title: SquareTrade
items.description: A protection plan company wants to raise its profile.

items.title: Tommy Bahama
items.description: California advertising agencies compete for the business of lifestyle brand Tommy Bahama.

items.title: Little Caesars Pizza
items.description: Chicago ad agencies compete for Little Caesars Pizza's business.

items.title: Gibson Brands
items.description: Nashville agencies compete for the business of Gibson Brands.

items.title: 1-800-FLOWERS.com
items.description: Los Angeles advertising agencies want to work with 1-800-FLOWERS.com.

items.title: The Fuller Brush Company
items.description: Chicago ad agencies compete to reboot the brand of The Fuller Brush Company.

items.title: The Possession
items.description: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

items.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
items.description: Nick Smith (Cecil Kellaway), a middle-aged roadside diner owner, hires a drifter, Frank Chambers (John Garfield), to work at his restaurant. Frank quickly begins an affair with Nick's beautiful young wife, Cora (Lana Turner), and the two conspire to kill Nick and seize his assets. When they succeed, local prosecutor Kyle Sackett (Leon Ames) becomes suspicious, but is unable to build a solid case. However, the couple soon realizes that no misdeed ever goes truly unpunished.

items.title: The Pregnancy Pact
items.description: A woman (Thora Birch) returns to her hometown to investigate the sudden increase in teenage pregnancies.

items.title: The Preppie Connection
items.description: A drug-dealing student (Thomas Mann) at a prep school travels to Colombia to try and smuggle cocaine back into the United States.

items.title: The Presidents: Trump
items.description: Taking a look at the leader who blurred the lines between entertainment and politics.

items.title: The Princess of Nebraska
items.description: A young Chinese-American (Li Ling), who attends college in Omaha, travels to San Francisco to have an abortion.

items.title: The Protector 2
items.description: Martial artist Kham must rescue his beloved elephant from poachers and thwart a plot to start a war.

items.title: The Prowler
items.description: A crazed World War II veteran gets revenge on his ex-girlfriend and her boyfriend, then stalks teens 35 years later.

items.title: The Puppet Monster Massacre
items.description: A group of teens spends the night in the Wagner mansion and meets a monster with a huge appetite.

items.title: The Queen of Ireland
items.description: The life of Irish drag queen Panti Bliss.

items.title: The Rainbow Bridge Motel
items.description: After reserving their dream wedding package at Niagara Falls, Dean and Darren learn they've booked themselves in a run-down motor lodge sandwiched between two chemical plants run by some guy named Shibbawitz and a Burmese refugee family.

items.title: The Ramen Girl
items.description: Abandoned by her boyfriend in Tokyo, a woman (Brittany Murphy) learns how to become a ramen chef.

items.title: The Ranger
items.description: A group of Punk-styled friends, fueled by a hallucinogenic drug called Echo, runs afoul of the law and an unhinged park ranger.

items.title: The Raven
items.description: A haunting-gothic noir adaptation of Edgar Allan Poe's famed poems "The Raven" and "Annabel Lee." In a 1940s dark and eerie setting, the story delves into Guy's descent into madness mere hours after the burial of his loved one, as he is tormented by supernatural encounters and memories of his lost love.

items.title: The Ravine
items.description: Inspired by a true story. An unthinkable tragedy rocks a tight-knit community, leaving survivors to navigate the darkness in search of understanding and solace.

items.title: Roman Crane
items.description: Over more than 500 years, tens of millions of patents for products have been issued, but some are lost to history, and most don't achieve the success of, say, the telephone. Hosts Matt Hunter and Jeremy MacPherson dig up some of those of yore to see how the ideas would fare in the modern world. The guys work with a team to examine original blueprints, build prototypes and test the inventions to see how well they work. Some that the hosts want to tackle are a submarine from the late 1500s, a 14th-century machine using wind power to propel a wagon, and a 1950s design combining a Ford Thunderbird with airplane parts to make a flying car.

items.title: Four Armed Catapult
items.description: Designs were made for a four-armed catapult that shoots four projectiles.

items.title: Human Propulsion
items.description: Matt and Jeremy combine machines with muscle and add some rockets, propellers, and jets into the mix.

items.title: Bulletproof Protection
items.description: Two designs from WWI in an attempt to aid a soldier from dangerous weapons.

items.title: Invention War
items.description: Matt and Jeremy modify a number of their previous inventions and pit them against one another in a bizarre battle scenario.

items.title: Snow Annihilator
items.description: The inventor of the Snow Annihilator claims the machine has all the answers to winter road maintenance and is tested against the Canadian winter.

items.title: Fire Fighting
items.description: The Re-Inventors build and test two extinguisher designs from the past going beyond the use of water.

items.title: Chinese Rockets
items.description: Rebuilding a 700-year-old multi-stage weapon brings multiple problems to Matt and Jeremy.

items.title: The Real Angelina
items.description: Angelina Jolie is an Oscar-winning actress turned director and humanitarian. The actress has come a long way, from a bullied and troubled teenager to a movie star and one of the most influential women in Hollywood.

items.title: The Real MVP: The Wanda Durant Story
items.description: Wanda Pratt works tirelessly to raise three children, including future NBA basketball player Kevin Durant.

items.title: The Red House
items.description: Meg (Allene Roberts) lives with her adoptive parents, Pete (Edward G. Robinson) and Ellen Morgan (Judith Anderson). When Nath (Lon McCallister), a classmate of Meg's, comes to help on their farm, Pete repeatedly tells Meg and Nath to stay out of the surrounding woods. Out of curiosity, they disobey, and Pete is irate, subsequently hiring Teller (Rory Calhoun) to guard the woods. As Pete's rage devolves into madness, the kids start to discover the dark secrets that are buried in the nearby land.

items.title: Gifts
items.description: The disappearance of a college student from a small town in New Jersey begins a series of events that forever changes the life of town Sheriff Harold Jensen. The investigation takes the officer into the neighboring mountains, where a federally unrecognized Native American tribe makes its home. Jensen eventually comes into contact with dangerous ex-con and tribe member Phillip Kopus, whose return to the college town raises suspicions and threatens to disrupt the peace. After a tragedy and cover-up further divides the town and the tribe, Kopus takes advantage, forcing Jensen to compromise his principles or risk destroying his family.

items.title: Graves
items.description: Kopus becomes the focus of the tribe's suspicion; Harold protects Junior and puts his standing in the police department in jeopardy.

items.title: A Cure
items.description: An unexpected turn of events for Harold; Junior and Marie argue about casinos; Kopus attempts to prove his innocence.

items.title: The Hatching
items.description: Harold makes an unexpected discovery in an abandoned mine; Kopus finds Harold to tell him that Junior went to kill Levi.

items.title: Shadow Walker
items.description: Harold and Kopus locate Junior in Connecticut; Rachel assumes the role of parent as Jean spirals out of control; Kopus defends the tribe from an attack.

items.title: The Reef
items.description: A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

items.title: The Reluctant Astronaut
items.description: Roy (Don Knotts), a perpetually terrified 35-year-old man-child, still lives with his parents. He plays an astronaut at a local fairground, but his father (Arthur O'Connell) wants him to be a real astronaut and lands him a place at NASA. On arrival, Roy discovers he's just a janitor, but he keeps up the charade, which eventually gets him fired. When NASA wants to send someone unqualified into orbit to one-up the Russians, however, they send Roy into space, where things invariably go wrong.

items.title: The Resident
items.description: A landlord becomes obsessed with a doctor (Hilary Swank) who moves into his building.

items.title: Coastal Modern Waves
items.description: This is the moment every designer loves and no client ever forgets; it's the moment when a home is complete, the design work is finished, and the transformation is ready to be unveiled.

items.title: Mid-Century Palm Springs Style
items.description: Michelle Boudreau celebrates the Palm Springs lifestyle in this mid-century modern abode.

items.title: Peaceful Palm Desert Remodel
items.description: Anne-Marie Barton creates a spirit of wellness in this charming Palm Springs remodel.

items.title: Artful & Eclectic Designer Dwelling
items.description: Andrea Schumacher shows her Colorado home which captures the essence of her adventures.

items.title: Prismatic & Patterned LA Bungalow
items.description: Looking inside Los Angeles-based designer Dani Dazey's pink bungalow in Highland Park, Calif.

items.title: Coloring Outside the Classic Cottage
items.description: Just outside of Charleston, Mary Welch Fox brings her signature edge to what looks like a classic cottage-until the front door swings open; inside, it's anything but expected: color-drenched walls, bold wallpaper, and fearless style at every turn.

items.title: Maximal Style in the Marshes
items.description: In this South Carolina stunner, designer Mary Welch Fox turns up the volume on style with bold choices, fearless edge, and serious design swagger; this home doesn't just bend the rules-it breaks them wide open.

items.title: It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
items.description: Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

items.title: The Reverend
items.description: After a clergyman (Stuart Brennan) is transformed into a vampire, he decides to put his newfound powers to good use and rid his town of drugs, prostitution and violence.

items.title: The Rewrite
items.description: A washed-up screenwriter (Hugh Grant) reluctantly takes a college teaching job and meets a single mother (Marisa Tomei) who changes his life in more ways than one.

items.title: U.K.
items.description: Join Sung Kang on a modern-day adventure to explore unique car cultures and the evolving relationship between man and machine.

items.title: Poland
items.description: Sung dives into Poland's car culture, discovering new freedoms in a thrilling experience.

items.title: The Sheridan Story
items.description: Lucas McCain raises a son while battling desperados in New Mexico.

items.title: The Retired Gun
items.description: Outlaws hunt a retired gunfighter who has settled in North Fork.

items.title: The Photographer
items.description: Lucas' old friend, a traveling photographer, is accused of murder.

items.title: Shivaree
items.description: A young couple traveling in a wagon train causes trouble for all of North Fork.

items.title: The Dead-Eye Kid
items.description: A smart-aleck boy from Brooklyn comes west to seek his fortune.

items.title: The Indian
items.description: A U.S. marshal arrives in North Fork, taking an Indian prisoner back east for trial.

items.title: Closer Than a Brother
items.description: Closer Than A Brother - Lucas looks for answers when recovering alcoholic lawman Micah Torrence turns in his badge and returns to the bottle.

items.title: The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
items.description: A visit to Micah's old home leads to the uncovering of an old mystery.

items.title: Dark Day at North Fork
items.description: Lucas, temporarily blind, faces a gunfight.

items.title: The Prisoner
items.description: A former POW imprisons Lucas for his role in the Civil War.

items.title: Assault
items.description: A traveling salesman is accused of forcing his attentions on a local woman.

items.title: Short Rope for a Tall Man
items.description: Lucas faces lynching for unwittingly buying stolen horses.

items.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
items.description: A stubborn idealist (Ryan Kwanten) spies a bride (Sara Canning) on her way to her wedding and immediately falls in love with her.

items.title: The Risen
items.description: A rogue government agent threatens to unleash an unspeakable evil upon humanity.

items.title: The River Niger
items.description: In a poor African-American neighborhood in Los Angeles, once-aspiring poet Johnny Williams (James Earl Jones) takes a low-paying job as a house painter in order to support his family. Already struggling to make ends meet, Williams -- who rests his hopes on his son Jeff (Glynn Turman), an Air Force lieutenant -- grows more despondent when he learns his wife, Mattie (Cicely Tyson), has terminal cancer. Now, Williams must summon the depths of his spirit to overcome his family's plight.

items.title: The River Why
items.description: Gus leaves the city to live and fish in the wilderness and begins a search for self-discovery. During his quest he embraces his love of the wilderness and finds romance with a beautiful woman.

items.title: The Road to Hong Kong
items.description: With their vaudeville act going nowhere, Harry Turner (Bing Crosby) and Chester Babcock (Bob Hope) decide to become con artists -- except Chester is having a few problems with his memory, which doesn't exactly help. Luckily, Turner and Chester find a miracle drug in Tibet that cures Chester. When he memorizes a secret formula for space travel with his improved mind, however, a whole host of other problems crop up, accompanied by an alluring spy, Diane (Joan Collins).

items.title: The Robertsons: Family, Faith and Ducks
items.description: Profile of the Robertson family from TV's "Duck Dynasty," whose daily lives center around their core beliefs of faith, family and ducks.

items.title: The Rolling Stones: Rock Royalty
items.description: Two old friends bumping into each other at a train station in England leads to formation of the Rolling Stones and the band's enduring success in music and business.

items.title: The Romans
items.description: The Rev. Eric Roman and Brucey B pick up the pieces of Earl Roman's empire in Buffalo.

items.title: The Room
items.description: A couple discover a strange room in their new house that grants material wishes, but all they want is a child.

items.title: The Roswell Coverup: 75 Years Later
items.description: Over seven decades later, experts attempt to discover the true story behind the Roswell Incident with a look back at the firsthand accounts of those who saw, held and were instrumental in disclosing the crash of a suspected alien spaceship.

items.title: Jailbreak
items.description: Television cowboy Roy Rogers fights for law and order in the West.

items.title: Doc Stevens' Traveling Store
items.description: Doc Stevens' traveling store has a more sinister purpose.

items.title: The Treasure of Howling Dog Canyon
items.description: A saloon hostess threatens her stepson to gain control of the final piece of a treasure map.

items.title: The Train Robbery
items.description: The local postmaster plots to rob a train carrying a valuable bank shipment.

items.title: Badman's Brother
items.description: Dale and Roy must convince an 11-year-old boy help catch his outlaw brother.

items.title: The Unwilling Outlaw
items.description: A bank employee (Stanford Jolley) is forced to join a gang after being framed for embezzlement.

items.title: Dead Men's Hills
items.description: Roy, Dale and Pat help a wounded sheriff contain an outlaw gang in a desert oasis town.

items.title: Minister's Son
items.description: A government agent poses as a minister's son to break up a gang of counterfeiters.

items.title: Ride in the Death Wagon
items.description: A crook is mistakenly given cash designated for the construction of a clinic.

items.title: Peril From the Past
items.description: Two outlaws threaten to expose a bank teller with a criminal past.

items.title: Ride of the Ranchers
items.description: Outlaws target the home of Don Jose while he is leading the annual Ride of the Ranchers.

items.title: Ghost Town Gold
items.description: Pat Brady buys an old ghost town inhabited by a strange old man (Tom London).

items.title: The Doublecrosser
items.description: Dale helps investigate the mayor (Harry Lauter) of a small town who is suspected of being corrupt.

items.title: Carnival Killer
items.description: A young carnival worker is framed for the murder of his boss.

items.title: Flying Bullets
items.description: Pat Brady is elected sheriff just in time to catch a notorious killer.

items.title: Death Medicine
items.description: Roy and Dale race the clock to find a kidnapped elderly diabetic.

items.title: Outlaw's Return
items.description: Roy hires an ex-con who is quickly suspected of committing several recent robberies.

items.title: Mayor of Ghost Town
items.description: A woman from Connecticut arrives at Dale's café seeking her father.

items.title: Blind Justice
items.description: A greedy veterinarian plans to murder a blind prospector who is using Roy's dog.

items.title: The Knockout
items.description: Roy and Pat aid a boxer (Charles Bronson) who has criminal connections.

items.title: The Run-a-round
items.description: Con men trick an unsuspecting Dale into selling the ranch.

items.title: Phantom Rustlers
items.description: A group of cattle rustlers tries to sell stolen beef to Dale's café.

items.title: Loaded Guns
items.description: The owner of a gun used to kill a rancher protests his innocence.

items.title: The Silver Fox Hunt
items.description: Roy and Dale discover the body of a murdered Indian chief.

items.title: The Mingo Kid
items.description: The Mingo Kid swaps clothes with Roy, who is then taken hostage by another outlaw.

items.title: The Long Chance
items.description: The leader of a cattle rustling gang declares his innocence in the robbery of school funds.

items.title: Money to Burn
items.description: Dale unknowingly buys a stove containing stolen payroll money from a local peddler (Dub Taylor).

items.title: The Milliner From Medicine Creek
items.description: An attractive milliner and her grandfather are suspects in a plot to rob the Wells Fargo office.

items.title: The Young Defenders
items.description: Two children of a kidnapped fur trapper are left alone in their cabin.

items.title: Backfire
items.description: Roy and Dale question the identity of a man claiming to be a friend of the local minister.

items.title: Last of the Larabee Kid
items.description: A mysterious outlaw hijacks stolen loot from stagecoach bandits.

items.title: Boy's Day in Paradise Valley
items.description: When students become lawmen for a day, the new "sheriff's" uncle takes advantage.

items.title: Bad Neighbors
items.description: Roy and Dale are caught between feuding cattlemen and homesteaders.

items.title: Strangers
items.description: A new family in Paradise Valley mistakes outlaws for a welcoming committee.

items.title: Hidden Treasure
items.description: Outlaws misinterpret a comment made by Roy and Dale.

items.title: Outcasts of Paradise Valley
items.description: Gang of crooks locks Roy in his own jail. (1951)

items.title: The Big Chance
items.description: Pat and Nellybelle are kidnapped by a gang of outlaws.

items.title: Dead End Trail
items.description: A young man decides to escape his overbearing father by joining the Carlson gang.

items.title: The Brothers O'Dell
items.description: Brothers are at odds when an outlaw gang robs an express office.

items.title: Three Masked Men
items.description: A shooting occurs when an outlaw gang tries to kidnap the governor.

items.title: Ambush
items.description: A young miner is kidnapped when it's learned that he's stumbled upon a bonanza.

items.title: Money Is Dangerous
items.description: A local miser is robbed by a con man hired to be his bodyguard.

items.title: Horse Crazy
items.description: An outlaw forces Roy to track down his missing horse.

items.title: Johnny Rover
items.description: A tyrannical Boston financier travels to Mineral City to confront his son.

items.title: Redesign Your Life
items.description: Join Sabrina Soto for a vibrant and inspiring show dedicated to transforming every aspect of your life. Each episode is a delightful blend of DIY projects, delectable food segments, and insightful health and wellness tips - your go-to guide for creating a beautiful, healthy, and fulfilling life, one step at a time. Let Sabrina help you redesign your life from the inside out.

items.title: Creating Space: Boundaries in Everyday Life
items.description: Carving out space for yourself can be overwhelming but psychotherapist and author Terri Cole, celebrity chef Cat Cora, and Dr. Ramani are here to help; these experts provide a masterclass in self-care, one step at a time.

items.title: Chic Hacks: Style, Flights & Gluten-Free Delights
items.description: Stylist Chellie Carlson shows Sabrina tricks for leveling up her wardrobe, cookbook author Danielle Walker spices things up in the kitchen, and comedienne Trish Suhr delivers laughs and next-level travel hacks that'll have you packing like a pro.

items.title: The Sacrament
items.description: Found footage reveals the events surrounding an investigative team's visit to a remote commune, led by a dangerous fanatic who maintains an iron grip on his followers.

items.title: The Salem Witch Trials
items.description: Delving deep into the case surrounding the deadliest example of witch hunt hysteria in the history of colonial North America.

items.title: The Santa Trap
items.description: Santa Claus (Dick Van Patten) winds up in jail after a 7-year-old sets a trap in order to prove his existence to her family (Robert Hays, Shelley Long).

items.title: The Search for General Tso
items.description: Filmmaker Ian Cheney explores the origin of a spicy-sweet chicken dish that is a popular item in many of America's Chinese restaurants.

items.title: The Secret Life of Bats
items.description: The fearsome bat is amongst the stealthiest hunters in the Animal Kingdom, but has a species of Bulgarian grasshopper outsmarted them?

items.title: The Secret Life of Seals
items.description: Explore the hidden life of gray seals, captivating, bear-sized creatures that hunt, eat, sleep, and mate mostly below the surface of the ocean.

items.title: All Fired Up
items.description: Skinwalker Ranch and the surrounding area have been referred to as "UFO alley" since the 1950s when numerous anomalous events and strange activity began occurring. A team of scientists and experts conducts a thorough and daring search of the infamous 512-acre property in Utah's Uinta Basin in an attempt to find out the answers behind more than 200 years of UFO sightings, strange animal mutations, and paranormal related mysteries. Scientists use the latest in cutting-edge technology, like ground-penetrating radar and drones, to seek shocking discoveries.

items.title: Flying High
items.description: The team runs a new test in the Mesa that produces loud and clear evidence of buried metallic objects; a new aerial experiment yields solid clues about a giant force field in the middle of Skinwalker Ranch.

items.title: Setting Boundaries
items.description: As the team begins a large-scale drilling operation to uncover a possible metal object in the Mesa, they launch a swarm of one hundred drones that reveals a major answer about the mystery of the Bubble.

items.title: Smoking Guns
items.description: After a new test deepens the mystery of the ceramics that were found in the Mesa, the team smokes out stunning new clues at the Triangle and along the boundary of the Bubble.

items.title: Home Sweet Homestead
items.description: The team encounters a series of mind-bending phenomena when a Navajo Shaman performs a sacred ritual at Homestead Two.

items.title: All Mesa'd Up
items.description: As the mystery deepens in the Mesa, the team makes a bewildering new discovery at the center of the Bubble.

items.title: High Voltage
items.description: The team shoots bolts of electricity in the Bubble, leading to shocking new clues surrounding the Blob.

items.title: Rocket Men
items.description: While investigating a region high above the Triangle with specialized rockets, the team makes a discovery that may explain the mysterious phenomena on Skinwalker Ranch.

items.title: Up in Smoke
items.description: As the team works to smoke out answers at Homestead Two, strange things appear at an unexpected area of the ranch.

items.title: The Twilight Zones
items.description: When the team looks for possible connections between two old decaying homesteads, they are surprised by what they discover.

items.title: On the Radar
items.description: The team uses Doppler radar to study the Bubble only to discover new, unexplained phenomena hiding in plain sight.

items.title: Medici Bitch
items.description: "The Serpent Queen" is a cunning account of one of the most influential women ever to wear a crown: Catherine de' Medici; considered an immigrant, common and plain, de' Medici marries into the 16th century French court as an orphanedteenager, expected to bring a fortune in dowry and produce many heirs; she quickly discovers that her husband is in love with an older woman, her dowry is unpaid, and she is unable to conceive; yet, with only her intelligence and determination, she manages to keep her marriage alive and masters the bloodsport that is the monarchy better than anyone else, ruling France for 50 years.

items.title: The Seven
items.description: A group of students sets out to solve the mystery of how devil worshipers died in an unexplained fire that razed their mansion to the ground.

items.title: The Shining
items.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

items.title: The Signal
items.description: Mya (Anessa Ramsey) and Ben (Justin Welborn) are very much in love, but she cannot quite find the courage to leave her awful husband, Lewis (A.J. Bowen). However, when a mysterious transmission starts turning people, including Lewis, into murderous maniacs, the lovers must go on the run.

items.title: The Silencers
items.description: Veteran secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) is living a life of luxury when his former lover, Tina Batori (Daliah Lavi), pulls him back into action. A sinister group known as the Big O has developed a plot to start a global nuclear conflict, so the carefree, womanizing Helm must stop the scheme of mastermind Tung-Tze (Victor Buono). Joining the suave Helm on his mission is the beautiful but inept operative Gail Hendricks (Stella Stevens), along with other gorgeous ladies.

items.title: The Silver Star
items.description: The old sheriff (Edgar Buchanan) handles three gunmen when the skittish new sheriff hides.

items.title: The Sisters Brothers
items.description: It's 1851, and Charlie and Eli Sisters are both brothers and assassins, boys grown to men in a savage and hostile world. The Sisters brothers find themselves on a journey through the Northwest, bringing them to the mountains of Oregon, a dangerous brothel in the small town of Mayfield, and eventually, the gold rush land of California -- an adventure that tests the deadly family ties that bind.

items.title: The Sixth Secret
items.description: At a late-night seance attended by 12 people, a medium announces that three secrets will be revealed before midnight. As bodies pile up, so do the secrets, leading to the darkest of them all.

items.title: The Sleepwalker
items.description: Tensions rise when a woman (Gitte Witt) receives an unexpected visit from her pregnant sister (Stephanie Ellis) and her fiancé (Brady Corbet).

items.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
items.description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

items.title: The Sorcerer and the White Snake
items.description: A sorcerer (Jet Li) battles against a barrage of demon temptresses to save a man's soul from an ancient serpent that was brought to life and disguised as a woman.

items.title: The Sound of Music
items.description: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

items.title: The Soviet Sleep Experiment
items.description: In the late 1940s, Russian researchers keep four test patients awake for 30 days using an experimental gas-based stimulant. What starts as a purely scientific study quickly spirals out of control.

items.title: The Spirit of Christmas
items.description: With breathtaking scenery and images accompanied by some of your favorite Christmas songs, the joy of the season is brought to life.

items.title: The Stairs
items.description: Hikers in the woods stumble upon a mysterious staircase that leads them into a subterranean nightmare.

items.title: The Standoff at Sparrow Creek
items.description: After a mass shooting at a police funeral, reclusive ex-cop Gannon finds himself unwittingly forced out of retirement when he realizes that the killer belongs to the same militia he joined after quitting the force. Understanding that the shooting could set off a chain reaction of copycat violence across the country, Gannon quarantines his fellow militiamen in the remote lumber mill they call their headquarters. There, he sets about a series of interrogations, intent on ferreting out the killer.

items.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
items.description: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

items.title: The Star Packer
items.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

items.title: The Stendhal Syndrome
items.description: A police detective falls under hallucinatory spells while trying to capture the sadistic man who raped her.

items.title: The Stepfather
items.description: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

items.title: Meth Dad; My Grandson is Killing Himself
items.description: The former Chicago cop and security guard of "The Jerry Springer Show" gets his own talk show that is adapted from the popular "Steve to the Rescue" shows he did while filling in for Springer. Wilkos says he hopes his show will provide him with a platform to stand up for everyday people and help viewers in need. Common topics include trying to confirm -- often using results of lie-detector tests -- whether guests abused or molested children. Steve also helps guests determine paternity and if guests are cheating on their partners. If Steve doesn't like the guests they might not last long on the show.

items.title: I Lost 6 of My Kids
items.description: Lisa has had all six of her children taken as a result of neglect, which she still tries to justify.

items.title: Mommy, Go To Jail For Me
items.description: Christi abandons her 10-year-old daughter and leaves the state.

items.title: I'm 14 and I Want a Baby
items.description: Shalonda, 14, tells her mother, Shondra, and Steve that she is ready to have a baby.

items.title: He Beat Me In My Sleep; He Pull...
items.description: An 18-year-old mother says her boyfriend is abusive; a former couple fight over custody of their children.

items.title: I Stand Accused
items.description: A woman says the father of her children has touched one of them inappropriately; he denies the charge and takes a lie-detector test.

items.title: You Wont Beat Me again
items.description: Steve confronts a man who admits he abuses the mother of his child.

items.title: He Punches Me Until I Prostitute
items.description: A man abuses his girlfriend until she agrees to prostitute herself for his financial gain.

items.title: You Want Him to Be the Father?
items.description: A woman says that a daughter's boyfriend is abusive and has isolated her from her family.

items.title: 16-Year-Old Prostitute Runaway
items.description: Desire, a 16-year-old, runs away from home; the only contact she has with her mother are random text messages telling her that she's still alive; Desire says she always risked abuse and could never confide in her mother.

items.title: Explosive Lie Detector Results
items.description: A man takes a lie-detector test to prove he did not molest his girlfriend's 4-year-old daughter.

items.title: How Can You Still Love Him?
items.description: A woman is desperate to keep her friend from going back to her abusive boyfriend.

items.title: Teen Girls in Trouble
items.description: A teen's sister tries to get her to stop prostituting herself; a teen wants her baby's daddy to take responsibility; a woman tries to stop her teenager from sending sexual pictures of herself to men.

items.title: I Have Proof, You're Abusing Our Child
items.description: Lie-detector tests gauge whether guests are abusing children.

items.title: My Daughter Prostitutes for Heroin
items.description: A young woman travels to a rehab clinic and tries to become free of heroin.

items.title: Abusers Don't Sit on My Stage
items.description: A couple take lie-detector and DNA tests to prove whether he is abusive and whether he is the father of her two children.

items.title: Too Young to Be Parents
items.description: A teen says her ex abused their child; a 14-year-old says her 16-year-old boyfriend kicked her in the abdomen while she was pregnant.

items.title: A Mother's Wrath
items.description: A woman fears that her boyfriend is molesting her child.

items.title: Do You Have a Gay Double Life?
items.description: After finding porn and email exchanges with transsexuals, Quintiqua demands that her boyfriend take a lie-detector test to determine whether he is bisexual; Beau wants to know whether his boyfriend cheated with a woman and got her pregnant.

items.title: Why Are You Dating a Child?
items.description: Sheila fears that her 14-year-old granddaughter has been having sex with a 26-year-old family friend; teen Shaquille's mother confronts his 30-something girlfriend and demands to know whether the woman's twins are his.

items.title: A Lifetime of Lies?
items.description: Callista has been living with a horrible rumor about her estranged father for the past 20 years, and he wants to prove that he is not the monster she thinks he is.

items.title: Liars and Scammers Exposed
items.description: Jason and Tamiko accuse each other of cheating; Marcus says he has heard rumors that his wife has been having sex with co-workers and strange men in parking lots.

items.title: I Think My Wife Is a Prostitute
items.description: Husband and wife accuse each other of cheating; Matt wants to know why his girlfriend has been receiving money and gifts from men.

items.title: Are You Pregnant by My Brother?
items.description: Deon believes that Cassandra has been having sex with his brother; Shawn wants to know whether his brother's confession of having slept with his wife is a lie.

items.title: DNA: Don't Run From the Results
items.description: Roberta suspects that her husband has fathered a child with an underage girl; Taschia's on again/off again boyfriend denies both of her babies.

items.title: Long-Lost Brother Stole My Family
items.description: Michael learns that his brother had an affair with his fiancée and may be the father of her son; Sarah believes that her daughter's much-older boyfriend is a sexual predator.

items.title: Did You Not Hear the Results?
items.description: Pam says she has had two miscarriages because of her boyfriend's accusations of infidelity; Natron denies being his girlfriend's children's father.

items.title: Stop Running Off My Stage!
items.description: Kela suspects her boyfriend of cheating; an older man who got a 16-year-old pregnant denies that the baby is his.

items.title: I Got a Bad Feeling About This
items.description: Ashley and DeNorris accuse each other of cheating; Jim denies having sex with his fiancée's sister and underage girls.

items.title: I Caught Her Sending Naked Pictures
items.description: Alyssa and her fiancé accuse each other of infidelity; Andrea says her husband has been parading another woman around as his wife, but he says it's all a big misunderstanding.

items.title: Before the Test He Confessed ...
items.description: Melody says her boyfriend gave her an STD from another woman; Ted is so suspicious, he sends the children to spy on his wife when she goes to the store.

items.title: I Caught You: Why Are You Still Lying?
items.description: Nye wants a lie-detector test to reveal what her boyfriend was doing when he mysteriously left her house on Easter night; John's girlfriend admits to a sexual encounter she had with a co-worker.

items.title: I Don't Want Your Sister, but She Wants Me

How do million-dollar birds procreate? What's the story behind a dog that ignited an international conflict? These are the strangest origin tales you've never heard-and won't believe!

With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

items.description: In the 1950s Oklahoma, FBI Agents Reed and Milner are tasked with infiltrating a cult run by Dexter Venito; as Milner embraces the cult, Reed grows closer with Dexter's wife, Theodosia, and he becomes alarmed at the cult's aims.

items.description: 1978 Oklahoma: Fairbanks, Elsa and Theodosia confront Braxton Chamberland, the architect of the Darkland Amusement Park; Braxton shines a light on the cult's rise, Dexter's abusive behavior toward Theodosia and what led to the park's shuttering.

items.description: 1940s Florida: Theodosia Birchwood's father, Mordechai, returns from his treasure hunting expedition with a cursed sarcophagus; despite his warning, she opens the relic and finds a ring that takes her into a dreamworld haunted by the Nightmare Man.

Oklahoma, 1978: Obsessed with Dexter Venito, Tammy convinces her friends to break into the abandoned Darkland park; during a wild night, she dares them to perform a ritual in Dexter's name, unaware she holds the key to his return.

items.title: Reanimated

items.title: The Unknown Girl
items.description: Jenny, a talented doctor, refuses to open the door of her practice to a mysterious late-night caller. The next morning, she learns that the caller was a girl who has been found dead, and the police have no way of identifying her. Shocked and guilt-stricken by the news, Jenny resolves to discover the name of the girl so she will not be buried anonymously and to ensure she doesn't disappear as if she had never lived.

Policeman Karl Brettschneider (Melvyn Douglas) doubts the existence of vampires, but Dr. Otto von Niemann (Lionel Atwill) argues to the contrary. Fingers point at the village idiot, Herman Gleib (Dwight Frye), but after local vigilantes get him out of the picture, the killings continue. But that plan comes crashing down when Edward falls in love with Lancastrian commoner Elizabeth Woodville. A conservative Christian, the policeman observes the residents' frivolous sexual displays and strange pagan rituals, particularly the temptations of Willow (Britt Ekland), daughter of the island magistrate, Lord Summerisle (Christopher Lee). The series goes beyond the battlefront to a conflict involving everyday men and women, taking place in a cryptic world of double agents, covert operations and code-breaking. It revolves around Abe Woodhull, a young farmer torn between loyalty to his Tory background and respect for those who fight for the Patriot cause. Living on British-occupied Long Island, Abe joins a group of his childhood friends to form what becomes known as the Culper Ring, a spy network charged with sniffing out British military strategy. Under the direction of Gen. Washington, Abe and his fellow agents help turn the war to the Continentals' favor, and their daring efforts ultimately serve as the foundation for modern espionage.
