items.title: Mendou Arrives With Trouble!; Constellation-Go-Round
items.description: Rich kid Shutarou Mendou airdrops into Tomobiki High and is a big hit with the ladies, but not so much with the boys; concerned by the daily horoscope, Lum uses a strange device to figure out whether she's better paired with Mendou or her darling.

items.title: The Great Spring War; The Benten Corps' Return
items.description: Lum drags Ataru along to fight in her planet's Setsubun Festival, but the lecher becomes enamored with warrior biker Benten; Ataru tries to use Earth's Setsubun to drive Lum away, but Benten suddenly rides into town with her posse.

items.title: Oh, Lonely Teacher! Kuribayashi Sensei Appears; Terrible Inspection Day
items.description: Ataru has a new nemesis in the classroom, and Lum has a plan to set things straight; mothers from all over town and the galaxy wreak havoc at parent-teacher conference time.

items.title: Fourth Dimensional Camera; Demonic Jogging
items.description: Ataru suddenly goes missing when Mendou snaps a photo of him using an antique camera; once he's found, Ataru seems to have an extremely lucky day, but there's a catch.

items.title: Girl's Day! Ran-chan's Arrival; Ran-chan's Introduction
items.description: Lum's childhood friend Ran comes to Earth, but she's here to seek revenge on Lum for all times she got her in trouble when they were both little; she tries to suck out Ataru's youth by kissing him.

items.title: Diary of Sorrowful Tomorrows; Whose Is This Child?
items.description: Lum nabs Ataru's diary from the future, causing Ataru to get into a boatload of trouble when he reads too far ahead; while getting ready for class, Mendou finds an alien baby in his locker.

items.title: Sleeping in Class on a Wonderful Spring Day/Peach Blossom Poetry Contest
items.description: A fairy and her master put Ataru's class to sleep. While having a poetry contest, the gang stumbles upon a strange woman.

items.title: Duel! Ataru vs. Ataru/Waking to a Nightmare
items.description: In "Duel. Ataru vs. Ataru" Ataru gets divided into two beings that are completely different. In "Walking to a Nightmare" Ataru goes to a deep sleep in class and his dreams make Mendo furious at Ataru and seconds away from killing him.

items.title: Great Space Matchmaking Operation
items.description: Extraterrestrials challenge Earth.

items.title: The Big Springtime Picnic Uproar
items.description: When gang goes out on a class picnic, Ataru runs into the local Kappa before discovering that Mendou is deathly afraid of the dark.

items.title: Don't Die! Ryoko's Special Straw Doll!!
items.description: Mendou starts throwing himself in harm's way when Ataru somehow gets his hands on a voodoo doll of the rich kid.

items.title: Omiai Hell! Is the Armored Girl a Beauty? Or a Beast?
items.description: Mendou has found himself thrown into an arranged marriage with the heavily armored sister of his greatest rival.

items.title: Love of the Armored Daughter! Maiden Heart is Shaky Wobbling
items.description: Both Mendou and Ataru have their sights set on the now armorless Asuka; however, Ryouko just might have something to say about that.

items.title: I Miss You So Much, I Could Die! The Return of the Pure-Hearted Fox!
items.description: The little fox scurries back into town after he hears of a legend that could fulfill his unrequited love for Shinobu.

items.title: V/H/S/94
items.description: A mysterious VHS tape reveals a sinister cult that has prerecorded material that uncovers a horrifying conspiracy.

items.title: V/H/S/99
items.description: A teen's home videos lead to a series of horrifying revelations.

items.title: Valleyheart
items.description: In the middle of the hot California summer, Jane Francis must decide how far she's willing to go to help her small-time criminal brother get out of a jam with the Russian mob.

items.title: Vampire at Midnight
items.description: A Los Angeles police detective (Jason Williams) hunts a hypnotic killer whose victims are drained of blood.

items.title: Vampire Hookers
items.description: While on shore leave, two sailors stumble upon a nest of sexy vampires.

items.title: Vampire Zombies... From Space!
items.description: From the depths of space, Dracula has devised his most dastardly plan yet; turning the residents of the small town of Marlow into his personal army of vampire zombies. A motley crew consisting of a grizzled detective, a skeptical rookie cop, a chain-smoking greaser, and a determined young woman band together to save the world.

items.title: Vampyr
items.description: After Allan Gray rents a room near Courtempierre in France, strange events unfold: An elderly man leaves a packet on Gray's table, and shadows that are seemingly alive lead him toward a castle. At a nearby manor, he witnesses the same man being murdered and gradually learns about the curse of the Vampyr. As Gray faces the horrors of the castle, he attempts to save the victim's daughters -- one of whom, Léone, has fallen ill after mysteriously being bitten.

items.title: Vampyres
items.description: Two bisexual vampires (Marianne Morris, Murray Brown) charm unwary victims into joining them at their castle for a midnight snack and more.

items.title: Veganism: Cooking for Tomorrow
items.description: Enrich the palette with some of the tastiest vegan dishes coming out of London with The Feel Good Cafe owner Idan Naor, social media superstar Clare Every (The Little London Vegan) and award-winning vegan chef Brett Cobley.

items.title: Leaves and Lettuces
items.description: Chef Pino Di Cerbo takes vegetables from the side dish to center stage.

items.title: Summer
items.description: Chef Pino Di Cerbo celebrates the summer with sweet recipes.

items.title: Red
items.description: Chef Pino Di Cerbo is seeing red with his crimson crop of rosy recipes.

items.title: Venus and Vegas
items.description: Three Las Vegas buddies (Eddie Kaye Thomas, Donald Faison, Eddie Guerra) face the wrath of gangsters, while also trying to keep their girlfriends happy.

items.title: Venus Die-Trap
items.description: On the tranquil coastal plains of North Carolina, a meteor crash triggers a chain of events. Mysterious ooze from the meteor seeps into the soil, transforming the once harmless venus fly traps into towering, carnivorous monstrosities. As chaos descends upon the unsuspecting town, a determined botany student and a skeptical rookie deputy must unite.

items.title: Marriage & Babies
items.description: Stevie Wonder wrote a hit song about it, proclaiming that when you believe in things that you don't understand, "superstition ain't the way." But a reverence for trusting that such beliefs lead to certain consequences, however unfounded, has been practiced for centuries and endures to this day, whether it involves a fear of Friday the 13th, a rabbit's foot fending off evil, or crossing one's fingers for luck. Comic George Lopez is fascinated by the subject, having been raised in a very superstitious home in Mexico. After years of bad luck, Lopez hopes to tap what he learned as a boy by exploring the beliefs and rituals of others. On this series, he travels around the U.S. to meet various people who hold unusual beliefs and discover the role these superstitions play in their lives.

items.title: Food
items.description: To learn about food superstitions and their origins, George takes to the high seas, confronts alligators, and has an experience he never expected when he agrees to hunt for his dinner in the backwoods of Missouri.

items.title: Faith vs. Superstition?
items.description: In trying to reveal the difference between religion and superstition, George uncovers some of life's great secrets.

items.title: Money
items.description: George visits the Las Vegas Strip and Wall Street to learn if lucky charms and strange rituals can actually help fatten one's wallet.

items.title: The Afterlife
items.description: George tries to communicate with a recently departed friend to learn if there are invisible souls, spirits or life after death.

items.title: Sports
items.description: George goes head-to-head with professional boxers, baseball stars and football fanatics to try to uncover the truth behind some of the sports' greatest superstitions.

items.title: Curses!
items.description: George meets several people who believe they are truly cursed, and takes them to a psychic, a voodoo priestess and a holistic healer to see if any superstitions can break the spells.

items.title: Fear No Evil
items.description: George travels from the swamps of Louisiana to the backstage corridors of Broadway to find out what superstitions people use to ward off evil spirits, and if any of them actually work.

items.title: My Strange Journey
items.description: George gets personal as he shares his favorite superstitious adventures, from the craziest ones that made him laugh to those that changed him forever.

items.title: VFW
items.description: A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into an all-out battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar with a bag of stolen drugs. When a gang of violent punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect the girl and themselves from an unrelenting attack.

items.title: VHS
items.description: Hired to steal a rare VHS tape from a remote house, a ragtag band of crooks finds a dead body, old TVs and a lot of cryptic footage.

items.title: VHS 2
items.description: As they search for clues to the whereabouts of a missing student, a couple view the ghastly stories recorded on a collection of videotapes.

items.title: VHS Massacre Too
items.description: A post-video store era adventure that starts at the last Blockbuster in Bend, Oregon and ends at Troma Entertainment's B movie HQ in New York City.

items.title: VHS Massacre: Cult Films and the Decline of Physical Media
items.description: The rise and fall of physical media and its effect on independent and cult films.

items.title: VHS: Viral
items.description: A police chase through the streets of Los Angeles inspires dozens of fame-obsessed teens to try to capture the salacious footage, but they are unaware that they will face their own deaths as stars of the next video sensation.

items.title: Viceroy's House
items.description: In 1947, British statesman Lord Mountbatten serves as India's last Viceroy and is charged with handing India back to its people.

items.title: Victor Crowley
items.description: Victor is mistakenly resurrected and begins to kill again.

items.title: Victory at Last WWII Is Over
items.description: After Germany surrenders in 1945 during World War II, celebrations erupt throughout the Western world, especially in North America and the United Kingdom, where more than 1 million people celebrated in the streets, including in London.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: "Vida" is a drama series about two Mexican-American siblings from East Los Angeles. Party girl Lyn lives a carefree life in the Bay Area. She couldn't be more different than, or distanced from, her sister Emma, with whom she has no relationship. A death in their family forces them to return to their old stomping grounds, where they confront long-repressed feelings and learn the surprising truth about their mother's identity.

items.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
items.description: Taking an in-depth look at the United States' involvement in Vietnam.

items.title: Game of Life
items.description: Detective Gary Travis (Todd Terry, Breaking Bad) is a dedicated, though flawed, law enforcement officer who investigates crimes in the small town of East Bank, Texas. His work must be meticulous, as the true-to-life cases are not always what they seem on the surface. Matters of faith and justice are explored, as personal and professional relationships are put to the test. Co-workers, family members, victims, and even suspects, wrestle with life's deepest questions in the pursuit of ultimate vindication.

items.title: The Facade
items.description: The questionable behavior of an eccentric photographer in East Bank reunites Sgt. Travis and Kris for an investigation.

items.title: Be a Man
items.description: A weekend hunting trip by the men's group reveals a flurry of unexpected family instabilities, both past and present.

items.title: Voodoo Black Exorcist
items.description: A long-dead mummy is revived on a luxury liner and terrorizes the passengers.

items.title: Waco
items.description: Waco's citizens hire an outlaw to clean up their town.

items.title: Wagons East!
items.description: When a group of dissatisfied settlers decides they've had enough of the Wild West, they hire James Harlow, an alcoholic wagon master, to take them back East. The eclectic but happy bunch includes Dr. Phil, prostitute Belle and openly gay man Julian. But the railroad investors don't want it getting out that the West isn't a nice place, so they do everything they can to make sure the group never makes it to their destination.

items.title: Waiting to Exhale
items.description: Navigating through careers, family and romance, four friends bond over the shortcomings in their love lives -- namely, the scarcity of good men. Both as the "other woman," Savannah (Whitney Houston) and Robin (Lela Rochon) carry on relationships with married men, each believing their lovers will leave their wives for them. On the flip side, Bernadine (Angela Bassett) ends up alone when her husband divorces her for his mistress. Meanwhile, Gloria (Loretta Devine) finds love with a new neighbor.

items.title: Wakefield
items.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

items.title: Waking Nightmare
items.description: Jordan suffers manic episodes after the loss of her friend and is prescribed Ambien. Her nightmares and sleepwalking continue, but she has issues remembering what happened.

items.title: Walking Out
items.description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

items.title: Wallis Simpson: Kingmaker
items.description: A profile of Wallis Simpson, a twice divorced American socialite who became Edward, the Duke of Windsor's mistress, leading to the crisis in which he stepped down as king in order to be with her.

items.title: War at Sea: Naval Aviation
items.description: Naval vessels are combined with aircraft to create a decisive military technical innovation.

items.title: Battle for Black Gold
items.description: The secret story of war production that shaped WWII; key factories for weapons, vehicles and ships including the American Liberty Ships.

items.title: Fiat And The Fascists
items.description: Find out how Fiat, along with cars, made trains and planes; how like modern-day kingmakers, they made and broke governments too.

items.title: The People's Car
items.description: Explore how Hitler wanted a car that would transform his nation: the "people's car" -- a Volkswagen, as America had Ford or Chrysler or Buick.

items.title: Apocalypse Factories
items.description: The story of the arms race to create nuclear arms factories of the U.S.

items.title: War on Everyone
items.description: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

items.title: Warrants & Weed
items.description: Chronicling the lives and work of conservation officers in America.

items.title: Cheeseheads
items.description: Game wardens search for poachers with a little help from full size decoys and local citizens.

items.title: Three-Fifty-Seven
items.description: Wardens track a potential poacher who took a deer out of season; a warden as he takes his son hunting.

items.title: Mercy Kill
items.description: Wardens deal with a trespassing incident and an early hunting violation in Montana.

items.title: Tangled
items.description: Nick Taylor looks for out-of-town hunters accused of trespassing and illegally killing a mule deer; Lee Burrows responds to a panicked deer hunter calling about a kill.

items.title: 18 Minutes
items.description: The wardens investigate a possible elk harassment case and possible poaching in Montana.

items.title: Thin Ice
items.description: Nick Taylor responds to a call about duck hunters shooting over thin ice; Bryan Golie keeps an eye on the Bear Tooth Game Range on opening day of elk season.

items.title: 700 Yards
items.description: Joe Kambic sets up an elk decoy to help nab illegal hunters; Kqyn Kuka tries to save a deer in the river.

items.title: Still on the List
items.description: Officers in both the lower and upper peninsula of Michigan work to stop hunters from baiting for bears too early.

items.title: Kings Hill
items.description: Warden Bryan Golie investigates a call of shots fired on private property during the big game season and is in for one long night.

items.title: Watching Walleye
items.description: In District 6, the walleye opener is one of the busiest weekends of the year; a 10-officer patrol works during the weekend to make sure everyone is safe and obeying the law.

items.title: Firearm Opener
items.description: All across Michigan, officers spend the 16 days of the firearm deer season responding to all types of calls; from trespassing to poaching, just when you think you've seen it all, something new pops up.

items.title: Watch Out for Grizzly
items.description: Hunters have their downed elk attacked by a grizzly bear and Warden Koeppen investigates a separate dead elk left in a field.

items.title: Elk Fever -- 2017
items.description: There are two distinct elk seasons in Michigan, one in August and one in December; patrolling those two seasons couldn't be more different for the Officers in District 3.

items.title: Water in a Broken Glass
items.description: A talented artist enters into a passionate love triangle that creates chaos in her life.

items.title: Bananas for Barbeque
items.description: Chef/TV personality Spencer Watts demonstrates how to barbecue anything, from steak and chicken, to seafood and breads, like a pro.

items.title: Fish on the Grill
items.description: Spencer shares fish recipes.

items.title: The Butter Did It
items.description: Spencer Watts butters up with a menu featuring some of his favorite recipes.

items.title: Way of the Wicked
items.description: When a town is swept by a series of gruesome killings, a mysterious priest (Christian Slater) seems to be the only one who can help protect them from a truth more evil than any of them could have imagined.

items.title: 3 Hats and You're Out
items.description: The Walker family, whose upbeat attitude and unique style make living in New York City without much money more of an adventure than a hardship.

items.title: A Friend in Greed
items.description: The Walker family, whose upbeat attitude and unique style make living in New York City without much money more of an adventure than a hardship.

items.title: Brothers and Bros
items.description: Damey learns the difference between friends and family when he sneaks out of the house to run with his gang.

items.title: Bummed Out
items.description: Davey helps a homeless DJ who works on his guilt over a prank they'd pulled just before the man was fired.

items.title: Dad's a Spaz
items.description: Damey asks his dad to coach the gang for a game against the tough St. Mary's team, and soon realizes his dad's a disaster on the court.

items.title: Demon of the Dozens
items.description: Damey digs for dirt when his battle with the school bully turns into a dozens fight, a contest of insults.

items.title: No Mo' Money
items.description: The Walker family, whose upbeat attitude and unique style make living in New York City without much money more of an adventure than a hardship.

items.title: Quest for Fireworks
items.description: When Toof and Damey happen to find a firecracker the night before the 4th of July, the gang thinks they've got a secret source for illegal fireworks.

items.title: Rebel Without a Paw
items.description: Damey becomes convinced that the world is against Tripod because of his missing paw.

items.title: Special Delivery
items.description: Damey and the gang struggle to get Mom to the hospital when she goes into labor at the library.

items.title: To Be Cool or Not to Be
items.description: Damey's desperate to keep his opera role a secret from the guys, but circumstances conspire against him.

items.title: We Are the Best!
items.description: Three rebellious teenagers form an all-girl punk band in the 1980s Stockholm.

items.title: We Are X
items.description: Glam rock band X Japan ignited a musical revolution in Japan during the late 1980s. Twenty years after disbanding, Yoshiki X, the leader of the band, wrestles with physical and spiritual demons to bring the band's music to the world.

items.title: We Have a Pope
items.description: A therapist (Roberto Nobile) is called in when a newly appointed pope (Michel Piccoli) refuses to accept the mantle of responsibility.

items.title: Breeding Heavily
items.description: Animals of all shapes, sizes and habitats show off their cute side.

items.title: Funny Farm
items.description: Awesome animals straight from the funny farm.

items.title: Cute and Fluffy
items.description: A variety of fluffy and cute animals are featured.

items.title: Playful Pets
items.description: Some of the most playful dogs and cats.

items.title: Wide World of Animals
items.description: There's no rhyme or reason to this one. Just great animal clips.

items.title: Cuteness Overload
items.description: Cats, dogs, bears, birds and more come together to create a cuteness overload.

items.title: Snack Time!
items.description: The pets have taken over the kitchen... and beyond!

items.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
items.description: Eva Khatchadourian is a travel writer/publisher who gives up her beloved freedom and Bohemian lifestyle to have a child with her husband, Franklin. Pregnancy does not seem to agree with Eva, but what's worse, when she does give birth to a baby boy named Kevin, she can't seem to bond with him. When Kevin grows from a fussy, demanding toddler into a sociopathic teen, Eva is forced to deal with the aftermath of her son's horrific act.

items.title: We Were the Mulvaneys
items.description: The Mulvaneys, a seemingly perfect family, are nearly destroyed after daughter Marianne is raped at the school prom. Patriarch Michael descends into alcoholism afterward, while mother Corinne tries to deny the incident happened. As her relationship with her parents becomes cold and distant, Marianne is sent away to a relative's home, and her once-pristine reputation is left to be dragged through the mud until one of her brothers takes action.

items.title: Weaponized
items.description: A disturbed homicide detective has to stop a man before he unleashes a virus to kill the members of a terrorist cell who murdered his son.

items.title: Married By the In-Laws
items.description: Mothers-in-law set up weddings.

items.title: The Wedding Place
items.description: A banquet hall can hold five weddings per day.

items.title: The Wedding Planners
items.description: Two different wedding planners manage weddings for their clients.

items.title: Always a Bridesmaid
items.description: Bridesmaids share their horror stories.

items.title: This Old Spouse
items.description: A long-married couple is advised by a marriage counselor and makeover expert as they renew their vows.

items.title: Amazing Wedding Gowns
items.description: The salons and workrooms of the top wedding gown designers.

items.title: Little People, Big Day
items.description: Mark and Carol plan and discuss their wedding and face the unique challenges of their big day.

items.title: Sin City Weddings
items.description: Couples have their pick of a variety of weddings in Las Vegas.

items.title: Bling on the Bride
items.description: Experts show how to make any wedding day sparkle.

items.title: Wedding Planners 3
items.description: Anne and Justin's wedding seems more like a Broadway production, with 26 people in the wedding party and 300 guests; Tammy helps an indecisive bride plan a wedding at a Florida golf course.

items.title: Wedding Planners 4
items.description: Competitive swimmers want an under-the-sea feel for their family-friendly ceremony in the Texas countryside.

items.title: The Wedding Planners
items.description: Melissa B. helps her bride and groom create their wedding at a golf course overlooking the Pacific Ocean; Tammy C. has her hands full with an unfocused bride and quiet groom.

items.title: Wedding Planners 2
items.description: Four planners from Austin aim to turn a lakeside Texas yacht club into a Moroccan beach resort for Lynsey and Seth.

items.title: Wedding Daze
items.description: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

items.title: Wedding Gown Secrets Revealed
items.description: Six brides-to-be get one-on-one consultations with style expert Rachel Zalis, who hits bridal salons to help women find their dream dresses suited to their individual style and shape.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: In a stately country mansion, Wedding House's creative team of experts takes care of the details and plans one-stop nuptials services, where couples can indulge their wildest matrimonial fantasies.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: A bus ride with a magical difference, a dark tale of dungeons and dog collars, and a demanding bride who doesn't play by the rules; the Wedding House asks couples to send a wish-list in advance and then leave every last detail to the team.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: A gothic Victorian-themed service, an exotic ceremony with birds-of-paradise flowers, and a "Dirty Dancing" wedding featuring former boy band member Justin.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: "Big Brother" stars Lisa and Mario tie the knot; the couple have been under the knife again to look youthful for their ceremony; Martin and Marcia are ready to get hitched after meeting online four years ago.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: The circus comes to town as Mihaela and Csaba of the Moscow State Circus marry; Mark and Stephanie go for Christmas-themed nuptials; Ben and Kylie head down the aisle for a traditional ceremony, and Scott and Kate don their togas.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: Jay and Lauren go glam rock for a Lady Gaga-inspired wedding ceremony; Paul and Lindsay indulge in their Western fantasies; Ian and Sebastian head to a masquerade ball for their civil partnership, and Laura and Matt opt for a romantic white wedding.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: Sammy's boyfriend Nigel springs a proposal and a wedding ceremony on her; Matt and Fee combine Bollywood bling with Hollywood glamour; Claire and Tricky get their groove on, and Alex and Avril head west for a Buffalo Bill inspired vow renewal.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: Shirene and Richard are transformed for a "King and I"-style ceremony; Sharon and Peter have a Cinderella dream day; Gemma and Danielle seal their love in a civil partnership and everything goes pink and sparkly for Kim and Dave's blessing.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: Laura and Matt, Yvonne and Alan, and Sammy and Nigel re-live their special day, talk about how married life has effected them and discuss the experience with their family and friends, as well as divulging details of their home lives.

items.title: Wedding House
items.description: A look at how the lives of three couples that got married at the Wedding house, Lauren and Jay, Lisa and Mario, Kim and Dave, have changed.

items.title: Weinstein: In Court
items.description: The shocking allegations of assault and manipulation plaguing Harvey Weinstein for decades.

items.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful
items.description: Investigate the quirky survival tactics of Africa's animals.

items.title: Weirdsville
items.description: Two stoners try to dump the body of a girlfriend who overdosed in an abandoned drive-in theater, and they run into a cult of Satanists performing a ritual sacrifice.

items.title: Werewolf Rising
items.description: Emma travels to her family's cabin in the Arkansas hills to get away from the city. After she settles in, she has to fight for her life when a werewolf begins slaughtering everything in its path.

items.title: Werewolf Shadow
items.description: While searching the countryside for the grave of supposed vampire Countess Wandesa Dárvula de Nadasdy (Barbara Capell), students Genevieve (Andres Resino) and Elvira (Gaby Fuchs) meet an amiable local named Daninsky (Paul Naschy) who offers to help them look. Not knowing he's a werewolf, they accept, and Daninsky leads them to the tomb where they accidentally revive the sleeping vampire. She attacks, and Daninsky and Elvira cooperate in trying to stop her -- falling in love in the process.

items.title: Werewolves Within
items.description: A snowstorm traps town residents together inside the local inn, where newly arrived forest ranger Finn and postal worker Cecily must try to keep the peace and uncover the truth behind a mysterious creature that has begun terrorizing the community.

items.title: West of the Divide
items.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

items.title: West of the Divide
items.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

items.title: West of the Law
items.description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) link a town leader to a gold-theft gang.

items.title: West of Thunder
items.description: Henry Seed, a mysterious stranger, visits a town in South Dakota in 1899, where atrocities are committed against the Lakota people. Little Thunder, the tribe's spiritual leader, considers whether to seek revenge or to remain true to Lakota values.

items.title: Whale Guardian
items.description: Whale researcher, Nan Hauserat, is in the Cook Islands to research humpback whales.

items.title: Whales and Us
items.description: Naturalist Steve Backshall free dives into the world of whales, orcas, and dolphins as he explores their habitats, relationships, behaviors, and the threats faced by these mammals.

items.title: What Breaks the Ice
items.description: Two teenage girls from different worlds form an unlikely friendship in the sweltering summer heat of 1998, but their fun and carefree days turn cold when they find themselves at the center of a mysterious murder.

items.title: What Just Happened?
items.description: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

items.title: Eat Your Greens
items.description: Dan Souza explores the science behind our favorite foods and shares tips and tricks that you can use in your own kitchen.

items.title: Morning Routine
items.description: Dan reveals the science of cooking bacon, then makes homemade yogurt and the perfect chewy bagels.

items.title: More Sides, Please
items.description: Dan shares his go-to side dishes: roasted broccoli, Brussels sprouts, baked potatoes and dinner rolls.

items.title: What's Love Got to Do With It
items.description: Based on the life of the legendary soul singer, Tina Turner (Angela Bassett) -- born Anna Mae Bullock -- discovers her love of singing in her Tennessee church choir. She moves to St. Louis to pursue a career, and there she meets the charismatic Ike Turner (Laurence Fishburne), who rechristens her Tina and offers to help her succeed. As a musical team, Ike and Tina take the charts by storm. But as his physical abuse worsens, Tina has to make the tough decision to leave Ike and set out on her own.

items.title: When a Stranger Calls
items.description: A retired police detective hunts a deranged British seaman out to re-create a babysitter's horror.

items.title: When Darkness Falls
items.description: While trekking across the Highlands, Jess and Andrea separate and Andrea goes missing. Jess searches for her friend but stumbles into a far darker situation than she could possibly have imagined.

items.title: Hunters
items.description: Six kids work for a week at the head office of Hunters Estate agents in York; their responsibilities include running the Harrogate branch for an afternoon, marketing two new properties, running an open house and negotiating a property deal.

items.title: When the Screaming Starts
items.description: When Norman Graysmith is invited to the home of aspiring serial killer Aidan Mendle, he thinks he's found the subject of a documentary that will save his failing career.

items.title: When You Finish Saving the World
items.description: Evelyn and her oblivious son, Ziggy, seek out replacements for each other as Evelyn tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter, while Ziggy fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

items.title: Where God Left His Shoes
items.description: Frank Diaz (John Leguizamo), an unemployed boxer, and his family live in a homeless shelter for months when, on Christmas Eve, word comes that an apartment may be available. The catch is that Frank must have a job before the end of the day. So he hits the cold streets of New York, his resentful stepson (David Castro) in tow, to find a job so that his family can have a real home for Christmas morning.

items.title: Whistling Hills
items.description: A gunman is hired by stage line owner Chet Norman to stop a series of stagecoach holdups that always take place when the driver, Pete, sees a mystery rider and hears the weird notes of a silver whistle.

items.title: White Bird in a Blizzard
items.description: A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

items.title: White Comanche
items.description: Half-white, half-Comanche twin brothers Johnny Moon (William Shatner) and Notah (also Shatner) have long been estranged, but things are even worse now that Notah is a bloodthirsty outlaw, and people mistake Johnny for him. Addicted to peyote, Notah believes himself destined to lead the Comanche to victory over the whites. Despite Johnny's pleas, his brother plans to destroy Rio Hondo, which is protected by Sheriff Logan (Joseph Cotten). Will Johnny side with the town or his brother?

items.title: White God
items.description: Failing in his efforts to find his beloved owner (Zsófia Psotta), an abandoned dog eventually joins a canine revolt against their human abusers.

items.title: Whitey: United States of America v. James J. Bulger
items.description: Filmmaker Joe Berlinger examines the story of South Boston crime boss Whitey Bulger, including his sensational trial. Key players on every side reveal Bulger's influence on crime and law enforcement.

items.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
items.description: One of the funniest comics on television.

items.title: Whitney Houston: As I Am
items.description: The life and untimely death of singer and actress Whitney Houston.

items.title: Whitney Houston: The Greatest Love of All
items.description: We talk to those who knew Whitney as "Nippy", retrace her steps to stardom and revisit some of her most stunning performances.

items.title: Whitney Houston: We will always love you
items.description: Celebrating the singer's life and career; performances by Celine Dion, Jennifer Hudson, Usher, Yolanda Adams and CeCe Winans.

items.title: Who Done It: The Clue Documentary
items.description: Telling behind-the-scenes stories of 1985's "Clue," a cult classic loved by multiple generations. Includes an animated re-creation of the fourth ending, which is somewhere in the vaults of Paramount Pictures.

items.title: Who Is Clark Rockefeller?
items.description: German con artist Christian Karl Gerhartsreiter (Eric McCormack) poses as a member of the Rockefeller family.

items.title: Who Is Takahiro Shiraishi? The Chilling Story of Japan's Twitter Killer
items.description: The filmmaker discusses the life and crimes of Takahiro Shiraishi, a Japanese serial killer who murdered nine people after luring them into his apartment.

items.title: Who Killed JFK? The Conspiracies
items.description: An examination of the conspiracy theories behind who assassinated John F. Kennedy.

items.title: Whoopi Goldberg: The Winning Act
items.description: A look at the life and career of Whoopi Goldberg, an award-winning comedian, actress and human rights advocate; she is one of the few 'EGOT' winners, having won the Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony awards.

items.title: Place of Hope
items.description: The stories of hope, struggle and survival, and the incredible lengths animals will go to preserve themselves and the next generation.

items.title: The Bone War
items.description: Fearless lawmen and ruthless outlaws ride once more in this new docudrama series that chronicles the tall tales, little-known stories, and front-page headlines of the Wild West. Wild West Chronicles sets the record straight with personal accounts of the West's most notorious events directly from the mouths of the characters who lived through them. Viewers see what it was like to thrive and survive in the American West.

items.title: The Gold Rush Lawman
items.description: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too; just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

items.title: Last Shot at the OK Corral
items.description: Photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Ariz., and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gun battle, the shootout at the O.K. Corral.

items.title: Jim Roberts Cleans Up Jerome
items.description: In his first week on the job as the new constable of Jerome, Ariz., Jim Roberts gets to work arresting the town's troublemakers and teaching his timid deputy how to be a courageous lawman as they track down a stone-cold killer and his gang.

items.title: Armed and Deadly
items.description: Examine the razor-sharp claws, teeth and senses of these wild killing machines.

items.title: Wildlife
items.description: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry -- a housewife and a golf pro -- in a small town in the 1960s Montana. Nearby, an uncontrolled forest fire rages close to the Canadian border, and when Jerry loses his job -- and his sense of purpose -- he decides to join the cause of fighting the fire, leaving his wife and son to fend for themselves. Suddenly forced into the role of an adult, Joe witnesses his mother's struggle as she tries to keep her head above water.

items.title: Lydia Moecklinghoff
items.description: Profiles of those who work tirelessly for nature and animals, thus saving lives and protecting natural areas.

items.title: Wildling
items.description: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events.

items.title: William & Kate: Becoming the Prince & Princess of Wales
William & Kate: Raising a Royal Family
items.description: The Duke and the Duchess of Cambridge change the royal parenting game with their modern approach to raising the next generation of royals.

items.title: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
items.description: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.

items.title: Willow Creek
items.description: A man (Bryce Johnson) and his girlfriend (Alexie Gilmore) camp in the woods to capture firsthand evidence of Bigfoot.

items.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
items.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

items.title: Winds of the Wasteland
items.description: When the emergence of the telegraph makes their jobs as Pony Express riders obsolete, cowboys John Blair (John Wayne) and Larry Adams (Lane Chandler) hastily purchase a stagecoach line operating out of Crescent City, Calif., unaware that the place is essentially a ghost town. The congenial mayor, Rocky (Lew Kelly), convinces John to compete in a horse race against Drake (Douglas Cosgrove), the man who sold them the bum deal, for a coveted government contract in postal delivery.

items.title: Winning of the West
items.description: Muckraking newspaperman John Randolph (William Forrest), using information gleaned from his faithful printer, Smiley (Smiley Burnette), can expose powerful local businessmen Art Selby (Robert Livingston) and Clint Raybold (Gregg Barton) as the brains behind a series of thefts blamed on local Native Americans. Fiercely devoted ranger Gene Autry (Gene Autry) is assigned to protect Randolph, but his foes include his own outlaw brother, Jack (Richard Crane), who is working for Selby and Raybold.

items.title: Wishmaster
items.description: A gemologist (Tammy Lauren) unwittingly frees an evil genie (Andrew Divoff) that plays deadly tricks on her friends and acquaintances.

items.title: Wishmaster 2: Evil Never Dies
items.description: A thief, Morgana (Holly Fields), accidentally frees an ancient supernatural creature known as the Djinn (Andrew Divoff) from his bottle when she botches an art heist. The Djinn lets Morgana get away and takes responsibility for the crime. Now disguised as a human, the Djinn is arrested and sent to jail, which he relishes since he can now claim the souls of the prison population. On the outside, Morgana and a priest unite to re-bottle the Djinn for good.

items.title: Wishmaster 3: Sword of Justice
items.description: A college student (A.J. Cook) tries to stop an evil genie (John Novak) from granting deadly wishes to unsuspecting victims.

items.title: Wishmaster 4: The Prophecy Fulfilled
items.description: A genie must grant three wishes to a troubled woman (Tara Spencer-Nairn) in order to awaken his evil cohorts.

items.title: Witchboard
items.description: When Jim (Todd Allen) and Linda (Tawny Kitaen) decide to throw a party, Linda's ex-boyfriend -- and Jim's ex-friend -- Brandon (Stephen Nichols) brings out a Ouija board to contact a pleasant, childish spirit named David with whom he communicates often. Apparently, the lines get crossed, because they instead reach across the supernatural divide to the decidedly less pleasant Malfeitor, who uses his connection to the world of the living to wreak havoc and terrify his new acquaintances.

items.title: Witchery
items.description: A photographer and others are stranded at a Massachusetts island hotel which is haunted by a woman in black.

items.title: Wolf
items.description: An ex-con's (Marwan Kenzari) violent tendencies serve him well as he muscles his way up the ladders of the kickboxing and organized-crime underworlds.

items.title: WolfCop
items.description: An alcoholic cop blacks out and wakes up in unfamiliar surroundings, and crime scenes seem oddly familiar when the full moon is out.

items.title: Wolves
items.description: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

items.title: Woman at War
items.description: Halla is a 50-year-old environmental activist who crusades against the local aluminum industry in Iceland. As her actions grow bolder, her life changes in the blink of an eye when she's finally granted permission to adopt a girl from Ukraine.

items.title: Woman Thou Art Loosed
items.description: When Michelle is only 12 years old, she is raped by Reggie, the boyfriend of her mother. When her mother does not believe her accusations, Michelle runs away and begins a downward spiral that includes drugs and prostitution, eventually landing in prison. There she hears of Bishop T.D. Jakes (playing himself), a preacher who works with women like her. Jakes takes an interest in Michelle's case and visits her.

items.title: Ecuador's Hidden Treasure
items.description: Three female scientists investigate Ecuador's endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

items.title: From The Lab To The Field
items.description: Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya to turn parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

items.title: Kyrgyzstan's Space School
items.description: A defiant all-girls space-tech school aims to build Kyrgyzstan's first satellite, a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry.

items.title: Problems
items.description: "The Monty Hall Problem" poses a counter-instinctive dilemma of picking a choice with a higher probability of winning; "The Birthday Problem" presents a situation that addresses brains' unintuitive response to exponents.

items.title: Mystery Unlocked
items.description: Step into the world of reclaimed design, where every material carries a past. Bo and Kyle of Woodward Throwbacks source, restore and transform salvaged materials into one-of-a-kind furniture and spaces, uncovering the history embedded in each piece.

items.title: Raising the Bar
items.description: On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

items.title: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
items.description: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

items.title: The Reclaimed Kitchen
items.description: Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

items.title: Designed to Dine
items.description: Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

items.title: The Backyard Blueprint
items.description: Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

Among the experiments presented is one that gained Spangler fame, in which he showed what happens when a mint candy is dropped into a bottle of diet soda. The conflicts play out through re-enactments that feature interviews with modern-day visionaries like Bill Nye, Steve Wozniak, Jack Welch, Steve Wynn and Michio Kaku.

Sheen stars as Charlie, a former professional baseball player whose career was ended by an injury caused by his anger issues. Charlie went back to school after his playing career ended and now works as a therapist who specializes in anger management. In addition to weekly sessions with his primary group of patients, Charlie does pro bono counseling for a group of inmates at a state prison. Even though he now helps others control their anger problems, Charlie continues to battle his own anger issues. Complicating his life are his relationships with his own therapist -- his ex-wife, whose positive outlook frustrates Charlie -- and his teenage daughter, who has obsessive-compulsive disorder.

For Paul Rosenberg and his buddies, the thrill of lacing the skates and hitting the ice to compete for local men's team The Chubbys is their bonding agent, strong enough that it's turned irrational and caused Paul all sorts of issues with his wife, Karen. Meanwhile, along for the ride are Paul's best friends Anthony, the charmer who schemes his way through life; Dicky, the wealthy hedge fund manager whose answer to everything is in his wallet; and Sebalos, the slacker on a misguided search for his purpose.

The hourlong series takes viewers deep inside the world of crime fighting through high-profile criminal cases that were ultimately solved by advances in forensic science or technology. Driven by first-person storytelling, episodes feature the lead detectives of each case and a supporting cast of forensic scientists who highlight how technology is changing the face of criminal investigations.

Prior to moving to New Orleans, the Talaveras ran an antiques business. As you can imagine, running a wedding chapel in the Big Easy is more interesting (to put it lightly) than running an antiques business. They have seen it all while in the wedding business -- from barroom brawls to quirky cemetery ceremonies. The chapel's staff includes take-no-prisoners wedding planner Maria, musician Dana, security guard Gino and feisty photographer Mia. The Talaveras and their staff are committed to making sure each couple experience an unforgettable wedding day ... Big Easy style.

providerSeries.description: A prequel to the classic Robert Louis Stevenson novel "Treasure Island," "Black Sails" is a pirate adventure that centers on the tales of Captain Flint, who has a reputation throughout the West Indies as being the most brilliant, most feared of all the Golden Age pirates. It's 1715, and as Flint fights for the survival of New Providence Island -- a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers -- in the wake of threats from British and Spanish forces, he aligns himself with Eleanor Guthrie, daughter of the local kingpin, to hunt the ultimate prize and ensure his people's survival. But standing in the way are rival captains, Eleanor's intrusive father, and perhaps the bigger obstacle of all: John Silver, a young, fast-talking, authority-flouting sailor recently added to Flint's crew.

Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring.

providerSeries.description: There's money to be made in commercial fishing, even if the job is to catch freshwater fish that other trawlers rarely want -- bottom-feeding fish like carp and suckers. "Bottom Feeders" follows the lives and struggles of a group of fishermen as they battle the working conditions and one another while riding the lakes and rivers of the Midwest for the chance to net thousands of pounds of carp, sheepshead and buffalo fish. The operations are a mix of small-time businesses and multiman, automated teams, but all share the same goal: to catch the big haul and put food on the family table.

providerSeries.title: Bottomless Brunch at Colman's

providerSeries.description: Brides, grooms and members of their wedding parties compete with other brides, grooms and family in mental and physical challenges to win a cash prize for their big day.

providerSeries.title: Bridezillas
providerSeries.description: Godzilla has nothing on a bride-to-be planning her dream wedding, as evidenced by the aptly named "Bridezillas." The docu-series follows women who were perfectly normal before wedding planning took over her life. Grimly determined to realize their "dream wedding" at all costs, these out-of-control brides make the time leading up to their day of days an utter nightmare for everyone around them. In the end, they hope all the stress and meltdowns are worth it and they have the perfect wedding they've been dreaming of since they were little.

providerSeries.title: Brockmire
providerSeries.description: Hank Azaria and Amanda Peet co-star in "Brockmire," a half-hour comedy series that began years ago as a viral short video on the Funny or Die website. The series centers on the fall of Jim Brockmire, a once-famed major league baseball announcer who suffers an embarrassing on-air meltdown caused by his wife's serial infidelity, leading to a decade away from the booth. Older and presumably wiser, Brockmire attempts to reclaim his career, reputation and love life by returning behind the mic, but the setting -- a broken-down rust belt town, home of the minor league's Morristown Frackers -- is not quite what he envisioned. Strong-willed, hard-drinking owner Julia James has a complicated relationship with Brockmire, while whiz-kid intern Charles is simultaneously entertained by and terrified of the new announcer.

providerSeries.title: Bryan's All In

providerSeries.title: Building to the Sky
providerSeries.description: Skyscrapers have dominated city landscapes for more than 100 years. Since debuting as 10-story buildings in the late 19th century, these tall towers have constantly evolved as architects and structural engineers pushed the boundaries of what's possible. This series unlocks the inner workings of these goliaths, spotlighting what cities such as Chicago, London, Melbourne and Tokyo are doing to transform their skylines with designs that seem to defy gravity. Each episode gives viewers exclusive looks at high-rises, among them Chicago's 82-story Aqua; the 1,500-feet-tall Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur; the landmark Jin Mao Tower in Shanghai; and the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest skyscraper.

providerSeries.title: Bunk
providerSeries.description: Offbeat games and bizarre challenges are the foundation for the on-the-spot comedy created in this new breed of game show. The contestants, a roster of comedians that includes Alex Borstein, Ben Garant, Thomas Lennon, Bobby Moynihan, Kumail Nanjiani and Nicole Parker, play games such as "Top This Lie," where they must out-fib host Kurt Braunohler in a rapid-fire succession of untruths, and "Wordy and the Tramp," where they provide answers to a series of disconnected questions while they and the host bounce on trampolines. The players are also challenged to -- among many other wacky tasks -- invent new sins, break harsh news to children, compose and sing original songs about grandmothers, and decide what mankind will evolve into next.

providerSeries.title: Business of Beauty
providerSeries.description: Cheddar's Business of series takes you behind the scenes of industries from food to fashion, showing how companies expand and innovate.

providerSeries.description: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job. Judge Frank Caprio is the Chief Municipal Judge in Providence, R.I. and former Chairman of the Rhode Island Board of Governors. He was appointed in 1985 and has been reappointed six times.

providerSeries.title: Cause of Death
providerSeries.description: Following real-life coroner's investigations into medical and police processes in a previously taboo world.

providerSeries.title: Cheyenne
providerSeries.description: Debuting in 1955, "Cheyenne" made history as television's first hourlong western and introduced brawny actor Clint Walker to the world as the jack-of-all-trades loner Cheyenne Bodie. Raised by an American Indian tribe after the death of his parents, the physically imposing Cheyenne calls upon the many skills learned from his past as he wanders the Old West, finding action and adventure at every turn. Like many other productions during the Golden Age of Television, "Cheyenne" had its share of guest stars who would later become famous in their own right, including Rod Taylor, Dennis Hopper, George Kennedy, James Garner, Richard Crenna and Michael Landon.

providerSeries.title: Chocolicious

providerSeries.title: Cities of the Underworld
providerSeries.description: A camera crew descends hundreds of feet below the streets of major cities -- such as New York, Cairo, London and Tokyo -- to explore the layered remnants of civilizations left buried deep under modern metropolitan centers.

providerSeries.title: Close Proximity
providerSeries.description: Professional drift racer Matt Field is followed across the United States as he takes on the 2016 Formula Drift Championship Series while balancing life as a business owner and navigating complex business and personal relationships.

providerSeries.title: Cold as Balls
providerSeries.description: Kevin Hart hops in the post-game cold tub to chat up different sports personalities.

providerSeries.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
providerSeries.description: As chronicled in Truman Capote's landmark book, "In Cold Blood," this docuseries takes a fresh, in-depth look at the legendary murder case of the Clutter family in a small Kansas town in 1959, a crime seemingly without motive. The four-hour event uses firsthand accounts of relatives, family friends, townspeople and law enforcement -- some of whom are speaking publicly about the murder for the first time. There's also never-before-seen details such as original photographs, audio recordings, and documents from the case, as well as memoirs and letters from the murderers and their families. Acclaimed filmmaker Joe Berlinger directs and co-produces.

providerSeries.title: CombiNATION Plates
providerSeries.description: Chefs Bianca Osbourne and Craig Wong take a culinary trip around the world, exploring two cultures and two cuisines.

providerSeries.title: Comedy Bang! Bang!
providerSeries.description: Upon first look, "Comedy Bang! Bang!" is like any late-night talk show... until the guests sit down and the interviews commence. Then it veers off in all sorts of directions, most of which include unfiltered and improvised dialogue. The show is based on host Scott Aukerman's popular podcast of the same name (and most certainly influenced by the Internet mock-talk show "Between Two Ferns With Zach Galifianakis," which Aukerman produced and directed). In each episode, Aukerman reinvents the traditional celebrity interview by engaging his guests in ad-libbed banter, all of which is punctuated by beats from "bandleader" Reggie Watts or, in later episodes, "Weird Al" Yankovic.

providerSeries.title: Comfort Eating
providerSeries.description: Nick Helm explores the foods of the United Kingdom in a program that is part comedy, part travelogue, and part restaurant review.

providerSeries.title: Comic Book Men
providerSeries.description: AMC dives into the comic book culture with this unscripted series that follows the antics of the "fanboys" in and around Jay and Silent Bob's Secret Stash, a New Jersey comic shop owned by writer-director Kevin Smith. Cameras capture the banter of the shop's employees and its customers as they collectively discover the treasures of the comic collecting world, and the staff -- de-facto leader Walt, shop whipping boy Ming and comic book virtuoso Mike among them -- shares all the details with Smith via a podcast that is woven throughout the series. Smith has been a comics fan since his youth and has written several comic books based on his movies, including "Clerks," as well as story arcs for the legendary "Green Arrow" and "Daredevil" comics.

providerSeries.title: Common Knowledge
providerSeries.description: Two teams of three compete to answer practical, everyday questions that everyone should know; Joey Fatone hosts.

The hosts are joined by test cooks Morgan Bolling, Lawman Johnson, Christie Morrison, Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof and Kelly Song. Episodes include equipment recommendations for the home cook, taste tests and regional recipes such as coastal Georgia paella and mesquite-grilled tacos rasurados.

From the first 911 call to the final verdict, every confrontation is presented in vivid detail. The result is a visceral experience, a 360-degree view of each case. Each critical moment occurs in real time as officers and detectives face life-or-death decisions on the front lines for justice.

Her ally, Congo native Mushiya, started The Damn Salon in her kitchen and now caters to high-fashion clients by using several natural styling techniques. Beautii, a veteran in the Atlanta market, is known for making up celebrities such as Grammy winner Regina Bell, Tamika Tiny Harris of "Family Hustle" and Kandi Burruss of "Real Housewives of Atlanta." Dedra combines artistic talents with savvy, aggressive business instincts, which creates a rift in this circle of businesswomen. Dedra's weave expert, LaKenya, befriends the other salon owners as she follows her dream to open her own shop.

To investigators, water can be a great hindrance, making the gathering of evidence all the more challenging. But investigators have devised some extraordinary measures to find what they are looking for when a crime involves water. Each episode of this series deals with a specific water-related crime, and the methods employed by crime lab specialists to bring the perpetrators to justice.

Also planning a baby shower -- for his life -- may be on Tutera's docket as he awaits the birth of his own child. But not everything is coming up roses for the reality star, for his nearly decadelong marriage has come to an end.

"Jersey Shore's" JWoww, rapper Lil' Kim and musical siblings Brandy and Ray J -- who needs a last name when you're famous? -- are among the stars who use Tutera's expansive knowledge, although their sometimes-outrageous demands don't make it easy for him to do things the way he wants. The soirees include a baby shower, anniversary party and, of course, a dream wedding.

providerSeries.title: Dietland
providerSeries.description: Based on Sarai Walker's best-selling novel of the same name, "Dietland" offers a darkly comedic look at the war of the sexes. The series explores a multitude of issues women face today -- including patriarchy, misogyny, rape culture and unrealistic beauty standards -- by following Plum Kettle's journey to self-awakening. A ghostwriter for the editor of one of New York's hottest fashion magazines, Plum has waged a lifelong battle with her image. Fed up, she turns to weight-loss surgery but ends up in the middle of two rival feminist factions -- one that may be responsible for the attacks on male harassers, and the other that preaches female empowerment. As she straddles the two groups, Plum must decide what part she plays in a wildly complicated, changing world.
