providerSeries.title: Dispatches From Elsewhere
providerSeries.description: "Dispatches From Elsewhere" is an anthology series from creator and star Jason Segal. The story centers around four ordinary people - Peter, Simone, Janice, and Fredwynn -- who are brought together by chance after they all respond to a flyer. Feeling as though something is missing in their lives, the characters are drawn into a game that unfolds in a serpentine series of events, taking them from parades to shareholders' meetings. As they piece together the puzzle to find a path forward, they come to delve deeper into a mind-boggling mystery hiding just behind the facade of everyday life and their eyes are opened to a world of possibility, whimsy and wonder. The 10-episode series features an ensemble cast including Sally Field, Richard E. Grant, André Benjamin, and Eve Lindley.

providerSeries.title: Divided
providerSeries.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.

providerSeries.title: DIY Giftshop
providerSeries.description: Step into the season of making with DIY Giftshop on CraftsyTV, your go-to destination for holiday crafting magic. From handmade gifts and festive décor to edible treats and clever crafting hacks, this curated programming block is packed with tutorials, tips, and inspiration to help you create from the heart.

providerSeries.title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
providerSeries.description: Salt Lake City DIY star Kylie Katich visits the homes of her stylish influencer friends to tackle their biggest home design dilemmas. With her signature charm, endless reservoir of creativity, and eternal 'let's make it happen' attitude, Kylie brings smart, everyday DIY solutions to life-infusing each space with style, function, and fun. With a little ingenuity and a lot of heart, Kylie proves that no space is too small-and no idea too bold-for a beautiful, budget-friendly makeover.

providerSeries.title: DNA Dinners
providerSeries.description: Participants take a DNA test to learn about their genetic origins and their heritage's cuisine and cooking techniques.

providerSeries.title: Documentary Now!
providerSeries.description: "Saturday Night Live" compatriots Fred Armisen, Bill Hader and Seth Meyers serve as creators, executive producers and writers of this IFC original series, using their love of documentary films and combining it with comedy to present a unique take on the form. Hosted by Dame Helen Mirren and starring Armisen and Hader, each episode is shot in a different documentary film style, paying tribute to some of the most important stories that didn't actually happen. "SNL" creator Lorne Michaels also executive produces "Documentary Now!", and guest stars include Jack Black and John Slattery.

providerSeries.title: Dog Whisperer
providerSeries.description: With a unique ability to see the world through their eyes, renowned dog behavior expert Cesar Millan rehabilitates all manner of troubled canines in this popular reality series, and often that involves Millan not only teaching dogs new tricks but also training their owners how to achieve a balanced relationship with their pets.

providerSeries.title: Don't Look Deeper
providerSeries.description: In near-future California, high-school senior Aisha learns a dark secret about herself and goes from dreams of graduation to running for her life.

providerSeries.title: Downsized
providerSeries.description: Five-minute showers. Changing the car's oil at home. Hair cuts from your sister/daughter. These are the new realities of life for the Bruce family. They were living the American dream until the economy took a nosedive; suddenly, money got tighter and investments vanished. So this blended family with seven children had to make serious adjustments to get out of debt and back on track. Their journey may look familiar to many, and may make others realize how lucky they are. Each episode also offers some of the family's money-saving tips.

providerSeries.title: Dr. Miami
providerSeries.description: There's no shortage of attractive people in Miami, but some of them needed some artificial help to get that way, and many of those folks probably went to Dr. Michael Salzhauer. He is such a prolific plastic surgeon around the city that he has earned the nickname Dr. Miami. The surgeon has even gained a worldwide following by sharing the uncensored, and sometimes unconventional, procedures that he performs on his patients, who he calls "beauty warriors." Whether it's a tummy tuck, a breast augmentation or a nose job, Dr. Miami isn't afraid to livestream it on social media, which is the job of social media coordinators Brittany and Ashley -- who are always vying for the doctor's attention. Dr. Miami's sister-in-law Rosy runs the practice as its COO, and her responsibilities include being the unofficial staff therapist.

providerSeries.title: Dr. Phur
providerSeries.description: Featuring pets who can't handle you giving attention to anyone else.

providerSeries.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
providerSeries.description: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

providerSeries.title: Drag Latina
providerSeries.description: Contestants from Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Mexico, Puerto Rico and more compete in a multinational drag competition.

providerSeries.title: Dragnet
providerSeries.description: Just the facts, ma'am. Every week, Sgt. Joe Friday follows the clues, interviews witnesses and spews a lot of crime jargon as he tries to catch one perp or another. For the majority of the show's 1950s run, he was partnered with Officer Smith, but when the show was brought back in 1967, he had Officer Gannon as a partner.

providerSeries.title: Driven to Love
providerSeries.description: There's no shortage of dating shows on cable, so shows need a unique aspect to stand out from the crowd. "Driven to Love" has that in the form of a "tricked-out love taxi," to use the network's term for the vehicle. Host Ray J serves as the driver as he helps a single person find love through five potential dates while cruising along the streets of New York City. Ray J also serves as the dater's wingman, offering advice and choosing prospective mates for the romantic meetings that happen both inside and outside the vehicle. But it's ultimately up to the dater to decide which potential suitors to give a chance. When Ray J drives up to a potential date, the single decides whether to drive past, let the suitor into the vehicle, or even kick out the current mate to let in the new one. In the end, the contestant chooses one mate with whom to go on a romantic getaway.

providerSeries.title: Droners
providerSeries.description: Going behind-the-scenes at an international racing tournament to discover the young pilots climbing the ranks and raking in the cash along the way.

providerSeries.title: Dropped
providerSeries.description: Participants are dropped into the wilderness and must survive.

providerSeries.title: Dublin Murders
providerSeries.description: Detectives Rob Reilly and Cassie Maddox find themselves dispatched to investigate the murder of a young girl on the outskirts of Dublin, Ireland. Based on the books "In the Woods" and "The Likeness" by American-Irish writer Tana French, this psychological thriller features a cast of mostly Irish actors, including Killian Scott and Sarah Greene as the leads. The series follows the detectives, who put their friendship to the test, as they are pulled deeper into the intrigue and darkness that surrounds the case.

providerSeries.title: Earth's Eternal Wonders
providerSeries.description: Earth's Eternal Wonders explores spectacular landscapes and Earth's formation with scientists, using CGI to bring the planet's history to life.

providerSeries.title: Eco-Trip: The Real Cost of Living
providerSeries.description: Environmental concerns.

providerSeries.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre
providerSeries.description: The mistress of the dark presents scary movies and provides commentary.

providerSeries.title: Emeril Cooks
providerSeries.description: New Orleans locals visit Emeril Lagasse's kitchen to see firsthand how he makes the dishes they helped inspire, from piping hot beignets to icy cold sake made with Louisiana-grown rice.

providerSeries.title: Emeril Live
providerSeries.description: Chef Emeril Lagasse kicks things up a notch, or three, as he whips up an assortment of gourmet dishes before a live audience that treats him like a rock star.

providerSeries.title: Emeril Tailgates
providerSeries.description: Football fans visit Emeril Lagasse's kitchen to learn how to make new tailgate dishes that will make their friends and family members proud.

providerSeries.title: Emeril Tailgates: The Postseason
providerSeries.description: This football season Emeril has been sharing recipes inspired by different cities; now that we're entering the post season, Emeril will show you how to make the dishes he serves at his own tailgates.

providerSeries.title: Emeril's Table
providerSeries.description: World-renowned chef and restaurateur Emeril Lagasse invites five guests to his chef's table as he prepares a meal for the quintet in each episode of this series. The chef provides a cooking lesson as only he can for the guests -- including newlyweds, busy mothers and firefighters -- and viewers in the intimate half-hour program. Lagasse inspires and engages his guests as he answers their culinary questions and helps with their food dilemmas. He also shares his fresh, fun recipes and provides tips and techniques people can employ in their own kitchens.

providerSeries.title: Emogenius
providerSeries.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s.

providerSeries.title: Empire Builders
providerSeries.description: Exploring the great empires that have come and gone through the ages.

providerSeries.title: Empire Builders: Mexico
providerSeries.description: Violent and bloody struggles define the culture and identity of Mexico.

providerSeries.title: Engaged with JoJo and Jordan
providerSeries.description: First comes reality TV, then comes engagement, then comes… real life! Jojo and Jordan fell in love in front of millions of viewers and now they’re letting you in on their day-to-day struggles, solutions, and fun along the way. They are navigating life on their own terms- together and engaged!

providerSeries.title: Engineering Reborn
providerSeries.description: Ignite your curiosity with INWONDER, your gateway to the extraordinary.

providerSeries.title: Engineering the Future
providerSeries.description: Dedicated individuals aim to engineer extraordinary machines to change people's lives.

providerSeries.title: Entertain Like Martha
providerSeries.description: Martha discusses a very good thing: Holiday Entertaining. With the re-release of her first book, Martha provides recipes and inspiration for special gatherings. Plus, the perfect product and tools to make everything easier.

providerSeries.title: Essence of Emeril
providerSeries.description: Cajun and Creole cuisine.

providerSeries.title: Every Detail
providerSeries.description: Anthony W. Robins and Sam Roberts highlight the architectural details of legendary structures.

providerSeries.title: Ex Isle
providerSeries.description: This relationship show takes five former couples and sends them to a secluded resort in the Dominican Republic in an attempt to help them gain closure so they can move on to new relationships. While at the resort, the participants are cut off from all distractions -- no phones, friends or family -- and guided by psychiatrist Dr. Ish Major, who specializes in broken relationships. Major leads the couples through a multistep process designed to help them conquer their past issues. Host Carmen Electra offers help in the process by sharing her own relationship stories. During the series, the couples are thrown a curveball when 10 singles enter the mix, giving the exes a chance at finding new love.

providerSeries.title: Exceptional Engineering
providerSeries.description: Exploring behind-the-scenes at the construction, design and operation of mega-projects and more.

providerSeries.title: Exhibition Awesome
providerSeries.description: From extreme sports and gymnastics to fitness, martial arts and more.

providerSeries.title: Exploring Venus
providerSeries.description: A look at why life flourishes on Earth but doesn't on Venus.

providerSeries.title: Extraordinary Weddings
providerSeries.description: Following couples who have fought the odds and overcome immense challenges, before finally getting married; the couples share their stories.

providerSeries.title: Extravagant Spaces
providerSeries.description: There are everyday homes and then there are homes with a little something extra; Designer Kelli Ellis takes her curiosity behind the doors homes.

providerSeries.title: Extreme Love
providerSeries.description: Based on the popular digital series of the same name, "Extreme Love" focuses on all manners of wild and unique instances of love. Such tales of vampires, sister wives, polyamorous couples, sugar babies and adult babies, unique fantasies, and many other unique relationships. These unique relationships prove that there is someone out there for everyone. Shocking and outrageous, these are love stories with a twist.

providerSeries.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
providerSeries.description: A group of marine rescue experts protect the Queensland coastline from toxic spills, environmental hazards and marine wreckage.

providerSeries.title: Extreme Snakes
providerSeries.description: The filmmaker sheds light on some of the deadliest species of snakes in Africa and Australia, presenting details about their life cycle and survival instincts.

providerSeries.description: Extremes is a series that features the longest largest tallest most expensive fastest smallest oldest remotest loudest most extreme machines people locations lifestyles and achievements.

providerSeries.title: F Troop
providerSeries.description: The accidentally heroic and chronically inept Wilton Parmenter is given command of Fort Courage, Kan., a dumping ground for the Army's least useful men, at the end of the Civil War. There, he contends with the illegal business enterprises of crafty Sgt. O'Rourke and the local Indians, occasional mock (and even more occasionally real) battles, and the romantic attentions of Wrangler Jane Angelica Thrift.

providerSeries.description: From surprise wipeouts to instant regret, these fails happen before anyone can react.

providerSeries.title: FailArmy Expectations vs. Reality
providerSeries.description: Sky-high dreams meet low-down landings. Watch high-hopes kiss the ground in spectacular style.

providerSeries.title: FailArmy Now
providerSeries.description: What do birds, fish and lunch have in common?; they're all in "FailArmy Now."

providerSeries.description: Every success begins with a failure; this is for people who go out and try; they laugh in the face of failure, and don't take themselves too seriously.

providerSeries.description: Grab your shades and sunscreen, it's time to test your smarts with a summer themed edition of "FailArmy Trivia."

providerSeries.title: Fails From the Vault
providerSeries.description: The best girl fails of all time meet the most expensive fails 2017 had to offer in this blast from the FailArmy past.

providerSeries.title: Fall of Fame
providerSeries.description: Athletes take on the game, their gear and gravity; they prove that sometimes failing is the real sport.

providerSeries.title: Fame Kills
providerSeries.description: Being a celebrity isn't all it's cracked up to be. Sure, there's the money, big houses and star-studded parties, but there's also a seedier side to fame. Jealousy, greed and murder are among the negative aspects of being famous and are regular subjects of this docuseries that profiles some rising stars whose roads to fame took detours, encountering deadly situations. Each hourlong episode tells one star-to-be's story from its rise to the untimely end. Re-enactments, interviews with friends and loved ones, and testimony from witnesses and detectives help to tell each tale.

providerSeries.title: Fame Kills
providerSeries.description: Exploring four of the most celebrated and renowned celebrities of the 20th century, all of whom have one thing in common: their stardom eventually led them to their misfortune.

providerSeries.title: Fame to Table
providerSeries.description: Join Matthew Hoffman as he descends on the kitchens of famous chefs who will serve up their most recognizable recipes - from the dish that put them on the map, to the first recipe they made on live TV, to the dish that wooed their spouse. Through an eye-opening house tour that culminates in a mouth-watering dish, Matthew will play sous chef to some of the most celebrated chefs on the planet in the comfort of their own kitchens.

providerSeries.title: Family Feud Favorites
providerSeries.description: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites. This fast-paced clip show delivers the funniest, most viral and most unforgettable highlights from America's favorite game show. From hilariously wrong answers to Steve Harvey's one-of-a kind reactions, "Family Feud Favorites" captures the best moments that fans can't stop talking about.

providerSeries.title: Fatal Attraction
providerSeries.description: Michael Douglas and Glenn Close are nowhere to be found in this docuseries that explores the potential consequences when an all-consuming romance causes people to commit unthinkable criminal acts in the name of love. Each hourlong episode brings together first-person testimonials with evocative cinematography and interrogation footage to illustrate the crime and the incidents that led up to it. The show opens with the crime before entering flashback mode and using re-enactments to provide a glimpse into the heart of the dangerous romance prior to the act being committed.

providerSeries.title: Fatal Crimes
providerSeries.description: Exploring murders committed using the world's deadliest weapons -- guns.

providerSeries.title: Fear Factor
providerSeries.description: A group of contestants is challenged to perform a number of terrifying and/or disgusting stunts, from driving a dangerous course to eating something really nasty. If a contestant refuses a challenge, fails in a challenge, or has the worst performance in a challenge, that contestant is eliminated from the competition. The contestant (or team) that manages to complete all of the stunts, including finishing the final stunt in the fastest time, wins the $50,000 prize. The rest? Well, they get nothing (except maybe a mouthful of worms). Joe Rogan hosts.

providerSeries.description: Coverage of the annual series where national teams of riders compete against one another for points across various international legs.

providerSeries.description: A deeper look into the equestrian world and the bond between humans and horses.

providerSeries.description: Coverage of auto races held as part of the Ferrari Challenge.

providerSeries.title: Ferrari Challenge UK
providerSeries.description: Each round comprised two races for the Ferrari Challenge Trofeo Pirelli UK championship.

providerSeries.title: FIBA 3x3 Basketball World Tour
providerSeries.description: Professional basketball players compete in the FIBA 3x3 Basketball World Tour.

providerSeries.title: Fight to Survive
providerSeries.description: Faith, determination and human spirit abound in "Fight to Survive," which recounts stories of people's deadly ordeals in the outdoors. Accompanying survivors back to where harrowing events occurred is rock-climber Craig DeMartino, who is featured in the premiere episode. His right leg was amputated below the knee after a climbing accident, but he continued in his sport. In 2006 he became the first amputee to free-climb the 3,200-foot face of Yosemite's El Capitan in one day. Other stories tell of sailor Steven Callahan clinging to a raft in the Atlantic, fisherman Dean Ririe trapped by a boulder in icy water, and hiker Ted Porter falling into a glacial crevasse.

providerSeries.title: Find Me a Classic
providerSeries.description: Skilled classic car expert Mat Watson has five days to hunt down a great car within a fixed budget.

providerSeries.title: Finding Nowhere
providerSeries.description: An experienced outdoorsman pulls his city-raised cousin into the wild, where hunting, fishing, and foraging become lessons in survival, humility, and the quiet power of living off the land.

providerSeries.title: First on Scene
providerSeries.description: Video journalists and on-scene experts examine the first moments of high-profile disasters across the U.S. with footage that video journalists capture and commentary that on-scene experts provide.

providerSeries.title: Fish the Dish
providerSeries.description: Chef Spencer Watts demonstrates how to make fish and seafood approachable for amateur cooks.

providerSeries.title: Fix My Family
providerSeries.description: Families featured on this hourlong series need fixing, and licensed therapist Tara Fields is ready to help. Their problems have gotten to the point that they feel the need to turn to the no-nonsense therapist as a last-ditch effort to keep peace. During the therapy sessions, Fields confronts parents and children regarding the way they communicate and behave with one another. Fields' methods include assigning tasks designed to put whole families on a path to stronger, happier days and give each one the skills and tools necessary for a lifetime of peaceful family dynamics.

providerSeries.title: Flip Side
providerSeries.description: Explores answers to questions from differing perspectives; host Jaleel White.

providerSeries.title: Floods - Challenging our Future
providerSeries.description: Floods are a growing threat to the Earth, posing engineering and technological challenges.

providerSeries.title: Flour Power
providerSeries.description: Host Jessica McGovern proves just how easy it is to bake a simple, delicious treat for any event from a bake sale to an elegant dinner party.

providerSeries.title: Food Party
providerSeries.description: A surreal adventure through space and time with multi-course, out-of-this-world gourmet meals brought to life by hostess Thu Tran with a cast of color puppets and celebrity guests.

providerSeries.title: Footvolley
providerSeries.description: The best Footvolley action from around the world.

providerSeries.title: For My Man
providerSeries.description: When people get married, they often promise to do anything for their new spouses. When the women profiled in this docuseries say they'll do anything, they mean anything. "For My Man" tells stories of women who have been arrested -- part of the growing female population in the criminal justice system -- for crimes that they committed in the name of love. The crimes committed range from becoming an inside informant at the DEA for a drug-addicted partner to turning on one's own family members at a jealous boyfriend's request, and even as extreme as going on a killing spree across the Midwest.

providerSeries.title: Forensic Factor
providerSeries.description: Based on true crimes solved by an elite team of investigators, "Forensic Factor" details the trade secrets used by the world's best sleuths to nab the most elusive criminals, with re-enactments of crucial incidents and firsthand accounts from the experts providing depth and insight.

providerSeries.title: Four in a Bed
providerSeries.description: Four pairs of Bed and Breakfast owners compete for the best establishment.

providerSeries.title: Four of a Kind
providerSeries.description: Calli, Kendra, Megan and Sarah Durst are identical quadruplets in their senior year of high school in Minnesota. The show chronicles the trials and tribulations the sisters experience while trying to juggle school with their personal lives. The girls deal with the possibility of splitting up as they decide which colleges to attend. Their mother, Naomi, faces potentially having an empty nest for the first time in many years as the quadruplets' older brother, Travis, is also heading to college.

providerSeries.title: Freakshow
providerSeries.description: The people employed by Todd Ray don't mind being called "freaks." In fact, they might even take it as a compliment. That's because "freak," according to Ray, means the most special, the unique, the magical creatures of the universe. And Ray looks all over the world for such creatures to add to his business, the Venice Beach Freakshow, a carnie-style attraction with an attached museum of strange, wondrous oddities. This reality series follows Ray, his wife, Danielle, and their two kids, Asia and Phoenix, as they operate the Freakshow on the boardwalk of Venice Beach, Calif. The Rays also open their home to their employees, who include Brianna Belladonna ("The Indestructible Woman"); body-modification artist Marcus "The Creature"; Morgue, who specializes in "shock" performances; and Murrugun "The Mystic," a veteran sideshow star known for sword-swallowing and human pincushion acts.

providerSeries.title: Fred Dinenage: Murder Casebook
providerSeries.description: A documentary series focusing on British criminals and serial killers.

providerSeries.title: French Ligue 1 Soccer
providerSeries.description: Coverage of matches played as part of France's premier football league.

providerSeries.title: Fresh Quilting
providerSeries.description: Modern quilters take traditional designs and apply their own fresh twist in this series co-produced by the Modern Quilt Guild and KS Inc. Productions. Inspiring viewers to create high-impact quilts, the series also features segments on community sewing, including tips and tricks from Modern Quilt Guild members and leaders. Some topics covered include charity quilting events; using templates to create contemporary curves; graphic quilt samplers with bold-colored triangles; whimsical quilted designs; and designs made with die-cut shapes.

providerSeries.title: Frontier Vets
providerSeries.description: Follows final year vet students over 4 weeks as they run an animal clinic in a remote community.

providerSeries.title: Fury
providerSeries.description: After he is taken into custody following a police fight, troubled city orphan Joey finds new purpose in his life when he moves to the Broken Wheel Ranch. Jim Newton, a recent widower, owns the ranch, and adopts Joey, also giving the boy a beautiful black horse named Fury. The horse frequently saves the day when visitors get into trouble on the ranch.

providerSeries.title: Future Boy Conan
providerSeries.description: Twenty years after a terrible war destroyed civilization, a boy named Conan and his new friend Lana set out to stop shadowy operatives from gaining control of what's left of the world.

providerSeries.title: Future Boy Conan
providerSeries.description: Twenty years after a terrible war destroyed civilization, a boy named Conan and his new friend Lana set out to stop shadowy operatives from gaining control of what's left of the world.

providerSeries.title: Future Warfare
providerSeries.description: The world is entering a new era of warfare, with cyber and autonomous weapons taking center stage. These technologies are making militaries faster, smarter, more efficient. But if unchecked, they threaten to destabilize the world.

providerSeries.title: Galapagos
providerSeries.description: Meet the islands' unique species and see Darwin's theory of evolution in action.

providerSeries.title: Game of Arms
providerSeries.description: There really is such a thing as organized arm wrestling tournaments. "Game of Arms" takes viewers a long way from the days of duels at the end of the bar after a night of drinking. The series follows the members of arm wrestling clubs in such cities as Erie, Pa., Kansas City, Kan., Sacramento, Calif., Baton Rouge, La., and New York, as they hit the road to compete for money, personal pride, and the reputation of their clubs. Episodes feature organized regional matches -- interspersed with scenes of arm wrestlers in more personal settings -- leading to a winner-take-all tournament involving the entire cast in the finale.

providerSeries.title: Garfunkel and Oates
providerSeries.description: The comic/folk duo Riki Lindhome and Kate Micucci hit prime time with their act in this scripted series for IFC. It follows hard-working underdogs trying to make their mark in comedy while muddling through messy dating scenarios, and doing so by performing one satirical (and often quite saucy) song after another. Nothing stops the ukulele- and guitar-wielding twosome from singing about life's unspoken truths, despite it leaving them detached from their peers. The series is titled after Lindhome and Micucci's band name, inspired by "two famous rock 'n' roll second bananas," Art Garfunkel and John Oates.

providerSeries.title: Gear Heads
providerSeries.description: Lan shows us techniques to keep meat crispy when frying. She also teaches us how to make fried potatoes.

providerSeries.title: Geared Up
providerSeries.description: Husband and wife team Ralph and Kelly Biase own one of the best "resto-mod" shops in the business.

providerSeries.title: Geeking Out
providerSeries.description: Kevin Smith ("Comic Book Men," "Clerks") and Greg Grunberg ("Heroes," "Star Wars: The Force Awakens") share their deep passion for all things pop culture by taking a timely look at the genre through a fanboy lens. The 30-minute show features discussions, clips, celebrity interviews and out-of-the-studio segments.

providerSeries.title: Generation Z
providerSeries.description: When an army truck crashes outside a care home and infects the residents, four teenage friends must deal with the deadly consequences while also coping with their family and relationship problems.

providerSeries.title: Get a Clue
providerSeries.description: A fast-paced clue game in which two teams compete to see who can successfully guess the most answer words before time runs out.

providerSeries.title: Ghost Hunters
providerSeries.description: After terrifying and captivating fans for 11 seasons, the series that introduced the world to the field of authentic paranormal investigation returns with a familiar face and a brand-new spook squad. Grant Wilson, one of the original team leaders of "Ghost Hunters," joins a handpicked group of professionals who uses its decades of field experience to help everyday people across the country who are struggling with supernatural phenomena. The team utilizes forensic experts, historical records and the most innovative technology available to follow the evidence wherever it may lead and discover the truth behind the unexplained hauntings.

providerSeries.title: Ghost Stories
providerSeries.description: Grade school students fight against supernatural forces.

providerSeries.title: Ghosts in the Hood
providerSeries.description: Members of the ghost-hunting Official Paranormal Operations (O.P.O.) team conduct paranormal investigations in neighborhoods throughout Los Angeles in this series that blends humor with the supernatural. Each episode features the O.P.O. responding to two clients who believe they have experienced ghostly encounters, whether their house is haunted or spirits overrun a business. The team -- led by CEO Defecio Stoglin, who founded the organization to help ordinary people deal with supernatural problems -- looks into unexplained phenomena in areas of Los Angeles that include Compton, South Central, Inglewood and downtown L.A.

providerSeries.title: Gigi Does It
providerSeries.description: David Krumholtz ("Numb3rs," "10 Things I Hate About You") stars as Gertrude "Gigi" Rotblum, whose life changes in unexpected ways after her beloved husband dies. A secret bank account is discovered in the will, granting the 76-year-old widow with a heart of gold and a razor-sharp tongue a new lease on life. With her assistant, Ricky, tagging along, Gigi sets out to experience everything she deprived herself of in her younger years. She travels to concert festivals, tries new technologies like online dating, and generally lives life to its fullest and fastest while ignoring doctors' orders and turning the stigma of aging on its head.

providerSeries.title: Girl Meets Gown
providerSeries.description: The search for the perfect wedding dress can be fraught with frustration. Jenny Kline and Marsha French, co-owners of Stardust Celebrations bridal salon in Dallas, have seen it all, and in this reality show they share what they know. In addition to watching brides pick their gowns, they offer suggestions for any bride wanting some expert assistance in finding the wedding dress of her dreams.

providerSeries.title: Global Veggies
providerSeries.description: A vegetarian cooking show featuring the return of Chef Pino Di Cerbo; each focused ingredient is prepared using signature flavors and techniques from a different country where it would be an unlikely visitor.

providerSeries.title: Gold Fever
providerSeries.description: Host Tom Massie covers subjects for the modern prospector.

providerSeries.title: Goodies vs. Baddies
providerSeries.description: Catch the most gentle giants and sneakiest snack snatchers caught on camera.

providerSeries.title: Gordon of Ghost City
providerSeries.description: A cowboy is hired to track down a gang of rustlers, but gets involved with a girl trying to run her grandfather's gold mine and the outlaws who are trying to stop her.

providerSeries.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
providerSeries.description: Gordon, Gino, and Fred hit the road for a wild food-filled tour of their homelands-Italy, France, and Scotland. With big egos, wild adventures, and epic feasts, it's a road trip like no other.

providerSeries.title: Gordon's Great Escape
providerSeries.description: Having a lifelong love of curry, chef Gordon Ramsay travels to India for the first time. While there he experiences the stunning diversity of its culinary traditions, immersing himself in all aspects of Indian culture, no matter how challenging, unfamiliar or extreme. In the show's second season, the famed chef expands his horizons to other areas of Southeast Asia -- exploring the regional cuisine in Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand. But he's Gordon Ramsay, so he doesn't just taste the food -- he also prepares dishes using the delicacies that aren't found in many other parts of the world. The experience leads to Ramsay reviewing his own relationship with food and his opinion of what is -- and is not -- acceptable to eat.

providerSeries.title: Granny Killer
providerSeries.description: Journalist Caroline Overington joins with a criminal profiler to investigate 'Granny Killer' John W. Glover.

providerSeries.title: Graveyard Carz
providerSeries.description: "It's Mopar or No Car" for Mark Worman and his Graveyard Carz ghouls. They're game for any repair or restoration job, as long as it's in the Mopar mold -- a Chrysler muscle car from the late 1960s or early '70s. The series follows the progress to get the racing classics -- some left for dead in a scrap heap -- across the proverbial finish line, which to muscle car specialist Worman means nothing less than perfect restorations. After all, too much beauty exists in quality Detroit automobiles to let them go to rust.

providerSeries.title: Great Blue Wild
providerSeries.description: An adventure with the world's greatest dive shops.

providerSeries.title: Growing Up Hip Hop
providerSeries.description: Growing up with a famous parent isn't easy, as the children often have to work hard to emerge from their parents' shadows and gain independence -- especially if they want entertainment careers of their own. "Growing Up Hip Hop" documents the lives of a tight-knit group of friends, most of whom have at least one parent who is famous. Angela Simmons, the daughter of Run-D.M.C.'s Rev Run, is a model and fashion designer; Romeo Miller has followed in the footsteps of his father, Master P, in becoming a musician; entrepreneur Damon "Boogie" Dash is the son of former record executive Damon Dash; singer Kristinia DeBarge, the daughter of James DeBarge, struggles to choose between family and fame; TJ Mizell, a DJ whose father was Run-D.M.C. member Jam Master Jay, views Angela as family since both of their dads were in Run-D.M.C.; and aspiring singer Egypt Criss gets her talent from both mom and dad -- Pepa from Salt-N-Pepa and Treach from Naughty by Nature.
categories: Growing Up Hip Hop WE tv

providerSeries.title: Growing Up Hip Hop Atlanta
providerSeries.description: Atlanta has become a hotbed for hip-hop music, and it is the setting for this reality series that explores what life is like for a tight-knit crew of friends, many of whom have family members who are well-known in the hip-hop community. But like any family, Atlanta's next generation of hip-hop stars do not always get along. Growing up together in the shadow of their legendary parents has established tight bonds and bitter rivalries, as they all fight for their chance to push their way into the spotlight. The well-connected Atlanta crew features, among others, Bow Wow, Da Brat, Waka Flocka Flame, Tammy Rivera, and Andrea "Drea" Kelly, the ex-wife of R. Kelly.
categories: Growing Up Hip Hop WE tv

providerSeries.title: Gypsy Rose: Life After Lock Up
providerSeries.description: Gypsy Rose Blanchard experiences life as a free woman, including reconnecting with family and finally living with her husband Ryan Anderson for the first time.

providerSeries.title: H.R. Pufnstuf
providerSeries.description: Mayor H.R. Pufnstuf and the other residents of Living Island try to help young Jimmy, shipwrecked and led to their island, escape the evil clutches of Witchiepoo, a zany witch who wants to steal Jimmy's talking flute for her collection of magical objects. But even as Jimmy tries to keep his talking flute out of Witchiepoo's evil grasp, he is also trying to find his way back home.

providerSeries.title: Hajime No Ippo: The Fighting!
providerSeries.description: Ippo is a high school student who gets bullied by the kids at his school; when a professional boxer introduces Ippo to the world of boxing, his life changes.

providerSeries.title: Halt and Catch Fire
providerSeries.description: It's the early 1980s, and the spirit of innovation in personal computing is about to catch fire. Hot on the trail is a renegade trio -- a visionary, an engineer and a prodigy -- who risk everything to realize their vision of building a computer that can change the future. Not long after IBM corners the market with its flagship PC, a flaw is discovered in its operation, opening the door for competition. In steps Joe MacMillan, a former IBM executive who now works for Cardiff Electric. MacMillan plans to reverse-engineer IBM's technology, putting Cardiff in the thick of the personal computer race. He enlists the help of engineer Gordon Clark, who dreams of creating a revolutionary computer, and Cameron Howe, a volatile prodigy who puts her future on the line to join MacMillan's rogue project.

providerSeries.title: Heartland
providerSeries.description: This sprawling family saga takes place where an unfortunate tragedy has glued a family together to pull them through life's thick and thin moments. Follow young Amy Fleming as she slowly discovers she possesses her now-deceased mother's ability to aid injured horses as well as maintaining good relationships with those who are trying to get by one day at a time. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

providerSeries.title: Heavy Lifting
providerSeries.description: An exploration of the engineering behind complex moving projects.

providerSeries.title: Helicopter ER
providerSeries.description: Helicopter rescues by the Yorkshire Air Ambulance.

providerSeries.title: Hell on Wheels
providerSeries.description: The Civil War is in the past, but former Confederate soldier Cullen Bohannon can't put it behind him. Fresh are the horrific memories of the death of his wife, killed at the hands of the Union soldiers, an act that sets Bohannon on a course of revenge. This contemporary Western tells the story of his journey, a story that rides on Union Pacific's construction of the first transcontinental railroad. Bohannon's westward travels take him to a lawless melting pot of a town called "Hell on Wheels," which moves with the construction of the railroad.

providerSeries.title: Hello Horror
providerSeries.description: Join Vanessa Decker for a horror variety show filled with spooky guests, red carpet events, haunted houses, creepy cocktails and more.

providerSeries.title: Hello Hunnay
providerSeries.description: Jeannie simply doesn’t hold back! Whether on “The Real” or the red carpet, she preaches self-confidence in all aspects of life. Jeannie and her mother, Mama Mai, are far from shy when it comes to sharing personal family stories, attempting internet challenges, and discussing all the ways they may or may not meet eye-to-eye on controversial topics. “Hello Hunnay” reinforces the idea that beauty begins from the inside, and Jeannie’s audience leaves with genuine advice about beauty, fashion, life, and love.

providerSeries.title: Hidden Gems
providerSeries.description: Experts break down iconic architecture and homes.

providerSeries.title: Hidden Histories of World War II
High School Confidential
providerSeries.description: For most teenagers, high school is a difficult time -- during which they undergo much change in their lives. This series documents life for some female students, from their freshman year to graduation. The hourlong program follows the girls through four years of obstacles that, in addition to school work, include drugs, unwanted pregnancy, health crises and family chaos. In addition to trying to overcome those types of issues, the teens also try to figure out who they are. Episodes explore the teens' stories through four years of heartache, discovery, friendship and self-acceptance -- otherwise known as "high school."

providerSeries.title: Highlander
providerSeries.description: Duncan MacLeod cannot die -- well, unless you cut off his head. He is a 400-year-old immortal, who has seen his share of humanity's bad side. Still, he risks his life to save people from harm.

providerSeries.title: Hip Hop Homicides
providerSeries.description: An investigative series that will closely examine and explore leads surrounding the murders of members of the Hip Hop community.

providerSeries.title: Hip Hop: The Songs That Shook America
providerSeries.description: From executive producers Ahmir Questlove Thompson, Tariq Black Thought Trotter, Shawn Gee and Alex Gibney, each episode of this series focuses on a groundbreaking song pivotal to the evolution of American music and culture. From the early hip-hop battles to verses that sparked hope and inspired change, watch artists deconstruct their composition, revisit the impact the song had on them personally, and dissect the socio-economic and cultural conditions that inspired the landmark work and gave voice to a generation.

providerSeries.title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
providerSeries.description: Interviews and re-creations bring some of history's most daring jailbreaks to life, detailing every step of the way, including the inmates' meticulous plans and the manhunts that followed; Academy Award-winning actor Morgan Freeman, who starred in "Shawshank Redemption," a film focusing on the exploits of a group of inmates inside the fictional Shawshank State Penitentiary, hosts and executive produces the series; conversations with some of the prisoners, their families, their cellmates, guards and prison employees are used to round out the potrayals of famous escapes from Alcatraz, Dannemora, Pittsburgh State Penitentiary and other locations.

providerSeries.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
providerSeries.description: Explore the impact of machines on history, including the printing press, the Model T and early personal computers.

providerSeries.title: History's Mystery Files
providerSeries.description: Revisiting history's unforgettable cases, from sacred discoveries and bizarre weapons to unsolved disappearances and high strangeness.

providerSeries.title: Hoarders SOS
providerSeries.description: Across the UK thousands of us live our lives surrounded by too much stuff.

providerSeries.title: Hoarders, Get Your House in Order
providerSeries.description: Out-of-control consumers have their lives turned around by experts.

providerSeries.title: HobbyKidsTV
providerSeries.description: Having fun with HobbyKidsTV and HobbyKids adventures.

providerSeries.title: Holiday Eatz
providerSeries.description: Chef Kimberly Lallouz demonstrates fun and accessible meals for various holidays.

providerSeries.title: Holiday Highlights
providerSeries.description: Bon Appétit presents a holiday recipe marathon.

providerSeries.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
providerSeries.description: Some of the most thrilling weapons action sequences from TV and movies are put to the test, with weapons expert Larry Zanoff breaking down some of the most explosive action scenes in Hollywood history.

providerSeries.title: Home At Last
providerSeries.description: Join Tan France and Architectural Digest for a new series, Home At Last.

providerSeries.title: Home At Last: The Full Story
providerSeries.description: Join Tan France and Architectural Digest for a new series, Home At Last.

providerSeries.title: Home Works
providerSeries.description: Interior Designer Claire Zinnecker shows quick and easy decorating projects for personalizing your home

providerSeries.title: Hometown Heroes
providerSeries.description: In this first-of-its-kind celebration of community leaders, celebrities return to their hometown to spotlight unsung heroes dedicated to important community initiatives and to raise awareness for their organizations. With the help of a passionate local design team, a major makeover is in store to support each charity's mission, culminating in a jaw-dropping, feel-good reveal.

providerSeries.title: Homeworthy: The Collection
providerSeries.description: A look inside the world's most extraordinary private residences, from storied historic estates to ingenious modern retreats. Join legendary designers, visionary artists, and passionate collectors as they reveal the deeply personal narratives woven into their four walls. Whether it's a meticulous restoration of a landmark or the transformation of a humble boat shed, this series explores the intersection of heritage, architecture, and the curated objects that turn a house into a soulful haven. It is a masterful celebration of the creative spirit, proving that every home has a story and every room is a chapter of a life well-lived.

providerSeries.title: Hotel Hell
providerSeries.description: Chef Gordon Ramsay is expanding his brand into another branch of the service industry in this new show. Along with a team of hospitality experts, Ramsay will travel the country applying his high standards to struggling hotels, motels, and bed and breakfasts in an effort to get the owners and staff to turn their establishments around. Ramsay's signature no-holds-barred style will make it clear to those he coaches that there is no place for dirty rooms or incompetent staff if one hopes to remain in business.

providerSeries.title: House Hazards
providerSeries.description: Scientist Francesca Garigue, engineer Dan Dicaire and special-effects engineer Brendan Callaghan test potential home hazards in a real house. Blazing kitchen fires, erupting vacuum cleaners and bursting helium tanks are all in a day's work. In each episode, Garigue, Dicaire and Callaghan re-create some of the most dangerous home hazards, using state of the art technology and scientific experiments. The three hosts set out to discover just how much a house can endure when human error results in disaster.

providerSeries.title: House of Curves
providerSeries.description: Kenyatta Jones, an Atlanta-based fashion designer who specializes in designing clothes for plus-size women, is the CEO of clothing boutique Bella René, named after her mother and main investor. Jones and her team, which includes her two close friends from college and an assistant with attitude, go to great lengths to expand the brand, but mishaps and in-house bickering hinder the dream. The ultimate test comes when the team competes for recognition in one of the world's top cities for fashion: New York.

providerSeries.title: How Do They Do It?
providerSeries.description: After watching this series you may never look at ordinary objects in the same way again. A tube of toothpaste? Car tires? Tea bags? A lot of technology goes into even the simplest of consumer goods, and this program offers viewers a glimpse at just what that entails.

providerSeries.title: How I Caught the Killer
providerSeries.description: Profiles the work of police officers who are tasked with investigating some of the toughest murder cases in criminal history.

providerSeries.title: How Things Work
providerSeries.description: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

providerSeries.title: Howards End
providerSeries.description: Based on E.M. Forster's classic novel, the miniseries adaptation of "Howards End" is a portrayal of England at the turn of the 20th century told through the lens of three families: the intellectual Schlegels, the wealthy and prejudiced Wilcoxes and the working-class Basts. In the evolving landscape of social and class divisions, idealistic Schlegel sisters Margaret and Helen seek to help the impoverished Bast family while simultaneously ridding the Wilcoxes of their preconceived notions of class and welfare.

providerSeries.title: Humans Vs. Everything
providerSeries.description: Mother nature always runs on her own agenda.

providerSeries.title: Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
providerSeries.description: Katmai National Park's bears have just 150 days to consume three million calories and pack on 200 pounds to ensure their winter survival. First-time moms BoldFace and QuadMom must try to keep their chaotic cubs out of harm's way as scrappy male Stomper fights with mysterious challenger BigBoi for Blondie's attention. Grizzled vet Bernie takes teen Casanova under his wing before facing off with the legendary Brooks Falls behemoths (Denali, Scarface, Rizzo and Blonde Ears), who are odds-on favorites in this rivalry. Contenders gorge their way to the top BIG (beefiness, ingenuity and grit) score, vying for the crown as the park's most valuable bear (MVB), just in time for a long winter's nap.

providerSeries.title: Hunting Fish
providerSeries.description: Thom Hunt is challenged to hunt the mighty pike in the UK's Norfolk Broads.

providerSeries.title: Hustle & Soul
providerSeries.description: Chef Lawrence Page moved his Pink Tea Cup restaurant to Brooklyn to try to bring his soul-food concept to the next level in the hopes of landing a coveted Michelin star. He and his team quickly learn that it takes more than good cooking to reach the level he wants to achieve. While running the eatery, Page has to manage cat fights, power moves and love triangles between members of his staff. General manager Ana -- also Page's hot-tempered girlfriend -- leads the crew, which includes flirty hostess Sana, who's not afraid to stand up to Ana; lead server Thandi; and head bartender Candice, who is as sweet as her drinks but not yet up to Michelin-star standards. Providing much-needed comic relief at the restaurant are twins Dominic and Stef, who can't seem to get much right. Page must keep his eye on the prize while trying to successfully manage his personal and professional lives if he wants to join the ranks of chefs who have a Michelin star attached to their name.

providerSeries.title: I Do Over
providerSeries.description: Ever wish you could have a mulligan for your wedding day and do the ceremony over again? "I Do Over" gives couples a second chance at their wedding. Renowned wedding and event planner Diann Valentine plans a second wedding ceremony for couples who had a disastrous walk down the aisle the first time around. Diann transforms bad bridal memories -- plagued by natural disasters, fainting grooms and missing dresses -- into dream ceremonies that try to wipe away the memories of the disastrous first ceremonies. Diann and her team have just five days to pull everything together for each ceremony, with designer wedding dresses, whimsical cake designs and breathtaking venues.

providerSeries.title: I Want to Save Your Life
providerSeries.description: Charles Stuart Platkin, also known as the Diet Detective, stages undercover health interventions. His mission is to coax Americans back to a more healthy lifestyle. "Do you want to see your daughter graduate from college?" he bluntly asks one target. Another woman is forced to walk 2.5 miles -- the distance she'd have to go to burn off the calories in the slice of chocolate cake he makes her carry as she walks. And no, she doesn't get to eat the cake after the walk. He works with each person to help them find out why they've developed the weight issues they struggle with, and then he helps them develop more effective ways to deal with their problems.

providerSeries.title: I'm Dead
providerSeries.description: A comedy series combining themed stand-up performances and candid reflections, revealing real-life experiences behind the laughs.

providerSeries.title: Icons of Auto
providerSeries.description: Tracing the lineage of the most famous motoring marques by highlighting five key machines, and five key moments that brought them to prominence.

providerSeries.title: Idiotest
providerSeries.description: If you buy into the title of this game show, you might be an idiot if you can't answer the questions asked of contestants. Each episode features two pairs of competitors, sometimes from a particular rivalry -- for example, UCLA vs. USC or Trekkies vs."Star Wars" fans -- participating in several rounds of simple, rapid-fire questions testing people's observational skills, attention to detail, and general knowledge. The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots.

providerSeries.title: Immortalized
providerSeries.description: The centuries-old art form of taxidermy comes alive in this competition series that pits professional "immortalizers" against amateur challengers. In each half-hour episode, a highly regarded artist -- one who practices either traditional taxidermy or a new, rogue style where artistic license trumps verisimilitude -- takes on a challenger, tasked with creating a piece judged on originality, workmanship and interpretation of a designated theme. The judges are comic Brian Posehn and artists/taxidermists Catherine Coan and Paul Rhymer. There is nothing tangible at stake for the winners -- it's an old-fashioned battle of pride and for bragging rights. Actor and comic Zach Selwyn hosts.

providerSeries.title: Impossible Builds
providerSeries.description: Impossible Builds follows the exploits of pioneering families building extraordinary 'kit homes' in situations where conventional construction techniques prove impossible.

providerSeries.title: In Search Of
providerSeries.description: Inspired by the original series from the 1970s and '80s, Zachary Quinto revives "In Search Of" to investigate the paranormal. Quinto delves into the unexplained mysteries from all around the world and even looks into the secret UFO program that the Pentagon just acknowledged. Such topics include alien encounters, mysterious creatures, UFO sightings, time travel, and artificial intelligence. Using experiments and immersive demonstrations, scholars and witnesses attempt to tell the stories.

providerSeries.title: In the Ring With Kevin Hart
Income Property
providerSeries.description: Host and renovator Scott McGillivray shows homeowners with cash problems how to create rental suites in their home, as a way to generate additional revenue to defray mortgage costs. In each episode, McGillivray presents his client with two design options. After they pick the one that meets their needs, the host and his team of contractors renovate the space, with the meticulous McGillivray overseeing a sleek and cost-effective makeover.

providerSeries.title: Inside Moto
providerSeries.description: Oscar Haro introduces the true stories and human spirit behind racing machines.

providerSeries.title: Inside the Ambulance
providerSeries.description: Following paramedics from the West Midlands Ambulance Service as they carry out their duties around Britain; cameras are placed within ambulances, while the team wear body-mounted filming technology to capture all the action on the front line.

providerSeries.title: Interrogation Raw
providerSeries.description: Telling the stories of dramatic murders and other serious crimes through the interrogation of the accused, intercut with interviews with key players along with relevant news footage and archival material, including trial footage.

providerSeries.title: Into the Badlands
providerSeries.description: AMC's goal for "Into the Badlands" was twofold: produce a compelling character drama, and introduce the highest caliber of martial arts filmmaking to a weekly, ongoing series. Left in the hands of creators Alfred Gough and Miles Millar ("Shanghai Noon," "Smallville"), the series stars Daniel Wu as ruthless, prodigiously skilled warrior Sunny, who mentors teenage boy M.K. during a spiritual journey across a feudal civilization known as the Badlands. With the help of trained assassins like Sunny, the area is ruled by rival barons, and for decades Quinn has consistently outflanked and outmaneuvered his fellow barons to keep the upper hand. His invincibility, however, begins to fade in light of brazen attacks by the newest baron, The Widow, who believes M.K. is the key to her success. As the battle for control of the Badlands heats up, the destinies of the stoic assassin and the impetuous teenager become intertwined.

providerSeries.title: Into the Wild Frontier
providerSeries.description: As America expands westward, intrepid explorers and rugged mountain men risk their lives to blaze new trails into the wild frontier. The promise of new lands teeming with game and other riches is an irresistible pull for fearless men like Daniel Boone, Jim Bridger and John Colter. Danger surrounds the hunters, trappers and traders who lead the way into the unknown frontier. As they push deeper into the wilderness, crossing impenetrable forests, vast mountain ranges, and unforgiving deserts, they face starvation, deadly weather, ferocious predators, and Native American forces. Their descriptions of the frontier's natural wonders encourage a tide of settlers to head West, and their epic tales of adventure and survival become the stuff of myths and legends.

providerSeries.title: Island of Bryan
providerSeries.description: Contractor Bryan Baeumler, his wife Sarah and their family head to the Bahamas to overhaul a beachfront resort.

providerSeries.title: It's Sew Easy
providerSeries.description: Sewing experts offer easy ways to create neat sewing projects right at home. Viewers of all skill levels learn tips and techniques for creating professional-looking garments, personalized apparel and home accents. Weekly episodes feature various themes, and feature two main projects and one shorter technique segment. Some projects include monogramming napkins and towels; baby poncho, hooded towel and baby-friendly diapers; embellishing yoga pants with a clothing tattoo; and sewing on knits.

providerSeries.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
providerSeries.description: Jamie travels through Italy to sample mouth-watering dishes and discover the simple secrets of Italy's best home cooking.

providerSeries.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
providerSeries.description: Jamie's heading around the Mediterranean to soak up inspiration from the local people, ingredients, techniques, and traditions to create delicious new recipes for us so that we can all bring a taste of holiday back home.

providerSeries.title: Jason Vlogs
providerSeries.description: Jason's in pretend play paradise! Tune in for magic lamps, DIY projects, playhouses for kids and more.

providerSeries.title: Jerry Springer
providerSeries.description: Tasteless talk shows come and go, but one magazine declared this long-running daytime chatfest "the worst show in the history of television." Loaded with bleeped profanity and guests who aren't afraid to embarrass themselves on national TV, "Jerry Springer" features a host who is the anti-Oprah, aiming his show squarely at viewers who rubberneck at traffic accidents. The former Cincinnati mayor must be doing something right because the show celebrates its milestone 25th season.

providerSeries.title: Jim & Chrissy: Vow or Never
providerSeries.description: Rapper Jim Jones and fiance Chrissy Lampkin have been together for a long time -- 11 years -- and have finally decided that it's time to get married, but it doesn't go smoothly. The couple's on-again, off-again history causes Chrissy to have her doubts when Jim insists on having the ceremony televised live. Things come to a head when Jones' mother shows up, intent on preventing the wedding from happening. Add in meddling friends and a longstanding family feud, and the couple may never make their way down the aisle. After more than a decade together, this could be Jones and Lampkins' last chance at having a "happily ever after" ending.

providerSeries.title: Joan & Melissa: Joan Knows Best?
providerSeries.description: Legendary comic Joan Rivers, who is a New Yorker at heart, decides to move across the country to Malibu, Calif., to live with her daughter, Melissa, and grandson, Cooper. But what Joan doesn't know is that Melissa isn't living with just Cooper -- Melissa's boyfriend, Jason, also lives in the house, until the couple break up during the course of the series, which leads Melissa to try to uncover the source of her problems with men. Can the outspoken mother-daughter pair coexist when Joan moves in, or will chaos ensue?

providerSeries.title: John Edward Cross Country
providerSeries.description: Self-proclaimed psychic John Edward travels the highways and byways of America to offer intimate and detailed individual readings for clients who are seeking answers and reassurances about their dearly departed.

providerSeries.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
providerSeries.description: Timed to coincide with the 40th anniversary of the 1978 Jonestown mass murder-suicide that killed more than 900 Americans, this four-part documentary tells of leader Jim Jones' transformation from charismatic preacher and civil rights advocate into narcissistic demagogue who championed the biggest mass suicide in U.S. history. The story is based on the best-selling book by investigative journalist Jeff Guinn and features archival footage -- including secret FBI and CIA recordings, unreleased photographs, personal letters and previously classified documents -- as well as new interviews with survivors and Jones family members who have not previously spoken on the record.

providerSeries.title: Journey to Planet Earth
providerSeries.description: This acclaimed series presents a challenging and in-depth look at critical world issues and the interlinking factors that can either alleviate or aggravate a problem - such as the way global warming and illegal fishing methods are eradicating some species of fish.

providerSeries.title: Joy of Painting
providerSeries.description: Bob Ross offers tips and shares painting techniques.

providerSeries.title: Joy of Painting With Nicholas Hankins: Bob Ross' Unfinished Season
providerSeries.description: Nicholas Hankins brings the last paintings by Bob Ross to life.

providerSeries.title: Judge Jerry
providerSeries.description: Former talk show host Jerry Springer puts his law degree to use, hearing real cases and rendering verdicts in a TV courtroom.

providerSeries.title: Judge Karen's Court
providerSeries.description: Judge Karen Mills-Francis returns to syndication with this new version of her show, in which she adjudicates real-life, small-claims disputes. The former Florida county judge allows litigants to cross-examine witnesses in some cases, and ends each episode with a segment called Ask Judge Karen, in which she responds to videotaped queries from viewers.

providerSeries.title: Judge Mathis
providerSeries.description: Judge Greg Mathis is unlike most adjudicators you'd see in a courtroom. The former Detroit-area district court judge infuses his court sessions with a generous dose of humor as he listens to diverse litigants plead their small-claims cases in his TV courtroom. A regular segment, Ask Judge Mathis, features the judge answering viewer questions to advise people with legal situations that they face. Prior to entering the legal world, Mathis was involved with gangs and spent time in jail as a young man before turning his life around.

providerSeries.title: Judge Mom
providerSeries.description: Bringing a mother's tough love and common sense to resolving real world disputes with cheating spouses, sneaky roommates, creepy landlords, disappointing friends, greedy siblings and scheming coworkers.

providerSeries.title: Judgy Cat
providerSeries.description: From barnyard blunders to pet smackdowns - Judgy Cat's paws are ready to deliver verdicts.

providerSeries.title: Julia at Home
providerSeries.description: Julia Collin Davison cooks in her home kitchen; she whips up test kitchen favorites and cooks from some of her recipe books, breathing new life into long-standing traditions.

providerSeries.title: Kalahari Meerkats
providerSeries.description: Meerkats have dramatic adventures, squabbles and struggles in the Kalahari Desert.

providerSeries.title: Karamo
providerSeries.description: Karamo is a true fan of the talk-show genre who brings that passion, a unique skill set and life experiences to guide his guests through life's dramatic crossroads and build a lasting connection with the daytime audience.

providerSeries.title: Kendra on Top
providerSeries.description: Kendra Wilkinson-Baskett first gained fame as one of Hugh Hefner's girlfriends on the E! reality series "The Girls Next Door." She has since translated that fame into an entertainment career and marriage to former professional football player Hank Baskett. Adding to the list of Kendra's reality shows is "Kendra on Top," which chronicles her transition into motherhood as she works to balance her family life -- including all the ups and downs of marriage -- with professional and personal ambitions. Kendra's trademark upbeat attitude and funny outlook on life help her get through the many challenges she faces. Meanwhile, Hank tries to discover what life is like outside of the NFL now that he has retired from the league.

providerSeries.title: Kevin Can F... Himself

Set in Worcester, Mass., the series follows the journey of Allison McRoberts, a stereotypically smart and beautiful sitcom wife, who is married to Kevin, a husky, self-centered man-child who is clearly punching above his weight. After making a dark discovery, Allison teams up with neighbor Patty O'Connor as she attempts to escape the confines of her life and take control of her fate.

providerSeries.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City
providerSeries.description: When tour-de-force entertainer Kevin Hart is not on a set filming a major movie or in a studio doing voice-over work for an animated project, he's likely on the road working the stand-up circuit. It's the latter that's the focal point of "Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City," a stand-up series with a distinct travelogue bent. Across eight episodes, Hart visits Atlanta, Houston, Chicago, Sacramento, Miami, Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and Birmingham, Ala., to find fresh talent and see what makes the comedy scenes special. Each episode features stand-up sets from a different group of local performers and segments featuring Hart and those comics discussing the comedy climate in their city.

Eve and Villanelle go head to head in a fierce game of cat and mouse, each woman equally obsessed with the other as Eve is tasked with hunting down the psychopathic assassin. Sarah Barnett, BBCA president, says, "'Killing Eve' stands out in a sea of scripted stories as refreshingly entertaining and great fun."

Her clientele also includes the not-so-famous through her successful retail product line and the exclusive Hollywood salon that she runs, Kimble Hair Studio. Staffed by talented but high-strung stylists, the salon is at the crux of this reality series that documents the stylists' fierce rivalry and desire to be on top. Also featured in the series is Kim's mother, Jasmine, a hairstylist and salon owner herself who encouraged her daughter to follow in the family's hairdressing legacy after recognizing Kim's talent at an early age.

While deployed in Afghanistan, Lorance ordered fire on three local men riding a motorcycle. Two of the men were killed, thus outraging his platoon. Lorance seeks to overturn his verdict, sparking an emotional debate across the country.

providerSeries.title: Loaded

Aside from battling others to get work, truckers must deal with road hazards, mechanical breakdowns and, of course, the weather in order to get their loads delivered on time and under budget. Rain, snow and even extreme heat are among the weather conditions that can make the driver late or damage the cargo, which could cause the trucker to lose money on the contract -- or possibly even have to pay for the value of the cargo. Each episode of "Loaded" follows several truckers to see who ends up with the most cash at the end of their runs.

providerSeries.title: Los Angeles: Stories from the City

providerSeries.title: Love After Lockup

Couples meet their potential future spouses for the first time once the bars are removed from the relationship. The way is full of bumps -- and some strong emotions -- along its rocky road, but these inmates are tasting freedom for the first time in a long while. Viewers follow along as they leave their paper and pen behind and jump straight into dating, meeting the family and experiencing other first-time, nerve-wracking moments.

As they run the company, Lisa and Jim have to deal with a staff of wild, young matchmakers. Another obstacle they face is Jim's former mistress, who has a knack for creating drama for the company's employees and clients. The show features appearances by "Million Dollar Matchmaker" star Patti Stanger, who also serves as an executive producer.

While they have a strong sisterly bond and are best friends, they also bring out the worst in one another. One reason for that could be because they work together, partnering on a natural hair care line called Rucker Roots. Ruby, the oldest of the three, is a former lawyer who spends her time volunteering and supporting education; youngest sister Ione, who used to be married to former NBA player Antawn Jamison, strives to be a successful philanthropist and businesswoman; and perfectionist Ellen is the middle sister, who has left her chiropractic practice to work on the sisters' hair care venture.

providerSeries.title: Low Winter Sun
providerSeries.description: The line between cops and criminals is sometimes blurry. When human nature intercedes and a man is forced to take matters into his own hands, there's not a badge big enough that will stop him. Detroit homicide detective Frank Agnew is used to helping others, but he can't help himself when a loved one is abruptly taken from him by a corrupt element. Vengeance gets the better of Agnew, and now he finds himself and his career at the mercy of fellow detective Joe Geddes, a smart but slimy veteran cop whose misdeeds may involve covered-up murders. "Low Winter Sun" -- a gritty, dark drama played out amid Detroit's underworld -- is based on the 2006 award-winning British miniseries of the same name.

With that notoriety came jokes from comedians and people on social media about her weight. Coming off the end of her marriage to Sugar Bear and facing health issues, Mama June wants to do something about her weight and slim down so she can start a new life with a new body and, she hopes, a new love. Any attempt at losing weight is challenging and requires a strong support system. For Mama June, that includes now-preteen Honey Boo Boo, daughter Pumpkin and lifelong friend Big Mike. In addition to undergoing a series of surgeries, Mama June undertakes an intense workout routine led by drill sergeant-style trainer Kenya Crooks to help shed the pounds.

In this series of the "Marriage Boot Camp" franchise, stars of such shows as "The Real Housewives", "Bad Girls Club," as well as some of the biggest names in hip-hop seek help from therapists and other experts to prevent their personal relationships -- either romantic or familial -- from getting worse. The therapists put the celebs and their loved ones through their form of boot camp, testing them with challenges that include revealing some of their deepest secrets and personal woes.

Through his company, Ultimate USA Weddings, Filippone helps couples plan their dream weddings in such iconic locations as the Empire State Building, Rockefeller Center's Top of the Rock, Central Park and the Brooklyn Bridge. And he often does it while adhering to small budgets, something that's difficult to do in New York.

Each episode begins with a recipe's basic foundation before Stewart uses additional ingredients or different cooking methods to prepare multiple dishes.

providerSeries.title: Martha Cooks

providerSeries.title: Martha Holidays

providerSeries.description: Martha Stewart offers home cooks a culinary master class which covers everything from roasting and poaching to braising and blanching. In each 30-minute episode, Martha uses her signature step-by-step, how-to teaching process to illustrate classic cooking techniques as well as the basics every cook should know. Lessons include making marinara sauce with four ingredients, butchering a beef tenderloin, cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper and how to determine which meats are good for braising.

But out of the spotlight, they are wives and mothers trying to balance family life with their superstar lifestyles. It's not easy for family members to work together -- especially when in the spotlight -- and over time, betrayals and other obstacles lead to Mary Mary separating and the ladies pursuing solo careers.

These movers race against the clock to lift whole buildings right off their foundations and transport them, still in one piece and complete with furniture, over all kinds of terrain and settle them into their new locations. Nothing is too big or off-limits, including homes, cathedrals and even an entire town. This stressful, and often emotional, process is overseen by the nervous people who love the buildings or call them home.

"Masters of Flip" tells of the couple's adventures through the messes and stresses of renovations and the anticipation of enormous profits. Tireless contractor Dave and award-winning realtor Kortney have built their real estate business through flips, buy and hold properties, and vacation rentals.

Known widely for offering guests the chance to take DNA tests to prove or disprove paternity -- usually with guests breaking out in tears of joy or sorrow -- Povich's show also frequently utilizes lie-detector tests. Cheaters and out-of-control teens are often featured on the show, and episodes occasionally focus on outrageous moments that have been captured on video.
