providerSeries.description: Patti Stanger has earned her "Millionaire Matchmaker" nickname (also the title of her previous show) through the years she has spent setting up wealthy people through her Millionaire's Club dating service, a practice she continues on this show. In each episode, two wealthy clients check into a luxury property in Southern California, where they unwittingly begin their "love lesson" through custom challenges designed by Stanger and her crew. Stanger then gives her feedback -- which can be brutally honest at times -- in one-on-one sessions with the daters, during which she gives an in-depth review of the surprise date. Each client is then introduced to the matches chosen by Patti, with the hope that one of them will be "the one." Stanger's team includes former beauty queen Candace, who has a psychology degree and is the top associate in Stanger's organization.

providerSeries.title: Mind of a Man
providerSeries.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000.

providerSeries.title: Minute to Win It
providerSeries.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000.

Among those unknowns are lawyers, who help stars make deals and get paid. This docuseries profiles several high-powered attorneys in the entertainment industry who help one another, use one another, and sometimes throw one another under the bus to get ahead in their personal and professional lives. "Money Power Respect" shows how the lawyers deal with failed partnerships, cheating boyfriends, stolen clients and back-stabbing friends. The featured lawyers include former music executive Wendy Credle; intellectual property attorney Kendell Kelly; Dana Whitfield, whose husband doesn't want her mixing with "grimy" music industry wannabes; Kelly Shapiro, who is anxious to move back to New York; and Jamaica native Nakia Thomas, who attended Brown University at the age of 16.

providerSeries.title: Mountain Men
providerSeries.description: Most people enjoy the modern technologies and conveniences of today -- smartphones, tablets, cable and satellite TV among them -- but there are those who choose to live off the grid in the unspoiled wilderness where dangers like mudslides, falling trees and bears are all part of life. "Mountain Men" profiles some of them. Eustace Conway, who has lived at the western edge of the Blue Ridge Mountains in North Carolina for more than 25 years, teaches interns about the old ways of living with nature. Tom Oar needs an entire year to prepare for the 7-month-long winter on Montana's Yaak River. In Alaska, Marty Meierotto must gather enough wood to survive -- in complete isolation -- winters that can have temperatures drop to 60 degrees below zero. It's not easy, but for these mountaineers it's life as they know it.

providerSeries.description: Celebrity party planner David Tutera leads a team of event professionals in remaking a bride's fantasy wedding into something less nightmarish. For example, the bride who wants a fantasy princess wedding, and adores her dress with yards of tulle, is told she must wear a different dress. A bride who wants spiders to adorn her wedding cupcakes and who plans to wear a sleeveless dress to display her tattoos is convinced to make some changes. Whether the brides go along with Tutera's advice remains to be seen.

providerSeries.title: My Life Is a Telenovela
providerSeries.description: Telenovelas are one of the most popular genres on Spanish television. This docuseries introduces American viewers to some of the stars of the shows, taking a look at the drama, intrigue and betrayal that happens both on and off the screen. Set in Miami, "My Life Is a Telenovela" profiles the Hispanic actors and actresses whose characters captivate millions of viewers. The featured stars include Maria "Raquenel" Portillo, who was a singer before turning her attention to acting; model Sissi Fleitas; Enrique Sapena, who comes from a well-known Venezuelan media family; outspoken Liliana Rodriguez Morillo, who was once fired from a show for saying the wrong thing; singer Gustavo Pedraza; and model Alina Robert.

providerSeries.title: Mystery Millionaire
providerSeries.description: In the early days of reality TV, there was a dating show on which a working-class bachelor pretended to be a millionaire while looking for a significant other from a group of female hopefuls. The premise of "Mystery Millionaire," which WE calls a social dating experiment, is the reverse of that. Each episode features a bachelor or bachelorette shedding expensive threads and fancy home for more modest clothing and living accommodations. Not to mention having to live on a much lower income than the person is used to. The featured dater goes on three blind dates, after which he or she must decide whom to pursue. The millionaire then goes on another date with the chosen person -- this time, a group date with friends -- and must decide whether or not to try to take it to the next level. But doing that means that he or she must reveal his/her identity. Then it's up to the chosen partner to decide whether or not to continue the relationship.

Dedicated to anyone interested in preserving memories -- whether it be with scrapbooks, paper crafts or cards -- the series offers a wide range of ideas for any skill level. Projects include simple art journaling, a welcome banner featuring old photos, a family tree album, a travel journal with painted images, and stenciling.

providerSeries.title: Secrets of the Brain
providerSeries.description: Neuroscientist Dr. Jack Lewis gives fascinating insight into how the brain works.

providerSeries.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
providerSeries.description: Showcasing the raw beauty of nature while diving into our planet's water worlds, with a mix of character-driven animal stories interspersed with fascinating scientific insights into these magical habitats.

providerSeries.title: Secrets of the Factories
providerSeries.description: Showcasing today's factory workers alongside tomorrow's machines making cans of food most viewers have at home.

providerSeries.title: Secrets of Wild Australia
providerSeries.description: A look into the lives of the secretive creatures of Australia.

providerSeries.title: Seduced: Inside the NXIVM Cult
providerSeries.description: An inside look at the Nxivm cult and its enigmatic, manipulative founder Keith Raniere.

providerSeries.title: Selling It in the ATL
providerSeries.description: The Atlanta real estate market was once dominated by men, but women are increasingly making themselves known in the city's housing industry. This docuseries shines the spotlight on seven such women, who use their business acumen and larger-than-life personalities to close deals in the growing city. It's a seller's market as new buyers and investors flock to the ATL, embracing a new, progressive culture that is forcing the old guard to fight to remain relevant. The ladies' client lists include everyone from professional athletes to music industry executives and even foreign diplomats. The featured agents include Tahlia, who specializes in finding high-dollar leases for musicians making albums in the city, and New York native Chrishena, who brings her Big Apple attitude to Atlanta.

providerSeries.title: Serial Psyche
providerSeries.description: An exploration of the psychological underpinnings of serial killers to better understand their specific frame of mind and psychology.

providerSeries.title: Serving Up Style
providerSeries.description: Tip and how-to's for a memorable gathering.

providerSeries.title: Sex Box
providerSeries.description: Rather than thinking outside the box, couples featured on this series are going inside a box in an attempt to save their troubled relationships. Each episode begins with the couple speaking candidly to a panel of experts -- psychotherapist Fran Walfish, certified sex therapist Chris Donaghue, and pastor/couples' counselor Yvonne Capehart -- about their intimacy issues. After getting the initial advice, the couple must decide whether to go into a camera-free, soundproof box located on the set, and in front of the studio audience, in which they have a private lovemaking session. That is followed by another, more revealing discussion with the panel -- because it is believed that people are more trusting and open after making love. In the end, each couple's goal is to solve their problems and save the relationship. Comic Danielle Stewart also joins the show to provide commentary and conduct on-the-street interviews.

providerSeries.title: Shadowlands
providerSeries.description: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of aquatic animals residing in remote areas of the Earth where survival is paramount.

providerSeries.title: Shannen Says
providerSeries.description: Shannen Doherty is best known for starring in drama series such as "Beverly Hills, 90210" and "Charmed." Now the drama is real as she stars in this reality show that follows her as she plans for what she hopes is the wedding of her dreams with photographer Kurt Iswarienko. Planning a wedding is always stressful, so imagine how stressed Doherty is when she has just seven weeks to plan her big day. In a bit of network synergy, "My Fair Wedding" host David Tutera swoops in to give Doherty a wedding-planning assist when the pressure becomes too much for the actress. Among the obstacles that get in the way are a groom distracted by his career, a trip to Prague, family turmoil and wardrobe malfunctions.

providerSeries.title: She's Moving In
providerSeries.description: Couples move in together for the first time and find that their interior design and ways of living clash; in come design experts to help them turn things around, find balance in their spaces and leave them with a space both partners are happy with.

providerSeries.title: Sheriffs: El Dorado County
providerSeries.description: Cameras follow sheriff's deputies in a Northern California county.

providerSeries.title: Show Us Your Pets
providerSeries.description: Celebrities and stars are revealing their pets and raising awareness for important animal charities.

providerSeries.title: Showville
providerSeries.description: Main Street, USA, is where "Showville" is playing, a celebration of everyday Americans' passion for performing. The series highlights local talent of all ages in small towns across the country -- singers, dancers, comedy acts, jugglers and other performers who compete to appear in their towns' talent shows. In each episode, actor Alec Mapa and choreographer Lisette Bustamante host open auditions in one town, select four finalists, and have two days to mentor them. The final competition takes place at a well-known town venue filled with locals, who are ultimately responsible for selecting the best act. The winner receives $10,000, a cup to signify the achievement, and a moment to cherish for a lifetime.

providerSeries.title: Silly Sustainability
providerSeries.description: Taking a fun look at impractical applications of very practical sustainability science.

providerSeries.title: Sinbad It's Just Family
providerSeries.description: Stand-up comic Sinbad, whose fame peaked in the 1990s with gigs such as hosting a short-lived talk show, enters the realm of reality TV in this show that explores his family life. Sinbad has remarried his ex-wife and moved back into their old house. Their son and daughter, both in their 20s, are trying to build their own careers but still seek financial support from their parents. Financial struggles and privacy issues are among the challenges the family faces as they try to rebuild their lives together.

providerSeries.title: Sins of the City
providerSeries.description: Exposing the dark underbelly of various cities by highlighting the mysterious crimes that changed the community forever.

providerSeries.title: SisterS
providerSeries.description: Two women born continents apart, one Canadian and the other Irish, realize that they are half-sisters and embark on an eventful road trip in search of their alcoholic father.

providerSeries.title: Sisters In Law
providerSeries.description: This Houston-based series profiles several black, female attorneys who tackle some of the toughest legal cases in Texas. The women, some of whom have known one another for decades, form a tight bond to help themselves succeed in a male-dominated profession. The featured women include Jolanda, who aims to provide justice for poor defendants; criminal lawyer Vivian, who went to law school at age 30 after leaving her banking career; civil attorney Rhonda, who specializes in class-action lawsuits and has won cases in front of the U.S. Supreme Court; public defender Juanita, who has handled over 2500 cases and was previously a partner in a firm with Rhonda; criminal attorney Monique, who has grown to enjoy being able to help people get out of tough situations; and civil lawyer Tiye, the wife of a well-known attorney.

providerSeries.title: Skuld: A Look Into the Future
providerSeries.description: Have a look at a solar car competition; teams from around the world build their own pure solar model and compete in a race across Australia.

providerSeries.title: Sleeping With a Killer
providerSeries.description: The stories of ordinary people who met fatal ends because of jealousy, with a look at the dramatic and true events and the setbacks of the victims whose lives were forever changed.

providerSeries.title: Small Town Security
providerSeries.description: The unscripted "Small Town Security" follows the workplace drama of a small, family-run security and private investigation company in rural Georgia called JJK Security. While the day-to-day operations are depicted, the heartbeat of the series is found in the oddball behavior of JJK's colorful employees, led by the hilarious and inappropriate Joan Koplan, otherwise called "The Chief." There's also Joan's old-school, charming husband, Irwin; straight-laced detective and process server Brian Taylor; flighty office secretary Christa Stephens; and "The Lieutenant," Dennis Croft, who Joan reveals in the premiere episode used to be a woman. No wonder AMC describes the show as "a cross between Christopher Guest's brilliant films and the sublime absurdity of `The Office.' ".

providerSeries.title: Soulmates
providerSeries.description: In the very near future, a test is developed that incontrovertibly lets a person know who their soulmate is. The new science is clear, and no matter a person's current relationship status, whether they are single, dating or even married, this test will unmistakably point a person in the direction of their actual, scientifically determined soulmate. People in long-term relationships should not be content in believing they've already made the right choice. Even if a person seems to be deep in love with their current partner, this test may just prove that they are mistaken. After all, science knows best.

providerSeries.title: Spartacus
providerSeries.description: Betrayed by the Romans; forced into slavery; reborn as a Gladiator, torn from his homeland and the woman he loves, Spartacus is condemned to the brutal world of the arena where blood and death are prime-time entertainment.

providerSeries.title: Spec Check
providerSeries.description: The ultimate pickleball gear review show revealing the sport's latest technology and industry secrets.

providerSeries.title: Special Forces
providerSeries.description: Documentary exploring the missions of commando forces around the world.

providerSeries.title: Spencer's BIG 30
providerSeries.description: Chef Spencer Watts offers cooking tips and tricks for preparing meals in 30 minutes, for $30, without sacrificing flavor.

providerSeries.title: Spooks
providerSeries.description: A team of agents in the British security intelligence service work to protect the U.K. from terrorists and other threats to national security. A repackaged version of the BBC series "Spooks," "MI-5" follows a counterterrorism unit based in the highly secure suite of offices called The Grid, where Harry Pearce oversees the team and deals with the often dirty politics of the spy game.

providerSeries.title: Stan Against Evil
providerSeries.description: John C. McGinley ("Scrubs") stars in this comedy-horror series as sour, judgmental sheriff Stan Miller, who is forced to give up his job because of an angry outburst at a most inopportune moment -- his wife's funeral. Relinquishing authority doesn't come easily for Stan, especially after he finds out he must make way for Evie Barret, the strong-willed and beautiful new sheriff. However, when both soon realize something is not quite right in their sleepy New Hampshire town -- which just so happens to be built on the site of a massive 17th-century witch burning -- Stan and Evie form an unlikely alliance to bravely battle a plague of spine-chilling demons.

providerSeries.title: Staten Island Cakes
providerSeries.description: Vinny Buzzetta is a 20-something baking prodigy, having graduated first in his class from New York's prestigious French Culinary Institute at the age of 18 (at the time, the school's youngest graduate). The Brooklyn-born foodie has always had a passion for chocolate and a dream to own his own bakery. When he saw a vacant storefront while driving through Staten Island a few months after he graduated, he decided that was the perfect location for his dream bakery, which he opened thanks in part to financial support from his Grandpa Joe (affectionately known in the community as "Crazy Joe"). Since then, the bakery, The Cake Artist, has thrived and become the go-to bakery for weddings and other special occasions in the area. Even though he's a successful business owner, Vinny still lives at home with his parents, including meddling mom Cammy, and younger siblings. This series follows Vinny and his staff as they work at the bakery and he deals with his personal relationships.

providerSeries.title: Static Shock
providerSeries.description: Accidental exposure to an experimental mutagen leaves geeky high school student Virgil with super powers. Able to control electromagnetic forces, he channels his newfound powers to fight evil, aided by his pal Osgood, who builds gadgets to help Virgil fight crime.

providerSeries.title: Steel Monsters
providerSeries.description: An introduction to some of the biggest, heaviest and deadliest machines ever developed and built for very specific "mega tasks."

providerSeries.title: Stepping in to The Shade Room
providerSeries.description: Podcast by The Shade Room. Hosted by Thembi Mawema, the show features interviews with major celebrities, musicians and cultural icons.

providerSeries.title: Stir It Up
providerSeries.description: Karrueche Tran is sharing all the things you didn’t know about her inspiring journey to success. From her dynamic Vietnamese-African American upbringing to her career as a personal shopper, she is spilling the tea on how she got to where she is today. And with expert tips on fashion, food, and fitness, she’ll give you a taste of everything she’s learned along the way.

providerSeries.title: Stop! Border Control: Cuba
providerSeries.description: An international film crew records, for the first time, the activities of the Cuban security forces.

providerSeries.title: STOP! Border Control: Latin America
providerSeries.description: Witness the high-stakes games at South American checkpoints; thousands risk everything to bypass security across Mexico, Brazil and beyond.

providerSeries.title: STOP! Border Control: Roma
providerSeries.description: A heavily dressed traveler from Lisbon and a fake passport holder spark a desperate scene at Leonardo da Vinci Airport.

providerSeries.title: Storage Wars: Miami
providerSeries.description: Bidding for more ratings, "Storage Wars" producers continue to expand the franchise beyond its 2010 flagship show in California. Following stops in Texas and New York, the series introduces a cast of Magic City buyers hoping to find treasures hidden within storage lockers. Local auctioneers Bob Nichols and Jerry Mahaffey officiate the "wars" that break out among longtime buyer Kevin Pew, fiery Cuban couple Jorge Gomez and Maydel Garcia, married duo Greg and Lindsey Atz, and cousins Yorgen Ugalde and Christian Fernandez.

providerSeries.title: Strange World
providerSeries.description: Host Alex Hannaford investigates some of the strangest phenomena of our times.

providerSeries.title: Strip the City
providerSeries.description: Explore the geological, architectural and technological foundations of the world's largest cities.

providerSeries.title: Strip the Cosmos
providerSeries.description: Stripping celestial bodies layer by layer to get at the heart of what makes the universe tick.

providerSeries.title: Styled
providerSeries.description: Styled follows the staging and renovation adventures of Nicole Babb and Caffery Vanhorne, best friends and design experts, as they transform spaces from drab to fab.

providerSeries.title: Success Story
providerSeries.description: Entrepreneur and business executive Scott Clary delves into the journeys of successful achievers - executives, celebrities, influencers and even politicians.

providerSeries.title: Sunset Daze
providerSeries.description: Adding a new wrinkle to reality shows, "Sunset Daze" follows a group of fun-loving friends who are spending their twilight years at the Sun City retirement community in Arizona. And they're spending them like Spring Breakers, lounging poolside, talking about sex, boozing it up at happy hour and making the nightlife scene. Included in the spotlight are sassy New Yorker Gail, a former off-Broadway actress and cabaret singer; "Mr. Romeo" Jack, who enjoys dancing and courting women; and Sandy, nicknamed "The Wild Child," perhaps because of her membership in the Blue Thong Society.

providerSeries.title: Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream
providerSeries.description: Charting the journey of Alexandra Hirschi, aka Supercar Blondie, as she reviews the world's most exclusive and expensive supercars.

providerSeries.title: Supertruckers
providerSeries.description: A team of elite truckers tackle large, challenging, or otherwise unusual jobs.

providerSeries.title: Survival Science
providerSeries.description: Nick Mundt and Laura Schara explore the reason and science behind surviving in the outdoors.

providerSeries.title: Survivor's Remorse
providerSeries.description: Cam Calloway is about to find out the price he'll pay for stardom, love and loyalty. A basketball star in his early 20s, Calloway's life changes after he signs a multimillion-dollar contract with a team in Atlanta. He arrives in Georgia bright-eyed and eager to begin his career, joined by cousin and confidant Reggie Vaughn, who tries to keep Cam focused and free from distractions caused by Cam's blunt-but-loyal sister M-Chuck and opportunistic mom Cassie. Feeling a responsibility to support needy family and friends, Cam wrestles with the rewards and pitfalls of sudden wealth and fame. "Survivor's Remorse" is a half-hour comedy series executive produced by Mike O'Malley ("Yes, Dear") and Tom Werner, among others.

providerSeries.title: Survivorman
providerSeries.description: Outdoorsman and survival expert Les Stroud permits himself to be stranded for a week in a remote location with no equipment or supplies apart from his one-man camera rig, documenting his experience and providing insight into how to manage whatever hurdles the wilderness might throw at him.

providerSeries.title: Survivorman
providerSeries.description: The series follows Les Stroud as he spends 10 consecutive days alone in remote locations around the world. Without a safety or camera crew and geared with only a bit of food, Stroud takes to the wilderness to teach viewers how to survive if they find themselves stranded alone. After being dropped in locations such as the mountains of Norway and the desert island of Tiburon, Stroud struggles to find his own food, shelter and fresh water, while avoiding dangerous predators and battling the elements.

providerSeries.title: Swamp Thing
providerSeries.description: An experimental potion mutates Dr. Alec Holland into Swamp Thing, a part-man/part-plant superhero.

providerSeries.title: Sweetbitter
providerSeries.description: A new life awaits 22-year-old Tess when she arrives friendless in New York City and lacking any specific ambitions beyond finding a job. Her charm and observational nature lead to an invitation to train at one of the city's best restaurants. She thinks it is a temporary place to wait for her life's big break, but Tess is quickly intoxicated by the people she meets and by the chaotic world behind the scenes -- tasting expensive wine, exploring dive bars, learning whom to trust. Her co-workers become her family, and through them she finds a sense of belonging that she has never encountered before.

providerSeries.title: Sweetpea
providerSeries.description: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance; that is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control; Rhiannon's life transforms.

providerSeries.title: Taking Stock
providerSeries.description: Hosted by J.D. Durkin from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, Taking Stock covers market close, big money moves of the day, and industry trends from crypto to A.I. to startups.

providerSeries.title: Tales From The Void
providerSeries.description: An episodic horror anthology series based on the most viral and haunting stories from the r/NoSleep community.

providerSeries.title: Tamar & Vince
providerSeries.description: Introduced to viewers in "Braxton Family Values," Tamar Braxton is the family's sassy youngest sister. This series follows Tamar and music mogul husband Vince Herbert, whom she married in 2008, in their relationship, which centers around her obsession with achieving instant pop stardom and his attempts to keep his sanity while trying to help her reach her goal. While they have an over-the-top lifestyle, Tamar has her hands full dealing with Vince's health issues, her stagnant music career, and pet dog Miracle, who constantly barks and relieves himself everywhere. Through the highs and lows, the couple are out to prove that a husband and wife can mix business with pleasure.

providerSeries.title: Tamar Braxton: Get Ya Life!
providerSeries.description: After nearly losing everything, including herself, the singer is determined to turn her life around and take matters into her own hands by sharing her truth.

providerSeries.title: Taste Panel
providerSeries.description: Three experts evaluate everyday food items in one room; the program identifies which brands perform well in the taste evaluation.

providerSeries.title: TechKnow
providerSeries.description: Recounting how innovations in technology and breakthroughs in knowledge change lives in astonishing ways.

providerSeries.title: Teenage Boss
providerSeries.description: A number of teenagers from diverse families are put in control of the monthly budget so they can learn a thing or two about financial planning.

providerSeries.title: Texas Multi Mamas
providerSeries.description: Raising one child can be a challenge for a parent. So imagine the difficulty of raising twins, triplets or even quadruplets. That's the task that the ladies on this docu-series face. The series follows a group of Texas women who are each raising multiple babies -- twins, triplets or quadruplets. The ladies, who have big personalities, staunch opinions and wild lives, support one another in their moms-of-multiples group. And although they are supportive of one another, each mother thinks that her way of parenting is the correct way to do it.

providerSeries.title: The 6000 Lb Diaries With Dr. Now
providerSeries.description: Following ten morbidly obese individuals who collectively have a combined weight of 6,000 pounds and fight to transform their lives.

providerSeries.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
providerSeries.description: Wealthy planter Jim Bowie relies on the knife he invented after breaking his regular one fighting a bear.

providerSeries.title: The Adventures of Kit Carson
providerSeries.description: Kit Carson and El Toro right wrongs in the Old West.

providerSeries.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
providerSeries.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories.

providerSeries.title: The Alaskans
providerSeries.description: A pair of adventurers are intent on swindling travelers bound for the Yukon Territories during the height of the Klondike Gold Rush.

providerSeries.title: The American Presidency With Bill Clinton
providerSeries.description: Exploring the history of the American presidency with a comprehensive look at a wide variety of presidential action that moved our country forward.

providerSeries.title: The American West
providerSeries.description: AMC has proven its considerable skill in producing historical Western content ("Broken Trail," "Hell on Wheels"). The network dips into the same well again with the limited event series "The American West," a docudrama that shows how, in the aftermath of the Civil War, the United States transforms into the "land of opportunity," a violent world dominated by cowboys, Indians, outlaws and law men. Across eight episodes, little-known stories are told of Western legends such as Jesse James, Billy the Kid, Wyatt Earp, Crazy Horse and Sitting Bull. The series also features exclusive interviews with notable names from classic Western films, including James Caan, Tom Selleck, Kiefer Sutherland, Ed Harris and more.

providerSeries.title: The Animal Breakdown
providerSeries.description: Are pig pens cleaner than your kitchen? Can you see better than a cow? We're down on the farm finding out.

providerSeries.title: The Ark
providerSeries.description: "The Ark" takes place 100 years in the future when planetary colonization missions begin as a necessity to help secure the survival of the human race; after the brave crew of Ark One reaches their destination and finds it uninhabitable, they must survive long enough to locate a new home for themselves and all the ships that follow; the spacecraft's crew must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

providerSeries.title: The Bay City Rollers Show
providerSeries.description: Skits and songs from the band "Bay City Rollers" as well as episode segments from past Krofft shows.

providerSeries.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
providerSeries.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process.

providerSeries.title: The Big Body Hotel
providerSeries.description: Plus-sized people embark on a trip of a lifetime. They check into a hotel designed with larger guests in mind and learn to embrace their bodies in a place where size is no obstacle to enjoying a carefree holiday.

providerSeries.title: The Birthday Boys
providerSeries.description: Executive produced by Bob Odenkirk ("Breaking Bad") and Ben Stiller, "The Birthday Boys" is a scripted original sketch show starring the Los Angeles comedy group of the same name. The Birthday Boys are Jefferson Dutton, Dave Ferguson, Mike Hanford, Tim Kalpakis, Matt Kowalick, Mike Mitchell and Chris VanArtsdalen, whose collective credits include "Parks and Recreation," "The Office," "Portlandia," "Funny or Die," "Comedy Bang! Bang!" and "Conan." Episodes combine a mix of stand-alone and multiact sketches that twist real-life situations and cultural touchstones, taking a page from absurd yet intelligent classic sketch shows "Monty Python," "Kids in the Hall" and Odenkirk's "Mr. Show With Bob and David."

providerSeries.title: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
providerSeries.description: "BMF: Blowing Money Fast" tracks the rise and fall of the most notorious drug syndicate in American history, Black Mafia Family, as chronicled through firsthand accounts of BMF members, insiders, associates, and celebrity figures close to the Flenory family. The series focuses on Meech's time in Atlanta, where he set up East Coast BMF headquarters and launched an entertainment company to promote rap artists in the early 2000s. He and his crew spent gobs of money on strippers and champagne at dance clubs and lounges while rubbing shoulders with P. Diddy and Lil Jon.

providerSeries.title: The Boo Crew
providerSeries.description: Discussions and interviews about all things horror.

providerSeries.title: The CEO Series
providerSeries.description: A look into the CEO's personal story, mindset, and business and industry; each episode profiles a business leader and their respective business.

providerSeries.title: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality
providerSeries.description: "The Chrisleys: Back to Reality" begins during the wake of the family's controversy and upheaval with Todd and Julie in federal prison and follows the family as their parents are eventually pardoned, released from prison and return home. The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family--Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam.

providerSeries.title: The Cocktail Lab
providerSeries.description: Joe Gitter shows how to achieve two high-end cocktail elements at home: fat-washed spirits and clear ice.

providerSeries.title: The Conners
providerSeries.description: The Conners continue to face the daily struggles of life in Lanford, grappling with parenthood, dating, financial pressures and aging in working-class America; with love, humor and perseverance, the family prevails.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

providerSeries.title: The Cops
providerSeries.description: Up close and personal with the Bodycam Squad, cops armed with the latest body cameras policing the frontline; following them as they crack down on lawbreakers across Staffordshire; quelling late night brawls and swooping on inter-city drug dealers.

providerSeries.title: The Couple Next Door
providerSeries.description: A young couple develop a fast friendship with their new neighbors when they move to an idyllic suburb; but the relationship soon takes some unexpected and sinister turns.

providerSeries.title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
providerSeries.description: Driven by faith, family and American tradition, three young cowboys, Bubba Thompson, Cody Harris and Chris Booger Brown, work hard to build their cattle business in Alabama and live according to an old-fashioned cowboy code.

providerSeries.title: The Cozy Test Kitchen
providerSeries.description: Fall recipes and comfort foods from the Test Kitchen.

providerSeries.title: The Curse of Oak Island
providerSeries.description: Oak Island is a tree-covered island on the south shore of Nova Scotia that has intrigued treasure hunters for more than 200 years. It is believed that the island is hiding one of the greatest treasures of all time, but no one has been able to find it. Enter Rick and Marty Lagina, brothers from Michigan who have bought the rights to much of the island to try to solve the mystery. The two use modern technology and good old American know-how to look for the treasure. But it won't be easy as the search is expensive and dangerous -- several people have died trying to strike it rich on Oak Island, inspiring the titular curse. The Laginas hope to avoid the curse long enough to find the treasure before they run out of money... or worse.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

providerSeries.title: The Demolition Man
providerSeries.description: Traveling across the globe, "The Demolition Man" takes in the sights of some of the most complicated demolition projects from all over the world.

providerSeries.title: The Diana Story
providerSeries.description: Exploring the life of Princess Diana.

providerSeries.title: The Dick Van Dyke Show
providerSeries.description: Considered to be one of television's classics, "The Dick Van Dyke Show" centers on the personal and professional lives Rob Petrie, a writer on the fictional Alan Brady Show. He's happily married to former dancer Laura, and they have a young son, Ritchie. The plots generally revolve around problems at work -- where Rob got into various comedic jams with fellow writers Buddy Sorrell, Sally Rogers and producer Mel Cooley -- or at home.

providerSeries.title: The Disappearance of William Tyrrell
providerSeries.description: The hosts shed light on the disappearance of three-year-old William Tyrrell, which sparked an extensive manhunt, yet the case remains unsolved.

providerSeries.title: The Disaster Diaries
providerSeries.description: Exploring natural disasters, how scientists try to forecast them and how people living in danger zones can try to anticipate and prepare for cataclysms.

providerSeries.title: The Dish
providerSeries.description: Byron and Rachel Talbott show how restaurant quality meals can be made at home.

providerSeries.title: The Disruptors
providerSeries.description: We dive deep into the lives and minds of visionary entrepreneurs, innovators and change-makers who are revolutionizing industries and shaping the future.

providerSeries.title: The Divide
providerSeries.description: Murders of a family in their Philadelphia home 12 years ago led to the conviction of two construction workers. The sentence quelled rising racial tension and made a name for DA Adam Page. Now, Innocence Initiative caseworker Christine Rosa believes that one of the two convicts isn't guilty, and she struggles to stop his impending execution. Working to exonerate him, she clashes with Page, who would uphold the verdict and his reputation. Faced with the question of a man's innocence but motivated by their history -- their own divide -- they struggle within the justice system.

providerSeries.title: The Edible Road Show
providerSeries.description: Exploring regional and ethnic influences around various locales in Canada.

providerSeries.title: The FBI Files
providerSeries.description: Behind the scenes of major case investigations.

providerSeries.title: The Flying Kestrel
providerSeries.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel with the intention of restoring it and breaking the land-speed record. Following the events from restoration to record day.

providerSeries.title: The Grand Party Hotel
providerSeries.description: The secret life of one of the most popular hotels in Britain; the hotel is situated in the heart of Liverpool and people flock there from all over the UK to celebrate important moments.

providerSeries.title: The Grill Next Door
providerSeries.description: Morgan Bolling is on a smoky mission: to empower everyone, everywhere with the tips, techniques, and recipes that make "fear of the grill" a thing of the past.

providerSeries.title: The Institute
providerSeries.description: A group of psychic children unites to take on the shadowy organization that has kidnapped them and claims to be using their power to "save the world."

providerSeries.title: The Island
providerSeries.description: A deadly virus infects a small community living on the island of Sløborn, between Denmark and Germany, in the North Sea.

providerSeries.title: The Joy of Painting with Bob Ross
providerSeries.description: Bob Ross offers tips and shares painting techniques.

providerSeries.title: The Last 24 Hours
providerSeries.description: A look at the final hours of some of the world's most famous people.

providerSeries.title: The Librarians
providerSeries.description: Cued by the popular "The Librarian" trilogy, this series introduces new members of an ancient group protecting mystical artifacts. Hidden below the Metropolitan Public Library, the secret society's longtime leader is Flynn Carsen, whose job has become very complicated. To help, the Library recruits Eve, a counterterrorism agent responsible for organizational security; Jacob, who has encyclopedic knowledge of art, architecture and history; Cassandra, who links auditory/sensory hallucinations to memory; and Ezekiel, a skilled thief and master technician. Overseeing them is Jenkins, the reclusive caretaker of the Library's sleepy little annex in Oregon. Noah Wyle executive produces and recurs as Flynn, the role he played in the movie series.

providerSeries.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
providerSeries.description: A Librarian -- a custodian of a magical repository of the world's most powerful and dangerous supernatural artifacts -- from the past travels to the present and finds himself unable to return to his own time. But the road to the top is full of personal and professional obstacles, including the stresses of living and working together for the first time in years. The sisters' strong personalities mixed with the pressure of wanting to succeed test their ability to work together. Also complicating matters is the Lylas' early realization that they don't see eye to eye with their management team.

The series blends dramatic scenes, archival footage and visual effects to show how notorious wiseguys like Charles "Lucky" Luciano and Benjamin "Bugsy" Siegel transformed from neighborhood gang members in the early 1900s to murderous entrepreneurs and bootleggers. Included are exclusive interviews with former New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, Meyer Lansky II, Chazz Palminteri, Drea de Matteo, Joe Mantegna, Frankie Valli, Mob attorney and former Las Vegas mayor Oscar Goodman, noted author and historian David Pietrusza, and many others.

Known widely for offering guests the chance to take DNA tests to prove or disprove paternity -- usually with guests breaking out in tears of joy or sorrow -- Povich's show also frequently utilizes lie-detector tests. Cheaters and out-of-control teens are often featured on the show, and episodes occasionally focus on outrageous moments that have been captured on video.

He avoids attention, as he prefers a life lived in the margins, going unseen and unnoticed. But one morning, Lukas witnesses a home invasion and has no choice but to get involved. Forced back into the very world he's been trying to escape, Lukas must confront his past or risk losing the people he loves.

As she makes the journey, she discovers that she possesses a mysterious supernatural power that she must now learn to control, not only to save herself but to defend the world against the tyranny of a fanatical religious dictator.

Each episode follows two agencies as they manage high-level stakes and killer deadlines while preparing campaigns for actual brands, and then the agencies go head-to-head with presentations known in the advertising industry as "the pitch."

providerSeries.title: The Re-Inventors

Hosts Matt Hunter and Jeremy MacPherson dig up some of those of yore to see how the ideas would fare in the modern world. The guys work with a team to examine original blueprints, build prototypes and test the inventions to see how well they work. Some that the hosts want to tackle are a submarine from the late 1500s, a 14th-century machine using wind power to propel a wagon, and a 1950s design combining a Ford Thunderbird with airplane parts to make a flying car.

Science teacher Steve Spangler hosts the show, providing step-by-step demonstrations of the DIY experiments that help explain scientific principles. Among the experiments presented is one that gained Spangler fame, in which he showed what happens when a mint candy is dropped into a bottle of diet soda. On the show, he explains the "why" and "how" behind the experiment and what cause the soda to react with the candy.

providerSeries.title: Xploration Earth 2050
providerSeries.description: 2050 is still decades away, but what might the world be like in that year? What new technology will be available? Will robots be commonplace? Will space tourism thrive? "Xploration Earth 2050" investigates some of the questions. The host speaks with entrepreneurs whose businesses focus on futuristic ideas and products in automotive technology, consumer electronics and health care. Scientists, doctors and science-fiction writers also explore the questions posed. The show also looks at older sci-fi movies to see how many proposed ideas have come to fruition.

providerSeries.title: Xploration Outer Space
providerSeries.description: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.
